text.title: 零件而已
text.objectives: 对战斗之痕中倒下的士兵使用卡尔德的锯子，收集15套破烂的装备零件。
text.description: 我一直想缝制一只憎恶。听上去很简单，但是实际操作起来很是麻烦。我缺少替换的部件！$B$B首先，我需要一批零件。大量零件。收集工作就交给你来完成。$B$B不用太挑剔：人类或是兽人的装备……都可以。只是零件而已。$B$B你最好去战斗之痕拆解那些倒下士兵身上的装备，大部分装备使用的零件都不错。$B$B<卡尔德递给你一柄满是锈迹和缺口的锯子，露出了和善的笑容。>
text.progress: Did you get my parts? Let me see them!
text.completion:
<Calder peers into the sack of extremities and licks his lips with a dry, black tongue.>

Oh my. This is exciting.

Aren't you excited, $N?

english.title: Parts-is-Parts
english.objectives: Use Calder's Bonesaw on corpses within the Battlescar and collect 15 Severed Extremities.
english.description: I've always wanted to try making an abomination. It looks simple enough, but you know how it is when you learn things from a book. There's no substitute for doing!$B$BFirst, I'm going to need parts. Lots of parts. And you're going to get them for me.$B$BNo need to be picky: human, orc... it doesn't matter. Parts is parts.$B$BJust be sure the corpses you harvest come from the Battlescar, so I know they're fresh.$B$B<Calder presses a rusted, gore-covered bonesaw into your hands and smiles disarmingly.>
english.progress: Did you get my parts? Let me see them!
english.completion:
<Calder peers into the sack of extremities and licks his lips with a dry, black tongue.>

Oh my. This is exciting.

Aren't you excited, $N?

text.title: 心脏而已
text.objectives: 杀死战斗之痕以南的震地蛮兽，取回巨大的科多兽之心。
text.description: 呀……多么可爱的零件！螺栓、板材、内衬和锁件……我很饥饿呢。$B$B工作为重。把这些部件组装起来后，我需要一颗强大的心脏来提供血液循环的动力。我倒是很乐意献出自己的心脏，但是和这尊躯壳一比，它就像干瘪的果核。$B$B这可不行，我需要更强劲的心脏。去战斗之痕以南杀死那些体型庞大的震地公牛，取回科多兽之心。
text.progress: You've gotta have heart, $N. All you really need is heart.
text.completion:
<Calder grasps the gigantic heart in both hands, squeezing it and listening to the valves slurp and squish.>

<His pale mask of a face splits open into an enormous, childlike grin.>

It is so very important to love one's work, wouldn't you agree, $N?

english.title: Hearts-is-Hearts
english.objectives: Slay a Landquaker Bull south of the Battlescar and collect an Enormous Kodo Heart.
english.description: These parts - so lovely! Muscle and sinew and fingers and toes ... I am SO hungry right now.$B$BBut work must come first. Once I stitch this pile of parts together I'm going to need a heart strong enough to pump sludge through this rat's nest of veins. I would use my own heart, but it's a shriveled up husk resembling a turnip.$B$BNo, I need some real power. Get me a kodo heart from one of those giant landquaker bulls to the south of the Battlescar.
english.progress: You've gotta have heart, $N. All you really need is heart.
english.completion:
<Calder grasps the gigantic heart in both hands, squeezing it and listening to the valves slurp and squish.>

<His pale mask of a face splits open into an enormous, childlike grin.>

It is so very important to love one's work, wouldn't you agree, $N?

text.title: 装饰而已
text.objectives: 击败战斗之痕远端的凯旋上尉，取回闪亮的徽记。
text.description: 我的憎恶逐渐成型了！现在只需要往他的身上里塞点有用的玩意儿就大功告成了。$B$B$n，我说的是徽记。这可马虎不得。在缝制憎恶的过程中，他的徽记受到了严重的损伤，最好能用聪明人的替换一下。$B$B我看联盟官员的徽记就不错。去战斗之痕的远端击败一个凯旋上尉，注意不要弄坏他的徽记哦。
text.progress: Brraaaaaaiiinnnnss...
text.completion:
<Calder holds the brains in an outstretched hand while withdrawing a gore-caked multi-tool from his belt.>

Wonderful work! Now the secret here is to leave the reptilian nervous systems intact while removing the higher cognitive functions. We can't have our new friend developing a conscience or remembering he's Alliance...

<Calder digs and snips at the brain, removing large chunks.>

And... we're finished! How lovely.

english.title: Smarts-is-Smarts
english.objectives: Kill a Triumph Captain on the far side of the Battlescar and acquire a Fresh Brain.
english.description: My monstrosity is taking shape! All that's left is to stuff his skull with something useful.$B$BI'm talking about brains, $n. And here I'm going to be picky. The abomification process causes significant brain damage so it's best to start with someone smart.$B$BOne of the Alliance officers should do nicely. Seek out one of the Captains on the far side of the Battlescar and try not to damage the goods while you kill him.
english.progress: Brraaaaaaiiinnnnss...
english.completion:
<Calder holds the brains in an outstretched hand while withdrawing a gore-caked multi-tool from his belt.>

Wonderful work! Now the secret here is to leave the reptilian nervous systems intact while removing the higher cognitive functions. We can't have our new friend developing a conscience or remembering he's Alliance...

<Calder digs and snips at the brain, removing large chunks.>

And... we're finished! How lovely.

text.title: 巨魔的铁杆伙伴
text.objectives: 与血爪海滩的基加拉交谈。
text.description: 如果你要找些事做，我们需要圈养更多迅猛龙。到南边的岛上去找我们的管理员吧，他们会给你安排工作的。$B$B而且他们也确实需要帮助，人多好办事嘛。

english.title: A Troll's Truest Companion
english.objectives: Speak to Kijara on Bloodtalon Shore.
english.description: If ya lookin' for something ta do, we need some more raptors moved over to da pens. If ya head over to da island south of here, you can be meetin' with our caretakers and dey can set ya up.$B$BDey might appreciate a hand too. Got ta be spreadin' da love, ya know?

text.title: 拯救幼崽
text.objectives: 使用血爪之哨，营救12只丢失的血爪幼崽。
text.description: 实际上，我确实有些非常重要的事需要你的帮助，兄弟。$B$B我们的迅猛龙幼崽被附近岛上的某些家伙偷走了。起初我还以为它们只是跑远了，或者回归了大自然，但是现在我们已经丢失了超过一打的幼崽。$B$B请到西北边的扎拉赞恩之墓去，把那些小家伙领回来。可怜的小东西。

english.title: Saving the Young
english.objectives: Use the Bloodtalon Whistle to rescue 12 Lost Bloodtalon Hatchlings.
english.description: I actually have somethin' really important dat I could use help with, if ya be willin', mon.$B$BOur hatchlins' are bein' stolen by someone on da next island. At first I thought dey were just runnin' away or that nature be claimin' dem, but we are missin' more than a dozen of da little guys now.$B$BPlease head to Zalazane's Fall to da northwest and point da little hatchlins back dis way. Poor tings.

text.title: 给迷失者的怜悯
text.objectives: 杀死8只被腐蚀的血爪迅猛龙。
text.description: 偷迅猛龙的家伙用魔法腐蚀了它们。它们正在带着这种腐蚀成长起来，而且恐怕我们对此无能为力，只能帮助它们安乐死了。到西北边的扎拉赞恩之墓去，搞定这件事吧。$B$B希望你能坚持下来。我自己可下不了手，即便我心里清楚这是必需的。

english.title: Mercy for the Lost
english.objectives: Kill 8 Corrupted Bloodtalon Raptors.
english.description: The fiend who stole our raptors has been corruptin' dem with some kind of magic. Now dat dey've grown with dis corruption inside of them, I fear dere's little we can be doin' to save dem outside grantin' them da peace of death. Go ta Zalazane's Fall, northwest of here, an' see da task done.$B$BI hope ya can stomach dae work. I don't tink I could bring myself ta do da deed, even knowin' that it be needed.

text.title: 海巫的配偶
text.objectives: 杀死纳杰特丝，夺取他的宝珠。
text.description: 我对迅猛龙被腐蚀一事进行了简单的调查，发现了这个问题的根源：一个落单的纳迦。他拿着一颗红色的宝珠在我们的迅猛龙幼崽头上晃一晃，它们就……变了。$B$B我敢肯定，他以为自己的偷窃行为和小把戏没有被人察觉到，所以你应该可以打他个措手不及。干掉这个纳迦，把他的邪恶宝珠给我带回来——他就在西北边的扎拉赞恩之墓。
text.progress: Da naga have been our enemies for a long, long time, and our previous encounters with dem have not gone well. It be clear dat dis time will be different. Tings have changed, and you be part of dat change.
text.giverWindow: 纳杰特丝以为能够让暗矛部族与他们最信任的盟友相互残杀。实际上，他不止是低估了巨魔。

english.title: Consort of the Sea Witch
english.objectives: Kill Naj'tess and retrieve his orb.
english.description: I been investigatin' our corrupted Bloodtalons troubles and I think I've found da source. A lone naga. He was holdin' a red orb aloft over our hatchlings and I could see dem... changin'.$B$BI'm certain he tinks his thievery and spellcastin' have gone unnoticed, so ya should be able ta catch him unawares. Kill dis naga and bring me back dat vile orb - you'll be findin' him to da northwest, at Zalazane's Fall.
english.progress: Da naga have been our enemies for a long, long time, and our previous encounters with dem have not gone well. It be clear dat dis time will be different. Tings have changed, and you be part of dat change.
english.giverWindow: Naj'tess thought to turn the Darkspear's most trusted allies against them, but in so doing, he underestimates more than just the trolls.

text.title: 年轻气盛
text.objectives: 捕捉迅爪，把它带回暗矛要塞附近的围栏。
text.description: 你表现得很出色，$n。$B$B莫拉亚叫我送些新的迅猛龙过去训练，不能让她再等下去啦！我让其他的新人送了一些迅猛龙过去，不过还有一只特殊的迅猛龙，我早就答应给莫拉亚送去的。$B$B迄今为止，迅爪是我们这里最敏捷、最勇敢的年轻迅猛龙，但它有点野性未改。我把套索给你，而你要做的就是在这座岛上的某处抓到它，把它送到主岛上的围栏里去。它可不好对付哟。

english.title: Young and Vicious
english.objectives: Capture Swiftclaw and bring him back to the pens near Darkspear Hold.
english.description: Ya be a good one, $n.$B$BMoraya was askin' for new raptors ta train. We shouldn't keep her waitin' any longa! I have a few other recruits bringin' some over as well, but I have a special one dat I've been promisin' Moraya for a while.$B$BSwiftclaw be one of our fastest and bravest young raptors yet, but he can be a bit unruly. I'll lend ya da lasso, I just need ya to catch him somewhere on da island here and steer him over to da pens on da main isle. I doubt he'll be makin' it easy on ya though.

objectiveDetails.description: 将迅爪送回迅猛龙围栏

text.title: 兵临城下
text.objectives: 杀死6名尖啸女妖。
text.description: $n，暗夜精灵在这段日子里教会了我们很多东西，比如我们是谁，以及我们来自哪里。$B$B感谢他们……感谢这个地方……我们不再是野兽了。我们已经重新获得了自由意志。$B$B被遗忘者要的不仅仅是土地。$B$B他们还想从我们这里夺走某件器物。这件器物可以不受约束地让所有人类都受到狼人诅咒的影响。绝不能让他们得逞。$B$B希尔瓦娜斯的女妖已经逼近了。请帮助我们消灭她们。
text.completion: You are as good as I remember, $N.  It is good to have you back.

english.title: At Our Doorstep
english.objectives: Kill 6 Howling Banshees.
english.description: The night elves have taught us much during this time, $n.  They've taught us who we are and where we come from.$B$BThanks to them... thanks to this place... we're no longer mere beasts.  We have regained free will.$B$BThe Forsaken aren't here for our land alone.$B$BThey're looking for something we possess.  An artifact capable of uncontrollably spreading the Curse to all humanity.  We cannot let them find it.$B$BSylvanas's banshees have come very close.  Help my trackers take them out.
english.completion: You are as good as I remember, $N.  It is good to have you back.

text.title: 仪式前的准备
text.objectives: 将6片月叶交给法珊德拉。
text.description: 如你所知，一开始我们都以为狼人的诅咒仅仅是个异端邪说。$B$B在与恶魔的战争失利后，德鲁伊背弃誓言，偏离了他们恪守的平衡之道，让兽性占据了心灵。$B$B他们被放逐到翡翠梦境，在树下进入永恒的沉睡，但狼人的诅咒却早已蔓延开来。$B$B我们的仪式可以帮助你们恢复平衡。将生长在塔多伦这一带的月叶带给我吧。
text.progress: You've returned, $N.
text.completion: These simple leaves grow by Elune's grace.  They will help your mind understand the need for balance and your soul will permanently earn mastery over the beast.

english.title: Preparations
english.objectives: Bring 6 Moonleafs to Vassandra.
english.description: What you know as the Curse began as a heresy among our brethren.$B$BFaced with a losing battle against demonic forces, the Druids of the Pack eschewed the balance they were sworn to and allowed the beast to overtake them.$B$BThey were banished to the Emerald Dream where they live in eternal slumber under a tree identical to this one, but not before their curse spread to others.$B$BToday our ceremony will restore balance to your people. Bring me the leaf that grows only in Tal'doren's vicinity.
english.progress: You've returned, $N.
english.completion: These simple leaves grow by Elune's grace.  They will help your mind understand the need for balance and your soul will permanently earn mastery over the beast.

text.title: 完美的香水
text.objectives: 用皇冠古龙水瓶向10个人喷洒古龙水。
text.description: $c，看上去你是个能干的家伙。我们来一次双赢的合作如何？$B$B皇冠公司希望将我们最新的节日主题产品小样提供给尽可能多的潜在客户。如果你能帮助我们推广我们的心血之作，也许你能得到一些非常精彩的皇冠公司产品！$B$B朋友，花些力气，我们提供令你满意的报酬，如何？
text.progress: That perfume's not going to spray itself, you know.$B$BGet going!
text.completion: Great work, $N! People will come running to buy Crown perfumes now that they've had a chance to sample their wonders.$B$BHere's a little something for helping us out.

english.title: A Perfect Puff of Perfume
english.objectives: Spray 10 people with the Crown Perfume Sprayer.
english.description: You look like a real go-getter, $c. How about we work out a little win-win scenario?$B$BCrown's looking to offer samples of our latest holiday-themed products to as many potential customers as possible. Help us share the love, and we'll give you discounts on some great Crown merchandise!$B$BYour time, our money, friend. What do you say?
english.progress: That perfume's not going to spray itself, you know.$B$BGet going!
english.completion: Great work, $N! People will come running to buy Crown perfumes now that they've had a chance to sample their wonders.$B$BHere's a little something for helping us out.

text.title: The Crone of the Kraul
text.objectives: Kill Charlga Razorflank in Razorfen Kraul.
text.description: The five of us have communed with the spirits, and found the source of the Quilboar's aggression. Charlga Razorflank leads them from within Razorfen Kraul. She holds the promise of Agamaggan's resurrection over their heads, whipping the tribes into frenzy to raze and pillage the land for her.$B$BPlease, $c, put a stop to this. Without Charlga, the quilboar may not be saved, but they may at least be less dangerous.
text.completed: Return to Mahka at Firestone Point in Southern Barrens.

english.title: The Crone of the Kraul
english.objectives: Kill Charlga Razorflank in Razorfen Kraul.
english.description: The five of us have communed with the spirits, and found the source of the Quilboar's aggression. Charlga Razorflank leads them from within Razorfen Kraul. She holds the promise of Agamaggan's resurrection over their heads, whipping the tribes into frenzy to raze and pillage the land for her.$B$BPlease, $c, put a stop to this. Without Charlga, the quilboar may not be saved, but they may at least be less dangerous.
english.completed: Return to Mahka at Firestone Point in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 狮鹫骑士的噩梦
text.objectives: 对凯旋作战狮鹫使用托穆沙的钩子令蛮锤佣兵跌下坐骑，并杀死5名佣兵。
text.description: 联盟雇佣蛮锤佣兵来控制战斗之痕的领空。我相信这些狮鹫骑士就是在陶拉祖之战中朝我们投掷火焰弹的家伙。$B$B我决意取得领空权。$B$B眼尖的$c就可以对付那些飞得够低的蛮锤矮人。带上这个。瞄准狮鹫，当他们落地后，请不要留情。
text.progress: The Wildhammer are fierce fighters, in the air or on the ground. How goes the battle?
text.completion:
<Tomusa snorts as he takes back his hook.>

Vengeance feels hollow. Still. I could not allow them to go unpunished.

english.title: Flightmare
english.objectives: Use Tomusa's Hook on Triumph War Gryphons to dismount and kill 5 Wildhammer Mercenaries.
english.description: The Alliance has hired in Wildhammer mercenaries to control the skies over the Battlescar. I believe these same gryphon-riders were the ones to firebomb Taurajo during the attack.$B$BI want our skies scoured clean.$B$BThe wildhammer dwarves fly low enough for a sharp-eyed $c to hook them. Take this. Target their gryphons and dismount the riders - once grounded, show them no mercy.
english.progress: The Wildhammer are fierce fighters, in the air or on the ground. How goes the battle?
english.completion:
<Tomusa snorts as he takes back his hook.>

Vengeance feels hollow. Still. I could not allow them to go unpunished.

text.title: 牛头人的复仇
text.objectives: 前往南贫瘠之地的锐矛村，找到加恩·石塔。
text.description: 牛头人天性温和，但是有时正义会激起我们的愤怒，促使我们拿起武器。$B$B我的老朋友加恩·石塔得知陶拉祖的大屠杀事件后顿时怒火中烧，连氏族的长者也没法令他平息下来。$B$B$n，他有了自己的想法，打算跟一小撮志同道合的族人偷袭联盟。$B$B如果你也想复仇的话，就去东南方巴尔莫丹的山脚下找他吧。
text.completion:
<Gann looks you up and down.>

We could use your help, $c. But this is not a skirmish. We fight here to strike a killing blow... or die trying.
text.completed: 去找南贫瘠之地锐矛村的加恩·石塔。

english.title: Tauren Vengeance
english.objectives: Seek out Gann Stonespire at Spearhead in Southern Barrens.
english.description: My people are not wrathful by nature, but sometimes a thirst for justice causes us to take up arms in anger.$B$BMy old friend Gann Stonespire, on learning of the butchery in Taurajo, flew into a fury. Tribal elders could no longer hold his rage in check.$B$BNow he has all but parted ways with the Horde. He's gone rogue, $n, and seeks to lash out at the Alliance with a small band of like-minded partisans.$B$BIf you, too, seek vengeance, you will find him southeast of here, at the foot of Bael Modan.
english.completion:
<Gann looks you up and down.>

We could use your help, $c. But this is not a skirmish. We fight here to strike a killing blow... or die trying.
english.completed: Seek out Gann Stonespire at Spearhead in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 玛卡的恳求
text.objectives: 跟曼科里克谈一谈。
text.description: 他的身影在我的脑海中挥之不去，$n。我时常能在深夜里听到他的怒吼，夹杂着狂怒与痛苦的回声在原野的空气中震颤。我甚至无法去想象他的孤独和他的痛苦……$B$B我必须请你帮助我，去见见曼科里克，告诉他，让他来见我。
text.completion: Thank you, $N.
text.completed: 去找火石岗哨的玛卡。

english.title: Mahka's Plea
english.objectives: Talk to Mankrik.
english.description: I can't put him out of my mind, $n. Sometimes at night, I can hear his howls of rage and suffering, echoing across the plains. To imagine him out there, alone and in such pain...$B$BPlease, I must ask a favor of you. Go to Mankrik, and tell him to come see me.
english.completion: Thank you, $N.
english.completed: Return to Mahka at Firestone Point.

text.title: 情报战
text.objectives: 杀死贫瘠之地特工，取回军情七处情报。
text.description: 我相信联盟派出了探子收集战地情报。他们趁猎手外出时袭击了陶拉祖。他们对加杜尔的每一步行动都了如指掌。$B$B$n，我是不会被打败的。绝不会。我们要赢得情报战的胜利。$B$B我连续接到联盟特工藏身附近的报告，他们就潜伏在这些高墙外。杀死他们，取回一些有用的情报。
text.progress: Watch your back, $c. They could be anywhere.
text.completion:
Hah! The fool didn't destroy these orders.

Let's see what we can learn...

english.title: Intelligence Warfare
english.objectives: Kill a Barrens Operative and retrieve the SI:7 Briefings.
english.description: I am convinced the Alliance is using spies to scout the field and pass along information. They knew to strike at Taurajo while the hunters were afield. And they countered every one of Gar'dul's moves like he was an open book.$B$BWell $n, I for one will not be outplayed. Not here. We will win the battle for intelligence.$B$BEven now I hear reports of Alliance operatives slinking around in the shadows, especially here, outside these very walls. Kill them and bring me back something of use.
english.progress: Watch your back, $c. They could be anywhere.
english.completion:
Hah! The fool didn't destroy these orders.

Let's see what we can learn...

text.title: 一滴优雅的古龙水
text.objectives: 用皇冠古龙水瓶向10个人喷洒古龙水。
text.description: 看起来，你是个颇有事业心的$c。我们做一笔小交易如何？$B$B皇冠公司希望将我们最新的节日主题产品小样提供给尽可能多的潜在客户。如果你能帮助我们推广我们的心血之作，也许你能得到一些非常精彩的皇冠公司产品！$B$B朋友，花些力气，我们提供令你满意的报酬，如何？
text.progress: The cologne isn't going to give itself out, you know.$B$BGet spraying!
text.completion: Nice work, $N! People will be buying Crown colognes by the crate-load now that they've had a chance to try them.$B$BHere's a little something for helping us out.

english.title: A Cloudlet of Classy Cologne
english.objectives: Spray 10 people with the Crown Cologne Sprayer.
english.description: You seem the enterprising sort, $c. How about we make a little deal?$B$BCrown wants to offer samples of our latest holiday-themed products to as many potential customers as we can. Help us share the love while earning some fantastic Crown merchandise!$B$BYour time, our money, friend. What do you think?
english.progress: The cologne isn't going to give itself out, you know.$B$BGet spraying!
english.completion: Nice work, $N! People will be buying Crown colognes by the crate-load now that they've had a chance to try them.$B$BHere's a little something for helping us out.

text.title: 糖果闪电战
text.objectives: 将皇冠巧克力样品抛掷给10个人。
text.description: 我知道你在找活干，$c。我们一起可以赚点小钱，你意下如何？$B$B皇冠要向城里的每一位潜在的客户推销我们最新的节日主题的产品样品。如果你能帮我们，我们会送你一些珍贵的皇冠商品的！$B$B我出钱，你出力，怎么样，朋友？
text.progress: You know, those chocolates aren't going to fling themselves at people.$B$BYou need to get to work!
text.completion: Lovely work, $N! People will be tripping over one another to get Crown chocolates now that they've had a chance to taste those sweet, romantic treats.$B$BHere's a little something for helping us out.

english.title: Bonbon Blitz
english.objectives: Toss 10 people samples from the Crown Chocolate Sampler.
english.description: I can see you've got an eye for opportunity, $c. What do you say we make a little coin together?$B$BCrown needs to push samples of our latest holiday-themed products to every potential customer in the city. Help us share the love, and we'll share some of that amazing Crown merchandise with you!$B$BYour time, our money, friend. We got a deal?
english.progress: You know, those chocolates aren't going to fling themselves at people.$B$BYou need to get to work!
english.completion: Lovely work, $N! People will be tripping over one another to get Crown chocolates now that they've had a chance to taste those sweet, romantic treats.$B$BHere's a little something for helping us out.

text.title: 陶拉祖的刽子手
text.objectives: 跟卡索格谈一谈，然后诱出霍索恩将军并击败他。
text.description: 这份情报指出，务必确保联盟指挥营与凯旋壁垒之间的道路畅通无阻。看来霍索恩将军有所行动。$B$B<血柄将文件揉成一团。>$B$B是他，$n！霍索恩，我呸！就是他下令袭击陶拉祖的！我们掌握了他的行踪，就可以对付他了！快，沿着战斗之痕以北的道路走，跟刺客卡索格会面。击败霍索恩，为陶拉祖复仇！
text.completion:
<Upon hearing the news, Bloodhilt snorts. His eyes gleam. He tips his head back and bellows a wet, cackling laugher that echoes between the blackened walls of Desolation hold and reverberates throughout the hills beyond.>

So it is done! The Butcher of Taurajo is felled at last. Cut down in the streets like a dog. Fitting.

You have done well, $N. You've sowed fear into our enemies, and soon we will reap the harvest!
text.giverWindow: 在战斗之痕北面的路上找到卡索格，并与他一起消灭陶拉祖的刽子手。

english.title: The Butcher of Taurajo
english.objectives: Speak with Karthog, then lure out and assassinate General Hawthorne.
english.description: This operative had orders to secure the roadways between the Alliance command and Fort Triumph. General Hawthorne is on the move.$B$B<Bloodhilt crumples the documents in his fist.>$B$BIt's HIM, $n! Hawthorne - I spit the name - he is the one who ordered the assault on Taurajo! Now we know when and where to strike him down. Quickly, follow the road north of the Battlescar and meet up with my assassin Karthog. CRUSH Hawthorne and string his body up along the road!
english.completion:
<Upon hearing the news, Bloodhilt snorts. His eyes gleam. He tips his head back and bellows a wet, cackling laugher that echoes between the blackened walls of Desolation hold and reverberates throughout the hills beyond.>

So it is done! The Butcher of Taurajo is felled at last. Cut down in the streets like a dog. Fitting.

You have done well, $N. You've sowed fear into our enemies, and soon we will reap the harvest!

text.title: Crushing the Crown
text.objectives: Kill 5 Crown Lackeys and use Snagglebolt's Khorium Bomb to damage one Chemical Wagon just west of Orgrimmar's gates in Durotar, then return to Detective Snap Snagglebolt in Orgrimmar.
text.description: This ledger is full of locations, and I need you to investigate and take action, pal. This has gone on long enough.$b$bHere's an entry I want you to check out: it's right outside Orgrimmar's gates, to the west! That can't be good. Get out there and rough 'em up.$b$bOh, and if you see something big and dangerous enough that it needs destroying, toss this bomb at it.
text.progress: Did you teach 'em a lesson?
text.completion: Good job, kid. You deserve a little somethin'. And hey, come back tomorrow if you get the time; I might have a job for ya.

text.title: 基础教程：攻击目标
text.objectives: 摧毁6个蒂基面具假人。
text.description: 好了，伙计，我们先从简单的开始。首先我得确认你知道如何使用手里的武器。$B$B去拿那些蒂基面具假人练练手，慢点来，自然一点。我会观察你的表现，然后决定下一步要怎么做。
text.completion: Not bad, mon. Ya have a natural flow to ya swings - you may have a talent for dis.$B$BSome rough edges ta be sure, but we'll get dose ironed out here and I'll teach ya a few new tings as we go.

english.title: The Basics: Hitting Things
english.objectives: Destroy 6 Tiki Targets.
english.description: Alright, mon. We start with da basics. I need ta know dat you know how ta swing dat weapon you're totin' around.$B$BGo thrash dose tiki targets. Take it slowly. Natural-like. I'll watch ya fighting form and we'll go from dere.
english.completion: Not bad, mon. Ya have a natural flow to ya swings - you may have a talent for dis.$B$BSome rough edges ta be sure, but we'll get dose ironed out here and I'll teach ya a few new tings as we go.

text.title: The Arts of a Warrior
text.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Charge. Practice using Charge against a Tiki Target.
text.description: As ya get bettah' at fightin', you'll start to find new tings that ya nevah knew you could do.$B$BWanna see? Go, train up some, and learn someting new.$B$B'Den come back and ya can show me.

text.title: 粗暴的开始
text.objectives: 收集6块蛮鬃豹皮。
text.description: 咱们来给你找点事做吧。先从简单的开始，伙计。$B$B岛上的豹子在猎杀我们的野猪。跟它们分享食物可不成！如果你今晚还想填饱肚子的话，就得想办法保证那些野猪还活着。$B$B岛上到处都是豹子。去把它们的毛皮给我拿来。
text.progress: I doubt dey too much of a challenge, mon, but they'll still claw up ya ankles if ya don't stay quick footed.
text.completion: Dese are some fine pelts, $G boy:girl;. We could make some hefty cloaks outta dese.

english.title: A Rough Start
english.objectives: Retrieve 6 Wildmane Cat Pelts.
english.description: Lets put dose skills ta use. I'll start ya off easy, mon.$B$BThere be cats killing our boars. Dat food ain't for sharin'. Dose boars are gonna need ta be alive if ya be wanting food tonight.$B$BDey're all over the island. Bring me some cat pelts.
english.progress: I doubt dey too much of a challenge, mon, but they'll still claw up ya ankles if ya don't stay quick footed.
english.completion: Dese are some fine pelts, $G boy:girl;. We could make some hefty cloaks outta dese.

text.title: 试炼场
text.objectives: 同暗矛狱卒交谈，然后进入试炼场，杀死一名恶鳞斥候俘虏。
text.description: 你干得很不错，$c。我还可以再教你一些手段，但我不会再让你对着假人浪费时间了。$B$B现在我给你安排最后一项考验吧，伙计。到这个区域中间的试炼场去，跟一个真正的敌人交手——对方对你可是毫不留情的哟。等你准备好了，告诉那边的狱卒一声就行了。
text.completion: Ya handle yerself quite well. Ya gonna be quite powerful some day.

english.title: Proving Pit
english.objectives: Speak to a Darkspear Jailor, then enter the proving pit and kill a Captive Spitescale Scout.
english.description: Ya done quite well for ya'self, $c. I'm sure I could teach ya a trick or two here and dere, but I not be wastin' ya time on tiki targets no longer.$B$Bl put one last trial before ya den, mon. Head over to da provin' pit in the middle of dis area and fight a real baddy - one dat wants ta kill ya back. Just let the jailor by the pit know when ya ready.
english.completion: Ya handle yerself quite well. Ya gonna be quite powerful some day.

text.title: 喜出望外
text.objectives: 向暗矛要塞中的沃金报到。
text.description: 你真是令我们喜出望外，伙计。我敢说，你的天赋对我们肯定是大有帮助。你不用再跟这些新兵蛋子混在一起啦。$B$B到东南边的村子里去吧，闯出你自己的天地来。到处帮帮忙，我相信你很快就会出人头地的。
text.completion: Ya tha new recruit everyone's talkin' about, eh? Welcome ta tha Darkspear.

english.title: More Than Expected
english.objectives: Report to Vol'jin at Darkspear Hold.
english.description: Ya definitely more den expected, mon. I'm sure dere's more important stuff we can be usin' ya talents on now. Ya don't need ta hang out with da newbloods no more.$B$BHead down to da village to da southeast and make yaself known. Lend a hand here and there and I'm sure ya make yer way up to sometin' more prestigious quick enough.
english.completion: Ya tha new recruit everyone's talkin' about, eh? Welcome ta tha Darkspear.

text.title: 粉碎皇冠药剂公司
text.objectives: 消灭5个皇冠暴徒，并使用滑栓的氪金炸弹摧毁银松森林中安伯米尔外面的一台药剂车。然后返回奥格瑞玛，去见侦探斯奈普·滑栓。
text.description: 这账本上提到了多处地点，我需要你前去调查并采取相应的行动，伙计。不能再拖下去了。$b$b这是我要你调查的一处地点：就在银松森林的安伯米尔外面！他们肯定不会干什么好事。到那儿去解决掉他们。$b$b噢，对了，如果你发现了某些危险的大玩意儿需要当场销毁的话，就朝它丢这个炸弹。
text.progress: Did you teach 'em a lesson?
text.completion: Good job, kid. You deserve a little somethin'. And hey, come back tomorrow if you get the time; I might have a job for ya.

text.title: 夺回镰刀
text.objectives: 在林中小屋吹响塔多伦号角，取回神秘的圣物。
text.description: 自从被遗忘者攻入吉尔尼斯以来，我们就千方百计地确保月神镰刀的藏匿点不被发现。我们总是趁夜将它转移到安全的地点。黑暗游侠始终没有发现……直到现在。$B$B我们最后一次看见他们是在西边的林中小屋。找到他们并吹响这支号角，托比亚斯和他的追踪者就会现身帮你对付黑暗游侠。$B$B你要趁机进入小屋，夺回镰刀。$n，动作要快。绝不能让镰刀落入希尔瓦娜斯之手。
text.progress: Do you have the scythe, $N?
text.completion: I knew we could count on you.  You've done well, $N.

english.title: Take Back What's Ours
english.objectives: Blow the Horn of Tal'doren at the Woods' End Cabin and retrieve the Mysterious Artifact inside.
english.description: Ever since the Forsaken invaded Gilneas, we've tried to keep the location of the Scythe of Elune secret.   We moved it at night to one of many safe locations.  The Dark Rangers got close, but never found it... until now.$B$BThey were last spotted at the Woods' End Cabin, west of here.  Blow this horn when you find them and Tobias and his trackers will engage the Dark Rangers.$B$BOnly then will it be safe for you to venture inside the cabin and take back the scythe.  Hurry, $n.  It must not reach Sylvanas.
english.progress: Do you have the scythe, $N?
english.completion: I knew we could count on you.  You've done well, $N.

text.title: 阿迦玛甘的回声
text.objectives: 收集3颗抛光的野猪神像。
text.description: 我想驱使野猪人的不仅仅是原始的欲望。你是否愿意帮我作进一步的调查？$B$B在西边零星散布着野猪人的聚居点和营地。我注意到了那里的野猪神像。它们远远地闪着光亮，表面光滑可鉴……与其它成堆摆放的废物格外不同。我想这也许是用来崇拜的物体。$B$B给我带些来，好让我检查检查，$n。
text.progress: Do you have the skulls?
text.completion:
Yes, these are clearly symbols of Agamaggan. But if the quilboar are still devoted to their dead god, what is the source of their vicious agression?  It is said Agamaggan was noble, and even gave his life fighting the Burning Legion...

A moment, $N. We must confer with the spirits.

english.title: Echoes of Agamaggan
english.objectives: Collect 3 Polished Boar Skulls.
english.description: I think the quilboar are being driven by more than just crude desire. Would you help me look into this further?$B$BTo the west, scattered among the quilboar's settlements and camps, I've noticed boar skulls. They gleam from a distance, polished smooth...distinct from the remains littered in their waste piles. I think these may be objects of worship.$B$BBring me several of these to examine, $n.
english.progress: Do you have the skulls?
english.completion:
Yes, these are clearly symbols of Agamaggan. But if the quilboar are still devoted to their dead god, what is the source of their vicious agression?  It is said Agamaggan was noble, and even gave his life fighting the Burning Legion...

A moment, $N. We must confer with the spirits.

text.title: 异种蝎的问题
text.objectives: 对异种蝎土丘使用一桶燃烧着的沥青，趁着异种蝎蜂涌而出时杀死10只异种群居蝎。
text.description: 异种蝎！$n，昆虫，或者说类虫生物。它们并不是自然的造物……我们的要塞不巧建在了它们的巢穴附近。$B$B带上这桶燃烧的沥青点燃那些恶心的虫子，迫使它们逃离巢穴。倾倒沥青的时候要当心——异种蝎会蜂涌而出的！$B$B你可以在凄凉要塞的外围找到异种蝎土丘，其外形类似于沙丘。杀死从那里爬出的任何生物。
text.progress:
The Alliance is nothing. Swarms of those critter-crawlys?

<Crawgol shudders.>
text.completion:
You're covered in hot tar and bug juice! Don't worry, friend. It'll come off.

Someday.

english.title: Silithissues
english.objectives: Use the Bucket of Burning Pitch on Silithid Mounds and kill 10 Silithid Swarmers as they emerge.
english.description: The silithid! They're bugs, $n. Or something like bugs. They're not natural... and we built a fortress on the equivalent of an anthill.$B$BTake this burning pitch. It'll set the buggers on fire and plug up their burrows at the same time. Be careful when you pour this stuff on there - the silithid will come out in swarms!$B$BLook for silithid mounds around the exterior of Desolation Hold. They look like heaps of sand. Kill anything that crawls out.
english.progress:
The Alliance is nothing. Swarms of those critter-crawlys?

<Crawgol shudders.>
english.completion:
You're covered in hot tar and bug juice! Don't worry, friend. It'll come off.

Someday.

text.title: 恶臭的东西
text.objectives: 使用滑栓的空气分析器测试6位带有浓郁香气的卫兵周围的空气，然后返回暴风城，去见探员斯尼普·滑栓。
text.description:
这种家伙有不少，对不对？多年以来，热砂集团一直控制着这里的节日生意。但突然之间，这些家伙一下子涌进了市场。他们不是热砂集团的，所以集团派我来调查这件事。这东西并非只有香气，还散发着一股臭味。

拿上这个设备，去分析一下那些卫兵周围的香气云。我想知道他们在那里都加了些什么。这很不正常。
text.progress: You analyze that reek yet, kid?
text.completion: Hey, thanks, kid. Give it over, let's take a look.$B$B<He takes the device from you and fiddles with it.>$B$BOh, that ain't good.

english.title: Something Stinks
english.objectives: Use Snagglebolt's Air Analyzer to test the air around 6 heavily perfumed guards, then return to Inspector Snip Snagglebolt in Stormwind.
english.description:
Get a load of these guys, would ya? Steamwheedle's been handling the business of holidays for years, and all of a sudden, these guys bust into the market. They're not Steamwheedle; the cartel hired me to get to the bottom of this. Something stinks here and it ain't just perfume.

Take this device I brought and go analyze the perfume clouds around the guards. I want to know what they're putting in that stuff. Things ain't natural.
english.progress: You analyze that reek yet, kid?
english.completion: Hey, thanks, kid. Give it over, let's take a look.$B$B<He takes the device from you and fiddles with it.>$B$BOh, that ain't good.

text.title: 香水行动
text.objectives: 被伪装成一个送包裹的人之后，前往暴风城大门外皇冠药剂公司的物资存放处，然后将他们给你的包裹交给暴风城的探员斯尼普·滑栓。
text.description:
我就知道他们干不了什么好事！那里有一些能够影响神志的化学药剂，但现在我手中的样品太少，没办法对它进行分析。我需要更多这种药剂。

不要去花钱买那种东西！我可不想给那些恶棍一个铜板。你要想其它办法把它弄过来。

我会把你伪装成一个送包裹的。我看到那些恶棍正在城门外看守着一批那种货物。过去取包裹，千万不要逗留，否则他们就会认出你！他们会扔给你一只箱子。把箱子带到这里来。
text.progress: Did they toss ya a crate to deliver?
text.completion: You got it, huh? Good job, kid. Top notch. Let's see what we what we got here.$B$B<He cracks open the crate and rummages around inside.
text.end: 从暴风城外皇冠药剂公司物资存放处偷取香水包裹。
text.completed: 去找暴风城的探员斯尼普·滑栓。

english.title: Pilfering Perfume
english.objectives: While disguised as a package-runner, go to the Crown Chemical Company's stockpile outside the gates of Stormwind, then return the package they toss you to Inspector Snip Snagglebolt in Stormwind.
english.description:
I knew they were up to no good! There's some sort of mind-affecting chemical in here, but I can't get a handle on it with such a small sample. I need the real stuff.

Don't just go over there and buy it! I don't want you giving these scumbags one copper. Nah, you gotta get it from the source, discreet-like.

I'll disguise you as a package runner. I saw a stockpile guarded by their goons outside the gates. Go run by, and DON'T stop, or they'll make you! They'll toss you a crate. Bring it back here.
english.progress: Did they toss ya a crate to deliver?
english.completion: You got it, huh? Good job, kid. Top notch. Let's see what we what we got here.$B$B<He cracks open the crate and rummages around inside.
english.end: Steal perfume package from Crown Chemical Co. outside Stormwind
english.completed: Return to Inspector Snip Snagglebolt in Stormwind.

text.title: 友善地交谈……
text.objectives: 前往暴风城港口，向斯内维尔·拉斯罗凯特询问关于供给物资的事情。然后带着他给你的证据回去。
text.description: <你向玛丽恩讲述追查斯内维尔的原因，玛丽恩的脸上露出惊恐的表情。>$B$B你是说，他很可能给我下了药？哦！我竟然受到这样的欺骗，真是难以置信！$B$B如果他已经完成了使命，那么他应该正赶往码头，想要搭上前往南海的船只！$n，绝不能让他逃走。$B$B赶快到暴风城港口去！
text.progress: Did you find the guy, or did he crawl under a rock?
text.completion: You got his ledger? Really? That's great, $N. There's probably loads of good information in here.

english.title: A Friendly Chat...
english.objectives: Go to Stormwind Harbor and question Snivel Rustrocket about the supplies. Return with any evidence he gives you.
english.description: <Marion listens with horror as you tell her why you're trying to track down Snivel.>$B$BYou mean, he might've used some kind of chemical on me? Ew! I can't believe I fell for that fraud!$B$BIf he's finished all of his errands, he's on his way down to the docks to catch a ship to the South Seas! Whatever you do, $n, you can't let him get away with this.$B$BHurry down to Stormwind Harbor before you miss him!
english.progress: Did you find the guy, or did he crawl under a rock?
english.completion: You got his ledger? Really? That's great, $N. There's probably loads of good information in here.

text.title: Crushing the Crown
text.objectives: Kill 5 Crown Lackeys and use Snagglebolt's Khorium Bomb to damage one Chemical Wagon northeast of Westbrook Garrison in Elwynn Forest, then return to Inspector Snip Snagglebolt in Stormwind.
text.description: This ledger is full of locations, and I need you to investigate and take action, pal. This has gone on long enough.$b$bHere's an entry I want you to check out: it's northeast of Westbrook Garrison right outside in Elwynn! That can't be good. Get out there and rough 'em up.$b$bOh, and if you see something big and dangerous enough that it needs destroying, toss this bomb at it.
text.progress: Did you teach 'em a lesson?
text.completion: Good job, kid. You deserve a little somethin'. And hey, come back tomorrow if you get the time; I might have a job for ya.

text.title: 火石岗哨
text.objectives: 将克劳格的异种蝎百科交给南贫瘠之地火石岗哨的塔乌娜·逐星。
text.description: 我用了近一个月的时间研究贫瘠之地的异种蝎，已然具备了专家的素质。就在上周，大地之环的成员前来拜访，希望我能记录下所知的一切。$B$B<克劳格递给你一本残破的笔记。>$B$B我算不上作家，也不敢妄下评论。但是这本手册恐怕是关于异种蝎最权威的书籍了。$B$B将它交给火石岗哨的塔乌娜·逐星。往南走，火石岗哨就在大路以西。
text.progress: Ah, do you bring news from up north?
text.completion:
Is this from Crawgol? Wonderful! Despite all the turmoil in the world, we can't turn our back on the silithid threat. It is important to have people like Crawgol studying our enemy closely and learning its secrets for the fight ahead!

<Tauna opens the book and glances over the first page. Her face falls.>

Oh. Well. I suppose it's something, at least.
