text.title: 飞翔的肉鸡
text.objectives: 将远程遥控焰火绑在野生肉鸡上，捕获10只肉鸡。
text.description: 可笑！拥有史上最伟大头脑的地精竟然要把时间浪费在食物这种琐事上？！我研究微型机动战鸡的目的就是为了打发这种烂事！$B$B<霍巴特的血压飙升，令他的肤色变成了墨绿色。>$B$B难道要我去捕捉肉鸡？没门，朋友，我不去！这原本是巴姆的活儿，但是他太懒了。我看你最近的日子真是越过越糟糕了。所以该你去！$B$B将这些远程遥控焰火绑在肉鸡上就行了，动作快点！
text.completion: Success! Was there ever any doubt?$B$BGreely, fire up the poultryizer!

english.title: Cluster Cluck
english.objectives: Capture 10 Wild Cluckers by attaching remote control fireworks to them.
english.description: Ridiculous! The greatest goblin mind of all time reduced to food detail? I made the Micro Mechachicken just for this reason and they let it get away!$B$B<Hobart turns a deeper shade of green as his blood pressure rises.>$B$BDo I look like I should be rounding up escaped cluckers? No, my friend, not I! Bamm most definitely, though he's too lazy.$B$BYour station in life has recently taken a turn for the worse. You do it!$B$BTake these remote control fireworks and attach them to the cluckers.
english.completion: Success! Was there ever any doubt?$B$BGreely, fire up the poultryizer!

text.title: 勇敢向前
text.objectives: 在通往风暴海崖的路上找到克雷南·阿朗纳斯。
text.description: 我会照达利乌斯说的去做，带领大家穿越黑瘴林。$B$B你得追上格雷迈恩国王。 高弗雷勋爵确认风暴海崖还有幸存者后，国王和克雷南就动身赶往那里了。$B$B出风谷村后沿着通往山林的道路走。我让克雷南在风暴海崖前面的小桥处等你。
text.completion: $N!$B$BGenn... they've taken Genn... they've taken... our king!

english.title: Onwards and Upwards
english.objectives: Find Krennan Aranas on the road to Tempest's Reach.
english.description: I will do as Darius asked and have our people move through the Blackwald.$B$BYou ought to catch up with King Greymane.  He and Krennan went into Tempest's Reach after Lord Godfrey confirmed survivors had made their dwelling there.$B$BFollow the road out of Stormglen into the mountains.  I asked Krennan to wait for you at the bridge before Tempest's Reach.
english.completion: $N!$B$BGenn... they've taken Genn... they've taken... our king!

text.title: 返回风谷村
text.objectives: 跟风谷村的格温·阿姆斯特谈一谈。
text.description: 氏族重聚尚且需要一段时日。昔日的政治冲突在整个种族分崩离析的危机前显得微不足道。$B$B现在，是我们携手并进，共同御敌的时候。$n，在你的帮助下，氏族的人民得以团结一致。$B$B返回风谷村，让他们放心地穿越黑瘴林前往风暴海崖吧。我们会解决掉所有的被遗忘者跟屁虫。
text.completion: King Greymane gave me a brief rundown of the plan before he set off for the Blackwald.  Doesn't make it sound any less crazy.

english.title: Return to Stormglen
english.objectives: Speak to Gwen Armstead in Stormglen.
english.description: It'll be a long time before our nation comes together again.  The old political divisions pale in comparison to what divides us now.$B$BYet if there was ever a time for us to come together and unite against a common enemy, it is now.  And it is you, $n, who have proven able to bridge the gap between our people.$B$BReturn to Stormglen and tell them it is safe to go through the Blackwald on their way to Tempest's Reach.  We will take care of any Forsaken who follow them.
english.completion: King Greymane gave me a brief rundown of the plan before he set off for the Blackwald.  Doesn't make it sound any less crazy.

text.title: 揭竿而起
text.objectives: 进入烬石矿脉，击败奴隶主博罗索格。
text.description: $n，只有极少数人逃了出来。被遗忘者占领了我们的城镇和矿洞，残忍地奴役着被俘的村民。$B$B许多体弱的村民不堪繁重的劳作，被活活累死了。这一幕幕惨剧的主使就是那个名叫博罗索格的憎恶头子。$B$B$c，我的妻子也沦为了他的牺牲品。我发誓要为她报仇。我太虚弱了，但是你，你要为我的妻子……为吉尔尼斯……声张正义！
text.completion: I thank you, $N.  Our people will no longer suffer under that monstrosity's yoke.
text.giverWindow: 解决这个……这个……怪物。

english.title: Slaves to No One
english.objectives: Slay Brothogg the Slavedriver inside Emberstone Mine.
english.description: I was one of the few that escaped, $n.  When the Forsaken took over our town and our mine, they treated us with utmost cruelty.$B$BThose of us who were weak and could not endure hard labor were worked to death by the abomination known as Brothogg.$B$BMy wife was among his victims, $c, and I swore that one day her death would be avenged.  I am too frail now, but you can deliver justice... for my wife... for Gilneas!
english.completion: I thank you, $N.  Our people will no longer suffer under that monstrosity's yoke.
english.giverWindow: Get rid of this... this... ABOMINATION.

text.title: 最后的美餐
text.objectives: 收集10块鹿肉。
text.description: $n，我又不傻。我很清楚接下来要面临的一切。$B$B在穿越城门的过程中，我们将遭遇训练有素、装备精良且数量繁多的敌军。$B$B即便侥幸获胜，也会付出巨大的代价。对大多数人来说，这很可能就是他们的最后一餐了。$B$B我虽然不能参战，但是烹饪的功夫还是不错的。这附近有很多游荡的雄鹿。替我弄些鹿肉来，我相信这会是他们吃过的最好吃的一餐。
text.progress: Did you get what I needed, $N?
text.completion: I thank you, $N.  Our men and women will have a last good meal before they set off for battle.

english.title: Last Meal
english.objectives: Obtain 10 Sides of Stag Meat.
english.description: I'm not dumb, $n.  I know what's ahead of us.$B$BOur people are going to go through those gates and fight against an enemy that is better trained, has more numbers and better weapons than us.$B$BEven if we succeed, it'll be at a great cost.  For most of us, today's meal will be the last.$B$BI cannot fight, but I sure can cook.  Bring me meat from the stags that roam this area and I will ensure that the last meal these folks get will be their best.
english.progress: Did you get what I needed, $N?
english.completion: I thank you, $N.  Our men and women will have a last good meal before they set off for battle.

text.title: 手刃仇人
text.objectives: 在烬石村击败4名被遗忘者士兵、执行官柯奈尔和疯狂的瓦尔诺瓦。
text.description: 村民获救了，但是被遗忘者依然占领着城镇。他们已经脱离了主力部队，眼下是我们收复失地的好机会。$B$B敌军的头目执行官柯奈尔以残暴著称。疯狂的瓦尔诺瓦，这个所谓的科学家竟然强迫那些年老而难以下井作业的村民为被遗忘者军团工作。$B$B将他们统统解决掉。
text.completion: We have the people of Emberstone on our side now thanks to you.

english.title: Push Them Out
english.objectives: Slay 4 Forsaken Infantry, Executor Cornell and Valnov the Mad in Emberstone Village.
english.description: The people are free, but the town is still occupied by the Forsaken.  They're cut off from their main force, so if we're to drive them out, now's our chance.$B$BTheir leader, Executor Cornell, is known  for his unbound ruthlessness.  Also among them is Valnov the Mad, a so-called scientist who carries out inhuman experiments on villagers too old to work the mines.$B$BTake care of them all.
english.completion: We have the people of Emberstone on our side now thanks to you.

text.title: 包抄被遗忘者
text.objectives: 跟赫维尔勋爵谈一谈，骑马前往利维里前哨站，向罗娜·克罗雷报到。
text.description: 谢谢你，$n。但是，我们不能满足于眼前的胜利。$B$B不远处的一座矿井村落仍在被遗忘者的控制之中。我已经派了一些人手，跟克罗雷的女儿一起赶往附近的马厩做准备。利亚姆应该很快就会与他们会合。$B$B我得留在这里，组织最后一次反攻。跟赫维尔勋爵谈一谈，骑马前往前哨站吧。
text.completion: I am glad to have you here, $N.  We're surrounded by Forsaken on all sides and can use all the help we can get.

english.title: Flank the Forsaken
english.objectives: Speak to Lord Hewell to obtain a ride to the Livery Outpost and report to Lorna Crowley.
english.description: I thank you, $n.  We can't rest on our laurels, however.$B$BWe found out about a mining town, currently under Forsaken occupation.  We sent some of my men, along with Crowley's daughter to the nearby livery stables to begin operations there.  Liam should be joining them shortly.$B$BI'll stay here and organize the final push for Gilneas City.  Speak to Lord Hewell to secure a horse to get you there.
english.completion: I am glad to have you here, $N.  We're surrounded by Forsaken on all sides and can use all the help we can get.

text.title: 齐膝的危险
text.objectives: 使用烧了一半的火把抵达吉尔尼斯城地下通道的另一端。
text.description: $n，是时候撤离了。绝大多数城民已经转移到了安全的地点，你也该动身了。$B$B带上这根火炬，你用得着的。地下通道里生活着一种恶心的小动物，专咬人的膝盖。有火炬的话，它们就不敢靠近你了。$B$B跟通道另一端的克雷南谈一谈。
text.completion: You're here, $N.  Most everyone made it through, but now we're stuck here... surrounded by our own... dead!

english.title: Knee-Deep
english.objectives: Use the Half-Burnt Torch to get to the other side of the tunnel beneath Gilneas City.
english.description: It's time to pack it in, $n.  Most of our people have made it through -- it's your turn now.$B$BTake this torch, you're going to need it.  The tunnel is full of nasty, knee-biting critters of the worst kind.  Use it to keep them at bay.$B$BSpeak to Krennan on the other side.
english.completion: You're here, $N.  Most everyone made it through, but now we're stuck here... surrounded by our own... dead!

text.title: 先祖的祝福
text.objectives: 将神圣供品放在埃德里奇的坟墓前。
text.description: $n，你做得很好。即便是在战乱年代，我们也应该尊重亡者。$B$B将这些祭品放在埃德里奇的坟墓前。$B$B希望这样可以安抚先祖的灵魂。
text.completion: It's done, $N.  The dead return to their slumber.

english.title: Patriarch's Blessing
english.objectives: Place the Blessed Offerings at Aderic's Tomb.
english.description: You've done it, $n.  Even in these times we must honor our dead.$B$BTake these offerings and place them at Aderic's tomb.$B$BLet's hope that's enough to placate the ghosts of our ancestors.
english.completion: It's done, $N.  The dead return to their slumber.

text.title: 覆舟海湾
text.objectives: 跟吉尔尼斯覆舟海湾的达利乌斯·克罗雷领主谈一谈。
text.description: 城市虽然沦陷，但是我们得到了亡者的宽恕。$B$B前往覆舟海湾，跟其他幸存者碰面吧。$B$B在我们脱离险境之前，要做的事情还有很多。吉恩还没有到，港口的一切事务应该由达利乌斯·克罗雷领主负责。
text.completion: It's good to see you again, $N.

english.title: Keel Harbor
english.objectives: Speak to Lord Darius Crowley at Keel Harbor in Gilneas.
english.description: We might've lost our city, but at least it looks like the dead have forgiven us.$B$BMeet with the rest of the survivors in Keel Harbor.$B$BI'm sure there's plenty to do before we're in the clear.  Genn hasn't arrived yet, so I suppose Lord Crowley will be in charge there.
english.completion: It's good to see you again, $N.

text.title: 他们有盟友，我们也有
text.objectives: 使用暗夜精灵投刃车杀死40名兽人掠夺者和8名狼喉护卫，并摧毁4台兽人战争机器。
text.description: 暗夜精灵没有食言。他们带来了船只，准备将我们送往新的避难所。$B$B但是，被遗忘者的盟友也赶来了。$B$B兽人向我们发动了攻击，部落的飞艇也试图击毁运送难民的船只。$B$B德鲁伊正在全力御敌，但是他们坚持不了多久了。所幸的是，暗夜精灵的船只上配有攻城武器。使用投刃车，给予敌人迎头痛击吧。
text.completion: It's almost over, $N.  Only one obstacle remains between us and survival.

english.title: They Have Allies, But So Do We
english.objectives: Use the Night Elven Glaivethrower to slay 40 Orc Raiders, 8 Wolfmaw Outriders and 4 Orcish War Machines.
english.description: The night elves made good on their promise.  They've brought ships and are ready to offer us sanctuary in their lands.$B$BUnfortunately, the Forsaken's allies have arrived as well.$B$BThe orcs are advancing upon us while the Horde gunship prevents the transport ships from taking our people to safety.$B$BThe druids are holding the enemy back, but won't last long.  Fortunately, the elven ships were carrying siege weapons.  Take one of the glaive throwers and meet the enemy head on.
english.completion: It's almost over, $N.  Only one obstacle remains between us and survival.

text.title: 萨隆矿坑
text.objectives: 在萨隆矿坑和希尔瓦娜斯·风行者见面。
text.description: 赶快行动，穿过这道传送门！我会在传送门的另一边与你汇合。
text.completion: Incapable fools.$B$BI begin to wonder if any of these louts from the tournament will be of any use at all. Perhaps you'll prove me wrong.

english.title: The Pit of Saron
english.objectives: Meet Lady Sylvanas Windrunner inside the entrance to the Pit of Saron.
english.description: Quickly, through the portal! I'll find you on the other side.
english.completion: Incapable fools.$B$BI begin to wonder if any of these louts from the tournament will be of any use at all. Perhaps you'll prove me wrong.

text.title: 萨隆矿坑
text.objectives: 在萨隆矿坑和吉安娜·普罗德摩尔见面。
text.description: 赶快行动，穿过这道传送门！我会在传送门的另一边与你汇合。
text.completion: I underestimated this Scourgelord, and it's my men that paid for it. When I think that my guilt over Arthas' betrayal cannot go any deeper, he proves me wrong yet again.$B$BWe have to press on. We cannot let their sacrifice be meaningless.

english.title: The Pit of Saron
english.objectives: Meet Lady Jaina Proudmoore just inside the Pit of Saron.
english.description: Quickly, through the portal! I'll meet you on the other side.
english.completion: I underestimated this Scourgelord, and it's my men that paid for it. When I think that my guilt over Arthas' betrayal cannot go any deeper, he proves me wrong yet again.$B$BWe have to press on. We cannot let their sacrifice be meaningless.

text.title: 鸡舍里的维兹尔
text.objectives: 进入巴尔丹城堡，杀死10名巴尔丹矮人（火枪手、士兵和军官），然后找到藏身城堡的维兹尔·滑影。
text.description: <加恩用满是血污的手一把抓住你。>$B$B我的伤势很重，但是在让巴尔莫丹的矮人付出代价前，我是不会休息的。<喘息声>在上一次进攻中，我们的人偷偷潜入了要塞。他就是地精破坏者：维兹尔·滑影。$B$B我要你杀死拦路的矮人，设法突破城门，然后溜进南面的巴尔丹城堡找到维兹尔。$B$B那座城堡<咳嗽声>非常坚固，只能从内部破坏，维兹尔需要帮手。
text.completion: You do good work, $c. That riot you caused at the fortress entrance has these dwarves running around with their heads cut off.

english.title: A Weezil in the Henhouse
english.objectives: Head into the Bael'Dun Keep and kill 10 Bael'Dun Dwarves (Riflemen, Soldiers, and Officers.) Then find Weezil Slipshadow, who should be hiding within.
english.description: <Gann grasps you with a blood-caked hand.>$B$BMy wounds are great but I will not rest until the dwarves of Bael Modan pay for their crimes. <Wheeze> We smuggled a man inside their fortress during our last raid. A goblin saboteur: Weezil Slipshadow. $B$BCreate a disruption at the gates - kill who you can - then slip inside the fortress of Bael'dun to the south and find Weezil.$B$BThat stronghold <cough> can only be destroyed from within, and Weezil can't do it alone.
english.completion: You do good work, $c. That riot you caused at the fortress entrance has these dwarves running around with their heads cut off.

text.title: 矮人的要塞
text.objectives: 取回巴尔丹要塞结构图。
text.description: 不知道你在来的路上有没有注意到，这座要塞建立在一尊巨型炮台附近。如果我们能找到弹药库，就可以不费吹灰之力地将它炸飞！$B$B要达成目标，我需要要塞的结构图，却苦于没有机会偷到手。$B$B沿着楼梯往下走，去最底层寻找结构图吧。
text.progress:
Give me the plans, quickly! Our time grows short.

Mostly because I've been eating my disguise.
text.completion:
Let's see, let's see.

It looks like the artillery shells are prepped here, then loaded into the secure magazine...

<Weezil rubs his hands together.>

$N, are you ready to blow some stuff up?

english.title: Dwarf Fortress
english.objectives: Acquire the Bael'Dun Fortress Schematics.
english.description: I don't know if you noticed on your way in, but this whole fortress is erected around a giant cannon. If we can just find the ammunition magazine, we could blow this place sky-high as easy as kiss-my-hand!$B$BBut to figure it out I'm going to need the fortress schematics, and I haven't been able to steal them yet.$B$BLook for the plans on the lowest floor, right down these stairs.
english.progress:
Give me the plans, quickly! Our time grows short.

Mostly because I've been eating my disguise.
english.completion:
Let's see, let's see.

It looks like the artillery shells are prepped here, then loaded into the secure magazine...

<Weezil rubs his hands together.>

$N, are you ready to blow some stuff up?

text.title: 波浪里的种子
text.objectives: 使用加尔的网收集4枚血瓣花的种子。
text.description: 安戈洛的血瓣花拥有神奇的生命周期。$b$b血瓣花的种子在成熟后会自动脱落，掉入河中。河流将种子带到此地以北，种子会在那里孵化——就像鸡蛋一样，成为一株新生的血瓣花。$b$b我需要研究这些种子。用这张网从河里打捞起明黄色的种子。你需要潜入水中打捞它们。
text.giverWindow: 这些细小的孢子由水底的暗流带来至此。

english.title: Carried on the Waves
english.objectives: Use Garl's Net to obtain 4 Bloodpetal Seeds.
english.description: The Bloodpetals of Un'Goro have a fascinating life cycle.$b$bThese trees in front of us bear seeds that fall down into the river when they mature.  The river's current then takes the seed north of here, where the seed hatches - almost like an egg - and a newborn Bloodpetal emerges.$b$bI require these seeds for my studies.  Take this net, and use it to scoop up the bright orange seeds in the river.  You'll have to hunt them down under the water.
english.giverWindow: These tiny spores are carried by currents underwater.

text.title: 死亡的花束
text.objectives: 杀死6簇幼花鞭笞者。
text.description: 你已经了解了血瓣花生命周期的第一阶段：水生种子。但是当它们进入到下一个生命阶段，变成血瓣幼花簇之后可就没这么温驯了。$b$b血瓣花孵化后，它们会迅速集结起来，以数量优势弥补其弱点。这些幼苗通常不会招惹是非，但是如果你惹恼了其中一株，它们就会群起攻之。$b$b为了我们和他人的安全，去除掉它们吧。血瓣幼花簇就在附近，西边和北边都可以发现它们的踪迹。

english.title: Bouquets of Death
english.objectives: Kill 6 packs of Juvenile Lashers.
english.description: You're already familiar with the first phase of the Bloodpetals' life cycle: the waterborne seed.  The next phase, however, is not so docile: the pack of juveniles.$b$bWhen Bloodpetals hatch, they quickly form gangs and travel together, offsetting their weakness with overwhelming numbers.  These packs of young lashers normally keep to themselves, but upset one of them and you upset them all.$b$bFor our safety and the safety of others, dispose of them.  They roam close by, to the west and north.

text.title: Zen'Aliri
text.objectives: Report to Zen'Aliri in Marshal's Stand.
text.description: You've already met one of my new students, the young worgen named Garl.  My other student is a troll by the name of Zen'Aliri.  He currently camps with the explorers of Marshal's Expedition, to the west of here.$b$bTake these results to him, $n, and tell him to read them well.

english.title: Zen'Aliri
english.objectives: Report to Zen'Aliri in Marshal's Stand.
english.description: You've already met one of my new students, the young worgen named Garl.  My other student is a troll by the name of Zen'Aliri.  He currently camps with the explorers of Marshal's Expedition, to the west of here.$b$bTake these results to him, $n, and tell him to read them well.

text.title: 飘向北方
text.objectives: 向异生花园的伊西斯·月卫报到。
text.description: 暗夜精灵德鲁伊伊西斯·月卫指引我加入了塞纳里奥议会。他的营地坐落在此地以北，环形山东部边缘的山崖上。跟血瓣花种子一起顺流而下，你就可以找到他。$b$b我的研究仅限于种子和普通药剂，他则专注于更高级的课题。如果你对安戈洛的植被感兴趣的话，就去找他谈谈吧。
text.completed: 去异生花园找伊西斯·月卫。

english.title: Flowing to the North
english.objectives: Report to Ithis Moonwarden in the Roiling Gardens.
english.description: Ithis Moonwarden is the night elf druid who indoctrinated me into the Cenarion Circle.  He has set up camp north of here, near the cliffs of the crater's easternmost edge.  Follow the flow of the Bloodpetal seeds, and I'll wager you'll find him nearby.$b$bMy studies are limited only to seeds and other reagents, but he pursues more advanced matters.  If you are curious to learn more about Un'Goro's flora, you should speak with him now.
english.completed: Report to Ithis Moonwarden in the Roiling Gardens.

text.title: 火焰使者
text.objectives: 杀死火焰使者。
text.description: 我还是有些担心这些火焰元素，$n。我有最后一个请求：前往火羽山顶部，杀死火焰使者。他是环形山最大最厉害的火焰元素。如果能消灭他，那我也会睡得安稳点。
text.giverWindow: 他会把你烧焦。

english.title: Blazerunner
english.objectives: Kill Blazerunner.
english.description: I'm still a bit concerned about these fire elementals, $n.  One last request: head to the top of Fire Plume Ridge, and kill the one they call Blazerunner.  He's the biggest and strongest of all the fire elementals in the crater.  With him gone, I'll be able to sleep much better.
english.giverWindow: He will burn you.

text.title: 奇特的美味
text.objectives: 收集96条异种蝎的腿。
text.description: 嗨，$g兄弟:甜心;，想不想赚点外快呀？$b$b来自可靠渠道的消息称，有人愿意出大价钱购买异种蝎的腿。对，你没听错，是异种蝎的腿！如果烹制得当，那可是难得的美味。异种蝎生活在此地以南，像是陆生龙虾。$b$b我需要大批货来支付各种经费。要不你去帮我搞8打虫腿来？

english.title: Peculiar Delicacies
english.objectives: Obtain 96 Silithid Legs.
english.description: Hey $g bub: sweetie;, interested in making an extra dime?$b$bI've got it on good authority that some interested parties are paying BIG money for silithid legs.  Yes, you heard me right, silithid legs!  Apparently these things are delicious if you cook them right.  They're like underground lobsters, and they live just south of here.$b$bThing is, I'll need a good amount of them to pay for my overhead.  Think you could get me 8 dozen or so?

text.title: 初生的巨虫
text.objectives: 杀死初生的格里什巨虫。
text.description: 如果你愿意的话，就帮我铲除潜在的威胁吧。$B$B南面就是巨痕谷——异种蝎的聚集地，在丛林中分外刺眼。你不会错过的。$B$B侦察兵来报，位于巨痕谷中央的大型地下虫洞中有一只初生的巨虫。异种蝎打算等它发育成熟后，就利用它攻击安戈洛！$B$B$n，这可不行。找到这只巨虫并杀死它。
text.giverWindow: 当巨虫开始施放毒气炸药时，你最好赶紧找掩护。

english.title: The Fledgling Colossus
english.objectives: Kill the Gorishi Fledgling Colossus.
english.description: If you're here to help, then maybe you can help us with a lurking threat.$b$bTo the south lies the Slithering Scar, a quivering silithid outpost in the middle of the jungle.  You can't miss it.$b$bOne of my scouts reports that the silithid are harboring a young colossus in their large central underground chamber, and once it is fully grown, they plan to unleash it upon Un'Goro!$b$bThis must not be allowed to pass, $n.  Find the colossus and kill it.
english.giverWindow: When it starts to cast its Poison Explosion, you'd better run for cover.

text.title: 覆苔营地
text.objectives: 向覆苔营地的格雷米斯报到。
text.description: 在马绍尔哨站，我几乎没有机会搞倒买倒卖，唯恐引起科学家的怀疑。但是，我可以推荐你去别的地方帮忙。$b$b我的合伙人格雷米斯在西北边设立了一处营地，就在火山对面。他是个精明的商人，对利益的把握和追逐都远胜于我。如果你想赚点零花钱的话，我相信他会为你安排的。
text.completed: 向覆苔营地的格雷米斯报到。

english.title: Mossy Pile
english.objectives: Report to Gremix at Mossy Pile.
english.description: Here in Marshal's Stand, I can't really do too much profiteering without arousing suspicion from the scientists.  There is, however, another place where I might have use of you.$b$bMy business associate, Gremix, has a camp northwest of here, on the opposite side of the volcano.  He's a savvy business mind, and has a better eye for profit than even I do.  I'm sure he could put you to work, if you'd like to make some more coin.
english.completed: Report to Gremix at Mossy Pile.

text.title: 塑造者之台
text.objectives: 跟安戈洛测试者谈一谈，传送到塑造者之台，然后跟娜博亚谈一谈。
text.description: <你注视着眼前的宝珠，耳畔传来了声音。>$B$B水晶塔已被激活。已集齐足够数量的水晶。先决条件达成。准备传送到塑造者之台。$b$b准备好了就跟我谈谈，$r。我们将与守护者进行交流。
text.completed: 跟安戈洛测试者谈一谈，传送到塑造者之台，然后跟娜博亚谈一谈。

english.title: The Shaper's Terrace
english.objectives: Speak with the Un'Goro Examinant to teleport to The Shaper's Terrace, then speak with Nablya.
english.description: <As you look into the orb in front of you, you hear a voice.>$b$BThe crystal pylons have been activated.  A sufficient number of crystals have been gathered.  The prerequisites have been met.  We are prepared for teleport to The Shaper's Terrace.$b$bSpeak to me when you are ready, $r.  We will consult with The Watcher.
english.completed: Speak with the Un'Goro Examinant to teleport to The Shaper's Terrace, then speak with Nablya.

text.title: 从高台眺望
text.objectives: 拉动娜博亚身后的杠杆，完成测试。
text.description: 当我的主人卡兹格罗斯塑造了这个你们称之为艾泽拉斯的世界时，他将安戈洛环形山划为试验地。你可以把这里看做是泰坦的培养皿。$B$B如果你想了解更多关于我们如何审视这个世界的知识，就拉动我身后的四根杠杆，完成测试。

english.title: Ever Watching From Above
english.objectives: Pull the levers behind Nablya and complete her tests.
english.description: When my master Khaz'Goroth shaped the world you call Azeroth, he designed Un'Goro Crater to be an area for experimentation.  You might call it the Titans' petri dish.$b$bIf you seek further knowledge about the methods in which we observe the world, pull the four levers behind me and complete my tests.

text.title: Un'Goro: PRK - E - Shizzle's Flyer 02 - Testing It Out

english.title: Un'Goro: PRK - E - Shizzle's Flyer 02 - Testing It Out

text.title: 如何获取鲜肉
text.objectives: 使用腐臭的肉块引诱恐龙踩进马绍尔哨站附近的陷阱坑。
text.description: 我们没见过面吧……我是诺伦·敲钉器，马绍尔探险队的新任卫兵队长。我还是这支探险队的头儿。好吧，其实这两个头衔的职能相当重叠。$b$b我要交给你一项有趣的任务。你看见营地周围的刺坑了吗？试试诱使附近的恐龙踩进去。如果你能趁其不备将这块腐臭的肉块朝它们抛过去，那么会产生两种结果：要么它们一口吞下肉块，要么愤怒地朝你冲过来。随便怎样啦，将它们诱进陷阱就行！

english.title: How to Make Meat Fresh Again
english.objectives: Use the Scraps of Rotting Meat on nearby dinosaurs to lure them into the pits around Marshal's Stand.
english.description: I don't believe we've met... I'm Nolen Tacker, Marshal Expeditions' new chief of the guards.  I'm also their chef.  There's actually more overlap than you'd think.$b$bI've got a fun little task for you.  Have you seen the spike pits around the perimeter of the camp?  See if you can convince some of the nearby dinosaurs to walk into them.  If you throw this rotten meat at them when they're not looking, it'll either make them hungry or angry.  Either way is fine, as long as they follow you into the pit!

text.title: 考古学之旅
text.objectives: 向葛拉卡温泉的斯巴克·尼米尔报到。
text.description: 嗨，要不要尝尝我最新烹制的双帆龙热狗？不要吗？迅猛龙烩饭呢？翼手龙玉米卷呢？$b$b好吧。噢，我想起来了！你说不定能帮上我的朋友。他叫斯巴克·尼米尔，是马绍尔探险队的首席考古学家。$b$b他去了西边的葛拉卡温泉。你可以在温泉的西岸找到他。
text.completed: 去葛拉卡温泉找斯巴克·尼米尔。

english.title: Adventures in Archaeology
english.objectives: Report to Spark Nilminer at Golakka Hot Springs.
english.description: Hey, you want to try my new diemetradon dogs?  No?  Raptor risotto?  Pterrordax ptacos?$b$bFine.  Oh, I just remembered!  I have a friend nearby that might be able to use your assistance.  His name is Spark Nilminer, and he's Marshal Expeditions' chief archaeology officer.$b$bHe's been sent out to Golakka Hot Springs, to the west.  You'll likely find him on the springs' western shore.
english.completed: Report to Spark Nilminer at Golakka Hot Springs.

text.title: 粘糊糊的格玛什
text.objectives: 杀死格玛什并取回无比粘稠的焦油。
text.description: 嗨！我们找错了焦油生物。$b$b格雷米斯曾经撞见过一只体型异常庞大的焦油生物。它就潜伏在遥远的东方，位于蘑菇石以南的焦油坑。这种生物的体型越大，体内的焦油就越粘稠！我们可以小赚一笔了，$n！$b$b记得带上刮刀！
text.giverWindow: 可以的话，在你杀死他的时候尽量别碰到他。

english.title: Gormashh the Glutinous
english.objectives: Kill Gormashh and obtain the Unbelievably Sticky Tar.
english.description: Hey, I know!  We've been looking at the wrong tar creatures.$b$bGremix once told me about a larger-than-normal tar creature that he ran into.  It lurks around the tar pit far to the east of here, south of Fungal Rock.  I'll bet that the bigger these creatures get, the stickier they get!  We'll make some money yet, $n!$b$bDon't forget the scraper!
english.giverWindow: If you can help it, try not to touch him while you're slaying him.

text.title: 难以采集的花朵
text.objectives: 采集4朵焦油之花。
text.description: 北面的拉卡利油沼埋藏着巨大的财富：生长在油沼底部的稀有花朵。焦油之花的卖点在于美艳和坚韧。我有好一阵子没去采集了，那里应该新生了不少植株吧。帮我跑一趟？$b$b顺便说一句，在油沼里游泳还是当心点好。这跟你在水里游泳是截然不同的。

english.title: Hard to Harvest
english.objectives: Obtain 4 Tarblossom Blossoms.
english.description: The Lakkari Tar Pits, just north of here, conceal a hidden treasure: rare flowers that grow at the bottom of the pits.  These tarblossoms, as they're called, are valued for their beauty and their durability.  It's been a while since I last harvested tarblossoms, so there should be some new plants growing at the bottom of the pits.  Grab some for me?$b$bBy the way, good luck swimming in tar.  It's nothing like swimming in water.

text.title: 马绍尔营地
text.objectives: 取回10件被弃的补给品。
text.description: 想发财就别管什么礼义廉耻。你必须学会利用他人的不幸赚取利润。归根结底就一个问题：你有多爱钱？$b$b马绍尔探险队在撤离北部营地的时候，落下了许多补给品。倒不是什么稀罕货，也不值几个钱，但是它们就堆在那里，谁都可以去拿。马绍尔营地就在北边的山崖上。$b$b哦，顺便查探一下他们为什么遗弃了那座营地……

english.title: Marshal's Refuse
english.objectives: Obtain 10 Discarded Supplies.
english.description: A big part of making money is shamelessness.  You have to be willing to profit off of the misfortune of others.  It all ends up boiling down to one question: How much do you love money?$b$bWhen Marshal and his crew abandoned their refuge up to the north, they left behind lots of supplies.  This stuff isn't rare, or even particularly valuable, but it's there if you're willing to take it.  His camp is up in the cliffs, to the north.$b$bOh, and be on the lookout for whatever it was that made them leave...

text.title: 达丹加之墓
text.objectives: 收集10株血瓣花苗。

english.title: Here Lies Dadanga
english.objectives: Obtain 10 Bloodpetal Sprouts.

text.title: 重要的一课
text.objectives: 跟北郡骑士麦斯米兰谈一谈，了解如何担当侍从之职。
text.description: 嗨，旅行者！欢迎造访北郡骑士麦斯米兰的营地！你大概已经听说了我的丰功伟绩？你的眼神印证了这一点。你的脸庞因为赞许和激动变得容光焕发，就像月神艾露恩照耀石碑湖一般明亮。$b$b我看得出，你喜欢冒险。既然你有能力，又有十足的善意，我愿意让你担任我的侍从。
text.completed: 去葛拉卡温泉找北郡骑士麦斯米兰。

english.title: An Important Lesson
english.objectives: Speak to Maximillian of Northshire to learn more about becoming a squire.
english.description: What ho, traveler!  You must know that you set foot upon the camp of Maximillian of Northshire!  Mayhap you have heard tales sung of my many exploits?  I can see from the look in your eye that you have.  That glint of recognition plays upon your visage like the White Lady's reflection o'er Stonecairne Lake.$b$bIt is clear to me that you seek adventure.  As you seem able enough, and thoroughly well-intentioned, I would offer to make you my squire.
english.completed: Return to Maximillian of Northshire in Golakka Hot Springs.

text.title: 安戈洛环形山的恶龙
text.objectives: 帮助北郡骑士麦斯米兰杀死15只“龙”。
text.description: 环形山到处都是生性邪恶的龙。你见过吗？这些背脊生刺，长着蜥蜴脸的怪兽在环形山四处游荡。$b$b别被骗了，它们不是红龙女王阿莱克丝塔萨的侍从。邪恶的生物注定要被英雄的利刃斩杀。$b$b我决定杀死15只龙。作为我的侍从，你必须与我同行。如果你不小心跟我走散了，就回到温泉处找我。

english.title: The Evil Dragons of Un'Goro Crater
english.objectives: Help Maximillian of Northshire slay 15 "Dragons".
english.description: This crater is filled with a malignant breed of dragon.  Have you seen them?  They wander all about, parading their spiky backs and lizardy faces all around the Crater.$b$bDon't let them fool you, squire, for these dragons are no minions of graceful Alexstrasza.  They are clearly vicious, and direly in need of a hero's blade.$b$bI have decided that I will slay no less than 15 of them.  As my squire, you must come along.  Should we become separated, you may meet me back here at the Hot Springs.

text.title: 落难的少女
text.objectives: 营救岸边的少女、山崖上的少女和北方的少女。
text.description: 我觉得我们在环形山的冒险之旅不仅仅是对付龙而已。圣骑士的直觉告诉我，这附近的少女等待我们伸出援手。虽然我心只为多罗莉亚而跳，但是我也不能无视危难中的其他少女。$b$b继续前进吧，侍从$n！安戈洛的少女需要我们的帮助！

english.title: Damsels Were Made to be Saved
english.objectives: Rescue the Damsel by the Shore, the Damsel in the Cliffs, and the Damsel of the North.
english.description: I've a feeling that we may find more than dragons here in this crater.  My paladin's instinct tells me that there are maidens nearby that require our aid.  While my heart beats only for my lady Doloria, a damsel in distress cannot be ignored.$b$bLet us sally forth, Squire $n!  The ladies of Un'Goro require our aid!

text.title: 葛拉卡温泉的幽灵
text.objectives: 在北郡骑士麦斯米兰跟2名蒸汽怒灵交谈期间陪伴左右。
text.description: 正事儿来了，$n。接下来我们要执行一项重要的任务。除非斩杀恶龙女王，否则这些奸诈的怪兽会一直在环形山为非作歹。在此之前，我们必须寻求圣光的帮助。$b$b我曾在葛拉卡温泉岸边见过圣光以幽灵的形态显身。来吧，我必须跟他们谈谈，请求帮助。

english.title: The Spirits of Golakka Hot Springs
english.objectives: Stand by as Maximillian of Northshire speaks to 2 Steam Furies.
english.description: A moment of seriousness now, $n.  We have an important quest ahead of us.  The treacherous dragons that plague this valley will not cease their mischief until we destroy their repugnant brood mother.  Before we even attempt to complete such a task, we must ask the Light for aid.$b$bI have seen the Light manifest itself nearby, in the form of Spirits floating by the shores of Golakka Hot Springs.  Come, I must speak with them, and ask them for aid.

text.title: 麦斯米兰之歌
text.objectives: 帮助北郡骑士麦斯米兰杀死魔暴龙女王。如果你跟麦斯米兰走散了，就去安戈洛环形山的葛拉卡温泉找他。
text.description: 侍从$n，我们期待已久的时刻终于来临了。我要手刃安戈洛的恶龙女王。这项艰巨的任务让我喘不过气来，但是在圣光的帮助下，我们一定会取得胜利的。$b$b你做好准备了吗？

english.title: The Ballad of Maximillian
english.objectives: Help Maximillian of Northshire kill the Devilsaur Queen.  If you become separated from Maximillian, meet him at Golakka Hot Springs in Un'Goro Crater.
english.description: The time we have waited for is upon us, Squire $n.  Un'Goro's brood mother will perish at my hands.  The gravity of our task weighs heavily on me, but with the power of the Light behind us, we are guaranteed to succeed.$b$bAre you ready to depart?

objectiveDetails.description: 击败安戈洛的恶龙女王

text.title: 化石探测器3000型
text.objectives: 取回一支巨大的恐龙爪。
text.description: 考古挖掘中最令我讨厌的事情之一就是，有一半的时间你挖到的只是泥土。这也是我不惜耗费大量时间打造新型装置的原因。$b$b来瞧瞧我的发明吧：化石探测器3000型。我已经完成了最后的调试。如果它能正常运作的话，就能探测到本地最大的化石。很厉害，对吧？$b$b试试吧，看你能不能找到巨大的恐龙骨头。

english.title: The Fossil-Finder 3000
english.objectives: Obtain an Enormous Dinosaur Talon.
english.description: One of the things I hate the most about digging is the fact that half the time, all you find is dirt.  That's why I've been spending most of my time out here tinkering instead of digging.$b$bLet me show you what I've invented: the Fossil-Finder 3000.  I just put the finishing touches on it.  If it works properly, it should find the largest fossils in the area.  I know, sweet, huh?$b$bTest it out and see if you can find some ridiculously big dinosaur bones.

text.title: 双铲记
text.objectives: 杀死杜林·恐铲并取回杜林的考古报告。
text.description: 等等，这块骨头上有用铲子刨出的印记。这不是你留下的吧？不对，我认得这个图案……是那个该死的矮人留下的！我呸！$B$B听我解释。此地以南还有一个名叫杜林·恐铲的考古学家。他对待古器的方式草率而鲁莽，连我都难以忍受。$B$B如此珍贵的化石，就这样被他的铲子给毁了。杜林，我忍无可忍了！$B$B$n，杀死杜林·恐铲，终止他不计后果的挖掘工事。
text.giverWindow: 不计代价的考古发掘是绝不能被允许的。

english.title: A Tale of Two Shovels
english.objectives: Kill Durrin Direshovel and obtain Durrin's Archaeological Findings.
english.description: Hey wait a minute, this bone has pickax marks on it.  These aren't yours, are they?  No, I recognize this mark... this must be that blasted dwarf!  Gah!$b$bLet me step back for a minute and explain.  There's another archaeologist south of here named Durrin Direshovel.  He practices a reckless, devil-may-care brand of archaeology that offends even me.$B$BA priceless fossil, ruined by sloppy pick-work.  This is the last straw, Durrin!$b$b$n, go put an end to Direshovel and his negligent excavation.
english.giverWindow: Reckless archaeology shall not go unpunished.

text.title: 深渊的裁决
text.objectives: 杀死天灾领主泰兰努斯。
text.description: 我们需要找到一条通往大道并穿越洞穴到达泰兰努斯之台的路。我们将与他正面交锋，前提是我们得找到通往要塞的正确路线。$B$B立即行动，$c。届时，我和我的人会在那里与你会合。
text.completion: Such a senseless waste! Arthas goes too far! I can only hope what we find in the Halls of Reflection makes this somehow worth it.$B$BIf what that vile gnome said is to be trusted, Frostmourne should be there, and with it, answers to confronting Arthas.

english.title: Deliverance from the Pit
english.objectives: Kill Scourgelord Tyrannus.
english.description: We need to make our way up the main path and through the cave to Tyrannus' rise.$B$BHe will be forced to confront us there lest we make our way into the citadel proper.$B$BGo now, $c. My men and I will be there to stand by you when the confrontation with Tyrannus comes.
english.completion: Such a senseless waste! Arthas goes too far! I can only hope what we find in the Halls of Reflection makes this somehow worth it.$B$BIf what that vile gnome said is to be trusted, Frostmourne should be there, and with it, answers to confronting Arthas.

text.title: 霜之哀伤
text.objectives: 在映像大厅的入口与吉安娜女士汇合。
text.description: 我们必须前进，英雄。在付出了这么多的努力之后……我们的目标终于近在咫尺了。$B$B我必须耽误一小会去送大法师埃兰德拉回到飞艇。在损失了这么多人手之后，留下来保护道路安全的人已经很少了，我不知道我们还能不能成功撤退。$B$B继续前进吧。我会在映像大厅与你汇合。
text.completion: The Halls of Reflection. Finally.$B$BLet me know when you are ready. Arthas may not be here, but it would be naive to think that he would leave Frostmourne unguarded entirely.

english.title: Frostmourne
english.objectives: Meet Lady Jaina Proudmoore at the entrance to the Halls of Reflection.
english.description: We must press on, hero. We've come so far... we're so close to our goal.$B$BI must delay a moment to send Elandra back to the airship. I'm uncertain how we're going to escape with so many men lost and so few to keep our path in secure.$B$BContinue on. I will meet you in the Halls of Reflection.
english.completion: The Halls of Reflection. Finally.$B$BLet me know when you are ready. Arthas may not be here, but it would be naive to think that he would leave Frostmourne unguarded entirely.

text.title: 深渊的裁决
text.objectives: 杀死天灾领主泰兰努斯。
text.description: 我们需要找到一条通往大道并穿越洞穴到达泰兰努斯之台的路。我们将在那里与他正面交锋，前提是我们得找到通往要塞的正确路线。$B$B立即行动，$c。届时，我和我的人会在那里与你汇合。
text.completion: The Halls of Reflection lie ahead.$B$BIf what that vile gnome said is to be trusted, Frostmourne should be there, and with it, answers to confronting Arthas.

english.title: Deliverance from the Pit
english.objectives: Kill Scourgelord Tyrannus.
english.description: We need to make our way up the main path and through the cave to Tyrannus' rise.$B$BThere, he will be forced to confront us there lest we make our way into the citadel proper.$B$BGo now, $c. My men and I will be there to stand by you when the confrontation with Tyrannus comes.
english.completion: The Halls of Reflection lie ahead.$B$BIf what that vile gnome said is to be trusted, Frostmourne should be there, and with it, answers to confronting Arthas.

text.title: 霜之哀伤
text.objectives: 在映像大厅的入口与希尔瓦娜斯汇合。
text.description: 继续前进，霜之哀伤就近在咫尺了。$B$B我需要耽误一会送我的一名黑暗游侠回到飞艇上。在损失这么多战友之后，我不会再执行准备不足的行动——我们需要他们的鼎力帮助。$B$B去吧。我会在映像大厅与你汇合。
text.completion: The Halls of Reflection. Finally.$B$BLet me know when you are ready, $c. I will not be so naive as to think that Arthas left his precious sword entirely unguarded.

english.title: Frostmourne
english.objectives: Meet Lady Sylvanas Windrunner inside the entrance to the Halls of Reflection.
english.description: Keep moving, the sword is close.$B$BI need a moment to send one of my dark rangers back to the airship. With all of our fodder gone, I will not be caught unprepared - we will need any help they can send.$B$BGo. I will meet you in the Halls of Reflection.
english.completion: The Halls of Reflection. Finally.$B$BLet me know when you are ready, $c. I will not be so naive as to think that Arthas left his precious sword entirely unguarded.

text.title: 找回A-Me 01
text.objectives: 在蘑菇石找到A-Me 01。
text.description: 非常不幸，我的一项最伟大的发明出了点问题。你以前见过机械松鼠，对吗？嗯，为了接近安戈洛环形山的猩猩，我制造了一只机械猩猩混入它们的群落——我把她称为A-Me 01。$B$B这几个月来，她一直在蘑菇石一带进行生物研究，现在本应该回来了。我担心她出了什么状况。$B$B你能帮我找到她吗？
text.giverWindow: 预编程灵长类机器人。

english.title: Chasing A-Me 01
english.objectives: Find A-Me 01 at Fungal Rock.
english.description: Unfortunately, something's happened to one of my greatest inventions.  You've seen mechanical squirrels, yes?  Well, to get closer to the apes of Un'Goro Crater, I created a mechanical ape to blend in with their kind--I call her A-Me 01.$B$BShe has been studying the local wildlife at Fungal Rock for several months, but she should have returned by now.  I fear the worst for her.$b$bCan you help me find her?
english.giverWindow: A pre-programmed primate.

text.title: 修理A-Me 01
text.objectives: 你确定A-Me 01要你找到一颗安戈洛椰子并在附近的岩石上敲开椰子，然后将特浓椰奶交给她。
text.description: <机械猩猩的眼睛突然亮了起来，它开口说话了。>$b$b“……操作载量……不足5%……储油器……意外破裂……”$b$b“……使用椰奶……岩石……修理A-Me 01……”$B$B<A-Me 01闭上了眼睛。>

english.title: Repairing A-Me 01
english.objectives: You're pretty sure that A-Me 01 has asked you to obtain an Un'Goro Coconut, crack it on the rock nearby, and give her the High Viscosity Coconut Milk.
english.description: <Suddenly, the robotic gorilla's eyes light up, and it begins to speak.>$b$b"...operational capacity... less than 5%... accidentally... punctured oil reservoir..."$b$b"...use coconut milk... rock... save A-Me 01..."$b$b<A-Me closes her eyes.>

text.title: Returning A-Me 01
text.objectives: Escort A-Me 01 back to Karna Remtravel at Mossy Pile.
text.description: Greetings.  I unit A-Me 01.  You... $r?$B$BA-Me's mission to study the local gorillas was success.  A-Me has gathered data and now will bring to Karna.$b$bIt time for A-Me to return to Karna.  You come with?  We embark right away, so make sure you ready first.
text.completed: Return to Karna Remtravel at Mossy Pile.

english.title: Returning A-Me 01
english.objectives: Escort A-Me 01 back to Karna Remtravel at Mossy Pile.
english.description: Greetings.  I unit A-Me 01.  You... $r?$B$BA-Me's mission to study the local gorillas was success.  A-Me has gathered data and now will bring to Karna.$b$bIt time for A-Me to return to Karna.  You come with?  We embark right away, so make sure you ready first.
english.completed: Return to Karna Remtravel at Mossy Pile.

objectiveDetails.description: Protect A-Me 01 until you reach Karna Remtravel

text.title: 安戈洛的猩猩
text.objectives: 将2张安戈洛猩猩的皮、2张安戈洛巨猩猩的皮和2张安戈洛大猩猩的皮交给覆苔营地的格雷米斯。
text.description: 安戈洛是块发财的宝地，你只需要有一双敏锐的眼睛就行了！$b$b猩猩是安戈洛常见的物种，但是往北走，它们就属于稀有动物了。在永望镇，一张猩猩皮能卖出十倍的价！$b$b我不会让你去冬泉谷啦，那样显得我太不负责任了。不过我希望你能帮我收集一些猩猩皮。$b$b东北方的瀑布旁就是蘑菇石，你可以在那里找到猩猩。顺便进洞打探一番吧！

english.title: The Apes of Un'Goro
english.objectives: Bring 2 Un'Goro Gorilla Pelts, 2 Un'Goro Stomper Pelts, and 2 Un'Goro Thunderer Pelts to Gremix at Mossy Pile.
english.description: There's plenty of money to be had here in Un'Goro, you just need to know where to look!$b$bApes may be common here in Un'Goro, but they're much rarer up north.  In Everlook, a gorilla hide fetches ten times what you'll get for it down here!$b$bI'm not going to send you all the way up to Winterspring - that'd be irresponsible - but I could use your help actually obtaining some hides.$b$bYou'll find gorillas at Fungal Rock, to the northeast, near a waterfall.  Don't forget to check inside the cave!

text.title: 强大的尤尔查
text.objectives: 将尤尔查的毛皮交给覆苔营地的格雷米斯。
text.description: 你发现洞穴地上有几撮红色的毛发。从毛发的浓密程度来看，准是猩猩没跑了。$B$B基于你跟格雷米斯的谈话，你可以肯定他会对红色的猩猩皮感兴趣的。
text.giverWindow: 关于红毛猩猩的模样，你能想到的也就这么多了。

english.title: The Mighty U'cha
english.objectives: Bring U'cha's Pelt to Gremix at Mossy Pile.
english.description: Looking around, you see bits of red fur laying around this part of the cave.  It appears to match the consistency of gorilla fur.$b$bBased on your conversations with Gremix, you know that he would almost certainly be interested in a red gorilla hide, if you were to obtain one.
english.giverWindow: This is your best guess as to what a red gorilla might look like.

text.title: 白色龙爪
text.objectives: 取回5个白色暴掠龙爪。
text.description: 等等，$r。像你这样的$c能帮得上我。$b$b营地外生活着拥有致命利爪的迅猛龙。我一直在德鲁伊仪式上使用龙爪，但是它们似乎没什么效果。大多数迅猛龙的爪子是黑色的，不过我注意到有些长着白色的爪子。$b$b自然造物总是很奇怪的。帮我取回一些白色龙爪，让我再试试德鲁伊仪式？

english.title: Claws of White
english.objectives: Obtain 5 White Ravasaur Claws.
english.description: Stop, $r.  I could use the help of a $c like you.$b$bRight outside this camp, there are raptors with deadly claws.  I've been using the claws for druid rituals, but it doesn't seem to be working.  However, I did notice that some of those raptors sometimes have white claws, when most have deathly black ones.$b$bThe earth works in strange ways.  Maybe you could fetch me some of the white claws, and I'll try one last time?

text.title: 能量水晶
text.objectives: 收集红色能量水晶、蓝色能量水晶、黄色能量水晶和绿色能量水晶各7块。
text.description: 我确定你一定已经注意过它们了，$n。它们到处都是！$B$B我在说什么？这都不知道，我当然在说水晶！$B$B那些水晶……它们遍布在整个环形山里。大多数人都会忽视它们，但我感觉到那些水晶里一定蕴含着特殊的力量。$B$B这么说吧，我这里的水晶已经不多了——我想你也许能够帮我收集一些水晶回来？$b$b你可以在西北方找到黄色水晶，红色水晶在……嗯，你自己肯定可以搞定的啦。

english.title: Crystals of Power
english.objectives: Collect 7 Power Crystals of each color: red, blue, yellow, and green.
english.description: I'm sure you've noticed 'em, $n. They're everywhere!$B$BWhat am I talking about? Why, the crystals, of course!$B$BThe crystals... They're all over the crater. Most people ignore them, but I have a strange feeling that they hold power within them.$B$BSay, I'm running a little low on the crystals I have here -- think you might be able to collect some more for me?  $b$bYou'll find yellow crystals to the northwest, red crystals to the... oh, I'm sure you'll figure it out.

text.title: 东部水晶塔
text.objectives: 触摸安戈洛尔环形山的东部水晶塔。
text.description: 上方的山崖上有一座巨大的水晶塔。我不能告诉你是谁放在那里的，我也不知道是基于什么样的原因才将水晶塔建在如此奇怪的地方。$b$b说不定你可以了解到更多的信息。我本人是不太关心这件事的，所以你不需要回来汇报，不过马绍尔哨站的学者或许对此有兴趣。
text.end: 找到并触摸东部水晶塔
text.completed: 向马绍尔哨站的科琳报到。

english.title: The Eastern Pylon
english.objectives: Touch the Eastern Crystal Pylon in Un'Goro Crater.
english.description: High up in the cliffs above me there is a large crystal pylon.  Who placed it there, I cannot say, nor can I determine any reason that it would be built in such a strange place.$b$bMaybe you can make more of it than I can.  I personally don't care what it does, so you needn't report back to me, but perhaps one of the scholars in Marshal's Stand might be interested in what you discover.
english.end: Discover and examine the Eastern Crystal Pylon
english.completed: Report to J.D. Collie at Marshal's Stand.

text.title: 北部水晶塔
text.objectives: 在安戈洛尔环形山找到北部水晶塔。
text.description: $n，你帮了我们不少忙……现在轮到格雷米斯报恩啦。马绍尔营地显然遭到了猛烈的攻击。敌人毫无征兆地发动突袭并血洗了整座营地。那些幸存者真是走了大运。$b$b数周前，我在马绍尔营地以东，此地东北方的山崖上看见了一座水晶塔。我觉得它和马绍尔营地的袭击事件有关。你能不能前去调查一下？营地的幸存者会感谢你的。
text.end: 找到并触摸北部水晶塔
text.completed: 向马绍尔哨站的科琳报到。

english.title: The Northern Pylon
english.objectives: Discover the location of the Northern Crystal Pylon in Un'Goro Crater.
english.description: You've done us a number of favors, $n... now let Gremix do one for you.  The attacks on Marshal's Refuge were terrible, undoubtedly.  They came without warning, and took no prisoners.  They were lucky that so many of them survived.$b$bA few weeks ago, I came across a crystal pylon in the cliffs to the northeast of here, east of Marshal's Refuge.  I think the pylon and the attacks may be related somehow.  Maybe you can investigate?  I'm sure someone in Marshal's Stand will thank you.
english.end: Discover and examine the Northern Crystal Pylon
english.completed: Report to J.D. Collie at Marshal's Stand.

text.title: 西部水晶塔
text.objectives: 找到西部水晶塔。
text.description: 杜林的研究所涉及的领域令我非常着迷：泰坦与恐龙之间可能存在关联。科琳回到营地后总是会谈起泰坦和水晶什么的……或许她也对此感兴趣吧。$b$b在你向她报到之前，最好查探一下不远处的水晶塔。它就矗立在西边的山崖上。在我看来，那座水晶塔跟泰坦有关。
text.end: 寻找并观察西部水晶塔
text.completed: 去马绍尔哨站找科琳。

english.title: The Western Pylon
english.objectives: Discover the location of the Western Crystal Pylon.
english.description: Durrin's research touched on one area that intrigues me: a potential link between the titans and the dinosaurs.  J.D. Collie back at camp is always talking about titan this and crystal that... maybe she'd be interested.$b$bBefore you report to her, you might want to check out the crystal pylon not far from here.  It's just up in the cliffs, to the west of here.  It's got crystals on it, and it always seemed to me like it might have something to do with the titans.
english.end: Discover and examine the Western Crystal Pylon
english.completed: Report to J.D. Collie at Marshal's Stand.

text.title: 挖骨头
text.objectives: 收集8根恐龙骨头。
text.description: 你也许认为我在马绍尔探险队里当挖掘工是因为我喜欢这活儿，好吧，世上可能的确有比这更糟糕的差事……但是我还真没见过。$B$B我们本应是在恐惧小道那个鬼地方进行剑龙和双帆龙化石的挖掘工作——顺便提一句，那地名可真古怪。呃，那儿也有许多活着的恐龙！威利和霍莱坚持要研究这些东西，所以我们还是得弄些恐龙骨头来。咱们私下里说说，其实你只要从活着的恐龙身上给我取些骨头回来就行了。

english.title: Roll the Bones
english.objectives: Obtain 8 Dinosaur Bones.
english.description: You'd think that being chief digger for Marshal Expeditions means I like digging.  There might be worse things to do in this world... but none really leap to mind.$B$BWe were supposed to be digging in Terror Run - FANTASTIC name by the way - for dead stegodons and diemetradons.  Well, there are plenty of live ones there too!  Wil and Hol are still all about studying this death trap, so we need those dinosaur bones.  Between you and me though, bringing some from live ones will work out just as well.

text.title: 拉克维的食物
text.objectives: 找到拉克维刚刚猎杀的动物的尸体，从尸体上偷取一块蛇颈龙肉块。
text.description: 很久以前，我的一个兄弟从拉克维的猎物身上拿了一些肉。他那时并不知道拉克维就潜伏在丛林中看着他。拉克维跟踪了我的兄弟好几天，毁灭了他碰过的一切。我的兄弟吓坏了，最终他决定从安戈洛逃走，彻底甩开拉克维。$B$B拉克维就在这附近杀死了他。$B$B如果你想激怒拉克维，就去寻找它刚刚杀死的猎物，并从尸体上取一些肉。$B$B从西边开始搜寻它的踪迹吧。

english.title: The Fare of Lar'korwi
english.objectives: Find the carcass of Lar'korwi's freshest kill and steal a Piece of Threshadon Carcass.
english.description: Once, a long time ago, a brother of mine took some meat from one of Lar'korwi's kills. He didn't know it at the time, but Lar'korwi saw him from the forest. Lar'korwi followed my brother for days, destroying everything he touched. My brother, scared, finally decided to run from the Crater and leave Lar'korwi behind.$B$BLar'korwi killed him not far from this spot.$B$BIf you want to provoke Lar'korwi, find a fresh kill of his and take some of the meat from it.$B$BStart your search to the west.

text.title: 拉克维的气味
text.objectives: 收集2份暴掠龙信息素。
text.description: 它居然没有来攻击你，这让我感到很惊讶。但是不要紧，我有个计划可以让那头野兽出来。$B$B作为这块区域的领袖，拉克维有权与任何雌性暴掠龙交配——而且它确实这么做了。你可以在这里的西边找到许多暴掠龙蛋，靠近它们，这时就会有雌性暴掠龙跑出来攻击你。这些雌性暴掠龙头上有一种腺体，它所散发出的味道可以告诉雄性暴掠龙：它准备进行交配了。给我带两个这样的腺体回来。
text.giverWindow: 要是有什么东西能比肉更吸引拉克维，那就是妞了。

english.title: The Scent of Lar'korwi
english.objectives: Obtain 2 Ravasaur Pheromone Glands.
english.description: I'm actually surprised he has not come for you yet, $n. But all is well, for I have a final plan that will bring the monster to us.$B$BBeing the dominant male gives Lar'korwi rights to breed with any female he chooses--and he chooses many of them. You'll find many ravasaur eggs to the west of here. Get close to them and you should provoke an attack by his mates. The females produce an awful smell from a gland in their heads that allow males to know they are ready to breed. Bring me two of those glands.

text.title: 拉克维的诱饵
text.objectives: 使用托尔瓦的麻袋中的东西召唤拉克维并打败它。将拉克维的头颅交给安戈洛环形山入口处的托尔瓦·寻路者。
text.description: 这将是整个计划中最困难的部分，因为它有点复杂。沿着河流一直向北走，寻找河水转向的地方。那是我最后一次看到拉克维的地方。那里应该散落着大型野兽的残骸，所以你很容易判断自己的位置是否正确。$B$B带上这块肉，把它放在那儿。然后在肉上涂抹我配制的这种液体。$B$B如果这两样东西加起来还不能使拉克维现身的话，我想也没什么东西能把它引诱出来了。
text.giverWindow: 爱鲜肉，更爱美人。

english.title: The Bait for Lar'korwi
english.objectives: Using the contents of Torwa's Pouch, summon Lar'korwi and defeat him. Then bring Lar'korwi's Head to Torwa Pathfinder near the entrance to Un'Goro Crater.
english.description: This will be the most difficult part because there is some complexity to the plan.  Continue following the river to the north, and look for a bend in the river.  It was here I saw Lar'korwi last.  You will know you are in the right area because of all the bones from massive creatures that once wandered nearby.$b$bTake the meat you recovered and place it there.  Then, rub this mixture I created on the meat.$b$bIf both lures mingled together do not bring Lar'korwi to you, then I know nothing else that will.
english.giverWindow: If there's one thing Lar'korwi likes more than meat, it's the ladies.

text.title: 走丢了！
text.objectives: 在火羽山寻找林格的下落。
text.description: 你一定要帮帮我，$n！我的朋友林格去了北面的火山探险，我已经很久没有他的消息了。我真的很担心他。$B$B你能去寻找他的下落吗？带上我的水壶吧——如果你找到林格的话，我相信他会用得着的！

english.title: Lost!
english.objectives: Find signs of Ringo at Fire Plume Ridge.
english.description: You've got to help me, $n! My friend, Ringo left earlier to explore the volcano to the north of here, and he has been gone way too long. I am really worried about him.$B$BDo you think you could find him? Why don't you take my canteen with you -- if you do find Ringo, I'm sure he'll need it!

text.title: 朋友的帮助
text.objectives: 把林格带回马绍尔哨站的斯普拉格·弗劳克身边。$B$B如果林格变得虚弱，就抽他耳光，如果林格晕倒了，就用斯普拉格的水壶让他恢复。
text.description: 啊……太热了……$B$B我正在探索这片地域，突然之间，我就热得昏了过去，我一定是中暑了。$B$B求求你，带我回到马绍尔哨站的朋友斯普拉格那里去，我想我还可以坚持到走回去……$B$B我感觉有些不对劲，如果我有些神志模糊，你就把我抽醒，如果我又晕倒了，就用斯普拉格的水壶里给我洒点水。我希望这能有点用……
text.end: 把林格带回马绍尔哨站
text.completed: 向马绍尔哨站的斯普拉格·弗劳克复命。

english.title: A Little Help From My Friends
english.objectives: Lead Ringo to Spraggle Frock at Marshal's Stand.$B$BIf Ringo feels weak, slap him.  If he faints, use Spraggle's Canteen to revive him.
english.description: Ugh... It's so hot...$B$BI was exploring this area, when all of a sudden, the heat just became unbearable. I must be suffering from heat exhaustion.$B$BPlease, help me get back to my friend Spraggle at Marshal's Stand. I think I'm well enough to follow you there.$B$BI am feeling a little out of it, so you can slap me if I'm feeling woozy.  If I do happen to faint again, just splash some water on me from Spraggle's canteen. That should work, I hope...
english.completed: Return to Spraggle Frock at Marshal's Stand.

text.title: 希兹尔的飞行器
text.objectives: 收集35块精细的翼手龙鳞片。
text.description: 我正在做一架飞行器！$B$B我被困在了这里，而且不敢轻易出去。如果我走出这里的话，肯定会迷路的，但是如果使用飞行器，我就可以轻松地回到加基森去。$B$B那么，你愿意帮助我吗？我现在只剩下机翼没有完成了，我想西边尖啸河滩那里的翼手龙的鳞片会是非常合适的材料。我自己是不可能去搞到这些鳞片的，但是你看上去好像有两把刷子。为什么你不帮我找找呢？

english.title: Shizzle's Flyer
english.objectives: Collect 35 Webbed Pterrordax Scales.
english.description: I'm making a flying machine!$B$BI got stranded here, and I'm absolutely horrible at finding my way around. I'd take a gryphon or wind rider back to Gadgetzan, but those beasts just scare me to death.$B$BSo, will you help me? All I have left to build is the wings, and I was thinking that the webby scales from the pterrordax in the Screaming Reaches to the west would be perfect. There's no way I'm going to go up against one of those, but you look pretty tough. Why don't you give it a try?

text.title: 极度粘稠
text.objectives: 收集8份极度粘稠的沥青。
text.description: 我总是在寻找快速赚钱的方法，$n。如果你能帮我实现新计划，我可以让你也赚点钱，怎么样？$B$B就这么定了！$B$B我们要制作一些粘合剂。到北边的油沼去，帮我收集一些沥青。并不是所有的沥青都合适，你必须从油沼周围的野兽身上得到它。另外呢，如果你使用我的刮油刀从它们的尸体上刮沥青，就不用担心弄脏手啦。

english.title: Super Sticky
english.objectives: Collect 8 samples of Super Sticky Tar.
english.description: I'm always looking for a quick way to earn a gold, $n. If you help me with my newest idea, I'll let you in on a little of the profit. How does that sound to you?$B$BI thought so!$B$BWe're going to be making some glue. Head to the tar pits just north of here, and collect me some tar. Not just any tar, now, you'll need to get it from the beasts that live around the tar pits. As a bonus, if you use my tar scraper on their corpses, you'll keep your hands nice and clean.

text.title: Williden's Journal
text.objectives: Return the journal to Williden Marshal somewhere in Un'Goro Crater.
text.description: You have uncovered a mangled journal.  Parts of it remain legible, with a Williden Marshal claiming ownership over the contents therein.  If the journal is accurate, then Williden may be found somewhere in the central part of the Crater; according to the journal, he and his companions sought to take a more offensive stance once their refuge was attacked.
text.completed: Return to Williden Marshal at Un'Goro Crater.

english.title: Williden's Journal
english.objectives: Return the journal to Williden Marshal somewhere in Un'Goro Crater.
english.description: You have uncovered a mangled journal.  Parts of it remain legible, with a Williden Marshal claiming ownership over the contents therein.  If the journal is accurate, then Williden may be found somewhere in the central part of the Crater; according to the journal, he and his companions sought to take a more offensive stance once their refuge was attacked.
english.completed: Return to Williden Marshal at Un'Goro Crater.

text.title: Expedition Salvation
text.objectives: Bring a Crate of Foodstuffs and Research Equipment to Williden Marshal in Un'Goro Crater.
text.description: I'm Williden Marshal, and I lead a non-aligned expedition troupe.  Now that our camp is more centrally located, it will be much more convenient for us to do many things... such as retrieving some long-forgotten supplies.$B$BWe've left some old supplies at deserted base camps both northeast and southwest of here.  You look like you're capable enough - can you help us by getting them back?
text.completed: Return to Williden Marshal at Un'Goro Crater.

english.title: Expedition Salvation
english.objectives: Bring a Crate of Foodstuffs and Research Equipment to Williden Marshal in Un'Goro Crater.
english.description: I'm Williden Marshal, and I lead a non-aligned expedition troupe.  Now that our camp is more centrally located, it will be much more convenient for us to do many things... such as retrieving some long-forgotten supplies.$B$BWe've left some old supplies at deserted base camps both northeast and southwest of here.  You look like you're capable enough - can you help us by getting them back?
english.completed: Return to Williden Marshal at Un'Goro Crater.

text.title: 火山活动
text.objectives: 从安戈洛环形山火山口附近的火焰元素身上收集9份安戈洛灰烬样本。
text.description: 你好。我是威利德·马绍尔，我和我的姐妹一起带领着这支由探险家和科学家组成的远征队。你有空吗？$b$b我很不喜欢在那座火山附近活动的元素生物，$c。我们有这么多的设备和笔记……倘若有只发疯的元素生物溜进了我们的营地，那它肯定会造成非常非常非常严重的破坏。$b$b让它们明白，新邻居可不是好惹的。顺便带回它们的灰烬……说不定可以拿来做个小试验。

english.title: Volcanic Activity
english.objectives: Collect 9 samples of Un'Goro Ash from the fire elementals around the volcano in Un'Goro Crater.
english.description: Welcome.  I'm Williden Marshal, and my sister and I run this expedition of explorers and scientists.  You have a moment?$b$bI don't like the look of those elementals on that volcano, $c.  We have too much equipment, too many notes... one crazed elemental could streak its way through our camp and do terrible, terrible damage.$b$bShow them that their new neighbors aren't to be trifled with.  And bring back the ash that they leave behind... we might as well do a little science while we're at it.

text.title: 以小换大
text.objectives: 收集5枚骨刺迅猛龙蛋。
text.description: 霍巴特认为这些小小的肉鸡蛋就够我们吃的了？呸！我们要吃正宗的蛋！$B$B我在东边的迅猛龙高地上设置了一些陷阱。将这些野生肉鸡蛋放置在陷阱里，迅猛龙就会赶过去觅食。然后，你就能换到巨大的迅猛龙蛋了。$B$B我真是个天才！
text.progress: How many did you get? I can just taste the massive omelet we're going to cook up now!
text.completion: Nice! Look at the size of those things!$B$BThere's no way that Grapplehammer's going to be able to top those!

english.title: Trading Up
english.objectives: Gather 5 Spiny Raptor Eggs.
english.description: Hobart thinks he's going to feed us on those tiny clucker eggs? Bah! We're going to get some real eggs!$B$BI've already set up some traps on the Raptor Rise up the path to the east. Take this bunch of wild clucker eggs and lay them in the traps. The spiny raptors will go right after the clucker eggs, and then you'll get to trade up to their larger eggs.$B$BGenius!
english.progress: How many did you get? I can just taste the massive omelet we're going to cook up now!
english.completion: Nice! Look at the size of those things!$B$BThere's no way that Grapplehammer's going to be able to top those!

text.title: 究根问底
text.objectives: 安戈洛尔环形山的克拉兰克要你去找到火羽山中温度最高的地方。$B$B当你找到一个看上去很热的地方时，就使用温度计来测量当地的温度。不断尝试，直到你找到温度最高的地方。
text.description: 我制作了一个测温计来读取火山的温度，希望能找到温度最高的地方。它是按照我独创的计量单位进行测量的！$B$B拿着这个温度计，当你经过某个炎热的地方，就顺便读取一下那里的温度！$B$B热点一般都是突出地面的、炽热的岩石柱。你可以在火羽山下找到这种岩石柱……沿着山麓跑一遍应该就够了。
text.giverWindow: 如果你要帮它，请别在杀掉他时碰他。

english.title: Finding the Source
english.objectives: Krakle in Un'Goro Crater wants you to find the hottest area of Fire Plume Ridge.$B$BWhenever you find a hot spot, use the thermometer to check the temperature. Keep looking until you find the hottest one.
english.description: I created a thermometer to take readings of the temperatures at the volcano, and I'd like to find the hottest lava flows.  It gives the measurements in degrees Kraklenheit!$B$BHere, take it, and take readings of the temperatures at the ridge whenever you see a hot spot!$b$bHot spots usually take the form of a glowing, rocky pillar jutting out of the ground.  You'll find them around the base of Fire Plume Ridge... one trip around the perimeter will likely suffice.

objectiveDetails.description: 找到火羽山最热的区域

starters.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

enders.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

text.title: 史上第一巨蛋
text.objectives: 取回史上第一巨蛋。
text.description: 巴姆·重磅炸弹？他以为自己是谁啊？什么骨刺迅猛龙蛋，根本比不上我们接下来要弄来的巨蛋！$B$B你也知道，每座胶囊镇都会配备一只微型机动战鸡以备不时之需。聪明如我，早就推断出这只预编程的大家伙跑到哪儿去了。$B$B去北边的焦痕深谷找它吧。当心，那玩意儿的电路板坏了，不打一架是不会把蛋给你的。
text.progress: Just think about the accolades that will rain down upon me... us, when the Biggest Egg Ever is returned!
text.completion: Eureka! My genius saves the day yet again! Take that Bamm Megabomb!$B$BAnd now, to reap the benefits!
text.giverWindow: 把史上最大的蛋弄来！

english.title: The Biggest Egg Ever
english.objectives: Recover the Biggest Egg Ever.
english.description: Bamm Megabomb? Who does he think he is? His spiny raptor eggs are no match for what we are about to recover!$B$BAs you well know, each Town-In-A-Box is equipped with a micro mechachicken for just such a dietary emergency. Luckily for us, my keen intellect was able to deduce the location that our prodigious, pre-programmed poultry ran off to.$B$BHead north to the Scorched Gully. But beware, its circuit boards are fried and I imagine it's not so micro any longer!
english.progress: Just think about the accolades that will rain down upon me... us, when the Biggest Egg Ever is returned!
english.completion: Eureka! My genius saves the day yet again! Take that Bamm Megabomb!$B$BAnd now, to reap the benefits!
english.giverWindow: Obtain the Biggest Egg Ever!

text.title: 微妙的气氛（肯定不是爱）
text.objectives: 将褪色的情人节卡片交给暴风城的探员斯尼普·滑栓。
text.description: 这张卡片里面记录了一个疯狂而详细的计划。其目的是感染艾泽拉斯的全部生物。你应该立刻把它交给热砂集团的一名调查员！
text.progress: Did you take care of those no-good scheming villains?
text.completion: What've you got there?$B$BOh hey, this is big. Real big. Most of the crazy details in one little package. Thanks - you really helped us reel this all in. Good working with ya.

english.title: Something is in the Air (and it Ain't Love)
english.objectives: Bring the Faded Lovely Greeting Card to Inspector Snip Snagglebolt in Stormwind.
english.description: The inside of the card is scribbled with mad, detailed plans to infect most of Azeroth.  You should show this to one of Steamwheedle's investigators immediately!
english.progress: Did you take care of those no-good scheming villains?
english.completion: What've you got there?$B$BOh hey, this is big. Real big. Most of the crazy details in one little package. Thanks - you really helped us reel this all in. Good working with ya.

objectiveDetails.description: 被分析的洒上香水的镇民

text.title: 搞破坏！
text.objectives: 破坏一枚矮人炮弹，在它爆炸前逃离巴尔丹。
text.description: 这些矮人炮弹都设有内置的空爆计时器。这太简单了！破坏装货间的一枚炮弹，将其抛进弹药库。轰隆隆！轰隆隆！$B$B这一层的停机库后面就是装货间，你可以装货间的角落里找到炮弹。$B$B破坏炮弹之后……赶紧跑！像风一样逃走，$n！然后返回营地向加恩复命，我会紧跟着你的。
text.completion:
Bael'dun? Destroyed?

<Wincing in pain, Gann twists his head to peer behind him, where plumes of smoke darken the skyline.>

$N, my friend. You have avenged Taurajo and avenged the Tauren people. The invaders will not soon recover from that blow. Thank you.

english.title: Sabotage!
english.objectives: Sabotage a Dwarven Artillery Shell and then flee from Bael'Dun before it explodes.
english.description: These dwarven artillery shells have a built-in airburst timer. This is easy! Just sabotage one of the artillery shells in the loading bay and then hoist it up into the magazine. Boom, baby. BOOM!$B$BYou'll find the shells in one of two loading bays behind the main garage on this level. It's right around the corner.$B$BOnce you've rigged the artillery shell... Run! Run like the wind, $n! Then report to Gann back at camp. I'll be right behind you.
english.completion:
Bael'dun? Destroyed?

<Wincing in pain, Gann twists his head to peer behind him, where plumes of smoke darken the skyline.>

$N, my friend. You have avenged Taurajo and avenged the Tauren people. The invaders will not soon recover from that blow. Thank you.

text.title: 巫妖王最后的阵地
text.objectives: 冰冠堡垒中的大领主达里安·莫格莱尼希望你去消灭巫妖王。
text.description: 影之哀伤，这件武器刚刚问世不久，却已经改写了这个世界的历史。它初生便背负着无与伦比的命运。$b$b手握这件武器的你同样背负着巨大的责任，而且现在就是你履行这一责任的时候。$b$b举起这件传奇武器，向敌人发起冲锋吧。为我们牺牲的无数英雄复仇，让他们饱受折磨的灵魂得到安息。$b$b坚定你的意志，$c，引领影之哀伤去实现它的命运吧。

english.title: The Lich King's Last Stand
english.objectives: Highlord Darion Mograine in Icecrown Citadel wants you to kill the Lich King.
english.description: Shadowmourne; a newly forged weapon already steeped in this world's history, reborn into an unrivaled destiny.$b$bWith this weapon you bear a solemn responsibility, and the time to carry out that charge is at hand.$b$bTake this weapon of myth and legend and march on the enemy. Avenge the countless heroes lost in his merciless campaign. Bring rest to their tortured souls.$b$bSteel yourself, $c, and guide Shadowmourne to fulfill the purpose of its creation.

starters.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

enders.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

text.title: 注入邪恶
text.objectives: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼要你用邪恶能量灌注影锋，并杀死普崔塞德教授。$B$B该任务只能在冰冠堡垒25人模式下完成。
text.description: 你的武器必须注入足够的力量，才能发挥出它真正的潜力。第一种要注入的力量就是邪恶。$b$b你必须找到并击败那个名叫普崔塞德教授的人。但消灭他并非你唯一的目标。你还要利用他的力量来对抗他。$b$b想办法吸收他的变异粘液。使用那种邪恶的物质为你的武器注入邪恶力量。然后我会指示你下一步的任务。
text.end: 将邪恶能量灌注到影锋之中，然后杀死普崔塞德教授。
text.completed: 去找大领主达里安·莫格莱尼。

english.title: Unholy Infusion
english.objectives: Highlord Darion Mograine wants you to infuse Shadow's Edge with Unholy power and slay Professor Putricide.$B$BThis quest may only be completed in 25 person difficulty of Icecrown Citadel.
english.description: Before your weapon can reach its full potential it must be endowed with its signature powers. First among them is unholiness.$b$bYou must seek out and defeat the one called Professor Putricide, but his death is not your only goal. You must use his resources against him.$b$bFind a way to absorb his mutated slime. Use the foul substance to infuse your weapon with the power of the unholy. Only when this has been done shall I reveal your next task.
english.end: Infuse Shadow's Edge with Unholy power then slay Putricide.
english.completed: Return to Highlord Darion Mograine.

starters.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

enders.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

text.title: 暗矛的崛起
text.objectives: 与暗矛训练场中的索拉萨谈谈。
text.description: 很久以来，暗矛部族一直都是受害者和流亡者。我们一直在逃离家园……但是这一次，我们并不是为了逃亡而来到这里的。$B$B沃金以他的智慧引领着我们，使我们生存到了今天。现在，这种智慧使我们察觉到了，在加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮的领导下，部落将会有怎样黑暗而混乱的未来。$B$B不，这一次我们不再逃亡了。这一次，我们要为了可以长期定居下去的家园而战。$B$B是时候开始你的训练了，$n。去跟东边的索拉萨谈谈吧。
text.completion: Anotha newblood, eh?$B$BYa actually have a sly look about ya though. Fierce eyes. You might have the makings of a real $c.$B$BLets not waste anymore time 'den.

english.title: The Rise of the Darkspear
english.objectives: Meet with Soratha in the Darkspear Training Grounds.
english.description: Tha Darkspear tribe have long been victims. Outcasts. We found ourselves fleein' our homes time 'n time again... but dis time, it's not fleein' dat drives us here.$B$BVol'jin has offered us leadership through wisdom, and it has kept us alive dis long. Now dat same wisdom offers portents of a chaotic future for tha Horde unda Garrosh Hellscream.$B$BNo, dis time we not fleein'. Dis time, we are fightin' for a home dat will last.$B$BIt's time to begin ya trainin', $n. Speak with Soratha to the east.
english.completion: Anotha newblood, eh?$B$BYa actually have a sly look about ya though. Fierce eyes. You might have the makings of a real $c.$B$BLets not waste anymore time 'den.

text.title: 基础教程：攻击目标
text.objectives: 摧毁6个蒂基面具假人。
text.description: 好了，伙计，我们先从简单的开始。首先我得确认你知道如何运用魔法的力量。$B$B去拿那些蒂基面具假人练练手，慢点来，自然一点。我会观察你的表现，然后决定下一步要怎么做。
text.completion: Not bad, mon. Ya have a natural flow to ya swings - you may have a talent for dis.$B$BSome rough edges ta be sure, but we'll get dose ironed out here and I'll teach ya a few new tings as we go.

english.title: The Basics: Hitting Things
english.objectives: Destroy 6 Tiki Targets.
english.description: Alright, mon. We start simple. I need ta know dat you know the basics of the arcane arts.$B$BGo thrash dose tiki targets. Take it slowly. Natural-like. I'll watch how you form your casts and we'll go from dere.
english.completion: Not bad, mon. Ya have a natural flow to ya swings - you may have a talent for dis.$B$BSome rough edges ta be sure, but we'll get dose ironed out here and I'll teach ya a few new tings as we go.

text.title: The Arts of a Mage
text.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Frost Nova. Practice using it 2 times against a Tiki Target.
text.description:
As ya' develop ya' powah, ya' gonna start to tink of new spells, new ways to use ya' arcane talents. 

Go now, grow ya' skills, and 'den come back an' show me what 'cha figure out.
text.progress: With time, ya'll learn enchantments that are a bit more crude, but have a bigger impact on yer fightin'. Shields dat'll absorb attacks. Armor dat'll freeze ya opponents. Ya'll even learn ta make copies of yerself that can cast spells as well.

english.title: The Arts of a Mage
english.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Frost Nova. Practice using it 2 times against a Tiki Target.
english.description:
As ya' develop ya' powah, ya' gonna start to tink of new spells, new ways to use ya' arcane talents. 

Go now, grow ya' skills, and 'den come back an' show me what 'cha figure out.
english.progress: With time, ya'll learn enchantments that are a bit more crude, but have a bigger impact on yer fightin'. Shields dat'll absorb attacks. Armor dat'll freeze ya opponents. Ya'll even learn ta make copies of yerself that can cast spells as well.

objectiveDetails.description: Reach Level 3 to Learn Frost Nova

text.title: 粗暴的开始
text.objectives: 收集6块蛮鬃豹皮。
text.description: 咱们来给你找点事做吧。先从简单的开始，伙计。$B$B岛上的豹子在猎杀我们的野猪。跟它们分享食物可不成！如果你今晚还想填饱肚子的话，就得想办法保证那些野猪还活着。$B$B岛上到处都是豹子。去把它们的毛皮给我拿来。
text.progress: I doubt dey too much of a challenge, mon, but they'll still claw up ya ankles if ya don't stay quick footed.
text.completion: Dese are some fine pelts, $G boy:girl;. We could make some hefty cloaks outta dese.

english.title: A Rough Start
english.objectives: Retrieve 6 Wildmane Cat Pelts.
english.description: Lets put dose skills ta use. I'll start ya off easy, mon.$B$BThere be cats killing our boars. Dat food ain't for sharin'. Dose boars are gonna need ta be alive if ya be wanting food tonight.$B$BDey're all over the island. Bring me some cat pelts.
english.progress: I doubt dey too much of a challenge, mon, but they'll still claw up ya ankles if ya don't stay quick footed.
english.completion: Dese are some fine pelts, $G boy:girl;. We could make some hefty cloaks outta dese.

text.title: 试炼场

text.title: 鲜血灌注
text.objectives: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼要你使用鲜血灌注影锋，并击败鲜血女王兰娜瑟尔。$B$B该任务只能在25人难度的冰冠堡垒中完成。
text.description: 你的武器现在已经准备好要接受鲜血的力量了。$b$b你必须在战斗中面对鲜血女王兰娜瑟尔，然后使你自己受到她的血之镜像的影响。这股力量将使影锋吸取最近的活体生物的鲜血，也就是你，$r。$b$b一旦刀刃完成了苏醒，让女王的疯狂嗜血控制你，满足影锋的渴望，然后再给女王致命的一击。$b$b但愿女王死时的绝望尖啸能刺穿巫妖王的双耳。
text.end: 使用鲜血灌注影锋后击败兰娜瑟尔。
text.completed: 去找大领主达里安·莫格莱尼。

english.title: Blood Infusion
english.objectives: Highlord Darion Mograine wants you to infuse Shadow's Edge with blood and defeat Queen Lana'thel.$B$BThis quest may only be completed in 25 person difficulty of Icecrown Citadel.
english.description: Your weapon is ready to be endowed with the power of blood.$b$bYou must face Queen Lana'thel in battle and subject yourself to her Blood Mirror. This will cause Shadow's Edge to drink the blood of the nearest living being. That being would be you, $r.$b$bOnce the blade has been thus awakened, allow the Queen's Frenzied Bloodthirst to take hold of you, feed the blade thrice to sate it, and then give the queen an ignominious death.$b$bMay her screams pierce the ears of the Lich King as he awaits his fate.
english.end: Infuse Shadow's Edge with Blood then defeat Lana'thel.
english.completed: Return to Highlord Darion Mograine.

text.title: 冰霜灌注
text.objectives: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼对你做出了指示，他要你在使用影锋与辛达苟萨战斗时，经受住辛达苟萨的四次气息攻击，然后再杀死她。$B$B该任务只能在25人难度的冰冠堡垒中完成。
text.description: 影锋已经准好要接收其最终的力量灌注了。$b$b辛达苟萨，敌人的坐骑，必须死。但是在杀死她之前，你必须要在不死的情况下经受住她的四次冰霜气息。$b$b没有了他的龙之后，在你和巫妖王之间就不再有真正意义上的对手了。
text.end: 为影锋注入冰霜之力后杀死辛达苟萨。
text.completed: 去找大领主达里安·莫格莱尼。

english.title: Frost Infusion
english.objectives: Highlord Darion Mograine has instructed you to slay Sindragosa after subjecting yourself to 4 of her breath attacks while wielding Shadow's Edge.$B$BThis quest may only be completed in 25 person difficulty of Icecrown Citadel.
english.description: Shadow's Edge is prepared to receive its final infusion of power.$b$bSindragosa, the enemy's own mount, must fall. But before she is brought down, you must sustain four of her frozen breath attacks without tasting death.$b$bWithout his dragon, nothing shall stand between you and the Lich King.
english.end: Infuse Shadow's Edge with Frost then slay Sindragosa.

text.title: 暗矛的崛起
text.objectives: 与暗矛训练场中的奈卡利谈谈。
text.description: 很久以来，暗矛部族一直都是受害者和流亡者。我们一直在逃离家园……但是这一次，我们并不是为了逃亡而来到这里的。$B$B沃金以他的智慧引领着我们，使我们生存到了今天。现在，这种智慧使我们察觉到了，在加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮的领导下，部落将会有怎样黑暗而混乱的未来。$B$B不，这一次我们不再逃亡了。这一次，我们要为了可以长期定居下去的家园而战。$B$B是时候开始你的训练了，$n。去跟东边的奈卡利谈谈吧。
text.completion: Anotha newblood, eh?$B$BYa actually have a sly look about ya though. Fierce eyes. You might have the makings of a real $c.$B$BLets not waste anymore time 'den.

english.title: The Rise of the Darkspear
english.objectives: Meet with Nekali in the Darkspear Training Grounds.
english.description: Tha Darkspear tribe have long been victims. Outcasts. We found ourselves fleein' our homes time 'n time again... but dis time, it's not fleein' dat drives us here.$B$BVol'jin has offered us leadership through wisdom, and it has kept us alive dis long. Now dat same wisdom offers portents of a chaotic future for tha Horde unda Garrosh Hellscream.$B$BNo, dis time we not fleein'. Dis time, we are fightin' for a home dat will last.$B$BIt's time to begin ya trainin', $n. Speak with Nekali to the east.
english.completion: Anotha newblood, eh?$B$BYa actually have a sly look about ya though. Fierce eyes. You might have the makings of a real $c.$B$BLets not waste anymore time 'den.

text.title: 基础教程：攻击目标
text.objectives: 摧毁6个蒂基面具假人。
text.description: 好了，伙计，我们先从简单的开始。首先我得确认你知道如何运用自然的力量。$B$B去拿那些蒂基面具假人练练手，慢点来，自然一点。我会观察你的表现，然后决定下一步要怎么做。
text.completion: Not bad, mon. Ya have a natural flow to ya swings - you may have a talent for dis.$B$BSome rough edges ta be sure, but we'll get dose ironed out here and I'll teach ya a few new tings as we go.

english.title: The Basics: Hitting Things
english.objectives: Destroy 6 Tiki Targets.
english.description: Alright, mon. We start simple. I need ta know dat you know the basics of the natural arts.$B$BGo thrash dose tiki targets. Take it slowly. Natural-like. I'll watch how you form your casts and we'll go from dere.
english.completion: Not bad, mon. Ya have a natural flow to ya swings - you may have a talent for dis.$B$BSome rough edges ta be sure, but we'll get dose ironed out here and I'll teach ya a few new tings as we go.

text.title: The Arts of a Shaman
text.objectives: Reach Level 3 to learn Primal Strike, and then use Primal Strike 3 times against a Tiki Target.

As ya grow in powah, you begin ta discovah the voices of da ancestahs speakin' to ya, teachin' you dere secrets.

Tha first of 'dese is to focus tha power of da elements into yer weapon. It allows ya to unleash a quick, vicious attack on your enemies. Dis should be easy enough for ya to make a lot of use of it.$B$BTry it out. Let me know when ya tink you have it down.

There's one ya should be learnin' soon to let ya see dere weaknesses and set up for devastating combo attacks. After ya've struck a few blows to weaken ya foe, finish dem off with a vicious evisceration attack.

When ya learn it, try it out. Let me know when ya tink you have it down.

text.title: 粗暴的开始
text.objectives: 收集6块蛮鬃豹皮。
text.description: 咱们来给你找点事做吧。先从简单的开始，伙计。$B$B岛上的豹子在猎杀我们的野猪。跟它们分享食物可不成！如果你今晚还想填饱肚子的话，就得想办法保证那些野猪还活着。$B$B岛上到处都是豹子。去把它们的毛皮给我拿来。
text.completion: Dese are some fine pelts, $G boy:girl;. We could make some hefty cloaks outta dese.

english.title: A Rough Start
english.objectives: Retrieve 6 Wildmane Cat Pelts.
english.description: Lets put dose skills ta use. I'll start ya off easy, mon.$B$BThere be cats killing our boars. Dat food ain't for sharin'. Dose boars are gonna need ta be alive if ya be wanting food tonight.$B$BDey're all over the island. Bring me some cat pelts.
english.completion: Dese are some fine pelts, $G boy:girl;. We could make some hefty cloaks outta dese.

text.title: 试炼场
text.objectives: 同暗矛狱卒交谈，然后进入试炼场，杀死一名恶鳞斥候俘虏。
text.description: 你干得很不错，$c。我还可以再教你一些手段，但我不会再让你对着假人浪费时间了。$B$B现在我给你安排最后一项考验吧，伙计。到这个区域中间的试炼场去，跟一个真正的敌人交手——对方对你可是毫不留情的哟。等你准备好了，告诉那边的狱卒一声就行了。
text.completion: Ya handle yerself quite well. Ya gonna be quite powerful some day.

english.title: Proving Pit
english.objectives: Speak to a Darkspear Jailor, then enter the proving pit and kill a Captive Spitescale Scout.
english.description: Ya done quite well for ya'self, $c. I'm sure I could teach ya a trick or two here and dere, but I not be wastin' ya time on tiki targets no longer.$B$Bl put one last trial before ya den, mon. Head over to da provin' pit in the middle of dis area and fight a real baddy - one dat wants ta kill ya back. Just let the jailor by the pit know when ya ready.
english.completion: Ya handle yerself quite well. Ya gonna be quite powerful some day.

text.title: 喜出望外
text.objectives: 向暗矛要塞中的沃金报到。
text.description: 你真是令我们喜出望外，伙计。我敢说，你的天赋对我们肯定是大有帮助。你不用再跟这些新兵蛋子混在一起啦。$B$B到东南边的村子里去吧，闯出你自己的天地来。到处帮帮忙，我相信你很快就会出人头地的。
text.completion: Ya tha new recruit everyone's talkin' about, eh? Welcome ta tha Darkspear.

english.title: More Than Expected
english.objectives: Report to Vol'jin at Darkspear Hold.
english.description: Ya definitely more den expected, mon. I'm sure dere's more important stuff we can be usin' ya talents on now. Ya don't need ta hang out with da newbloods no more.$B$BHead down to da village to da southeast and make yaself known. Lend a hand here and there and I'm sure ya make yer way up to sometin' more prestigious quick enough.
english.completion: Ya tha new recruit everyone's talkin' about, eh? Welcome ta tha Darkspear.

text.title: 暗矛的崛起
text.objectives: 与暗矛训练场中的欧塔扎谈谈。
text.description: 很久以来，暗矛部族一直都是受害者和流亡者。我们一直在逃离家园……但是这一次，我们并不是为了逃亡而来到这里的。$B$B沃金以他的智慧引领着我们，使我们生存到了今天。现在，这种智慧使我们察觉到了，在加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮的领导下，部落将会有怎样黑暗而混乱的未来。$B$B不，这一次我们不再逃亡了。这一次，我们要为了可以长期定居下去的家园而战。$B$B是时候开始你的训练了，$n。去跟东边的欧塔扎谈谈吧。
text.completion: Anotha newblood, eh?$B$BYa actually have a sly look about ya though. Fierce eyes. You might have the makings of a real $c.$B$BLets not waste anymore time 'den.

english.title: The Rise of the Darkspear
english.objectives: Meet with Ortezza in the Darkspear Training Grounds.
english.description: Tha Darkspear tribe have long been victims. Outcasts. We found ourselves fleein' our homes time 'n time again... but dis time, it's not fleein' dat drives us here.$B$BVol'jin has offered us leadership through wisdom, and it has kept us alive dis long. Now dat same wisdom offers portents of a chaotic future for tha Horde unda Garrosh Hellscream.$B$BNo, dis time we not fleein'. Dis time, we are fightin' for a home dat will last.$B$BIt's time to begin ya trainin', $n. Speak with Ortezza to the east.
english.completion: Anotha newblood, eh?$B$BYa actually have a sly look about ya though. Fierce eyes. You might have the makings of a real $c.$B$BLets not waste anymore time 'den.

text.title: 基础教程：攻击目标
text.objectives: 摧毁6个蒂基面具假人。
text.description: 好了，伙计，我们先从简单的开始。首先我得确认你知道如何使用手里的武器。$B$B去拿那些蒂基面具假人练练手，慢点来，自然一点。我会观察你的表现，然后决定下一步要怎么做。
text.completion: Not bad, mon. Ya have a natural flow to ya swings - you may have a talent for dis.$B$BSome rough edges ta be sure, but we'll get dose ironed out here and I'll teach ya a few new tings as we go.

english.title: The Basics: Hitting Things
english.objectives: Destroy 6 Tiki Targets.
english.description: Alright, mon. We start with da basics. I need ta know dat you know how ta use dat weapon you're totin' around.$B$BGo thrash dose tiki targets. Take it slowly. Natural-like. I'll watch ya fighting form and we'll go from dere.
english.completion: Not bad, mon. Ya have a natural flow to ya swings - you may have a talent for dis.$B$BSome rough edges ta be sure, but we'll get dose ironed out here and I'll teach ya a few new tings as we go.

text.title: The Arts of a Hunter
text.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Steady Shot. Use Steady Shot 5 times on a Tiki Target.
text.description: As ya' start to get da hang of tings, ya gonna figure out how ta do new tricks.$B$BOne of da' first ya gonna learn is to keep a steady hand between shots, or else ya gonna find yaself exhausted and not really managin' to kill much.$B$BGo get some more experience 'till ya figure it out, 'den come back and try it out. Let me know when ya tink you have it down.
text.completion: Good work, mon! Dis stuff come easy to ya.

text.objectives: 跟马绍尔哨站的斯普拉格·弗劳克谈一谈。
text.description: 我的好朋友斯普拉格为了某件事烦恼了好一阵子了。我本来想帮她的，但是如你所见，我现在不挺舒坦的嘛。$b$b你能不能跟她谈谈，看看她有什么需要帮忙的？
