english.title: Speak With Spraggle
english.objectives: Speak to Spraggle Frock in Marshal's Stand.
english.description: My good friend Spraggle has been fretting about something for some time now.  I'd help her, but as you can see, I'm pretty comfortable right now.$b$bCould you check in with her and see what she needs?
english.completed: Speak to Spraggle Frock in Marshal's Stand.

text.title: 银色盟约的胜利
text.objectives: 将奎尔德拉交给银色比武场的裁决者玛蕾尔·图哈特。
text.description: 在鲜血女王兰娜瑟尔自吹自擂的时候，而你，$n，却已经取得了奎尔德拉。$B$B银色盟约和全体奎尔多雷都对你心怀感激。$B$B奎尔德拉似乎知道你是一名$c，无法使用它。那么它的下一个主人该是谁？也许银色十字军能为它找到新主人。到北边的银色比武场去，代表银色盟约将这把剑交给裁决者玛蕾尔·图哈特。

english.title: A Victory For The Silver Covenant
english.objectives: Bring the Restored Quel'Delar to Justicar Mariel Trueheart at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: In spite of Queen Lana'thel's boasting, you have restored Quel'Delar, $n. Long have we dreamt of reclaiming Quel'Delar.$B$BThe Silver Covenant, and indeed all quel'dorei owe you a debt of gratitude.$B$BAs a $c, the sword seems to know you lack the training to wield it and hasn't bonded to you. Where, then, will its next master come from? Perhaps the Argent Crusade can find one. Go north to the Argent Tournament Grounds and present the sword to Justicar Mariel Trueheart on behalf of the Silver Covenant.

text.title: 银色盟约的胜利
text.objectives: 将奎尔德拉交给达拉然紫罗兰城堡中的温蕾萨·风行者。
text.description: 在鲜血女王兰娜瑟尔自吹自擂的时候，而你，$n，却已经取得了奎尔德拉。$B$B银色盟约和全体奎尔多雷都对你心怀感激。$B$B银色盟约的领袖温蕾萨·风行者希望你从太阳之井返回以后能去见她一面。请带着奎尔德拉前往达拉然的紫罗兰城堡，她正在那里等你，$n。

english.title: A Victory For The Silver Covenant
english.objectives: Bring the Restored Quel'Delar to Vereesa Windrunner at the Violet Citadel in Dalaran.
english.description: In spite of Queen Lana'thel's boasting, you have restored Quel'Delar, $n. Long have we dreamt of reclaiming Quel'Delar.$B$BThe Silver Covenant, and indeed all quel'dorei owe you a debt of gratitude.$B$BVereesa Windrunner, the leader of the Silver Covenant, asked to see you after you returned from the Sunwell. Take Quel'Delar with you and go to Dalaran's Violet Citadel where she waits, $n.

text.title: A Victory For The Sunreavers
text.objectives: Bring the Restored Quel'Delar to Justicar Mariel Trueheart at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
text.description: At last, Quel'Delar is restored for the glory of the Sunreavers and the sin'dorei!$B$BAll of Silvermoon will celebrate you as a hero, $n.$B$BAs a $c, the sword seems to know you lack the training to wield it and hasn't bonded to you. Where, then, will its next master come from? No worthy sin'dorei has come forward. Let us seek the Argent Crusade's counsel. Go north to the Argent Tournament Grounds and present the sword to Justicar Mariel Trueheart on behalf of the Sunreavers.

text.title: 夺日者的胜利
text.objectives: 将奎尔德拉交给达拉然紫罗兰城堡的大法师艾萨斯·夺日者。
text.description: 奎尔德拉终于回到了我们的手中，这是夺日者和辛多雷的光荣！银月城的全部居民和全体部落成员都会将你视为英雄。$B$B夺日者的领袖，大法师艾萨斯·夺日者希望你从太阳之井回来以后去见他一面。$n，带着奎尔德拉前往达拉然的紫罗兰城堡。大法师要亲自向你祝贺胜利！

english.title: A Victory For The Sunreavers
english.objectives: Bring the Restored Quel'Delar to Archmage Aethas Sunreaver at the Violet Citadel in Dalaran.
english.description: At last, Quel'Delar is restored for the glory of the Sunreavers and the sin'dorei! All of Silvermoon will proclaim you a hero, as will all of the Horde.$B$BArchmage Aethas Sunreaver, the leader of the Sunreavers, asked to see you after you returned from the Sunwell. Travel to the Violet Citadel in Dalaran as soon as you can, $n and bring Quel'Delar with you. The archmage wishes to congratulate you personally!

text.title: 夺日者的胜利
text.objectives: 将奎尔德拉交给达拉然紫罗兰城堡的大法师艾萨斯·夺日者。
text.description: 奎尔德拉终于回到了我们的手中，这是夺日者和部落的光荣！也是这场对抗巫妖王的战争中我们得到的祝福。$B$B夺日者的领袖，大法师艾萨斯·夺日者希望你从太阳之井回来以后去见他一面。$n，带着奎尔德拉前往达拉然的紫罗兰城堡。大法师要亲自向你祝贺胜利！

text.title: 巫妖王之怒
text.objectives: 找到希尔瓦娜斯·风行者，并逃出映像大厅。
text.description: 很难相信，最有可能击败阿尔萨斯的地方恰恰就是在他王座前的阶梯上。如果阿尔萨斯倒下，谁又会戴上巫妖王的王冠？$B$B有许多问题还悬而未决，但你必须找到希尔瓦娜斯，并逃过巫妖王的攻击。
text.completion: Yet again, vengeance slips through my grasp. It's hard to believe how much stronger he's gotten.$B$BIt was foolish of you to come for me, but it's good to know that there are still some champions of the Horde that aren't useless cowards.$B$BThe information Uther gave us may well be key to finally killing Arthas, though it is becoming more and more clear that the Horde will not be able to accomplish this on their own.$B$BGo, $c. I expect your prowess may be needed again very soon.

english.title: Wrath of the Lich King
english.objectives: Find Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and escape the Halls of Reflection.
english.description: It's hard to believe that there is much hope of defeating Arthas upon the steps of his own throne. And who will take up the crown of Lich King if it comes to that?$B$BMany questions remain, but you need to find Sylvanas and escape the Lich King while there's still time.
english.completion: Yet again, vengeance slips through my grasp. It's hard to believe how much stronger he's gotten.$B$BIt was foolish of you to come for me, but it's good to know that there are still some champions of the Horde that aren't useless cowards.$B$BThe information Uther gave us may well be key to finally killing Arthas, though it is becoming more and more clear that the Horde will not be able to accomplish this on their own.$B$BGo, $c. Try fishing for the blacktip wherever you would normally catch the suckerfish.

text.description: 皇冠药剂公司有些不对劲的地方。热砂集团已经开始注意他们了。我们要对此采取行动。$b$b如果你有兴趣帮助我们，就请到暴风城去。探员斯尼普·滑栓正在那里进行调查，他很需要你的帮助。

text.title: 温诺亚·松林
text.objectives: 跟南贫瘠之地世仇哨站的温诺亚·松林谈一谈。
text.description: 尽管我们在这里收获颇丰，但如果让这腐蚀趁我们的不注意的时候散布出去，那可就真是一场悲剧了。哀嚎洞穴的走廊蜿蜒在整个贫瘠之地里，如果狂野的能量找到了另一个可以冒头的地方……$B$B不过，你为我做的已经够多了。我只能要求你把这里的事情去告诉我的一个德鲁伊同伴。你可以在西南边的世仇哨站找到温诺亚·松林。
text.completion:
I could feel what occured from here, $c. It bristled every hair I have.

I'm overjoyed to hear you succeeded in pushing those horrors back, and I'll be sure to scour the area for any stray deviate creatures.

english.title: Winnoa Pineforest
english.objectives: Speak to Winnoa Pineforest at Vendetta Point in Southern Barrens.
english.description: While we've accomplished much here, it would be a tragedy if part of this corruption has escaped our notice.  The corridors of the Wailing Cavern stretch throughout the entire Barrens, and if another spot of wild energy has made its way to the surface...$B$BYou've done enough for me, though. I would simply ask that you let a fellow druid of mine know of what's happened here. You will find Winnoa Pineforest at Vendetta Point, southwest of here.
english.completion:

text.title: 不再怜悯
text.objectives: 杀死12个恶鳞纳迦。
text.description: 纳迦对我们的同胞犯下了滔天的罪行。对于他们，无需有任何怜悯之心。$B$B到山洞里去，对纳迦格杀勿论。今天你多干掉一个纳迦，明天就可以少一份担忧。我相信你会认真执行这个任务的。

english.title: No More Mercy
english.objectives: Kill 12 Spitescale Naga.
english.description: Da naga have committed great atrocities on our people. Da time ta show dem mercy has long passed.$B$BEnter da cave and kill any naga you find dere. Every naga dead dis day is one less naga ta take us unawares later on. I trust ya will be thorough.

text.title: 领土神像
text.objectives: 在恶鳞纳迦的旗帜上放置8个领土神像。
text.description: 这可不是一次普通的反击。我们的目标是把这里的纳迦赶尽杀绝，尽一切努力使他们不敢再回来。$B$B我要你去把这些神像放在纳迦山洞里的恶鳞旗帜上，这是我们向他们传达的明确信号。而且，这些神像中蕴含的魔法可以极大地削弱附近的恶鳞纳迦，这样他们就不敢留下来了。

english.title: Territorial Fetish
english.objectives: Place 8 Territorial Fetishes on Spitescale flags.
english.description: Dis is no casual counter-attack. We be fully intendin' ta slaughter every last naga here and do anything we can ta ensure that dey will have no desire ta return.$B$BI want ya ta place dese fetishes on any Spitescale banner ya be findin' inside their cave. It should prove a clear statement of what we think of their presence here. More dan dat, da magic in dese fetishes will be weakenin' any Spitescale dat approach, which should make dem second guess stayin' on our isle.

text.title: 古老的宿敌
text.objectives: 与恶鳞海湾内的沃金交谈，协助他杀死海巫扎尔吉拉。
text.description: 海巫就在这里，这座岛屿的顶部。我们等待这个复仇的机会已经很久了，而你将有幸亲眼见证这个时刻。$B$B到东北方的斜坡上去，与沃金会合。等你准备好加入战斗之后，就告诉他。
text.giverWindow: 很久以前，海巫杀死了沃金的父亲，并将巨魔赶出了他们的岛屿家园。现在她回来了，沃金终于有了复仇的机会。

english.title: An Ancient Enemy
english.objectives: Speak with Vol'jin in Spitescale Cove and aid him in killing Zar'jira, the Sea Witch.
english.description: Da Sea Witch is here, on top of dis very isle. We've been waitin' a long time for dis chance at revenge and ya will be havin' da privilege of seein' it through.$B$BMeet with Vol'jin, up da ramp to da northeast. Let him know when you are ready ta join da battle.
english.giverWindow: Long ago, the Sea Witch killed Vol'jin's father and chased the trolls out of their island homes. Now she returns, and Vol'jin is finally given a chance for vengeance.

objectiveDetails.description: 与恶鳞海湾的沃金交谈

text.title: 道路的选择
text.completion: To atone for the sins I committed as one of the Lich King's Death Knights, I've dedicated myself to creating rings of great power for our brothers and sisters to use in the struggle.$B$BYou've proven yourself as a valuable ally in the fight against the Scourge, $N.  As your dedication continues I can improve on the ring's original design.$B$BChoose your path carefully.  A change of heart will come at a price.

text.title: 到底谁站在食物链顶层？
text.objectives: 收集5块鲨鱼肉。
text.description: 好吧，巨蛋这回事算是我输掉了。有谁想吃鲨鱼肉吗？$B$B不过有个小问题。嗯，大问题。好吧，是很大的问题：巨锤！$B$B当然，我已经想到一个绝妙的办法了。去西边的险峻海峡收集一些鲨鱼肉。将它们交给我的助手格瑞里就行，我可不想为这种小事弄脏自己的手。
text.progress: $N, take it easy on Grapplehammer. He's a genius, but he's got a fragile ego.
text.completion: These will do very nicely! We're going to combine the shark parts and the robotic remains of the Mechachicken into a submersible that should allow you to rid us of that nuisance, The Hammer!

english.title: Who's Top of the Food Chain Now?
english.objectives: Collect 5 Shark Parts.
english.description: Fine, fine, perhaps the whole egg thing didn't quite pan out. Who's up for some shark meat?$B$BOnly one little problem. Well, a big problem, actually. A really BIG problem: The Hammer!$B$BOf course, I have a brilliant idea. Swim out into the Dire Strait to the west and get us some shark parts. Give them to my assistant, Greely. I'm too important to get my hands dirty with the small details.

english.completion: These will do very nicely! We're going to combine the shark parts and the robotic remains of the Mechachicken into a submersible that should allow you to rid us of that nuisance, The Hammer!

text.title: 披着鲨鱼皮的地精
text.objectives: 激活X型蒸汽机械鲨鱼控制器，再使用X型蒸汽机械鲨鱼杀死巨锤。
text.description: 我们将机动战鸡的废弃部件和鲨鱼肉块组合起来，制成了一件了不起的潜水战斗装置：X型蒸汽机械鲨鱼！$B$B霍巴特和我希望你来驾驶它，$n。潜入西边的海峡，激活X型蒸汽机械鲨鱼控制器。$B$B你必须杀死巨锤，否则我们就没法发掘险峻海峡里丰富的自然资源了！为了财团的利益 ！
text.completion: Excellent work, my $g boy : girl;! The Town-In-A-Box is saved and the Bilgewater Cartel will be profitable once again thanks to my overwhelmingly unbelievable intellect and tinkering know-how.
text.giverWindow: 使用X型蒸汽机械鲨鱼把这个怪物啃个干净！

english.title: A Goblin in Shark's Clothing
english.objectives: Activate a Mechashark X-Steam Controller and use the Mechashark X-Steam to slay The Hammer.
english.description: Combining the remains of the Mechachicken with these shark parts, we've assembled the greatest fighting submersible of all time: the Mechashark X-Steam!$B$BHobart and I want you to pilot it, $n. Go west to the water and activate the Mechashark X-Steam Controller.$B$BYou must kill The Hammer if we're to have any hope of exploiting the natural resources of the Dire Strait to their fullest extent. It's for the good of the cartel!

text.title: 镶金玫瑰的焰火
text.objectives: 到暴风城贸易区的镶金玫瑰旅店去，同那里的玛丽恩·桑顿交谈。
text.description: 小鬼，这可不仅仅是香水那么简单。那个木箱里安有一些火箭，那些火箭内部有一种化学成分。我在这儿没法跟你细讲，但我可以让你前往那个实验室。$B$B你得查出是谁制造了这些东西。我认识制作者的标记。斯内维尔。$B$B我有个可靠的消息，斯内维尔目前正在暴风城，你可以在镶金玫瑰那里找到他。还有，他还有个相好，名叫玛丽恩·桑顿。去镶金玫瑰找找看，看她有什么消息。
text.completion: You... You're not Snivel. Did he send you? He's so late, I had started to give up hope...$B$B<Tears start welling up in the woman's eyes once she realizes that you aren't there to deliver a message from Snivel.>$B$BThat's not like my Snivel, but what choice is there?

english.title: Fireworks At The Gilded Rose
english.objectives: Speak to Marion Sutton at the Gilded Rose in Stormwind's Trade District.
english.description: Kid, this is about more than just perfume. There were some rockets in that crate, and they had some kind of chemical payload inside. I can't analyze it here, but I'll spare ya the trip to the lab.$B$BNah, you gotta find the guy who made these. I know the maker's mark. Snivel Rustrocket.$B$BI got a tip from a reliable source that Snivel's here in Stormwind, livin' it up at the Gilded Rose. What's more, he had some dame on his arm. Marion Sutton was the name. Go to the Gilded Rose and see what she knows.
english.completion: You... You're not Snivel. Did he send you? He's so late, I had started to give up hope...$B$B<Tears start welling up in the woman's eyes once she realizes that you aren't there to deliver a message from Snivel.>$B$BThat's not like my Snivel, but what choice is there?

text.title: 热力追踪
text.objectives: 在暴风城的会计室、拍卖行和理发店寻找斯内维尔·拉斯罗凯特。
text.description: 我最好从头开始说。起初是爱情，$n。那是我一眼就看中的一个地精。$B$B我们共度了一个星期的美好时光，斯内维尔说他弄到了一大笔钱，打算和我一起去南海度个长假！你能相信吗？$B$B不管怎么说，他让我收拾好行李，自己去银行、拍卖行和理发店跑趟差，但他再没回来过！我开始意识到他就是个大骗子！
text.progress: Who are you?
text.completion: All he talked about was leaving town with all his money? Then he really has abandoned me, hasn't he?$B$BOh, $N. I was such a fool to fall for him, but how could I help myself? He was so irresistible!

english.title: Hot On The Trail
english.objectives: Look for Snivel Rustrocket in the Stormwind Counting House, the Auction House, and the Barbershop in Stormwind City.
english.description: I'd better start from the beginning. It was love at first sight, $n. There was just something about that goblin from the moment I set eyes on him.$B$BAfter a wonderful week together, Snivel said he had come into a lot of money and that he was going to take me on a long vacation to the South Seas! Can you believe it?$B$BAnyway, he told me to pack while he ran some errands to the bank, the auction house, and the barber shop, but he never came back! I'm beginning to think he's nothing but a big liar!
english.progress: Who are you?
english.completion: All he talked about was leaving town with all his money? Then he really has abandoned me, hasn't he?$B$BOh, $N. I was such a fool to fall for him, but how could I help myself? He was so irresistible!

text.title: 斯内维尔的情人
text.objectives: 在奥格瑞玛暗巷区的高特雷的旅行装备店同洛卡交谈。
text.description: 孩子，这里面装的可不只是香水。在这只箱子里有一些火箭，它们里面都储存着某种化学能量。我在这里无法对它们进行分析。不过我可以把它们带到实验室去。$B$B你要去找到那个制造出这些东西的人。我认识他——斯内维尔·拉斯罗凯特。$B$B我听说斯内维尔就在奥格瑞玛，而且他还有个女朋友，一个名叫洛卡的女兽人。她和斯内维尔约好了在暗巷区的高特雷的旅行装备店见面，然后一同逃走。
text.completion: You're not Snivel. He was supposed to be here an hour ago! What have you done with him?$B$B<Roka seems to calm down when you tell her that you're looking for Snivel, too. Then the tears start to well up in her eyes.>$B$BThis isn't like my Snivel. Do you think something's happened to him?

english.objectives: Speak to Roka at Gotri's Traveling Gear in Orgrimmar's Drag district.
english.description: Kid, this is about more than just perfume. There were some rockets in that crate, and they had some kind of chemical payload inside. I can't analyze it here, but I'll spare ya the trip to the lab.$B$BNah, you gotta find the guy who made these. I know the maker's mark. Snivel Rustrocket.$B$BI hear Snivel's livin' it up here in Orgrimmar. What's more, he's got himself a girlfriend -- some orc dame named Roka. She's supposed to meet him at Gotri's Traveling Gear in the Drag before they make their escape.
english.completion: You're not Snivel. He was supposed to be here an hour ago! What have you done with him?$B$B<Roka seems to calm down when you tell her that you're looking for Snivel, too. Then the tears start to well up in her eyes.>$B$BThis isn't like my Snivel. Do you think something's happened to him?

text.title: 被囚禁的部族
text.objectives: 打开4座野猪人牢笼。
text.description: 个头姑且不论，刺背野猪人的数量也远超我们，就算是最大的牛头人，也无法抵挡结群野猪人的伏击。$B$B许多见习生都举起了武器，保卫家园，有些献出了自己的生命，而其他人则被活捉了起来。$B$B请找到关押他们的笼子，将他们解救出来。正在忙于作战的野猪人不会给你制造多少麻烦的。
text.completion: Thanks to you, our people are free to fight for our home.

english.title: Our Tribe, Imprisoned
english.objectives: Open 4 Quilboar Cages.
english.description: Despite their size, the Bristleback greatly outnumber us. A pack ambush can easily overwhelm even the largest tauren.$B$BMany new initiates have taken up arms to defend our home. Some have given their lives, but others have been captured alive.$B$BPlease, find their cages and free them. The battle should keep the quilboar distracted.
english.completion: Thanks to you, our people are free to fight for our home.

text.title: 寻找暴风爪
text.objectives: 向安戈洛环形山入口处的加尔·暴风爪报到。
text.description: 赞阿利利一直在学习德鲁伊的知识，$r。希望有一天赞阿利利能加入利爪德鲁伊的行列，像风暴乌鸦那样翱翔在环形山的上空。$b$b但是导师让我待在这里耐心等待。所以赞阿利利就安心地待在这里。$b$b我认识的另一名德鲁伊说不定需要你的帮助。他叫加尔·暴风爪，他就在此地以东研究药剂。要不你去找他谈谈？
text.completed: 向安戈洛环形山入口处的加尔·暴风爪报到。

english.title: Finding Stormclaw
english.objectives: Report to Garl Stormclaw at the entrance to Un'Goro Crater.
english.description: Zen'Aliri been studyin' the ways of the druid, $r.  Hopefully one day, Zen'Aliri join the Druids of the Talon, and soar over this crater as a storm crow.$b$bBut for now, my mentor says I stay here and wait.  So Zen'Aliri waits.$b$bI know another druid who might be able to use your help.  His name is Garl Stormclaw, and he's somewhere to the east of here, studying reagents.  Maybe you go talk to him?
english.completed: Report to Garl Stormclaw at the entrance to Un'Goro Crater.

text.title: 变异的花朵
text.objectives: 杀死11只血瓣花。任何种类的成年血瓣花都可以。
text.description: 北面的异生花园中的植被对血瓣花产生了奇怪的反应。树木上攀生出了更多的花朵和藤蔓，大朵的鲜花也从地面探出头来，这些情况都非比寻常。$b$b大地在与我们交谈，$r。血瓣花正在破坏生态平衡。$b$b这是我交代给你的最后一项任务，请你前往异生花园削减成年血瓣花的数量。

english.title: Aberrant Flora
english.objectives: Kill 11 Bloodpetals.  Any type of adult Bloodpetal will do.
english.description: Look how strangely the plant life reacts to the bloodpetals in the Roiling Gardens to the north.  The trees are enveloped with more flowers and vines than usual.  Large, sporous blossoms project themselves from the ground where they once did not.$b$bThe land is speaking to us, $r.  The bloodpetals are destroying the balance.$b$bAs my final task, I ask you to visit the swarming adult Bloodpetals and prune their numbers.

text.title: 迫在眉睫的威胁
text.objectives: 跟失落群岛瓦丝耶兰废墟西部入口的梅格斯·碎纸机谈一谈。
text.description: 你在这里的工作算是告一段落了，但是邪恶的势力总是想来捣乱。$B$B你还记得之前的市场营销专员梅格斯·碎纸机吗？她和其他几个人穿越迅猛龙高地，往东南方去了。沿着东面的道路离开胶囊镇，在岔路口往南走，你就会遇到她了。$B$B据说海边废墟里的蛇形人蠢蠢欲动，好像在酝酿什么阴谋。去那里调查一下情况好吗？
text.completion: Boss, we gotta problem.

english.title: Invasion Imminent!
english.objectives: Speak with Megs Dreadshredder at the western entrance to the Ruins of Vashj'elan on the Lost Isles.
english.description: Your work here is done for now, but there's no rest for the wicked, eh?$B$BYou remember Megs Dreadshredder, our old marketing rep? She's taken some others over the hills to the southeast, just past the Raptor Rise. If you follow the path east out of town and follow it south at the fork, you can't miss her.$B$BApparently there's some trouble or other brewing with the snake-men at the ruins on the shore. Go see if you can't sort it all out, would you?
english.completion: Boss, we gotta problem.

text.title: Attack on Camp Narache
text.objectives: Bring the Bristleback Attack Plans to Chief Hawkwind in Camp Narache.
text.description: After carefully evaluating the map, you realize that what you discovered are the plans made by the Bristleback warchief for an extended siege on Camp Narache.$b$bSurely Chief Hawkwind could use this information!
text.progress: You have a look of concern about you,$N. What news do you bring?
text.completion: This is quite alarming indeed! But with this information we can call on our brethren from Bloodhoof Village to help thwart the attack. You have saved the lives of many $r, $N.
text.completed: Return to Chief Hawkwind at Camp Narache in Mulgore.

text.title: 锈水财阀的地权主张
text.objectives: 摧毁10面纳迦旗帜，将其换成锈水财阀旗帜。
text.description: 看来废墟里的纳迦正在计划入侵胶囊镇。我派出去的侦察员都死了，这就是证据。$B$B我不知道你是什么态度，反正我是不会让他们得逞的。我们要先下手为强！$B$B你能不能将他们的旗帜换成我们的，为占领那片海滩打下基础？完美的地产开发区啊！
text.completion: I wish I could have seen the looks on their scaly faces when you blew up their banners and replaced them with our own.$B$BOn second thought, I don't want to be close enough to see their snarls.

english.title: Bilgewater Cartel Represent
english.objectives: Destroy 10 Naga Banners, replacing them with Bilgewater Cartel Banners.
english.description: Looks like the naga down there in the ruins are preparing to invade our Town-In-A-Box. I have lots of dead scouts here as proof.$B$BI don't know about you, but I'm not about to let them try. Let's get the jump on them!$B$BCould you lay the foundation for our new coastal holdings by replacing their banners with our own? That's some prime real estate down there!
english.completion: I wish I could have seen the looks on their scaly faces when you blew up their banners and replaced them with our own.$B$BOn second thought, I don't want to be close enough to see their snarls.

text.title: 纳迦皮
text.objectives: 收集5片完好的纳迦皮。
text.description: 人们常常在暗地里谈论某种优质的材料，它的触感是如此的精致，连最老谋深算的地精也不惜重金购买一块。$B$B我说的就是纳迦皮！$B$B<布雷特四下张望，确保没有人偷听你们的谈话。>$B$B我知道你正准备去那片废墟，免不了要跟纳迦交手的。嗨，反正他们也用不着那身皮囊了。因为他们很快就会没命了！
text.progress: Well? How many do you have for me? I think that a 95 to 5 split is more than generous.
text.completion: We're going to be filthy rich, I tell you! Well, if we can get off of this island, that is.

english.title: Naga Hide
english.objectives: Collect 5 Intact Naga Hides.
english.description: It's oft whispered in dark corners of a material so fine, so exquisite to the touch, that goblins of sophisticated taste will spend any amount of moolah to get their hands on some.$B$BOf course, I'm speaking of naga hide!$B$B<Brett looks around to make sure no one else is listening in.>$B$BI know that you're going to head down there and that it's inevitable that you're going to have to fight those snakes. Hey, they're not going to have a use for their hides anyway. They'll be dead!
english.progress: Well? How many do you have for me? I think that a 95 to 5 split is more than generous.
english.completion: We're going to be filthy rich, I tell you! Well, if we can get off of this island, that is.

text.title: Profitable Preservation
text.objectives: Collect 12 Kaldorei Artifacts.
text.description: You know, the naga are the mutated and prettier versions of the kaldorei, better known as the night elves. Don't ask me... it's a long story.$B$BSuffice to say that I'm sure you could 'procure' an artifact or two while you're down there in the ruins. If you know what I mean?$B$BWe have to preserve them in the homes of wealthy collectors everywhere! Right?
text.completed: Return to Ace at the Ruins of Vashj'elan on the Lost Isles.

text.title: 最后的仪式，最初的仪式
text.objectives: 在鹰风主母的坟墓前使用葬礼祭品。
text.description: 营地已经安全，野猪人也被赶走了，这都得感谢你，年轻人。我要感谢你为我的母亲、我的儿子和我们大家所做的一切。$B$B是时候让我的母亲安息了。把最后的这件祭品放在她的脚下，$n，我们要向她道别。
text.completion: There is balance in all things. As Greatmother Hawkwind's spirit takes its final journey, you will begin your first.

english.title: Last Rites, First Rites
english.objectives: Use the Ceremonial Offering at Greatmother Hawkwind's grave.
english.description: The camp is safe, and the quilboar driven off, all thanks to you, young one. You have my personal thanks for what you have done for my mother, my son, and for all of us.$B$BIt is now time to put Greatmother Hawkwind to rest. Lay the final offering at her feet, $n, and we will say our goodbyes.
english.completion: There is balance in all things. As Greatmother Hawkwind's spirit takes its final journey, you will begin your first.

text.title: 夹道进攻
text.objectives: 杀死8名猎手岭斥候。
text.description: $c，看看四周吧。部落埋伏在俯瞰这座山谷的小道中，我们没有任何办法迫使他们走出藏身之所。他们偷袭我们的供给车队，然后消失得无影无踪！$B$B我要你杀入荣耀岗哨，让部落知道这里并不安全。跟大门口的军需官玛丁雷谈一谈。$B$B在沿途杀死这些野蛮的家伙！
text.completion: They're ambushing the roads to Stonetalon, too? We just can't get a break here. Where are they coming from, anyways?

english.title: Running the Gauntlet
english.objectives: Kill 8 Hunter Hill Scouts.
english.description: Look around you, $c. We've had no luck dislodging the Horde from the hidden trails that overlook this valley. They appear out of nowhere to ambush our supply caravans and then disappear into the hills!$B$BI need you to run the gauntlet to Honor's Stand and let them know the roads still aren't safe. Talk to Mattingly, the supplies officer by the gate.$B$BAnd kill a few of these brutes along the way!
english.completion: They're ambushing the roads to Stonetalon, too? We just can't get a break here. Where are they coming from, anyways?

text.title: 冲出重围
text.objectives: 在荣耀岗哨以西的废墟中收集10份石爪补给品。
text.description: 部落的斥候躲藏在前面的废墟中，伺机偷袭了我的补给车队。只有两名护卫得以生还。你问我？我原本是有头发的！$B$B车队运送的补给品散落在废墟中。将它们收集起来并交给荣耀岗哨的詹妮丝·玛丁雷。即便这批物资无法抵达石爪山脉，也不能让其落入部落之手……
text.progress: What's the story out there?
text.completion:
What ... our supplies? These were meant for Stonetalon.

No matter, at the rate we're going, we need them more here. Honor's Stand has been cut off from the coast, $N. Commander Singleton is at his wit's end.

english.title: Breaking the Siege
english.objectives: Gather 10 Stonetalon Supply crates from the ruins west of Honor's Stand.
english.description: Horde scouts hiding in the ruins up ahead ambushed my supply train. Only two of my bodyguards made it out of there alive. And me? I used to have hair!$B$BThe supplies I was delivering are scattered through the ruins up ahead. Gather them up and take them to Janice Mattingly at Honor's Stand. If they can't make it to Stonetalon, at least we can keep them out of Horde hands...
english.progress: What's the story out there?
english.completion:
What ... our supplies? These were meant for Stonetalon.

No matter, at the rate we're going, we need them more here. Honor's Stand has been cut off from the coast, $N. Commander Singleton is at his wit's end.

text.title: 无法抗拒的池塘小马
text.objectives: 使用无法抗拒的池塘小马获得12只纳迦幼崽的好感。
text.description: 我有个计划，而你是我所知的唯一一个疯狂到愿意来尝试，并且有能力完成的家伙！$B$B我要你带上这匹无法抗拒的池塘小马。嗯，本来我是打算骑着它与纳迦一起戏水的。$B$B将它带至瓦丝耶兰孵化池旁并充气，然后骑着它潜入孵化池中。我敢打赌，纳迦幼崽们一定会爱死这匹池塘小马的。只要获得了幼崽的好感，与纳迦首领的和谈就有希望了。$B$B将他们带回这里，我们就可以进行这项计划的下一步骤了。
text.completion: Oh, they're so cute! I wish that we could turn them into little plush toys and sell them for a gazillion macaroons!

english.title: Irresistible Pool Pony
english.objectives: Use the Irresistible Pool Pony to lure 12 Naga Hatchlings.
english.description: I've got a plan and you're the only one that I know crazy enough to pull it off!$B$BI need you to take this irresistible pool pony to the Vashj'elan Spawning Pool and inflate it. Then, swim down to their hatchlings with it on. I'll bet anything that the hatchlings can be lured away to follow you.$B$BBring them back here and we'll proceed with the next phase of the plan.
english.completion: Oh, they're so cute! I wish that we could turn them into little plush toys and sell them for a gazillion macaroons!

text.title: 这箱食物还能吃吗？
text.objectives: 将食物箱交给马绍尔哨站的威利德·马绍尔。
text.description: 你发现了一箱食物，看来是这座营地被遗弃时落下的。食物箱上的印章写着“马绍尔探险队的财产”。$b$b或许你可以将它交给适当的人？

english.title: Is This Stuff Still Good?
english.objectives: Return the Crate of Foodstuffs to Williden Marshal at Marshal's Stand.
english.description: You find what appears to be a crate of food, left behind when this camp was abandoned.  On the outside of the crate, you can make out a stamp that says "PROPERTY OF MARSHAL EXPEDITIONS".$b$bPerhaps you might find someone who could use this?

text.title: 被遗弃的研究营地
text.objectives: 将研究设备交给马绍尔哨站的霍莱伊·马绍尔。
text.description: 你发现了一件研究设备，看来是这座营地被遗弃时落下的。食物箱上的印章写着“马绍尔探险队的财产”。$b$b或许你可以将它交给适当的人？

english.title: An Abandoned Research Camp
english.objectives: Return the Research Equipment to Hol'anyee Marshal at Marshal's Stand.
english.description: You find what appears to be a piece of research equipment, left behind when this camp was abandoned.  Chiseled onto the side of the device are the words "PROPERTY OF MARSHAL EXPADISHUNS".$b$bPerhaps you might find someone who could use this?

text.title: [NOT USED] Lumberjack Slam Placeholder
text.objectives: Do something cool with the lumberjack.
text.description: Placeholder, $n! This is a placeholder lumberjack quest. You? Grab that lumberjack. And do something ... placeholder-y with him.$B$BYou heard me.
text.completed: Return to Janice Mattingly.

text.title: 和谈的希望
text.objectives: 消灭瓦丝耶兰废墟的纳迦首领。
text.description: $n，我要你和王牌带上这些纳迦幼崽进入山坡下的废墟，并利用它们要挟纳迦的首领投降。$B$B王牌会带你径直前往废墟的南端……你跟着他走就是了。
text.completion: A faceless of the deep? What's that? That does NOT sound like a naga!$B$BWell, you killed it, whatever it was. It doesn't matter now. We have other fish to fry....
text.giverWindow: 这东西是他们的头领？！干掉它！

english.title: Surrender or Else!
english.objectives: Deal with the leader of the Naga at the Ruins of Vashj'elan.
english.description: $n, you and Ace need to march those naga hatchlings down there and use them as leverage to convince the leader of the naga to surrender to us.$B$BAce knows where to go on the south side of the ruins... just follow him.
english.completion: A faceless of the deep? What's that? That does NOT sound like a naga!$B$BWell, you killed it, whatever it was. It doesn't matter now. We have other fish to fry....
english.giverWindow: This is their leader?! Deal with it!

text.title: Deprogramming
text.objectives: Defeat Lady Deathwhisper while ensuring that Darnavan survives.
text.description: We had hoped to place a man on the inside of the Cult of the Damned, to give us an inside angle on the Lich King's machinations, but we... underestimated the persuasive powers of Arthas and his dark minister, Lady Deathwhisper.$B$BOur man, Darnavan, is one of them now.$B$BIf you plan on fighting your way through the Oratory ahead, please keep your eyes peeled for Darnavan. If you can bring him back to us alive, we can attempt to reverse the Cult's brainwashing.

text.title: Securing the Ramparts
text.objectives: Slay the Rotting Frost Giant.
text.description: As if this place weren't enough of a madhouse to begin with, we're fighting a war on two fronts up here, with the Scourge on one side and those blasted Alliance dogs on our other flank!$B$BWe are here to clear a safe landing for our vessels, but a behemoth of a giant on the other side of the Ramparts is hurling debris at anything that comes close and keeping our smaller ships at bay.$B$BI'll be honest -- he's a bit much for us to handle, but you and your companions look up to the task.

text.title: Respite for a Tormented Soul
text.objectives: Use the Life Crystals to preserve Sindragosa's Essence.
text.description: Take this Life Crystal, and have your companions take one as well. It contains potent energies from the verdant Dragonshrine in Dragonblight, and it was my own secret to resisting the dark magics of this place for so long.$B$BWhen you face Sindragosa, battle her until she is weakened, and then have your companions use these Crystals to coax out the essence that is dormant within her. If you then defeat her, you should be able to recover it and return it to Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.

text.title: Residue Rendezvous
text.objectives: Return to Alchemist Adrianna while infected with Orange and Green Blight.
text.description: Professor Putricide has been holed up in his foul laboratory, experimenting and refining increasingly lethal strains of blight to be used against us. If only we could obtain pure samples of the toxins, our researchers could concoct an antidote that would save countless lives.$B$BBut there's a catch -- a proper sample will need to mix two active strains within a living host. Should you have the... misfortune... of becoming such a host, please return here immediately so that we can harvest you for study.
text.completion: At last, we have live specimens to study! You have helped to save countless lives this day, $N.$B$BPlease, take this as a token of thanks for this great deed.
text.end: Return with two strains of Blight.
text.completed: Return to Adrianna inside Icecrown Citadel.

text.title: Blood Quickening
text.objectives: Rescue Infiltrator Minchar before he is executed.
text.description: These Scourge bloodsuckers -- San'layn they call themselves - give me the creeps. We've had one of our best men keeping an eye on them. But this morning he got sloppy and got himself taken prisoner. He's being interrogated by the Queen herself right now, and his cries echo through the Crimson Halls. Please, save him before it's too late!

text.title: 返回胶囊镇
text.objectives: 跟失落群岛胶囊镇的莎希·硬钳谈一谈。
text.description: 我们搞错了。准备发动攻击的不是纳迦……而是附近的乌姆洛特部族。$B$B$n，赶紧回胶囊镇去吧。那些俾格米矮人正在攻打镇子！$B$B来，戴上这个。这是从一个俾格米人手里买来的，据说这玩意儿原本属于一个叫黑粽帽的乌姆洛特部族首领。$B$B这玩意儿可以糊弄小矮子，让你免受袭击。
text.completion: $N? We're saved!$B$BWho am I kidding? We're all going to die!!!

english.title: Get Back to Town
english.objectives: Speak with Sassy Hardwrench at the Town-In-A-Box on the Lost Isles.
english.description: We were wrong. It wasn't the naga that were preparing to attack... it was the nearby Oomlot tribe.$B$B$n, you need to get back to the Town-In-A-Box. The pygmies are already attacking!$B$BHere, take this. We bought it off of a pygmy who said it used to belong to some great leader of theirs. Someone whose name translates as Dark Tan Helmet.$B$BIt should fool them so that they don't attack you.
english.completion: $N? We're saved!$B$BWho am I kidding? We're all going to die!!!

text.title: Going, Going, Guano!
text.objectives: Bring 1 pile of Kraul Guano to Zan'do at Firestone Point.
text.description: There be more in the Razorfen than just pigs, $gbruddah:sistah;. There be bats as well...and if you're goin in there and rilin' up the quilboar anyway, I want ya to bring me back some guano.$B$BYah, guano. The droppin's. Don't give me that look. It be foul, but powerful, primal stuff for rituals...rituals to keep the earth 'round here strong enough to keep from rippin' apart under all the damn fools warrin' round here.$B$BJust bring Zan'do one pile of guano, yah?

text.title: Going, Going, Guano!
text.objectives: Bring 1 pile of Kraul Guano to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.
text.description: As you can see, $n, we're up to some very.... interesting experiments at the Royal Apothecary Society.$b$bAs the Master here, it is my job to oversee the most ambitious of our alchemical attempts. So much work and so little time!$b$bYou look well traveled for a $c. Perhaps you can aid me.$b$bI'm in need of a rare substance. It's foul material; it comes from a rare species of bats only found in the muck-hole known as Razorfen Kraul. Bring to me the guano from the Kraul Bats so we can begin our work...
text.completed: Return to Master Apothecary Faranell at Alterac Mountains.

text.title: Blueleaf Tubers
text.objectives: In Razorfen Kraul, use the Crate with Holes to summon a Snufflenose Gopher, and use the Command Stick on the gopher to make it search for Tubers.$B$BBring 6 Blueleaf Tubers to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.
text.description: Blueleaf tubers are a delicacy around the world!  But they're rare, very rare.  The only place to find them is here in the Barrens, deep in the earth, in Razorfen Kraul.$B$BAnd even then, they're impossible to find unless you know just where to look!  That's why I've trained these snufflenose gophers to find them for me.  They have great noses and can smell a tuber from fifty paces away.$B$BIt won't be easy, but if you get me some tubers I'll pay you handsomely.
text.completed: Return to Mebok Mizzyrix at Firestone Point in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 胶囊镇：遭到攻击
text.objectives: 使用B.C.消除者击杀30名乌姆洛特战士。
text.description: $n，保护我们！$B$B我让他们在镇子周围部署了炮弹防御敌军，但是乌姆洛特战士的数量太多了！$B$B跳进B.C.消除者，消除胶囊镇的威胁吧！
text.completion: Okay, I think that's good enough for now, but they took a bunch of the townsfolk captive.$B$BWe're going to have to take the fight to them!

english.title: Town-In-A-Box: Under Attack
english.objectives: Use a B.C. Eliminator to defeat 30 Oomlot Warriors.
english.description: $n, you have to defend us!$B$BI had the eggheads deploy the town's cannon defenses, but it seems like there's an unlimited supply of these Oomlot warriors!$B$BGet your behind into one of those B.C. Eliminators and eliminate the pygmy threat to the town!
english.completion: Okay, I think that's good enough for now, but they took a bunch of the townsfolk captive.$B$BWe're going to have to take the fight to them!

text.title: 追踪希尔瓦娜斯
text.objectives: 跟随托比亚斯·密斯特曼托追踪希尔瓦娜斯。
text.description: 这是真的？吉尔尼斯失去了她的宠儿。$B$B战事结束后，我们会为此默哀的，但是不是现在。$B$B敌人还踩在吉尔尼斯的土地上，我们不能沉浸在悲伤之中。$B$B父亲的军队已经做好了反击的准备，与此同时，我们还发现了女妖之王的踪迹。你准备好了就说一声。我们要为利亚姆复仇。
text.completion: The Plague?  Something so heinous that not even the orcs condone its use?  I'd say this warrants notifying King Greymane.
text.completed: 返回吉尔尼斯城的格雷迈恩广场，向罗娜·克罗雷复命。

english.title: The Hunt For Sylvanas
english.objectives: Follow Tobias Mistmantle in the Hunt for Sylvanas.
english.description: It's true then?  Gilneas has lost her favorite son.$B$BWe will mourn when this is all over but not a day sooner.$B$BWe will not allow ourselves the luxury of grief while the enemy still breathes Gilnean air.$B$BMy father's men are ready to strike while we still have the Banshee Queen's trail.  Just say the word if you're ready.  Liam deserves swift vengeance.
english.completion: The Plague?  Something so heinous that not even the orcs condone its use?  I'd say this warrants notifying King Greymane.
english.completed: Return to Lorna Crowley at Greymane Square in Gilneas City.

text.title: 复仇或是生存
text.objectives: 跟吉尔尼斯城格雷迈恩皇家庭院的吉恩·格雷迈恩国王谈一谈。
text.description: 请转告格雷迈恩，我们掌握了希尔瓦娜斯的行踪并发现了瘟疫的阴谋。$B$B请他做出决定吧。是集结所有兵力对付被遗忘者的首领，还是安排幸存者撤离。
text.completion: You present me with the most difficult choice of my life, $N.

english.title: Vengeance or Survival
english.objectives: Speak to King Genn Greymane at Greymane Court in Gilneas City.
english.description: Tell Greymane that we have trackers on Sylvanas and tell him about the Plague.$B$BThe decision will be his.  Launch an all out attack against the leader of the Forsaken or try to evacuate our survivors.
english.completion: You present me with the most difficult choice of my life, $N.

text.title: 吉尔尼斯城保卫战
text.objectives: 取得吉尔尼斯城保卫战的胜利。
text.description: $n，是时候了。我们已经集结并武装了吉尔尼斯城所有可用的兵力。$B$B迎敌奋战吧。一举歼灭希尔瓦娜斯和她麾下的被遗忘者渣滓。$B$B利亚姆负责抵御城门处的敌军。格雷迈恩国王和我的父亲在其他城区作战。$B$B你在这场战事中也肩负重任。带上这柄剑，用它激励作战的将士们。跟克雷南·阿朗纳斯谈一谈，参与吉尔尼斯城的保卫之战吧。
text.completion: We've driven the Forsaken back.  We hold three out of the four districts.$B$BBut at what cost...

english.title: The Battle for Gilneas City
english.objectives: Achieve victory in the Battle for Gilneas City.
english.description: The time has come, $n.  We've rallied and armed every available Gilnean.$B$BIt is time to meet the enemy head on.  Time to settle the score with Sylvanas and her Forsaken dogs once and for all.$B$BLiam is heading the assault from this gate.  King Greymane and my father are leading the assault on the other districts.$B$BYou have a crucial role to play in this as well.  Take this rapier.  Use it to inspire our men and women in combat.  Speak to Krennan Aranas to take part in the battle for Gilneas City.
english.completion: We've driven the Forsaken back.  We hold three out of the four districts.$B$BBut at what cost...

objectiveDetails.description: 完成吉尔尼斯城保卫战

text.title: 还人情
text.objectives: 去找砂槌营地的梅格斯·碎纸机。
text.description: 你知道吧，你出去做事时，梅格斯过来串门了。我已经有好几个月没有看到她了，她只是告诉了我当下的形势，然后要我告诉你她已经安排了许多事情要做。$B$B她说她去砂槌营地开店，处理一些食人魔的事情。你做完事之后，最好也跟着去吧……我不会让她这样的地精久等的。

english.title: Returning a Favor
english.objectives: Find Megs Dreadshredder at the Dunemaul Camp.
english.description: You know, while you were out doin' your thing, Megs stopped by here. I hadn't seen her in months, but she barely gave me the time of day, just wanted me to tell you she had more business lined up.$B$BShe said she was headed over to the Dunemaul Compound to set up shop, something about ogres. Since you're done here, might as well head over...I wouldn't keep a goblin like her waiting.

text.title: 海边打捞
text.objectives: 收集7份热砂补给品。
text.description: 我们得把货物立刻投放到市场里去，不然就没竞争力了。我有一招。$B$B加基森正处于海盗的封锁之下，不过许多被打下船的货物并没有遭到损毁……它们只是被冲走了。大多数都漂到了镇子南边的浅滩上。$B$B去那儿打捞打捞，那些漂浮的箱子里可全是不要本钱的纯利润啊。

english.title: Seaside Salvage
english.objectives: Collect 7 Steamwheedle Supplies.
english.description: We've got to get goods moving in this market ASAP if we want to be competitive. I've got an angle for us.$B$BGadgetzan's under blockade by pirates, but plenty of the goods that get blown off the ships survive intact... they just wash away. Most of them wash up in the shallows just south of town.$B$BHead down there and start salvaging; there's crates full of pure profit just floating around down there.

text.title: 踩水坑
text.objectives: 杀死8名潮行巨人。
text.description: 情况是这样的。如果我们要在加基森为锈水财阀开拓市场，就得开始为社区提供服务。$B$B新海岸上商机无限，但大海也把海洋巨人给带来了。他们又大又脏，还影响到房地产价格。$B$B到镇子南边的浅滩去，尽可能地把他们除掉，等我这儿生意做成了，少不了你的一份。

english.title: Puddle Stomping
english.objectives: Kill 8 Tidal Striders.
english.description: Here's the situation. If we want to establish the Bilgewater Cartel's market presence in Gadgetzan, we'll need to start providing services to the community.$B$BThe new coast has been great for business here, but the sea also brought sea giants with it. They're large, foul, and drive real estate values down.$B$BHead to the shallows just south of town and kill as many as you can, and I'll cut you in on some of the deals I'm brokering here.

text.title: [NOT USED] Build the Fort Placeholder
text.objectives: Contact Foreman Franklin.
text.description: Nice work! For our next placeholder, talk to that dude. Uh, Foreman Franklin. Special stuff will happen.
text.completed: Contact Foreman Franklin.

text.objectives: Use the guns.
text.description: This here placeholder will be like a shootin' gallery. On Steroids.
text.completed: Go see Foreman Franklin.

text.title: 火箭营救
text.objectives: 把救生火箭交给5名热砂港幸存者，用炸弹杀死40名南海封锁者。
text.description: 好吧，$n。小打小闹够了，该做大事了。$B$B热砂港废墟里还有很多倒霉的热砂地精等着人救他们。他们每一个都是未来潜在的客户。离港的每艘船都被打沉了……所以我说咱们走空路！$B$B镇子外面的港口那儿有个热气球，我们可以用它。去吧，我一会儿就到。

english.title: Rocket Rescue
english.objectives: Deliver Life-Rockets to 5 Steamwheedle Survivors and use bombs to kill 40 Southshore Blockaders.
english.description: Alright, $n. We've done enough small jobs around here; it's time to seal the deal.$B$BThe ruins of Steamwheedle Port are still full of hapless Steamwheedle goblins, waiting to be rescued. Every single one of them is a potential future customer. They're firing on every boat that leaves port...so I say we take to the skies!$B$BThere's a hot air balloon just outside of town near the docks, we can use that. Go ahead and hop in, I'll catch up with you.

text.title: 热带天堂在呼唤
text.objectives: 去找安戈洛环形山马绍尔哨站的威利德·马绍尔。
text.description: 嗨，你看来像是个眼界独到的冒险者。在找什么不一样的东西么？异国情调？某种……发财的机会？$b$b那么就把你靴里的沙子清出来，因为我有个提议。威利德·马绍尔正在寻找像你一样可靠的雇佣兵。他在马绍尔哨站有个营地，从安戈洛环形山中央的火山朝东南走便是。$b$b再次重申，天堂不是为所有人准备的，$r。是为了你。热带绿洲正等着你哪。

english.title: Tropical Paradise Beckons
english.objectives: Report to Williden Marshal at Marshal's Stand in Un'Goro Crater.
english.description: Hey, you look like a discriminating adventurer.  Are you looking for something different?  Something exotic?  Something... profitable?$b$bWell shake the sand out of your boots, because I've got a proposition for you.  Williden Marshal is looking for competent sellswords such as yourself.  He's set up camp at Marshal's Stand, just southeast of the volcano in the center of lush Un'Goro Crater.$b$bThen again, paradise isn't for everyone, $r.  It's up to you.  Your tropical oasis awaits.

starters.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

enders.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

text.title: 记住圣光
text.objectives: 帮助学者阿弗恩同玛格图尔告别。
text.description: 玛格图尔逐渐虚弱，$n。我的治疗药准备好了……它一定要管用。一定要！$B$B你为我们俩已经做了太多。假如你能留下来见证玛格图尔的最后一刻，我将十分荣幸。

english.title: Remember the Light
english.objectives: Help Anchorite Avuun say farewell to Magtoor.
english.description: Magtoor grows weaker by the second, $n. My remedy is prepared... it must work. It must!$B$BYou have done so much for the both of us. I would be honored if you stayed for what may be Magtoor's final moments.

text.title: 个人财产
text.objectives: 将密封的金属箱交给冰冠堡垒的大领主莫格莱尼。
text.description: 你在这只箱子上找不到任何开关铰链或缝隙。如果不是你在摇晃这只箱子的时候能听到里面发出物体碰撞的声音，你一定会以为它是一整块金属。$b$b很可能只有大领主莫格莱尼才知道打开这只箱子的办法。

english.title: Personal Property
english.objectives: Bring the Sealed Chest to Highlord Darion Mograine in Icecrown Citadel.
english.description: You can detect no hinges or openings on this box. Were it not for the shifting of items inside, it could easily be mistaken for solid metal.$b$bIf anyone could know the method of its opening, it would be Highlord Mograine.

enders.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

text.title: Mograine's Reunion
text.progress: What is that you hold, $c?$B$BIt calls out to me, stirring feelings I thought to be long dead.
text.completion: Impossible...$B$BFather, is it you?!$B$BYou have done me a great service, hero. I offer you the reins of my faithful steed. Do with it as you please, but do not forget those that assisted you in this monumental feat.

text.progress: How may I be of service, $r?
text.completion: <Uther stares at the medal, speechless for a moment.>$B$BArthas' medal.$B$BI remember well the day I presented it to him...$B$BYou have done me a great service, hero. My soul may now rest in peace. I offer you a memory lost in time. Do with it as you please, but do not forget those that assisted you in this monumental feat.

text.title: 拖延不可避免的局势
text.objectives: 乘坐被俘的骑乘蝙蝠摧毁6台被遗忘者投石车，并杀死40名入侵的被遗忘者。
text.description: 虽然我很想大开杀戒，为利亚姆复仇……但是我希望按照他的想法行事。生前，他总是将臣民的安危放在首位。$B$B北门河底就是送葬者小径。在城民撤离到埃德里奇的安息地前，你必须阻止瘟疫的蔓延。$B$B我们捕获到一只被遗忘者的蝙蝠。我要你驾驭这只野兽，消灭那些传播瘟疫的怪物。动作要快！
text.progress: Is it done, $N?
text.completion: You've done well, $N.  Almost everybody managed to make it through.

english.title: Slowing the Inevitable
english.objectives: Use the Captured Riding Bat to destroy 6 Forsaken Catapults and 40 Invading Forsaken.
english.description: As much as I want to exact swift and brutal revenge... I must honor my son's memory first.  He cared for his people first and foremost.$B$BThe Undertaker's Pass goes underground below Northgate River.  You must prevent the plague from being deployed while we evacuate our men, women and children to Aderic's Repose.$B$BWe captured one of the Forsaken's dreaded bombing bats.  I want you to fly the infernal beast as best you can and unleash hell upon those who seek to bring the Plague to our people.  Hurry!
english.progress: Is it done, $N?
english.completion: You've done well, $N.  Almost everybody managed to make it through.

text.title: 向奥布里报到
text.objectives: 向北方城堡的海军司令奥布里报到。
text.description: 嗨，叫你呢！刚刚下船的新兵？欢迎你来到卡利姆多。要么葬身于此，要么全力奋战。$B$B城堡遇到了麻烦，你在来的路上应该也注意到了吧。海军司令奥布里急需人手来度过这次难关。$c，你已被征召！$B$B沿着山路往上走，你可以在塔楼顶层找到奥布里。
text.completed: 向海军司令奥布里报到。

english.title: Report to Aubrey
english.objectives: Report to Admiral Aubrey in Northwatch Hold.
english.description: You there! Fresh off the boat? Welcome to Kalimdor, a land hellbent to kill you or die tryin'.$B$BThere's trouble at the hold - as I'm sure you noticed on your way in. Admiral Aubrey needs all hands on deck if we're to make it through this. Consider yourself drafted, $c!$B$BFollow the road up the hill and you'll find Aubrey in the tower, topside.
english.completed: Report to Admiral Aubrey.

text.title: 乌姆洛特村
text.objectives: 跟失落群岛乌姆洛特村的小静谈一谈。
text.description: 俾格米人把大部分镇民都掳回了自己的村落。谁知道他们会干出什么坏事来？$B$B$n，趁他们还没有对俘虏使用巫毒术，赶紧去救人吧！$B$B小静已经去了东南方的乌姆洛特村。她会告诉你村落的具体情况的。$B$B你的俾格米头盔有点破了，但是应该足以使你避开沿途的敌人，让你顺利抵达目的地。$B$B希望如此。
text.completion: $N? What are you doing wearing that pygmy helm? Looks like it's about to fall apart.$B$BI'm glad that they sent you up here. I thought for sure they were going to send that jerk, Grapplehammer and his ego-enabling assistant.

english.title: Oomlot Village
english.objectives: Speak with Izzy at Oomlot Village on the Lost Isles.
english.description: The pygmies took most of our people back to their village. Who knows what evil they're up to?$B$B$n, you have to go up there and free all of the captives before the pygmies work their voodoo on them!$B$BIzzy's already up near Oomlot Village to the southeast. She'll give you the heads-up on what's going down.$B$BYour pygmy helmet looks like it's in bad shape, but it should last long enough for you to get there.$B$BI hope.
english.completion: $N? What are you doing wearing that pygmy helm? Looks like it's about to fall apart.$B$BI'm glad that they sent you up here. I thought for sure they were going to send that jerk, Grapplehammer and his ego-enabling assistant.

text.title: 营救俘虏
text.objectives: 营救5名地精俘虏。
text.description: 他们抓走了好些人。俾格米人正在对俘虏使用奇怪的仪式。看起来像是从俘虏身上汲取生命的力量！$B$B你必须进入村落，尽快营救俘虏！
text.completion: Great job, but that's not even half of the hostages that they took from town.$B$BDarn it all! They must have taken the rest of the captives to their other villages up in the volcano!

english.title: Free the Captives
english.objectives: Free 5 Goblin Captives.
english.description: They've got a bunch of our people in there. I know that they're doing strange rituals to them. It looks like they're sucking the life force right out of them!$B$BYou have to go into the village and free the captives before it's too late!
english.completion: Great job, but that's not even half of the hostages that they took from town.$B$BDarn it all! They must have taken the rest of the captives to their other villages up in the volcano!

text.title: 为A-Me 01服务
text.objectives: 将A-Me的随身存储器交给安戈洛环形山覆苔营地卡尔纳·雷塔维。
text.description: 你好。我是A-Me 01。你是……$r？$B$BA-Me成功地完成了研究本地猩猩的任务。卡尔纳所需的数据已经收集完毕。$b$b但是A-Me 01不会回去。A-Me有了新的家庭。A-Me要留在这里陪伴猩猩。$b$b<A-Me将一件小型装置从它身上拆离下来，递给了你。>$b$b你把数据交给卡尔纳。你告诉她发生的事情。

english.title: Serving A-Me 01
english.objectives: Bring A-Me's Thumb Drive back to Karna Remtravel at Mossy Pile in Un'Goro Crater.
english.description: Greetings.  I unit A-Me 01.  You... $r?$B$BA-Me's mission to study the local gorillas was success.  A-Me has gathered data that Karna needs.$b$bA-Me 01 not returning, though.  A-Me has new family now.  Here, with the gorillas, A-Me stay.$b$b<A-Me 01 detaches a small device from her hand and gives it to you.>$b$bYou bring data back to Karna.  You tell her what happen.

text.title: 加基森海盗：亡灵宝藏
text.objectives: 杀死任意15名南海海盗。
text.description: 瞧，宝贝儿，你应该很容易就明白这是怎么回事。这里有海盗，有地精，地精在打海盗。还有一些可悲的小侏儒也在打海盗。$B$B我来给你说明白点：我们要去杀掉大量的海盗。去动手吧，好吗？毕竟，我们可不能被侏儒的战绩给比下去。

english.title: Dead Man's Chest
english.objectives: Kill 15 Southsea Freebooters of any kind.
english.description: Look, babe, you should be able to see what's happening here pretty easily. There's pirates, there's goblins, the goblins are fighting the pirates. There's some sad little gnomes trying to fight the pirates too.$B$BI'll make it nice and simple for you: we need to kill a lot of pirates. Go do that, 'kay? We don't want the gnomes killing more than us, after all.

text.title: 夷为平地！
text.objectives: 给西北小屋、东北小屋，以及西南小屋点火。
text.description: 我正在对这里的房地产进行全面评估，但不幸的是，其市值远低于可接受程度。我们必须重新翻修。$B$B我碰巧知道一种靠谱的改造方式：火攻！你要把这些完全安全的朗姆酒燃烧瓶扔到那些脏兮兮的破茅屋上去。$B$B尽量别站在下风口。

english.title: To The Ground!
english.objectives: Set fire to the Northwest Shack, the Southeast Shack, and the Northeast Shack.
english.description: I've conducted a thorough appraisal of the real estate here and, unfortunately, its market value is just far too low to be of any use. We're going to have to renovate.$B$BLuckily for you, I've learned a few things about arson. Hopefully you have too! You're going to be throwing these perfectly safe bottles of flaming rum at those filthy ramshackle huts over there.$B$BTry not to stand downwind.

text.title: 传递信息
text.objectives: 杀死英格维。
text.description: 乌姆洛特的首领英格维拥有强大的力量，绝不能留他在世上。他正在村落西边的高地上乱吠，穿过那座绳桥就是了。$B$B去那里杀死他，不然他还会派兵攻打我们的。$B$B干掉这家伙应该是小菜一碟吧！
text.completion: Nice work, $g bud : girlfriend;! Hope he wasn't too tough.
text.giverWindow: 这条消息会让他们永世难忘。

english.title: Send a Message
english.objectives: Slay Yngwie.
english.description: The Oomlot leader, Yngwie, is too powerful to be left alive. He's barking nonsense from the raised west side of the village, across the rope bridge.$B$BGo up there and get him before he sends the rest of the village against us.$B$BPiece of cake!
english.completion: Nice work, $g bud : girlfriend;! Hope he wasn't too tough.
english.giverWindow: Send them a message they'll never forget.

text.title: 顺路除害
text.objectives: 杀死5名血牙狼人。
text.description: 格雷迈恩国王要你冒生命危险营救一个恶名昭著的叛徒？这我倒没有意见。$B$B在你出去的路上，不如帮我个忙，杀死这些被诅咒的怪物。
text.progress: What is it then, $N?
text.completion: If I hadn't seen you kill a few of the mangy things with my own eyes, I'd think you did not complete the task I asked of you.$B$BIt looks like we're hardly putting a dent in their numbers.

english.title: While You're At It
english.objectives: Kill 5 Bloodfang Worgen.
english.description: Fine by me if King Greymane wants you to risk your life to rescue a known traitor.$B$BDo me a favor and do something useful while you're out there and kill these cursed fleabags.
english.progress: What is it then, $N?
english.completion: If I hadn't seen you kill a few of the mangy things with my own eyes, I'd think you did not complete the task I asked of you.$B$BIt looks like we're hardly putting a dent in their numbers.

text.title: 凝视者的标记
text.objectives: 从晶鳞凝视者身上获得5颗水晶之眼。
text.description: 你要出去打土狼，是吗？如果你不介意的话，我有个提议。我需要潜伏在北边的晶鳞蜥蜴的眼睛。它们的眼珠里含有神奇的水晶，有高度的……收藏价值。$B$B当然，你也许听说过有些傻子会用它们来强化自己心灵能力的事，不过我向你保证，我的意图是纯学术性的！$B$B给我多带一些来，我会大加犒赏你的。至少比这些一个铜子儿掰两半的地精要大方！
text.progress: Do, ah, do you have them?
text.completion: Ahh, perfect! Just what I need...full of potent focusing energies...$B$B...ahem! I mean, perfect for my collection! Narain Soothfancy is in no need of artificial enhancement of any kind!$B$BNow take your pay and be off!

english.title: Gazer Tag
english.objectives: Collect 5 Ocular Crystals from Glasshide Gazers.
english.description: You're going out to hunt hyenas, eh? If you don't mind, I've got an offer myself. I'm in need of eyes from the Glasshide Gazers that lurk to the north. Their eyes contain wonderful crystals, valuable to...collectors.$B$BNow, you may have heard that some sad individuals use these to enhance paramental abilities, but I assure you, my interests are purely academic!$B$BBring me a good portion of them and I'll pay you well for them. Better than these copper-pinching goblins will, at least!
english.progress: Do, ah, do you have them?
english.completion: Ahh, perfect! Just what I need...full of potent focusing energies...$B$B...ahem! I mean, perfect for my collection! Narain Soothfancy is in no need of artificial enhancement of any kind!$B$BNow take your pay and be off!

text.title: 斩仓
text.objectives: 在大裂口消灭任意15只哈扎里异种。
text.description: 上个星期我一直盯着这丑陋的虫巢，打算琢磨明白到底怎么才能靠一群危险、暴力的节肢动物赚钱。现在我想不出来了，还饿着肚子。$B$B这些动物就是一群废物，我说就该把它们清光。下去开始杀虫子吧。
text.completion: This isn't goin' fast enough. There's gotta be a faster way...

english.title: Cutting Losses
english.objectives: Kill 15 Hazzali Silithid of any kind in the Gaping Chasm.
english.description: I've spent the last week starin' at this ugly pit trying to think of how to exploit a bunch of dangerous, violent arthropods for profit. Now I'm out of ideas, and starving.$B$BThese things are a wash, and I say it's time to start clearing them out. Head down into that pit and start killin' bugs.
english.completion: This isn't goin' fast enough. There's gotta be a faster way...

text.title: 沙漠之鸡
text.objectives: 收集6块土狼肉块。
text.description: 我有个主意，但得先需要饵。$B$B有一天，我看到一头疯狂的疱爪土狼离裂口太近了，一只异种虫突然窜了出来，差不多一口就把它囫囵吞了！真可怕。$B$B所以显然我们需要的就是土狼肉。去找点来，确保新鲜，然后带回来。营地北边应该有不少土狼。
text.progress: This is fresh, right? They won't go after anything that's been withering in the sun.
text.completion: Man, this stuff looks delicious. I'm half tempted to just fry some up myself.$B$BNo! We've gotta focus on gettin' out of here.$B$BMaybe just one piece...

english.title: Chicken of the Desert
english.objectives: Collect 6 pieces of Hyena Meat.
english.description: I've got an idea, but we're going to need bait.$B$BThe other day I saw a rabid blisterpaw hyena wander too close to the edge of the chasm, and one of the silithid comes diving out of nowhere. Nearly swallowed it whole! Horrible sight.$B$BSo we're gonna need hyena meat, obviously. Go gather some, make sure it's fresh, and bring it back here. There should be plenty just north of the camp.
english.progress: This is fresh, right? They won't go after anything that's been withering in the sun.
english.completion: Man, this stuff looks delicious. I'm half tempted to just fry some up myself.$B$BNo! We've gotta focus on gettin' out of here.$B$BMaybe just one piece...

text.title: 击退不速之客！
text.objectives: 跟海军司令奥布里谈一谈，飞往黑弹珠号杀死6名怒吼水兵。
text.description: $n，海洋是我们的命脉。眼下大多数战舰要么返回塞拉摩维修船体，要么躺在海底等着生锈。只有黑弹珠号仍在坚守，保卫着这座海港。$B$B但是就在刚才，我们收到了她发出的讯号，黑弹珠号被敌人攻占了！$B$B准备好了就跟我谈谈，我会派一只狮鹫送你登上甲板。杀死那些胆敢攻击我心爱的战舰的怒吼水兵，然后向菲舍尔船长汇报。

english.title: Repel Boarders!
english.objectives: Speak to Admiral Aubrey to fly to the Blackpool and kill 6 Rageroar Sea Dogs.
english.description: $n, the sea is our only lifeline, and right now most of my fleet is either steaming back to Theramore for repairs or rusting at the bottom of this bay. Only the Blackpool remains afloat to defend our harbor.$B$BBut she's just signaled that she's being boarded!$B$BSpeak to me when you're ready, I'll have one of our naval gryphons deposit you right on the deck. Slaughter the rageroar sea dogs who dare assault my precious ship and report to Captain Fisher for further orders.

text.title: Body And Soul
text.objectives: Destroy Yngwie's Soul.$B$BIf you somehow misplace Yngwie's Body, ask Izzy if she found it.
text.description: There are powerful and evil magics at work in this village. Yngwie, was tough. In fact, he was probably too tough.$B$BIf you were to drag his body down to the big blue bonfire and toss it in, you'd release his soul. Destroying it would deal with the Oomlot chieftain for good, and ensure that the attacks upon the Town-In-A-Box come to an end.
text.completed: Return to Izzy at Oomlot Village on the Lost Isles.

english.title: Body And Soul
english.objectives: Destroy Yngwie's Soul.$B$BIf you somehow misplace Yngwie's Body, ask Izzy if she found it.
english.description: There are powerful and evil magics at work in this village. Yngwie, was tough. In fact, he was probably too tough.$B$BIf you were to drag his body down to the big blue bonfire and toss it in, you'd release his soul. Destroying it would deal with the Oomlot chieftain for good, and ensure that the attacks upon the Town-In-A-Box come to an end.
english.completed: Return to Izzy at Oomlot Village on the Lost Isles.

text.description: There are powerful and evil magics at work in this village, $n. Yngwie, was tough. In fact, he was probably too tough.$B$BIf you were to drag his body over to the big blue bonfire and toss it in, you'd release his soul. Destroying it would deal with the Oomlot chieftain for good, and ensure that the attacks upon the Town-In-A-Box come to an end.
text.completed: Return to Izzy at Oomlot Village on the Lost Isles.
