english.description: There are powerful and evil magics at work in this village, $n. Yngwie, was tough. In fact, he was probably too tough.$B$BIf you were to drag his body over to the big blue bonfire and toss it in, you'd release his soul. Destroying it would deal with the Oomlot chieftain for good, and ensure that the attacks upon the Town-In-A-Box come to an end.
english.completed: Return to Izzy at Oomlot Village on the Lost Isles.

text.title: 危机解除
text.objectives: 跟失落群岛胶囊镇的莎希·硬钳谈一谈。
text.description: $n，你得返回胶囊镇，警告他们火山口出现了大批地精僵尸！
text.completion: They turned some of our people into zombies? Tell me something I don't know....

english.title: Oomlot Dealt With
english.objectives: Speak with Sassy Hardwrench at the Town-In-A-Box on the Lost Isles.
english.description: $n, you have to get back to the Town-In-A-Box and warn them about the goblin zombies up in the volcano's caldera!
english.completion: They turned some of our people into zombies? Tell me something I don't know....

text.title: 北方城堡的枪炮
text.objectives: 跟炮兵斯密瑟谈一谈。
text.description: 我们收到了菲舍尔船长发出的讯号。部落战舰派出了岸勤部队？不能让他们发动侧面夹攻。$B$B我已经安排两名优秀的炮手前去阻击敌人。跟海岸边的炮兵斯密瑟谈一谈。$B$B你恐怕要一路杀出去了。就当是顺便守护城堡了嘛！
text.completion: Aubrey sent you? Good! I take it you know your way around a cannon?
text.completed: 跟炮兵斯密瑟谈一谈。

english.title: The Guns of Northwatch
english.objectives: Speak with Cannoneer Smythe.
english.description: Captain Fisher signaled us from below. The Horde fleet is landing shore parties? We can't let them flank us from the beach.$B$BI've already sent two of my best gunners down there to defend the beach head. Talk to Cannoneer Smythe down on the shore.$B$BYou'll have to fight your way through the courtyard to get there. See if you can help the others secure the hold on your way down!
english.completion: Aubrey sent you? Good! I take it you know your way around a cannon?
english.completed: Speak with Cannoneer Smythe.

text.title: 用尽炮弹
text.objectives: 使用北卫军海岸排炮摧毁10艘怒吼划艇。
text.description: 我们拥有足够的资源，却陷入人手不足的窘境，$n。操纵海岸边的大炮，击毁部落的战舰！
text.completion:
Ho ho! The beach is ours!

We just might keep a foothold on this miserable dustball of a continent after all.

english.title: Run Out the Guns
english.objectives: Use a Northwatch Shore Battery to destroy 10 Rageroar Rowboats.
english.description: We've got the hardware but not the manpower, $n. Man one of the carronades on the shore here and take out those incoming boats!
english.completion:
Ho ho! The beach is ours!

We just might keep a foothold on this miserable dustball of a continent after all.

text.title: 前往火山口
text.objectives: 跟失落群岛失落峰的克罗斯彻克教练谈一谈。
text.description: 有一大票人去了火山口实施营救工作并展开反击行动。失落峰上可能有异常情况。$B$B你没到之前，他们不想贸然对小矮子采取行动。你也看见了，这些邪恶的小东西将很多镇民都变成了僵尸。$B$B$n，我相信你会拯救我们的！
text.completion: My star player has arrived!

english.title: Up the Volcano
english.objectives: Speak with Coach Crosscheck at the Lost Peak on the Lost Isles.
english.description: A whole bunch of our people headed up to the top of the volcano to mount a counter-offensive. There's something horrible brewing up there on the Lost Peak.$B$BThey're waiting for you before they make any moves against the pygmies. Those evil little things turned a lot of us into zombies!$B$B$n, save us!
english.completion: My star player has arrived!

text.title: 开花弹
text.objectives: 收集15枚开花弹。
text.description: $C！感谢圣光——他们将我们赶回了码头。庭院已经失陷！$B$B我们的弹药储备所剩无几，而兽人正准备从山上发动袭击。必须立即补充弹药。$B$B快，冲进那座残破的塔楼，尽你所能地收集任何锋利的金属器械。刀，叉甚至钉子也行！集齐一把之后就将它们塞进炮台里！
text.progress: Paxton has already loaded a charge into the cannon. All it needs is the ammunition you improvised.
text.completion: The Horde is massing at the base of the hill. Breathlessly, you stuff the debris you collected into the muzzle of the cannon, step back, cover one ear, and tug on the igniter cord...

english.title: Langridge Shot
english.objectives: Gather 15 pieces of Langridge Shot.
english.description: $C! Thank the light - they've practically driven us back to the docks. The courtyard is overrun!$B$BWe're out of canister shot and the orcs are getting ready for an assault up the hill. We need to improvise some scatter-shot, and fast.$B$BHurry, run into the broken tower here and grab whatever sharp, pointy bits of scrap metal you can lay your hands on. Knives, forks, nails - anything! Load the cannon when you've got an armful!
english.progress: Paxton has already loaded a charge into the cannon. All it needs is the ammunition you improvised.
english.completion: The Horde is massing at the base of the hill. Breathlessly, you stuff the debris you collected into the muzzle of the cannon, step back, cover one ear, and tug on the igniter cord...

text.title: 僵尸大战超级火箭靴
text.objectives: 使用超级助推火箭之靴杀死50个地精僵尸。
text.description: 你沿途看到的僵尸根本不足以与我们身后蠢蠢欲动的敌军相提并论。如果我们不赶紧解决掉他们，俾格米巫医就会派他们攻打胶囊镇，到时候恐怕连炮弹也挡不住了！$B$B我随身带着几双鞋子。经过格瑞里的改造，它们已经变成了超级助推火箭靴了！$B$B使用这双靴子烧死东边乌司坦村落里的僵尸大军。
text.completion: You did it! No more zombies to worry about. Let's pause a moment in silence for the stinky departed.$B$BOkay, done.

english.title: Zombies vs. Super Booster Rocket Boots
english.objectives: Use the Super Booster Rocket Boots to slay 50 Goblin Zombies.
english.description: Those zombies that got past us are nothing compared to the numbers waiting just through the pass. If we don't deal with them soon, the pygmy witch doctors are going to send all of them against the town, and even the cannons down there won't be able to handle that many!$B$BI brought a couple of shredder boots along. Greely modded them and now they're Super Booster Rocket Boots!$B$BUse the boots to incinerate the zombies in the Oostan villages to the east.
english.completion: You did it! No more zombies to worry about. Let's pause a moment in silence for the stinky departed.$B$BOkay, done.

text.title: 夺回庭院
text.objectives: 消灭10名怒吼步兵。
text.description: 这也是剿灭敌人的妙招。兽人的尸体上插满了刀叉！$B$B怒吼氏族已经攻破了城墙，但是我们还有机会扭转战局。去山下帮助士兵们夺回庭院吧……
text.completion:
Great work! We've knocked them on their heels, maybe long enough to shore up our defenses.

Provided we find a way to take out their artillery...

english.title: Re-Take the Courtyard
english.objectives: Kill 10 Rageroar Grunts.
english.description: That's one way to clear a hill. Those corpses are impaled with knives and forks!$B$BThe Rageroar clan has breached the walls, but we can still turn this fight around. Go down the hill and help our men hold on to the courtyard below...
english.completion:
Great work! We've knocked them on their heels, maybe long enough to shore up our defenses.

Provided we find a way to take out their artillery...

text.title: 重返战场
text.objectives: 对6名受伤的防御者使用药草绷带。
text.description: 这场战争还没有结束，$c。远没有结束。$B$B庭院中的士兵有的仍一息尚存。我们可以挽救他们的性命！我将绷带放入特制的药水中浸泡，这是我们在吉尔尼斯常用的法子。这种草药非常难闻，却有起死回生的疗效。$B$B对庭院中受伤的防御者使用绷带，或许可以帮助他们恢复健康并重返战场。
text.progress: I hope you have enough bandages. My supply of those herbs was cut off when these brutes sacked my beloved Gilneas.
text.completion: A steady stream of the walking wounded have come up the hill to see me, $N. I trust that was your work? Well done!

english.title: Back in the Fight
english.objectives: Use the Herb-Soaked Bandages on 6 Wounded Defenders.
english.description: This fight isn't over, $c. Not by a long shot.$B$BSome of the soldiers in the courtyard still have breath in their lungs. We can save them! I've soaked these rags in an herbal remedy we used to rely on back in Gilneas. The smell is awful but this poultice can practically raise the dead.$B$BUse these bandages on wounded defenders down in the courtyard and we'll see if we can't get them back in the fight.
english.progress: I hope you have enough bandages. My supply of those herbs was cut off when these brutes sacked my beloved Gilneas.
english.completion: A steady stream of the walking wounded have come up the hill to see me, $N. I trust that was your work? Well done!

objectiveDetails.description: 对受伤的防御者使用绷带

text.title: 三个小俾格米人
text.objectives: 杀死加奥、马奥默和塔卢可。
text.description: 我们是该消灭所有的僵尸，尽管他们曾经是我们的朋友和家人。但是你不觉得那些将他们变成僵尸的俾格米人更该死吗？$B$B乌司坦诺德村、乌司坦索尔村和乌司坦欧司特村这三座小矮子村落里分别由巫医加奥、马奥默和塔卢可把守。$B$B去杀死他们吧。我可不想变成僵尸！
text.completion: I gotta tell you, that's a load off of my mind. That is, I won't have to worry about no new zombies coming after my brains!

english.title: Three Little Pygmies
english.objectives: Slay Gaahl, Malmo, and Teloch.
english.description: Look, I think it's great that we're destroying all of these zombies, even though they're our friends and family. But don't you think we should be taking care of the pygmies that are creating them as well?$B$BAt the three Oostan villages, Nord, Sor, and Ost, there are witch doctors: Gaahl, Malmo, and Teloch.$B$BMaybe you could take care of them? I don't want to be turned into a zombie!
english.completion: I gotta tell you, that's a load off of my mind. That is, I won't have to worry about no new zombies coming after my brains!

text.title: 摇滚粉末
text.objectives: 收集5份摇滚粉末。
text.description: 关于这些小矮子，有一件事情不得不承认……他们倒是挺享受摇滚的！可惜不够聪明。我已经发现了摇滚村落之谜：摇滚粉末！$B$B这种物质令他们成为世界一流的摇滚歌手，但同时它也是高度危险的爆炸物。我们必须把它搞到手！$B$B听说你正在去东边的乌司坦村落，记得顺便收集一些来。相信我，这玩意儿接下来会派上大用场的！
text.progress: Hmm, let me see how much you've got.
text.completion: This will do. In fact, it's more than we need. I devised an ingenious idea for a weapon that the boots will be turned into once you get them to Hobart.$B$BHand the powder over and I'll load it into the Super Booster Rocket Boots.

english.title: Rockin' Powder
english.objectives: Collect 5 scoops of Rockin' Powder.
english.description: I'll give these pygmies one thing... they sure know how to party! But they're not so clever. I think I've discovered the source of their rockin' powers: Rockin' Powder!$B$BIt turns out that this stuff, which turns them into world-class rockers, is also highly explosive. We must have it!$B$BSo, while you're in there at Oostan to the east, make sure that you pickup a whole bunch of the stuff. Trust me, you're going to need it for what's coming up!
english.progress: Hmm, let me see how much you've got.
english.completion: This will do. In fact, it's more than we need. I devised an ingenious idea for a weapon that the boots will be turned into once you get them to Hobart.$B$BHand the powder over and I'll load it into the Super Booster Rocket Boots.

text.title: 推进力
text.objectives: 去找落帆海湾的梅格斯·碎纸机。
text.description: 我们不能坐享其成，宝贝儿。必须加把劲！大家都在谈论我们呢。$B$B不幸的是，他们也在谈论那个脑袋空空的凯尔希，就是那个和我们打对台的侏儒。要想把她赶出镇子，我们就得干一票大买卖。$B$B我们要为他们处理掉加基森的海盗，永远解决。到南边的落帆海湾去，我会在那儿见你。

english.title: Momentum
english.objectives: Meet Megs Dreadshredder at Lost Rigger Cove.
english.description: We can't just rest on our laurels here, babe. We've got to keep this momentum going! People are talking about us.$B$BUnfortunately, they're also talking about this air-headed gnome, Kelsey, who's apparently been running jobs right alongside us. If we're going to drive her out of what's rightfully a goblin town, we need to seal the deal here.$B$BWe're going to take care of Gadgetzan's pirate problem for them, for good. Head south to Lost Rigger Cove, I'll meet you there.

text.title: 解除困境
text.objectives: 使用帕克斯顿的火炬烧毁3台怒吼投石车和1台投刃车。
text.description: 一旦怒吼兽人获得军火供给，我们就很难确保城堡的高墙不被攻破了。我要你穿越峡谷，摧毁他们的武器。$B$B兽人喜欢在重型军械上涂抹煤焦油，这让它们成为危险的易燃品。带上我的火炬，焚毁北方城堡以北的投石车。$B$B然后点燃怒吼营地里的投刃车！这些军械杀死了不少我们的士兵。
text.progress: Burn it all, $c. Burn it to cinders!
text.completion: Good! Without heavy equipment, the Horde will have to pull back to regroup. We've bought ourselves some time to re-secure the fortress. Well done!

english.title: Lifting the Siege
english.objectives: Use Paxton's Torch to burn 3 Rageroar Catapults and 1 Rageroar Blade Thrower.
english.description: We'll never be able to re-secure the fortress walls so long as Rageroar and his goons have access to artillery. I need you to fight your way across that chasm and take out his big guns.$B$BOrcs season their heavy machinery with coal tar, which makes them flammable. Take my torch and burn any catapults you see north of Northwatch.$B$BThen, torch those big blade-throwers in Rageroar's base camp! Those things have killed enough of our men.
english.progress: Burn it all, $c. Burn it to cinders!
english.completion: Good! Without heavy equipment, the Horde will have to pull back to regroup. We've bought ourselves some time to re-secure the fortress. Well done!

text.title: 收赃物
text.objectives: 获得10份海盗赃物。
text.description: 咱们干点有用的，宝贝儿。这些海盗把成吨的好东西就这么放着，等人去拿。你能相信他们就坐在这这种东西上面吗？$B$B我是说，既然东西就在那儿，他们干嘛不去拿呢？赃物可以卖掉，然后买些崭新的漂亮玩意啊。$B$B总之，行行好，出门干架的时候尽量把他们值钱的玩意儿都拿来。拜拜！

english.title: Booty Duty
english.objectives: Collect 10 pieces of Pirate Booty.
english.description: Let's not be wasteful here, babe. These pirates have tons of valuable nonsense just sitting around, waiting to be fenced. Can you believe they just sit on this stuff?$B$BI mean, why do they even bother taking it if it's just going to sit around? Stolen goods should be sold off and used to buy shiny new things.$B$BAnyway, be a dear and go grab as much of their loot as you can carry while you're out busting heads. Ciao!

text.title: 恐须船长
text.objectives: 杀死恐须船长。
text.description: 好吧，宝贝儿，这次我有一桩更大的生意。$B$B我们在南边一条小船上发现了南海海盗的船长。是南边，不是我们横冲直撞了好几个小时想找条大鱼的地方。他就坐在那儿，袖手旁观，看着我们在这儿打成一团。$B$B我就不跟你开什么“恶意收购”的玩笑了。到他的船上去给他一顿胖揍，然后我们就能收工了！
text.giverWindow: 可怕的胡须。

english.title: Captain Dreadbeard
english.objectives: Kill Captain Dreadbeard.
english.description: Alright, babe, I've got something bigger for you to take on here.$B$BWe spotted the captain of the Southsea over on one of his boats to the south; that's to the south, and NOT the one we've been suicidally bum-rushing for the better part of several hours. He's sitting up there, smug and stoic, watching us war down here.$B$BI'll spare you the "hostile takeover" jokes. Get on his ship and beat the tar out of him, and we're done here!
english.giverWindow: Fear the beard.

text.title: 好主意
text.objectives: 用走私贩的虫饵抓到一只哈扎里群居蝎。
text.description: 既然我们有一堆新鲜上好的肉块，那我们只要把它们绑在这根绳子上……现在，你就去抓虫子吧。$B$B怎么？别那么看着我，完全安全。好吧，基本上安全。行了，你可能会痛苦地死去。不过很简单！只要把这块肉扔进去，等着虫子上钩，然后用绳子把它拉回来就好了！$B$B去抓一只群居蝎来。我还没见过有其它种类的生物会把土狼吃掉。你可以在虫巢边上找到大量的群居蝎。
text.completion: Look at the size of it! It's glorious. This ugly sucker's gonna help us bring down the whole hive.

english.title: A Great Idea
english.objectives: Use the Bootlegger Bug Bait to capture a Hazzali Swarmer.
english.description: Now that we've got a good pile of fresh chunks, we just tie it to this rope...and now you're ready to go catch me a silithid.$B$BWhat? Don't give me that look, it's perfectly safe. Well, mostly safe. Okay, you might die painfully. But it'll be easy! Just throw this meat out there, wait for a bug to pounce on it, and then drag 'em back here by the rope!$B$BGo after one of the swarmers. I haven't seen the other ones go for hyenas before, and you should find plenty of swarmers around the edge of the pit.
english.completion: Look at the size of it! It's glorious. This ugly sucker's gonna help us bring down the whole hive.

text.title: 火箭靴的威力
text.objectives: 使用沾满摇滚粉末的火箭靴，并将其交给霍巴特·钩锤。
text.description: 你得将这双靴子交给火山口的霍巴特·钩锤。$B$B上面沾满了摇滚粉末，其推动力应该足以将你一次性地送达目的地。$B$B你准备好之后就启动火箭靴吧。别担心，我为它们设置了自动安全着陆的程序。$B$B我想差不多是这样。
text.progress: Well there you are!
text.completion: There's no time to waste, $G boy : girl;!$B$BWhat's wrong with the actuator on the left boot?!

english.title: Rocket Boot Boost
english.objectives: Use the Rockin' Powder Infused Rocket Boots and deliver them to Hobart Grapplehammer.
english.description: You need to get those boots down into the caldera to Hobart Grapplehammer.$B$BNow that they're infused with the leftover rockin' powder, they should have enough thrust to get you all the way there on one shot.$B$BWhen you're ready, activate the boots. Don't worry, they're automatically set to land you safely.$B$BI think.
english.progress: Well there you are!
english.completion: There's no time to waste, $G boy : girl;!$B$BWhat's wrong with the actuator on the left boot?!

objectiveDetails.description: 使用沾满摇滚粉末的火箭靴

text.title: 只想杀点虫
text.objectives: 跟纳瑞安交谈，指挥被控制意识的爬虫进入大裂口虫巢。
text.description: 现在该全面实施我的计划了。我们在俘获的虫子上尽可能多地绑了炸药，借助纳瑞安最为奇妙的心灵之力，我们就可以把那垃圾直接送到地下虫巢的中心去。$B$B然后呢……砰！就没虫子啦！$B$B指挥这只恶心东西的荣誉就交给你了。去和纳瑞安谈一谈，跟你的虫子朋友做好准备。
text.progress: I didn't hear no cave-ins, pal! Try again!
text.completion: Oh man, that was awesome! You should've seen the flames coming out of the hive!$B$BHere's your reward, for entertaining me as much as for clearing the hive!

english.title: Just Trying to Kill Some Bugs
english.objectives: Talk to Narain Soothfancy to pilot the Mind-Controlled Swarmer into the Gaping Chasm hive.
english.description: Now it's time for my plan to go into full effect. We've got the captured bug strapped up with as many explosives as it can carry, and with Soothfancy's mostly amazing mental powers, we're gonna drive that sucker straight down into the center of the underground hive.$B$BAnd then...BOOM! No more bugs!$B$BYou get the personal honor of directin' the ugly thing. Go talk to Narain and get set up with your bug-pal.
english.progress: I didn't hear no cave-ins, pal! Try again!
english.completion: Oh man, that was awesome! You should've seen the flames coming out of the hive!$B$BHere's your reward, for entertaining me as much as for clearing the hive!

text.title: 龟神的子嗣
text.objectives: 收集5个火囊。
text.description: 龟神沃卡洛斯就在那边的洞穴里，这帮原始人可劲儿地崇拜它。$B$B它根本就不是什么神灵啊。$B$B<霍巴特转动着眼珠。>$B$B要我利用仅剩的一只火箭靴来打造一件全新的武器，这有点棘手呢。$B$B俗话说“以火攻火”嘛。而且我喜欢火焰！$B$B从沃卡洛斯之子那里收集火囊吧。我这就来改造这只火箭靴。
text.progress: No time like the present to be done with the simple task I put before you, $N. Wouldn't you agree?
text.completion: Careful with those glands, $N, careful!$B$B<Grapplehammer's eyes light up at the sight of the fiery organs.>$B$BAnd now to load them into the refashioned shredder boot. I'm certain that you'll be surprised and amazed by my genius invention.

english.title: Children of a Turtle God
english.objectives: Collect 5 Fire Glands.
english.description: Volcanoth is the turtle god in the cave that these primitives worship.$B$BIt's not really a god.$B$B<Hobart rolls his eyes.>$B$BBut it is tough enough that I'm going to have to devise a new weapon for you from the one functioning boot we have left.$B$BI think that the age-old motto of "fight fire with fire" applies here. Plus, I like fire!$B$BLet's get some fire glands from Volcanoth's children. That should give me time to modify the rocket boot into something more fitting.
english.progress: No time like the present to be done with the simple task I put before you, $N. Wouldn't you agree?
english.completion: Careful with those glands, $N, careful!$B$B<Grapplehammer's eyes light up at the sight of the fiery organs.>$B$BAnd now to load them into the refashioned shredder boot. I'm certain that you'll be surprised and amazed by my genius invention.

text.title: 未经许可
text.objectives: 让10个砂槌食人魔在表格上签名。
text.description: 我之前也提到了，我想让那些砂槌食人魔加入部落……以及作为廉价劳力为锈水财阀卖命。$B$B为了成事，我们就得少说多做，实际行动起来，不然我就要背黑锅。所以我把许可证画好了，入行表贴在咱们自己的限时劳动契约合同上。$B$B我给你找了一身伪装，穿上去把签名都收集过来。

english.title: Un-Chartered
english.objectives: Obtain 10 Charter Signatures from Dunemaul Ogres.
english.description: As I may have mentioned, I'm trying to get these Dunemaul ogres to join the Horde..and  work for the Bilgewater Cartel as cheap local labor.$B$BTo pull this off, we've gotta pay lip service to the actual initiation process and all that, or I'm going to catch flak later on. So I've gotten this charter drawn up, and slapped the initiation rites onto our own limited time offer labor stipulation contract.$B$BI've got a disguise for you here, so suit up and get all these signatures filled out.

text.title: 除掉卡迦·怒吼
text.objectives: 击败4名怒吼上尉和卡迦·怒吼，并从卡迦身上取回怒吼之盔。
text.description: 我曾经与怒吼氏族交过手，$n。氏族的首领并非兽人，而是一只阴险而残忍的嗜战恶魔。我们必须除掉他和他麾下的上尉，拯救北方城堡乃至整个艾泽拉斯。$B$B$c，杀死卡迦·怒吼并将他的头盔带回来给我。这件头盔……尤其重要。$B$B卡迦的营地就在东边，穿过峡谷就到。
text.progress: Is he dead? Do you have his ... helm?
text.completion:
<Tolliver grasps the helmet reverently with quivering hands.>

Rageroar's battleships intercepted our vessel as we fled from Gilneas. We were to be carried here as trophies to the Warchief. As we neared the shore, some of us fought back. Rageroar - he began killing indiscriminately - howling with laughter. Our ship capsized and he ordered his men to fire at us as we drowned. Few of us made it to land.

Afterwards, I learned that he wore my brother's scalp as... as a trophy.

<He closes his eyes.>
text.giverWindow: 消灭卡迦·怒吼。当心他的爪牙。

english.title: Silencing Rageroar
english.objectives: Slay 4 Rageroar Lieutenants and acquire Rageroar's Helm by killing Karga Rageroar.
english.description: I have encountered the Rageroar clan before, $n. They are led not by an orc, but by a monster - a war-gorged fiend without a shred of decency or compassion. He and his lieutenants must be killed, not just to save Northwatch, but for the good of all of Azeroth.$B$BKarga Rageroar wears a helm. Execute him, $c, and bring the helm to me. It is of ... particular importance.$B$BRageroar has made his camp across the chasm, east of here.
english.progress: Is he dead? Do you have his ... helm?
english.completion:
<Tolliver grasps the helmet reverently with quivering hands.>

Rageroar's battleships intercepted our vessel as we fled from Gilneas. We were to be carried here as trophies to the Warchief. As we neared the shore, some of us fought back. Rageroar - he began killing indiscriminately - howling with laughter. Our ship capsized and he ordered his men to fire at us as we drowned. Few of us made it to land.

Afterwards, I learned that he wore my brother's scalp as... as a trophy.

<He closes his eyes.>
english.giverWindow: Destroy Karga Rageroar. Be careful of what his minions are capable of.

text.title: 森提帕尔派对开始
text.objectives: 从森提帕尔异种蝎身上获得20块森提帕尔蝎肉。
text.description: 好了，宝贝儿。就像我说的，食人魔蠢得要死，不晓得签字意味着什么。现在我们得让他们跟我们走，所以要弄点显然是受当地人欢迎的口味来。$B$B我是说，受当地流口水的白痴欢迎的口味。$B$B跑到西边的腐化之巢去，那里有个又大又吓人的巢穴，里面全是危险的异种蝎。杀掉一些森提帕尔异种蝎，把肉块带回来给他们，好不好？回头见。

english.title: Get The Centipaarty Started
english.objectives: Collect 20 Centipaarts from Centipaar Silithid.
english.description: Okay, babe. Like I said, the ogres are too dumb to know what signing that charter meant. Now we have to actually get them to come along with us, so we'll be procuring what is apparently beloved local flavor.$B$BBeloved local flavor for drooling idiots, I mean.$B$BJust pop on over to the Noxious Lair to the west, it's that big horrible pit full of dangerous silithid. Kill a bunch of the Centipaar silithid and bring back the pieces so we can hand 'em out, okay? Ciao.

text.title: 沃卡洛斯！
text.objectives: 使用地精火箭筒杀死沃卡洛斯。
text.description: 一件浸透着我的心血、汗水和眼泪的杰作：地精火箭筒，诞生了！我已经提交了专利申请！$B$B这些俾格米矮子将我们的同胞丢去喂“神”，现在还打算放出巨兽沃卡洛斯攻击镇子！$B$B你必须进入洞穴，尽快杀死沃卡洛斯！
text.completion: I managed to get everyone else safely back to town.$B$BJump in, we gotta get out of here before the volcano blows for good!!!
text.giverWindow: 使用地精火箭筒把这个怪物轰成渣！！！

english.title: Volcanoth!
english.objectives: Use the Bootzooka to slay Volcanoth.
english.description: It took a lot of blood, sweat, and tears, but the Bootzooka, patent-pending, is ready for use!$B$BThese no-good pygmies have been feeding our people to their "god", Volcanoth, and they're about to unleash it on our town!$B$BYou have to get into the cave and kill that thing before it's too late!
english.completion: I managed to get everyone else safely back to town.$B$BJump in, we gotta get out of here before the volcano blows for good!!!
english.giverWindow: Use the Bootzooka to bring down this monstrosity!!!

text.title: 从墓穴中醒来
text.objectives: 向提瑞斯法林地的丧钟镇墓地中的送葬者摩尔多报到。
text.description: $n！$b$b苏醒吧，$n！$b$b欢迎回到生者的世界。我以黑暗女王的力量为你降下赐福，将你从死亡的桎梏中解放出来。$b$b你不是奴隶，$n。你可以自由选择你的道路。如果你选择效忠黑暗女王，就去和送葬者摩尔多谈谈。你可以在我身后的墓地里找到他。
text.completion: Hello there.  You must be... $N?

english.title: Fresh out of the Grave
english.objectives: Report to Undertaker Mordo at the Deathknell Graves in Tirisfal Glades.
english.description: $n!$b$bRise, $n!$b$bWelcome back to the realm of the living.  With the blessing and power of the Dark Lady, I have freed you from death's grip.$b$bYou are no slave, $n.  You are free to follow whatever path you choose from here.  If you choose to serve the Dark Lady Sylvanas, I recommend you speak with Undertaker Mordo.  You will find him behind me, in the graveyard.
english.completion: Hello there.  You must be... $N?

text.title: 苏醒
text.objectives: 同治安官雷德帕斯，莉莉安·沃斯和瓦德雷·莫莱交谈。
text.description: 国王，农夫，或者$c……你以前是干什么的，这根本不重要。我只需要一个舌头能活动的家伙。$b$b从死亡中苏醒的人会承受巨大的压力。所以并非每具躯体都能像你这样行动自如。现在就有三个刚刚苏醒的亡灵，还无法适应自身的变化。$b$b我希望你找到他们，和他们谈谈。他们也许只是需要一个能够交流的人。$b$b你可以在这座墓地里找到他们。
text.progress: No dilly-dallying now.  You're among the Forsaken now, and we hold ours to a higher standard.
text.completion: You've done well, $c.  As you can see, not all of us have resigned to our fates.  I'm glad to see that you're at least willing to work.$b$bValdred will be a valuable asset to the Forsaken.  As for the other two... there is not much we can do.  We cannot force them to join us.

english.title: The Wakening
english.objectives: Speak with Marshal Redpath, Lilian Voss, and Valdred Moray.
english.description: King, peasant, or $c... I don't care WHAT you were before.  I just need somebody with a working tongue.$b$bBeing raised from the dead is strenuous.  Not everyone copes with it as well as you did.  In particular, there are three newly-raised undead who are having trouble coping right now.$b$bI want you to find them and talk to them.  It might be that they just need someone that they can relate with.$b$bYou'll find them here in the graveyard.
english.progress: No dilly-dallying now.  You're among the Forsaken now, and we hold ours to a higher standard.
english.completion: You've done well, $c.  As you can see, not all of us have resigned to our fates.  I'm glad to see that you're at least willing to work.$b$bValdred will be a valuable asset to the Forsaken.  As for the other two... there is not much we can do.  We cannot force them to join us.

objectiveDetails.description: 同治安官雷德帕斯交谈

text.title: 墓中的真相
text.objectives: 在丧钟镇的大旅店中找到莉莉安·沃斯。同她交谈，让她看看艾尔雷斯的小手镜。
text.description: 早先，我看到一个年轻的被遗忘者女性跑进了旧旅店里。她在为自己逝去的生命而尖叫，央求别人带她回家。$B$B并不是所有被遗忘者都跟其他人一样坚强，$n。即便如此，我们也必须接受自己已经成为亡灵的命运，不然就会死在那些处心积虑想要干掉我们的人的手上。$B$B拿着我的小手镜，让她看看自己到底是什么样，加入我们的行列。而且……我们也需要尽可能多的尸体。
text.progress: Have you spoken with her yet?  She needs to be shown the truth.
text.completion: You say she ran away?  What a shame.$b$bVery well.  As long as she's maintained her free will, there's still hope.

english.title: The Truth of the Grave
english.objectives: Find Lilian Voss inside the large inn in Deathknell.  Then speak with her to show her Elreth's Hand Mirror.
english.description: Earlier on, I saw a young Forsaken woman running towards the old inn.  She was screaming for her life, pleading to be taken back home.$b$bNot all of us are as resolute as others, $n.  Even so, we must accept our fate as undead if we are to rise up against those that would put us down.$b$bTake my hand mirror and show it to the young woman.  She needs to see what she really is, and join us in our cause.  Besides... we can use all the bodies that we can get.
english.progress: Have you spoken with her yet?  She needs to be shown the truth.
english.completion: You say she ran away?  What a shame.$b$bVery well.  As long as she's maintained her free will, there's still hope.

objectiveDetails.description: 让莉莉安看到自己的样子

text.title: Trail-Worn Scroll
text.objectives: Read the Trail-Worn Scroll and speak to Xavier the Huntsman in Deathknell.
text.description: Ah, while you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. I would think it's some matter of importance as it seems it bears the seal of the hunter trainer Xavier. I would take some time to read it before heading out again.
text.progress: Ah, so you've arrived. Good. I overheard that a few others were able to escape "death" and were heading into town. Perhaps that resilience will pay off in the future also.$B$BYou may thank Sylvanas for your freedom... freedom of mind and body. Though you still remain tortured by the plague and its effects, you are now free to come and go as you see fit.
text.completion: I will be here to train you as you grow in experience... find me as often as you like. I charge a minimal fee, but you'll find everything I can teach you to be worthwhile.$B$BGo now and test your skill. Many more things will become known to you as you gain experience, some of which I am unable to discuss with you here. Just know that Sylvanas will need hunters with your type of cunning in the future.$b$bYou will be the backbone of our salvation. Do not forget it.

Just know that Sylvanas will need hunters with your type of cunning in the future.$b$bYou will be the backbone of our salvation. Do not forget it.

text.title: 好心加大棒
text.objectives: 削弱8名砂槌食人魔，然后把锈水财阀精致餐点给他们。
text.description: 好了，宝贝儿，听好。要让人听你话有两个办法。你可以提供东西、服务，以及人们想要的……或者你可以把他们打得生不如死。$B$B我发现双管齐下通常很有用，而且你目前也对这两种方法非常熟悉了。带上这些异种蝎礼物，去把食人魔打晕乎了，再把吃的给他们，别打死了，行吗？

english.title: Maul 'Em With Kindness
english.objectives: Use the Bilgewater Cartel Promotional Delicacy Morsels on 8 Dunemaul Ogres after weakening them.
english.description: Okay, babe, listen up. There's two ways to get people to do what you want. You can provide goods, services, and things people want...or you can beat the living daylights out of them.$B$BI've often found it's useful to do both at the same time, and you're pretty familiar with both methods by now. Take these little silithid treats, go and beat some ogres dizzy, and then give them the treat before you knock them completely dead, 'kay?

text.title: The Thrill of the Hunt
text.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Steady Shot, then practice using Steady Shot 5 times on a Training Dummy.
text.description: I've been told that I'm supposed to train you how to be a hunter.  That's all well and good, but in my opinion, you'll get more training out in the field than you will talking about theories with me.$b$bGo out, get some more experience, and see if you learn any new tricks. Then you can come back and show me.
text.completion: You seem to be somewhat of a natural, $n.  This is good.  I can't teach you everything myself.$b$bGo, practice what we've discussed today.  Return when you're stronger, and we'll cover some more tricks and abilities.

text.title: Magic Training
text.objectives: Reach Level 3 to learn Frost Nova, then practice using it 2 times against a Training Dummy.
text.description:
Let's get some work done, shall we?

As you grow in power, your connection to the arcane will deepen, granting you access to new spells.

You'll see. Go, get some more experience, then come back and demonstrate what you've learned.
text.progress: What's the matter... did you run out of money?
text.completion: I've got to admit, the spell I just taught you probably won't increase your intellect severalfold.  That was a lie to get you to buy my services.  But it will still be a helpful spell for you and your allies.$b$bNo hard feelings!

text.title: Of Light and Shadows
text.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Shadow Word: Pain. Then, practice casting it 5 times on training dummies.
text.description:
A Forsaken priest is a curious beast,$b$g his: her; path an unusual course.$b$G His: Her; shadowy rites cannot come from the Light, so $g he: she; seeks a more sinister source.$b$bNot only has the world forsaken us, $n... it seems the Light has left us as well.  As the poem hints, however... we are not without power.

Go, get more experience, grow your power. Return to me, and demonstrate what you have learned.

text.title: Stab!
text.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Eviscerate, then practice using Eviscerate 3 times on a Training Dummy.
text.description:
Quiet down!  I don't want these novices around us to hear what we're about to discuss.$b$bListen up... $n, is it? Soon, you'll learn something that'll change the way you operate as a rogue.  You'll be able to follow up on your attacks with a deadly finishing move. Maybe even slide a dagger between their vertebrae.

To learn it, you just gotta get some more experience. Don't worry, you'll figure it out.

text.title: Dark Deeds
text.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Corruption, then practice casting Corruption 5 times on a Training Dummy.
text.description:
As you continue your career as a warlock, you'll begin to hear the voices of fel power... they will reveal their secrets, teaching you new spells.

I want to see you learn a new spell and try it out on one of the dummies here.

english.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Corruption, then practice casting Corruption 5 times on a Training Dummy.

text.title: Charging into Battle
text.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Charge, then practice using Charge on a Training Dummy.
text.description: If you want to become a stronger warrior, you'll need to work on your weapons.  You'll find stronger swords and larger shields out on your adventures, that I have no doubt about.$b$bBut it isn't just your physical armory that will get stronger - you'll also begin to discover new techniques. Go, get some experience, learn something new, then come back and show me.

english.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Charge, then practice using Charge on a Training Dummy.
