Go, get some experience, learn something new, then come back and show me.

text.title: 跟僵尸一样烂
text.objectives: 去找提瑞斯法林地丧钟镇的达内尔。
text.description: 你在那座矿洞里面的时候，你的朋友达内尔带来了一些值得警惕的消息。$b$b自从瓦格里抵达以来，我们遇到了越来越多不愿效忠黑暗女王的亡灵。他们在山谷里建立了一座小营地，现在已经颇具规模了。$b$b他们想要进攻丧钟镇，$c。$b$b达内尔就在东边的路上。多加小心，$n。虽然那些亡灵并非完全无头无脑的，但它们仍有些不太正常。
text.completion: $N.  You made it.$b$bYou see those tents up there?  That's where we're headed.  The battle's probably already started.

english.title: No Better Than the Zombies
english.objectives: Report to Darnell at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.
english.description: While you were inside that cave, your big friend Darnell came by with some alarming news.$b$bSince the val'kyr arrived, we've seen more and more undead that chose not to join our forces under the banner of the Dark Lady.  They've been gathering at a small camp here in the valley, and now they've organized forces.$b$bThey plan to attack Deathknell, $c.$b$bDarnell is just down the road, to the east.  Be careful, $n.  While those undead aren't completely brainless, they're still not quite right in the head.
english.completion: $N.  You made it.$b$bYou see those tents up there?  That's where we're headed.  The battle's probably already started.

text.title: 袭击腐脑营地
text.objectives: 杀死治安官雷德帕斯和8个腐脑亡灵。
text.description: 在你为执行官阿伦跑腿的时候，上峰指派了一个任务给我。暗影牧师萨维斯要我去侦察一下腐脑营地。$b$b他们被称为腐脑是有原因的。$b$b他们的领袖叫治安官雷德帕斯，他绝对是头野兽。$b$b你看，$n……进攻就要开始了。你的战斗水平比我高。去帮忙吧！$b$b搞定之后，到礼拜堂去找暗影牧师萨维斯。祝你好运，$n。
text.completion: Being born again under the power of a val'kyr is a strenuous process.  Many don't survive the shock, turning into zombies or ghouls.$b$bOthers retain just enough humanity to seem normal on the outside... but they're sick inside.  We should have slain those rotbrains the day they were raised.$b$bAs for you... you're a strong $c, $n.  I knew you'd do well.  You'll be headed out of Deathknell soon.

english.title: Assault on the Rotbrain Encampment
english.objectives: Kill Marshal Redpath and 8 Rotbrain undead.
english.description: While you were taking care of matters for Executor Arren, I went off on an assignment of my own.  Shadow Priest Sarvis asked me to peek in on the Rotbrain camp.$b$bThere's a reason why they're called Rotbrains.$b$bTheir leader goes by the name of Marshal Redpath, and he's an absolute beast.$b$bLook, $n... the attack is starting.  You're better in combat than I am.  Get in there and help out!$b$bWhen you're done, meet up with Shadow Priest Sarvis in the chapel.  Good luck, $n.
english.completion: Being born again under the power of a val'kyr is a strenuous process.  Many don't survive the shock, turning into zombies or ghouls.$b$bOthers retain just enough humanity to seem normal on the outside... but they're sick inside.  We should have slain those rotbrains the day they were raised.$b$bAs for you... you're a strong $c, $n.  I knew you'd do well.  You'll be headed out of Deathknell soon.

text.title: 重要情报
text.objectives: 将血色十字军文件交给提瑞斯法林地的卡尔斯通庄园里的亡灵卫兵希米尔。
text.description: <萨维斯从长袍里拿出一份文件。>$b$b必须马上把这些文件交给我的战地特使，亡灵卫兵希米尔。有了这些情报，我们就能知道血色十字军最后几个据点的位置。我们要彻底消灭血色十字军。我相信，你在这次任务中有着举足轻重的作用，$n。$B$B沿着丧钟镇北边的路出去，在进入提瑞斯法地界之后，你很快就可以看到一间大宅子。希米尔就在那里面。
text.progress: Yes, what do you want?
text.completion: Yes, this is very good. You've done well in obtaining this information, $n. Hmm... names of the Scarlet Crusade officers in the Tirisfal Glades...$b$bImagine the blow we could deal to the morale of those bloody zealots if we were to kill their leaders in one swift strike.  I will pass this information forward.

english.title: Vital Intelligence
english.objectives: Deliver the Scarlet Crusade Documents to Deathguard Simmer at Calston Estate in Tirisfal Glades.
english.description: <Sarvis produces a piece of paper from within his robes.>$b$bThese will need to be taken to my field agent, Deathguard Simmer.  This information contains the whereabouts of the last few holdouts from the Scarlet Crusade.  We will destroy these crusaders, once and for all.  And I have a feeling you'll be instrumental in that effort, $n.$b$bTake the road north out of Deathknell.  Soon after entering Tirisfal proper, you'll see a large manse.  Simmer's inside.
english.progress: Yes, what do you want?
english.completion: Yes, this is very good. You've done well in obtaining this information, $n. Hmm... names of the Scarlet Crusade officers in the Tirisfal Glades...$b$bImagine the blow we could deal to the morale of those bloody zealots if we were to kill their leaders in one swift strike.  I will pass this information forward.

text.title: 夜行蜘蛛洞穴
text.objectives: 杀死8只小夜行蜘蛛和5只夜行蜘蛛。
text.description: 我们最重要的一项斗争，就是要夺取赖以生存的自然资源。洛丹伦的黄金资源相当匮乏，即便在多年以前，处于巅峰状态的联盟统治这里的时候也是如此。$b$b西边有一座金矿，里面满地是蜘蛛。我们需要那里的金矿，但在蜘蛛横行的情况下是没法采矿的。我没有足够的人手去处理这件事，所以只好一点点来。$B$B去看看你能帮点什么忙吧，$n。
text.completion: Well, it's a start.  It'll take a few weeks or months to fully clean out the infestation.  After that, we'll have to get down there with some torches to burn away the webbing.$b$bYou've done your duty well, $n.

english.title: Night Web's Hollow
english.objectives: Kill 8 Young Night Web Spiders and 5 Night Web Spiders.
english.description: One of our greatest struggles is obtaining the natural resources we need to survive.  Gold was scarce in Lordaeron, even in the height of the Alliance's power so many years ago.$b$bThere is a gold mine to the west that has been overrun with spiders.  We need gold from the mine, but we can't very well get it while the spiders are crawling around in there.  I've not much manpower to commit to the task, so we'll just have to do it little by little.$B$BGet up there and see what you can do for us, $n.
english.completion: Well, it's a start.  It'll take a few weeks or months to fully clean out the infestation.  After that, we'll have to get down there with some torches to burn away the webbing.$b$bYou've done your duty well, $n.

text.title: 从未如此孤单
text.objectives: 在耳语海岸上对一名邪鳍鱼人使用鱼人拴绳，然后带着它去找卡尔斯通庄园的塞德里克·卡尔斯通。
text.description: 你一生辛勤工作，换来了什么？死于瘟疫。然后你作为亡灵加倍努力，换来了什么？钱，是的，还有一座小小的庄园，附赠几个讨厌的食客。至于幸福？没那么多。$b$b我年事已高，孑然一身，$n。我需要一个伴儿。用这根拴绳到西北方的耳语海岸上绑一只鱼人来。你得先把它削弱，才能用拴绳绑。然后把它带来给我。
text.progress: Oh, the pain of loneliness is too much to bear!
text.completion: Oh, look at him!  Isn't he the most adorable thing you've ever seen?  Thank you, $n.  I feel more energetic already.

english.title: Ever So Lonely
english.objectives: Use the Murloc Leash on a Vile Fin murloc at the Whispering Shore, then return it to Sedrick Calston at Calston Estate.
english.description: You work hard your whole life, and what do you get?  Killed by a plague.  Then you work even harder in undeath, and what do you get?  Money, yes, and a small estate with a few pesky hangers-on, but happiness?  Not so much.$b$bI'm lonely in my old age, $n.  I need a companion.  Use this leash on one of the murlocs at the Whispering Shore to the northwest.  You'll have to weaken it first before it can be leashed.  Then bring it back to me.
english.progress: Oh, the pain of loneliness is too much to bear!
english.completion: Oh, look at him!  Isn't he the most adorable thing you've ever seen?  Thank you, $n.  I feel more energetic already.

text.title: 悲伤之地
text.objectives: 从提瑞斯法林地的索利丹农场中偷10颗南瓜来。
text.description: 看看谁来了？你看上去像是个菜鸟$c。如果你想向黑暗女王陛下证明自己的实力，就得先学会我们被遗忘者行事的几条基本原则。$b$b这里的西边有个农场，那块地上的人类多得跟腐烂尸体上的苍蝇一样多。更糟糕的是，血色十字军也会从他们的哨塔里出发巡逻周边地区。给这些渣滓们好好地上一课吧，把他们的宝贝南瓜给我偷10颗来。$b$b偷到10颗南瓜以后，就把它们带来给我。
text.progress: Were you able to gather 10 pumpkins yet, $N?
text.completion: You have performed your bidding well, young $c.  You are proving yourself to be quite an asset to the Dark Lady's army.

english.title: Fields of Grief
english.objectives: Steal 10 pumpkins from the Solliden Farmstead in Tirisfal Glades.
english.description: What have we here?  You look like a fledgling $c.  If you hope to prove yourself to the Dark Lady, you need to learn the ways of the Forsaken.$b$bTo the west you'll find a farm.  Humans infest the land like mold on a rotting corpse.  And worse yet, the Scarlet Crusade patrols nearby from their tower.  Teach those scum a lesson and steal 10 of their precious pumpkins.$b$bOnce you have 10, bring them back to me.
english.progress: Were you able to gather 10 pumpkins yet, $N?
english.completion: You have performed your bidding well, young $c.  You are proving yourself to be quite an asset to the Dark Lady's army.

text.title: 药剂也要多姿多彩
text.objectives: 获得4朵骨髓之花、4根萨维伦之棘，以及8条咸海参。
text.description: 这些南瓜是有用场的，$c。它们将用来装我最新发明的瘟疫，一种特别痛苦致命的药剂。不过，这瘟疫还缺一些稀有的材料。$b$b我们需要用到骨髓之花，它就生长在东边的静水湖底。我们还需要萨维伦之棘，它长在西北方的石崖上。最后，我们需要一些咸海参，去耳语海岸外的水里找找看。
text.progress: I've got a feeling this will be my best batch yet, good $c.
text.completion: Excellent work, $N.  Now comes the fun part.

english.title: Variety is the Spice of Death
english.objectives: Obtain 4 Marrowpetals, 4 Xavren's Thorns, and 8 Briny Sea Cucumbers.
english.description: These pumpkins have a purpose, $c.  They'll be the delivery mechanism for my latest batch of plague, which should be a particularly painful and virulent concoction.  However, the plague requires a few rare ingredients.$b$bWe'll need Marrowpetals, which grow at the bottom of Stillwater Pond, just to the east of here.  We'll also need Xavren's thorn, which grows on rocky cliffs to the northwest.  Finally, we need some briny sea cucumbers, found in the surf off of Whispering Shore.
english.progress: I've got a feeling this will be my best batch yet, good $c.
english.completion: Excellent work, $N.  Now comes the fun part.

text.title: 乔汉的实验
text.objectives: 将斑纹南瓜交给卡尔斯通庄园瞭望台的被俘虏的血色狂热者。
text.description: 无害的南瓜，对吧？看上去是的。如果我们要击溃北边天灾的进军，打败南边人类的侵扰，就得进一步挖掘我们作为被遗忘者的真正潜力。$b$b只要一点点独创性，一个简单的南瓜就能变成黑暗女王的使者。这个南瓜，掺上了我最新的配方，将成为一个优秀的解决方案。$b$b正好我们逮住了又一个血色狂热者，他被关在外面的瞭望台那儿。把这个南瓜给那蠢货带去。
text.progress: Stay away, foul and unholy creature!  May the Light protect me!  The Scarlet Crusade shall rid Azeroth of your...$b$b...oh wait.  Is that food for me?  I am so hungry...
text.completion: By the Light!  Finally some food!  Sweet, sweet pumpkin....

english.title: Johaan's Experiment
english.objectives: Take the Laced Pumpkin to the Captured Scarlet Zealot at the gazebo at Calston Estate.
english.description: Harmless pumpkins, right?  Or so it would seem.  If we are to defeat the Scourge advances from the North and the human infestation from the South we need to start realizing the full potential of our gift of undeath.$b$bWith a little ingenuity a simple pumpkin becomes an agent for our Dark Lady.  This pumpkin, laced with my latest formula, will prove to be quite a treat.$b$bYet another Scarlet Zealot has been captured and is being kept outside, by the gazebo.  Take this pumpkin to the fool.
english.progress: Stay away, foul and unholy creature!  May the Light protect me!  The Scarlet Crusade shall rid Azeroth of your...$b$b...oh wait.  Is that food for me?  I am so hungry...
english.completion: By the Light!  Finally some food!  Sweet, sweet pumpkin....

text.title: 收割收割者
text.objectives: 杀掉10个提瑞斯法农夫或提瑞斯法雇农。
text.description: 人类这种生物是出了名的反复无常。西边的农夫也不例外。当然，他们现在安宁地在耕着田，可明天，他们就可能举起镰刀对付我们。联盟在吉尔尼斯正逐渐逼近，暴风城的力量也在从南边推进……任何一方都可能征招这些种地的来攻打我们。$b$b我要他们死。去把这事解决了。
text.completion: You've the makings of a mighty $c, $r.  I heard the cries of those humans from all the way over here.  Perhaps soon we will be rid of this human blight.

english.title: Reaping the Reapers
english.objectives: Kill 10 Tirisfal Farmers or Tirisfal Farmhands.
english.description: Humans are notoriously fickle creatures.  The farmers to the west are no exception.  Sure, they may be plowing their fields peacefully now, but tomorrow, they may be raising their scythes against us.  The Alliance looms close by in Gilneas, and the power of Stormwind looms to the south... any of these could recruit these tillers and use them as a wedge against us.$b$bI want them dead.  See to it that it's done.
english.completion: You've the makings of a mighty $c, $r.  I heard the cries of those humans from all the way over here.  Perhaps soon we will be rid of this human blight.

text.title: 血色信件
text.objectives: 在血色关哨找到囚犯。
text.description: 盖比勒上尉：$b$b你收押囚犯的决定真是奇怪……而且还是一个亡灵囚犯。你在想什么？你是不是认为，因为囚犯的生前状况，她就可以凌驾在血色十字军的法令之上？$b$b这再让人苦恼不过了，盖比勒。我必须提醒你，这样做是要受惩罚的。我建议你立刻处决该囚犯。她不再是我们的一员了。
text.progress: A letter?  What does it say?
text.completion: The Scarlet Crusade takes no prisoners.  That they would do so with this young woman... curious.$b$bThe powers that you describe are even more curious.  She passed through the bars of her prison and killed her captor?  Why hadn't she done that in the first place?

english.title: A Scarlet Letter
english.objectives: Find the prisoner in Scarlet Palisade.
english.description: Lieutenant Gebler:$b$bHow curious that you would decide to take a prisoner... an undead one at that.  What were you thinking?  Do you think that, just because of the prisoner's former status, that she would be above the edicts of the Scarlet Crusade?$b$bThis is most troubling, Gebler.  I would remind you that there are penalties for such behavior.  I command you to execute the prisoner at once.  She is no longer one of us.
english.progress: A letter?  What does it say?
english.completion: The Scarlet Crusade takes no prisoners.  That they would do so with this young woman... curious.$b$bThe powers that you describe are even more curious.  She passed through the bars of her prison and killed her captor?  Why hadn't she done that in the first place?

text.title: 血色关哨
text.objectives: 杀死10名血色战士。
text.description: 我们需要像你这样“积极”的人，来把血色十字军送进坟墓。$b$b到西边索利丹农场后面的高塔去，杀掉10名血色十字军的战士，证明给我看，你有能力为黑暗女王效力。
text.progress: If you wish to prove your worth to The Dark Lady, slay 10 Scarlet Warriors, $c.
text.completion: Most excellent, $c.  Your skill in the art of combat is undeniable.

english.title: The Scarlet Palisade
english.objectives: Kill 10 Scarlet Warriors.
english.description: We need someone with "initiative" like yourself to drive the Scarlet Crusade to the grave.$b$bProve to me you are capable of serving The Dark Lady by travelling west to the tower past the Solliden Farmstead and slaying 10 warriors of the Scarlet Crusade.
english.progress: If you wish to prove your worth to The Dark Lady, slay 10 Scarlet Warriors, $c.
english.completion: Most excellent, $c.  Your skill in the art of combat is undeniable.

text.title: 如芒在背
text.objectives: 杀掉3名血色狂热者和3名血色传教士，拿到血色信函。
text.description: 我们从丧钟镇的执行官阿伦那儿收到的消息里，有着我们需要知道的所有细节，可以把人类的滋扰从这片土地里清除出去。根据情报，血色十字军指派派瑞恩队长和他的小队前往布瑞尔西南边的废墟塔楼。$b$b杀掉他手下的3个狂热者和3个传教士。你在那儿的时候，看能不能找到任何其他情报，好让我们知道他们到底打算干什么。
text.progress: We shall herd the Scarlet Crusade like cattle to their demise.
text.completion: It sounds like we'll have to keep our eyes out for this Voss character.  I don't expect any Forsaken to receive a reward if we capture her... I'm just worried she'll eventually turn against us.

english.title: A Thorn in our Side
english.objectives: Kill 3 Scarlet Zealots and 3 Scarlet Missionaries, and obtain the Scarlet Epistle.
english.description: Information we've received from Executor Arren in Deathknell contain all the details we need to wipe the human infestation from the lands.  According to the information, The Scarlet Crusade has assigned Captain Perrine and a brigade to the ruined tower southwest of Brill.$b$bKill 3 of his zealots and 3 of his missionaries.  And while you're there, see if you can dig up any other information about what they're up to.
english.progress: We shall herd the Scarlet Crusade like cattle to their demise.
english.completion: It sounds like we'll have to keep our eyes out for this Voss character.  I don't expect any Forsaken to receive a reward if we capture her... I'm just worried she'll eventually turn against us.

text.title: 被遗忘者的新生
text.objectives: 去找提瑞斯法林地布瑞尔的执政官塞弗伦。
text.description: 老实说，昔日的被遗忘者是一群饮泣吞声，可怜可悲的家伙。我们流亡在人类的残垣断壁之下，躲避着天灾，畏惧着联盟，对部落卑躬屈膝。$b$b过去的日子一去不复返了，你来看看如今全新的被遗忘者。我们已经在艾泽拉斯留下了自己的威名，这威名日后还将更加响亮。我们的统治很快将席卷世界！$b$b你想听听我的建议？去找布瑞尔的执政官塞弗伦聊聊吧。顺着路走下去就行了，他是那里的管理者。
text.completion: Yes, I'm Brill's local magistrate, reporting directly to the Dark Lady.  Impress me, and you may end up meeting the Banshee Queen herself.  Now, onto your first task...

english.title: The New Forsaken
english.objectives: Report to Magistrate Sevren at Brill in Tirisfal Glades.
english.description: Speaking frankly, the Forsaken of yesteryear were a sniveling, pathetic group.  We huddled together in decrepit old human buildings, hiding from the Scourge, cowering from the Alliance, and groveling at the foot of the Horde.$b$bLook before you now, and see the product of the new Forsaken.  We have made our mark here on Azeroth, and that mark will grow.  Our dominion will soon blanket the world!$b$bYou want my advice?  Speak with Magistrate Sevren in Brill, down this road.  He runs that town.
english.completion: Yes, I'm Brill's local magistrate, reporting directly to the Dark Lady.  Impress me, and you may end up meeting the Banshee Queen herself.  Now, onto your first task...

text.title: 亡灵卫兵的职责
text.objectives: 与提瑞斯法林地死亡观察站的亡灵卫兵林奈谈一谈。
text.description: 我要这里东边的亡灵卫兵驿站立刻给我提交一份最新的报告。$B$B我必须知道天灾军团是否已经迂回绕过了亡灵壁垒并进入了提瑞斯法林地。我们要时刻保持警惕，封锁住这里与瘟疫之地的边境，绝对不能让天灾军团占据这里的任何一寸土地！$B$B沿着路向南走，在第一个岔路口转向东，就可以到达驿站了。到那里去找亡灵卫兵林奈，她手里掌握着我最需要的情报。
text.completion: Magistrate Sevren wants a report?  Very well: the defenders at The Bulwark are holding the majority of the Scourge at bay, but some do slip through on occasion.$B$BWe have seen sporadic Scourge activity east of this station, with a concentration around the Balnir Farmstead.

english.title: Forsaken Duties
english.objectives: Speak with Deathguard Linnea at Death's Watch Waystation in Tirisfal Glades.
english.description: I need a fresh report from our Deathguard waystation to the east.$B$BI must know if more Scourge forces have slipped past The Bulwark and into Tirisfal.  Our vigilance on the border to the Plaguelands must be maintained - we can't let the Scourge get a stronger foothold here!$B$BTravel south along the road, then east at the fork to the waystation.  Speak with Deathguard Linnea.  She has the information I need.
english.completion: Magistrate Sevren wants a report?  Very well: the defenders at The Bulwark are holding the majority of the Scourge at bay, but some do slip through on occasion.$B$BWe have seen sporadic Scourge activity east of this station, with a concentration around the Balnir Farmstead.

text.title: The Prodigal Lich
text.objectives: Report to Gunther Arcanus at Gunther's Retreat in Tirisfal Glades.
text.description: Long ago, the mage Gunther Arcanus, along with Bethor Iceshard and the now-Scourge Necromancer Thule Ravenclaw, were friends and students within the Kirin Tor - a society of mages in Dalaran.$B$BGunther fell to the Plague, but we thought he either remained dead, or was raised into the ranks of the Lich King.  We now know he is free.$B$BWe must have him.  If you travel east, you will find him on an island in Brightwater Lake.  Convince him to join our ranks.

english.title: The Prodigal Lich
english.objectives: Report to Gunther Arcanus at Gunther's Retreat in Tirisfal Glades.
english.description: Long ago, the mage Gunther Arcanus, along with Bethor Iceshard and the now-Scourge Necromancer Thule Ravenclaw, were friends and students within the Kirin Tor - a society of mages in Dalaran.$B$BGunther fell to the Plague, but we thought he either remained dead, or was raised into the ranks of the Lich King.  We now know he is free.$B$BWe must have him.  If you travel east, you will find him on an island in Brightwater Lake.  Convince him to join our ranks.

text.title: Proving Allegiance
text.objectives: Obtain a Candle of Beckoning.$B$BSummon Lillith Nefara and kill her.
text.description: Fine.  I will continue with this charade, but only because I sense in you a spark of... excellence.  But before I believe you I must have proof that you are enemy to the Scourge.$B$BThere is an old, bloody altar just off the southern coast of this island.  It is used by a powerful Scourge agent, Lillith Nefara.$B$BTake a Candle of Beckoning from this crate here.  Light it on the altar and Lillith will awake.  Destroy Lillith, and I will believe you are an ally.
text.completed: Return to Gunther Arcanus at Gunther's Retreat in Tirisfal Glades.

english.title: Proving Allegiance
english.objectives: Obtain a Candle of Beckoning.$B$BSummon Lillith Nefara and kill her.
english.description: Fine.  I will continue with this charade, but only because I sense in you a spark of... excellence.  But before I believe you I must have proof that you are enemy to the Scourge.$B$BThere is an old, bloody altar just off the southern coast of this island.  It is used by a powerful Scourge agent, Lillith Nefara.$B$BTake a Candle of Beckoning from this crate here.  Light it on the altar and Lillith will awake.  Destroy Lillith, and I will believe you are an ally.
english.completed: Return to Gunther Arcanus at Gunther's Retreat in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: The Prodigal Lich Returns
text.objectives: Bring the Nether Gem to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.
text.description: Take this Nether Gem to my old comrade Bethor, who resides in the Undercity.  It will let us communicate ... and I have much to tell him.
text.completed: Return to Bethor Iceshard at Western Plaguelands.

english.title: The Prodigal Lich Returns
english.objectives: Bring the Nether Gem to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.
english.description: Take this Nether Gem to my old comrade Bethor, who resides in the Undercity.  It will let us communicate ... and I have much to tell him.
english.completed: Return to Bethor Iceshard at Western Plaguelands.

text.title: Dark Lady, Watch Over Us
text.objectives: Speak with Lady Sylvanas Windrunner in the Undercity.
text.description: In fact, why don't you speak with Lady Sylvanas herself?  The presence of another Kirin Tor-trained mage among our ranks is an occasion worthy of an audience.

english.title: Dark Lady, Watch Over Us
english.objectives: Speak with Lady Sylvanas Windrunner in the Undercity.
english.description: In fact, why don't you speak with Lady Sylvanas herself?  The presence of another Kirin Tor-trained mage among our ranks is an occasion worthy of an audience.

text.title: 死亡之寒
text.objectives: 带回5张夜行蝙蝠的毛皮.
text.description: 好冷啊……可怕的瘟疫正如冰冷的毒蛇一般在我的血管中逡巡，也许很快我就会彻底失去意志，但这世上没有任何东西能够阻止我为我们伟大的黑暗女王效命。一接到命令，我就开始为希尔瓦娜斯大人军队中那些死去的战士缝制尸袋。$b$b但现在我的手却因为寒冷而颤栗不已。如果你能给我带回五张夜行蝙蝠的毛皮的话，我就可以给自己缝条毯子了。帮帮我，$n，这样我就可以继续为黑暗女王陛下的事业效力了。
text.progress: Do you have five duskbat pelts yet, $N?
text.completion: I appreciate your efforts, $N.  May Sylvanas recognize your bravery one day. . . .

english.title: The Chill of Death
english.objectives: Obtain five Duskbat Pelts.
english.description: It's so cold, now.  The Plague of Undeath crawls through my veins like an icy serpent.  The mindless state will be upon me soon.  But no doomed destiny will prevent me from serving our Dark Lady.  When the call arose I sewed body bags for the fallen soldiers of Sylvanas's mighty army.$b$bNow my hands shake from the chill.  If you would bring me five duskbat pelts, I could sew myself a blanket.  Help me, $n, so that I can continue to serve the cause.
english.progress: Do you have five duskbat pelts yet, $N?
english.completion: I appreciate your efforts, $N.  May Sylvanas recognize your bravery one day. . . .

text.title: 向塞弗伦回报
text.objectives: 向布瑞尔的执政官塞弗伦报告。
text.description: 现在带着这些情报回到执政官塞弗伦那里去吧。他急需这几份报告，你动作最好快点。
text.completion: It is troubling to hear of the Scourge slipping past the Bulwark.  Even now, they are ceaseless in their assaults.$B$BBut we will not give in.  The Lich King is dead; we will not be taken again!

english.title: Return to the Magistrate
english.objectives: Return to Magistrate Sevren in Brill.
english.description: You should return to Magistrate Sevren with the information I gave you.  He'll want it as soon as possible, so be swift.
english.completion: It is troubling to hear of the Scourge slipping past the Bulwark.  Even now, they are ceaseless in their assaults.$B$BBut we will not give in.  The Lich King is dead; we will not be taken again!

text.title: 采血
text.objectives: 收集5瓶黑暗犬的血液。
text.description: 希尔瓦娜斯女士已经召集了皇家药剂师协会。她命令我们要配制出一种新的瘟疫，一种艾泽拉斯大陆上最致命的疾病。这种新的疾病会让我们的敌人－－无论是活物还是死者，悉数毁灭。$b$b我的研究显示，某种野兽的血液可能是配制这种瘟疫的关键。拿上这些瓶子，给我装点黑暗犬的血液回来，让我好测试一下我的理论。
text.progress: Have you collected the darkhound blood yet, $N? Time is fleeting!
text.completion: You have done well, $N and I thank you for your efforts.

english.title: Darkhound Pounding
english.objectives: Collect 5 Vials of Darkhound Blood.
english.description: Lady Sylvanas has called upon the Royal Apothecary Society.  She has challenged us to concoct a new plague, a plague deadlier than any ailment on Azeroth. This new disease will bring our enemies - living and dead - to ruin.$b$bMy studies show that the blood of beasts might prove to be the key. Here, fill these vials with darkhound blood so I can test my theory.
english.progress: Have you collected the darkhound blood yet, $N? Time is fleeting!
english.completion: You have done well, $N and I thank you for your efforts.

text.title: 加伦鬼屋
text.objectives: 去找提瑞斯法林地加伦鬼屋的药剂师杰罗德。
text.description: 你可能已经意识到了，皇家药剂师协会是一个庞大的组织。我们对瘟疫炼金学的态度非常严谨。我们相信，进行试验的人越多，了解到真谛也就越早。$b$b我们中的一个人正在北边的一个小营地里做试验呢。他叫杰罗德，他可能会用到你的……才干。
text.completion: Holland?  He's an amateur.  You don't need a fancy two-story apothecarium to make plague... you need love.  And maybe some good assistants.$b$bLet me show you how plague is REALLY made.

english.title: Garren's Haunt
english.objectives: Report to Apothecary Jerrod at Garren's Haunt in Tirisfal Glades.
english.description: As you're probably already realizing, the Royal Apothecary Society is a widespread organization.  We take our plague-alchemy seriously.  It is our belief that the more agents we have performing experiments, the sooner we will realize our objective.$b$bOne of our agents performs his work at a small encampment to the north of here.  His name is Jerrod, and he could use an apprentice of your... stature.
english.completion: Holland?  He's an amateur.  You don't need a fancy two-story apothecarium to make plague... you need love.  And maybe some good assistants.$b$bLet me show you how plague is REALLY made.

text.title: 逃离吉尔尼斯
text.objectives: 将狼人的存在报告给提瑞斯法林地布瑞尔的执行官塞加德。
text.description: 就你所知，事情有了新的变化——有个狼人盗贼正在提瑞斯法林地中游荡。执行官塞加德肯定会对此十分感兴趣的。
text.completion: Hmm... yes, that makes sense.  Since the worgen have come streaming out of Gilneas, I knew it would only be a matter of time before they arrived here in Tirisfal.

english.title: Escaped From Gilneas
english.objectives: Report the worgen's presence to Executor Zygand at Brill in Tirisfal Glades.
english.description: As far as you know, a worgen rogue roaming in Tirisfal is a new development.  This is something that Executor Zygand would certainly be interested in.
english.completion: Hmm... yes, that makes sense.  Since the worgen have come streaming out of Gilneas, I knew it would only be a matter of time before they arrived here in Tirisfal.

text.title: 消灭狼人
text.objectives: 找到并杀掉布瑞尔的5个狼人渗透者。
text.description: 狼人的问题必须尽快处理掉。我们的第一要务是消灭任何渗透到布瑞尔来的敌人。$b$b我要你当监视哨，$n，去注意布瑞尔任何的可疑活动。我们知道这些狼人可以潜藏在阴影里，因此要注意所有你能找到的蛛丝马迹……脚印、被踢翻的石头……任何东西。
text.completion: To think, they've been right under our noses!  I'll put my deathguards on alert... this will NOT happen again.

english.title: Annihilate the Worgen
english.objectives: Find and kill 5 Worgen Infiltrators within Brill.
english.description: These worgen must be dealt with, and quickly.  Our first priority is to eliminate any which may have infiltrated Brill.$b$bI want you to be on the lookout for any suspicious activity here in Brill, $n.  We know that these worgen can hide in the shadows, so look for any signs you can find... footsteps, kicked-up rocks... anything.
english.completion: To think, they've been right under our noses!  I'll put my deathguards on alert... this will NOT happen again.

text.title: 末日草
text.objectives: 收集10株末日草。
text.description: 我的信使刚刚给我送来一捆阴暗草。见鬼的阴暗草！我不要什么阴暗草，我要的是末日草！你知道我现在的困境，$n。$b$b你如果能帮我，我不会亏待你的。给我带回来足够份量的末日草，我会给你一份合适的报酬。$B$B据我所知，这些植物喜欢生长在乱坟岗附近，污染其他的花花草草。那坟岗子就在布瑞尔墓地的北边。赶紧去吧，记得防备着那里的豺狼人。
text.progress: <The apothecary mutters to himself.>$b$bThey brought me gloom weed?  GLOOM WEED?!
text.completion: Ah, my doom weed. Excellent!$B$B<Apothecary Jerrod rubs his hands together greedily.>$B$BThese will come in quite handy. You've done me, uh, the Lady, a fine service today, $N. As promised, here is the reward that you deserve.

english.title: Doom Weed
english.objectives: Collect 10 Doom Weed.
english.description: My envoy just delivered me a bushel of gloom weed.  Gloom weed!  I don't need gloom weed, I need doom weed!  You can see the predicament that I'm in, $n.$b$bI'll make it worth your while to gather what I need. Bring back to me enough doom weed and I'll give you a suitable reward.$B$BIt is my understanding that they like to plague the flora near the mass gravesite, to the north of the Brill graveyard. Hurry and be mindful of the gnolls in the area.
english.progress: <The apothecary mutters to himself.>$b$bThey brought me gloom weed?  GLOOM WEED?!
english.completion: Ah, my doom weed. Excellent!$B$B<Apothecary Jerrod rubs his hands together greedily.>$B$BThese will come in quite handy. You've done me, uh, the Lady, a fine service today, $N. As promised, here is the reward that you deserve.

text.title: 刮鳞
text.objectives: 获得5枚邪鳍鱼人的鳞片。
text.description: 你在给我收集样本的时候，我的实验让我明白了，要想很好地传播这种新型疾病，就需要更多的素材。毒害倒霉的受害者不过是儿戏。把瘟疫散布到整个世界才有一点挑战性。$b$b我需要附近鱼人身上的几枚鳞片。这些无脑的生物就漫步在北边的海岸上。
text.progress: $N, were you able to obtain those scales from the murlocs?
text.completion: The scales are perfect, $N. Exactly what I needed for this concoction.

english.title: Off the Scales
english.objectives: Obtain 5 Vile Fin Scales.
english.description: While you were collecting samples for me, my experiments led me to realize that more reagents will be required for this new disease to spread properly.  Poisoning some hapless victim is child's play.  Plaguing an entire world proves to be a bit more complicated.$b$bI will need several scales from murlocs in the vicinity.  You will find the creatures ambling brainlessly along the coast to the north.
english.progress: $N, were you able to obtain those scales from the murlocs?
english.completion: The scales are perfect, $N. Exactly what I needed for this concoction.

text.title: 霍兰德的实验
text.objectives: 将霍兰德的神奇饮料带给被俘虏的巡山人。
text.description: 据我了解，又有一个愚蠢的矮人巡山人被俘虏了。亡灵卫兵把他关押在这座建筑里，还派去了一个人来劝说那矮人不要妄想越狱。$b$b你为啥不去看看那矮人是怎么品味我给他专门调制的饮料呢？那饮料里可有黑暗女王意图统治艾泽拉斯世界的秘密。
text.progress: Why if I had my trusted rifle you'd be as good as dead, $C.  Just wait until the Steam Tank Brigade arrives to rescue me!
text.completion: Ah, a drink at last.  What matter of ale is this?  I'm sure it's no Rhapsody Malt but I'll take anything to wet the old whistle at this point.

english.title: Holland's Experiment
english.objectives: Bring Holland's Special Drink to the Captured Mountaineer.
english.description: I am to understand that another one of those foolish Dwarven Mountaineers has just been captured.  The deathguard has him stored here in this building, and they've assigned one of their own to persuade him not to escape.$b$bWhy don't you go see how the Captured Mountaineer enjoys this special drink I made for him?  It contains a subtle hint of what The Dark Lady has planned for the rest of Azeroth.
english.progress: Why if I had my trusted rifle you'd be as good as dead, $C.  Just wait until the Steam Tank Brigade arrives to rescue me!
english.completion: Ah, a drink at last.  What matter of ale is this?  I'm sure it's no Rhapsody Malt but I'll take anything to wet the old whistle at this point.

text.title: 盗墓贼
text.objectives: 杀死腐皮盗墓贼和混血腐皮豺狼人。$B$B弄到6瓶防腐剂。
text.description: 我们西边的森林里有一大片乱坟岗，里面葬着……数量可观的因瘟疫而丧命的提瑞斯法死者。$B$B那边坟墓里的尸体大多没能变亡灵，但最近天灾军团派出了一群腐皮豺狼人到那里去收集尸体，以此来壮大他们的军队。我们不能允许这样的事情发生！$B$B你的任务有两个：杀光躲在乱坟岗和加伦鬼屋里的腐皮豺狼人，并把他们身上的防腐剂抢回来，正是这种防腐剂使他们活过来的。
text.progress: Is your task complete?  Have you destroyed those dog-things and drained them of their ichor?
text.completion: Expertly done, $N.  The Scourge are mistaken if they think they can use those corpses against us, and the fluid you gathered from the Rot Hide slaves will be studied by my master.  It may have secrets we can use against them.

english.title: Graverobbers
english.objectives: Kill Rot Hide Graverobbers and Rot Hide Mongrels, and obtain 6 flasks of Embalming Ichor.
english.description: The mass graves within the forest to the west of us were made to accommodate the... impressive... number of deaths Tirisfal suffered when the plague first came.  $B$BThe bodies in these graves have so far been spared an undeath, but the Scourge now send Rot Hide gnolls to gather the corpses and use them to bolster their armies.  This cannot be allowed!$B$BYour task is twofold: slay the Rot Hides at the mass grave and Garren's Haunt, and gather from them the embalming ichor that gives them life.
english.progress: Is your task complete?  Have you destroyed those dog-things and drained them of their ichor?
english.completion: Expertly done, $N.  The Scourge are mistaken if they think they can use those corpses against us, and the fluid you gathered from the Rot Hide slaves will be studied by my master.  It may have secrets we can use against them.

text.title: 蛆眼
text.objectives: 杀死蛆眼，拿到他的爪子。
text.description: 就算以豺狼人的标准，蛆眼也是只邪恶的野兽。他率领着一票叛变的豺狼人四处横行，摧毁林地，偷盗任何沿途发现的遗骸。$b$b那些遗骸是我们的！它们对我们来说有大用场！$b$b顺着这条路往前，蛆眼占了据路边的一个小屋。快去杀他个措手不及。
text.progress: Yes?
text.completion: Excellent work!  Now if only I can convince Jerrod to let us move our operation into that shack...

english.title: Maggot Eye
english.objectives: Kill Maggot Eye and obtain his paw.
english.description: Maggot Eye is a foul beast, even by gnoll standards.  He leads a band of renegade gnolls through the land, tearing up the glades and stealing whatever corpses he can find along the way.$b$bThose are our corpses!  We had plans for those!$b$bMaggot Eye resides just up the path from us.  Show him no mercy.  Mercy is for the weak.
english.progress: Yes?
english.completion: Excellent work!  Now if only I can convince Jerrod to let us move our operation into that shack...

text.title: 播下恐惧的种子
text.objectives: 追逐12条邪鳍鱼人蝌蚪，直到它们因恐惧而虚脱。
text.description: 貌似杰罗德让你去捕杀北边的鱼人了。很好……我们可以用它们的身体部件来制作毒药。不过，有时我还是有点担心……$b$b邪鳍鱼人的孵化池就在提瑞斯法北部海岸的不远处，因此你可能会在海岸上的成年鱼人中发现几只蝌蚪。要是这些容易受影响的年轻鱼人找我们来复仇……就可以毁了我们。去追赶它们，让它们知道被遗忘者和部落不是好对付的。
text.completion: Did they run from you, $N?  Good.  This is better than killing them... if they live to tell the tale, then future generations of murlocs will learn to fear us.

english.title: Planting the Seed of Fear
english.objectives: Chase 12 Vile Fin Tadpoles until they pass out in fear.
english.description: It seems that Jerrod has you hunting the murlocs to the north.  That's good... we can use their parts for our poisons.  I get a little worried sometimes, though...$b$bThe Vile Fin spawning grounds are not far off Tirisfal's northern coast, so you'll probably notice several tadpoles among the adults on the shore.  If these impressionable young murlocs were to seek revenge against us... that could ruin us.  Go chase them, and show them that the Forsaken and the Horde are not to be trifled with.
english.completion: Did they run from you, $N?  Good.  This is better than killing them... if they live to tell the tale, then future generations of murlocs will learn to fear us.

text.title: 缇甘的部下
text.objectives: 杀死恐齿疾步龙和恐齿镰爪龙，从它们身上收集8张恐齿迅猛龙的皮。
text.description: 嗨，$c！$B$B你这是赶去支援缇甘下士吗？他负责确保物资运输线的畅通。$B$B缇甘指派他手下最顽固的两名矮人监管运送物资。如果你想给这两个古怪的猎人留下深刻印象的话，最好证明自己有能力应付这里的掠食者。$B$B生活在西边的迅猛龙以凶残著称。将几张新鲜的迅猛龙皮交给古克，你就可以在为军队提供供给的同时，让他对你刮目相看了。
text.progress: What is it, $c? This here camp ain't fit for sight-seein'.
text.completion: Hey, you're tougher than you look. These terrortooth hides reflect arrows and turn axe-blades - they don't go down easy, but their hides are worth their weight in silver in these light-forsaken Barrens. Nice work.

english.title: Teegan's People
english.objectives: Kill Terrortooth Runners and Terrortooth Scytheclaws to collect 8 Terrortooth Hides.
english.description: Hey, $c!$B$BAre you headed to support Corporal Teegan? He's in charge of keeping the supply routes open.$B$BHe's got two of the most ornery dwarves I've ever met in charge of sundries. If you want to make an impression on those two crotchety hunters, you're going to need to show that you can hold your own against the predators around here.$B$BThe raptors west of the hold here are especially vicious. Bring Goucho some fresh hides and you'll make an impression while supplying the troops in one swoop.
english.progress: What is it, $c? This here camp ain't fit for sight-seein'.
english.completion: Hey, you're tougher than you look. These terrortooth hides reflect arrows and turn axe-blades - they don't go down easy, but their hides are worth their weight in silver in these light-forsaken Barrens. Nice work.

text.title: 碎沙者
text.objectives: 杀掉碎沙者。
text.description: 我的其他助手将保证咱们骄傲的新同志们乖乖地进到舒服的笼子里，被运到最需要他们的地方去。为了部落。与此同时，我们的计划上还有最后一件事。$B$B砂槌氏族的酋长碎沙者，多半蠢得根本不知道我们在这儿干什么。不过我非常不喜欢做事虎头蛇尾，宝贝儿。他就潜伏在西边的洞窟里。好好干，把他干掉，然后我们就可以完事了，好吗？
text.giverWindow: 砂槌督军。

english.title: Sandscraper
english.objectives: Kill Sandscraper.
english.description: My other assistants are making sure our proud new comrades are put into comfy cages and shipped to where they're needed most. For the Horde. Meanwhile, we've got one last item on our agenda.$B$BSandscraper, the chief of the Dunemaul Clan, is probably too dumb to even be aware of what we're doing here. But I absolutely loathe unfinished business, babe. He's lurking in the den just over there to the west. Knuckle down, take him out, and we'll be good to sign off on this, 'kay?
english.giverWindow: Warlord of the Dunemaul.

text.title: 抢救物资
text.objectives: 从迅猛龙巢穴中取回10只北卫军补给箱。
text.description: <你在尸体上发现一张货物清单，上面详细地罗列着前线急需的各项物资。>$B$B<地上的血迹表明，更多的尸体被拖往了南面的迅猛龙巢穴。>$B$B<说不定迅猛龙也掠走了那些货物。如果夺回物资，或许可以帮助缇甘下士解决困难！>
text.progress: What? My supply caravan was sacked by those cold-blooded scissor-paw things?
text.completion: My supplies! Well, that showed some real initiative, $c. Those rap-saws or whatever they're called have torn lesser men to ribbons. Thank you!

english.title: Scavenged
english.objectives: Retrieve 10 Northwatch Supply Crates from the Raptor Den.
english.description: <You discover a cargo manifest on the body, detailing a long list of sundries urgently needed on the front.>$B$B<A bloody trail in the dirt indicates bodies were dragged south of here, toward the raptor dens.>$B$B<The raptors may have dragged away the supplies, as well. Retrieving those supplies for Corporal Teegan could help salvage this disaster!>
english.progress: What? My supply caravan was sacked by those cold-blooded scissor-paw things?
english.completion: My supplies! Well, that showed some real initiative, $c. Those rap-saws or whatever they're called have torn lesser men to ribbons. Thank you!

text.title: 家族墓穴
text.objectives: 杀死5只哀嚎的先祖和5只腐烂的古尸。
text.description: 磨坊里的阿加曼德家族墓穴最难处理。达高尔队长使用死灵法术让阿加曼德的先祖们都变成了亡灵，准备利用他们来对付我们。$B$B我们绝对不能允许这种事情发生，你必须阻止它。到阿加曼德家族墓穴去，战胜那些还魂的阿加曼德家族先祖。
text.completion: Your actions struck a telling blow against the Scourge.  And your victory will not go unnoticed - not by the Forsaken, nor by our enemies.$B$BContinue the struggle as we all do, $N, and one day the Forsaken will have the dominion over Azeroth that they are owed!

english.title: The Family Crypt
english.objectives: Kill 5 Wailing Ancestors and 5 Rotting Ancestors.
english.description: The strongest point in the mills is the Agamand Family Crypt.  With necromancy, Captain Dargol has raised the ancestors of the Agamands and plans to use them against us.$B$BThis cannot pass, and you must stop it.  Travel to the Agamand Family Crypt and defeat the raised Agamand ancestors.
english.completion: Your actions struck a telling blow against the Scourge.  And your victory will not go unnoticed - not by the Forsaken, nor by our enemies.$B$BContinue the struggle as we all do, $N, and one day the Forsaken will have the dominion over Azeroth that they are owed!

text.title: 磨坊告急
text.objectives: 收集5根锯齿肋骨和3个焦黑的徽记。
text.description: 天灾军团正试图在阿加曼德磨坊这里建立起一座前哨基地。如果他们得逞了，那么他们在提瑞斯法的军事行动将得到有利的支持。$B$B上头已经发话下来了，必须将磨坊那边的天灾军团势力全部清除干净。$B$B从断骨士兵和碎颅士兵身上收集锯齿肋骨，再从暗眼骷髅法师身上收集焦黑的徽记。
text.progress: Our battles with the Scourge wage on, $N.  Do your part and throw those cursed, mindless undead back into the Plaguelands!
text.completion: Your efforts are appreciated, $N.  I will not thank you for doing what is necessary, but I will remember your name.

english.title: The Mills Overrun
english.objectives: Gather 5 Notched Ribs and 3 Blackened Skulls.
english.description: The Scourge are trying to form a base here at the Agamand Mills.  If they do, then they can stage further attacks within Tirisfal.$B$BThe orders have been given.  The Scourge in the Mills must be destroyed.$B$BCollect Notched Ribs from Rattlecage and Cracked Skull Soldiers, and Blackened Skulls from Darkeye Bonecasters.
english.progress: Our battles with the Scourge wage on, $N.  Do your part and throw those cursed, mindless undead back into the Plaguelands!
english.completion: Your efforts are appreciated, $N.  I will not thank you for doing what is necessary, but I will remember your name.

text.title: 与塞弗伦交谈
text.objectives: 跟提瑞斯法林地布瑞尔的执政官塞弗伦谈一谈。
text.description: 我把你交给我的遗物都毁了，$n。没错，所有的遗物，除了这些……$b$b代弗林·阿加曼德生前身体羸弱、牙尖齿利，也是头一个被瘟疫要去了性命的。他作为天灾的奴隶存在了很长时间，比所有人都长。既然如此，他就可能拥有对我们有用的知识。$b$b将他的遗物交给执政官塞弗伦，把我跟你说的告诉他。他会知道该怎么做的。
text.progress: The fetor of Scourge hangs about you, $n.  What is it you seek?
text.completion: Devlin Agamand?  Is that him you carry in your sack there?  Ha!$b$bYes, I know what Coleman wants to try, and I want to try it too.  I hope you're prepared, $N.

english.title: Speak with Sevren
english.objectives: Speak with Magistrate Sevren at Brill in Tirisfal Glades.
english.description: I have destroyed the remains you've given me, $n.  That is, all remains except for these...$b$bDevlin Agamand was weak and sharp-tongued in life, and was among the first to succumb to the plague.  He existed as a slave of the Scourge for a long time, longer than most.  As such, he may possess knowledge that would be of value to us.$b$bBring his remains to Magistrate Sevren, and tell him what I've told you.  He'll know what to do.
english.progress: The fetor of Scourge hangs about you, $n.  What is it you seek?
english.completion: Devlin Agamand?  Is that him you carry in your sack there?  Ha!$b$bYes, I know what Coleman wants to try, and I want to try it too.  I hope you're prepared, $N.

text.title: 虚弱的掌握
text.objectives: 跟布瑞尔的暗影牧师玛利亚谈一谈，然后参与代弗林·阿加曼德的意志唤醒。
text.description: 巫妖王在冰封王座里进入了休眠，他对天灾亡灵的掌控也变得前所未有地虚弱。即使是代弗林·阿加曼德这种弱者，我们也应该能够彻底移除巫妖王对他的控制。$B$B跟镇子东边庄园里的暗影牧师玛利亚谈一谈。她会帮助你完成唤醒过程。
text.completion: Ah, how unfortunate.  Perhaps the Scourge's dominion over Devlin's mind remained too strong.  Or perhaps our methods are simply not strong enough.  It's also possible that Devlin was too simple-minded to comprehend what we were asking him.

english.title: The Grasp Weakens
english.objectives: Speak with Shadow Priestess Malia in Brill and participate in the extraction of Devlin Agamand.
english.description: While the Frozen Throne lies dormant, the grasp that the Lich King once held over the Scourge grows ever-weaker.  His grip on a weakling like Devlin Agamand should be weak enough that we can remove it entirely.$B$BSpeak with Shadow Priestess Malia in the manor on the east side of town.  She will assist you in the procedure.
english.completion: Ah, how unfortunate.  Perhaps the Scourge's dominion over Devlin's mind remained too strong.  Or perhaps our methods are simply not strong enough.  It's also possible that Devlin was too simple-minded to comprehend what we were asking him.

text.title: 东边……又是东边
text.objectives: 去找提瑞斯法林地亡灵壁垒的高级执行官德灵顿。
text.description: 你帮了我们很多忙，$n，但别的地方仍需要你的才能。$b$b在东边有一座亡灵壁垒：一面抵挡瘟疫之地天灾的铜墙铁壁。它让我们不受天灾的侵扰，让我们能够安稳地在提瑞斯法林地建立自己的部队。$b$b去吧，去找高级执行官德灵顿谈谈。他是我们的盟友，他会对你的协助倍感欣慰。
text.completion: <The High Executor sizes you up.>$b$bNot much of a $c, are you?  Well, you will be when I'm done with you.

english.title: East... Always to the East
english.objectives: Report to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.
english.description: You've done much for us here, $n, but $g men: women; of your caliber are needed elsewhere.$b$bTo the east lies the Bulwark: a fortified barricade against the ravages of the Plaguelands.  The Bulwark protects us from Scourge invasions, and has allowed us enough sanctity to build up our forces here in Tirisfal Glades.$b$bGo, speak with High Executor Derrington.  He is an ally, and will doubtless appreciate whatever aid you can give him.
english.completion: <The High Executor sizes you up.>$b$bNot much of a $c, are you?  Well, you will be when I'm done with you.

text.title: 肮脏的动物
text.objectives: 杀死6只乱齿清道夫。
text.description: 在来的路上，你大概已经闻到了乱齿清道夫散发的臭味——他们比老脏鬼佩蒂还要难闻。一群没用的野兽！他们偷取我们的猎物，随意翻动我们的物资，更糟糕的是……他们一点也不好吃。$B$B去杀掉几只吧。$B$B如果你乐意的话，可以再多杀一些。
text.completion: Ooooo-oooh aye! The best Hecklefangs are the dead ones.

english.title: Filthy Animals
english.objectives: Kill 6 Hecklefang Scavengers.
english.description: You probably caught wind of some of them Hecklefang scavengers on the way in - they reek worse than ol' Durty Pete here. Worthless animals! They steal our kills, rummage through our supplies, and worse... they ain't good for eatin'.$B$BGo kill some.$B$BThen kill some more, if you want to.
english.completion: Ooooo-oooh aye! The best Hecklefangs are the dead ones.

text.title: 与血色十字军的战争
text.objectives: 杀死3名血色狂热者和4名血色苦行修士。
text.description: 尽管血色十字军的力量已经衰弱了，但我们之间的战争没有结束。执行官阿伦的报告显示，血色十字军们一直在瓦松队长的指挥下从提瑞斯法东南方向的废塔中发动进攻，那座塔就在巴尼尔农场旁边。$b$b去杀死3名他的狂热者和4名苦行修士。这一定会给血色十字军以沉重的打击！
text.progress: I see you have returned but your task is not complete.  Perhaps you are at ease with the mere humans interfering with The Dark Lady's plan?  Or perhaps you can heed the call of duty and slay the Scarlet band that lies only moments away!
text.completion: Your actions will slow down the Scarlet Crusade's advancement in Tirisfal quite a bit... hopefully for good.  But other threats loom.

english.title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade
english.objectives: Slay 3 Scarlet Zealots and 4 Scarlet Friars.
english.description: Though the strength of the Scarlet Crusade wanes, we are still at war.  The report Executor Arren sent me indicates Scarlet Crusaders have been raiding from the ruined tower in southeastern Tirisfal near the Balnir Farmstead under the command of Captain Vachon.$b$bKill 3 of his zealots and 4 of his friars. It should prove to be a devastating blow to the Crusade!
english.progress: I see you have returned but your task is not complete.  Perhaps you are at ease with the mere humans interfering with The Dark Lady's plan?  Or perhaps you can heed the call of duty and slay the Scarlet band that lies only moments away!
english.completion: Your actions will slow down the Scarlet Crusade's advancement in Tirisfal quite a bit... hopefully for good.  But other threats loom.

text.title: 致命的新盟友
text.objectives: 在提瑞斯法林地血色营地寻找你的新盟友。
text.description: 就在你到达亡灵壁垒之前，一个不寻常的年轻女亡灵来找过我。她对血色十字军极度仇视，因此我就派她到北边去对付我们的敌人了。你说你早些时候见到了几个死掉的十字军？那些可能就是她的杰作。$b$b去找找她，看你是不是能帮她解决对十字军的宿仇……要是说她已经把他们都杀光了，那我可一点儿都不奇怪。
text.completion: As you look over the ruins of the camp, you hear a whisper behind you.$b$b<"I could kill you right now if I wanted to.  You'd better watch your step, $r.">

english.title: A Deadly New Ally
english.objectives: Look for your new ally at the Scarlet Encampment in Tirisfal Glades.
english.description: Shortly before you arrived at the Bulwark, I was approached by the most unusual young undead woman.  She swore enmity against the Scarlet Crusade, so I sent her to work on our enemies to the north.  You say you saw some dead crusaders earlier?  Those were probably her work.$b$bGo check up on her, and see if she can use any assistance in her vendetta against the Crusade... though I wouldn't be surprised if she's already killed them all.
english.completion: As you look over the ruins of the camp, you hear a whisper behind you.$b$b<"I could kill you right now if I wanted to.  You'd better watch your step, $r.">

text.title: 又大又好的东西
text.objectives: 跟提瑞斯法林地亡灵壁垒的提摩西·卡宁汉谈一谈。
text.description: 亡灵壁垒这里已经没什么功绩可供你创造的了，$n。你已经做得够多。但是，银松森林里或许有更多的冒险在等待你。$b$b跟我的蝙蝠管理员提摩西·卡宁汉谈一谈。他会带你飞往布瑞尔，免费。
text.completion: Sure, I'll give you a ride.  If High Executor Derrington asks for it, then technically I have to.

english.title: To Bigger and Better Things
english.objectives: Speak with Timothy Cunningham at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.
english.description: There isn't much more glory for you here on the Bulwark, $n.  You've done enough already.  There may, however, be further adventures waiting in Silverpine Forest.$b$bSpeak with my bat man, Timothy Cunningham.  He'll give you a ride to Brill, free of charge.
english.completion: Sure, I'll give you a ride.  If High Executor Derrington asks for it, then technically I have to.

text.title: 飞向天空
text.objectives: 跟提瑞斯法林地布瑞尔的执行官塞加德谈一谈。
text.description: 如果你回到布瑞尔，你也许可以顺路拜访一下执行官塞加德，我听说银松森林南部发生了点有意思的事。他知道的比我清楚。$b$b你如果做好了出发的准备，就再跟我谈一谈。
text.completion: Welcome back, $N.  I've heard stories from the east.  Who would have thought that a young $r $c like you would have been the one to wipe out the last whimpering remnants of the Scarlet Crusade?

english.title: Take to the Skies
english.objectives: Speak with Executor Zygand at Brill in Tirisfal Glades.
english.description: If you're headed back to Brill, you'll want to stop by Executor Zygand on your way out.  I hear there's some excitement going on in Silverpine Forest, to the south.  He'll know more than I do.$b$bSpeak with me again when you're ready to head out.
english.completion: Welcome back, $N.  I've heard stories from the east.  Who would have thought that a young $r $c like you would have been the one to wipe out the last whimpering remnants of the Scarlet Crusade?

text.title: 一点点活力
text.objectives: 获得4份邪恶夜行蜘蛛的毒液。
text.description: <迪瑟斯检验了他新制的药剂。>$b$b嗯……还不到位。里面还需要能够稍稍带来点活力的东西。我明白了！北边蜘蛛身上的强力毒液就可以。你看是不是能帮我去提取一些来，$n？
text.progress: Do you have some venom from a Vicious Night Web Spider yet, $N?  It's the final component I need in order to test my experiment.
text.completion: Ah, this venom will do perfectly, $N.  Everything else has been added to my concoction and boiled down.  Thank you, $c!

english.title: A Little Oomph
english.objectives: Obtain 4 samples of Vicious Night Web Spider Venom.
english.description: <Dithers samples his latest concoction.>$b$bHmm... this isn't quite there.  It needs something to give at a little more zing.  I've got it!  The spiders to the north have a potent venom that'll do the trick.  See if you can extract some for me, $n?
english.progress: Do you have some venom from a Vicious Night Web Spider yet, $N?  It's the final component I need in order to test my experiment.
english.completion: Ah, this venom will do perfectly, $N.  Everything else has been added to my concoction and boiled down.  Thank you, $c!

text.title: 碎沙者的财宝
text.objectives: 跟梅格斯·碎纸机谈一谈。
text.description: 在碎沙者巢穴深处的风化石头箱子里，你找到一件奇异的神器。$B$B样子像是一只甲虫，表面光洁湛蓝，镶着金边。看起来是机械的，但不像是凡人的手工所制，而且年代久远。$B$B梅格斯可能会对它感兴趣。

english.title: Sandscraper's Treasure
english.objectives: Talk to Megs Dreadshredder.
english.description: Inside this weathered stone chest at the back of Stonescraper's lair, you find a curious artifact.$B$BShaped like a beetle, its surface is a smooth, brilliant blue, lined with gold. It looks mechanical, but unlike anything you've seen crafted by mortal hands, and very old.$B$BMegs will probably be interested in this.

text.title: 野猪人的惨叫
text.objectives: 任意杀死8名刺背刀刃卫士或变异织棘者，并从变异织棘者那里取回一根棘刺之杖。
text.description: “野猪人”是卡利姆多的本土物种之一。这种浑身长刺的小混蛋足以让我憎恨这片大陆了。$B$B前线营地建好没多久，他们就乌泱泱地来滋事。更糟糕的是，生活在这片荆棘林中的野猪人数量也太庞大了吧。我要你击退他们，以便我们再次与前线指挥官取得联系。$B$B顺便从野猪人施法者手中夺得一根扭曲的棘杖，我感觉那玩意儿就是用来操控这片丛林的扩张度的。
text.progress:
I should mention, you're probably going to need a machete to hack through this mess.

This jungle came out of nowhere!
text.completion:
<Corporal Teegan nods as you deliver your report, then grasps the Bramblestaff with both hands.>

So, this is what the quilboar are using against us? Do you think they used these to create this jungle?

english.title: Make 'em Squeal
english.objectives: Kill any combination of 8 Bristleback Bladewardens or Deviate Thornweavers, and collect a Bramblestaff from one of the Thornweavers.
english.description: One of the native species in Kalimdor is the 'quilboar.' Prickly little buggers. Reason enough to hate this continent.$B$BThe raids started shortly after we established our forward camps. Worse, those spiny fiends seem to thrive in this thorny hell of a jungle. I need you to help beat them back so we can re-establish contact with Forward Command.$B$BWhile you're out there, acquire one of those twisted branches their casters seem to be using to manipulate the jungle growth...
english.progress:
I should mention, you're probably going to need a machete to hack through this mess.

This jungle came out of nowhere!
english.completion:
<Corporal Teegan nods as you deliver your report, then grasps the Bramblestaff with both hands.>

So, this is what the quilboar are using against us? Do you think they used these to create this jungle?

text.title: 古老的障碍
text.objectives: 摧毁6个砂石魔像。
text.description: 数年来，这道峡谷都被一扇坚不可摧的大门封闭着。现在，巨大的灾变把门震塌了，里面的秘密正在等着我们去探索。$B$B不过路上还有一些障碍。古老的泰坦造物已经醒来，从门里蜂拥而出。它们毫无目的地在沙漠中游荡，攻击任何敢于靠近的人。$B$B得找个人去除掉那些在峡谷中巡逻的魔像。你觉得自己能行吗？

english.title: Ancient Obstacles
english.objectives: Destroy 6 Sandstone Golems.
english.description: For years, this valley has been sealed behind impenetrable gates. Now that the cataclysm has torn them down, the secrets within are ours to discover.$B$BThere are yet some obstacles in the way. From within the gates, the bygone creations of the titans have awoken. They wander aimlessly across the sand, attacking any who approach.$B$BSomeone needs to destroy the golems patrolling the valley; are you up to it?

text.title: 安多伦会知道
text.objectives: 把神器交给观察者之谷的安多伦·晨光。
text.description: 仔细听好，$n。我不知道那些食人魔是怎么拿到它的，但这是一件泰坦神器。我不是专家，不过光这一点就足以让它比咱们脚下的沙子还要历史悠久。$B$B我也知道这样的东西只会带来麻烦。我不想和它扯上关系。把它带到南边的观察者之谷里去，交给一个叫做安多伦·晨光的血精灵。别问任何问题，宝贝儿，拜托了。

english.title: Andoren Will Know
english.objectives: Deliver the artifact to Andoren Dawnrise at the Valley of the Watchers.
english.description: Listen carefully, $n. I don't know how those ogres got ahold of it, but that thing's a titan artifact. I'm no expert, but just that fact alone makes it probably older than the sand we're standing on.$B$BI also know that things like this are nothing but trouble. I don't want anything to do with it. Take it south, to the Valley of the Watchers, and give it to a blood elf named Andoren Dawnrise there. And don't ask any questions, babe, please.

text.title: 所有权
text.objectives: 击败10名矮人考古学家。
text.description: 不只是我们发现了南月废墟的价值。探险者协会的矮人也蜂拥至此，为联盟攫取着神器和碑文。$B$B我想我不用再做解释了。我们不允许这里的发现落入联盟之手。尽你所能击败矮人，把他们赶出废墟！

english.title: Laying Claim
english.objectives: Kill 10 Dwarven Archeologists.
english.description: We are not the only ones who have discovered the value of the Southmoon Ruins. The dwarves of the Explorers' League have swarmed there, taking artifacts and inscriptions for the Alliance.$B$BI don't think I have to explain much further. We will not allow the discoveries here to fall into the hands of the Alliance. Slay as many dwarves as you can, and drive them from the ruins!

text.title: 语言的碎片
text.objectives: 收集5份远古符文碑刻。
text.description: 在东边的南月废墟里，我们有了新的发现。我的同事找到了一些石头碎片，上面刻有古代的文字，它们最近才因为流沙的移动而显露出来。$B$B这些文字是我们没有见过的语言，但是它们与我们在其它泰坦废墟中看到的文字有相似之处。如果能破译这些文字，就可以解开许多秘密。$B$B不幸的是，我的同事忙于保护石板不被联盟夺走，所以我要派你去南月废墟，亲自收集那些石板。

english.title: Fragments of Language
english.objectives: Collect 5 Ancient Hieroglyphs.
english.description: At the Southmoon ruins, just east of here, we've made some finds. My colleagues have found stone shards, engraved with ancient writings, newly exposed by the shifting sands.$B$BThe writings are in no known tongue, though they bear resemblance to markings we've seen on other ruins of the titans. Deciphering them could reveal many more secrets.$B$BUnfortunately, my colleagues are also busy defending the tablets from the Alliance. I need you to go to the Southmoon ruins and retrieve the tablets yourself.

text.title: 魔精饥渴症
text.objectives: 从沙怒巨魔身上收集6团粘稠的魔精。
text.description: 为了能在恶劣的沙漠生存，沙怒巨魔必须知晓所有关于魔精的秘密。你喝了魔精，就会有力量……最黑暗的巫毒，不是吗？不过没有退缩的余地。$B$B假如我们想找到宝剑，就需要魔精。你真走运，玛佐加是个叛徒，是吧？这里山丘上都是成群的沙怒巨魔。$B$B去给玛佐加弄点魔精来……很多魔精……然后我们就可以举行仪式找到迦萨斯。
text.progress: Ya ain't been drinkin' it yaself, eh? I need all of it...
text.completion: <Mazoga gathers the pile of blood in his hands and raises it to his mouth. It liquifies and pours gorily down his throat.>$B$BDey drink de blood, dey get de power. I drink dere blood...$B$B<Mazoga gives you a wide, blood-smeared grin.>

english.title: Blood to Thrive
english.objectives: Collect 6 Fistfuls of Blood from Sandfury Trolls.
english.description: To survive in de harsh desert, de Sandfury had to learn all de secrets of blood magic. You drink de blood, you get de power...darkest voodoo, yah? But dere be no room for holdin' back out here.$B$BIf we gonna find de sword, we need blood. Lucky for ya, Mazoga be a traitor, yah? And dere be plenty of Sandfury trolls wanderin' over de hills dere.$B$BGo an' get Mazoga blood...plenty of blood...and we make de ritual to find Jang'thraze.
english.progress: Ya ain't been drinkin' it yaself, eh? I need all of it...
english.completion: <Mazoga gathers the pile of blood in his hands and raises it to his mouth. It liquifies and pours gorily down his throat.>$B$BDey drink de blood, dey get de power. I drink dere blood...$B$B<Mazoga gives you a wide, blood-smeared grin.>

text.title: 失败的和谈
text.objectives: 从蔓生绿洲的野猪人手中救回盖恩斯大使。
text.description: 我早就警告过盖恩斯大使这法子行不通了，但是他坚持认为自己能促成与野猪人的同盟，共同对抗部落。即便谈判成功，我也不想跟这些……猪人并肩战斗。$B$B果不其然，盖恩斯一直没有回来。他是我们最好的谈判专家之一，如果盖恩斯被那些野蛮的野猪人干掉的话，恐怕霍索恩将军要拿我问责了。$B$B进入丛林，找到并营救盖恩斯大使，如果他还活着的话。
text.completion:
Good work. Gaines passed through here not long ago on his way to Northwatch and a warm bath.

The mission wasn't a total loss, though. We've learned a good deal about these quilboar and their leadership structure.

Now we can handle things ... MY way.

english.title: A Failure to Communicate
english.objectives: Rescue Ambassador Gaines from the quilboar in the Overgrowth.
english.description: I told him he was a fool, but Ambassador Gaines insisted he could negotiate an alliance with the quilboar against the Horde. Even if he succeeded, I for one wouldn't want to fight with those ... pig-men at my side.$B$BWell, Gaines hasn't returned, and General Hawthorne will hold me accountable if I lose one of our best negotiators to these squealing savages.$B$BLocate the Ambassador in this steaming mess of a jungle and rescue him if he's still alive.
english.completion:
Good work. Gaines passed through here not long ago on his way to Northwatch and a warm bath.

The mission wasn't a total loss, though. We've learned a good deal about these quilboar and their leadership structure.

Now we can handle things ... MY way.

text.title: 老朋友
text.objectives: 跟失落群岛酋长瞭望台的萨尔谈一谈。
text.description: 好啦，赶紧爬上梯子吧。我们得离开这里！$B$B我们会途经胶囊镇，然后就送你去见几位老朋友！
text.completion: I told you we would meet again, $N.$B$B<The Warchief gives you an appraising look.>$B$BUnfortunate that it's under such dire circumstances.

english.title: Old Friends
english.objectives: Speak with Thrall at the Warchief's Lookout on the Lost Isles.
english.description: Alright then, grab onto the ladder. We gotta get outa here!$B$BWe'll make a flyby of the town, and then I'm gonna get you to some old friends!
english.completion: I told you we would meet again, $N.$B$B<The Warchief gives you an appraising look.>$B$BUnfortunate that it's under such dire circumstances.

text.title: 击退伞兵
text.objectives: 杀死10名联盟伞兵。
text.description: 朋友，联盟的部队跟我们撞了个正着。我们击沉了他们的战舰，但是飞机还在将第127巡山人部队的伞兵源源不断地投放到下面的海滩上。$B$B士兵们已经疲惫不堪了，只能死守两条斜坡，防止他们冲上来。如果你愿意伸出援手的话，我相信很快就能扭转战局了。
text.progress: There are yet more Alliance paratroopers that need to be dispatched if we're to get about the business of escaping from this island, $N.
text.completion: I've not seen a finer display of $c prowess.

english.title: Repel the Paratroopers
english.objectives: Slay 10 Alliance Paratroopers.
english.description: The Alliance have caught back up with us at just the wrong moment, my friend. We took care of their ships, but they still have planes that are dropping their vaunted 127th Paratroopers onto the coast below.$B$BIt's all that the battlesworn and scouts can do to hold the two ramps against their overwhelming numbers. I'm certain that if you were to aid them, the tide would quickly be turned.
english.progress: There are yet more Alliance paratroopers that need to be dispatched if we're to get about the business of escaping from this island, $N.
english.completion: I've not seen a finer display of $c prowess.

text.title: 反击者桑萨斯
text.objectives: 击败扎卡鲁，获得被封印的桑萨斯。
text.description: 灵魂说话了。我能感到它在沙中流淌……浸透在死亡中，痛苦的沙漠……$B$B<玛佐加的眼睛都翻白了。>$B$B找到了！灵魂去向了南方，进入了由骨头形成的山谷。扎卡鲁！扎卡鲁，玛卡里的后裔，渴求牺牲的黑暗者……他的父亲从祖尔法拉克被赶出来，他的升腾仪式受到了干扰……他将再度尝到灵魂的味道……$B$B<玛佐加瘫了下来。>$B$B去，$c。扎卡鲁拿着桑萨斯。相信我，你不会愿意让他拥有这武器的。
text.progress: Did the spirits speak true, mon? You got it?
text.completion: <Mazoga grins as he takes the sword from you in both hands.>$B$BDidn't like ya much, eh? More in this world craves blood than just trolls, mon.$B$BLet's find the other blade...
text.giverWindow: 玛卡里的后裔

english.title: Sang'thraze the Deflector
english.objectives: Defeat Zakkaru and collect the Sealed Sang'Thraze.
english.description: The blood speaks. I can feel its flow through the sand...drenched in death, a desert of suffering...$B$B<Mazoga's eyes roll back in his head.>$B$BThere! The blood flows to the south, in a valley of bones. Zakkaru! Zakkaru, spawn of Makkari, the dark one who demands sacrifice... his father forced from Zul'Farrak, his ascension interrupted... he will taste blood once more...$B$B<Mazora reels.>$B$BGo, $c. Zakkaru has Sang'thraze. Ya not be wanting him to keep it, trust me.
english.progress: Did the spirits speak true, mon? You got it?
english.completion: <Mazoga grins as he takes the sword from you in both hands.>$B$BDidn't like ya much, eh? More in this world craves blood than just trolls, mon.$B$BLet's find the other blade...
english.giverWindow: Zakkaru, spawn of Makkari.

text.title: 至黯魔精
text.objectives: 从沙怒僵尸身上收集6份至黯魔精。
text.description: 迦萨斯在逃避我，伙计……光有普通的魔精是不够的。我们需要更强劲的东西才能找到它。$B$B当你需要所有的巨魔同舟共济才能勉强度日的时候，同伴的阵亡就是一个大麻烦，伙计，这就是为什么沙怒巨魔要学习如何用巫毒让死人复生的原因。你倒下去了，然后又站起来继续工作……直到永远！$B$B我们制造的僵尸附着最黑暗的魔精。你可以到西边找到一大堆僵尸，给我弄点魔精来，行吗？
text.progress: You got de stuff, mon?
text.completion: <Mazoga tilts his head back and inhales the clumps of mysterious material. His eyes flash.>$B$BPowerful stuff, mon... ah, if ya could see what I see now... mebbe you go try it yaself sometime.$B$BThe spirits call...

english.title: Darkest Mojo
english.objectives: Collect 6 Darkest Mojo from Sandfury Zombies.
english.description: Jang'thraze eludes me, mon... de blood is not enough. We gonna need somethin' stronger to find it.$B$BWhen you need every troll you got to help out to scrape by, one o' them dyin' on ya is a big problem, mon, an' dat's why de Sandfury learned to raise our dead wit' da voodoo. You fall over, you just get back up again and keep workin'... forever!$B$BDe zombies we make be imbued wit' darkest mojo. You go on to de west an' find a whole mess o' dem, an' get me dat mojo, yah?
english.progress: You got de stuff, mon?
english.completion: <Mazoga tilts his head back and inhales the clumps of mysterious material. His eyes flash.>$B$BPowerful stuff, mon... ah, if ya could see what I see now... mebbe you go try it yaself sometime.$B$BThe spirits call...

text.title: 你轻轻地走了，不带走一根棘刺
text.objectives: 对蔓生绿洲的三瓣牙使用荆刺之杖，并杀死她身边的2名变异野猪人巫师。
text.description: 根据盖恩斯大使的情报，野猪人的女族长叫做“三瓣牙”。她对丛林中的荆棘施加了邪恶的法术，以达到自己不可告人的目的。她还下令把盖恩斯“撕成碎片并丢进蔓生绿洲去”。真是个有气势的女王。$B$B我们要让她自食恶果。带上棘刺之杖，用它除掉三瓣牙。然后杀死受训中的变异野猪人巫师，确保没有人继承她的族长之位。
text.progress: I can see why the Horde hates these little nuisances. Have you taken on Three-Tooth yet?
text.completion:
...Torn limb from limb!? Well, I'd almost feel bad but the burning hatred gets in the way. She got what she deserved.

<Corporal Teegan takes the Bramblestaff and snaps it over his knee.>
text.giverWindow: 使用棘刺之杖反射她的魔法。

english.title: You Flicked a Fine Vine to Leaf Me
english.objectives: Use the Bramblestaff on Three-Tooth and kill her 2 Deviate Crones in the Overgrowth.
english.description: According to Gaines, "Three-Tooth" is what the quilboar call their matriarch. She's been twisting the thorns of this crazy jungle to her own ends, and it was her orders that Gaines be "torn apart and fed to the overgrowth." Nice lady.$B$BLet's give her a taste of her own. Take the Bramblestaff you recovered, and use it on Three-Tooth to take her out of the picture. Then kill the crones she's been training, to ensure nobody else can take her place.
english.progress: I can see why the Horde hates these little nuisances. Have you taken on Three-Tooth yet?
english.completion:
...Torn limb from limb!? Well, I'd almost feel bad but the burning hatred gets in the way. She got what she deserved.

<Corporal Teegan takes the Bramblestaff and snaps it over his knee.>
english.giverWindow: Use the Bramblestaff to turn her magic against her.

text.title: 地面的威胁
text.objectives: 从蔓生绿洲中的初生的花朵上收集10个不寻常的花芽。
text.description: 缇甘竟然以为这片突然冒出来的绿洲是野猪人干的，真是愚蠢的想法。看看四周吧。我每天都在观察这些植株的花朵和嫩芽，它们的变异状况一代比一代严重。这肯定不是野猪人氏族的烂魔法，而是某种原始的力量。原始而可怕的力量。$B$B前天，一位伟大的德鲁伊曾路过我们的营地。去丛林深处寻找纳拉雷克斯吧。$B$B记得在蔓生绿洲中采集一些植株样本给他以便研究。
text.progress: I am very busy, $c. This uncontrolled growth threatens to engulf the continent. Do you have any news?
text.completion: Ah, samples from different parts of the overgrowth? These will be immensely helpful, yes. Thank you, $c.

english.title: Trouble From the Ground Up
english.objectives: Gather 10 Unusual Flower Buds from Budding Flowers in the overgrowth.
english.description: Teegan's a fool to think the quilboar caused this sudden overgrowth. Look around you. I've been watching these plants bloom and sprout daily - each generation is more mutated than the last. This isn't tribal magic - it's something primal. And dangerous.$B$BThe day before last a great druid passed through our camp. Seek out Naralex, somewhere in the midst of this jungle. He'll know what to do.$B$BAnd bring him some plant samples from around the overgrowth to help his studies.
english.progress: I am very busy, $c. This uncontrolled growth threatens to engulf the continent. Do you have any news?
english.completion: Ah, samples from different parts of the overgrowth? These will be immensely helpful, yes. Thank you, $c.

text.title: 阿加曼德家族
text.objectives: 弄到格里高的遗物、妮萨的遗物、萨尔曼的遗物和代弗林的遗物。
text.description: 阿加曼德家族曾是提瑞斯法林地中最富有的家族。我过去曾在他们的磨坊里工作……当然，我是说在瘟疫降临之前。$B$B天灾军团入侵的时候，阿加曼德家族的人们加固了他们的庄园，并说服了在他们家做工的人留下来帮助他们抵抗天灾军团。我们实在是太蠢了，但我们至少是愚蠢而忠诚。$B$B而阿加曼德家族用荣耀之类的幌子让我们去送死，结果现在他们倒成了天灾军团的走狗！$B$B为了被遗忘者，你必须去剿灭堕落于瘟疫之中的阿加曼德家族！把表明他们身份的遗物带回来给我。
text.progress: Do you have the remains of the Agamands?  Are those cursed beasts finally destroyed?
text.completion: Revenge has a sweet taste, don't you think?  When you destroyed the Agamands, did you catch any hint of free will within them?  I hope so.  I hope they knew fear before they were smashed into oblivion.$B$BIt is a foolish hope, I know.  But it is a hope I foster nonetheless.

english.title: Deaths in the Family
english.objectives: Obtain Gregor's Remains, Nissa's Remains, Thurman's Remains, and Devlin's Remains.
english.description: The Agamand family was the most prosperous family in Tirisfal Glades.  I used to work their mills...before the plague.$B$BWhen the Scourge first came, the Agamands fortified their home and convinced those in their employ to remain and help them defend.  We were fools, but at least we were loyal fools.$B$BThe Agamands, in their pride, doomed us to undeath.  And now they are minions of the Scourge!$B$BServe the Forsaken by defeating the Agamands who fell to the plague.  Serve me by bringing me their remains.
english.progress: Do you have the remains of the Agamands?  Are those cursed beasts finally destroyed?
english.completion: Revenge has a sweet taste, don't you think?  When you destroyed the Agamands, did you catch any hint of free will within them?  I hope so.  I hope they knew fear before they were smashed into oblivion.$B$BIt is a foolish hope, I know.  But it is a hope I foster nonetheless.

text.title: 闹鬼的磨坊
text.objectives: 将达高尔的徽记带给阿加曼德磨坊的库勒曼·法席恩。
text.description: 你感受到了徽记中传来的一股邪恶气场。库勒曼·法席恩也许会对这感兴趣。

english.title: The Haunted Mills
english.objectives: Bring Dargol's Skull to Coleman Farthing at the Agamand Mills.
english.description: You sense a malign presence coming from within the skull of the beast.  Coleman Farthing may be interested in seeing this.

text.title: 前往磨坊
text.objectives: 去找提瑞斯法林地阿加曼德磨坊的库勒曼·法席恩。
text.description: 西边的阿加曼德磨坊已经被天灾占领了。阿加曼德一家遭到了杀害，整座房子都被天灾占据。$b$b这可能是提瑞斯法最大的天灾哨站，$n。如果你觉自己是个$c，就去和那里的库勒曼·法席恩谈谈。他在尽全力收复失地，他需要帮助。沿着这条路，你就能找到他。
text.completion: Argh!  Get back!  Oh, you're not Scourge, are you?$b$bThank the Banshee Queen that you're here.  I've greatly underestimated how bad it's gotten up here.

english.title: Head for the Mills
english.objectives: Report to Coleman Farthing at Agamand Mills in Tirisfal Glades.
english.description: The Agamand Mills, to the west, have been lost to the Scourge.  The Agamand family has been slain, and the entire residence has been claimed by the Scourge.$b$bThis is probably the largest Scourge outpost in Tirisfal, $n.  If you think you're enough of a $c, head up there and speak with Coleman Farthing.  He's been doing his best to take the land back, and he'll need help.  Just follow this road, it'll take you right to him.
english.completion: Argh!  Get back!  Oh, you're not Scourge, are you?$b$bThank the Banshee Queen that you're here.  I've greatly underestimated how bad it's gotten up here.

text.title: 绿洲的秘密
text.objectives: 寻找保护者迦萨斯。
text.description: 是的，我看到另一半了，伙计……就在南边……$B$B我们近了，伙计。它在一个绿洲里，就埋在水里的淤泥里。别耽搁了！
text.completion: Mazoga? He's taken the sword? That filthy...$B$B<Trenton glowers for a moment.>$B$BAt least you escaped with your life. The Lasher's bite is a vicious one.

english.title: Secrets in the Oasis
english.objectives: Search for Jang'thraze the Protector.
english.description: Yes, I see the other half now, mon...to the south...$B$BWe be close now, mon. It's in an oasis, buried in de muck beneath de water. Don't delay!
english.completion: Mazoga? He's taken the sword? That filthy...$B$B<Trenton glowers for a moment.>$B$BAt least you escaped with your life. The Lasher's bite is a vicious one.

text.title: The Red Messenger
text.objectives: Kill Meven Korgal, the messenger, at the Crusader camp, and obtain any information you can find.
text.description: Reports from my superiors in Brill indicate that an agent of the Scarlet Crusade was dispatched from the Scarlet Monastery and sent here to Deathknell. According to the reports, the messenger possesses important information on his person. I do not have further details, but whatever it is, we must have it!$b$bYou're the most qualified person I have to send, $n. Find that messenger and bring me whatever information you can find.
text.completed: Return to Executor Arren at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.

english.objectives: Kill Meven Korgal, the messenger, at the Crusader camp, and obtain any information you can find.

According to the reports, the messenger possesses important information on his person. I do not have further details, but whatever it is, we must have it!$b$bYou're the most qualified person I have to send, $n. Find that messenger and bring me whatever information you can find.
