text.title: 上前线！
text.objectives: 在南贫瘠之地的前线指挥站找到盖恩斯大使。
text.description: 我很想让你留在后方，但是前线传来了征召令。你还记得盖恩斯大使吗？他调去了前线指挥站，并希望你能前去协助他执行一项新任务。$B$B前线指挥站坐落在南面的平原上，当然现在我们称那里为“鲜血平原”。$B$B诸事小心，$n。部落在沿途设伏，有好几位官员遭到了袭击。
text.completion: Ah, $N! I've been talking you up to the General here. Thank you again for saving my life.
text.completed: 去南贫瘠之地的前线指挥站找盖恩斯大使。

english.title: To the Front!
english.objectives: Locate Ambassador Gaines at Forward Command in Southern Barrens.
english.description: I'd love to keep you here behind the lines, but it looks like you've been summoned to the front. Ambassador Gaines - remember him? - has relocated to Forward Command and in his latest missive he's requested you, personally, to assist him.$B$BYou'll find our Forward Command operation south of here, in what's become known as the "Fields of Blood."$B$BBe careful, $n. The Horde has taken to ambushing some of our officers en route.
english.completion: Ah, $N! I've been talking you up to the General here. Thank you again for saving my life.
english.completed: Locate Ambassador Gaines at Forward Command in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 突破防线
text.objectives: 与佐奴恩交谈，前往恶鳞海湾，然后找到莫拉基。
text.description: 沃金已经下令对那些占据我们北方岛屿的纳迦展开全面攻击。我们有许多战士在桥边与他们交战，但另有一小批部队正在突破他们的防线，直接进攻他们的岛屿。$B$B跟那边的佐奴恩谈谈，让他送你到岛上去。抵达之后就去找哨所队长莫拉基。他会给你委派具体任务。

english.title: Breaking the Line
english.objectives: Speak to Jornun to secure a ride to Spitescale Cove and then seek out Morakki.
english.description: Vol'jin be callin' for an all out attack on da naga that have taken over our northern isle. Many of our men were already engaged with their forces near da bridge, but several of us are breakin' through their lines ta assault their isle itself.$B$BSpeak to Jornun right 'ere to secure a ride to da isle. Once there, seek out Morakki, da Captain of da Watch. He will be tellin' ya how ya can aid in da battle.

text.title: 缇甘的麻烦
text.objectives: 向南贫瘠之地缇甘远征军营地的缇甘下士报到。
text.description: 如果海军司令得知北方城堡安然渡过难关的话，应该会很高兴吧。但是想要坚守阵地，我们必须开辟一条连接内陆的供给线。$B$B缇甘下士负责与前线指挥官的联络事宜，开战前他送来了一份奇怪的报告。他说他在“丛林”里遇到了麻烦。贫瘠之地哪来什么丛林啊！$B$B沿着往上的道路离开北方城堡，看看你能不能帮帮这位固执的下士。
text.completion:
So, Paxton says there's no jungle in the Barrens? What do you call THIS!?

I've got a pile of supplies to move to the interior and my camp has been overrun by a forest that - I swear - grows by the hour!
text.completed: 向南贫瘠之地缇甘远征军营地的缇甘下士报到。

english.title: Teegan's Troubles
english.objectives: Report to Corporal Teegan at Teegan's Expedition in Southern Barrens.
english.description: The Admiral will be pleased that Northwatch is almost secured, but if we're to keep a grip on this continent we're going to need to maintain the supply lines to the interior.$B$BJust before the assault I received the strangest of reports from Corporal Teegan, who's in charge of maintaining our contact with Forward Command. Says he's having trouble with the "jungle?" There's no jungle in the Barrens!$B$BFollow the upper road out of Northwatch and see if you can render any assistance to our wayward Corporal.
english.completion:
So, Paxton says there's no jungle in the Barrens? What do you call THIS!?

I've got a pile of supplies to move to the interior and my camp has been overrun by a forest that - I swear - grows by the hour!
english.completed: Report to Corporal Teegan at Teegan's Expedition in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 捉螃蟹
text.objectives: 杀死一些小海浪蟹，收集5份新鲜的螃蟹肉。
text.description: 我这老朽的身躯是越来越挑剔啦，但是野猪肉对我来说的确是有点难以下咽。也许新来的伙计们可以吃下那东西。$B$B我们放置了一些捕蟹器，不过如果你能容忍一个没多少耐心的老头，能不能现在就帮我弄些新鲜的螃蟹肉来尝尝？岛上到处都是螃蟹，但最佳的狩猎地点是东边的海滩。
text.progress: Da sea be offerin' few boons as delicious as fresh crawler meat.
text.completion: Oi! Tasty, mon. Thank ya for your great kindness, young one. Da spirits shall surely be regardin' ya with great favor.

english.title: Crab Fishin'
english.objectives: Kill Pygmy Surf Crawlers and collect 5 Fresh Crawler Meat.
english.description: Perhaps me agin' body is just growin' too picky after all dese years, but boar meat just ain't goin' down easy no more. More for da new recruits I be thinkin'.$B$BWe just set out some crab traps, but if ya be willin' ta help an impatient old troll, I'd love ta have some fresh crawler meat right now. Dey're all around da island, but da best spot ta be huntin' them is off da eastern coast.
english.progress: Da sea be offerin' few boons as delicious as fresh crawler meat.
english.completion: Oi! Tasty, mon. Thank ya for your great kindness, young one. Da spirits shall surely be regardin' ya with great favor.

text.title: 葛尔多的任务
text.objectives: 收集3根阴暗草，把它们交给布瑞尔的初级药剂师霍兰德。
text.description: 主人需要草。我们的手太大，没有办法捡。你可以帮我们，我们不伤害你。我们需要阴暗草。这里有许多这样的草，路边也有。$B$B拿到草之后，把它交给我的主人，布瑞尔的霍兰德。
text.progress: Where's that useless abomination? Either you have what I need or you'd best get out there and find it.
text.completion: What's this? Gloom weed?! I've no need for gloom weed! That mindless mass of flesh is out there picking daisies and convincing the Lady knows how many dupes like you into doing the same. No offense.$b$bWe'll deal with the gloom weed later.  For now, we've got other matters to discuss.

english.title: Gordo's Task
english.objectives: Collect 3 Gloom Weed and deliver them to Junior Apothecary Holland in Brill.
english.description: Master want weeds. Us gots big hands and not good at picking. You help us and we not hurt you. Us need gloom weed. Many weeds around here and near road.$b$bWhen you have gloom weed you take to Master Holland in Brill.
english.progress: Where's that useless abomination? Either you have what I need or you'd best get out there and find it.
english.completion: What's this? Gloom weed?! I've no need for gloom weed! That mindless mass of flesh is out there picking daisies and convincing the Lady knows how many dupes like you into doing the same. No offense.$b$bWe'll deal with the gloom weed later.  For now, we've got other matters to discuss.

text.title: Have You Seen Anything Weird Out There?
text.objectives: Speak with Executor Zygand about your encounter with the worgen.
text.description: $R!  Listen up, I got somethin'... odd to discuss.$b$bI was out fishin' by Brightwater Lake when I saw the darnedest thing... some sorta wolf-man, running around Tirisfal.  Ya don't suppose that could be a... worgen, do ya?$b$bAnyway, I keep tellin' myself I should tell Executor Zygand about it, but I just get so scared when I talk to that guy.  Maybe you could talk with him?
text.completion: Hmm... yes, that makes sense.  Since the worgen have come streaming out of Gilneas, I knew it would only be a matter of time before they arrived here in Tirisfal.

english.title: Have You Seen Anything Weird Out There?
english.objectives: Speak with Executor Zygand about your encounter with the worgen.
english.description: $R!  Listen up, I got somethin'... odd to discuss.$b$bI was out fishin' by Brightwater Lake when I saw the darnedest thing... some sorta wolf-man, running around Tirisfal.  Ya don't suppose that could be a... worgen, do ya?$b$bAnyway, I keep tellin' myself I should tell Executor Zygand about it, but I just get so scared when I talk to that guy.  Maybe you could talk with him?
english.completion: Hmm... yes, that makes sense.  Since the worgen have come streaming out of Gilneas, I knew it would only be a matter of time before they arrived here in Tirisfal.

text.title: 狮子的尊严
text.objectives: 任意杀死5名只野徘徊者或原野傲鬃狮。
text.description: 狮子，$n！凶猛的捕食者。它那优雅的线条……发达的肌肉和锋利的爪子……追逐猎物时……爆发出的原始野性……$B$B抱歉，我走神了。我是说，我非常欣赏这些狮子，但是它们谋杀了好几个巡逻兵。没错，就是谋杀。现在，士兵们天黑之后都不敢独自去洗澡了。你能帮助我们维护营地的安全吗？$B$B贫瘠之地的狮群通常栖息在大树下。
text.completion:
Nice work! How was it? Did you enjoy the hunt?

Did you run through tall grasses, the scent of your prey urging you forward, until you leapt at its throat, adrenaline surging as your slavering fangs... Well, something like that.

english.title: Lion's Pride
english.objectives: Kill any combination of 5 Plains Prowlers or Plains Pridemanes.
english.description: Respect the lion, $n! A ferocious killer. You gotta admire the elegance of the beast... Muscle and claws... Running down its food... So primal...$B$BI'm sorry, my mind wandered. As I was saying, I respect these lions, but they're just murder on our patrols. I mean that literally. The men are afraid to go to the bathroom alone at night. Can you help make our camp a little safer?$B$BBarrens lions like to linger under trees.
english.completion:
Nice work! How was it? Did you enjoy the hunt?

Did you run through tall grasses, the scent of your prey urging you forward, until you leapt at its throat, adrenaline surging as your slavering fangs... Well, something like that.

text.title: 填饱肚子
text.objectives: 杀死南贫瘠之地的雷角蜥蜴，收集4块新鲜的雷角蜥蜴肉排。
text.description: 所谓兵马未动，粮草先行。我们的军队已经行进了很长一段路。$B$B我在想，如果弄几只笨拙的大蜥蜴来烤烤，就可以满足数周的肉食供给了。$B$B雷角蜥蜴体型庞大，行动迟缓，应该很容易捕杀。不过……嘿你身上没带家伙吗？
text.progress:
<Trawley licks his lips, barely able to constrain his drool.>

You get my steaks yet? Nice and bloody?
text.completion:
<Sam's eyes bug out of his head as you slam the huge slabs of meat before him.>

Oh yeah... oh ... YES! I'll have mine raw. I suppose I can grill some up for the others... How would you like yours?

english.title: Marching On Our Stomachs
english.objectives: Collect 4 Fresh Stormsnout Steaks by killing Stormsnouts in Southern Barrens.
english.description: It's true what they say: An army marches on its stomach. And we've been marching a long way.$B$BI'm thinking if we barbecue up a few of those giant lumbering stormsnouts, we'll have enough meat to feed us for weeks.$B$BStormsnouts are big and slow, so they should be easy to kill. Except... Hey you're not carrying any metal on you are you?
english.progress:
<Trawley licks his lips, barely able to constrain his drool.>

You get my steaks yet? Nice and bloody?
english.completion:
<Sam's eyes bug out of his head as you slam the huge slabs of meat before him.>

Oh yeah... oh ... YES! I'll have mine raw. I suppose I can grill some up for the others... How would you like yours?

text.title: 鲜血旷野
text.objectives: 去南贫瘠之地的鲜血旷野，杀死10名凄凉蛮兵。
text.description: 部落开始把这块区域称为“鲜血旷野”。这是一个别名：因为是我的勇士们用鲜血染红了这里的草木。$B$B我派了侦查巡逻队去击垮野猪人，并打探部落军队的动向，但他们没能全身而退。他们需要你的支援。$B$B去巡查战场，然后找到那些给我们带来无尽悲痛的凄凉蛮兵。别指望他们会投降；他们的酋长教导他们要血战到死。
text.completion: Very good. We may never drive the Horde completely from these lands, but with a strong presence we can undermine their will to fight.

english.title: Fields of Blood
english.objectives: Kill 10 Desolation Grunts at the Fields of Blood in Southern Barrens.
english.description: The Horde has taken to calling this region the "Fields of Blood." It's an apt name: these reeds run red with the blood of some of my best men.$B$BI've sent out recon patrols to crush the quilboar and report on the Horde troop movements, but not all of them return. They could use your support out there.$B$BPatrol the fields and seek out the Desolation Grunts that are causing us so much grief. Do not expect them to surrender; their Warchief has instructed them to fight to the death.
english.completion: Very good. We may never drive the Horde completely from these lands, but with a strong presence we can undermine their will to fight.

text.title: 另一种形式的外交
text.objectives: 带上挑战之角前往南贫瘠之地的刺背挑战之环。吹响号角，向刃鼻发起挑战并杀死他。
text.description: 我永远也忘不了在那片丛林里经历的恐怖遭遇，我差一点就死在野猪人手里了。将军下令向野猪人发动了战略进攻，就在我们有机会彻底灭绝野猪人氏族的关键时刻，他却终止了攻击行动。我可没有这样的顾忌。$B$B这是我在谈判时“借来”的号角，在刺背挑战之环中吹响它。这座斗技场就在此地以西，你肯定能找到。我要你单挑野猪人的武士刃鼻。在他的同伴面前杀死他，让残余的野猪人陷入无尽的恐慌。
text.progress: Sabersnout! Is he dead? What's the news?
text.completion:
A "Boarpocalypse," you say? These animals certainly have a unique idea of "Single combat!"

No matter, you've done well. With the quilboar in chaos I should have no trouble convincing the field commanders to execute any strays they find scurrying about. The General need not know we've stepped up the campaign... it's for the better.
text.giverWindow: 吹响挑战号角并单挑刃鼻。

english.title: Diplomacy By Another Means
english.objectives: Take the Horn of Challenge to the Bristleback Challenge Ring in Southern Barrens. Blow the horn to challenge Sabersnout and kill him.
english.description: I have not forgotten my brush with death at the hands of the quilboar in that filthy jungle. The General here has ordered some tactical strikes, but he stops short of genocide. I have no such qualms.$B$BTake this horn that I 'borrowed' during my negotiations. Blow the horn within the Bristleback challenge ring west of our position - you can't miss it. I want you to challenge the champion of the Bristleback, Sabersnout, to single combat. His death in front of his followers will leave them in utter chaos.
english.progress: Sabersnout! Is he dead? What's the news?
english.completion:
A "Boarpocalypse," you say? These animals certainly have a unique idea of "Single combat!"

No matter, you've done well. With the quilboar in chaos I should have no trouble convincing the field commanders to execute any strays they find scurrying about. The General need not know we've stepped up the campaign... it's for the better.
english.giverWindow: Blow the Horn of Challenge to engage Sabresnout.

text.title: 寸土必争
text.objectives: 夺取鲜血旷野中的一座中立丘陵，然后在那里抵御部落的反击。
text.description: 从战略上来说，控制一个区域需要持续不断的侦查。你来看地图－－我已经划定了一些战略性的丘陵，和这个类似，联盟必须保持对这里的控制才能让敌人受制于我们。$B$B我的探子已经在战场上标记了它们的位置。我现在需要有人来带头夺取它们，你自然是干这活的最佳人选。$B$B去陶拉祖废墟的北边、东边和南边找到中立的灰色旗帜。夺取并守住它！
text.completion:
Your report, $c?



Incredible, $N! You're a real asset to the Alliance. I'll see to it that my men follow your example!

english.title: A Line in the Dirt
english.objectives: Capture a neutral hill in the Fields of Blood and defend it against a Horde counter-attack.
english.description: Strategically, control of a region requires constant observation. See here on this map - I've identified a number of strategic hills, similar to this one, that the Alliance must acquire if we are to keep the enemy under our thumb.$B$BMy scouts have already marked their location on the field. What I need is someone to spearhead their capture, and you're the $gman:woman; for the job.$B$BSeek out neutral grey flags on hills to the north, east, and south of the Taurajo Ruins. Capture one and defend it!
english.completion:
Your report, $c?



Incredible, $N! You're a real asset to the Alliance. I'll see to it that my men follow your example!

text.title: 女儿的拥抱
text.objectives: 把莉莉安·沃斯带到十字军小径她父亲的高塔里去。
text.description: 那声音继续低语道：$b$b<“我的名字叫做莉莉安·沃斯。生前我是血色十字军的成员。我的父亲高阶牧师沃斯把我作为对抗被感染者的武器养大。我钻研潜行、法术、武术，任何能让我变得更强的学问。我为了他放弃了我的童年。”>$b$b<“然后，命运所致，我死了，变成了……这个样子。我的父亲立刻把我忘记，当我回去的时候，他命令将我处决。”>$b$b<“来吧。我们现在要跟他谈谈，他就在西北边的塔里。”>
text.completion: From birth to grave to undeath, we all have our own path to follow.  Some are easier than others.  It sounds like this Voss girl has had a rough path so far.$b$bHopefully she ultimately chooses to join us and follow the Dark Lady.  With power like hers, we could do incredible things.$b$bBy the way, $N... excellent work out there.  If you're ever ready and willing, I may have some more work for you in the Plaguelands.

english.title: A Daughter's Embrace
english.objectives: Bring Lilian Voss to her father in the tower at Crusader's Run.
english.description: The whisper continues:$b$b<"My name is Lilian Voss.  Before I died, I was a member of the Scarlet Crusade.  My father, High Priest Voss, raised me to be a weapon against the plagued.  I studied stealth, sorcery, martial arts, anything to make myself stronger.  I gave up my childhood for him.">$b$b<"Then, as fate would have it, I died and returned as... this.  My father instantly forgot me and, when I returned, ordered me executed.">$b$b<"Come.  We will speak with him now, in his tower to the northwest.">
english.completion: From birth to grave to undeath, we all have our own path to follow.  Some are easier than others.  It sounds like this Voss girl has had a rough path so far.$b$bHopefully she ultimately chooses to join us and follow the Dark Lady.  With power like hers, we could do incredible things.$b$bBy the way, $N... excellent work out there.  If you're ever ready and willing, I may have some more work for you in the Plaguelands.

text.title: 破损的黑豹雕像
text.objectives: 运用你的技能和材料，修复破损的雕像。
text.description: 这只破损的雕像被它的主人扔掉了。不过，只要有合适的材料，再加上你的珠宝加工技能，就可以完全修复它。

english.title: Broken Panther Figurine
english.objectives: Repair the broken figurine using your skill and materials.
english.description: This badly broken figurine was discarded by its last owner.  However, with the right materials and your skill in jewelcrafting, it could be completely restored.

text.title: 海边打捞
text.objectives: 收集7份热砂补给品。
text.description: 如果你想说服诺格弗格先生让更多的侏儒搬进来，我们就得让他看看我们有多好才行！我有个点子。$B$B加基森正处于海盗的封锁之下，不过许多被打下船的货物并没有遭到损毁……它们只是被冲走了。大多数都漂到了镇子南边的浅滩上。$B$B要是你能帮他们把补给收集起来，就能让我们交上朋友！而且还能阻止那刻薄的地精姑娘把东西拿去卖。
text.progress: Do you have a whole buncha boxes? Let's see!
text.completion: Most of this looks just fine! How lucky!$B$BThe Steamwheedle goblins will be so happy to see their cargo back safe and sound. And here's a reward for your good deeds, of course!$B$BWe've got lots of other stuff to do though! Busy busy!

english.title: Seaside Salvage
english.objectives: Collect 7 Steamwheedle Supplies.
english.description: If we want to convince Mister Noggenfogger to let us move more gnomes here, we've got to show him just how nice we are! I know just the thing.$B$BGadgetzan's under blockade by pirates, but plenty of the goods that get blown off the ships survive intact... they just wash away. Most of them wash up in the shallows just south of town.$B$BIf you could go collect those supplies for them, it'd help us make friends! And it'll keep that mean goblin girl over there from taking them and selling them.
english.progress: Do you have a whole buncha boxes? Let's see!
english.completion: Most of this looks just fine! How lucky!$B$BThe Steamwheedle goblins will be so happy to see their cargo back safe and sound. And here's a reward for your good deeds, of course!$B$BWe've got lots of other stuff to do though! Busy busy!

text.title: 踩水坑
text.objectives: 杀死8名潮行巨人。
text.description: 这里有个大麻烦！海洋淹过来其实挺好的，因为现在船能直接开到加基森。不过如今一帮恶心的海洋巨人在朝镇子进发！我敢肯定，如果咱们把他们处理掉，诺格弗格先生一定会感谢咱们的。$B$B别担心，我不会叫你去做白干活的志愿者！把他们除掉，我给你赏钱！
text.completion: Oh, it's going to be so much nicer around here now that they're gone!$B$BAt least until more show up. But thank you!

english.title: Puddle Stomping
english.objectives: Kill 8 Tidal Striders.
english.description: There's a big problem here! It's great that the ocean came in so far, because now ships can get to Gadgetzan. But now there's a bunch of nasty old sea giants encroaching on the town! I'm sure Mister Noggenfogger would appreciate us taking care of them for him.$B$BDon't worry, I won't ask you to do it just out of the goodness of your heart! Take care of them and I'll give you a reward!
english.completion: Oh, it's going to be so much nicer around here now that they're gone!$B$BAt least until more show up. But thank you!

text.title: 火箭营救
text.objectives: 把救生火箭交给5名热砂港幸存者，用炸弹杀死40名南海封锁者。
text.description: 大水冲进来的时候，东边的热砂港就被淹了，不少可怜的地精还困在那儿！如今这些该死的海盗要把每一艘离开港口的船只击沉。$B$B但他们不会想到我们能飞！码头上有只热气球。我们可以用它飞过去，营救地精们，并顺便处理一下海盗。诺格弗格先生会高兴的！$B$B到码头去登上气球，我紧随其后，好吗？我得弄些火箭……
text.completion: That was great! It looks like most of the goblins we helped made it back here and didn't blow up. We really showed that goblin girl!$B$BHere's a special reward for you, $gmister:miss;.

english.title: Rocket Rescue
english.objectives: Deliver Liferockets to 5 Steamwheedle Survivors and use bombs to kill 40 Southsea Blockaders.
english.description: When the water came in, Steamwheedle Port to the east was flooded, and a lot of poor goblins are still stuck there! Now those mean pirates are shooting at any boat that leaves the docks here.$B$BBut they won't expect us to fly! There's a hot air balloon by the docks. We can use that, fly over to rescue the goblins, and take care of the pirates, too. Mr. Noggenfogger will be so pleased!$B$BGo to the docks and hop in the balloon and I'll be right behind you, okay? I've got to get some rockets...
english.completion: That was great! It looks like most of the goblins we helped made it back here and didn't blow up. We really showed that goblin girl!$B$BHere's a special reward for you, $gmister:miss;.

text.title: 黑雾灭绝
text.objectives: 在黑雾洞穴里摧毁8枚黑雾之卵。
text.description: 占据西北边黑雾洞穴的蜘蛛，对我们来说是另一个严重威胁。食人魔倒不是对付不了它们，但在塞拉摩的部队潜伏于附近的时候把我们的注意力分散出去，将是一个致命的错误。$B$B我需要有人能到黑雾洞穴里去把它们的卵毁掉，这样就能根除这一祸害。你可以在结满蛛网的矿洞最深处找到那些卵……还有它们的守护者。

english.title: Darkmist Extermination
english.objectives: Destroy 8 Darkmist Eggs in Darkmist Cavern.
english.description: The spiders that occupy Darkmist Cavern to the northwest are another vicious threat to us here. They are nothing the ogres cannot handle, but splitting our attention to them when Theramore's forces lurk nearby is a deadly mistake.$B$BI need someone to destroy the eggs inside Darkmist Cavern, to cut off this infestation. You will find the eggs in the deepest part of the webbed mines... along with their guardians.

text.title: 加基森海盗：亡灵宝藏
text.objectives: 杀死15名南海海盗。
text.description: 天哪，你也看到了，这里即将会有一场与海盗的大战。我们要尽全力保证他们不再骚扰加基森……或者是我们侏儒的新家！$B$B杀掉他们就行。$B$B那么帮帮我们如何？我们真的得把那绿鼻子和她可怕的强盗杀掉才可以。我会万分感激你的！
text.completion: Good job! We're really cleaning up around here!

english.title: Dead Man's Chest
english.objectives: Kill 15 Southsea Pirates.
english.description: Well gosh, as you can plainly see there's this really big battle with these pirates here going on. We're doing our best to make sure they never bother Gadgetzan or our new gnomish homes there ever again!$B$BBy killing them.$B$BSo how about helping us? We really wanna make sure we kill more than green-nose over there and her awful thugs. I'd really appreciate it!
english.completion: Good job! We're really cleaning up around here!

text.title: 夷为平地！
text.objectives: 用灼烧的朗姆酒点燃西北小屋、东北小屋，以及西南小屋。
text.description: 跟你说吧，这地方如果不是又旧又脏而且还有海盗肆虐的话，倒是可以成为我们侏儒的一个不错的新家！我们正在处理海盗的问题，但是脏乱的问题也要解决。$B$B我是说，有点自尊的侏儒都不会住在像这么丑的茅舍里！因此呢，拿上这个朗姆酒燃烧瓶，把那些难看的小屋都给我们烧掉！
text.completion: Isn't that just so pretty to watch?

english.title: To The Ground!
english.objectives: Use the Burning Rum to set fire to the Northwest Shack, the Northeast Shack, and the Southwest Shack.
english.description: You know, this place would probably make a great home for us gnomes if it wasn't so old and dirty and full of pirates! We're taking care of the pirates problem, but the awful and dirty problem needs fixing.$B$BI mean, no self-respecting gnome would ever live in such an ugly hovel like these buildings! So here, take this bottle of flaming rum and go burn those ugly shacks down for us!
english.completion: Isn't that just so pretty to watch?

text.title: 抢宝贝
text.objectives: 获得10份海盗赃物。
text.description: 这些海盗真是暴殄天物，竟然把金银财宝随地乱扔。其中有些东西是完全可以用来制作成实用的东西的！比如说熔制成金属线或是内生防护体，又或者卖给那些喜欢把金子买来供起的守财奴们。$B$B说到守财奴，我敢肯定那些视财为命的地精想把它们都抢走。我们不能让他们得逞！为了诺莫瑞根，去把那些财宝拿回来！
text.progress: I hope you don't think you're hiding any for yourself, silly! These goggles can see right through your bags.$B$BAnd your armor.
text.completion: Fantastic! Gosh, this will make enough wire for an entire army.$B$BLucky us!

english.title: Lootin' Plunder
english.objectives: Collect 10 pieces of Pirate Loot.
english.description: It's just really so wasteful that all these pirates have golden treasures lying around. Some of this stuff could be used for practical things! Like melting into wire, or intrinsic shielding matrices, or selling to other stupid races that buy gold just to keep it around.$B$BAnd speaking of other stupid races, I bet those greedy goblins are going to be taking all of it. We can't let that happen! Go collect that treasure for Gnomeregan!
english.progress: I hope you don't think you're hiding any for yourself, silly! These goggles can see right through your bags.$B$BAnd your armor.
english.completion: Fantastic! Gosh, this will make enough wire for an entire army.$B$BLucky us!

text.title: Subduing the Elements
text.objectives: Gavan Grayfeather wants you to use the elemental sapta and cleansing totem from the Earthen Ring supplies to subdue 20 Agitated Earth Spirits.
text.description: The elements are restless, $c.  The earthquakes that plague the land and threaten to collapse Ironforge are not normal.  The Earthen Ring are convinced that we must put the elements to rest before they tear Azeroth apart.  We need your help, $n.$b$bI will give you a bag of Earthen Ring supplies.  In it you will find two items, elemental sapta and a cleansing totem.  Use the sapta to see into the elemental world.  Then use the cleansing totem to subdue the agitated earth spirits.

english.title: Subduing the Elements
english.objectives: Gavan Grayfeather wants you to use the elemental sapta and cleansing totem from the Earthen Ring supplies to subdue 20 Agitated Earth Spirits.
english.description: The elements are restless, $c.  The earthquakes that plague the land and threaten to collapse Ironforge are not normal.  The Earthen Ring are convinced that we must put the elements to rest before they tear Azeroth apart.  We need your help, $n.$b$bI will give you a bag of Earthen Ring supplies.  In it you will find two items, elemental sapta and a cleansing totem.  Use the sapta to see into the elemental world.  Then use the cleansing totem to subdue the agitated earth spirits.

text.title: 可怕的灰熊
text.objectives: 获得5张染病褐熊的毛皮。
text.description: 你看到西边染病的褐熊了吗？那些皮……那么恶心，那么病态，那么……实用！$b$b给我弄5张来。我有个主意，可以制造出万无一失的抗天灾毒药来！
text.progress: Let's see... do you have enough hides?
text.completion: Dithers, you've done it again!  These are perfect.

english.title: Grisly Grizzlies
english.objectives: Obtain 5 Plagued Bruin Hides.
english.description: Have you seen the plagued bruins that wander to the west of here?  Those hides... so hideous, so diseased, so... perfect!$b$bFetch me 5 of them.  I've got an idea for an anti-Scourge poison that's guaranteed to succeed!
english.progress: Let's see... do you have enough hides?
english.completion: Dithers, you've done it again!  These are perfect.

text.title: 铐上他们
text.objectives: 跟陶拉祖废墟的陶拉祖强夺者谈一谈并逮捕他们。使用北卫军镣铐逮捕5名受伤的强夺者。
text.description: $n，征召暴风城监狱中非暴力型罪犯这一政策的弊端已经暴露，给我们造成了不少麻烦。在陶拉祖之战获胜后，某些目无法纪的士兵居然擅离职守，四下掠夺城里的财物。$B$B这是藐视军规的恶行。更糟糕的是，他们的行为遭到了敌人激烈的反抗；而我们的最终目标是达成和平。$B$B带上这些镣铐，让陶拉祖强夺者受到正义的制裁。你最好先跟他们谈谈，必要的时候就使用武力。
text.progress: Is the Taurajo situation under control?
text.completion:
Well done, $N. Several of the looters have already crawled back, requesting clemency. I'll let them stew for a bit in the Northwatch brig.

Thank you for helping maintain discipline in the ranks. It is important for our army to be perceived as soldiers, not common bandits.

english.title: Clap 'Em In Irons
english.objectives: Speak to the Taurajo Looters in the Taurajo Ruins and place them under arrest. Use the Northwatch Manacles to subdue 5 wounded looters.
english.description: Our policy of conscripting non-violent criminals from the Stormwind Stockades has come back to haunt us, $n. Some of my less-scrupulous soldiers broke ranks after our victory in Taurajo and are looting the remains of the city.$B$BThis is a breakdown in discipline. Worse, the desecration of their homes only spurs the enemy to fight harder when our ultimate goal should be peace.$B$BTake these manacles and bring the Taurajo looters to justice. Speak to them first, but you may need force to subdue them.
english.progress: Is the Taurajo situation under control?
english.completion:
Well done, $N. Several of the looters have already crawled back, requesting clemency. I'll let them stew for a bit in the Northwatch brig.

Thank you for helping maintain discipline in the ranks. It is important for our army to be perceived as soldiers, not common bandits.

text.title: 以地精的方式拆除地雷
text.objectives: 引爆10枚地雷。
text.description: 矮人伞兵在海滩上埋下了很多地雷！$B$B酋长问我能不能设法拆除那些地雷。我说“绝对没问题啊！”。带上这袋手榴弹，站在安全距离外引爆地雷吧。$B$B这就是地精的方式啊！
text.completion: Score one for the goblins! Stupid dwarves and gnomes.

english.title: Mine Disposal, the Goblin Way
english.objectives: Detonate 10 Land Mines.
english.description: The paratroopers have mined the beach!$B$BThe Warchief asked me if there's anything we can do about that. I told him, 'You bet we can!'. I was thinking maybe you could take this satchel of grenades and detonate the land mines from a safe distance?$B$BIt's how we do things, right?!
english.completion: Score one for the goblins! Stupid dwarves and gnomes.

text.title: 陶拉祖的情报
text.objectives: 在陶拉祖废墟搜寻3份陶拉祖情报。
text.description: 将军居然还在专心处理陶拉祖强夺者的事情。真是愚蠢！我们应该将注意力转移到继续对付部落才对。$B$B如果陶拉祖废墟被彻底焚毁的话，我们很可能会失去一批有价值的情报。在你为将军跑腿期间，留意一下废墟中的地图或是书页。我知道一点点兽人语，应该可以看懂你找到的情报。
text.progress: Have you searched the ruins yet?
text.completion:
What have you dug up for me? Hmm. Interesting. This notice from Orgrimmar indicates a change in Horde leadership is underway - I guess heads are going to roll after what we did to Taurajo.

What's this? A death warrant for the General here! This is good to know... Very good to know...

english.title: The Taurajo Briefs
english.objectives: Search the Ruins of Taurajo for 3 pieces of Taurajo Intelligence.
english.description: The General is too preoccupied with the looters in Taurajo. Too soft! We ought to be focused on our next move against the Horde.$B$BThere's valuable intelligence that might be compromised if we allow the ruins of Taurajo to continue to burn. While you're running the General's errand, dig around for any maps or notes you can find. I can speak a little of the orcish tongue - I'll be able to make sense of what you find.
english.progress: Have you searched the ruins yet?
english.completion:
What have you dug up for me? Hmm. Interesting. This notice from Orgrimmar indicates a change in Horde leadership is underway - I guess heads are going to roll after what we did to Taurajo.

What's this? A death warrant for the General here! This is good to know... Very good to know...

text.title: 定义“疯狂”
text.objectives: 杀死10个疯狂的幸存者。
text.description: 我们收到报告说，一艘地精船只前段时间在该海滩上遇难，幸存者们只能自力更生。我们原本以为那儿的幸存者没多少人，或许和他们谈谈比较妥当。$B$B结果我们发现锈水地精船员都变得疯狂、妄想，极端暴力……比通常情况要更甚。$B$B简而言之，他们不但没用，而且危险。尽我们所能把这些家伙干掉，这对诺莫瑞根来说是最好不过了。

english.title: Define "Crazy"
english.objectives: Kill 10 Crazed Survivors.
english.description: We received reports that a goblin shipwreck occured on this beach some time ago, with the survivors left to fend for themselves. We expected there to be a modicum of survivors, perhaps some even suitable for interrogation.$B$BWhat we found was a crew of Bilgewater goblins who have all become insane, delusional, and maniacally violent...to further degrees than is normally observed, rather.$B$BIn short, they are useless and dangerous. Gnomeregan will be best served by cutting down as many as we can.

text.title: 世界的尽头
text.objectives: 跟钢烁哨站的凯尔希·钢烁谈一谈。
text.description: 嘘！嘿！靠近点，你这蠢货，你是指望让我读心还是——哦。总之过来点！$B$B你在推进诺莫瑞根在此地的计划中，做出了杰出的贡献，朋友！而且还假装你只是为了钱才这么干的，真漂亮。不过现在凯尔希·钢烁需要你的直接帮助。$B$B她还没有开始行动……她让我叫你到遥远南部的天涯海滩去找她。别让她久等了！
text.completion: I'm amazed that Soothfancy was capable of following a simple set of instructions. And ones that required him to keep his foolish mouth silenced as well.$B$BIn addition, it is honestly good to see you again, $n. Now that I've dropped the charade, you'll get to see how gnomes get things done around here.

english.title: Land's End
english.objectives: Talk to Kelsey Steelspark at Steelspark Station.
english.description: Psst! Hey! Come closer, you fool, you expect me to read your mind or--oh. Come closer anyway!$B$BYou've done a wonderful job advancing the agenda of Gnomeregan here, friend! And an amazing job of pretending you were only in it for the coin, simply splendid. But now Kelsey Steelspark could use more of your direct help.$B$BShe's moved on yet again...she asked me to tell you to meet her far south, at Land's End Beach. I wouldn't keep her waiting, either!
english.completion: I'm amazed that Soothfancy was capable of following a simple set of instructions. And ones that required him to keep his foolish mouth silenced as well.$B$BIn addition, it is honestly good to see you again, $n. Now that I've dropped the charade, you'll get to see how gnomes get things done around here.

text.title: 我们来此的目的
text.objectives: 在锈水箱里寻找证据。
text.description: 诺莫瑞根此前得知，部落的锈水地精们在来到杜隆塔尔之前，曾在卡利姆多附近的一座不知名的小岛上遇难。我们本是来调查这些绿皮低能儿能在如此恶劣的条件下得以幸存，到底是借助了什么样的技术与科技。$B$B尽管地精们丧失了心智，但我们还是要查明这里到底发生了什么。在海滩上搜查残骸和私人物品，一有发现就带来给我。

english.title: What We Came For
english.objectives: Search Bilgewater Footlockers for evidence.
english.description: Gnomeregan previously learned that the Bilgewater goblins of the Horde survived a crash on an uncharted island near Kalimdor before arriving in Durotar. We initially came here to investigate what techniques and technology could possibly allow a hopeless pack of green-skinned imbeciles to survive such harsh conditions.$B$BWhile the goblins are at a loss, we still need to find out exactly what happened here. Search the beach for wreckage and belongings and bring anything that appears significant back to me.

text.title: 泥龟一族
text.objectives: 从海浪龟身上获得海龟消化过的钥匙。
text.description: 显然，我们需要找到日志上描述的这件物品。把它从箱子里取出来的这个方法听上去合乎情理，但却十分危险而且不稳定。试图用蛮力打开箱子可能导致灾难性的后果。$B$B幸运的是我们知道钥匙在哪儿……至少，从统计上来说是这样。海滩东边尽头有许多海龟，钥匙可能就在其中一只身上。

english.title: Terrapination
english.objectives: Obtain a Turtle-Digested Key from a Surf Glider.
english.description: We need to obtain the object described in this journal, for certain. Extracting it from a chest would be a feasible matter, but the object itself sounds compromised, and unstable. Attempting to forcefully open the chest could be disastrous.$B$BFortunately, we know where the key is...statistically speaking, at least. There's plenty of sea turtles at the east end of this beach. One of them may hold the key.

text.title: 莫拉亚
text.objectives: 跟莫拉亚谈谈。
text.description: 莫拉亚在找人帮忙解决迅猛龙的问题。如果有机会的话，你应该去找她谈谈。她就在暗矛要塞的另一边。
text.completion: Hey there, hon. Vol'jin sent you? So sweet of him to be thinkin' of me.$B$BI surely could use da help, but ya have a bit more walkin' ahead of ya.

english.title: Moraya
english.objectives: Speak with Moraya.
english.description: Moraya has been lookin' for some help with tha raptors. Ya should talk to her on the other side of Darkspear Hold when ya get a chance.
english.completion: Hey there, hon. Vol'jin sent you? So sweet of him to be thinkin' of me.$B$BI surely could use da help, but ya have a bit more walkin' ahead of ya.

text.title: 你也是吗，蛮兵？
text.objectives: 获得肉脸的箱子。
text.description: 该把事情解决干净了。就我们所推算，这件神秘的物体在日志上所说的一个“聪明”蛮兵手上。我们并不知道这生物到底发生了什么事情，很显然，你要多加小心。$B$B这个……“肉脸”就藏在山丘后面，那里是地精埋死人的地方。找到坟场便是，他应该就在那后面。

english.title: You Too, Brute?
english.objectives: Obtain Meatface's Chest.
english.description: It's time to conclude this matter efficiently. From what we've determined, this mysterious object is in the possession of the "smart" brute described in the journal. We don't know exactly what's happened to this creature, obviously, so you should take caution.$B$BThis... "Meatface" is hiding in the hills, near where these goblins bury their dead. Look for the graveyard and he should be just past it.

text.title: 科赞的骄傲
text.objectives: 击毁10架诺莫瑞根隐形战机。
text.description: 太可笑了！这些侏儒真是不折不挠啊！$B$B地精的宝贝战机可在这儿呢！$n，跳进科赞的骄傲，给他们点颜色瞧瞧！$B$B准备好了就告诉我！
text.progress: What are you doing back here? Get up there and shoot them down!
text.completion: YES!

english.title: The Pride of Kezan
english.objectives: Shoot down 10 Gnomeregan Stealth Fighters.
english.description: This is ridiculous! Those gnomes just don't know when to stop!$B$BGoblin pride is on the line here! $n, you gotta jump into the Pride of Kezan and show them what's what!$B$BLet me know when you're ready!
english.progress: What are you doing back here? Get up there and shoot them down!
english.completion: YES!

objectiveDetails.description: 击毁诺莫瑞根隐形战机

text.title: 雷霆斗技场：巨又霸！
text.objectives: 击败巨又霸。
text.description: 规则很简单：两个男人进去，一个人——等等，有时是女人。$B$B两个人进去，一个人——等等，不，有时不止两个……$B$B好吧，只有一条规则，就是待在机场里！没有别的规则！$B$B你头一个要面对的是废土强盗里最大、最坏的成员。这要么是一场热身赛，要么是一场血战……看你实力了！
text.completed: 去塔纳利斯，找加基森的卡崔娜·特纳尔。

english.title: Thunderdrome: The Ginormus!
english.objectives: Defeat Lord Ginormus.
english.description: The rules are simple: Two men enter, one--wait. Sometimes there's women.$B$BTwo people enter, one--Wait, no, sometimes it's more than two...and that means more than two come out--$B$BAlright, only rule is stay in the drome! There are no other rules!$B$BYou're up against the biggest, baddest member of the Wastewander Bandits first. This'll either be a warmup or a bloodbath...it's up to you which!
english.completed: Return to Katrina Turner at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

text.title: 崩裂的历史
text.objectives: 收集5份土灵珠宝。
text.description: 在这些废墟中游荡的生物是土灵，他们是矮人的远祖。泰坦创造了他们，用来塑造这个世界。$B$B数千年前，原始土灵开始损毁并发生了偏差，这些新近发现的土灵也不例外。我们也许可以利用这些混乱而不稳定的机体。$B$B进入废墟，消灭那些土灵，收集镶嵌在他们身上的珠宝，它们的魔法能量极具研究价值。

english.title: The Crumbling Past
english.objectives: Collect 5 Earthen Jewels.
english.description: The creatures wandering these ruins are Earthen, the ancient ancestors of dwarves, made by the Titans to shape the world itself.$B$BThe original Earthen broke down and went awry thousands of years ago, and these freshly uncovered ones seem no different. We may as well make use of these confused and unstable constructs.$B$BEnter the ruins and destroy the Earthen, and collect the jewels embedded in them; their magical energies will be both valuable and worthy of study.

text.title: 奥丹姆的秘密
text.objectives: 搜索奥丹姆前厅，寻找安然无恙的神器。
text.description: 我们准备好进入前厅了，$n。这是纪念意义的一刻。$B$B根据你带来的手迹来看，我相信这些废墟事实上是奥丹姆的宏伟入口。地震将大门震开，可能也塌方了隧道，不过我们还是可能会在里面发现神奇的宝贝的。$B$B在废墟里寻找任何完好、同时值得研究的东西。发现的快感在等着你！

english.title: The Secrets of Uldum
english.objectives: Search the Antechamber of Uldum for an intact artifact.
english.description: We are ready to enter the antechamber itself, $n. This is a momentous occasion.$B$BFrom the writings you've brought us, I believe these ruins were in fact once the grand entrance to Uldum itself. The quakes that ripped its doors open have probably collapsed the tunnels, but we may yet find amazing things hidden within.$B$BSearch the ruins for anything intact that may be studied.  The thrill of discovery awaits!

text.title: 里面是什么
text.objectives: 击败前厅守卫者。
text.description: 你把手放在箱子上，听到了一阵轻微的晃动声。摩擦运动的声音在你身后回响，箱子开始关闭。$B$B有东西过来了！

english.title: What Lies Within
english.objectives: Defeat the Antechamber Guardian.
english.description: As you lay your hand upon the chest, a faint rumbling can be heard. The sound of grinding movement echoes behind you as the chest begins to shut itself.$B$BSomething is approaching!

text.title: 好地精寥寥
text.objectives: 从哈扎里虫茧中解救8名被俘的地精昆虫学者。
text.description: 我们可不是来这儿扎营与侏儒唱歌、玩弄危险机械的。我的人已经试图清除这个虫巢几个星期了！问题是，我们的人损失严重，虫子占了上风。$B$B不过还好，虫子既不喜欢吃地精，也不喜欢拿我们招待他人，所以谢天谢地，我手下几乎所有人都还困在茧里呢。我要你去把他们救出来。
text.completion: Thanks for the help, this was really killin' things here. Once you start losing men, you start losing manpower. And morale. And weapons. And the magazines you loaned to that one guy.$B$BYou know how it is.

english.title: A Few Good Goblins
english.objectives: Save 8 Captured Goblin Bughunters from Hazzali Cocoons.
english.description: We haven't just been camped here singin' songs with gnomes and playing with dangerous machinery, you know. My men have been trying to clear this hive out for a week now! Problem is, we've taken so many losses by now that the bugs have the advantage.$B$BLucky for us, the bugs either don't like to eat goblins, or they like us so much they save us as treats, because nearly all my men are still cocooned up out there. I need you to go save 'em.
english.completion: Thanks for the help, this was really killin' things here. Once you start losing men, you start losing manpower. And morale. And weapons. And the magazines you loaned to that one guy.$B$BYou know how it is.

text.title: 森金村
text.objectives: 向森金村的加德林大师报到。
text.description: 这么年轻就有这样出色的表现，我相信你将来一定可以闯出自己的天地。$B$B去吧，到西北边去，渡过浅水滩，到森金村去找加德林大师。在你真正进入杜隆塔尔的荒野之前，他可能会给你指派一两个任务。$B$B请记住，$n，我们也许有时无法认同年轻的地狱咆哮，但他的动机毕竟是崇高的，而我们保持与部落的团结也是非常重要的事。让暗矛部族为你感到骄傲吧。

english.title: Sen'jin Village
english.objectives: Report to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.
english.description: You've be doin' quite well for one so young. I've no doubts you'll be makin' quite da name for yarself.$B$BGo now, northwest, across da shallows ta Sen'jin Village. Dere you'll be meetin' Master Gadrin. He'll likely have a task or two for ya before ya truly make ya way out into the Durotar wilds.$B$BPlease remember, $n, we may disagree wit' the young Hellscream at times, but his intentions are noble, and it be very important that we remain united as one Horde. Make da Darkspear proud.

text.title: 在凯旋壁垒碰头
text.objectives: 去找贫瘠之地凯旋壁垒的指挥官罗伯兹。
text.description: 感谢你的帮助，我们终于将局势稳定下来了。现在我们需要将注意力转向南边，转向凯旋壁垒。$B$B凯旋壁垒是我们在贫瘠之地执行任务的关键－－它是连接北方城堡和塞拉摩的重要纽带。$B$B我们分头出发。你去要塞找指挥官罗伯兹，我很快会去那里找你碰头。让我们携手保卫前线吧！
text.completion:
Have you heard? The General never made it!

Killed in the field, like some kind of dog!
text.completed: 去找南贫瘠之地凯旋壁垒的指挥官罗伯兹。

english.title: Meet Me at Triumph
english.objectives: Report to Commander Roberts at Fort Triumph in Southern Barrens.
english.description: Thanks in part to your efforts, we've stabilized the situation here. We need to turn our attention south, to Fort Triumph.$B$BFort Triumph is the keystone of our operation in the Barrens - the vital land-link between Northwatch and Theramore.$B$BI'll pack up and head out separately. Report to Commander Roberts at the fortress and I will see you there soon. Together, we will secure the frontier!
english.completion:
Have you heard? The General never made it!

Killed in the field, like some kind of dog!
english.completed: Report to Commander Roberts at Fort Triumph in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 淘零件
text.objectives: 在南贫瘠之地的战斗之痕中收集8块攻城坦克废料。
text.description: 这些笨重的矮人攻城坦克压根就不适合在战斗之痕中进行近距离战斗。$B$B我这里有点新研究出来的好东西可以拿来小试牛刀，不过在那之前你得给我弄点备用零件来。战斗之痕里搁置着许多残骸。我需要一名有胆量的$c给我拖一架回来。$B$B说的就是你，$n。就是你没跑了。
text.progress: What have you got for me?
text.completion: Oohh look! A mostly complete exhaust manifold, a reciprocating junction box, a working counterweight slip differential ... you sure know your junk, $N.

english.title: Pick-a-Part
english.objectives: Collect 8 Siege Engine Scrap pieces from the Battlescar in Southern Barrens.
english.description: These bulky dwarven siege engines aren't cut out for the close-quarters fighting of the Battlescar.$B$BI've got some new designs I'd like to try out, but first I'm going to need some spare parts. There's plenty of wreckage sitting in the Battlescar. All I need is an enterprising $c to haul it back for me.$B$BThat's you, $n. I'm talking about you.
english.progress: What have you got for me?
english.completion: Oohh look! A mostly complete exhaust manifold, a reciprocating junction box, a working counterweight slip differential ... you sure know your junk, $N.

text.title: Taming the Beast
text.objectives: Use the Taming Rod to befriend a Vampiric Duskbat.
text.description: You have spent your young career mastering the arts of single combat.  I feel it is high time that you learned a new form of combat - that of the trained pet.$b$bTake this rod and use it on a vampiric duskbat until it joins you and your cause.  It may take you some time, but I have faith that you can bend the bat to your will.
text.completed: Return to Dedlow Wormwood at Brill in Tirisfal Glades.

english.title: Taming the Beast
english.objectives: Use the Taming Rod to befriend a Vampiric Duskbat.
english.description: You have spent your young career mastering the arts of single combat.  I feel it is high time that you learned a new form of combat - that of the trained pet.$b$bTake this rod and use it on a vampiric duskbat until it joins you and your cause.  It may take you some time, but I have faith that you can bend the bat to your will.
english.completed: Return to Dedlow Wormwood at Brill in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: Taming the Beast
text.objectives: Use the Taming Rod to befriend a Plagued Bruin.
text.description: Lately we have seen some young, plagued bears passing over the mountains between here and the plaguelands.  While these bears' trek into Tirisfal tests and threatens the defenses that we have laid at the Bulwark, their passage is a blessing to us hunters.$b$bProve to me you learned something from our last lesson, and use the rod on a plagued bruin, far to the east.
text.completed: Return to Dedlow Wormwood at Brill in Tirisfal Glades.

english.title: Taming the Beast
english.objectives: Use the Taming Rod to befriend a Plagued Bruin.
english.description: Lately we have seen some young, plagued bears passing over the mountains between here and the plaguelands.  While these bears' trek into Tirisfal tests and threatens the defenses that we have laid at the Bulwark, their passage is a blessing to us hunters.$b$bProve to me you learned something from our last lesson, and use the rod on a plagued bruin, far to the east.
english.completed: Return to Dedlow Wormwood at Brill in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: Taming the Beast
text.objectives: Use the Taming Rod to befriend a Vicious Night Web Spider.
text.description: Your final test involves the spiders that reside in Venomweb Vale, north of the Bulwark.  Yes, even these simple creatures can become a valuable trained ally.  I have seen many hunters that count these venomous creatures as part of their arsenal.$b$bUse the rod to tame one, and return to me when you finish.
text.end: Tame a Vicious Night Web Spider.
text.completed: Return to Dedlow Wormwood at Brill in Tirisfal Glades.

english.title: Taming the Beast
english.objectives: Use the Taming Rod to befriend a Vicious Night Web Spider.
english.description: Your final test involves the spiders that reside in Venomweb Vale, north of the Bulwark.  Yes, even these simple creatures can become a valuable trained ally.  I have seen many hunters that count these venomous creatures as part of their arsenal.$b$bUse the rod to tame one, and return to me when you finish.
english.end: Tame a Vicious Night Web Spider.
english.completed: Return to Dedlow Wormwood at Brill in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: 玩火药
text.objectives: 在战斗之痕附近击败一名专家级工兵，然后弄一桶烈性火药回来。
text.description: 我们从尘泥沼泽运来的硝石被劫了，这意味着我们不能在这儿自己生产火药了。$B$B但我可以改良咱们的装备，让它们能装填烈性火药。这种火药很不稳定、 非常危险、对皮肤有毒、而且吞服有害……不过我觉得我会成功的！$B$B去从那群轰炸我们的地精特种工兵那里给我抢一桶这种火药来。
text.progress:
Do you have a keg of Blast-O powder yet?

When you get one ... don't shake it.
text.completion: Great! Set the keg down right here. I'll measure out some charges once I've donned my full-body protective gear.

english.title: Powder Play
english.objectives: Defeat a Sapper Specialist near the Battlescar and acquire a Keg of Blast-O Powder.
english.description: Our shipments of saltpeter from Dustwallow have been held up, which means we can't manufacture our own gunpowder here.$B$BBut I can retrofit our armaments to use goblin Blast-O powder. It's unstable, dangerous, toxic to the skin, and harmful if swallowed... but I think I can make it work!$B$BGet me a keg of the stuff by attacking one of those goblin sapper specialists who've been storming our walls.
english.progress:
Do you have a keg of Blast-O powder yet?

When you get one ... don't shake it.
english.completion: Great! Set the keg down right here. I'll measure out some charges once I've donned my full-body protective gear.

text.title: 本品暂不包含电池
text.objectives: 从南贫瘠之地的雷霆蜥蜴身上弄到一个嗡嗡作响的电囊。
text.description: 好了！用了这些你给我找来的备用零件，我的全新多用途战车的框架已经初具雏形了。我现在需要的是一部小型化供电装置。$B$B我留意到这里的本地野生动物十分强力，我是说它们身上的电能很强力。你能帮我去基地周围猎杀几头雷霆蜥蜴吗？然后给我带一个完整的电囊回来。不过你可能要多杀上几头才能找到可用的电囊。
text.progress: It must be an enormous evolutionary advantage to be able to shoot lightning. From your face.
text.completion:
<The gizard shocks Mizzy as you hand it over, blasting her to the ground.>

Oh, OH! That's nasty! I love it!

english.title: Batteries Not Yet Included
english.objectives: Acquire a Humming Electrogizard from a Thunderhead in Southern Barrens.
english.description: Okay! Using the spare parts you've found for me, I've got a framework roughed out for my versatile new assault vehicle. All I need now is a compact power supply.$B$BI've noticed that the indigenous wildlife here packs quite the punch, electrostatically speaking. Can you hunt down Thunderheads near the base here and get me an intact electrogizard? It might take a few kills to find a usable gland.
english.progress: It must be an enormous evolutionary advantage to be able to shoot lightning. From your face.
english.completion:
<The gizard shocks Mizzy as you hand it over, blasting her to the ground.>

Oh, OH! That's nasty! I love it!

text.title: 占领战斗之痕
text.objectives: 前往战斗之痕。找到旗帜并干掉10名凄凉袭击者。$B$B夺取旗帜会让联盟玩家在战斗之痕中获得战场上的优势。
text.description: 这里往西有一座部落的要塞，他们与我们的战事陷入了胶着状态。战争在继续，即便脚下的大地四分五裂了，战斗也没有停止。$B$B需要有人站出来打破僵持的局面！我需要你潜入战斗之痕，帮助我的人击溃那里的部落军队。$B$B在战斗之痕的中心，你会找到一面象征着地区占领的旗帜。找到那面旗帜。如果我们的人还没有夺取那面旗帜，那就靠你了。它会让你获得对战斗之痕的控制权。
text.completion: Incredible work, $N! My men report a breakthrough. Their stronghold won't survive much longer...

english.title: Claim the Battlescar
english.objectives: Go to the Battlescar. Scout out the flag marker and kill 10 Desolation Raiders.$B$BCapturing the flag will give all Alliance players in the scar a combat advantage.
english.description: The Horde has fought us to a standstill from their stronghold west of here. The fighting continues, even as the land breaks open under our feet.$B$BSomeone's got to break the stalemate! I need you to venture into the Battlescar and help my men crush the Horde opposition there.$B$BIn the center of the scar you will find a flag marker designating who controls the area. Scout out the flag. It'll be worth your while to claim the scar for the Alliance if someone hasn't already done so.
english.completion: Incredible work, $N! My men report a breakthrough. Their stronghold won't survive much longer...

text.title: 解决虫害
text.objectives: 用一桶燃烧着的沥青倒在凯旋壁垒外面的异种蝎土丘上，然后杀掉10只被烧出来的异种群居蝎。
text.description: 我实在是不明白，为啥上级指挥官们会觉得异种蝎土丘是建造要塞的理想地点。这些小虫子会在我们要塞下面打洞，然后拖慢我们的工期。我们需要把它们烧出来！$B$B拿上这个燃烧的沥青桶，然后倒在大门外面的异种蝎土丘上。它们看上去就像大堆大堆的沙子。然后把从里面爬出来的东西统统干掉，但是要小心，$n－－这些恶心的家伙很有可能在你火烧它们老家的时候倾巢而出。
text.progress: How goes the fight, $N?
text.completion: That oughta take care of our bug problem for a while - they'll be hard-pressed to tunnel their way outta that!

english.title: Working the Bugs Out
english.objectives: Use the Bucket of Burning Pitch on the silithid mounds outside of Fort Triumph to flush out and kill 10 Silithid Swarmers.
english.description: Why high command decided that a silithid mound was the ideal place to build a fortress, I'll never know. Them lil' buggers are tunneling under our fortifications and setting back our timetables. We need to scorch 'em out!$B$BTake this here bucket of burning pitch and dump it on the silithid mounds right outside the main gate. They look like big piles of sand. Kill anything that comes out, but be careful, $n - them nasties are likely to swarm you when you light those mounds up.
english.progress: How goes the fight, $N?
english.completion: That oughta take care of our bug problem for a while - they'll be hard-pressed to tunnel their way outta that!

text.title: Beast Training
text.objectives: Speak with Apolos in the War Quarter of the Undercity.
text.description: One last thing, $g hunter: huntress;.  You'll want to speak with Apolos at the Undercity.  He'll teach you the last few bits of knowledge necessary to care for and train your pet.$b$bYou can find him in the War Quarter.
text.completed: Return to Ganaar at Azuremyst Isle.

english.title: Beast Training
english.objectives: Speak with Apolos in the War Quarter of the Undercity.
english.description: One last thing, $g hunter: huntress;.  You'll want to speak with Apolos at the Undercity.  He'll teach you the last few bits of knowledge necessary to care for and train your pet.$b$bYou can find him in the War Quarter.
english.completed: Return to Ganaar at Azuremyst Isle.

text.title: 增长的威胁
text.objectives: 杀掉13头钢鬃野猪人。
text.description: 稍微打扰一下，$c。$B$B就我们所知，这里的麻烦比世界末日还要严重。我们的卫戍受到了野猪人的威胁。当然，只要他们待在沼泽里，我们不会去打扰他们，但每一天他们都逐渐地朝我们的营地推进。$B$B如果我亲自出去大开杀戒的话，玛卡是绝对不会原谅我的。但如果你能帮我把那些离营地太近的野猪人赶回去，我将感激不尽。
text.completion:
You've my thanks, if not that of the entire Earthen Ring.

Maybe someday we'll find a way to talk it out with these pigs, but we can't heal the land if we're dead in our sleep.

english.title: A Growing Threat
english.objectives: Kill 13 Razormane Quilboar.
english.description: A moment there, $c.$B$BWe've got more problems here than just the end of the world as we know it. Our vigil here's threatened by the quilboar. We've been content to leave them be when they stay in the Kraul, sure, but every day they press further and further out towards our camp.$B$BMahka, bless her green heart, wouldn't ever forgive me if I went out bashing heads in myself, but if you could help drive back those that're wandering near the camp, I'd appreciate it.
english.completion:
You've my thanks, if not that of the entire Earthen Ring.

Maybe someday we'll find a way to talk it out with these pigs, but we can't heal the land if we're dead in our sleep.

text.title: 碎牙
text.objectives: 杀死碎牙。
text.description: 乌娜曾在陶拉祖营地里待过一段时间。她告诉我说曾有个野猪人被抓到那里去，他的名字叫做碎牙。对野猪人而言，他算是非常聪明的一个。$B$B我一直在想，究竟是什么让这些野猪人近来如此恼怒，也许原因就是那个从陶拉祖活着逃了出来的碎牙。如果是这样的话，那么一定是他在煽风点火。$B$B西北边的山丘上有个巨大的茅屋。如果你在那里找到碎牙，就把他宰掉。
text.completion: That's a relief. Maybe the rest of 'em will keep to their own devices now. The less fighting around here, the better.

english.title: Mangletooth
english.objectives: Kill Mangletooth.
english.description: Una here used to spend time in Camp Taurajo. She's told me about a quilboar that used to be captured there, named Mangletooth. Quite the clever one, for a quilboar.$B$BI've been tryin' to think what got these quilboar riled up so much recently, and it might be that Mangletooth escaped Taurajo alive. If he has, he's certainly calling the shots.$B$BThere's a large hut up in the hills to the northwest. If you find Mangletooth there, cut 'im down.
english.completion: That's a relief. Maybe the rest of 'em will keep to their own devices now. The less fighting around here, the better.

text.title: 火石岗哨
text.objectives: 去南贫瘠之地的火石岗哨寻找多恩·红土。
text.description: 有件大事要求你帮我，$n？我嫂子的叔叔是大地之环的人，他现在正在贫瘠之地的火石岗哨研究大灾变对那里的影响。他说他们的营地被野猪人包围了，我担心野猪人会血洗营地。$B$B你能帮我打听一下多恩·红土的消息吗？我不想他有事，一则为了我们的家族，也为了所有人。
text.completion:
What? Little Logan thinks I might need protection?

It's me doing the protectin'!

The quilboar here are poised to rampage. They've choked off the entire south, and we're the only thing standing in their way.
text.completed: 去南贫瘠之地的火石岗哨寻找多恩·红土。

english.title: Firestone Point
english.objectives: Seek out Dorn Redearth at Firestone Point in Southern Barrens.
english.description: Can you do me a huge favor, $n? My sister-in-law's uncle is in the Earthen Ring, and he's here in the Barrens studying the impact of the Cataclysm, down at Firestone Point. He says their camp is surrounded by quilboar and I worry that they might get overrun.$B$BCan you check in on Dorn Redearth for me? I'd hate for anything to happen to him, what with the close family bond and all.
english.completion:
What? Little Logan thinks I might need protection?

It's me doing the protectin'!

The quilboar here are poised to rampage. They've choked off the entire south, and we're the only thing standing in their way.
english.completed: Seek out Dorn Redearth at Firestone Point in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 向双辫将军汇报
text.objectives: 将前线战报送给双辫将军，他正在南贫瘠之地巡逻。
text.description: 联盟可欠巴尔莫丹矮人一个人情，我们在贫瘠之地最早期的防御工事都是他们修建的。$B$B他们的指挥官，双辫将军，那是条真正的汉子，是我们最强的勇士之一。他就在南边巡逻，时刻警惕着部落的来袭。$B$B我非常希望他能预估这里的形势，以便我们可以调整下一步的行动。你能把这份前线报告送给他吗？
text.progress: Hrm, news from the fortress? Well. Spit it out!
text.completion:
<The General reads over the report, nodding in approval as he reads about the Battlescar.>

Quite a name you're earning for yourself here in the Barrens, $N. But Roberts isn't going far enough. What we need is a decisive victory...

english.title: Report to Twinbraid
english.objectives: Deliver the Frontline Report to General Twinbraid, who is on patrol in Southern Barrens.
english.description: The Alliance owes a debt to the dwarves of Bael Modan, who built some of our earliest fortifications in the Barrens.$B$BTheir commander, General Twinbraid, is a real stalwart. One of our best. He's on patrol south of here, keeping the Horde on their toes.$B$BI definitely want to keep him appraised of the situation here so we can coordinate our next move. Can you deliver this frontline report to him in the field?
english.progress: Hrm, news from the fortress? Well. Spit it out!
english.completion:
<The General reads over the report, nodding in approval as he reads about the Battlescar.>

Quite a name you're earning for yourself here in the Barrens, $N. But Roberts isn't going far enough. What we need is a decisive victory...

text.title: 走出墓穴
text.objectives: 与提瑞斯法林地丧钟镇的亡灵卫兵萨尔坦交谈。
text.description: 达内尔跟我说，你们俩已经见过面了。很好，我要把你们都派到丧钟镇去。你们在这里的工作已经完成了。$b$b到北边去跟丧钟镇的亡灵卫兵萨尔坦谈一谈，他会告诉你更多你必须知道的事情。
text.completion: Those val'kyr have been really busy resurrecting you newbies lately.  I've already seen a couple dozen new bodies run down that hill since this morning.$b$bYou, however, are the most promising $c I've seen today.

english.title: Beyond the Graves
english.objectives: Speak with Deathguard Saltain at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.
english.description: Darnell tells me that the two of you have already met.  That's good, because I'm sending you both into Deathknell.  Your work is done here.$b$bSpeak with Deathguard Saltain in Deathknell, to the north.  He will tell you more of what you must know.
english.completion: Those val'kyr have been really busy resurrecting you newbies lately.  I've already seen a couple dozen new bodies run down that hill since this morning.$b$bYou, however, are the most promising $c I've seen today.

text.title: 腐烂的爪子
text.objectives: 给炉灰庄园的亡灵卫兵迪林格尔带回7只腐烂的爪子。
text.description: 有一小撮天灾军团的士兵已经渗入了提瑞斯法林地。$B$B我需要有人来帮我击退所有占领这个小农场的腐烂的死者和破碎的尸体。把他们都给我拆成骨头架子，然后把他们那腐烂的爪子给我带回来，我会奖励你的。
text.progress: Have you completed the task with which I have charged you?  Do you have those putrid claws?
text.completion: Well done.  I enjoyed watching you smash those undead into rotting pulp!

english.title: A Putrid Task
english.objectives: Bring 7 Putrid Claws to Deathguard Dillinger in Cold Hearth Manor.
english.description: Scourge have trickled into Tirisfal Glades and have infested this area.$B$BI need someone to beat back the rotting dead and ravaged corpses that have taken this small farm.  Scatter their bones and bring back their putrid claws.  The Deathguards will reward you.
english.progress: Have you completed the task with which I have charged you?  Do you have those putrid claws?
english.completion: Well done.  I enjoyed watching you smash those undead into rotting pulp!

text.title: 流沙岗哨
text.objectives: 跟流沙岗哨的特伦顿·轻锤谈一谈。
text.description: 假如你想找更多的事做，我给你指条路。$B$B我知道有个叫做特伦顿·轻锤的精灵，几年来一心只想着找附近的沙漠巨魔。他是打算非找到他们打造的某种神话般的宝剑不可，不久之前终于凑够了人，前往流沙岗哨进行寻找了。$B$B我听到的最新消息是，他们把巨魔从一个营地赶了出来，自己在那儿开了业。到西边的祖尔法拉克附近去找他。
text.completion: Marin sent you? I'm appreciative of his help.$B$BI'm here to seek out Sul'thraze. If you wish to help, speak with Mazoga...he's been cooperative so far.

english.title: Sandsorrow Watch
english.objectives: Speak with Trenton Lighthammer at Sandsorrow Watch.
english.description: If you're looking for more work, I've got a line for you.$B$B I know an elf by the name of Trenton Lighthammer who's been obsessed with the sand trolls near here for years. He's dead-set on finding some kind of mythical sword made by them, and just a while ago he finally got a crew together to go to Sandsorrow Watch and look for it.$B$BLast I heard, they kicked the trolls out of one of their camps and set up shop there. Look for it to the west, near Zul'Farrak.
english.completion: Marin sent you? I'm appreciative of his help.$B$BI'm here to seek out Sul'thraze. If you wish to help, speak with Mazoga...he's been cooperative so far.

text.title: Subduing the Elements
text.objectives: Seer Bahura wants you to use the elemental sapta and cleansing totem from the Earthen Ring supplies to subdue 20 Agitated Fire Spirits.
text.description: The elements are restless, $c.  The earthquakes that plague the land and the fires that threaten to burn down Orgrimmar are not normal.  The Earthen Ring are convinced that we must put the elements to rest before they tear Azeroth apart.  We need your help, $n.$b$bI will give you a bag of Earthen Ring supplies.  In it you will find two items, elemental sapta and a cleansing totem.  Use the sapta to see into the elemental world.  Then use the cleansing totem to subdue the agitated fire spirits.

english.title: Subduing the Elements
english.objectives: Seer Bahura wants you to use the elemental sapta and cleansing totem from the Earthen Ring supplies to subdue 20 Agitated Fire Spirits.
english.description: The elements are restless, $c.  The earthquakes that plague the land and the fires that threaten to burn down Orgrimmar are not normal.  The Earthen Ring are convinced that we must put the elements to rest before they tear Azeroth apart.  We need your help, $n.$b$bI will give you a bag of Earthen Ring supplies.  In it you will find two items, elemental sapta and a cleansing totem.  Use the sapta to see into the elemental world.  Then use the cleansing totem to subdue the agitated fire spirits.

text.title: 军情七处的头目们
text.objectives: 取得指挥官亚林登、黑刃希恩和阿莱克西·默嚎的徽记。
text.description: 这里的兽人都是被海滩上的联盟残忍地击败的。我们可没有招惹他们。$B$B$n，不能让他们白白牺牲。你愿意主持正义吗？$B$B<阿格娜怒气冲天，难以自持。>$B$B海滩上有三个军情七处的头目，将他们的徽记带回来给我。
text.progress: Has justice been served?
text.completion: Thank you, $N. The spirits of the fallen can now be put to rest.

english.title: The Heads of the SI:7
english.objectives: Collect the heads of Commander Arrington, Darkblade Cyn, and Alexi Silenthowl.
english.description: These orcs were murdered in cold-blood by the Alliance down on the coast. We did nothing to provoke them.$B$BTheir deaths should not be in vain, $n. Will you bring them justice?$B$B<Aggra appears as if she can barely contain her rage.>$B$BThere are three SI:7 leaders down there along the beach. Bring me each of their heads.
english.progress: Has justice been served?
english.completion: Thank you, $N. The spirits of the fallen can now be put to rest.

text.title: 雷霆斗技场：祖蒙加！
text.objectives: 击败祖蒙加。
text.description: 漂亮！但你的对手不止是人类！$B$B下一个上场的是个凶残的家伙……当心他的右勾拳。还有他的左勾拳。总之他的拳头都要当心。
text.completed: 去塔纳利斯，找加基森的卡崔娜·特纳尔。

english.title: Thunderdrome: Zumonga!
english.objectives: Defeat Zumonga.
english.description: Splendidly done! But you'll be fighting more than mere humans!$B$BYour next opponent's a mean one...watch out for his right hook. And his left. I'd be wary of his fists in general.
english.completed: Return to Katrina Turner at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

text.title: 雷霆斗技场：萨里尼克斯！
text.objectives: 击败萨里尼克斯。
text.description: 但愿你准备好继续下一场了，$n。走错一步，就可能立刻导致痛苦的死亡！但人们付钱就是来看这个的，不是吗？$B$B希望你不怕虫子……
text.completed: 去塔纳利斯，找加基森的卡崔娜·特纳尔。

english.title: Thunderdrome: Sarinexx!
english.objectives: Defeat Sarinexx.
english.description: I hope you're ready for the next one, $n. One mistake could mean instant, painful death! But that's what the people pay to see, isn't it?$B$BI hope you're not afraid of bugs...
english.completed: Return to Katrina Turner at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

text.title: Thunderdrome: Prince Mosh!
text.objectives: Defeat Prince Mosh.
text.description: We're gonna have to bring out the big guns to top that last fight!$B$BDon't worry, my friend, we've got more blood for you to spill. Many goblins died to capture the next fighter...he's a whopper!
text.completed: Return to Katrina Turner at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

english.title: Thunderdrome: Prince Mosh!
english.objectives: Defeat Prince Mosh.
english.description: We're gonna have to bring out the big guns to top that last fight!$B$BDon't worry, my friend, we've got more blood for you to spill. Many goblins died to capture the next fighter...he's a whopper!
english.completed: Return to Katrina Turner at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

text.title: Little Sumpthin'
text.objectives: Drazzit Dripvalve wants you to talk to Vern Futzwidget in Thousand Needles.
text.description: Lissen, pal.$b$bI got a friend, who knows a fella, who might just be lookin' for a $c that knows $ghis:her; way around a fight.$b$bIf you're not afraid to get your hands dirty, head south over the mountains and look for a goblin named Vern.$b$bTell him Drazz sent ya...

english.title: Little Sumpthin'
english.objectives: Drazzit Dripvalve wants you to talk to Vern Futzwidget in Thousand Needles.
english.description: Lissen, pal.$b$bI got a friend, who knows a fella, who might just be lookin' for a $c that knows $ghis:her; way around a fight.$b$bIf you're not afraid to get your hands dirty, head south over the mountains and look for a goblin named Vern.$b$bTell him Drazz sent ya...

text.title: 觐见酋长
text.objectives: 跟失落群岛酋长瞭望台的萨尔谈一谈。
text.description: 酋长决定兑现承诺，帮助我们救出被抓走的人。他说想跟你谈谈。$B$B$n，祝你好运。我们就指望你了。
text.completion: Once again you have helped us to overcome our mutual enemy, the Alliance.$B$BNow it is time for us to help you.

english.title: The Warchief Wants You
english.objectives: Speak with Thrall at the Warchief's Lookout on the Lost Isles.
english.description: True to his word, Thrall is going to get us going in the right direction to rescue our people. He asked to speak with you.$B$BGood luck, $n. We're all depending on you.
english.completion: Once again you have helped us to overcome our mutual enemy, the Alliance.$B$BNow it is time for us to help you.

text.title: 借巴斯蒂亚一用
text.objectives: 跟失落群岛静谧湾岸的基拉格·血牙谈一谈。
text.description: 返回海滩，告诉基拉格我想让你借巴斯蒂亚一用。那只黑豹知道你的朋友被关押在哪儿。$B$B去吧。在对付贸易大王之前，我们还会见面的。
text.completion: Of course you can borrow Bastia. That is, if she'll take you.$B$B<Kilag winks.>

english.title: Borrow Bastia
english.objectives: Speak with Kilag Gorefang at the Tranquil Coast on the Lost Isles.
english.description: Head back down to the coast and tell Kilag that I'd like for you to borrow Bastia. The panther knows the way to where your friends are being held captive.$B$BGo now. I will see you again before we make our move against the Trade Prince.
english.completion: Of course you can borrow Bastia. That is, if she'll take you.$B$B<Kilag winks.>

text.title: 奔跑吧
text.objectives: 跟失落群岛天坠瀑布的史莉琪·剃刀谈一谈。
text.description: 巴斯蒂亚会带你安全抵达目的地的，地精。
text.completion: $N?! Nice kitty.$B$BLook we don't have much time here. You might have noticed that the volcano is blowing?!

english.title: Let's Ride
english.objectives: Speak with Slinky Sharpshiv at Sky Falls on the Lost Isles.
english.description: Bastia will make sure that you get to where you need to go, goblin.
english.completion: $N?! Nice kitty.$B$BLook we don't have much time here. You might have noticed that the volcano is blowing?!

text.title: Friend of a Friend
text.objectives: Smiling Jim wants you to talk to Vern Futzwidget in Thousand Needles.
text.description: Say, you look like a frisky sort...$b$bI know a guy who knows a fella that might be lookin' for a $c who knows $ghis:her; way around a fight.$b$bIf you're not afraid to get your hands a little dirty, make your way south across the mountains and look for a goblin by the name of Vern.$b$bTell him Smiling Jim sent ya.

english.title: Friend of a Friend
english.objectives: Smiling Jim wants you to talk to Vern Futzwidget in Thousand Needles.
english.description: Say, you look like a frisky sort...$b$bI know a guy who knows a fella that might be lookin' for a $c who knows $ghis:her; way around a fight.$b$bIf you're not afraid to get your hands a little dirty, make your way south across the mountains and look for a goblin by the name of Vern.$b$bTell him Smiling Jim sent ya.

text.title: 驱赶巨兽
text.objectives: 在南贫瘠之地杀死4头震地科多兽和1头震地蛮兽。
text.description: 双辫将军的巡逻岗一直面临着诸多威胁。不是遭遇部落的突然袭击，就是被野猪人的游击战搞得苦不堪言。$B$B究其原因，要怪那些震地科多兽。这些体型庞大的多毛兽走起路来，大地都会震颤……导致我们无法察觉部落的伏兵。$B$B想法子让它们离开这片区域吧。杀掉几只，应该可以让兽群往南迁徙，远离巡逻岗。
text.completion: I thought you might be responsible for them clouds of dust I saw to the east. Nice work! Them bulls ain't sissies.

english.title: No Bull
english.objectives: Kill 4 Landquaker Kodos and 1 Landquaker Bull in Southern Barrens.
english.description: Twinbraid's patrols always throw us right into the thick of danger. If it's not Horde ambushes, it's a quilboar hit-and-run.$B$BThe problem is them lousy landquaker kodos. Big walkin' walls of fur, shakin' the ground... We can't see or hear an ambush creepin' up on our backside.$B$BGo scare 'em off from our patrol, here. Killing a few should drive the herd south and out of what's left of me hair.
english.completion: I thought you might be responsible for them clouds of dust I saw to the east. Nice work! Them bulls ain't sissies.

text.title: 商旅哨站
text.objectives: 跟商旅哨站的泽克·磨靴谈一谈。
text.description: 我们在这儿做了一件了不起的事。我得确保这些图书顺利完工，然后再回加基森一趟。$B$B要是你打算继续让我们的热砂港朋友们刮目相看，或只是打算多挣点，就到西南方去。商旅哨站就位于大裂口边上。跟泽克·磨靴谈谈。$B$B我敢跟你赌个大的，他正需要帮忙呢。

english.title: Bootlegger Outpost
english.objectives: Talk to Zeke Bootscuff at Bootlegger Outpost.
english.description: We've done a bang up job here. I'm gonna make sure these mooks finish properly and then head back to Gadgetzan for a bit.$B$BIf you want to keep making a good impression on our Steamwheedle friends, or just make more money, you should head southwest of here. Bootlegger Outpost is set up on the edge of the gaping chasm.$B$BTalk to Zeke Bootscuff. I'd bet good money he'll need help.

text.title: 挖掘场的情形
text.objectives: 在南贫瘠之地的巴尔莫丹挖掘场外找到马尔雷·双辫。
text.description: 巡逻兵还没有任何消息。这让我有些担忧，$n。$B$B自从联盟攻陷陶拉祖后，没有地方是安全的。你像是个有能力的家伙，能请你外出巡逻吗？$B$B去东南方的巴尔莫丹挖掘场外找我的儿子马尔雷。挖掘场完全暴露在敌方的火力范围内，很容易受到攻击。而我的儿子又非常自傲，即便是遇到麻烦，他也不肯发来求救信号的。
text.completion:
Father sent you? He worries too much. There's nothing here I can't handle...

But I'd still appreciate the help.
text.completed: 去南贫瘠之地的巴尔莫丹挖掘场外找马尔雷·双辫。

english.title: Digsite Status
english.objectives: Locate Marley Twinbraid outside the Bael Modan Excavation in Southern Barrens.
english.description: The patrol's been quiet today. And that's got me worried, $n.$B$BEver since the Alliance sacked Taurajo, none of our positions are secure. You look like you can handle yourself - can you scout around for me?$B$BCheck in with my son Marley outside the Bael Modan excavation, southeast of here. The site's exposed and susceptible to raids, and my son's too proud to signal for help if he needs it.
english.completion:
Father sent you? He worries too much. There's nothing here I can't handle...

But I'd still appreciate the help.
english.completed: Locate Marley Twinbraid outside the Bael Modan Excavation in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 龅牙！不！
text.objectives: 切割3颗致密泽菲蓝晶石，把它们交给暴风城的伊莎贝尔·琼斯。
text.description: 莉娜的宠物龅牙又闯进我的作坊了！$b$b当时我正在制作一只手镯，是今天就要交货的。工作就要完成了，只差镶宝石的环节。我花了一整晚切割宝石，但是就在我出去吃早餐的那一小会，该死的小怪物冲进我的作坊，把它看到的所有宝石都给吞了！那东西可以消化一切，而且说正经的，光是收拾它留下的一堆烂摊子就足以让你累断腰了。$b$b我必须尽快弄到备用的宝石，信使今晚就要来了。帮帮忙啊！

english.title: Nibbler!  No!
english.objectives: Cut three Solid Zephyrites and give them to Isabel Jones in Stormwind City.
english.description: Lila's pet Nibbler got into my workshop again!$b$bI was making a bracelet, to be delivered today.  The work was almost done, except for the gems.  I spent all night cutting them, but when I stepped out for a bit of breakfast, the little beast came into my workshop and swallowed every gem in sight!  The thing can digest ANYTHING, and trust me, you'd break your back trying to pick up its leavings.$b$bI need to get replacement gems fast; the courier is coming in tonight.  Help!

text.title: 考古成果属于我！
text.objectives: 进入巴尔莫丹挖掘场，杀死8名挖掘袭击者，取回5块巴尔莫丹圣物并找到双辫的工具。
text.description: 瞧瞧下面乱得一团糟，$n！我已经告诉工头，让他们尽可能地抢救圣物。谁知道那些牛头人会掠走什么样的古器。$B$B你能帮我处理一下这里的麻烦事吗？杀死袭击者，尽可能地夺回圣物。$B$B顺便找到我丢失的工具。只需要一些小修理，这台飞行器就能再次正常运转啦。
text.progress:
How's the situation down there?

When the raid started I popped a bullet into their ringleader, Stonespire, but they just kept right on coming.
text.completion:
My father would be proud of you, $N.

Now, to get this flying machine up and about again...

english.title: Hands Off Me Dig!
english.objectives: Kill 8 Excavation Raiders, rescue 5 Bael'modan Artifacts, and acquire Twinbraid's Tools in the Bael'modan Digsite.
english.description: Look at the chaos down there, $n! I've instructed the foremen to save what artifacts they can. Who knows what treasures these tauren animals are like to make off with.$B$BCan you help get a handle on things? Kill the raiders and save what artifacts you can.$B$BWhile you're at it, look for my missing tools. A few quick repairs and I can get this flying machine up and running again.
english.progress:
How's the situation down there?

When the raid started I popped a bullet into their ringleader, Stonespire, but they just kept right on coming.
english.completion:
My father would be proud of you, $N.

Now, to get this flying machine up and about again...

text.title: 庄严的石板
text.objectives: 将庄严的石板交给安多伦·晨光。
text.description: 在箱子底部，你找到了一块大石板。它的材质好像是石头，但非常光滑，毫无瑕疵，表面布满了奇怪的文字。$B$B其中一些文字和墙上的文字类似，另一些则完全不同。安多伦可能会对它感兴趣。

english.title: The Grand Tablet
english.objectives: Take the Grand Tablet to Andoren Dawnrise.
english.description: At the bottom of the chest, you find a large tablet. Made of a material resembling stone, but completely smooth and flawless, it is covered in strange writing.$B$BWhile some resembles the writing on the walls, other scripts appear completely different. Andoren would probably like to see this.

text.title: 被流放的费格雷
text.objectives: 杀死巴尔莫丹挖掘场中被流放的费格雷。
text.description: $n，这是我所知的最悲惨的故事。费格雷原本是最优秀的挖掘工之一，直到他得到——“月神之泪”。它改变并重塑了费格雷。我真希望这玩意儿永远埋在地下。$B$B费格雷被逐出了巴尔莫丹，但是我接到报告称他又回到挖掘场。月神之泪让他吃尽了苦头。如果你在挖掘场里撞见费格雷，结束他的痛苦吧。
text.completion:
<Marley nods grimly.>

Aye, it's for the best I suppose.
text.giverWindow: 他挖得太深了。

english.title: Feegly the Exiled
english.objectives: Kill Feegly the Exiled in the Bael Modan Digsite.
english.description: Saddest story I ever heard told, $n. Feegly was one of our fastest diggers, until he got a hold of that - thing. "The Tear of the Moons" we called it. It changed him. Remade him. I wish it had stayed buried.$B$BFeegly was banished from Bael Modan but I've heard reports he's come sniffing around the dig site again. He's suffered enough, the wretched thing. If you find him down there, put ol' Feegly out of his misery.
english.completion:
<Marley nods grimly.>

Aye, it's for the best I suppose.
english.giverWindow: He dug too deep.

text.title: 加里维克斯劳工矿井
text.objectives: 跟失落群岛加里维克斯劳工矿井内的助手格瑞里谈一谈。
text.description: 我们侥幸活命啊！$B$B贸易大王把我们当奴隶使唤，强迫我们去洞里挖矿。$B$B在格瑞里的帮助下，有七个人逃了出来。但是她没能成功，又被抓回去了。$B$B$n，你是唯一一个疯狂到敢于走进活火山口的人！格瑞里会跟你一起营救其他人的。$B$B快点！这里的地壳很不稳定！
text.completion: <The assistant looks confused.>$B$BHuh... what? Who?

english.title: The Gallywix Labor Mine
english.objectives: Speak with Assistant Greely inside the Gallywix Labor Mine on the Lost Isles.
english.description: We barely escaped with our hides intact!$B$BThe Trade Prince has a whole bunch of us enslaved and performing manual labor inside the cavern.$B$BGreely helped the seven of us to get out, but she was recaptured in the process.$B$B$n, you're the only one crazy enough to walk into an exploding volcano! The assistant will be able to help you free the others.$B$BHurry! This place is about to blow for good!
english.completion: <The assistant looks confused.>$B$BHuh... what? Who?

text.title: 卡亚可乐，给你灵感！(注册商标)
text.objectives: 取回1罐卡亚零一度可乐。
text.description: 助手格瑞里有点迷糊，她显然是受到了恫吓。在这种状态下，她怎么能帮你营救其他人呢？$B$B这里到处都是卡亚零一度可乐。说不定喝一罐，她的脑子就清醒了。
text.progress: Huh?
text.completion: <Assistant Greely spots the Kaja'Cola Zero-One in your hand and her eyes seem to come to life.>

english.title: Kaja'Cola Gives You IDEAS! (TM)
english.objectives: Collect 1 Kaja'Cola Zero-One.
english.description: Assistant Greely is clearly bewildered and intimidated. How will she help you to find a way to rescue everyone in this condition?$B$BMaybe if she were to drink one of those Kaja'Cola Zero-One drinks you saw, she'd be able to have a bright idea?
english.progress: Huh?
english.completion: <Assistant Greely spots the Kaja'Cola Zero-One in your hand and her eyes seem to come to life.>

text.title: 清扫食腐动物
text.objectives: 使用收集机器人采集12具火鹏尸体。
text.description: 我知道你不挑活儿，所以我有另外一个工作要交给你。你看见聚集在骨头附近的那些红色羽毛的鸟了吗？那些是火鹏。不当心的话，它们会把你点着的。$B$B托它们那独特的构造的福，它们可值钱了。在这里晃悠的大多数猎人都是来杀吐火的秃鹰挣钱的……你觉得你能搞定吗？
text.completion: Alchemists pay through the nose for these things. Sure, maybe I tell some of them they're dragon parts, but that ain't my problem, right?

english.title: Scavengers Scavenged
english.objectives: Use Butcherbot to harvest 12 Fire Roc corpses.
english.description: Now that I know you're not squeamish, I've got another job for you. Have you seen the red-feathered birds swarming around the bones out there? Those are fire rocs. They'll light you up good if you're not careful.$B$BThey're also pretty darn valuable thanks to their unique anatomy. Most of the hunters loafing around here aren't up to the task of killing fire-spitting buzzards for money... think you can handle it?
english.completion: Alchemists pay through the nose for these things. Sure, maybe I tell some of them they're dragon parts, but that ain't my problem, right?

text.title: 收集机器人
text.objectives: 使用收集机器人采集8具晶鳞蜥蜴尸体。
text.description: 我在这里靠卖动物器官挣钱。我已经完善了一种万无一失、一本万利的方法：收集机器人！$B$B基于逐项分析机制，这些小东西被编制程序，专门从野生动物身上采集每一块有用的材料。他什么都能干，最棒的是，只有我才知道怎么把货从他背上拿出来。$B$B要是你对挣钱感兴趣的话，就带上我的一架收集机器人出去转一转。我需要一些晶鳞蜥蜴的器官，你在南边应该能找到很多。
text.completion: Nice going, kid. Didn't lose any fingers? Good, we can get some more work for you then.

english.title: Butcherbot
english.objectives: Use the Butcherbot to harvest 10 Glasshide Basilisk corpses.
english.description: I make my money around here selling animal parts. I've been perfecting a foolproof method of maximizing profit: The butcherbot!$B$BThese little guys are programmed to harvest every scrap of usable material from the wildlife around here, on a case-by-case basis. He does all the work, and best of all, only I know how to get the goods back out of him.$B$BIf you're interested in making some coin, take one of these guys for a spin. I need some glasshide basilisk parts; you'll find a bunch of them to the south.
english.completion: Nice going, kid. Didn't lose any fingers? Good, we can get some more work for you then.

text.title: [DEPRECATED]Scorpid Poaching: Dunestalkers
text.objectives: Collect 12 Pounds of Dunestalker Legs from Scorpid Dunestalkers.
text.description: The bigger scorpids to the south, the dunestalkers, are too tough and dry for the tail meat to sell. But I'll tell you what everyone overlooks: the legs!$B$BI won't bother you with all the finer details of scorpid part appraisal, but suffice it to say they sell like hotcakes. Or crablegs. Crabcakes?$B$BAnyway, I don't care what the chefs do with them as long as the money flows. Bring me about, oh, twelve pounds of legs.
text.completed: Return to Driz Plunkbow at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

But I'll tell you what everyone overlooks: the legs!$B$BI won't bother you with all the finer details of scorpid part appraisal, but suffice it to say they sell like hotcakes. Or crablegs. Crabcakes?$B$BAnyway, I don't care what the chefs do with them as long as the money flows. Bring me about, oh, twelve pounds of legs.
english.completed: Return to Driz Plunkbow at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

text.title: [DEPRECATED]Basilisk Poaching: Gazer Guts
text.objectives: Collect 12 Gazer Guts from Glasshide Gazers.
text.description: That last job didn't exactly paint you as the dainty type, so I think you're cut out for more.$B$BThe larger basilisks to the south, the gazers, get to some impressive sizes. The alchemists prefer the smaller brains, usually, but the other organs are better sized up.$B$BAt any rate, I'm no alchemist: I just know what Driz sells by the truckload. Bring us back a sack full of gazer guts.
text.completed: Return to Jane Farnum at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

english.objectives: Collect 12 Gazer Guts from Glasshide Gazers.
