Bring us back a sack full of gazer guts.
english.completed: Return to Jane Farnum at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

text.title: 疱爪肉贩
text.objectives: 使用收集机器人采集10具疱爪土狼尸体。
text.description: 废土上徘徊的土狼看起来瘦骨嶙峋，可它们拥有你能找到的最强壮的下颚！不当心的话，它们一口能把你的一条腿咬掉。那种骨密度可是稀有资源，我的朋友，就等着找个买家吧！$B$B把我的收集机器人带上。分离下颚不是件轻松的活，这个小家伙已经设置好了，知道该怎么做。他装满之后，就把他带回来。
text.completion: Beautiful! We'll have these puppies shined up and ready to sell in no time.

english.title: Blisterpaw Butchery
english.objectives: Use the Butcherbot to harvest 10 Blisterpaw Hyena corpses.
english.description: The hyenas wandering the wastes here might look scrawny, but they've got some of the strongest jaws you'll find! If you're not careful, they'll take a leg off in one bite. That kind of bone strength is a valuable resource, my friend, just waiting to find a buyer!$B$BTake one of my Butcherbots with you. Jaw separation isn't an easy task, and this little guy has been set up to know exactly what to do. Just bring him back when he's full.
english.completion: Beautiful! We'll have these puppies shined up and ready to sell in no time.

text.title: [DEPRECATED]Hyena Poaching: Rabid Livers
text.objectives: Collect 12 Rabid Livers from Blisterpaw Hyenas.
text.description: I know Driz hates sport hunting, but the way I see it, it's okay to have fun as long as you're not being wasteful! Right?$B$BWhat I mean is, the northern hyenas are no fun. The ones further south, they've all got nasty cases of rabies. Now that's fun, when a single deep bite could do you in! And what's more, the rabies makes the liver swell up so much, it's prized for its weight.$B$BNow I've gotten all worked up again. Could you bring back some livers while I sit here, bored? Sigh.
text.completed: Return to Alastair the Savage at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

english.title: [DEPRECATED]Hyena Poaching: Rabid Livers
english.objectives: Collect 12 Rabid Livers from Blisterpaw Hyenas.

The ones further south, they've all got nasty cases of rabies. Now that's fun, when a single deep bite could do you in! And what's more, the rabies makes the liver swell up so much, it's prized for its weight.$B$BNow I've gotten all worked up again. Could you bring back some livers while I sit here, bored? Sigh.
english.completed: Return to Alastair the Savage at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

text.title: Scout's Dishonor
text.objectives: Collect the Dark Iron Dispatch from the Dark Iron Scout.
text.description: The Dark Iron are up to their usual tricks out here. They've been keeping to themselves, but I just know trouble's brewing.$B$BWe're going to take a look at it. There's a Dark Iron Scout puttering around the center of what used to be the Loch, keeping an eye out. I want you to take him out and bring back any documents or orders he has.$B$BIf my suspicions are unfounded... I'll take the blame from Moira myself. Promise ya.
text.completed: Return to Ashlan Stonesmirk at the Mo'grosh Camp in Loch Modan.

english.title: Scout's Dishonor
english.objectives: Collect the Dark Iron Dispatch from the Dark Iron Scout.
english.description: The Dark Iron are up to their usual tricks out here. They've been keeping to themselves, but I just know trouble's brewing.$B$BWe're going to take a look at it. There's a Dark Iron Scout puttering around the center of what used to be the Loch, keeping an eye out. I want you to take him out and bring back any documents or orders he has.$B$BIf my suspicions are unfounded... I'll take the blame from Moira myself. Promise ya.
english.completed: Return to Ashlan Stonesmirk at the Mo'grosh Camp in Loch Modan.

text.title: 寻找潜伏者
text.objectives: 消灭8只森林潜伏者。
text.description: 不知道你怎么想，不过我可不大喜欢蜘蛛，尤其不喜欢那些比我还要大的。洛克莫丹是个怡人的地方，但我要说得先把那些在附近溜达的恐怖玩意给除掉才行。$B$B告诉你吧，我有点闲钱，而你看起来又是个厉害角色。要是你去花时间帮我干掉那些家伙，我就付钱给你。
text.completion: I'll rest easier knowing one of those lumbering things won't be wandering into my bedroom at night... again.  Thanks much.

english.title: Looking for Lurkers
english.objectives: Kill 8 Forest Lurkers.
english.description: I don't know about you, but I'm not much a fan of spiders, much less the kind that come bigger than me. Loch Modan's a gorgeous place, but I'd say it could do without those horrid things waltzing around.$B$BTell you what, I've got some spare coin, and you look like a tough one. If you head out and off some of those things for me, I'll pay you for your time.
english.completion: I'll rest easier knowing one of those lumbering things won't be wandering into my bedroom at night... again.  Thanks much.

text.title: Impulse Hunting
text.objectives: Collect 6 Sides of Crocolisk from Loch Crocolisks.
text.description: Ashlan's no doubt going to send you off to the Loch to investigate the Dark Iron hooligans he keeps muttering about. If you're headed down there, might as well make some coin while you're at it, right?$B$BThe loch's draining wiped out most of the wildlife in it. Not many places to swim anymore. But there's still crocolisks padding around on the now-dry ground.$B$BThey'll starve in time, so we may as well get 'em while they're fresh. Bring me back some full sides of croc and we'll talk rewards.
text.completed: Return to Kelt Thomasin at the Mo'grosh Camp in Loch Modan.

english.title: Impulse Hunting
english.objectives: Collect 6 Sides of Crocolisk from Loch Crocolisks.
english.description: Ashlan's no doubt going to send you off to the Loch to investigate the Dark Iron hooligans he keeps muttering about. If you're headed down there, might as well make some coin while you're at it, right?$B$BThe loch's draining wiped out most of the wildlife in it. Not many places to swim anymore. But there's still crocolisks padding around on the now-dry ground.$B$BThey'll starve in time, so we may as well get 'em while they're fresh. Bring me back some full sides of croc and we'll talk rewards.
english.completed: Return to Kelt Thomasin at the Mo'grosh Camp in Loch Modan.

text.title: 马尔雷最后的飞行
text.objectives: 跟马尔雷·双辫谈一谈，乘坐他的飞行器兜一圈。
text.description: 嗨，$n！将这些圣物以及第一手报告交给我的父亲吧。$B$B在你的帮助下，飞行器可以正常运转了。我们可以一起飞翔，享受美妙的时光。$B$B你准备好出发的话，就跟我谈谈！
text.completion:
<The battered dwarf hangs limply from the cockpit. As you approach the burning wreckage, his eyes flutter open.>

<Marley Twinbraid is still alive!>

english.title: Marley's Final Flight
english.objectives: Talk to Marley Twinbraid and take a spin in his flying machine.
english.description: Okay, $n! Let's take these artifacts to my father and give him our report firsthand.$B$BThanks to your help my flying machine is ready to roll. We can fly there together and share in the glory.$B$BTalk to me when you're all set to move out!
english.completion:
<The battered dwarf hangs limply from the cockpit. As you approach the burning wreckage, his eyes flutter open.>

<Marley Twinbraid is still alive!>

objectiveDetails.description: 与马尔雷·双辫一起飞行

text.title: 推进力
text.objectives: 去找落帆海湾的凯尔希·钢烁。
text.description: 看来我们有更多的工作要做！诺格弗格先生能让我们处理剩下的海盗真是我们的荣幸。$B$B既然你这么有用，为什么不到落帆海湾去找我呢？我要找个稍微舒服点的交通工具摸进去，所以不要等我了。我会比你先到的，我保证！
text.completion: Hi there! The fun's already started!

english.title: Momentum
english.objectives: Meet Kelsey Steelspark at Lost Rigger Cove.
english.description: It looks like we've got more work to do! Having Mr. Noggenfogger ask us to take care of the rest of the pirates is a true honor.$B$BSince you've been SO helpful, why don't you meet me at Lost Rigger Cove? I've just got to slip into something a bit more comfortable, so don't wait on me. I'll beat you there, promise!
english.completion: Hi there! The fun's already started!

text.title: 重振士气
text.objectives: 使用卡亚零一度可乐营救王牌、小静、大胖以及6名地精幸存者或是科赞公民。
text.description: 让地精们都喝下卡亚零一度可乐。重振士气，帮助他们摆脱束缚！
text.completion: I hate the Trade Prince, but you can't argue with the results of his methods. Kaja'Cola Zero-One is a huge improvement over regular old Kaja'Cola at half the calories and twice the ideas!

english.title: Morale Boost
english.objectives: Use Kaja'Cola Zero-One to free Ace, Izzy, Gobber, and 6 Goblin Survivors or Kezan Citizens.
english.description: You've got to get all the Kaja'Cola Zero-One that you can and make the goblins drink it to boost their morale and free them!
english.completion: I hate the Trade Prince, but you can't argue with the results of his methods. Kaja'Cola Zero-One is a huge improvement over regular old Kaja'Cola at half the calories and twice the ideas!

text.title: 摧毁灵魂石！
text.objectives: 摧毁残酷主人“裂影”的灵魂石。
text.description: 只要残酷主人“裂影”还活着，这场噩梦就不会结束。想对付他需要注意几个问题。$B$B第一，他是个术士，所以他身边跟着一个名叫德莉西娅·鞭击的魅魔。如果你能在短时间内杀死裂影，魅魔就会返回虚空。$B$B第二，他是个术士，所以他可以通过灵魂石复活。你必须夺得灵魂石并彻底摧毁，让他死得透透的！
text.completion: Your soulstone has expired, Blastshadow!
text.giverWindow: 摧毁他的灵魂石！

english.title: Throw It On the Ground!
english.objectives: Destroy Blastshadow the Brutemaster's soulstone.
english.description: This nightmare will never be over while Blastshadow the Brutemaster still breathes. There are a couple of problems though.$B$BOne, being a warlock, he's got a succubus named Delicia Whipsnaps. If you kill Blastshadow quickly, the demon will go back to where it was summoned from.$B$BThe second problem, since Blastshadow is a warlock, he has a soulstone that allows him to resurrect. You have to get his soulstone and destroy it so that he'll be dead forever!
english.completion: Your soulstone has expired, Blastshadow!
english.giverWindow: Destroy his soulstone!

text.title: Brute Brutality
text.objectives: Slay 6 Brute Overseers.
text.description: I was thinking. You should probably take care of some of these Brute Overseers while you're doing everything else.$B$BYou know?
text.completed: Speak with Assistant Greely in the Gallywix Labor Mine on the Lost Isles.

english.title: Brute Brutality
english.objectives: Slay 6 Brute Overseers.
english.description: I was thinking. You should probably take care of some of these Brute Overseers while you're doing everything else.$B$BYou know?
english.completed: Speak with Assistant Greely in the Gallywix Labor Mine on the Lost Isles.

text.title: 矿道尽头的亮光
text.objectives: 与失落群岛加里维克斯劳工矿井外的采矿车进行交互。
text.description: 好啦，我们必须在火山爆发前离开这里！$B$B这就动身前往矿洞北边的矿道尽头吧。或许我们可以借用一辆采矿车，快速逃到火山脚下去。
text.completion: Looks a little rickety....

english.title: Light at the End of the Tunnel
english.objectives: Interact with the Mine Cart outside the Gallywix Labor Mine on the Lost Isles.
english.description: Okay, we have got to get out of here before she blows for good!$B$BLet's head out the other end of the tunnel on the north side of the mine. We should be able to use one of the mine carts for a quick ride down the side of the volcano.
english.completion: Looks a little rickety....

text.title: 小试身手
text.objectives: 杀掉6只杂斑野猪。
text.description: 第一项任务将在力量方面对你进行考验。我本来可以把你派去贫瘠之地猎杀科多兽，不过呢，照实说，你活着比死了对我们来说更有用。$b$b我相信，如果你去杀掉北边和东北边的农场里的一些杂斑野猪，对我们来说就更有价值了。
text.progress: I hope you haven't returned to try and convince me that you have completed your task, $n? No, of course not. I would think better of you.
text.completion: Hmmm, not bad, $n. But don't let it get to your head...you'll fight tougher than boars in your career.$b$bNonetheless, you've proven yourself well, and your next trial will be against a considerably more dangerous opponent, so you'll need some extra protection.

english.title: Cutting Teeth
english.objectives: Slaughter 6 Mottled Boars.
english.description: The first order of business will be to put a little strength in your backbone. I could send you out to the Barrens to hunt kodo, but well, in all honesty, you're more useful to us alive than dead.$b$bI believe you'll be of more use to us slaughtering the boars you'll find in the farms to the north and northeast of here.
english.progress: I hope you haven't returned to try and convince me that you have completed your task, $n? No, of course not. I would think better of you.
english.completion: Hmmm, not bad, $n. But don't let it get to your head...you'll fight tougher than boars in your career.$b$bNonetheless, you've proven yourself well, and your next trial will be against a considerably more dangerous opponent, so you'll need some extra protection.

text.title: 工蝎的尾巴
text.objectives: 获得8根工蝎的尾巴。
text.description: 我必须把你再次派到荒野中去，$c。在这里的西北方有大量蝎子在活动，你去给我带八条蝎尾回来。$b$b事实上，它们尾巴上的毒针正是制作解毒剂的重要材料，解毒剂是从毒针中提取的。我们必须备有大量的解毒剂，以防止像你这样的新手被蝎毒所害……$b$b但我肯定你是不会需要这种玩意的，对吧？
text.progress: The carapace of a scorpid isn't so thick that the strength of a determined warrior will be deterred. Strike strongly and without doubt, and the scorpids should prove easy prey.
text.completion: There is an important lesson that you must take away from fighting scorpids. The smallest or largest of opponents can still send you to your doom. In fierce combat, any number of things can prove your downfall.$b$bI have no more to teach you, $n. You have done well, and I will watch your progress with interest.

english.title: Sting of the Scorpid
english.objectives: Obtain 8 Scorpid Worker Tails.
english.description: I must send you back into the fields again, $c. You will find large numbers of scorpids northwest of here. Bring me eight of their tails.$b$bThe antidote for their sting is actually made from venom extracted from their stingers. We keep large quantities of antidote for scorpid venom on hand to heal young bloods just like you...$b$bBut I'm sure you won't be needing any of that, will you?
english.progress: The carapace of a scorpid isn't so thick that the strength of a determined warrior will be deterred. Strike strongly and without doubt, and the scorpids should prove easy prey.
english.completion: There is an important lesson that you must take away from fighting scorpids. The smallest or largest of opponents can still send you to your doom. In fierce combat, any number of things can prove your downfall.$b$bI have no more to teach you, $n. You have done well, and I will watch your progress with interest.

text.title: 哈纳祖
text.objectives: 在试炼谷中找到哈纳祖。
text.description: 嘿，伙计，稍等一下，听我说几句话。我们遇到了一个麻烦。$b$b我的一个好朋友哈纳祖到峡谷中去了，到现在还没有回来。我最后一次看到他的时候，他朝北边去了，那里是蝎子的狩猎场。你能去找找他吗？万灵告诉我说，他的情况很糟。
text.completion: <Hana'zua groans in pain.>

english.title: Hana'zua
english.objectives: Find Hana'zua in the Valley of Trials.
english.description: Hey mon, take a knee and hear me out.  We got a problem.$b$bA good friend of mine, Hana'zua, has gone out into the valley and he hasn't returned.  Last I seen, he was headin' north, where the scorpids hunt.  Maybe you go take a look for him?  The spirits be tellin' me that he's not well.
english.completion: <Hana'zua groans in pain.>

text.title: 萨科斯
text.objectives: 杀死萨科斯，并将它的爪子带回去交给哈纳祖。
text.description: $C！我差点就神不知鬼不觉地死在这鬼地方了！我在谷里捕猎蝎子的时候，突然看到一只看上去特别凶恶的蝎子。当时我就决定以它为猎物，打算在它那硕大的钳子钳住我的腿以前，先重重地给它来上那么一下子。$b$b但我忘记了它还有根毒刺，毒刺猛扎了下来，一下子就刺进我的胸口。拜托，你一定得替我报仇！只有这样才能留存我的名誉！我是在南边的高地上碰上它的。
text.progress: Ahhh... my father always said I would never amount to much, and here, lying beneath a tree as life seeps away, I'm afraid it looks like he was right.$b$bAt least I wish to die knowing that my last enemy in life lays dead.
text.completion: My blow was not enough to kill him, but looking at the damage I inflicted gives me some small measure of pride. That small measure will be all I have to sustain myself if I die, and in that light, the short list of my life's accomplishments fills me with anger.
text.giverWindow: 要小心躲避他的剧毒，朋友。

english.title: Sarkoth
english.objectives: Kill Sarkoth and bring his claw back to Hana'zua.
english.description: $C! I thought I would die out here with none to know of it. While I was hunting the scorpids of the Valley, I came across a particularly vicious-looking one. Hurling myself at it, I managed to inflict a massive blow to its claw before it closed around my leg.$b$bI wasn't ready for its stinger though, and it sliced down and into my chest, cutting into my flesh and letting my blood. Please, you must kill the scorpid for me! My honor must be upheld! I fought it up on the plateau to the south.
english.progress: Ahhh... my father always said I would never amount to much, and here, lying beneath a tree as life seeps away, I'm afraid it looks like he was right.$b$bAt least I wish to die knowing that my last enemy in life lays dead.
english.completion: My blow was not enough to kill him, but looking at the damage I inflicted gives me some small measure of pride. That small measure will be all I have to sustain myself if I die, and in that light, the short list of my life's accomplishments fills me with anger.
english.giverWindow: Be ready to dodge his poison, friend.

text.title: 返回大兽穴
text.objectives: 将哈纳祖目前的状况告诉试炼谷的高内克。
text.description: 看见你为我这么一个素不相识的可怜家伙做了这么多事情，我突然又坚强了起来。我绝不能就这么轻易地死在这种地方！我得坚持下去！$b$b可现在我还是不能自己回到营地去。$n，请你再帮个忙，回去向高内克报告一下我现在的情况。
text.completion: From your description of the beast, I believe you must be speaking of Sarkoth! It is no wonder that Hana'zua was overtaken by it. Aid will be dispatched to him immediately, trouble yourself no more with Hana'zua's plight.$b$bHowever, I must say, I am most impressed to hear that you brought Sarkoth to death. It is a feat to be proud of, $n. And that you would fight for a stranger's honor, while other tasks occupied your time, your own honor is heightened.

english.title: Back to the Den
english.objectives: Bring the news of Hana'zua's plight to Gornek in the Valley of Trials.
english.description: Seeing the deed you have done for me steels my heart. I cannot fall so easily! I must endure!$b$bBut it remains that I cannot make the trek back to our settlement unassisted. Please, $n, return and tell Gornek of my situation. Perhaps he can help me.
english.completion: From your description of the beast, I believe you must be speaking of Sarkoth! It is no wonder that Hana'zua was overtaken by it. Aid will be dispatched to him immediately, trouble yourself no more with Hana'zua's plight.$b$bHowever, I must say, I am most impressed to hear that you brought Sarkoth to death. It is a feat to be proud of, $n. And that you would fight for a stranger's honor, while other tasks occupied your time, your own honor is heightened.

text.title: 邪灵劣魔
text.objectives: 杀死8只邪灵劣魔。
text.description: 我相信你会在试炼谷学到很多东西，年轻的$c。$B$B我本是被派到这处谷地里来指引和教育你们的，但我却在这里发现了不断滋长的腐蚀气息……$B$B一个火刃教派的成员——这是个崇拜恶魔的邪恶教派——潜入了试炼谷，躲进北方的一处洞穴里，他的邪灵劣魔则不断从洞中涌出，在周边的一大片地区肆虐。$B$B作为你对抗火刃的第一个任务，我命令你消灭这些劣魔。尽可能地多杀一些，如果杀完了它们之后你还活着的话，就回来向我复命。
text.progress: To prove yourself against the Burning Blade, you must first defeat these vile familiars.  Return to me when you have done this.
text.completion: You have done well, $n.$B$BAlthough the Vile Familiars were merely pets of the darker powers within the Burning Blade, your success against them foretells greater deeds ahead.

english.title: Vile Familiars
english.objectives: Kill 8 Vile Familiars.
english.description: I trust the Valley of Trials will teach you much, young $c.$B$BI was sent to the Valley to guide you, but I have discovered a growing taint here...$B$BOne of the Burning Blade - a foul, demon-worshipping cult - has made camp here in the Valley of Trials.  He skulks in a cave to the north, and his vile familiars have spilled from its mouth to cause havoc.$B$BAs your first task against the Burning Blade, I bid you, defeat these familiars. Slay many and, if you survive, return to me.
english.progress: To prove yourself against the Burning Blade, you must first defeat these vile familiars.  Return to me when you have done this.
english.completion: You have done well, $n.$B$BAlthough the Vile Familiars were merely pets of the darker powers within the Burning Blade, your success against them foretells greater deeds ahead.

text.title: 火刃奖章
text.objectives: 杀死5只魔犬，并获得火刃奖章。
text.description: 通过占卜，我发现在火刃集会所的深处藏有一件蕴涵着强大力量的物品——一枚奖章，它被一些猛兽和黑暗的魔法守卫着。我们必须得到它。$b$b这些膜拜恶魔的家伙已经污染我们的家园很久了。杀死那些恶魔野兽和他们的头目，净化洞穴中的恶魔污染。带着那枚奖章回来作为证明。$B$B去吧，$n。你可以在北边的一座洞穴中找到他们的集会所。
text.progress: Is your task complete, $n?
text.completion: You retrieved it!  Well done!$B$BYour efforts within the Burning Blade Coven are key in rooting out this cult in the Valley of Trials.  But I fear they have further aims in our land.$B$BWe have not seen the end of them.

english.title: Burning Blade Medallion
english.objectives: Slay 5 Felstalkers and obtain the Burning Blade Medallion.
english.description: Through my divinations, I see that an item of power - a medallion - hides deep within the Burning Blade Coven, guarded by beasts and black magic.  We must have it.$b$bFor too long these demon-worshippers have defiled our homelands.  Cleanse the coven of its demonic taint by slaying the fel beasts and their leader.  Return with this medallion as proof of your deed.$B$BGo, $n.  You will find the coven in a cave to the north.
english.progress: Is your task complete, $n?
english.completion: You retrieved it!  Well done!$B$BYour efforts within the Burning Blade Coven are key in rooting out this cult in the Valley of Trials.  But I fear they have further aims in our land.$B$BWe have not seen the end of them.

text.title: 去森金村报到
text.objectives: 与森金村的加德林大师谈一谈。
text.description: 你在这山谷中的针对火刃氏族的试炼……如今就算是完成了。但我希望你能去向其他人报告一下你的发现。$B$B到森金村去找加德林大师吧。先从山谷的东侧出去，在岔路口转向右一直走到底就能抵达森金村了。$B$B我们必须把火刃氏族的势力出现在试炼谷的事告诉加德林大师。$B$B去吧，$n，动作要快。恐怕我们在火刃集会所中找到的东西只是更可怕的威胁的预兆而已……

english.title: Report to Sen'jin Village
english.objectives: Speak with Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.
english.description: Your trials against the Burning Blade are finished... here in the Valley.  But I want you to report your findings.$B$BGo to the troll village of Sen'jin and seek out Master Gadrin.  Sen'jin Village is east out of the valley, then right at the fork.$B$BTell Gadrin of the Burning Blade, and that they have reached the Valley of Trials.  Discover from him if they have yet reached Sen'jin.$B$BGo, $n, and be swift.  I fear the evil found in the Burning Blade Coven is but the herald of a larger threat...

text.title: Lazy Peons
text.objectives: Use the Foreman's Blackjack on 4 Lazy Peons when they're sleeping.
text.description: Cursed peons!  They work hard gathering lumber from the trees of the valley, but they're always taking naps!  I need someone to help keep the peons in line.$B$BYou look like the right $r for my task.  Here, you take this blackjack and use it on any lazy peons you find sleeping on the job.  A good smack will get them right back to work!  Return the blackjack when you're done.$B$BLook for them underneath the trees in the valley.  Lousy slacking peons...

A good smack will get them right back to work!  Return the blackjack when you're done.$B$BLook for them underneath the trees in the valley.  Lousy slacking peons...

text.title: 塔兹利尔的镐
text.objectives: 将塔兹利尔的镐还给塔兹利尔。
text.description: $n，你是个值得信赖的$r。我能把另一个任务也托付给你吗？$B$B不久前，我在北边的一个洞穴中挖掘矿石的时候不小心弄丢了我最喜欢的镐。后来当我回去找它的时候，却发现洞穴中住满了邪恶的野兽！到那个被称作火刃集会所的洞穴中去帮我取回我的镐，行吗？$B$B我把它放在一个有瀑布的大厅里了。我的镐附有魔法，你在黑暗中也能看见它，所以你不必担心找不到它……只要小心那些守护它的野兽就是了！
text.progress: Have you entered the Burning Blade Coven, $n?  Did you find my pick?
text.completion: Great, you got it!  Thanks a lot, $n.  This is my favorite pick!  Now if my peons ever finish chopping down these trees, maybe we can find a nice cave to mine!

english.title: Thazz'ril's Pick
english.objectives: Bring Thazz'ril's Pick to Foreman Thazz'ril.
english.description: $n, you are a dependable $r.  Can I count on you for another task?$B$BSome time ago I was surveying the cave to the north for minerals, and I left my favorite pick behind.  When I later returned to retrieve it I found the cave was filled with vicious beasts!  Will you go into the cave, the Burning Blade Coven, and get my pick?$B$BI left it in a chamber with waterfalls.  My pick has a spell on it so you can see it in the dark, so you won't have to worry about finding it... just what's guarding it!
english.progress: Have you entered the Burning Blade Coven, $n?  Did you find my pick?
english.completion: Great, you got it!  Thanks a lot, $n.  This is my favorite pick!  Now if my peons ever finish chopping down these trees, maybe we can find a nice cave to mine!

text.title: 戈加尔的清凉果
text.objectives: 收集6颗仙人掌果。
text.description: 试炼谷这里真是热得要死。$B$B<戈加尔擦了擦额头。>$B$B如果我有仙人掌果的话，就可以做点清凉果来吃了！没什么能比清凉果更甘甜消暑的。$B$B我跟你说啊，$n，只要你给我弄6颗仙人掌果来，我就帮你做一些清凉果。如果你感兴趣的话，就到这附近去找找仙人掌，采集它们的果子。
text.progress: Have you finished collecting cactus apples?
text.completion: Wonderful, $n! As promised, here is your cactus apple surprise plus a little something extra.

english.title: Galgar's Cactus Apple Surprise
english.objectives: Obtain 6 Cactus Apples.
english.description: It sure gets hot out here in the Valley of Trials.$B$B<Galgar wipes his brow.>$B$BIf only I had some cactus apples, I could make my famous cactus apple surprise! Nothing cools you off faster than a piece of that delicious treat.$B$BI'll tell you what, $n. If you bring me 6 cactus apples, I'll make you a few portions of cactus apple surprise to take with you on your adventures. If you're interested, you can find cactus apples growing near the cactus plants around here.
english.progress: Have you finished collecting cactus apples?
english.completion: Wonderful, $n! As promised, here is your cactus apple surprise plus a little something extra.

text.title: Valley of Trials: PRK - H - Warlock Pet Imp
text.objectives: Bring 6 Vile Familiar Heads to Ruzan.
text.description: Those warlocks who came before us have earned the distrust of the Horde, and while we are tolerated, we are not loved.$b$bThis has not brought the warlocks closer together, however, as many choose to live reclusively, dabbling in their magics alone. I will not seek to lead you down one path or the other, but only help you in your maturation.$b$bBefore I teach you the art of summoning, bring me six heads of the vile familiars from the cave to the northeast.
text.completed: Return to Ruzan at Valley of Trials in Durotar.

text.objectives: Read the Glyphic Parchment and speak with Acrypha in the Valley of Trials.
text.description: Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, $n.$B$BRead it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the mage trainer Acrypha. She would have words with you when you're ready.
text.progress: What?  Who are you?  Get away!$b$bOh, you're the other mage, the new one, the one with the $g big arms: funny hair;.  Come on, let's get to work.

text.title: Steady Shot
text.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Steady Shot. Locate a Training Dummy and practice using Steady Shot 5 times.
text.description:
You already know how to fire an arcane shot. Good. But doing so depletes your focus. To gain your focus back you will need to switch to a second type of ranged attack.

Go out and get some more experience. As you do, you'll learn some new abilities. The first of these will help you get your focus back.
text.progress: Whenever you're ready, we'll move forward.
text.completion: You learn quickly.

text.title: Swine Hunting
text.objectives: Pluck Lo'shall's hair.  You may wish to use Track Beasts.
text.description: Just to the south of this village, you will find a young swine that goes by the name of Lo'shall.  He hides among the cactus and the trees.  While he is small of size, he conceals an intelligence that most boars lack.$b$bFind him, pluck one of his hairs, and then return to me.$b$bRemember what I taught you, $n.  You may find Track Beasts to be helpful here.
text.completed: Return to Karranisha at the Valley of Trials in Durotar.

text.objectives: Reach Level 3 to Learn Eviscerate, then locate a Training Dummy and practice using Eviscerate 3 times.
text.description: Let's start with the basics, shall we?  I'm the only rogue trainer in town, so you're going to have to learn it from me.$b$bGo get some more experience, figure out how to eviscerate your foes, and then show me on the training dummies here. I'll evaluate your form.

text.objectives: Use your Stealth ability next to Rwag in the Valley of Trials.
text.description: I want to see you try to sneak past me.  I'll still be able to detect you, since you're still a novice, so don't try anything funny.  I just want to see what you've learned.
text.completed: Return to Rwag at the Valley of Trials in Durotar.

text.objectives: Learn Primal Strike by reaching Level 3, then look for a training dummy near Shikrik and practice using Primal Strike 3 times.
text.description:
As you grow in power by gaining levels, you will discover the power to use new abilities. The first you will discover on your journey is Primal Strike.

Use it to deliver a strike with your weapon, infused with the power of the elements.$B$BIt is time to learn and master your new skill. Practice using it on the training dummies outside the Den.

text.title: Rock Meets Flesh
text.objectives: Defeat a Captured Northwatch Scout while your weapon is enchanted with Rockbiter Weapon.
text.description: Our village leaders have apprehended human invaders that have attempted to enter the valley.  These invaders are kept in cages, in the cave to the west.$b$bI want you to use this ability on one of these invaders, $n.  Enchant your blade with the power of earth, then strike out at these enemies!

Go, get more experience, learn a new spell, and then practice your new spell against one of the training dummies around here.

These invaders are kept in cages, in the cave to the west.$b$bI want you to use your shout on one of these invaders, $n.  Defeat a captured Northwatch scout while under the effects of your battle shout.  Return when you are successful.

text.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Frost Nova. Locate a Training Dummy and practice using Frost Nova 2 times.
text.description:
Alright, here's the easy part.

All you have to do to deepen your connection to the arcane is to get more experience and grow your power. You'll begin to find that you can cast new spells.

You'll see. Go try it, and show me what you learn.

text.description: Arcane Intellect is a spell that you can use on yourself, your friends, or even random passers-by.  While under the spell's temporary effect, you should feel a bit more... mentally acute.  Now let's try it out.$b$bI want you to cast Arcane Intellect on someone.  Actually, scratch that.  I want you to cast it on ME.

text.title: 他需要麦酒！
text.objectives: 在巴尔丹城堡内找到一杯陈年招牌烈酒，将它交给入口处的马尔雷·双辫。
text.description: <马尔雷的手上满是血污，他颤抖着抓住你耳边的头发。>$B$B麦酒……要……麦酒……$B$B城堡里有陈年招牌烈酒。<他剧烈地咳嗽起来。>我……需要它。
text.progress:
<Marley's breathing is ragged, coming and going in shuddering gasps.>

<His eyes look at you imploringly.>
text.completion:
<Marley's eyes sparkle as you rush toward him with the ale. He grasps the mug in both of his shaking hands and upends it, white foam spilling out over his blood-caked beard.>

Ah... that's the stuff. Ol' Barkerstout... Thank you, friend.

That'll make this... a little easier.

<Coughing one final time, he slumps over the shattered control console, the half-empty mug crashing to the ground and spilling its contents into the sand. His eyes glaze over.>

<Marley Twinbraid is dead.>

text.title: 你的位置
text.objectives: 跟高内克谈一谈。
text.description: 终于，你成年了，$n……是以部落的名义上战场的年纪。为了酋长的荣誉去征战吧。$B$B是的……$B$B<卡尔图克打量着你。>$B$B你会成功的。$B$B无疑你急于想要赤手空拳对付一条龙或是恶魔，但也许最好从不那么……危险的事情开始着手。$B$B<卡尔图克笑了。>$B$B去找高内克，他应该有任务适合指派给一个年轻的$c。他就坐在我身后的火边。
text.completion: Another one of Kaltunk's recruits, hm?$b$bA sorry state of affairs we find ourselves in if this is the best the Horde can produce. No matter. By the time we think you're ready to leave the Valley, you'll be a proud warrior of the Horde.

english.title: Your Place In The World
english.objectives: Speak with Gornek.
english.description: Finally, you are of age, $n... of age to battle in the name of the Horde. To conquer for the glory of the Warchief.$B$BYes...$B$B<Kaltunk looks you over.>$B$BYou will do nicely.$B$BNo doubt you wish to find a great dragon or demon and strangle it with your bare hands, but perhaps it would be wise to start on something less... dangerous.$B$B<Kaltunk laughs.>$B$BReport to Gornek, he should be able to assign a task better suited to a young $c. You will find him seated at the fire behind me.
english.completion: Another one of Kaltunk's recruits, hm?$b$bA sorry state of affairs we find ourselves in if this is the best the Horde can produce. No matter. By the time we think you're ready to leave the Valley, you'll be a proud warrior of the Horde.

text.title: 营救巴尔丹幸存者
text.objectives: 进入巴尔丹城堡，从废墟中营救10名巴尔丹幸存者。$B$B使用紧急灭火阀保护自己不被火焰吞噬。
text.description: 帮帮忙！帮帮忙啊！你就不能伸出援手吗！$B$B城堡里还有很多矮人——他们被活活掩埋在废墟和火焰里！那真是噩梦般的回忆。城堡的屋顶随时都可能坍塌……$B$B$c，求求你，救救他们吧！$B$B冲进城堡，使用紧急灭火阀保护自己不被火焰吞噬。你是那些幸存者唯一的希望……
text.completion:
You're a legend, $N.

The other survivors and I will be telling the story of your deeds for years to come.

english.title: Bael'dun Rescue
english.objectives: Go into Bael'dun Keep and rescue 10 Bael'dun Survivors from the rubble.$B$BUse the Emergency Fire Valves to protect yourself from the flames.
english.description: Help - Help! You've got to do something!$B$BSome dwarves are still inside - so many - they're trapped in the debris. Buried alive. The flames! It's a nightmare in there. We don't know how much longer until the roof collapses...$B$BPlease, $c, you've got to save them!$B$BRun inside. Use the emergency fire valves to protect yourself from the flames. You're the only hope they have...
english.completion:
You're a legend, $N.

The other survivors and I will be telling the story of your deeds for years to come.

text.title: 给莉娜的礼物
text.objectives: 切割3颗永恒夜之石，把它们交给暴风城的伊莎贝尔·琼斯。
text.description: 我正在试图拉拢一艘商船的船长莉娜。我动手制作了一条项链，用来配她漂亮的紫色秀发，但是宝石却不翼而飞了！昨天晚上，我把项链给好友柯薇儿欣赏的时候，它们还好好的呢。当时我们在喝月光酒，我醉倒了——醒来之后宝石就不见了！肯定是很厉害的盗贼偷走的，因为柯薇儿什么都没看到。$b$b她的船今晚就要靠港，我需要三颗夜之石来完成这件给她的礼物。帮帮我吧！

english.title: A Present for Lila
english.objectives: Cut three Timeless Nightstones and give them to Isabel Jones in Stormwind City.
english.description: I'm trying to impress this trade ship captain Lila.  I've been working on a necklace to match her lovely purple hair, but the gems have gone missing!  They were there when I was showing them off to my good friend Curver last evening.  We were drinking moonshine and I blacked out - when I woke up the gems were gone!  They must have been darn good thieves, because Curver didn't see anything.$b$bHer ship is coming in tonight, and I really need three nightstones to get her present done.  Help me out here!

text.title: 诡异的欧格佐尼亚斯
text.objectives: 切割3颗裂纹碧玉，把它们交给暴风城的伊莎贝尔·琼斯。
text.description: 艾泽拉斯快递公司应该送一批碧玉来给我的，但我刚刚听说他们的船撞上了一座名叫欧格佐尼亚的小岛。我挺担心那些船员的，据说岛上的女食人魔会对不幸登岛的男性举行可怕的仪式。不过，我的工作还得继续，我们需要那些宝石。我听说你是个非常出色的珠宝匠——今晚之前能交给我三颗裂纹碧玉吗？

english.title: Ogrezonians in the Mood
english.objectives: Cut three Jagged Jaspers and give them to Isabel Jones in Stormwind City.
english.description: I was supposed to receive a shipment of jasper from Azeroth Express, but I just heard their ship crashed into some tiny island called Ogrezonia.  I worry about the crew, as the giant female ogres on the island are rumored to perform horrible rituals on men who happen upon their island.  My work must go on, though, and we need those gems.  I've heard great things about your skill as a jewelcrafter - could you deliver three jagged jaspers by the end of the day?

text.title: 元素粘稠物
text.objectives: 从任意灾变元素生物身上收集10份元素粘稠物，把它们交给暴风城的伊莎贝尔·琼斯。
text.description: 我厌倦了那套将宝石镶入戒指首饰的老办法，开始使用一种具有创造性的全新手艺。只需用巴恩沃斯神奇元素胶水把宝石粘上去就好啦！不过教授需要更多元素粘稠物才能制作新的胶水，而我手头的工作堆积如山。你能去帮我弄一点吗？

english.title: Elemental Goo
english.objectives: Collect 10 Elemental Goo from any Cataclysm elemental and bring them to Isabel Jones in Stormwind City.
english.description: Instead of using the tired old method of setting gems into rings and such, I use an innovative new method.  I simply glue on the gems with Barnsworth Elemental Glue!  The professor needs more elemental goo for another batch, though, and I have a whole bunch of setting to do.  Can you go get me some?

text.title: The Latest Fashion!
text.objectives: Test Stardust No. 2 on 10 "humanoid subjects".
text.description: Professor Barnsworth has been working on this new stardust - what with the fashion in Stormwind this season being about all things sparkly, I'm sure if we can get it to the market it will be all the rage!  The Jewelcrafter's Association, however, won't let us market it until we've completed some humanoid testing - something about tinkering with magical dust being dangerous or some such nonsense.  Well, I suppose we need to humor them.  Take this bag and test out Stardust No. 2 on some humanoid subjects.

text.title: 龅牙！不！
text.objectives: 切割3颗致密泽菲蓝晶石，把它们交给奥格瑞玛的玛瑞希·拉苏妮亚。
text.description: 莉娜的宠物龅牙又闯进我的作坊了！$b$b当时我正在制作一只手镯，是今天就要交货的。工作就要完成了，只差镶宝石的环节。我花了一整晚切割宝石，但是就在我出去吃早餐的那一小会，该死的小怪物冲进我的作坊，把它看到的所有宝石都给吞了！那东西可以消化一切，而且说正经的，光是收拾它留下的一堆烂摊子就足以让你累断腰了。$b$b我必须尽快弄到备用的宝石，信使今晚就要来了。帮帮忙啊！

english.title: Nibbler!  No!
english.objectives: Cut three Solid Zephyrites and give them to Marith Lazuria in Orgrimmar.
english.description: Lila's pet Nibbler got into my workshop again!$b$bI was making a bracelet, to be delivered today.  The work was almost done, except for the gems.  I spent all night cutting them, but when I stepped out for a bit of breakfast, the little beast came into my workshop and swallowed every gem in sight!  The thing can digest ANYTHING, and trust me, you'd break your back trying to pick up its leavings.$b$bI need to get replacement gems fast; the courier is coming in tonight.  Help!

text.title: 时尚潮流！
text.objectives: 对10名“人型生物目标”测试星尘2号。
text.description: 维恩斯通博士正在研究新的星尘——这可是本季度奥格瑞玛最热门的玩意，它能令一切都闪闪发光。如果我们将它投放市场的话，肯定要赚翻了！不过珠宝匠协会不允许我们贩卖它，除非我们完成一些“活体实验”——因为他们觉得使用魔法尘可能会导致危险什么的。好吧，看来我们得迎合他们一下。把这袋星尘拿上，找些人来测试星尘2号。

english.title: The Latest Fashion!
english.objectives: Test Stardust No. 2 on 10 "humanoid subjects".
english.description: Dr. Vernstrom has been working on this new stardust - what with the fashion in Orgrimmar this season being about all things sparkly, I'm sure if we can get it to the market it will be all the rage!  The Jewelcrafter's Association, however, won't let us market it until we've completed some "live testing" - something about tinkering with magical dust being dangerous or some such nonsense.  Well, I suppose we need to humor them.  Take this bag and test out Stardust No. 2 on humanoid subjects.

The doctor needs more elemental goo for another batch, though, and I have a whole bunch of setting to do.  Can you go get me some?

text.title: 谁干的？
text.objectives: 在巴尔丹城堡中找到一具部落的尸体。
text.description: 阴谋！这是个阴谋。城堡的仓库发生了爆炸。肯定有部落潜了进来……$B$B$C，你既然有勇气冲进这座燃烧的城堡……就去寻找灾难的线索吧。将军迫不及待地想要知道答案！在废墟中寻找部落的尸体，揭开这场灾难背后的秘密……
text.completion:
<One smoldering corpse stands out amidst the carnage. The dead goblin clutches the schematics of the fortress in his lifeless hand...>

<The Bilgewater Cartel goblins. They did this!>
text.completed: 在南贫瘠之地的巴尔丹城堡中找到一具部落尸体。

english.title: Who Did This?
english.objectives: Look for a Horde corpse within Bael'dun Keep.
english.description: Sabotage! It had to be. The whole fortress magazine exploded. The Horde must've gotten someone inside...$B$B$C, if you've the stones to rush into that burning nightmare... look for some clues as to who did this to us. The General will want to know! Look for a Horde corpse in the wreckage and get to the bottom of this disaster...
english.completion:
<One smoldering corpse stands out amidst the carnage. The dead goblin clutches the schematics of the fortress in his lifeless hand...>

<The Bilgewater Cartel goblins. They did this!>
english.completed: Look for a Horde corpse within Bael'dun Keep in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 背水一战
text.objectives: 保卫大地之环营地直到纳迦撤退。
text.description: 纳迦打过来了，$c。帮我们击退他们！

english.title: Backed Into a Corner
english.objectives: Defend the Earthen Ring camp until the naga retreat.
english.description: The naga are upon us, $c. Aid us in fightin' dem off!

objectiveDetails.description: 击败深水领主金加塔尔

text.title: 永远不要相信大蝎刺和微笑
text.objectives: 将毒素萃取图腾插在巨钳蝎附近，收集6份蝎毒样本。
text.description: 接下来，我们需要附近的蝎子身上的毒药。不要担心，波贝不会让你受伤的！$b$b波贝有一个大图腾，你在蝎子攻击时把它插在地上。图腾会吸收所有的毒素，你就可以活着回来啦。听起来不错吧？

english.title: Never Trust a Big Barb and a Smile
english.objectives: Obtain 6 samples of Scorpid Venom by placing the Poison Extraction Totem near a Clattering Scorpid.
english.description: Next, we gonna get some poison from the scorpions that be runnin' around here.  But don't you worry, Bom'bay's not gonna let you get hurt!$b$bBom'bay's got a big totem that you gonna stick in the ground when the scorpion strikes.  The totem gonna suck up all the poison, and you gonna walk away still breathing.  Sound good?

text.title: 恐须船长
text.objectives: 杀死恐须船长。
text.description: 真是有意思，不过别忘了我们是为了诺莫瑞根来的！$B$B我们在南边的一艘小艇上发现了南海海盗的船长，就在战场后面。小船上就他一个人，毫无防守！$B$B如果你能去把他干掉，剩下来的海盗我们转眼就能清光。
text.completion: He was controlling a sea giant? Fascinating. If we'd managed to investigate further...$B$BOh, I mean, wow, that's totally crazy! But thank goodness he's gone, hooray! Mister Noggenfogger will be so pleased.$B$BHere's a nice big reward, you!
text.giverWindow: 可怕的胡须。

english.title: Captain Dreadbeard
english.objectives: Kill Captain Dreadbeard.
english.description: This is getting pretty fun, but let's not forget we're here for Gnomeregan!$B$BWe spotted the captain of the Southsea over on one of his boats to the south, past where all the fighting is. He's all alone on his little boat, undefended!$B$BIf you go take care of him, we'll have the rest of these pirates mopped up in no time.
english.completion: He was controlling a sea giant? Fascinating. If we'd managed to investigate further...$B$BOh, I mean, wow, that's totally crazy! But thank goodness he's gone, hooray! Mister Noggenfogger will be so pleased.$B$BHere's a nice big reward, you!
english.giverWindow: Fear the beard.

text.title: 斩断链条
text.objectives: 摧毁3只北方城堡补给箱，并杀死10个北卫军劳工。
text.description: 啊，伙计，这可真不妙。不是一般的不妙。$b$b萨尔出海去了，沃金在处理回音群岛的事，老加德林大师留在了森金村。然后呢？那些人类从北方城堡出来，在我们的后院扎营了！$B$B幸运的是，他们刚来不久，还在忙着建造基地。你可以帮助老加德林，摧毁他们搬来的物资储备箱，以及搬运它们的劳工。你可以在西南边找到他们。
text.completion: Well, we've stymied their efforts for now, but they're still here.  We'll have to press on, $n.

english.title: Breaking the Chain
english.objectives: Destroy 3 Northwatch Supply Crates and kill 10 Northwatch Lugs.
english.description: Aw man, this ain't good.  Not one bit, mon.$b$bThrall's off to sea, Vol'jin's taking care of business in Echo Isles, and old Master Gadrin is left behind to take care of Sen'jin.  And then what happens?  Those humans come outta Northwatch Hold and set up camp in our backyard!$b$bLucky for us, they just got here, and they're still setting up their base.  You can help out old Gadrin by destroying those big supply crates they carry, and by killing the laborers carryin' them. You'll find'm to the southwest.
english.completion: Well, we've stymied their efforts for now, but they're still here.  We'll have to press on, $n.

text.title: 净化峡谷
text.objectives: 在北卫军根据地击败12名北卫军的士兵。
text.description: 北方城堡是一座有重兵把守的要塞，坐落在这里的西南方，过了港口就是。这是一座具有重大战略意义的要塞，部落仍在为了攻陷它而努力。我们不能让人类在杜隆塔尔再建起一座北方城堡来。$b$b去西边的峡谷中大开杀戒，干掉那些人类，$n。让他们感受森金的愤怒和力量吧。
text.completion: A battle well-fought, $c, but I still have my doubts about our effectiveness.  These humans don't seem to be going anywhere.$b$bYou, however, have done more than could reasonably be asked of any loyal member of the Horde.  Thank you.

english.title: Purge the Valley
english.objectives: Defeat 12 Northwatch troops in Northwatch Foothold.
english.description: Northwatch is a highly-defended stronghold southwest of here, across the harbor.  It's a strategically-located stronghold that the Horde still struggles to overtake.  We don't need the humans setting up another Northwatch here in Durotar.$b$bSweep through the valley to the west and slay these humans, $n.  Let them know the power and the fury of Sen'jin.
english.completion: A battle well-fought, $c, but I still have my doubts about our effectiveness.  These humans don't seem to be going anywhere.$b$bYou, however, have done more than could reasonably be asked of any loyal member of the Horde.  Thank you.

text.title: 北卫军的侵略战争
text.objectives: 在北卫军根据地里摧毁3份进攻计划。
text.description: 西边的那些人类，可不是只打算在杜隆塔尔扎个营就算了的，伙计。他们有更大的计划，比如占领我们的家园，把我们斩首示众之类的。$b$b我可不答应！绝对不行！拉尔不答应！我的家人都在森金村，我绝对不能允许那些蛮子把我心爱的泰塔希的脑袋挂起来！$b$b他们的计划都是写下来的，伙计。大卷轴，看起来很重要。在他们烧死我们之前，我们要烧掉那些卷轴。
text.completion: Good work, hero.  You done good for Sen'jin today.  No... you done good for all of Durotar.

english.title: The War of Northwatch Aggression
english.objectives: Destroy the 3 sets of Attack Plans held within Northwatch Foothold.
english.description: These humans in the west, they don't just wanna camp out in Durotar, mon.  They got bigger plans, and those plans involve takin' our home and leavin' our skulls on pikes.$b$bWell I'm not havin' it.  Nope!  Not Lar!  I've got family here in Sen'jin, and I'll be damned if I let one of those brutes put my Tai'tasi's head on a stick!$b$bThey've got their plans written down in there, mon.  Big scrolls, real important-lookin'.  We gonna burn those scrolls before they burn us.
english.completion: Good work, hero.  You done good for Sen'jin today.  No... you done good for all of Durotar.

objectiveDetails.description: 烧毁进攻计划：奥格瑞玛

text.title: 清理海岸
text.objectives: 收集5抷蟹胶。
text.description: 你好呀，伙计！波贝正在试制新的魔精。你要来点吗？嗯，在这之前，波贝得让你帮忙去弄点材料。$b$b首先，波贝需要你去水边，从螃蟹身上弄些黏糊糊的东西。让我看看你的手！$b$b<波贝仔细检查了一下你的手。>$b$b波贝需要5捧。快去吧！
text.progress: You bring the jujus, I show you my mojo.
text.completion: Ya mon, that's tha stuff.  Now we get the other jujus.

english.title: Cleaning Up the Coastline
english.objectives: Obtain 5 handfuls of Crawler Mucus.
english.description: Heya mon!  Bom'bay be workin' on some new mojo.  You wanna try a piece of it?  Well, before ya do, Bom'bay's gonna need ya to pick up some jujus.$b$bFirst, Bom'bay needs ya to get some o' the goop from the crabs down by the water.  Let me see your hands!$b$b<Bom'bay examines your hands closely.>$b$bBom'bay gonna need 5 handfuls.  Go on now!
english.progress: You bring the jujus, I show you my mojo.
english.completion: Ya mon, that's tha stuff.  Now we get the other jujus.

text.title: 骑狼旅行
text.objectives: 与狼骑兵希亚什交谈，让他送你前往剃刀岭。抵达之后，与加索克交谈。
text.description: 我们必须把情况告知剃刀岭。这些人类今天也许是败退了，但他们改日肯定要卷土重来，届时我们就需要兽人的帮助了。$b$b去跟希亚什谈谈，他就在森金村的大门外。他会送你去剃刀岭的。他的狼很熟悉这条路。
text.completion: That troll wants us to send help?  Bah, he can forget it.  I've got my own human problems to worry about, and even those are the least of my worries right now.$b$bSen'jin Village is right next to Echo Isles and the Valley of Trials.  Old Gadrin should find plenty of youngbloods to help him with his human infestation.

english.title: Riding On
english.objectives: Speak to Raider Jhash to get a ride to Razor Hill.  Once there, speak with Gar'thok.
english.description: We gotta pass the word on to Razor Hill.  These humans may be defeated today, but tomorrow they'll come again, and when they do, we'll need help from the orcs.$b$bSpeak with Jhash, outside the gates of Sen'jin.  He'll give you a ride to Razor Hill.  His wolves know the path well.
english.completion: That troll wants us to send help?  Bah, he can forget it.  I've got my own human problems to worry about, and even those are the least of my worries right now.$b$bSen'jin Village is right next to Echo Isles and the Valley of Trials.  Old Gadrin should find plenty of youngbloods to help him with his human infestation.

text.title: 家园里的入侵者
text.objectives: 杀死7个北卫军斥候。
text.description: 你不是个普通的步兵——好像是个挺认真的$c呢。很好，这正是我要的。$b$b你最好不要声张，因为我不想引起恐慌……有报告称附近有更多人类活动。这是明目张胆地违反我们与那个可悲的吉安娜·普罗德摩尔签订的和平协议！我们不能允许人类踏足杜隆塔尔，尤其是试炼谷。$b$b你可以在南边找到他们。快点去把他们干掉，免得他们人数越来越多。
text.progress: Quickly, $n.  Dispatch of these humans in our valley.
text.completion: Executed with quickness and discretion.  A job well done.

english.title: Invaders in Our Home
english.objectives: Slay 7 Northwatch Scouts.
english.description: You're not just another grunt - you seem to be a serious $c.  Good, because that's exactly what I need.$b$bTry not to let the word out, since I don't want to cause a panic... but there have been reports of more humans nearby.  This is an egregious betrayal of the peace that we negotiated with that miserable Jaina Proudmoore!  We can't allow humans here in Durotar, and especially not here in the Valley.$b$bYou will find them to the south.  Slay them quickly, before their numbers increase any more.
english.progress: Quickly, $n.  Dispatch of these humans in our valley.
english.completion: Executed with quickness and discretion.  A job well done.

text.title: 越来越糟
text.objectives: 在提拉加德城堡中杀死6个北卫军水兵、6个北卫军射手和帕里特中尉。
text.description: 提拉加德城堡坐落在这里的东南方，杜隆塔尔的东部海岸上。你从森金村过来的路上也许会经过它。这座城堡一直以来都是我的眼中钉肉中刺。$b$b库尔提拉斯来的人类在城堡里住了好些年，每次我试图攻陷它的努力都无功而返。大灾变降临时，海岸线被撕裂，那座城堡和里面的人类也都玩完了。不过，北方城堡的那帮自以为是的家伙又跑去替代了他们的位置！$b$b<加索克发出了攻击性的咆哮。>
text.completion: Word of your bravery travels fast, $c. Tales of your victory at Tiragarde Keep will be heralded in Orgrimmar.

english.title: From Bad to Worse
english.objectives: Kill 6 Northwatch Marines, 6 Northwatch Sharpshooters, and Lieutenant Palliter in Tiragarde Keep.
english.description: Tiragarde Keep lies to the southeast of here, on Durotar's eastern shore.  You probably passed it on your trip from Sen'jin Village.  This castle has been a thorn in my side for too long.$b$bHumans from Kul Tiras lived in the castle for years, thwarting my every attempt to crush them.  When the cataclysm hit us, the shore was wiped out, along with the castle and all the humans.  However, these upstarts from Northwatch have moved in to take their place!$b$b<Gar'Thok roars in aggravation.>
english.completion: Word of your bravery travels fast, $c. Tales of your victory at Tiragarde Keep will be heralded in Orgrimmar.

text.title: 告知双辫将军
text.objectives: 返回南贫瘠之地双辫将军的巡逻岗，向双辫将军复命。
text.description: <应该将这次卑劣的袭击行动汇报给双辫将军。你开始收集证据。>
text.completion:
What... WHAT!?

Bael'dun in ruins? Corpses everywhere - no. No!

<You describe the evidence you found at the scene.>

The Bilgewater goblins, was it? They want a fight do they? We'll show 'em what it means to be a part of the Horde, we will. I'll fill the Battlescar with their corpses. I'll redden the dirt with their blood.

<Twinbraid grabs you by the collar.>

Goblins. Are going. To die!
text.completed: 去找南贫瘠之地双辫将军的巡逻岗的双辫将军。

english.title: Twinbraid Needs to Know
english.objectives: Report to General Twinbraid at Twinbraid's Patrol in Southern Barrens.
english.description: <General Twinbraid will want to know the details of this cowardly attack. You gather up the evidence.>
english.completion:
What... WHAT!?

Bael'dun in ruins? Corpses everywhere - no. No!

<You describe the evidence you found at the scene.>

The Bilgewater goblins, was it? They want a fight do they? We'll show 'em what it means to be a part of the Horde, we will. I'll fill the Battlescar with their corpses. I'll redden the dirt with their blood.

<Twinbraid grabs you by the collar.>

Goblins. Are going. To die!
english.completed: Report to General Twinbraid at Twinbraid's Patrol in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 坏消息
text.objectives: 前往南贫瘠之地双辫将军的巡逻岗，告诉双辫将军这一坏消息。
text.description: <你用手阖上马尔雷的眼睛。>$B$B<必须有人告知双辫将军，部落杀死了他唯一的儿子。>$B$B<就由你来传达这个消息吧。>
text.completion:
<General Twinbraid hurls his axeblade into the dirt, his voice quiet but his body quivering with disbelief and rage.>

That was my boy, $N. My only boy.

They've made it personal, $c. Personal.
text.completed: 将这一坏消息告诉南贫瘠之地双辫将军的巡逻岗的双辫将军。

english.title: The Bad News
english.objectives: Bring the bad news to General Twinbraid at Twinbraid's Patrol in Southern Barrens.
english.description: <You gently close Marley's eyes.>$B$B<Someone is going to have to tell General Twinbraid that the Horde has killed his only son.>$B$B<That someone is you.>
english.completion:
<General Twinbraid hurls his axeblade into the dirt, his voice quiet but his body quivering with disbelief and rage.>

That was my boy, $N. My only boy.

They've made it personal, $c. Personal.
english.completed: Bring the bad news to General Twinbraid at Twinbraid's Patrol in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 顺手牵羊
text.objectives: 收集6份库尔提拉斯宝藏。
text.description: $g嘿，帅哥！你刚走到镇子上来，我就盯上你那健硕的二头肌啦。:你瞎看什么呢，丑八怪？我看到你在剃刀岭走来走去，想要抢走我的男人！;$b$b听着，我有些事情要交给你去做。我听说加索克派你去提拉加德城堡。等你到了那边，能帮我找点被遗弃的库尔提拉斯宝贝吗？$b$b$g谢谢你啦，甜心！:别问原因，去做就是了！;
text.progress: $g<Gail purrs disarmingly at you.>: <Gail glares menacingly at you.>;
text.completion: $G You brought me my treasure!  What a sweetheart!: About time you showed up.  Don't even think about stealing that treasure... it's worthless here in Kalimdor, anyhow.;

english.title: Exploiting the Situation
english.objectives: Obtain 6 pieces of Kul Tiras Treasure.
english.description: $g Hey there, handsome!  I've had my eye on those big, beefy biceps ever since you stepped into town.: What're you looking at, ugly?  I've seen you walking around Razor Hill, trying to steal MY men from me!;$b$bListen, I've got something for you to do.  I hear Gar'Thok's got you headed over to Tiragarde.  While you're there, think you could find some abandoned Kul Tiras knicknacks?$b$b$gThanks sweetie!: Don't ask why, just get to it!;
english.progress: $g<Gail purrs disarmingly at you.>: <Gail glares menacingly at you.>;
english.completion: $G You brought me my treasure!  What a sweetheart!: About time you showed up.  Don't even think about stealing that treasure... it's worthless here in Kalimdor, anyhow.;

text.title: 突袭海滩
text.objectives: 杀死11只泡沫海元素。
text.description: 人类已经滚远啦，现在该处理更为紧要的事务了。$b$b这场大灾变彻底吞噬了杜隆塔尔的东海岸区域。你所见到的残骸本是提拉加德城堡。东边的海滩处，破坏情况就更加严重了。$b$b第一波海浪席卷过后，那片海滩就被愤怒的海洋元素生物霸占了。我派了步兵去对付它们，却没能挡住其攻势。我觉得你会比较幸运吧。$b$b当心海浪！
text.completion: The scent of the sea hangs about you, $N.  Your efforts may have purchased another day for Razor Hill.$b$bI will pass word of your deeds up my chain of command.  You have our gratitude.

english.title: Storming the Beaches
english.objectives: Kill 11 Foaming Sea Elementals.
english.description: Now that those humans are out of our hair for a bit, we can move on to more pressing matters.$b$bThe cataclysm utterly decimated Durotar's eastern coast.  You saw the wreckage that it made of Tiragarde.  The devastation was even worse on the coast to the east of here.$b$bAfter the first wave, the beach was overtaken by angry elementals that came from the sea.  I sent grunts to take care of it, but the onslaught was too much.  I'm guessing you'll have a little more luck than they did.$b$bBeware the tides!
english.completion: The scent of the sea hangs about you, $N.  Your efforts may have purchased another day for Razor Hill.$b$bI will pass word of your deeds up my chain of command.  You have our gratitude.

text.title: 搜寻船骸
text.objectives: 收集4套侏儒的工具。
text.description: $g嘿，帅哥，欢迎回来！你不介意再帮我跑一趟腿吧？我会非常非常感激你的……:你！站着别动，烂人！我还没跟你说完呢。;$b$b我听说你要到东边的海滩上去。那里到处都是破烂的船只，里面有侏儒用的工具……我可以用到那些工具。$b$b$g回头见，壮汉！:赶紧去啊，小妞！;
text.progress: $g Has my knight in shining armor returned?: Well?;
text.completion: $g You really know how to treat a girl, you know that?  If you ever need anything...: Well, I suppose you're not completely useless.  Now stay away from my men!;

english.title: Shipwreck Searching
english.objectives: Obtain 4 sets of Gnomish Tools.
english.description: $g Hey handsome, welcome back!  You wouldn't mind running another errand, would you?  I'd be EVER so grateful...: You!  Stop right there, you tramp!  I'm not finished with you yet.;$b$bI hear you're headed off to the shore east of here.  The beach is filled with crashed ships, and those ships have gnomish tools in them... tools that I can use.$b$b$g See you soon, beefcake!: Get cracking, missy!;
english.progress: $g Has my knight in shining armor returned?: Well?;
english.completion: $g You really know how to treat a girl, you know that?  If you ever need anything...: Well, I suppose you're not completely useless.  Now stay away from my men!;

text.title: 减少损失
text.objectives: 营救4个受伤的剃刀岭步兵。
text.description: 你必须帮帮我们。那些元素生物……它们比外表看起来的更强，而且一来就是一大堆。它们突然发动攻击，我们措手不及，溃不成军。$b$b我的许多手下在海滩上垂死挣扎。如果你能救他们的命……我会很感谢你的。剃刀岭的加索克也会感谢你。
text.completion: I've already spoken with several orcs that have returned from the beach.  All of them told me that you were the one who saved them.$b$bYou've done a noble task today, $N.  Lok'tar ogar!  For the Horde!

english.title: Loss Reduction
english.objectives: Rescue 4 Injured Razor Hill Grunts.
english.description: You've got to help us.  The elementals... they're stronger than they look, and they come in waves.  They took us completely by surprise, and we were overcome.$b$bMany of my fellow grunts lay dying on the beach.  If you could save them... I would be grateful, as would Gar'Thok back in Razor Hill.
english.completion: I've already spoken with several orcs that have returned from the beach.  All of them told me that you were the one who saved them.$b$bYou've done a noble task today, $N.  Lok'tar ogar!  For the Horde!

objectiveDetails.description: 营救受伤的剃刀岭步兵

text.title: 地之石板
text.objectives: 将地之石板带给铁炉堡的顾问贝尔格拉姆。
text.description: 不久前，布莱恩从奥杜尔给麦格尼国王发来一份紧急报告。他说，他发现了一个古老的泰坦宝藏，从里面发掘出一些神秘而重要的遗物。乌瑞恩国王已经派遣了最快的一艘船前往诺森德，将携带遗物的信使护送回来。我本该在这里和使者会面，检查他带回的古老石板。但那名信使至今还没有出现。$B$B麦格尼很担心，$n。因为我到现在都没有得到任何关于那名使者的消息。你是否能去一趟暴风城港口，看看他是不是在那里？

english.title: Tablets of the Earth
english.objectives: Bring the Tablets of Earth to Advisor Belgrum in Ironforge.
english.description: Some time ago, Brann sent King Magni an urgent message from Ulduar. He said he'd found an ancient titan cache with mysterious and important relics. King Wrynn dispatched one of his fastest ships to Northrend to transport the courier. I was to meet him here and examine the tablets, but the courier is nowhere to be seen.$B$BMagni is worried, $n. I haven't heard anything about the courier's arrival. Would you be willing to travel to Stormwind Harbor and see if he's arrived?

text.title: 火之石板
text.objectives: 将火之石板带给奥格瑞玛的大地治愈者诺莎拉。
text.description: 我正在等待一名来自诺森德的使者。他随身携带着一些古老的宝物。我希望能够借助它们扫清我面前的黑暗。那位萨满乘坐的飞艇应该早已到达，但他本人却迟迟没有出现，所以我不免开始担心了。$B$B他原本要在奥格瑞玛大门外西南边的飞艇塔和我见面。但我不想错过觐见酋长的机会。你是否愿意帮我找到那位使者，看看是什么耽误了他？

english.title: Tablets of Fire
english.objectives: Bring the Tablets of Fire to Earthmender Norsala in Orgrimmar.
english.description: I'm expecting the arrival of a courier traveling from Northrend. He's carrying a collection of ancient titan treasures, ones I'm hoping will shed light on my troubling visions. The shaman should've arrived on one of the recent zeppelin flights and I'm starting to get worried.$B$BHe was to meet me by the zeppelin tower southwest of Orgrimmar's gates, but I don't want to miss my audience with the warchief. Would you be willing to look for the courier and see what's delaying him?

text.title: 杀光他们！
text.objectives: 杀死10名在南贫瘠之地弗兹卡勒的主矿脉中劳作的弗兹卡勒矿工。
text.description: 我想让狗地精死翘翘，$n！这些绿皮小矮子正在挖掘西边的矿脉。$B$B让他们尝尝自掘坟墓的滋味吧！$B$B杀掉他们。彻底破坏这帮家伙的挖掘作业。$c，他们注定要在巴尔丹丧命，是时候送他们上路了。
text.completion:
Dead? Good.

Let word of this deed spread, and with it, terror.

The Horde will feel the consequences of their attack on Bael'dun, and they'll rue the day they ever crossed us, $N.

english.title: Kill 'em All!
english.objectives: Kill 10 Frazzlecraz Miners at the Frazzlecraz Motherlode in Southern Barrens.
english.description: I want to see some dead goblins, $n! Just west of here you'll find a whole warren of those little insects burrowing into the mountain.$B$BLet's see to it that they're digging their grave.$B$BDestroy them. Lay waste to their whole grubby operation. They've sown their own demise in Bael'dun, $c, and it is time to meet the reaper.
english.completion:
Dead? Good.

Let word of this deed spread, and with it, terror.

The Horde will feel the consequences of their attack on Bael'dun, and they'll rue the day they ever crossed us, $N.

text.title: ……并掩埋一切
text.objectives: 在弗兹卡勒的主矿脉中装填6桶弗兹卡勒炸药。
text.description: 杀掉他们还不够——巴尔丹遇袭后，我就下定决心要以牙还牙，用地精的方式对付他们。$B$B进入弗兹卡勒矿脉中并布下炸药。你可以在矿洞入口处找到类似开关或是活塞的玩意儿。布好炸药后，就启动活塞炸飞矿洞。$C，让恐惧吞噬他们的心灵！
text.completion: <The explosives are armed and ready!>

english.title: ...And Bury the Rest
english.objectives: Arm 6 Frazzlecraz Explosives in the Frazzlecraz Motherlode mine.
english.description: It's not enough to kill 'em - after Bael'dun, I want to give those goblins a taste of their own.$B$BGo into Frazzlecraz's mine and arm a pile of the explosives inside.$B$BAt the entrance to the mine you should see some sort of switch or plunger. Once the explosives are armed, use the plunger to blow that place sky-high. Put the fear in 'em, $C!
english.completion: <The explosives are armed and ready!>

text.title: 乘坐采矿车
text.objectives: 乘坐采矿车抵达矿道尽头，然后与助手格瑞里谈一谈。
text.description: 跳进来吧。当你抵达山脚时，跟助手格瑞里谈一谈。
text.completion: As we would say in the Tinker's Union, out of the heat-applied metallic cooking container and into the oxydizing, energetic mixture of reacting gases and solids!

english.title: Wild Mine Cart Ride
english.objectives: Use the Mine Cart to take a ride to the end of the line and then speak with Assistant Greely.
english.description: All you have to do is jump in and speak with Assistant Greely when you get to the bottom.
english.completion: As we would say in the Tinker's Union, out of the heat-applied metallic cooking container and into the oxydizing, energetic mixture of reacting gases and solids!

text.title: 任务完成
text.objectives: 返回南贫瘠之地双辫将军的巡逻岗，向双辫将军复命。
text.description: <矿洞轰然坍塌，扬起漫天尘埃，你闭上了眼睛。>$B$B<双辫将军应该会很满意吧，但是你怀疑这样是否就能平息他复仇的欲望。>
text.completion:
<Twinbraid nods as you describe the destruction of the mine, but his eyes still burn with rage.>

Very nice work, $N. I suppose there's some strategic value in depriving the Horde of those minerals, but I'd have done it anyway just to crush those little green monstrosities.
text.completed: 去找南贫瘠之地双辫将军的巡逻岗的双辫将军。

english.title: The Deed Is Done
english.objectives: Return to General Twinbraid at Twinbraid's Patrol in Southern Barrens.
english.description: <You shield your eyes from the blast and the debris as the mine implodes onto itself.>$B$B<General Twinbraid will be pleased, but somehow you doubt it'll be enough to quench his thirst for vengeance.>
english.completion:
<Twinbraid nods as you describe the destruction of the mine, but his eyes still burn with rage.>

Very nice work, $N. I suppose there's some strategic value in depriving the Horde of those minerals, but I'd have done it anyway just to crush those little green monstrosities.
english.completed: Return to General Twinbraid at Twinbraid's Patrol in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 徒劳的反抗
text.objectives: 杀死位于石爪山脉和南贫瘠之地交界处的科纳·雷行。
text.description: $n，我可不希望指挥官辛格顿在这份报告中看不到一条好消息。经过艰苦的战斗，我们取得了部落驻军点周遭道路的控制权。$B$B从目前掌握的情报来看，科纳·雷行就是部落的头目。他驻扎在此地以北的营地里。这家伙是石爪山脉的原住民，他比任何人都要了解这里的山路。如果能除掉他，西边的敌军或许就会溃散。$B$B找到并杀死科纳·雷行，然后向指挥官辛格顿汇报！
text.completion:
So our supplies aren't getting through? Hmmm. Honor's Stand just gets more and more isolated.

Still, the defeat of Thunderwalk should send a signal to our foes that we mean to stay. Thank you, $N.
text.giverWindow: 在裂口的边缘搜寻他。

english.title: Futile Resistance
english.objectives: Slay Kona Thunderwalk on the border between Stonetalon and Southern Barrens.
english.description: $n, I certainly don't want to deliver my report to Commander Singleton without at least a little bit of good news. We've got to wrestle control of these roads back from these Horde holdouts.$B$BFrom what we can gather, Kona Thunderwalk is the name of the ringleader. He's got a camp just north of here. A Stonetalon native, he knows these roads better than his own hide. If we can wipe him out, resistance from the west might vanish.$B$BFind and kill Kona Thunderwalk, then report to Commander Singleton!
english.completion:
So our supplies aren't getting through? Hmmm. Honor's Stand just gets more and more isolated.

Still, the defeat of Thunderwalk should send a signal to our foes that we mean to stay. Thank you, $N.
english.giverWindow: Seek him out at the edge of the great chasm.

text.title: 迷失在洪水中
text.objectives: 使用索恩克的望远镜，在怒水河流域盆地搜索幸存者。
text.description: 最近这天翻地覆的大灾变可不仅仅是把几艘船冲到我们的海岸边而已，$c。怒水河泛滥成灾，整个杜隆塔尔西部盆地都被水淹了。$b$b那边仍有幸存者。我去搜寻过一段时间，但是没有找到任何东西。你要不要拿我的望远镜自己看看？
text.completion: I see... so the trick is that you need to put the LITTLE end of the spyglass up to your eye.  I'll remember that piece of information.

english.title: Lost in the Floods
english.objectives: Use Thonk's Spyglass to search for survivors in Southfury Watershed.
english.description: The recent cataclysmic events have done more than wash a few boats onto our shore, $c.  The Southfury River has overflowed, and Durotar's entire western basin is now flooded.$b$bThere are still people out there.  I've been searching for a while, but haven't been able to find anything.  Would you mind using my telescope and taking a look for yourself?
english.completion: I see... so the trick is that you need to put the LITTLE end of the spyglass up to your eye.  I'll remember that piece of information.

objectiveDetails.description: 找到被洪水淹没的棚屋

text.title: 巡逻流域盆地
text.objectives: 搜索怒水河流域盆地，帮助那些你用望远镜看到的人。
text.description: 我的岗位在这座塔里，$n，我不能擅离职守。得有人去帮助那些仍被困在洪水中的人。$b$b我能指望你吗？
text.completion: I used that trick you taught me with the spyglass, and I watched you running around down there.  Quite impressive!$b$bHow'd you make the old woman fly, by the way?

english.title: Watershed Patrol
english.objectives: Search the Southfury Watershed and help the people you saw in the spyglass.
english.description: My post is here on the tower, $n, and I cannot leave it.  I need someone to go out there and help the people who are still trapped in the river's overflow.$b$bCan I count on you?
english.completion: I used that trick you taught me with the spyglass, and I watched you running around down there.  Quite impressive!$b$bHow'd you make the old woman fly, by the way?

text.title: Spirits Be Praised
text.objectives: Escort Grandmatron Tekla to Raggaran.
text.description: Who are you?  What happened?$b$bI was alone in my hut, meditating, when...$b$bAhh, I remember now.  The spirits cried out, and the river swept in.  I'm lucky that you found me here.  I am old, and no longer physically able to endure the elements like this.  Will you lead me out of here?
text.completion: My grandmother was a powerful shaman in her day.  I thought she had lost most of her powers in her old age, but I suppose some things stay with you forever.
text.completed: Speak with Raggaran at the Southfury Watershed in Durotar.

english.objectives: Escort Grandmatron Tekla to Raggaran.
english.description: Who are you?  What happened?$b$bI was alone in my hut, meditating, when...$b$bAhh, I remember now.  The spirits cried out, and the river swept in.  I'm lucky that you found me here.  I am old, and no longer physically able to endure the elements like this.  Will you lead me out of here?
english.completion: My grandmother was a powerful shaman in her day.  I thought she had lost most of her powers in her old age, but I suppose some things stay with you forever.
english.completed: Speak with Raggaran at the Southfury Watershed in Durotar.

text.title: 拉格兰的愤怒
text.objectives: 杀死4个钢鬃野猪人和4个钢鬃斥候。
text.description: 野猪人是这片土地上挥之不去的污点，就连河水都冲不走！他们叫我赶快撤离，但我告诉他们，我的工作还没有完成。$b$b啊啊啊啊啊！我恨死野猪人了！你能帮我去杀掉他们吗？
text.progress: I hate quilboar!
text.completion: <Raggaran appears to have calmed down a bit since your last encounter.>$b$bGood, good.  One step closer to eliminating those beady-eyed, basket-wearing, hog-nosed, two-toed...$b$b<Raggaran's anger is clearly rising again.>$b$b...hunchbacked, squealing, prickly... no-good... gnome-loving... GREEEAAAAGH!  Quilboar!

english.title: Raggaran's Rage
english.objectives: Kill 4 Razormane Quilboar and 4 Razormane Scouts.
english.description: The quilboar are a stain on the land that not even the river can wash away.  They told me to evacuate, but I told them that my job was not yet done.$b$bHrrrraaagh!  I hate quilboar so much!  Will you help me kill them?
english.progress: I hate quilboar!
english.completion: <Raggaran appears to have calmed down a bit since your last encounter.>$b$bGood, good.  One step closer to eliminating those beady-eyed, basket-wearing, hog-nosed, two-toed...$b$b<Raggaran's anger is clearly rising again.>$b$b...hunchbacked, squealing, prickly... no-good... gnome-loving... GREEEAAAAGH!  Quilboar!

text.title: 调查灾情
text.objectives: 跟荣耀岗哨的妮布·轴轮谈一谈，调查这场浩劫的情况。
text.description: 早就听说卡利姆多爆发了大规模的异常地震活动，但是我没有料到这里的地壳变迁是如此剧烈！$B$B我得留下来研究地震波读数，同时我急需一份最新的灾后报告。你能乘坐自动航测飞机，帮我收集数据吗？航线已经设置好了。$B$B完成调查后，将报告交给我在北方城堡的同事荷尔登。
text.completed: 向南贫瘠之地北方城堡的荷尔登汇报你的发现。

english.title: Survey the Destruction
english.objectives: Speak with Nibb Spindlegear at Honor's Stand to survey the cataclysm's destruction.
english.description: I had heard of enormous seismic anomalies here in Kalimdor, but I had no inkling that the geological chaos would be so profound!$B$BI need an up-to-date survey of the destruction while I stay here to study the seismographic readings. Could you gather some data via my automated survey craft? I'll take care of all the flying.$B$BWhen the survey is complete, present the data to my colleague Horton Gimbleheart in Northwatch.
english.completed: Report your findings to Horton Gimbleheart at Northwatch Hold in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 拉格兰的怒火
text.objectives: 杀死5个钢鬃传令兵和5个钢鬃卫兵。
text.description: 除非他们都被干掉，我是无法安心休息的！杀光他们！$b$b<拉格兰缓了一口气。>$b$b他们恶臭的巢穴就在北边，或者西南边！
text.completion: <Again, Raggaran appears calmer.>$b$bYou've done well, stranger.$b$bI'm sorry you had to see me like that.  Thank you for killing the quilboar, but maybe you should leave before I fly into another one of my rages.

english.title: Raggaran's Fury
english.objectives: Kill 5 Razormane Dustrunners and 5 Razormane Battleguards.
english.description: I will not rest until they're defeated!  Slay them all!$b$b<Raggaran catches his breath.>$b$bTheir stinking lairs are to the north, or to the southwest!
english.completion: <Again, Raggaran appears calmer.>$b$bYou've done well, stranger.$b$bI'm sorry you had to see me like that.  Thank you for killing the quilboar, but maybe you should leave before I fly into another one of my rages.

text.title: 刻骨铭心的伤痛
text.objectives: 收集250颗鳄鱼的牙齿。
text.description: 今天是我的儿子克鲁恩的周年祭。我始终不愿意接受这件事，直到我清楚地认识到：克鲁恩再也不会回到我身边了，他在一次鳄鱼狩猎行动中永远地离开了我。$B$B我有个心愿……希望以此纪念克鲁恩。做一条鳄鱼牙齿项链……项链上串起密密麻麻的牙齿，只有最勇敢的兽人才配得上它。我想把这串项链放在他的墓碑旁。$b$b克鲁恩很勇敢，却没有你这么强壮。你愿意帮我收集牙齿吗？
text.progress: Kron will be remembered.
text.completion: Thank you, $r.  I will get to work on the necklace right away.$b$bBefore Kron died, I had made this for him to wear.  I have no use for it now, but perhaps you might.
text.giverWindow: 亲爱的克鲁恩，这是他生前的模样。

english.title: Lost But Not Forgotten
english.objectives: Obtain 250 Crocolisk Teeth.
english.description: Today marks the anniversary of my son Kron's passing.  As long as I refused to admit it, I recognize now: Kron is not returning from his crocolisk hunt.$B$BI've been working on a project... something that will memorialize Kron's passion for the hunt.  It's a crocolisk-tooth necklace... rows and rows of teeth, suitable to be worn by only the bravest young orc.  I will place it on his grave.$b$bKron was brave, but he was not strong, like you.  Will you bring me the teeth for my necklace?
english.progress: Kron will be remembered.
english.completion: Thank you, $r.  I will get to work on the necklace right away.$b$bBefore Kron died, I had made this for him to wear.  I have no use for it now, but perhaps you might.
english.giverWindow: Beloved Kron, as he appeared in life.

text.title: 不请自来的访客
text.objectives: 攻击3只游荡的平原陆行鸟，直到它们往贫瘠之地逃去。
text.description: 别担心，岑塔基没事啦。只是研究一下河水泛滥时到底发生了什么状况。$b$b你看见站在河床上的大鸟了吗？岑塔基觉得它们有麻烦了。地震和洪水让陆行鸟不得不撤到河流对岸，但是它们回不去了，又不会游泳。$b$b如果这些大鸟继续待在这里，它们会死掉的。岑塔基不喜欢暴力，但是你可以去攻击它们，让它们逃到对岸去。好吗？
text.completion: I love all the little animals, mon.  I love the big ones, too.  I just hate to see you hurt them like that... but it's for the best.

english.title: Unbidden Visitors
english.objectives: Attack 3 Wayward Plainstriders until they flee toward the Barrens.
english.description: Don' worry, Zen'Taji's not in any trouble.  He just been studyin' what happens when the river overflows.$b$bYa see the big tall birds that stand on the riverbank?  Zen'Taji thinks they're in trouble.  The earthquake and the flood pushed the plainstriders over to this side of the water, but they can't fly back, and they're too scared to swim.$b$bThey'll die if they stay here.  Zen'Taji doesn't like violence, but maybe YOU can attack them and scare them over to the other side.  Yes?
english.completion: I love all the little animals, mon.  I love the big ones, too.  I just hate to see you hurt them like that... but it's for the best.

objectiveDetails.description: 驱赶游荡的平原陆行鸟

text.title: 迅猛龙的末日
text.objectives: 杀死迅猛龙尖啸利爪。
text.description: 河水冲进山谷时淹死了不少动物。但是迅猛龙却活了下来。它们是聪明的猎食者，以其他动物的不幸为代价世代生活在这片土地上。$B$B其中一只迅猛龙尤其凶猛。它不断地捕杀小动物，却又不吃，任由尸体在河水里腐烂！它叫做尖啸利爪，如果我们不采取措施的话，这里的生态平衡就会遭到破坏。$B$B去北边杀死它，让它回归自然吧。
text.completion: Something happened to Screamslash when the cataclysm hit, Zen'Taji thinks.  He wasn't always so violent and irrational.$b$bThank you for your help, $N.  Zen'Taji gonna get back to his studying now.
text.giverWindow: 流域盆地的凶兽。

english.title: That's the End of That Raptor
english.objectives: Slay the raptor called Screamslash.
english.description: Many creatures died when the water came rushin' into the valley.  The raptors, however, thrived.  They're clever predators, and they've been living off the misfortune of the other creatures.$b$bOne of the raptors is particularly cruel.  He's killing the little animals and letting them rot in the water without even eating them!  He goes by the name of Screamslash, and if we're not careful, he could seriously disrupt the balance of nature.$b$bTravel north, slay him, and give his body back to nature.
english.completion: Something happened to Screamslash when the cataclysm hit, Zen'Taji thinks.  He wasn't always so violent and irrational.$b$bThank you for your help, $N.  Zen'Taji gonna get back to his studying now.
english.giverWindow: The Terror of the Watershed.

text.title: 德拉诺什尔封锁线
text.objectives: 向杜隆塔尔德拉诺什尔封锁线的执行者戈尔报到。
text.description: 往北边去吧，$n。跟杜隆塔尔德拉诺什尔封锁线的执行者戈尔谈谈。他负责保卫奥格瑞玛航道的安全，他所在的码头旁边就是骷髅石。我相信他会对我们未完成的事业感兴趣的。
text.completion: You're the one who handled the Burning Blade to the south?  I've got ears in all kinds of places, $g boy: my girl;, and word travels fast.

english.title: The Dranosh'ar Blockade
english.objectives: Report to Gor the Enforcer at the Dranosh'ar Blockade in Durotar.
english.description: You should head north from here, $n.  Speak with Gor the Enforcer at the Dranosh'ar Blockade.  He's been placed in charge of securing shipping lanes for Orgrimmar, and Skull Rock sits right next to his precious dock.  I'm certain he'll be interested in picking up where we left off.
english.completion: You're the one who handled the Burning Blade to the south?  I've got ears in all kinds of places, $g boy: my girl;, and word travels fast.

text.title: 不愿撤离的海军司令
text.objectives: 向南贫瘠之地北方城堡的海军司令奥布里报到。
text.description: 嗯？你想待在这里参战？你真是位典型的$c，即便有机会逃生，也要留下来击退部落。$B$B如果你真的愿意拯救北方城堡，就去后面的塔楼向海军司令奥布里报到吧。我曾经恳求他带我们撤离此地，但是他选择了坚守海湾。$B$B如果没有别的事，我要去收拾行李了！
text.completed: 向南贫瘠之地北方城堡的海军司令奥布里报到。

english.title: The Admiral Won't Back Down
english.objectives: Report to Admiral Aubrey at Northwatch Hold in Southern Barrens.
english.description: What? You want to stay here to fight? Typical $c, wanting to stay and fight off the Horde while there's still a chance to run for it.$B$BLook, if you really want to save Northwatch, you should report to Admiral Aubrey in the tower behind me. He's keeping his ships here to fight, instead of ferrying us all away like I begged him to.$B$BNow if you'll excuse me, I've got to finish packing!
english.completed: Report to Admiral Aubrey at Northwatch Hold in Southern Barrens.

text.title: Winnoa Pineforest
text.objectives: Speak to Winnoa Pineforest at Vendetta Point in Southern Barrens.
text.description: While we've accomplished much here, it would be a tragedy if part of this corruption has escaped our notice.  The corridors of the Wailing Cavern stretch throughout the entire Barrens, and if another spot of wild energy has made its way to the surface...$B$BYou've done enough for me, though. I would simply ask that you let a fellow druid of mine know of what's happened here. You will find Winnoa Pineforest at the Fields of Blood, southwest of here.

english.description: While we've accomplished much here, it would be a tragedy if part of this corruption has escaped our notice.  The corridors of the Wailing Cavern stretch throughout the entire Barrens, and if another spot of wild energy has made its way to the surface...$B$BYou've done enough for me, though. I would simply ask that you let a fellow druid of mine know of what's happened here. You will find Winnoa Pineforest at the Fields of Blood, southwest of here.

text.title: Basic Orders
text.objectives: Follow Drill Sergeant Steamcrank's cues and then report back to Captain Tread Sparknozzle.
text.description: Hey! You look like you could give us a hand!$B$BIf you're willing to help our cause, we have to get you through training.  Gnome training is brutal and rigorous, so I hope you're ready.$B$BHead over to Drill Sergeant Steamcrank and he'll walk you through what you need to know.  Make sure you follow his orders when he gives them, or else you'll never make it$B$BI'm warning you though, it's tough over there.  Come back to see me, if you make it.

english.objectives: Follow Drill Sergeant Steamcrank's cues and then report back to Captain Tread Sparknozzle.
