text.title: 传播恐惧
text.objectives: 杀死5名哨塔卫士。使用霍格姆身旁的绳索可以快速进出荣耀岗哨。
text.description: $c，我们的资源十分有限，但是我们仍然有能力解决周遭的麻烦。使用绳索滑下山岭，杀死哨塔卫士。$B$B虽然这点人员损失不会对战局产生影响，但是当人类发现那一堆尸体时，他们必然会陷入无尽的恐慌和混乱……$B$B<霍格姆发出爽朗的笑声，双目炯炯有神。>
text.completion: Good, good. It'll take them many sleepless nights to figure out where we came from and where we disappeared to after the kills...

english.title: Feeding the Fear
english.objectives: Kill 5 Tower Wardens. Use the ropes beside Holgom to quickly move in and out of Honor's Stand.
english.description: Our resources are limited, $c, but that doesn't mean we can't make some trouble down below. Use the ropes here to sneak down the hillside, then slay the human prison wardens.$B$BKilling a couple scrawny guards won't turn the tide of battle, but  imagine the fear and chaos we'll reap as the humans discover the mutilated bodies...$B$B<Holgom grins a yellowed grin, his eyes glinting.>
english.completion: Good, good. It'll take them many sleepless nights to figure out where we came from and where we disappeared to after the kills...

text.title: In and Out
text.objectives: Test out the ejection system in the Ejector Mechano-Tank.
text.description: We've gotta get these new mechano-tanks ready for the assault.  You ready to help test these bad boys out?!  Of course you are!$b$bFirst, we need to make sure that once you're in, you can get out.  In battle, if you think your tank is going to explode, get out!  I've seen many a gnome stay in 'til the bitter end... the tank blows up, and them along with it.$B$BWell, I've upgraded this tank with an ejection seat.  Try it out for me, will ya?

english.title: In and Out
english.objectives: Test out the ejection system in the Ejector Mechano-Tank.
english.description: We've gotta get these new mechano-tanks ready for the assault.  You ready to help test these bad boys out?!  Of course you are!$b$bFirst, we need to make sure that once you're in, you can get out.  In battle, if you think your tank is going to explode, get out!  I've seen many a gnome stay in 'til the bitter end... the tank blows up, and them along with it.$B$BWell, I've upgraded this tank with an ejection seat.  Try it out for me, will ya?

text.title: Words for Delivery
text.objectives: Give the speech to Captain Tread Sparknozzle at Steelgrill Depot.
text.description: Here we go.  This is the speech, $n!$B$BIt has everything to be a great battle starter: It's inspirational, has eloquent language and speaks directly to gnomes.  Never has a finer speech been written!$B$BTurn this in to Captain Tread Sparknozzle and get some transportation to High Tinker Mekkatorque!
text.completion: Toby is all done with the speech? Let me see...$b<Reads the speech> Pumping pistons! What a fantastic speech! I knew Toby was a good writer, but this is perhaps the best he's ever written.$bI think it's time to get you out to the battle.

text.title: 递送演讲稿
text.objectives: 登上钢架补给站的“雷光号”，前往大工匠梅卡托克那里，将托比的发言稿交给他。
text.description: 好了，士兵。现在你证明自身能力的时间到了！$B$B拿上这份演讲稿，登上“雷光号”。这是大工匠梅卡托克最快的一艘飞船。而这份演讲稿正是梅卡托克在诺莫瑞根行动之前最迫切需要的东西。$B$B赶快出发吧！

english.title: Words for Delivery
english.objectives: Ride 'Thunderflash' from Steelgrill Depot to High Tinker Mekkatorque and deliver Toby's speech.
english.description: All right, soldier. Time to prove your worth!$B$BTake the speech and board the flying machine "Thunderflash".  It's the fastest ship to High Tinker Mekkatorque and this speech is the only thing he's waiting on before starting Operation: Gnomeregan.$B$BGo! Now!

text.title: Infiltrating The Cult
text.objectives: Go to Orgrimmar's Drag and speak to a Doomsayer or take a robe from the crate near a Doomsayer to join the cult, then put on your Recruit's Robe.
text.description: The streets of Orgrimmar are wild with rumors about the cult's origins and practices. There's only one way to know the truth about this group, $n. You're going to join them.$B$BApproach one of the Doomsayers in the Drag and tell them you wish to join their group. With any luck, they will give you instructions to introduce yourself to one of the group's leaders and tell you where the group is hiding. Don any clothing given to you by the doomsayer; you'll need it to gain entry to the group's hideout.

english.objectives: Go to Orgrimmar's Drag and speak to a Doomsayer or take a robe from the crate near a Doomsayer to join the cult, then put on your Recruit's Robe.

Don any clothing given to you by the doomsayer; you'll need it to gain entry to the group's hideout.

text.title: One Step Forward...
text.objectives: Test the Scuttling Mechano-Tank's maneuverability.
text.description: With the ejection system working, I think we're ready to test out movement.  This tank has an extra special feature: Automatic Evasive Maneuvers!$b$bI want you to check out the servos on the left leg, the right leg and the Automatic Evasive Maneuver system.$b$bThis is easy stuff, so it shouldn't take too long.

english.title: One Step Forward...
english.objectives: Test the Scuttling Mechano-Tank's maneuverability.
english.description: With the ejection system working, I think we're ready to test out movement.  This tank has an extra special feature: Automatic Evasive Maneuvers!$b$bI want you to check out the servos on the left leg, the right leg and the Automatic Evasive Maneuver system.$b$bThis is easy stuff, so it shouldn't take too long.

text.title: Infiltrating the Cult
text.objectives: Go to Stormwind's Old Town and either speak to a Doomsayer or take a robe from the crate near a Doomsayer to join the doomsday cult, then equip the Doomsday Recruit's Robe you receive.
text.description: It's getting difficult to keep the cultists out of the public eye and rumors are spreading across the city. I want you to join the cult and learn as much as you can.$B$BApproach one of the doomsayers in Old Town and tell them you wish to join their group. The doomsayer will likely give you clothing and instructions to meet with other cultists in one of the group's hideouts. Follow those instructions, $n. It's the only way to gain their confidence.

text.title: 暮光训练
text.objectives: 跟海加尔山的导师密尔瓦谈一谈。
text.description: 你在我们最基本的训练中的最容易上手的任务中表现得还不错。$B$B东边有我们的营地，去跟导师密尔瓦谈一谈。

english.title: Twilight Training
english.objectives: Speak to Instructor Mylva in Hyjal.
english.description: You've proven you're worthy of at least participating in our most basic training.$B$BYou'll find one of our settlements east of here.  Speak to instructor Mylva there.

text.title: 近亲
text.objectives: 将矮人弹丸交给尘泥沼泽蕨墙村的奥托·石塔。
text.description: <纳托把你拉到一边，低声耳语道。>$B$B$n，我已经把子弹从加恩的胸部拿出来了，但他血里的气泡告诉了我一切。他的肺被击穿了，伤口正在化脓。他是活不了多久了。$B$B把这个拿去。这就是要他命的那颗子弹。他的家人会希望知道，他们最年轻的战士变成了什么样。$B$B找到奥托·石塔。他就驻扎在尘泥沼泽。朝东北方走，沿着道路前往蕨墙村便是。

english.title: Next of Kin
english.objectives: Take the Dwarven Slug to Alto Stonespire at Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh.
english.description: <Nato pulls you aside and speaks in a whisper.>$B$B$n, I have removed the bullet from Gann's chest, but the bubbles in his blood tell me all I need to know. His lungs are punctured, and the wound grows septic. He is not long for this world.$B$BTake this. It's the bullet that killed him. His family will want to know what became of their youngest warrior.$B$BSeek out Alto Stonespire. He is posted in Dustwallow Marsh. Go northeast, and follow the roads to Brackenwall Village.

text.title: The Missing
text.objectives: While wearing your Cult Disguise, speak to Cultist Kagarn, Cultist Agtar, Cultist Tokka, and Cultist Rokaga at the Jaggedswine Farm in Durotar.
text.description: Aside from the disturbances and the paranoia spread by the cult, we've been inundated with reports of missing people. Mothers, fathers, brothers, and sisters have seemingly disappeared, but I have a feeling that they can be found in one of the cult's compounds outside the city. If I give you the names of some of the missing people, would you try to locate them in the cultist camp at the Jaggedswine Farm south of Orgrimmar? To blend in, you'll need to get a robe from one of the doomsayers in the Drag.

english.objectives: While wearing your Cult Disguise, speak to Cultist Kagarn, Cultist Agtar, Cultist Tokka, and Cultist Rokaga at the Jaggedswine Farm in Durotar.

text.title: 遛狗
text.objectives: 收集5块烧烤蜥蜴肉给斯莫多斯的幼犬吃。
text.description: 嗯……这年头他们可真不挑人了。$B$B很好。你毫无疑问在实验场和斯莫多斯打得火热。$B$B好吧，我就让你照看他的小犬。让这小家伙安静点——要是他能长得和他父亲一样，就能为我们平添战力。$B$B从石化蜥蜴的身上弄点肉来给他吃。

english.title: Walking the Dog
english.objectives: Collect and feed 5 pieces of Charred Basilisk Meat to the Spawn of Smolderos.
english.description: Hmmmphh.... it seems they'll let anyone in these days.$B$BVery well.  You doubtlessly became acquainted with Smolderos in the proving grounds.$B$BWell, I've been entrusted with the care of one of his pups.  Quite the little terror -- if he grows up to be anything like his father he shall serve our cause well.$B$BCollect meat from the basilisks around the area and feed them to him.

text.title: Press Fire
text.objectives: Test out the Shooting Mechano-Tank weapon systems on the nearby targets.
text.description: Safety systems, online!  Motor functions, functioning!  Now all we need is to make sure that the guns will fire.$b$bThis shouldn't be too hard, $n.  The mechano-tank on the hill behind us has been loaded with harmless pellets. Just fire off a couple rounds at the nearby targets and report back to me.

english.title: Press Fire
english.objectives: Test out the Shooting Mechano-Tank weapon systems on the nearby targets.
english.description: Safety systems, online!  Motor functions, functioning!  Now all we need is to make sure that the guns will fire.$b$bThis shouldn't be too hard, $n.  The mechano-tank on the hill behind us has been loaded with harmless pellets. Just fire off a couple rounds at the nearby targets and report back to me.

text.title: 收集情报
text.objectives: 获得暮光公报和海加尔作战计划。
text.description: 是我，$n，奥泰尔！$B$B别朝厕所瞧过来，你会暴露我的位置的。$B$B一切都按计划进行吗？很好！$B$B我要你在这儿收集一些情报。我们是不大可能拿到地图啊密信什么的，但假如能预测敌人的下一步行动，也能救个百来条我们的人命。
text.progress: Did you get the documents, $N?

english.title: Gather the Intelligence
english.objectives: Obtain the Twilight Communique and the Hyjal Battleplans.
english.description: It's me, $n, Ortell!$B$BDon't look directly at the outhouse... you'll give away my position.$B$BEverything's going according to plan then?  Excellent!$B$BI'm going to need you to obtain some intelligence while you're here.  It might not seem like much to get our hands on a map or a letter, but it may mean saving a hundred lives on our side if we can anticipate our enemy's next move.
english.progress: Did you get the documents, $N?

text.title: 疯从口出
text.objectives: 收集石花、苦寒之花和一撮暗焰余烬。
text.description: 我知道一个方子，能让这些语无伦次的前奴隶为之一振。从伽格尔的营地边的石头上收集一些石花，附近的湖边收集一些苦寒之花，然后营地门口的火盆里揪一撮暗焰余烬。方剂效力不长，所以你得在营地入口的暮光之锅里投下原料。$B$B抿上这么一口，那些洗了脑的奴隶就会精神振奋起来的！
text.progress: <The cauldron burbles, filled with a disgusting liquid.>
text.completion: <You dump out the current contents of the cauldron, instantly killing the surrounding plant life.>$B$B<The draught you brew in its place boils chunky and reeks of rotted cabbage. You turn your head aside and bottle it up.>

english.title: From the Mouth of Madness
english.objectives: Gather up Stonebloom, Bitterblossom, and a Darkflame Ember.
english.description: I know of a draught that should jolt these gibbering former slaves back to reality. Gather some stonebloom from the rocks around Gar'gol's hovel, some bitterblossom from the shores of the nearby lake, and a darkflame ember from one of the braziers at the hovel entrance. The draught won't last long, so combine the ingredients at a twilight cauldron by the entrance to the hovel.$B$BOne sip of that draught should knock some sense into the brainwashed slaves!
english.progress: <The cauldron burbles, filled with a disgusting liquid.>
english.completion: <You dump out the current contents of the cauldron, instantly killing the surrounding plant life.>$B$B<The draught you brew in its place boils chunky and reeks of rotted cabbage. You turn your head aside and bottle it up.>

text.title: 心自在，体自来
text.objectives: 同8名暮光奴仆交谈，送药后把他们救出来。
text.description: <瑞欧说药剂的效力不会太长。>$B$B<你最好赶紧到营地去，将药剂送给尽可能多的暮光奴仆。>
text.progress: Did the draught work?
text.completion: Excellent! Let's hope the damage wasn't permanent.$B$BJudging by the poor victims still in camp here, the Twilight's Hammer really messed with their heads.

english.title: Free Your Mind, the Rest Follows
english.objectives: Speak with 8 Twilight Servitors to administer the draught and rescue them.
english.description: <Rio said that the draught would not remain effective for long.>$B$B<You'd better hurry into the hovel and administer it to as many Twilight Servitors as you can find.>
english.progress: Did the draught work?
english.completion: Excellent! Let's hope the damage wasn't permanent.$B$BJudging by the poor victims still in camp here, the Twilight's Hammer really messed with their heads.

text.title: 心灵训练：向权力说真话
text.objectives: 使用升腾宝珠如实回答10个问题。
text.description: 你可能以为自己准备好接受我们要传授的知识了，其实你没有。$B$B把你的心灵想象成盒中盒。$B$B我们的每一步训练都会打开其中一个，直到你达到同元素直接沟通的境界。$B$B拿上升腾之核，回答所有它提出的问题，要老实说。瞎编排的后果……是要命的。

english.title: Mental Training: Speaking the Truth to Power
english.objectives: Use the Orb of Ascension and answer 10 answers correctly.
english.description: You might think you're ready to receive the knowledge we're to impart on you.  But you are not.$B$BThink of your mind as a box inside a series of other boxes.$B$BEach step of our training will open one of those boxes, until you are ready to achieve direct communion with the elements.$B$BTake the Core of Ascension and answer all questions it asks of you, truthfully.  Failing to do so could be... fatal.

text.title: 暮光之眼
text.objectives: 去找海加尔山伽格尔的营地的暮光之眼。
text.description: 湖对岸的食人魔氏族的首领叫做伽格尔。我用词不当，伽格尔的智商也就和生牛肉差不多。$B$B就我所知，伽格尔听命于一件魔法装置：“暮光之眼”，而且对它惟命是从。$B$B要是我们能够破坏掉魔法之眼，那就能造成想象不到的伤害了。$B$B到伽格尔营地的入口去找到暮光之眼。研究它。想办法破坏它。啊，混乱是多么地美妙……
text.completion: <You approach the Eye of Twilight. As your fingertips graze its luminescent surface, you are aware of a malignant presence peering back at you, searching your soul.>$B$B<Instinctively, you draw back.>
text.completed: 去找海加尔山伽格尔的营地的暮光之眼。

english.title: The Eye of Twilight
english.objectives: Seek out the Eye of Twilight near the entrance to Gar'gol's Hovel in Hyjal.
english.description: The ogre clan across the lake is led by Gar'gol. I use the term loosely; Gar'gol has the intelligence of raw beef.$B$BSo far as I can tell, Gar'gol is taking orders from a magical instrument: "The Eye of Twilight." He follows its commands unquestioningly.$B$BIf we can sabotage the eye, we can cause unimaginable havoc.$B$BGo to Gar'gol's hovel and seek out the Eye of Twilight near the entrance. Study it. Find a way to subvert it. Ah, marvelous chaos...
english.completion: <You approach the Eye of Twilight. As your fingertips graze its luminescent surface, you are aware of a malignant presence peering back at you, searching your soul.>$B$B<Instinctively, you draw back.>
english.completed: Seek out the Eye of Twilight near the entrance to Gar'gol's Hovel in Hyjal.

text.title: 主宰玩偶
text.objectives: 在海加尔山伽格尔营地里找到暮光伪经。
text.description: <在你同眼睛的短暂交流中，你感到它的力量来自于营地深处。你感觉到一本强大的典籍，绑缚着四大元素。>$B$B<想要主宰魔眼，就要先得到营地里的典籍。>
text.completion: <A heavy tome, bound in flesh, lies open on the table.>$B$B<The language - pictographic and scrawled in rust-colored ink - is undecipherable, but notes and translations are tucked within several pages. This must be what you're looking for.>
text.completed: 在海加尔山伽格尔营地里找到暮光伪经。

english.title: Mastering Puppets
english.objectives: Locate the Twilight Apocrypha inside of Gar'gol's Hovel in Hyjal.
english.description: <During your brief communion with the Eye, you felt that its power source lay deep within the hovel. You felt the weight of a powerful tome, binding together four elements.>$B$B<Mastering the Eye will require you to search the hovel for this tome.>
english.completion: <A heavy tome, bound in flesh, lies open on the table.>$B$B<The language - pictographic and scrawled in rust-colored ink - is undecipherable, but notes and translations are tucked within several pages. This must be what you're looking for.>
english.completed: Locate the Twilight Apocrypha inside of Gar'gol's Hovel in Hyjal.

text.title: Remnants of Battle
text.objectives: Bring the Broken Shard to XXX at XXX.
text.description: A great battle took place here. Mixed with the naga skeletons are that of some sort of large humanoids. This might be interesting news to XXX.

english.title: Remnants of Battle
english.objectives: Bring the Broken Shard to XXX at XXX.
english.description: A great battle took place here. Mixed with the naga skeletons are that of some sort of large humanoids. This might be interesting news to XXX.

text.title: 元素太初！
text.objectives: 按正确的顺序启动附近的四座锻炉，控制暮光之眼。
text.description: <你无法读懂文字，但图画表明你应该以某种顺序激活一系列装置。>$B$B<暮光伪经的其中一节被翻译成了现代文：>$B$B起初，渊远黑暗。$B仇恨爆发，就有了火。$B伤结了痂，便是土。$B痛苦的哭号诞生了风。$B天上所渗下的，乃是泪的海洋。$B我们生于阴暗，$B所知的天地皑皑，$B是为愤怒、伤害、痛苦和悲哀。
text.progress: <You pour over the Apocrypha, trying to make sense of it all.>
text.completion: <Flush with the energies of the captured elementals, you stand before the Twilight Apocrypha. The pages turn of their own accord.>$B$B<Suddenly, you see what the Eye sees. It is yours to command!>

english.title: Elementary!
english.objectives: Activate the four nearby elemental crucibles in the correct order to take control of the Eye of Twilight.
english.description: <You can't read the text, but diagrams seem to indicate that the devices around you should be activated in a set order.>$B$B<One passage of the Apocrypha has been translated to modern text:>$B$B   In the beginning was shadow eternal.$B   Hate blazed forth, and FIRE was born.$B   Wounds scabbed, and so begat EARTH.$B   Cries of anguish birthed howling WIND.$B   Wherein the skies wept seas of TEARS.$B      We live in the shadow,$B      The world we know$B   Built of rage, hurt, anguish and sorrow.
english.progress: <You pour over the Apocrypha, trying to make sense of it all.>
english.completion: <Flush with the energies of the captured elementals, you stand before the Twilight Apocrypha. The pages turn of their own accord.>$B$B<Suddenly, you see what the Eye sees. It is yours to command!>

text.title: 萨尔多之战
text.objectives: 跟萨尔多岛的塔姆布莉谈一谈。
text.description: 我们在萨尔多岛的殖民地被憎世纳迦夺走了。在寡不敌众的情况下，我们只好撤回大陆。就在他们垂涎自己刚刚获得的沙洲时，我们已经在海岸上建立了新羽月要塞，召集了一支规模更大的军队。$B$B现在，憎世纳迦将被赶回海里去。在岸边找到我们的战争古树。他会带你到前线去，塔姆布莉是这次进攻的指挥。
text.completion: These foul things will be driven back into the sea. I hope you're ready.

english.title: The Battle of Sardor
english.objectives: Speak with Tambre on Sardor Isle.
english.description: Our settlement on Sardor Isle was lost to the Hatecrest naga. Overwhelmed by their numbers, we fell back to the mainland. While they coveted their newly-gained sandbar, we raised New Feathermoon on the shore and amassed an even greater army.$B$BNow, the Hatecrest will be driven back into the sea. Find our Ancient of War along the shore. He will take you to the front lines, where Tambre leads the offensive.
english.completion: These foul things will be driven back into the sea. I hope you're ready.

text.title: Never Look Back
text.objectives: Kill 10 Hatecrest Naga and slay their leader.
text.description: Our settlement on Sardor Isle was lost to the Hatecrest naga. Overwhelmed by their numbers, we fell back to the mainland. While they coveted their newly-gained sandbar, we raised New Feathermoon on the shore and amassed an even greater army.$B$BNow, the Hatecrest will be driven back into the sea. Speak with Sentinel Ranadae to join our forces at Sardor. Slay the naga, and make sure whichever foul snake they take orders from is killed as well.

english.title: Never Look Back
english.objectives: Kill 10 Hatecrest Naga and slay their leader.
english.description: Our settlement on Sardor Isle was lost to the Hatecrest naga. Overwhelmed by their numbers, we fell back to the mainland. While they coveted their newly-gained sandbar, we raised New Feathermoon on the shore and amassed an even greater army.$B$BNow, the Hatecrest will be driven back into the sea. Speak with Sentinel Ranadae to join our forces at Sardor. Slay the naga, and make sure whichever foul snake they take orders from is killed as well.

text.title: 你参军了！
text.objectives: [ph] Log Description
text.description: [ph] 戰爭!

english.title: You're In The Army Gnow!
english.objectives: [ph] Log Description
english.description: [ph] War!

text.title: 纷争的种子
text.objectives: 引开卡尔贡，消灭海加尔山天选者之座的高阶异教徒阿泽尼乌斯。
text.description: 根据你获得的情报，教派里食人魔和非食人魔之间摩擦不断。$B$B高阶异教徒阿泽尼乌斯和食人魔法师卡尔贡正在天选者之座会面，尝试解决纠纷。$B$B天选者之座那里也有个和这个一样的厕所。进去把食人魔的伪装换上，想办法在阿泽尼乌斯履行和平使命的时候击败他。$B$B我们必须好好利用这个矛盾！
text.giverWindow: 我们要的是阿泽尼乌斯！杀了他！
text.giverTarget: 高阶异教徒阿泽尼乌斯

english.title: Seeds of Discord
english.objectives: Distract Karr'gonn and slay Dark Cultist Azennios at the Seat of the Chosen in Hyjal.
english.description: According to the intelligence you acquired, there is major friction between the ogres and non-ogres in the cult.$B$BHigh Cultist Azennios and the ogre mage Karr'gonn are meeting at the Seat of the Chosen in an attempt to ease the conflict.$B$BThere is an outhouse like this one at the Seat of the Chosen.  Go there and put on this ogre disguise.  Find a way to kill Azennios while he's in this mission of peace.$B$BWe must exploit this division as much as we can!
english.giverWindow: Azennios is the one we want! Kill him!

text.title: 灵魂训练：弱者才手软
text.objectives: 教训末日祷告祭坛的5名失败的哀求者。
text.description: 你挺到了现在，而其他人都没有。$B$B到末日祷告祭坛去，就在北边。我们把……失败的都集合在那里。我要你去照看照看他们，这对你的灵魂成长有好处。$B$B要是这种冷血的作风让你感到不适，就把它当作他们的第二次机会好了。要是有人能教训你你……嗯，他们就能取你而代之。

english.title: Spiritual Training: Mercy is for the Weak
english.objectives: Slay 5 Failed Supplicants at Doom's Vigil.
english.description: You've made it this far.  Others haven't.$B$BGo to Doom's  Vigil, just north of here.  We've rounded up all the... failures.  I want you to help take care of them.  It'll be good for your spiritual growth.$B$BIf this cold-blooded act gives you trouble, think of it as their second chance.  Should any of them manage to kill you... well, they'll take your spot.

text.title: 两邪相权取其重
text.objectives: 在海加尔山索萨恩之门使用烈焰统御护符并消灭军团之拳加诺斯。
text.description: 我们用武力从燃烧军团的恶魔手中夺回了暗语峡谷。我们目前领土都还防守得不错，只有一处例外。$B$B最近索萨恩之门被一名深渊领主领军攻陷。我们不能允许这样的状况持续下去。$B$B你接近他的时候就使用这个护符，你将会暂时获得一名火焰升腾者的力量。善加利用吧。
text.giverWindow: 燃烧军团在这里没有立足之地。这里是暮光的领地。

english.title: The Greater of Two Evils
english.objectives: Use the Talisman of Flame Ascendancy and slay Garnoth, Fist of the Legion, at the Gates of Sothann in Hyjal.
english.description: We took Darkwhisper Gorge from the demons of the Burning Legion by force.  We've held on to our territory pretty well so far, with one exception.$B$BWe recently lost the Gates of Sothann to a pit lord and his army.  We cannot allow this to stand.$B$BUse this talisman when you're near him.  You'll gain the powers of a flame ascendant temporarily.  Make it count.
english.giverWindow: The Burning Legion has no place here. This is Twilight land now.

text.title: 暮光领地
text.objectives: 消灭海加尔山索萨恩之门的10名恐惧守卫。
text.description: 燃烧军团的恶魔以为他们可以为所欲为，随随便便就能攫取领土。是的——这地盘原本的确是他们的，但那又是另话了。$B$B我们得让他们晓得别和暮光之锤较劲。$B$B到索萨恩之门去把那里成群结队的恐惧守卫统统干掉。

english.title: Twilight Territory
english.objectives: Slay 10 Horrorguards at the Gates of Sothann in Hyjal.
english.description: The demons of the Burning Legion think they can just walk up here and take whatever territory they want.  Sure -- the territory was previously theirs, but that's beside the point.$B$BWe'll teach them not to cross the Twilight's Hammer.$B$BHead to the Gates of Sothann and wipe out the contingent of Horrorguards that roam the area.

text.title: 去找暮语
text.objectives: 去找海加尔山戈德林圣殿的罗伊斯·暮语。
text.description: <你将思维集中在魔眼上，操纵它对食人魔下达不同的命令。这时候，你感觉魔眼中又有另一个存在，窥探着你，寻找着弱点。某个充满着愤怒的遥远存在。你给自己树立了新的敌人！>$B$B<这里的工作已经结束。去找戈德林圣殿的罗伊斯·暮语，告诉他你完成任务了。>
text.completion: Hello, yes? What? You? Oh, you're one of the ones I sent after the Eye of Twilight, aren't you?$B$BGood work, very good. I suppose that's a valuable lesson:$B$BNever to take orders from a big purple ball.
text.completed: 去找海加尔山戈德林圣殿的罗伊斯·暮语。

english.title: Return to Duskwhisper
english.objectives: Return to Royce Duskwhisper at the Shrine of Goldrinn in Hyjal.
english.description: <You force your own image into the Eye, manipulating it to give the ogres different orders. As you do so, you feel another presence within the Eye, probing you, seeking out a weakness. A distant being fumes with rage. You've made some enemies today!>$B$B<Your work here is done, and the ogres will be friendly to you. Return to Royce Duskwhisper at the Shrine of Goldrinn and let him know what you've accomplished.>
english.completion: Hello, yes? What? You? Oh, you're one of the ones I sent after the Eye of Twilight, aren't you?$B$BGood work, very good. I suppose that's a valuable lesson:$B$BNever to take orders from a big purple ball.
english.completed: Return to Royce Duskwhisper at the Shrine of Goldrinn in Hyjal.

text.title: The Defector
text.objectives: Bring the Incriminating Envelope to Elementalist Ortell at the Outhouse at the Forge of Supplication in Hyjal.
text.description: Stay your hand!  Please, I beg you!$B$BI'm only here because of a girl.  Her words were so sweet... but now I realize the madness behind them.$B$BTake this envelope.  It has information that'll score you some points with your superiors.$B$BThe guards are distracted... I can make a run for it.  Please.  I don't want to die!

english.title: The Defector
english.objectives: Bring the Incriminating Envelope to Elementalist Ortell at the Outhouse at the Forge of Supplication in Hyjal.
english.description: Stay your hand!  Please, I beg you!$B$BI'm only here because of a girl.  Her words were so sweet... but now I realize the madness behind them.$B$BTake this envelope.  It has information that'll score you some points with your superiors.$B$BThe guards are distracted... I can make a run for it.  Please.  I don't want to die!

text.title: 傻瓜演讲小抄
text.objectives: 消灭海加尔山天选者之座外的欧克罗格。
text.description: 听好了，$n。我知道他们打算对加洛德·影歌干什么了。暮光之锤的食人魔打算把他当作今年的入教式上的祭品。$B$B我听说在血祭之前发表讲话的是一个叫做欧克罗格的食人魔，但注意了：你是替补。$B$B要想救出加洛德，就得要你来发表讲话。别担心——我会给你写几张小抄——而你必须确保欧克罗格在离开天选者之座时会遇上“意外”。
text.giverWindow: ……所谓“意外”的意思就是要你干掉他。

english.title: Speech Writing for Dummies
english.objectives: Kill Okrog outside the Seat of the Chosen in Hyjal.
english.description: Listen, $n.  I found out what they're doing with Jarod Shadowsong.  He's scheduled to be sacrificed by the ogres of the Twilight's Hammer as part of this year's initiation.$B$BI heard that the initiate charged with delivering the speech ahead of the sacrifice is an ogre named Okrog, but get this: you were a close second.$B$BWe need you to deliver that speech if we're to free Jarod.  Don't worry -- I'll write you some cue cards -- just make sure Okrog has an "accident" as he leaves the Seat of the Chosen.
english.giverWindow: ...and by "accident", I mean I want you to kill him.

text.title: 毕业演说
text.objectives: 在末日祷告祭坛的演讲台上成功发表毕业演说。
text.description: 你终于准备好了，$n·丹玛斯。$B$B我为你和你的成就而感到骄傲。$B$B今天你要在同袍前发表讲话，激励他们奋勇杀敌，直到海加尔山化为灰烬。$B$B记住，$n·丹玛斯。抓住观众的情绪，并且用言词把这些情绪尽可能地调用起来是极为重要的。

english.title: Graduation Speech
english.objectives: Use the Initiation Podium at Doom's Vigil to successfully deliver the Graduation Speech.
english.description: You're finally ready, $ndamus.$B$BI am so proud of you and all you've accomplished.$B$BToday you will deliver a speech in front of your peers and inspire them to crush our enemies until Hyjal is nothing but a pile of ash.$B$BRemember, $ndamus.  It'll be important to read your audience's emotions and use words that best address those emotions.

text.title: 海加尔在燃烧
text.objectives: 借助阿隆努斯飞往海加尔，到达后跟伊瑟拉谈一谈。
text.description: $n！我久仰你的丰功伟绩。$B$B艾泽拉斯需要的时候，你来了。$B$B死亡之翼的爪牙正在攻打海加尔山，想要将毁天灭地的拉格纳罗斯带回现世。$B$B阿隆努斯会带你加入玛法里奥部署在海加尔的部队。尽可能帮助他们。
text.completion: <Ysera appears to be in some sort of trance.>

english.title: As Hyjal Burns
english.objectives: Fly to Hyjal using Aronus and speak to Ysera once you're there.
english.description: $n!  We've heard much about you and your previous accomplishments.$B$BIt is good that you've come here just as Azeroth finds itself in a time of great need.$B$BDeathwing's minions are attacking Hyjal and seek to bring the destructive Ragnaros back into our world.$B$BAronus will take you to join Malfurion's forces in Hyjal. Lend them what help you can.
english.completion: <Ysera appears to be in some sort of trance.>

text.title: 保护世界之树
text.objectives: 与海加尔山宁静林地的玛法里奥·怒风交谈。
text.description: <伊瑟拉的眼神迷离，仿佛完全没有意识到你的存在一样。>$B$B我也感觉到了，$r。拉格纳罗斯来了。$B$B在他同爪牙会合、将力量赐予他们之前，我们必须打败他们。 $B$B到西边的宁静林地去找玛法里奥·怒风，尽你所能援助他的部队。$B$B我必须到翡翠梦境里去寻找答案，而你则要在我回来之前保护好世界之树。
text.completion: You've arrived just in time, $n.

english.title: Protect the World Tree
english.objectives: Speak to Malfurion Stormrage at the Tranquil Grove in Mount Hyjal.
english.description: <Ysera's eyes look distant, as if not fully acknowledging you.>$B$BI feel it as well, $c. Ragnaros has arrived.$B$BWe must defeat his minions before he can join them and lend them his strength.$B$BSeek Malfurion Stormrage at the Tranquil Grove, west of here, and aid his forces in any way you can.$B$BI must seek answers from within the Emerald Dream.  You must protect the World Tree until I return.
english.completion: You've arrived just in time, $n.

text.title: 向暮光之锤开战
text.objectives: 消灭4名暮光烈焰召唤者和10名暮光湮灭者。
text.description: 不要搞错了，$n。就我们所知，这场战争的结果决定着我们世界的存亡。$B$B死亡之翼归来后，暮光之锤的势力空前壮大。要是他们掌握了世界之树，就能给我们致命的一击。$B$B是向敌人发起反击的时候了。是捣毁暮光之锤的时候了。
text.completion: 'You''ve done well, $n.  But I fear the battle is far from over.'

english.title: War on the Twilight's Hammer
english.objectives: Kill 4 Twilight Flamecallers and 10 Twilight Vanquishers.
english.description: Make no mistake about this, $n.  The outcome of this war will determine the very survival of our world as we know it.$B$BThe Twilight's Hammer has become more powerful than ever with Deathwing's return.  Should they succeed in taking over the World Tree, they might strike a blow from which we will never recover.$B$BIt is time we beat back the enemy.  It is time we crushed the Twilight's Hammer.
english.completion: 'You''ve done well, $n.  But I fear the battle is far from over.'

text.title: 被俘的斥候
text.objectives: 去找海加尔山暮光封锁线的斥候拉兰迪雅。
text.description: 我听说过你，$n，还有你从南边带来的消息。战斗已经进入了僵局。$B$B我担心火焰领主的再度苏醒会打破这个僵局。$B$B除非我们能够想办法扭转局面。$B$B暮光之锤俘获了我们的一个斥候。我相信她携带着重要的情报，到西边的暮光营地去找她吧。
text.completion: Help has arrived at last!

english.title: The Captured Scout
english.objectives: Find Scout Larandia at the Twilight Command Post in Mount Hyjal.
english.description: I've heard about you, $n, and the news you brought from the south.  The battle has reached a stalemate.$B$BOne that I fear is about to be broken by the Firelord's reawakening.$B$BThat is unless we tip the scales in our favor in some way.$B$BThere is a scout that was captured by the Twilight's Hammer.  I believe she was in possession of valuable intelligence. Find her in the Twilight camp to the west.
english.completion: Help has arrived at last!

text.title: 监禁
text.objectives: 在海加尔山的暮光封锁线获得暮光监督者的钥匙。
text.description: 他们抓住我的时候，我已经在敌后侦察了快有一天了。$B$B对咱们前线的进攻并不是表面上那么简单，$n。$B$B我会告诉你详情，但首先你得把我弄出去。$B$B只有监督者手中才有笼子的钥匙。$B$B我记得他们位于山口中央，就在最深处。$B$B看你能不能从他们身上搞到钥匙。
text.progress: The key, $N.  Did you get it?
text.completion: 'I am thankful, $n.  I will deliver my findings to our people.'

english.title: Twilight Captivity
english.objectives: Obtain a Twilight Overseer's Key at the Twilight Command Post in Hyjal.
english.description: I'd been scouting behind enemy lines for nearly a day when they caught me.$B$BThis attack on our frontlines is not what it appears, $n.$B$BI'll give you all the details, but first let's find a way to get me out of here.$B$BOnly the overseers carry keys to these cages.$B$BFrom what I recall, they're in the middle of the crater, in the thick of it.$B$BSee if you can get a key off of one of them.
english.progress: The key, $N.  Did you get it?
english.completion: 'I am thankful, $n.  I will deliver my findings to our people.'

text.title: Fiery Inscriptions
text.objectives: Speak to Hamuul Runetotem in Hyjal.
text.description: The medallion is unlike any you've seen before.  Its runes appear to glow in conjunction with the near fire elementals.$B$BPerhaps you should tell Hamuul Runetotem about this.

english.title: Fiery Inscriptions
english.objectives: Speak to Hamuul Runetotem in Hyjal.
english.description: The medallion is unlike any you've seen before.  Its runes appear to glow in conjunction with the near fire elementals.$B$BPerhaps you should tell Hamuul Runetotem about this.

enders.name: 大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾

text.title: 破火诀
text.objectives: 消灭30个不受束缚的焰灵。
text.description: 围攻我们的巨型元素并非单一的个体。$B$B它是由暮光之锤的邪教徒用魔法将低级灵体组合在一起的。$B$B重塑过的烈焰先知之杖可以帮助我们削弱其中的连接。$B$B你把大的元素分解掉以后，就可以对付那些分解出来的小元素了。
text.completion: 'Well done, $n.  This will help us turn the tide against the enemy.'

english.title: Flamebreaker
english.objectives: Kill 30 Unbound Flame Spirits.
english.description: The large elementals that besiege us are not a singular entity.$B$BThey are an amalgamation of lesser spirits bound together by the Twilight's Hammer cultists' magic.$B$BThe rebuilt flameseer's staff will give us enough power to shatter its bonds.$B$BDestroy the smaller elementals once you've broken up the more dangerous large ones.
english.completion: 'Well done, $n.  This will help us turn the tide against the enemy.'

text.title: 事关利害
text.objectives: 与海加尔山兽穴中的萨伊娜·风驰队长交谈。
text.description: 暮光之锤想要释放范达尔·鹿盔？$B$B玛法里奥原本只是猜测他的堕落已经无可救药……这下倒是板上钉钉了。$B$B不管怎么样，我们都不能让敌人同如此强大的大德鲁伊接触。$B$B我有个计划，$n。我们要在翡翠梦境里转移囚犯。这很冒险，但是有这么多的邪教徒在，也许这是唯一能够确保成功的方法了。$B$B去找东北边兽穴中的萨伊娜·风驰吧。
text.completion: The dragon might be right.  The Twilight's Hammer has breached our security and this is our most dangerous prisoner.

english.title: A Prisoner of Interest
english.objectives: Speak to Captain Saynna Stormrunner at the Barrow Dens in Hyjal.
english.description: The Twilight's Hammer wants to free Fandral Staghelm?$B$BMalfurion suspected his corruption ran deep... this just cements it.$B$BAt any rate we cannot allow our enemies to get their hands on such a powerful arch druid.$B$BI've a plan, $n.  We will move the prisoner through the Emerald Dream.  It will be risky, but with all the cultists present here it might be the only way to guarantee our success.$B$BSpeak to Saynna Stormrunner inside the Barrow Dens to the northeast.
english.completion: The dragon might be right.  The Twilight's Hammer has breached our security and this is our most dangerous prisoner.

text.title: 穿越梦境
text.objectives: 把大德鲁伊范达尔·鹿盔押送到海加尔山兽穴入口的奥利瑟拉处。
text.description: 奥利瑟拉的计划或许很有必要，$n。我不知道我们还能抵挡住邪教徒多久。$B$B范达尔·鹿盔被禁锢在强力法术中，即便在翡翠梦境里，他也是没法逃掉的。$B$B不过，还是要当心，因为我们得知噩梦已经侵入了这里的梦境世界。$B$B把范达尔带上去交给奥利瑟拉。但愿月光林地的安保比这里要好。
text.progress: Is Staghelm with you, $N?
text.completion: 'You did well, $n.  I will take Fandral to Moonglade myself.$B$BHis prison will be far enough from the battlefront there.'
text.end: 押送大德鲁伊范达尔·鹿盔

english.title: Through the Dream
english.objectives: Deliver Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm to Alysra at the entrance of the Barrow Dens in Hyjal.
english.description: Alysra's plan might be necessary, $n.  I don't know how much longer we can hold off the cultists.$B$BFandral Staghelm is bound by powerful spells.  He won't be able to escape you, even inside the Emerald Dream.$B$BBeware, though, for all we know the nightmare has spread to this part of the world inside the dream.$B$BTake Fandral to the surface and hand him to Alysra.  Let us hope he's more secure in Moonglade than he is here.
english.progress: Is Staghelm with you, $N?
english.completion: 'You did well, $n.  I will take Fandral to Moonglade myself.$B$BHis prison will be far enough from the battlefront there.'

text.title: 伽格尔要出发
text.objectives: 从伽格尔的私人宝箱里拿到生锈的雕塑钥匙。
text.description: <克里斯托弗探过头来，想要盯着你的眼睛。>$B$B听着，你得把我弄出去。他们要么就会吃了我，要么把我交给暮光之锤。也许两者都有。$B$B他们把我锁在这儿，钥匙被伽格尔藏在了他的私人宝箱里。如有必要，杀掉伽格尔也行——但一定要拿到钥匙！$B$B<克里斯托弗无助地瘫软了下去。>
text.progress: Key? Now? Please?
text.completion: <Kristoff reaches down to snatch the key.>$B$BIt's about time!$B$B<He squirms in his bonds, trying to reach the padlock behind his back.>$B$B...Can I get a little help here?
text.giverWindow: 保险箱就在肮脏丑陋的伽格尔身边。

english.title: Gar'gol's Gotta Go
english.objectives: Get the Rusted Skull Key from Gar'gol's Personal Treasure Chest.
english.description: <Kristoff cranes his neck, trying to look you in the eye.>$B$BListen, you gotta get me outta here. They're either going to eat me or turn me over to the Twilight's Hammer. Maybe both.$B$BThey've padlocked me in, and Gar'gol keeps the key in his personal treasure chest. Kill Gar'gol if you have to - but get that key!$B$B<Kristoff flails his limbs, helplessly.>
english.progress: Key? Now? Please?
english.completion: <Kristoff reaches down to snatch the key.>$B$BIt's about time!$B$B<He squirms in his bonds, trying to reach the padlock behind his back.>$B$B...Can I get a little help here?
english.giverWindow: Look for a lockbox somewhere near Gar'gol's enormous, crud-crusted feet.

text.title: 石槌的强大
text.objectives: 干扰古加尔的暮光布道。
text.description: 这么说暮光之锤以为他们能拉起一支属于自己的食人魔大军？在部落的领土当中？$B$B咱们等着瞧吧。$B$B食人魔只看重一件事：力量。我要你带人进攻古加尔的布道，$n。踢开厄运之槌的大门，跳进竞技场，砍翻他的侍从。

english.title: Might of the Stonemaul
english.objectives: Disrupt Cho'Gall's Twilight Sermon.
english.description: So the Twilight's Hammer thinks it can just raise its own army of ogres here? In the middle of Horde territory? $B$BWe'll see about that.$B$BOgres only respect one thing: strength. I want you to lead the assault on Cho'gall's sermon, $n. Throw wide the doors of Dire Maul, leap into the arena, and cut down his attendants.

text.title: 肉身废物
text.objectives: 用寒霜之晶扑灭4个挑战失败的试炼者身上的火。
text.description: 瞧瞧这些蠢货。一半人都撑不过试炼，只能被元素的力量所束缚。$B$B他们不配被提拔到我们的核心中来。但也许……也许可以把他们当仆役来使。$B$B拿上这颗宝石，用它的力量救几个不够格，毫无成功机会的试炼者。

english.title: Waste of Flesh
english.objectives: Use the Frostgale Crystal to extinguish the flames on 4 Immolated Supplicants.
english.description: Look at these fools.  Half of them won't even make it past this trial.$B$BThey are not worthy of ascending into our inner circles.  But perhaps... perhaps they are worthy of menial service.$B$BTake this gem and utilize its power to save some of the less competent supplicants.  Those who have no chance of succeeding.  Those already on fire, preferably.

objectiveDetails.description: 拯救挑战失败的试炼者

text.title: Grandma's Cat
text.objectives: Grandma Wahl at the Wahl cottage wants you to retrieve Chance the Cat.
text.description: Right!  About the evacuation, dear.$B$BI just cannot leave without my cat.  He's an adorable orange tabby.$B$BChance's favorite spot to play is a broken down cart near an arbor northeast of here.$B$BBring him here and we'll be on our way.

english.title: Grandma's Cat
english.objectives: Grandma Wahl at the Wahl cottage wants you to retrieve Chance the Cat.
english.description: Right!  About the evacuation, dear.$B$BI just cannot leave without my cat.  He's an adorable orange tabby.$B$BChance's favorite spot to play is a broken down cart near an arbor northeast of here.$B$BBring him here and we'll be on our way.

text.title: 把我弄出去！
text.objectives: 把克里斯托弗护送出伽格尔的营地。
text.description: <你伸手去解克里斯托弗的枷锁。>$B$B好的！去找出口，我跟着你。$B$B要是咱们走散了，就回来瞧瞧，看我是不是又被抓住了。
text.completion: Kristoff, Kristoff... Oh yes, I remember now. I recall sending him on what amounted to a suicide mission.$B$BHe survived? I suppose that means he failed.$B$BStill, you deserve at least some coin for the trouble.

english.title: Get Me Outta Here!
english.objectives: Escort Kristoff out of Gar'gol's Hovel.
english.description: <You reach up to unfasten Kristoff's bonds.>$B$BGood! Make a break for the exit, and I'll follow.$B$BIf we get separated, check back here to make sure I haven't been recaptured.
english.completion: Kristoff, Kristoff... Oh yes, I remember now. I recall sending him on what amounted to a suicide mission.$B$BHe survived? I suppose that means he failed.$B$BStill, you deserve at least some coin for the trouble.

text.title: 哨兵的力量
text.objectives: 干扰古加尔的暮光布道。
text.description: 暮光之锤？在这里？$B$B这比我想象的还要严重得多。我们得着手制止他们。我不知道我是否准备好领导这样一次进攻，但我是不会让恐惧阻挡我的！$B$B我会把部队从羽月要塞集结过来。到厄运之槌的竞技场去干扰古加尔的活动，我们将趁他们阵脚大乱时发动攻击。
text.completion: Welcome back from the battle! The Twilight's Hammer have been disgraced in the eyes of the Gordunni, and driven from Feralas.$B$BWe've shown the glory of the Alliance in full force today! Be proud!

english.title: Might of the Sentinels
english.objectives: Disrupt Cho'Gall's Twilight Sermon.
english.description: The Twilight's Hammer? Here?$B$BThis is far more serious than I expected. We've got to put a stop to this. I don't know if I'm ready to lead such an offensive, but I'm not about to let my fears get in the way of what needs to be done!$B$BI will rally our forces from Feathermoon Stronghold. Head to Dire Maul, make your way to the arena, and disrupt Cho'gall's activities; we will launch our attack during the confusion.
english.completion: Welcome back from the battle! The Twilight's Hammer have been disgraced in the eyes of the Gordunni, and driven from Feralas.$B$BWe've shown the glory of the Alliance in full force today! Be proud!

text.title: 浮现的威胁
text.objectives: 同先知加德拉交谈，进入精神恍惚状态。
text.description: 你能感觉到元素们有多愤怒吗？自从我们来了以后它们就想攻击我们，消灭我们。我们得让它们镇静下来，但得先知道是什么惹恼了它们才行。$B$B过来同我坐在火边。把你自己投入到火焰里去……让你的灵魂窥探到真正的威胁。

english.title: The Looming Threat
english.objectives: Speak to Farseer Gadra to enter your Spirit Trance.
english.description: Can ya feel how angry the elements be? They be wantin' to attack us and consume us even as we just arrive. We need ta calm dem, but that kinda wisdom only comes from knowin' what's riling them up in da first place.$B$BCome sit with me by da fire. Let yaself get lost in da flames... let ya spirit peer into the true threat.

objectiveDetails.description: 分享先知加德拉所见到的幻像

text.title: Natural Materials
text.objectives: Bring 2 Splintered Logs, 6 Encrusted Minerals, 20 pieces of Resilient Sinew, and 40 Metallic Fragments to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Camp Mojache.
text.description: I will need certain materials to complete my endeavor... You may do this alongside the other tasks I will give you.$B$BI'll need a splintered log from a treant of Feralas. Encrusted minerals, these can be found on the mountain giants and faerie dragons to the west. Also, find me some resilient sinew from the owlbeasts of the Hinterlands or hippogryphs of Feralas. Finally, I'll need a large amount of metallic fragments from any of these creatures I mentioned.
text.completed: Return to Witch Doctor Uzer'i at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

english.title: Natural Materials
english.objectives: Bring 2 Splintered Logs, 6 Encrusted Minerals, 20 pieces of Resilient Sinew, and 40 Metallic Fragments to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Camp Mojache.
english.description: I will need certain materials to complete my endeavor... You may do this alongside the other tasks I will give you.$B$BI'll need a splintered log from a treant of Feralas. Encrusted minerals, these can be found on the mountain giants and faerie dragons to the west. Also, find me some resilient sinew from the owlbeasts of the Hinterlands or hippogryphs of Feralas. Finally, I'll need a large amount of metallic fragments from any of these creatures I mentioned.
english.completed: Return to Witch Doctor Uzer'i at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

text.title: 测试容器
text.objectives: 杀死10头铁鬃熊或长牙奔跑者，使用野兽灵魂精华容器缩小并俘获倒下的野兽。
text.description: 尤克里师傅教过我如何制作强力的灵魂武器。我会帮你逐步制作，而你则能给我锻炼手艺的机会。$B$B这个容器能将被击败的生物缩小并困在其中。我们首先需要野兽的灵魂精华，铁鬃熊或长牙奔跑者就行。杀掉它们，在它们的灵魂逃逸之前，用灵魂精华容器将其缩小并俘获。

english.title: Testing the Vessel
english.objectives: Kill 10 Ironfur Bears or Longtooth Runners, and use the Beast Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen beasts.
english.description: Master Uzer'i's taught me in the ways of making spirit weapons of great power. I'll help you set on the path to make some, and you'll give me the chance to practice my craft.$B$BThis vessel can shrink and trap a defeated creature inside of it. We'll need the muisek of beasts first; ironfur bears and longtooth wolves. Kill them, and use the muisek vessel to shrink and capture them before their spirits can escape.

text.title: 角鹰兽灵魂精华
text.objectives: 杀死10头任意种类的乱羽角鹰兽，然后使用灵魂精华容器缩小并俘获它们。
text.description: 下一步是角鹰兽。$B$B就像尤克里师傅一直说的，角鹰兽作为暗夜精灵的忠实伙伴已经许多年了，它们的灵魂同样忠贞不二。$B$B我想他们是不会介意少一两头的，而且就算介意我也不管。我们需要10头南部荒野中乱羽角鹰兽的灵魂精华。

english.title: Hippogryph Muisek
english.objectives: Kill 10 Frayfeather Hippogryphs of any type, then use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture them.
english.description: The next step is hippogryphs.$B$BAs Master Uzer'i always said, hippogryphs have been loyal companions to the night elves for many years, an' their spirits are loyal and steadfast.$B$BI don't think they'll miss a few, and I don't care if they do. We need the muisek of 10 frayfeather hippogyphs in the wilderness to the south.

text.title: 树人灵魂精华
text.objectives: 杀死3个森林漫游者，使用灵魂精华容器缩小并俘获倒下的树人。
text.description: 漫步在森林里的森林漫游者是我们的下一个目标，$n。暗夜精灵将树人征召为盟友，来对抗部落。他们的移动或许缓慢，但他们作为保护者的角色却是不可置疑的。$B$B不久我们就可以将这一力量加以利用。$B$B找到三个森林漫游者，杀掉他们，用灵魂精华容器缩小并俘获他们。

english.title: Treant Muisek
english.objectives: Kill 3 Wandering Forest Walkers. Use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Treants.
english.description: The wandering forest walkers that can be found meandering through the forest are our next target, $n. Night elves have enlisted treants as allies to fight against the horde. Their movement may be slow, but their role as protectors is undeniable.$B$BSoon we will be able to use this power for our own benefit.$B$BFind three wandering forest walkers; kill them, and use the muisek vessel to shrink and capture them.

text.title: 北泉复仇
text.objectives: 杀死6只北泉鹰身人和6只北泉唤风者。
text.description: 曾经，我是一位身手老练的猎人。没有什么生物能让我害怕，直到……$B$B那天我在森林里，刚刚经过一场恶战的我正在擦拭我的剑刃，就在此时我遭到了埋伏。鹰身人包围了我，我勉强才逃出生天。$B$B直到现在，我依然能听见她们的嘶号在回响……$B$B从此以后我就变了。仇恨在我体内沸腾——我必须复仇，哪怕经过了这么多年。$B$B西边就能找到北泉鹰身人。$n，替我报仇。

english.title: Vengeance on the Northspring
english.objectives: Kill 6 Northspring Harpies and 6 Northspring Windcallers.
english.description: In my day, I was a seasoned hunter. There wasn't any creature around that I feared. Until...$B$BI was out in the forest, sharpening my blade after a tough battle, when I was ambushed. Harpies surrounded me, and I barely managed to drag myself to safety.$B$BEven now, I can still hear their cries echoing...$B$BI was never the same after that. But the hate boils inside of me -- I must get even, after all these years.$B$BThe Northspring harpies can be found to the west of here. $n, get my revenge.

text.title: 黑暗坠饰
text.objectives: 击败艾丹娜·邪爪，获得艾丹娜的黑色坠饰。
text.description: 艾丹娜·邪爪是北泉鹰身人的女王，就栖息在西边的废墟中。她是一个绝对邪恶的存在，听说她的心脏是一颗水晶。除了对所有其他生物的憎恨以外，她没有任何感情。你必须面对艾丹娜，把她的黑色坠饰给我带来。$B$B我听说鹰身人所携带的号角可以召唤女王，在废墟北边邪爪之石附近吹响它。$B$B想象一下，当得知这并非她的子民，而是死亡的召唤时，她该有多惊讶。
text.giverWindow: 找到邪爪之石，然后吹响号角，她自会出现。

english.title: Dark Heart
english.objectives: Slay Edana Hatetalon and obtain Edana's Dark Heart.
english.description: Edana Hatetalon is the queen of the Northspring harpies that reside in the ruins to the west. She is pure evil; I have heard that her heart is one of crystal. She is void of any emotion aside from the hate she feels towards all others. You must face Edana and bring me back her dark heart.$B$BI have heard of a horn that harpies carry -- blowing it by the Hatetalon stones, in the northern part of the ruins, will summon the queen.$B$BImagine her surprise when it is not her kin calling her, but her death.
english.giverWindow: Search for the Hatetalon stones, then blast the horn. She will come.

text.title: 戈杜尼宝珠
text.objectives: 从一名戈杜尼术士手里获得戈杜尼宝珠。
text.description: 你在那里大开杀戒的时候……$B$B我收到了一些报告，我从报告中得知那些食人魔带来的威胁不仅仅是普通的乱砍乱伐而已。有人看见他们中的术士随身带着宝珠，很可能是一种象征权力的物品。$B$B那东西很容易就会被人当作是什么粗制的饰品什么的，不过我得搞清楚那玩意到底是什么，以防万一。给我带一颗宝珠回来。

english.title: The Gordunni Orb
english.objectives: Collect a Gordunni Orb from a Gordunni Warlock.
english.description: While you're down there cracking skulls...$B$BI've gotten reports that make me think these ogres may be more than the usual lumbering threat. The Warlocks among them have been seen carrying orbs, possibly items of empowerment.$B$BIt would be easy to dismiss them as crude trinkets, but I need to make sure we're not surprised. Bring me back one of these orbs.

text.title: 和斯瓦尔加交谈
text.objectives: 将戈杜尼宝珠交给石槌要塞的斯瓦尔加。
text.description: 我们既走运又倒霉，步兵。走运的是我可以麻烦你把这东西带走，倒霉的是我的怀疑成真了。这东西满是堕落的恶臭。$B$B它年代不久，也不可能是从废墟里发现的。有人在给食人魔提供这些东西，我们需要在情况恶化之前，知道是谁干的。$B$B把这污秽的物事交给楼上的斯瓦尔加，那个在防御塔顶的术士。他点子多。如果我是你，我就听他的。

english.title: Talk to Swar'jan
english.objectives: Deliver the Gordunni Orb to Swar'jan in Stonemaul Hold.
english.description: We're lucky and unlucky here, grunt. Lucky that I had you bother to bring this back, and unlucky that my suspicions turned out to hold water. This thing's full of corrupted stench.$B$BIt's far too new to be something fished out of the ruins, either. Someone is supplying these ogres, and we need to know who before this becomes a situation.$B$BGet that filthy thing upstairs to Swar'jan, the warlock on top of the guard tower. He's good for a few ideas; I'd listen to his suggestions, if I were you.

text.title: The Master's Plan
text.objectives: Learn more about the cult's plans at the altar in the eastern part of the Jaggedswine Farm.
text.description: You're fitting in well here, $n, but there is more to us than daily chores and spreading the message. I'm sure you heard a little bit about it when you first joined.$B$BAs you know, this world is ending and the unprepared will die painful deaths.$B$BWe have been given a gift, an opportunity to become something greater and more powerful. Overseer Golbaz is preparing a ritual before the altar at the eastern end of the farm. Wait there for him, and learn more of your new brothers and sisters.
text.completed: Return to Overseer Jintak at the Jaggedswine Farm.

english.objectives: Learn more about the cult's plans at the altar in the eastern part of the Jaggedswine Farm.

I'm sure you heard a little bit about it when you first joined.$B$BAs you know, this world is ending and the unprepared will die painful deaths.$B$BWe have been given a gift, an opportunity to become something greater and more powerful.
