english.completed: Return to Overseer Jintak at the Jaggedswine Farm.

text.title: 诱拐食人魔
text.objectives: 使用改良过的灵魂石俘虏一名戈多克食人魔。
text.description: 这些东西不可能是戈杜尼制作的。肯定是有人给他们的，我们需要知道是谁。$B$B守卫厄运之槌的上层阶级戈多克食人魔应该对此事更加了解。奥哈恩毫无疑问会派你去削减他们的数量，但是我需要一个活口。$B$B把这颗宝珠带回去。它类似于一颗灵魂石，没错，我做了一些……调整。在一名被削弱的食人魔面前使用它，当你成功俘虏了食人魔之后，就将他带回来给我。

english.title: Ogre Abduction
english.objectives: Use the Modified Soulstone to capture a Gordok ogre.
english.description: There's no way the Gordunni made these. They're being supplied. Someone is giving them gifts of power, and we need to find out who.$B$BThe upper-class Gordok that guard Dire Maul will know more about this. Orhan is no doubt having you thin their numbers, but I'll need one alive.$B$BTake the orb back. It's similar to a Soulstone, so I've made some...adjustments. Hold it up in front of a weakened Gordok ogre, and once you've captured him, bring it back here.

objectiveDetails.description: 俘虏戈多克食人魔法师

text.title: 精灵龙灵魂精华
text.objectives: 杀死8条小精龙或精龙，使用灵魂精华容器缩小并俘获倒下的精灵龙。
text.description: $n，下一个我要让你俘获的生物，外表上看起来十分脆弱，但其强大的灵魂正是我们所追求的。我所说的是一直作为暗夜精灵盟友的精灵龙。我们必须抓到一个，以便部落也可以从其灵魂的力量中获益。$B$B这是灵魂精华容器，$n。杀掉8条小精龙或精龙，俘获它们的灵魂精华。你可以在西边找到它们。

english.title: Faerie Dragon Muisek
english.objectives: Kill 8 Sprite Darters or Sprite Dragons. Use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Faerie Dragons.
english.description: $n, next I must have you capture a creature that in appearance, may look quite fragile, yet its powerful spirit is what we are truly after. The faerie dragons that I speak of have served the night elves as their allies. We must capture one so that the horde may benefit from this strength of spirit as well.$B$BHere is the muisek, $n. Kill 8 sprite darters or sprite dragons, and capture their muisek. They may be found to the west of here.

text.title: 山岭巨人灵魂精华
text.objectives: 杀死7名山岭巨人，使用灵魂精华容器缩小并俘获倒下的山岭巨人。
text.description: 当燃烧军团出现在这个世界的时候，山岭巨人离开了群山，来帮助暗夜精灵。你沿着他们多山的地形旅行时，就能从巨大的身形和振动的大地辨认出他们来。$B$B我等不及要利用那种强大的力量了。杀掉7名山岭巨人，然后用灵魂精华容器俘获他们强大的灵魂精华。

english.title: Mountain Giant Muisek
english.objectives: Kill 7 Mountain Giants. Use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Mountain Giants.
english.description: The mountain giants left the mountains to aid the night elves when the Burning Legion appeared in the world. You will know them by their massive size and the way the ground begins to shake as you travel along their rocky terrain.$B$BI am eager to harness power of that size. Kill 7 mountain giants, then use the muisek vessel to capture their powerful muisek.

text.title: The Doomsday Plan
text.objectives: Take the Elemental Devices to Blood Guard Torek in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.
text.description: The first batch of elemental devices are ready. Your task will be to conceal them inside the city of Orgrimmar. The devices will unleash their fire elementals at the proper time. Don't worry, $n, you'll be safely away before that happens.$B$BDo not do anything that would draw attention to yourself.$B$B<The overseer hands you a package containing several of the elemental devices. This is just the kind of proof that Blood Guard Torek was hoping you'd uncover. You should probably bring the devices to him.>

english.title: The Doomsday Plan
english.objectives: Take the Elemental Devices to Blood Guard Torek in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.
english.description: The first batch of elemental devices are ready. Your task will be to conceal them inside the city of Orgrimmar. The devices will unleash their fire elementals at the proper time. Don't worry, $n, you'll be safely away before that happens.$B$BDo not do anything that would draw attention to yourself.$B$B<The overseer hands you a package containing several of the elemental devices. This is just the kind of proof that Blood Guard Torek was hoping you'd uncover. You should probably bring the devices to him.>

text.title: Thwarting Twilight's Hammer
text.objectives: Break Elemental Devices to release their elementals. You must defeat 5 Raging Fire Elementals.
text.description: You can't have been the only person sent into Orgrimmar to deploy those devices containing fire elementals. We have to find and disable the rest of the devices before they set their captive elementals free and burn down the city.$B$BAre you familiar enough with the devices to destroy them? You need to break them open before the fire elementals inside have had time to reach full strength. They should be easy to defeat if you open the devices early. The cultists have probably put them all over the city.

english.title: Thwarting Twilight's Hammer
english.objectives: Break Elemental Devices to release their elementals. You must defeat 5 Raging Fire Elementals.
english.description: You can't have been the only person sent into Orgrimmar to deploy those devices containing fire elementals. We have to find and disable the rest of the devices before they set their captive elementals free and burn down the city.$B$BAre you familiar enough with the devices to destroy them? You need to break them open before the fire elementals inside have had time to reach full strength. They should be easy to defeat if you open the devices early. The cultists have probably put them all over the city.

text.title: 扭曲的姐妹
text.objectives: 杀死7名堕落的树妖。
text.description: 我听说了你同堕落巨龙战斗的事迹，$n，对于你的勇气，我深表谢意……但我收到了一份令人不安的消息。$B$B尽管是暗夜精灵的盟友，但森林里的树妖对我们一直很友好。可她们突然变得残忍扭曲起来，攻击任何胆敢靠近东部荒野的生物。$B$B我担心这里难民们的安全，$n。拜托你，阻止这些扭曲的树妖。

english.title: Twisted Sisters
english.objectives: Kill 7 Corrupted Dryads.
english.description: I have heard of your battle against the corrupted dragons, $n, and I thank you for your courage... but I have disturbing news.$B$BThe dryads of the forest, though allies of the Night Elves, have always passed us by in peace. But they have become cruel and twisted, attacking any who wander the eastern wilds.$B$BI fear for the safety of the refugees here, $n. Please, put a stop to these twisted dryads.

text.title: 失踪的学徒
text.objectives: 在黑雾废墟里寻找失踪的学徒。
text.description: 不知能否打扰你一下，$c……$B$B我的一个学生独自去南边的黑雾废墟探索了。我警告过他，那里太危险，但他过于兴奋，听不进去。我跟他讲过一个被封印在那些废墟中的护符的故事。现在看来，他可能是去找那东西了，都是因为我……$B$B埃斯图兰禁止我们去追他。如果你打算去那边的话，能不能帮忙找一找？

english.title: The Lost Apprentice
english.objectives: Look for the Lost Apprentice in the Darkmist Ruins.
english.description: If you have a moment, $c...$B$BOne of the students I was teaching has gone to explore the darkmist ruins to the south by himself. I warned him that it was too dangerous, but he was too excited to listen.  I had spoken with him earlier about an amulet that is concealed within those ruins.  Now, I fear that he may have run off in search of it, because of me...$B$BEstulan has forbidden us to pursue him. If you go there, could you please look for him?

text.title: Alert Our Leaders
text.objectives: Speak with Garrosh Hellscream at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom.
text.description: You have successfully defended Orgrimmar from the threat posed by this Twilight's Hammer cult, $n, and without shedding the blood of our own people. Our enemy will not rest for long. I cannot imagine that Cho'Gall will accept defeat so easily.$B$BGarrosh Hellscream is a well-known hero of the Horde and he will know how to deal with this matter. Go to the Valley of Wisdom and speak to him in Grommash Hold. Tell young Hellscream that our enemies have shown themselves and we must be prepared for their return.

english.title: Alert Our Leaders
english.objectives: Speak with Garrosh Hellscream at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom.
english.description: You have successfully defended Orgrimmar from the threat posed by this Twilight's Hammer cult, $n, and without shedding the blood of our own people. Our enemy will not rest for long. I cannot imagine that Cho'Gall will accept defeat so easily.$B$BGarrosh Hellscream is a well-known hero of the Horde and he will know how to deal with this matter. Go to the Valley of Wisdom and speak to him in Grommash Hold. Tell young Hellscream that our enemies have shown themselves and we must be prepared for their return.

text.title: 秋风扫落叶
text.objectives: 击败8名暮光风暴召唤者和5名咆哮的裂隙位面生物。
text.description: 营地里那票干得真不错，$n。你不在的时候，我在圣殿前祈祷，于幻景中，我看到戈德林在密切地关注你。$B$B然而我们处于被动的时间太长了，现在是该对暮光之锤进行直接打击了。$B$B飞到闪电崖去阻挠他们的行动，杀掉风暴召唤者和他们准备释放出来的怪物。
text.completion: You should've seen the battle from here! Bodies were falling off of the cliff! Spectacular!

english.title: Sweeping the Shelf
english.objectives: Slay 8 Twilight Stormcallers and 5 Howling Riftdwellers.
english.description: Wonderful work in the hovel, $n. I prayed at the shrine while you were away, and in my visions, Goldrinn was watching you closely.$B$BBut we've been on the defensive too long: it's time to foil the Twilight's Hammer directly.$B$BFly up to the Lightning Ledge and disrupt their operation. Kill the stormcallers and the monstrosities they're preparing to unleash!
english.completion: You should've seen the battle from here! Bodies were falling off of the cliff! Spectacular!

text.title: 瓶中闪电
text.objectives: 从暮光闪电通道里收集一个充能的冷凝瓶。
text.description: 当我在圣殿祈祷时，戈德林向我展示了另一幅幻象。我看见你耸立在闪电崖上，手中攥着闪电。戈德林似乎感觉这无比重要，但我不明白这位远古半神到底在计划些什么……$B$B到闪电崖去，$n。暮光之锤正在进行某种叫做“闪电通道”的试验。调查一下这些通道，然后用这根图腾召唤戈德林之魂，看看他是怎么想的……
text.progress: We meet again, $c. You carve a path of fear and confusion in your wake.$B$B<Goldrinn's eyes twinkle expectantly.>
text.completion: So, it is true! You indeed carry lightning in your hands.$B$BYou are the chosen one, $N. You will be my champion, and carry my vengeance to realms where I cannot tread...

english.title: Lightning in a Bottle
english.objectives: Collect a Charged Condenser Jar from a Twilight Lightning Channel.
english.description: When I prayed at the shrine, Goldrinn granted me another vision. I saw you standing astride the Lightning Ledge, with lightning in your hands. Goldrinn seems to feel that this is of the utmost importance, but I don't understand what the ancient has planned...$B$B$n, go to the Lightning Ledge. Twilight's Hammer has been running experiments with something called a "Lightning Channel." Investigate these channels, then use this totem to summon the Spirit of Goldrinn and see what he has in mind...
english.progress: We meet again, $c. You carve a path of fear and confusion in your wake.$B$B<Goldrinn's eyes twinkle expectantly.>
english.completion: So, it is true! You indeed carry lightning in your hands.$B$BYou are the chosen one, $N. You will be my champion, and carry my vengeance to realms where I cannot tread...

text.title: 秋风扫落叶
text.objectives: 击败8名暮光风暴召唤者和5名咆哮的裂隙位面生物。
text.description: 圣殿安全了，食人魔抱头鼠窜。够了。进攻的时候到了。$B$B我们头顶的闪电崖上正酝酿着某种罪恶的行径。该把古神的怒火释放出来了！$B$B飞到闪电崖去摧毁那里的暮光之锤。粉碎他们，$n，摧毁他们的造物，把他们赶出闪电崖。
text.completion: Impressive, $n. Very impressive.$B$BYou embody all of the strength of the wolf ancient, and possess the wisdom to use your powers well. I salute you.

english.title: Sweeping the Shelf
english.objectives: Slay 8 Twilight Stormcallers and 5 Howling Riftdwellers.
english.description: The shrine is secure, the ogres in disarray. Enough. The time has come to go on the offensive.$B$BSomething sinister is underway above us, on the Lightning Ledge. It is time to unleash the fury of the ancients!$B$BFly up to the Lightning Ledge and demolish the Twilight's Hammer there. Crush them, $n, slay their creations and hurl their bodies from the mountainside!
english.completion: Impressive, $n. Very impressive.$B$BYou embody all of the strength of the wolf ancient, and possess the wisdom to use your powers well. I salute you.

text.title: 瓶中闪电
text.objectives: 从暮光闪电通道里收集一个充能的冷凝瓶。
text.description: 你在营地的时候，洛戈什又降下了一幅幻象，$n。我看见你脚踩闪电崖，手中握着闪电。景象十分鲜明：洛戈什感觉它极其重要。我们不能让远古半神失望。$B$B在闪电崖上，暮光之锤已经对他们称之为“闪电通道”的装置进行了多次试验。$B$B调查其中一个通道，用这根图腾召唤洛戈什之魂，了解一下远古半神的计划……
text.progress: We meet again, $c. You fight well! You carve a path of fear and confusion in your wake.$B$B<Lo'Gosh peers at you, expectantly.>
text.completion: So, it is true! You indeed carry lightning in your hands.$B$BYou are the chosen one, $n. You will be my champion, and carry my vengeance to realms where I cannot tread...

english.title: Lightning in a Bottle
english.objectives: Collect a Charged Condenser Jar from a Twilight Lightning Channel.
english.description: Lo'Gosh granted me a vision while you were in the hovel, $n. I saw you striding across the Lightning Ledge, with lightning bolts in your hand. The vision was powerful: Lo'Gosh feels this is of utmost importance. We must not fail the ancient.$B$BUpon the Lightning Ledge, Twilight's Hammer has been experimenting with devices they call "Lightning Channels."$B$BInvestigate one of these channels, then use this totem to summon the Spirit of Lo'Gosh and learn what the ancient is planning...
english.progress: We meet again, $c. You fight well! You carve a path of fear and confusion in your wake.$B$B<Lo'Gosh peers at you, expectantly.>
english.completion: So, it is true! You indeed carry lightning in your hands.$B$BYou are the chosen one, $n. You will be my champion, and carry my vengeance to realms where I cannot tread...

text.title: 前往西岸峰
text.objectives: 向夏恩借一头驭风者，然后同菲拉斯西岸峰的卡纳提·灰云交谈。
text.description: 为了千针石林众生，我们在西岸峰展开了救灾工作。夏恩会把我的驭风者借给你，让你安全抵达。着陆后和卡纳提·灰云交谈。$B$B人命关天，你要赶快出发！

english.title: To the Summit
english.objectives: Borrow a wind rider from Shyn and speak with Kanati Greycloud at Westreach Summit in Thousand Needles.
english.description: We are staging a relief effort at Westreach Summit for all of Thousand Needles. Shyn will lend you my wind rider to safely get you there. Speak with Kanati Greycloud when you land.$B$BYou must go quickly if lives are to be saved!

text.title: 争取时间
text.objectives: 杀死8名金加塔尔袭击者。
text.description: 我们损失了很多优秀的士兵。要不是有你，恐怕阵亡数字还要增加。$b$b请接受我诚挚的谢意。$b$b如果萨满祭司的话属实，我们的时间已经不多了。纳迦正在这片水域中搜寻幸存者。$b$b但是我们还没有准备好跟他们作战。你必须为我们争取时间。杀死追踪我们的纳迦，减缓他们前进的步伐。

english.title: Buy Us Some Time
english.objectives: Slay 8 Zin'jatar Raiders.
english.description: So many good men have been lost today. Without you, that number would be even higher.$b$bYou have our gratitude.$b$bIf what the shaman says is true, then there is no time to spare. The naga are scouring these waters looking for survivors.$b$bWe are not yet ready to fight. You must buy us time to make preparations. Find the naga that hunt us and delay their efforts.

text.title: 舒缓情绪
text.objectives: 马克要你在柯尔普萨之森中收集5箱沉没的货物。
text.description: 你问我感觉如何？$B$B怎么形容呢，一只巨大的海兽猛烈地撞击甲板，于是我跌入海中，差点没被淹死……感觉不太好！$B$B老实说，我真是紧张到快要崩溃了。$B$B船只残骸附近漂浮着不少货物，如果你能帮我抢救一些回来，我或许可以试着做点吃的，舒缓一下情绪……
text.progress: Were ya able to grab some supplies, $r?
text.completion: I trust we both know what's been going on inside these crates...$b$bThat's right... ferrrmenntation! Here y'are. My personal secret recipe.$b$bYou wouldn't get this from any other guy!

english.title: Nerve Tonic
english.objectives: Mack wants you to collect 5 Sunken Cargo in Kelp'thar Forest.
english.description: How am I feelin', you ask?$b$bWell, after bein' yanked from the deck of our ship by a giant sea monster and then left to drown in the sea... not so good!$b$bMy nerves are gettin' the best of me, to be honest.$b$bIf you could round up some of the supplies that are sure to be floatin' around the nearby wrecks, I could likely whip up somethin' that'll take the edge off...
english.progress: Were ya able to grab some supplies, $r?
english.completion: I trust we both know what's been going on inside these crates...$b$bThat's right... ferrrmenntation! Here y'are. My personal secret recipe.$b$bYou wouldn't get this from any other guy!

text.title: 托什的复仇
text.objectives: 跟瑟尔萨莱神殿废墟的托什·混沌治愈者谈一谈。
text.description: 你在潮光洞穴里见过托什是吧？他追着逃跑的纳迦一直到东边一处废墟，然后就来搬救兵。$B$B赶快到废墟去找托什。要是你发现纳迦究竟想要什么的话，也请让我们知道。

english.title: Toshe's Vengeance
english.objectives: Speak to Toshe Chaosrender at the Ruins of Thelserai Temple.
english.description: You met Toshe back in Damplight Cavern, didn't you? He followed some of the fleeing naga to a set of ruins to the east and then sent for help.$B$BFind Toshe at the ruins as soon as you can. If you find out anything about what the naga want, please let us know.

text.title: 螃蟹光临
text.objectives: 杀掉10只绿沙蟹。
text.description: 这些螃蟹不是很友好…非常…不友好……$B$B萨姆一直钻个没完，这可把它们惹火了。根据经验，我知道萨姆是没法儿阻止的，那么我们就把思维逆转一下来看看，好吗？

english.title: Crabby Patrons
english.objectives: Kill 10 Green Sand Crabs.
english.description: These crabs are not friendly. Not. Friendly.$B$BSam's endless drilling is riling them up. I know from experience that there's no stopping Sam, so let's look into the other side of things, shall we?

text.title: 新斗篷的光泽
text.objectives: 将10个闪光的小精龙翅膀带给莫沙彻营地的克鲁伊格·碎颅。
text.description: 你好，$c。我和同伴们一同南下菲拉斯，是为我们在奥格瑞玛的主人们执行一项任务。$B$B我的老婆科琳十分喜欢新衣服，我打算用精灵龙轻薄的翅膀为她织一件斗篷。你能不能帮助我？那些翅膀炫丽的小精龙就在莫沙彻营地的西边。

english.title: A New Cloak's Sheen
english.objectives: Bring 10 Iridescent Sprite Darter Wings to Krueg Skullsplitter in Camp Mojache.
english.description: Well met, $c. I've traveled with my companions down to Feralas on a mission for our Orgrimmar masters.$B$BMy life-mate Korrin finds great pleasure in new clothing, so I aim to make her a new cloak adorned with the gossamer wings of faerie dragons. Would you be able to help me? Sprite darters with the gorgeous wings I want are west of Camp Mojache.

text.title: 恐怖的发现
text.objectives: 将20个恐怖图腾之角带给莫沙彻营地的克鲁伊格·碎颅。
text.description: 恐怖图腾氏族！那些懦弱的叛徒还潜伏在附近，呃……$B$B你得回去，$c。回去把他们的角给我带来……可以的话我要成堆的角。不可小觑恐怖图腾的实力。回去击败他们，让恐怖图腾从菲拉斯消失。

english.title: A Grim Discovery
english.objectives: Bring 20 Grimtotem Horns to Krueg Skullsplitter in Camp Mojache.
english.description: The Grimtotem clan! Those gutless traitors are still lurking around here, eh...$B$BYou have to go back, $c. Go back and bring me their horns... piles of them if you can. The Grimtotem are not to be trifled with or underestimated. Go back and slay them; let the rivers in Feralas run red with their dark blood.

text.title: 木爪的战争
text.objectives: 把10束木爪豺狼人的鬃毛交给莫沙彻营地的哈杜肯·迅蹄。
text.description: 豺狼人……已经不仅仅是让人讨厌而已了。他们的存在已经威胁到了这个营地！是不是菲拉斯的原住民已不重要，如果我们再不下定决心对付他们，到时候被赶出这个地区的人就会是我们。$B$B最近豺狼人对营地的攻击变得频繁起来。我们需要你帮忙把他们的数量削减下去，把他们的十束鬃毛带来，我会好好地奖赏你的。$B$B去吧！

english.title: War on the Woodpaw
english.objectives: Bring 10 Woodpaw Gnoll Manes to Hadoken Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.
english.description: The gnolls... they are more than a nuisance.  They are a constant threat to the existence of this very camp!  It is irrelevant whether they are indigenous to Feralas or not; if we do not strengthen our resolve against them, we will find ourselves driven out of the entire region.$B$BThe gnoll attacks against the camp have become more fevered as of late.  We need your aid in thinning their numbers; bring to me ten of their manes, and I will reward you handsomely for your effort.$B$BGo!

text.title: 突击
text.objectives: 杀死5名木爪突击队员。
text.description: 不幸的是，豺狼人的坚韧同他们的蛮横和愚蠢一样知名。我一次又一次地将他们从营地里赶回去，要不是酋长心慈手软，他们早就被灭族了。$B$B这么多年来，事情就在力量与支配中反反复复。他们数量剧增，威胁到了营地，一定要铲除那些突击队员，他们是最强壮的豺狼人。$B$B这样就能把他们赶回到森林里去，让我们得到一段时间的安宁，等他们又不长记性了再说。
text.completion: You've done as I have asked, and for that I salute you.  Take this small reward as compensation for your efforts, $n.$B$BWith their numbers thinned and their leaders slain, the gnolls will think twice about storming the camp.  This doesn't conclude the issue at hand, however...$B$BThere must be some reason why the gnolls have been whipped into such a frenzied state.  Before they have a chance to regroup, I want to find out what is causing it.

english.title: Alpha Strike
english.objectives: Kill 5 Woodpaw Alphas.
english.description: Gnolls are unfortunately as resilient as they are brutish and stupid. I have driven back the gnolls time after time from our camp, and it is only our chieftain's mercy that prevents them from being wiped out entirely.$B$BOver the years, it has fallen into a dance of strength and dominance. When their numbers surge and they threaten the camp, the alphas, the strongest gnolls, must be slain.$B$BThis will drive them back into the forest, and leave us is peace until they forget their lessons.
english.completion: You've done as I have asked, and for that I salute you.  Take this small reward as compensation for your efforts, $n.$B$BWith their numbers thinned and their leaders slain, the gnolls will think twice about storming the camp.  This doesn't conclude the issue at hand, however...$B$BThere must be some reason why the gnolls have been whipped into such a frenzied state.  Before they have a chance to regroup, I want to find out what is causing it.

text.title: 木爪调查
text.objectives: 在莫沙彻营地南部的豺狼人营地里找到豺狼人作战计划。
text.description: 豺狼人并不聪明，但在他们最近的活动中，无疑颇有一些像样的策略。如果我们能把这些计划拿到手，就能更为了解究竟是什么让他们如此的有组织。$B$B我要你去木爪村，寻找任何类似于他们作战计划的东西。他们一定有什么东西，没了它，他们的进攻也不会那么有组织性。找到它们，拿到后就给我带来。

english.title: Woodpaw Investigation
english.objectives: Find the gnoll battle plans somewhere in the gnoll camps to the south of Camp Mojache.
english.description: Gnolls aren't the sharpest tools in the shed, but they will no doubt have some sort of documented strategy on their recent activity.  If we were to find those plans, then we'd have a clearer idea of what is making them so worked up.$B$BI want you to head back to the Woodpaw and find anything that might resemble their battle plans.  They have to have something; their attacks have been too coordinated to be done without them.  Find them, and return to me when you have them.

text.title: 作战计划
text.objectives: 将豺狼人作战计划交给莫沙彻营地的哈杜肯·迅蹄。
text.description: 既然豺狼人作战计划已经找到了，剩下的就是把计划带到莫沙彻营地，交给哈杜肯·迅蹄。也许他或者别的什么人能搞明白豺狼人到底要干什么。
text.progress: Welcome back $n - were you able to find some tangible evidence as to the plans of the gnolls?
text.completion: Ah, this is exactly what we needed.  While I am not so skilled at ciphering what most of the scrawling on this map is, I've seen enough battle plans in my day to understand what is happening with the gnolls.  It looks like they are currently fighting a two front war.  One is with us... but it seems that their main energy has been against a foe to their south.$B$BThere's more at hand here than meets the eye.  Perhaps it is time to figure out who this other foe they face really is.

english.title: The Battle Plans
english.objectives: Bring the Woodpaw Battle Plans to Hadoken Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.
english.description: With the battle plans of the gnolls discovered, all that now remains is to bring the plans back to Hadoken Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.  Perhaps he or someone there can make further sense of what the gnolls are up to.
english.progress: Welcome back $n - were you able to find some tangible evidence as to the plans of the gnolls?
english.completion: Ah, this is exactly what we needed.  While I am not so skilled at ciphering what most of the scrawling on this map is, I've seen enough battle plans in my day to understand what is happening with the gnolls.  It looks like they are currently fighting a two front war.  One is with us... but it seems that their main energy has been against a foe to their south.$B$BThere's more at hand here than meets the eye.  Perhaps it is time to figure out who this other foe they face really is.

text.title: 祖卡什的侵害
text.objectives: 将20块祖卡什虫壳带给菲拉斯莫沙彻营地的哈杜肯·迅蹄。
text.description: 根据我们的侦查来看，我们相信豺狼人在南边的敌人是一个类昆虫种族。坦白地说，它们是否有感知力根本不重要。如果是它们把豺狼人逼得对我们如此疯狂的话，那么它们对我们来说就会是一个比豺狼人更为严重的威胁。$B$B深入到这些祖卡什所居住的地方去，那里叫做痛苦深渊。削减一点它们的数量，然后回来向我报告你的发现，同时别忘了把它们的虫壳带来作为你大展拳脚的证据。
text.progress: How goes the hunt, $N?  Are you here to report your success?
text.completion: Well done, $c.  Though the extensiveness of the Zukk'ash presence will not be thwarted with anything less than a full-scale invasion, you have bought us some time so we can devise a proper strategy.$B$BI will be sure to have these carapaces analyzed; we'll need to learn everything about them before we deal with what has unfortunately turned into a much larger issue than we had anticipated.

english.title: Zukk'ash Infestation
english.objectives: Bring 20 Zukk'ash Carapaces to Hadoken Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.
english.description: From what scouting we have managed to muster, we believe that the foe south of the gnolls is an insect-like race.  Frankly, it is irrelevant whether or not they're sentient.  If they are driving the gnolls to frenzy against us, then they are as big of a threat - if not more - than the gnolls.$B$BDive deep into where these Zukk'ash insects dwell; it is known as the Writhing Deep.  Thin their numbers and report back to me what you find, bringing back their carapaces as evidence of your handiwork.
english.progress: How goes the hunt, $N?  Are you here to report your success?
english.completion: Well done, $c.  Though the extensiveness of the Zukk'ash presence will not be thwarted with anything less than a full-scale invasion, you have bought us some time so we can devise a proper strategy.$B$BI will be sure to have these carapaces analyzed; we'll need to learn everything about them before we deal with what has unfortunately turned into a much larger issue than we had anticipated.

text.title: 扭曲者维林尼亚斯
text.objectives: 击败扭曲者维林尼亚斯。
text.description: 其他的灵魂和我被一个残忍的恶魔维林尼亚斯缚在这里。他抓住了我们，那扭曲、毫无心智的野兽，千年来吞噬着我们的灵魂。$B$B你可以用灵魂的诱惑和奥术魔法把他引出来。把这冷凝精华带到废墟北部尽头的枯树边，用它引出维林尼亚斯并将其杀掉，然后我才能终获自由……
text.giverWindow: 在北边找到这棵树，召唤他，并结束他和他的人民受到的折磨。

english.title: Verinias the Twisted
english.objectives: Defeat Verinias the Twisted.
english.description: The other spirits and I are bound here by a cruel demon named Verinias. He is our captor, a twisted, mindless beast who devours our souls over millennia.$B$BThe lure of the souls and arcane magic you've brought me should let you draw him out. Take this condensed essence to the dead tree at the far north of the ruins. Use it to lure Verinias and slay him, that I may finally be free...
english.giverWindow: Find the tree to the north, summon him, and end his torment of my people!

text.title: 毒刺鞭笞者
text.objectives: 击败痛苦深渊的毒刺鞭笞者，将它的腺体带给菲拉斯莫沙彻营地的哈杜肯·迅蹄。
text.description: 在调查痛苦深渊的时候，我们的一个斥候报告说看见了一只巨大的昆虫——比其他的要大得多——正徘徊在扭曲的地形上。它不仅更大，而且还分泌着某种其它昆虫所没有的气息。我们给它起了个名字——毒刺鞭笞者。$B$B这畜生的内脏将会具有非常高的研究价值，届时我们可以从它身上找出一个可以对付这一最新威胁的最佳办法。赶紧去把它的分泌腺给我带来吧！
text.progress: Have you managed to bring down Stinglasher yet?
text.completion: Impressive, $c... most impressive!  If Stinglasher is indeed one of their strongest creatures, the study of the beast will prove to be quite valuable in time.  It's now my charge to make sure we defend ourselves long enough to take advantage of it.$B$BPlease accept this coin bounty as a token of the entire camp's thanks, $N.  Well done.
text.giverWindow: 躲开他的剧毒鞭笞！

english.title: Stinglasher
english.objectives: Defeat Stinglasher in the Writhing Deep, bringing its glands back to Hadoken Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.
english.description: In surveying the Writhing Deep, one of our scouts reported seeing a giant insect - much larger than the other insects spotted - wandering about the twisted terrain.  Not only is it larger, it also seems to secrete some sort of aura that the other insects don't.  We've given it a name - Stinglasher.$B$BThe innards of this beast would be invaluable to study as we figure out the best way to deal with this new threat.  Cut out its secretion glands and bring it back to me immediately!
english.progress: Have you managed to bring down Stinglasher yet?
english.completion: Impressive, $c... most impressive!  If Stinglasher is indeed one of their strongest creatures, the study of the beast will prove to be quite valuable in time.  It's now my charge to make sure we defend ourselves long enough to take advantage of it.$B$BPlease accept this coin bounty as a token of the entire camp's thanks, $N.  Well done.
english.giverWindow: Stay clear of his venom splash!

text.title: 煽动元素
text.objectives: 把杜松子喂给精灵龙吃，然后消灭4名暮光煽动者。
text.description: 这不是单纯的自然事件，$n。一定有一股我们未曾注意到的暮光势力在背后。$B$B无论是谁为元素煽风点火，他们一定用邪恶的法术遮蔽了我们的视线。$B$B去寻求精灵龙的帮助，他们都在世界之树附近徘徊，能够看破敌人的幻术。$B$B把附近生长的杜松子喂给他们吃，就能赢得他们的好感。
text.completion: You've done well, $n.  We cannot allow the Twilight's Hammer spies this close to the world tree!

english.title: Inciting the Elements
english.objectives: Feed Juniper Berries to the Faerie Dragons and slay 4 Twilight Inciters.
english.description: This is no mere natural occurrence, $n.  There must be a twilight presence behind our lines that we haven't accounted for.$B$BIt's possible that whoever is instigating the elemental disturbance is using foul magic to hide themselves from our sight.$B$BSeek the aid of the faerie dragons that roam near the World Tree; they can see through any of our enemy's illusions.$B$BFeed them the juniper berries that grow nearby to gain their trust.
english.completion: You've done well, $n.  We cannot allow the Twilight's Hammer spies this close to the world tree!

text.title: 深渊坐骑
text.objectives: 钓上并制服一只深渊海马。
text.description: 如果你想要在这片海藻构成的森林中走动，就必须弄到一只靠谱的坐骑。我想到了一个比海龟更好的方案，而且还不远。$B$B在我们西边的那根绳子上绑一份鱼饵，等它引来了海马，就骑上去。$B$B要当心，你恐怕得多费些工夫才能制服那野兽。
text.completion: Amazing! You look exhausted. She must have really made you work for it.$B$BLife should be a lot easier down here going forward with a mount that swift at your beckoning. Congratulations, $n!

english.title: The Abyssal Ride
english.objectives: Lure and subdue an Abyssal Seahorse.
english.description: If you are going to be making it anywhere in this kelp forest, we need to get you a reliable mount. I think I've come up with a better plan than the sea turtle, and it's not far.$B$BTie off a lure at the rope just west of us, and then mount the seahorse that it will attract.$B$BBe warned, you may need to work hard to break the beast.
english.completion: Amazing! You look exhausted. She must have really made you work for it.$B$BLife should be a lot easier down here going forward with a mount that swift at your beckoning. Congratulations, $n!

text.title: 艾森娜的奇迹
text.objectives: 把森林之心交给海加尔山艾森娜林地的哈缪尔·符文图腾。
text.description: <诺尔度张开燃烧的四肢上手指般的枝杈，露出一颗完好无损、微微发光的种子。>$B$B此乃森林之心，生命的种子。$B$B把它带到艾森娜林地去，交给你们的大德鲁伊——哈缪尔·符文图腾，他知道该如何激发出它的力量。我保证，荒野中万灵将不再沉默。新的生命将会从灰烬中重生。$B$B谢谢你，$r。我的时候到了。
text.progress: I am at my wit's end, $N! Aessina is silent.$B$BHave you found something? What is this?

english.title: Aessina's Miracle
english.objectives: Take the Heart of the Forest to Hamuul Runetotem at the Grove of Aessina in Mount Hyjal.
english.description: <The finger-like branches of one of Nordu's burning limbs part, revealing an untouched, glimmering seed.>$B$BThis is the Heart of the Forest. The seed of life.$B$BTake this to your Arch Druid at Aessina's Grove - Hamuul Runetotem will know how to invoke its power. I promise you, the wilderness spirit will be silent no longer. New life will bloom from the ashes of old.$B$BThank you, $r. My time is done.
english.progress: I am at my wit's end, $N! Aessina is silent.$B$BHave you found something? What is this?

enders.name: 大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾

text.title: 山顶危机
text.objectives: 杀死5名戈杜尼山丘卫兵。
text.description: 莫沙彻被人称之为是菲拉斯荒野中的避风港，对此我很自豪，但是营地面临着诸多威胁。戈杜尼食人魔聚集在北方山脚附近，霸占着那里的土地，欺凌着那里的野生动物。$B$B由于我们的兄弟姐妹不断来此寻求庇护，我们不能再允许那些食人魔滞留此地了。去北方把食人魔们赶走。

english.title: The Hilltop Threat
english.objectives: Kill 5 Gordunni Hillguards.
english.description: I am proud of Mojache's reputation as a safe haven in the wilds of Feralas, but the camp faces many threats. The Gordunni ogres gather nearby in the northern foothills, claiming their territory and despoiling the wildlife.$B$BWith the arrival of our brothers and sisters seeking shelter, I cannot let them linger any more. Go north and drive the ogres out.

text.title: 发现野人
text.objectives: 杀掉大金刚。
text.description: 你本人或许没有亲眼见到过，但我的远行者送来一份令人不安的报告。山上的食人魔从野外抓来了一头巨大的大脚野人。$B$B我不知道它被关了多久，但食人魔可不像是会养宠物的样子。恐怕他们是计划要将那头受尽折磨的野兽放到莫沙彻营地里来。$B$B回到戈杜尼前哨站的最深处，杀掉大脚野人，$n。
text.completion: I will be able to rest easy now, $n. You've saved our camp from a terrible menace.
text.giverWindow: 我很好奇他怎么会叫这名字…

english.title: Sasquatch Sighting
english.objectives: Kill Bigfist.
english.description: You may have seen this with your own eyes, but my longrunners have reported something disturbing to me. The gordunni in the hills have captured an enormous sasquatch from the wilds.$B$BI don't know how long it's been held, but ogres are not ones for hobbies. I fear they plan to unleash the tortured beast on Camp Mojache.$B$BReturn to the deepest corner of the Gordunni Outpost and slay the sasquatch, $n.
english.completion: I will be able to rest easy now, $n. You've saved our camp from a terrible menace.
english.giverWindow: I wonder how he got his name...

text.title: 驯服驯兽员
text.objectives: 杀死6名戈杜尼驯兽员。
text.description: 戈杜尼食人魔并不善于驯服野兽。如果他们正在尝试掌握这门技术的话，那就值得警惕了。他们驯服的大脚野人或许对营地来说是主要威胁，但抓住它的戈杜尼食人魔也要铲除。放任不管的话，他们可能还会去抓另一只。$B$B杀掉戈杜尼驯兽员，让食人魔知道他们的行为是不能容忍的！
text.completion: Good, good. Let's hope the ogres are at least smart enough to realize we're sending a message!

english.title: Taming The Tamers
english.objectives: Kill 6 Gordunni Tamers.
english.description: The gordunni are not known to tame animals. If they're learning, this is cause for alarm. While the sasquatch they've tamed may be the major threat to our camp, the gordunni who captured him should be dealt with as well. If left, they may simply capture another.$B$BKill the gordunni tamers, and make sure the ogres know their efforts will not be tolerated!
english.completion: Good, good. Let's hope the ogres are at least smart enough to realize we're sending a message!

text.title: Gordunni Cobalt
text.objectives: Obtain 12 samples of Gordunni Cobalt.
text.description: I just arrived here in Feralas, and I've heard that the Gordunni Ogres that inhabit the wilds here have some interesting minerals. Who knows what they are up to, but they sure are protective of that stuff! They don't leave it just lying around; no, they bury it to protect folks like me from getting their hands on it.$B$BIf you'd be willing, I'll give you my shovel. Go to the Gordunni Outpost north of here and dig me up some Gordunni cobalt. Look for the blue glow, then start digging!
text.completed: Return to Orwin Gizzmick at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

english.title: Gordunni Cobalt
english.objectives: Obtain 12 samples of Gordunni Cobalt.
english.description: I just arrived here in Feralas, and I've heard that the Gordunni Ogres that inhabit the wilds here have some interesting minerals. Who knows what they are up to, but they sure are protective of that stuff! They don't leave it just lying around; no, they bury it to protect folks like me from getting their hands on it.$B$BIf you'd be willing, I'll give you my shovel. Go to the Gordunni Outpost north of here and dig me up some Gordunni cobalt. Look for the blue glow, then start digging!
english.completed: Return to Orwin Gizzmick at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

text.title: 部落的宝藏
text.objectives: 你必须击败阿卡莎，夺得部落宝箱钥匙，然后用它打开沉没的部落箱子。
text.description: 羊皮纸上乱七八糟地画着很多标记，像是有人随手描上去的；但是仔细一看，某些晦涩的图案看起来像是地标。$B$B你眺望海床，发现似乎有迹可循，其中的一个图标就是附近那艘沉没的船只。如果你的猜测没错的话，沉船附近可能藏有宝藏。$B$B你不禁思考起地图上那个蛇形人像所代表的含义来……
text.progress: This slightly encrusted lock might still be functional.

english.title: The Horde's Hoard
english.objectives: You must defeat Akasha to obtain the Horde Chest Key which you must then use to open the Sunken Horde Chest.
english.description: It is unclear what manner of creature scrawled the seemingly random markings on this piece of parchment, but upon close inspection, some of the obscure shapes begin to look like landmarks.$b$bScanning the sea floor, you think you recognize a few points of reference, one being a nearby sunken ship. If your guess is correct, there appears to be treasure of some kind near the wreck.$b$bYou cannot help but wonder what the scaly, serpentine figure on the map might represent....
english.progress: This slightly encrusted lock might still be functional.

text.title: 伊森德雷的召唤
text.objectives: 跟低地荒野翡翠峰顶的伊森德雷谈一谈。
text.description: 自然的巨龙……听从她的召唤，$n。不要在这里徘徊。她交给你的任务既是莫大的荣耀，也是异常凶险的征兆。$B$B她说的地方叫做翡翠峰。从低地荒野有条岔路，可以通往它其中一个高耸的石头高地，顶上有一个小小的圣殿。$B$B菲拉斯的一切都靠你了。愿大地母亲护佑着你。
text.completion: You've come.$B$BI am ashamed to ask this of you, $c, but I've ran from him long enough. Taerar must be stopped.

english.title: Ysondre's Call
english.objectives: Speak with Ysondre at the Emerald Summit in the Lower Wilds.
english.description: The dragons of nature... Heed her call, $n. Do not linger here. Her request for your aid is both a great honor and an omen of terrible danger.$B$BThe place she spoke of is called the Emerald Summit. A path off the main road through the Lower Wilds leads up one of the high stone plateaus; you will find a small shrine at the top.$B$BAll of Feralas may rest upon your shoulders. May the Earth Mother watch over you.
english.completion: You've come.$B$BI am ashamed to ask this of you, $c, but I've ran from him long enough. Taerar must be stopped.

text.title: 泰拉尔的陨落
text.objectives: 打败泰拉尔。
text.description: 艾莫莉丝和莱索恩都死了。现在只剩下我们了。我无法再躲藏。作为他们中的一员时，我的所作所为……我造成的所有痛苦……今天都必须要清算。$B$B我依然虚弱，$n，就算我想尝试，也无法显现出真正的形态。但我还是会在战斗中与你同在。$B$B假如你准备好了，我就要召唤泰拉尔。令我再度堕落这种事情对他来说有着不可抵挡的诱惑力。
text.completion: It is done.$B$BThis land that has suffered so much can rest now.
text.completed: 跟伊森德雷谈一谈。
text.giverWindow: 泰拉尔，我的兄弟…

english.title: Taerar's Fall
english.objectives: Defeat Taerar.
english.description: Emeriss and Lethon are gone. It's only us left now. I can hide from this no longer. All I did while a part of that brood...all the suffering I've caused...must be repaid today.$B$BI am still weak, $n. I cannot assume my true form even if I dare try. But I will still stand beside you in battle.$B$BIf you are prepared, I will call Taerar to us. He will be unable to resist the temptation of revisiting corruption upon me.
english.completion: It is done.$B$BThis land that has suffered so much can rest now.
english.completed: Speak with Ysondre.
english.giverWindow: Taerar, my brother...

text.title: Spreading The Word
text.objectives: While wearing your Doomsday Message, visit the East Zeppelin Tower, the West Zeppelin Tower, and the town square of Razor Hill.
text.description: Welcome to the farm, $n. Everyone here works to earn $g his:her; keep. For some, that means caring for the animals. Others are responsible for working on our construction projects. Still others work to spread our message among the people and I think that's a good place for you to start.$B$BTake this board. It bears a short message about our beliefs. While wearing the board, visit the eastern and western zeppelin towers outside Orgrimmar's gates, as well as the town square of Razor Hill, to the south.

objectiveDetails.description: Spread Message at East Zeppelin Tower
Spread Message at West Zeppelin Tower

text.title: 全力救火……
text.objectives: 杀死炼狱火海的10名狂怒的火焰风暴。
text.description: 前方惊涛怒浪的炼狱火海就标志着我们和火焰领主的交战前线。这里出现的火元素，我以前从未见识过。$B$B你能帮我们遏住毁灭的大潮么？消灭那些狂怒的火焰风暴……不能让它们包围艾森娜林地，否则收复这座山脉的希望就全完了！
text.completion: 'Thank you, $n. You''ve given us the opportunity to try to reclaim the upper hand.'

english.title: Fighting Fire With ... Anything
english.objectives: Slay 10 Raging Firestorms within the Inferno.
english.description: The inferno raging up ahead marks the front line between us and the forces of the Fire Lord. The fire elementals unleashed here are unlike any I've ever encountered.$B$BCan you help us stem the tide of destruction? Slay the raging firestorms... before they engulf Aessina's Grove and erase all hope of someday reclaiming this mountain!
english.completion: 'Thank you, $n. You''ve given us the opportunity to try to reclaim the upper hand.'

text.title: 干扰仪式
text.objectives: 杀死炼狱火海的6名暮光地狱火主宰。
text.description: 前面的火焰风暴是形式最为纯粹的自由元素——我没想到它们还能在别的位面存活。只有极为老练的召唤者才能召唤出它们。$B$B$n，到炼狱火海去找到暮光地狱火主宰。他们现在一定正在召唤增援。让他们彻底沉默……为了正义！
text.completion: Dead? Good!$B$BBut it seems there's still so much to be done... fires to quench... and the soil to heal...$B$BI hope you'll stay close and help us reclaim Hyjal!

english.title: Disrupting the Rituals
english.objectives: Slay 6 Twilight Inferno Lords within the Inferno.
english.description: The firestorms up ahead are unbound elementals in the purest form - something I didn't think could exist outside their own plane. Only very skilled summoners could unleash something like this.$B$B$n, head into the Inferno and seek out Twilight Inferno Lords. They've got to be summoning in reinforcements as we speak. Silence them... For good!
english.completion: Dead? Good!$B$BBut it seems there's still so much to be done... fires to quench... and the soil to heal...$B$BI hope you'll stay close and help us reclaim Hyjal!

text.title: 伊森德雷的别离
text.objectives: 跟莫沙彻营地的魂角酋长谈一谈。
text.description: 这下，我成为了最后一只了。$B$B即便我选择待在这个世界里，我也不能重新加入绿龙军团。但这场胜利给了我希望。也许迟早，我可以在凡人间的简单生活中找到平静。$B$B你应该回到你的人那儿去，告诉他们噩梦的巨龙已经消失，再也不会威胁他们的土地了。
text.completion: You are truly blessed by the Earth Mother, $n, to have the honor of fighting with the guardians of nature, and to also survive it.$B$BKnow that you have kept safe every living soul in this camp, and possibly this entire forest. Take these gifts with my deepest thanks.

english.title: Ysondre's Farewell
english.objectives: Speak to Chief Spirithorn in Camp Mojache.
english.description: With that, I am the only one left.$B$BEven if I choose to remain in this world, I cannot rejoin the green flight. But this victory gives me hope. Perhaps, in time, I can find peace in a simple life among mortals.$B$BYou must return to your people. Tell them that the dragons of nightmare are gone, and will no longer threaten these lands.
english.completion: You are truly blessed by the Earth Mother, $n, to have the honor of fighting with the guardians of nature, and to also survive it.$B$BKnow that you have kept safe every living soul in this camp, and possibly this entire forest. Take these gifts with my deepest thanks.

text.title: Raw Materials
text.objectives: Samir wants you to collect 3 Rent Scrap Metal from Frenzied Orca in the Kelp Forest.$b$bYou can lure an orca using Pincer Entrails from Clacksnap Pincers.
text.description: Thank you, $c. We owe you our lives.$b$bBut if we're ever to see the surface again, we'll have to fight our way out of here. That means I'm going to need to craft some weapons and armor.$b$bBefore you found me, I saw a soldier eaten by one of those orca up there.$b$bI'll wager that if you cut a few of them open, you'll find plenty of scrap metal for me to work with.$b$bIf you don't want to swim up to them, I bet you could lure one down to you with some entrails...

english.title: Raw Materials
english.objectives: Samir wants you to collect 3 Rent Scrap Metal from Frenzied Orca in the Kelp Forest.$b$bYou can lure an orca using Pincer Entrails from Clacksnap Pincers.
english.description: Thank you, $c. We owe you our lives.$b$bBut if we're ever to see the surface again, we'll have to fight our way out of here. That means I'm going to need to craft some weapons and armor.$b$bBefore you found me, I saw a soldier eaten by one of those orca up there.$b$bI'll wager that if you cut a few of them open, you'll find plenty of scrap metal for me to work with.$b$bIf you don't want to swim up to them, I bet you could lure one down to you with some entrails...

text.title: 拯救小动物
text.objectives: 到炼狱火海救出总计10只吓坏了的小兔子或惊恐的松鼠。
text.description: 帮帮我们，$c！森林被大火吞噬，小动物们都被困住了。光靠细细小小的牙齿和毛茸茸软乎乎的爪子，它们是没法儿逃出来的！它们那么软绵绵，那么好玩。$B$B它们的鼻子又小又湿！$B$B要是你不救他们的话，我都不愿去想。$B$B<她把脸埋进手掌，遮住眼睛。>$B$B我不想！
text.progress: Did you save the wee animals? And their wee little friends?
text.completion: Squueeeee!$B$BDid the nice $gMr.:Mrs.; $c pull you from the flames, little friend? You're safe now!$B$BHooray!

english.title: Save the Wee Animals
english.objectives: Go into the Inferno and rescue any combination of 10 Panicked Bunnies or Terrified Squirrels.
english.description: Help us, $c! The forest is aflame, and the wee animals can't find their way out. They can't fight for themselves, with their teeny-tiny little teeth and their soft furry paws! They're fluffy and sweet.$B$BThey have wet little noses!$B$BIf you don't save them, I don't want to even THINK about it.$B$B<She slaps her palms over her eyes.>$B$BI'm not thinking!
english.progress: Did you save the wee animals? And their wee little friends?
english.completion: Squueeeee!$B$BDid the nice $gMr.:Mrs.; $c pull you from the flames, little friend? You're safe now!$B$BHooray!

text.title: 到石槌要塞去
text.objectives: 跟石槌要塞的奥哈恩·食人魔之剑谈一谈。
text.description: 你必须把这里的消息传出去，$n。南边便是石槌要塞。在那里，我们的盟友集合了几名部落的食人魔，来对付那些劫掠森林的敌人。$B$B跟石槌氏族的头领奥哈恩·食人魔之剑谈一谈。她需要知道所发生的一切。要当心，我怕这些腐化还残留着……

english.title: To Stonemaul Hold
english.objectives: Speak with Orhan Ogreblade in Stonemaul Hold.
english.description: You must send word of what has happened here, $n. To the south is Stonemaul Hold. There, our allies have gathered the few ogres of the horde to fight against those despoiling these forests.$B$BSpeak with Orhan Ogreblade. She leads the Stonemaul clan here, and will need to know of all that has occured. And be wary, lest some of this corruption remain...

text.title: 到莫沙彻营地去
text.objectives: 跟莫沙彻营地的魂角酋长谈一谈。
text.description: 你干了一件了不起的事情，$n。暮光之锤蒙了羞，戈杜尼残破不全，我们终于可以把精力放在联盟身上了。$B$B我将挤出时间来组建一支可以对付这里的暗夜精灵的军队。我将派你到东边的莫沙彻营地那里去，他们遇到了一些麻烦事需要帮忙，我们可不能让任何一块部落的领土失陷。$B$BLok'tar！

english.title: To Camp Mojache
english.objectives: Speak with Chief Spirithorn in Camp Mojache.
english.description: You've done a hell of a job here, $n. With the Twilight's Hammer shamed and the Gordunni left bleeding and broken, we'll be able to set our sights on the true battle with the Alliance here.$B$BIt'll take time to build our forces enough to match the night elves infesting this place. I'm sending you ahead to Camp Mojache to the east; they've got problems of their own, and we can't let any Horde territory fall here.$B$BLok'tar!

text.title: 一箱螃蟹
text.objectives: 将一箱螃蟹交给走私者洞穴的埃达尔拉。
text.description: 箱子上贴着“蟹肉”的标签，像是沉没没多久的货船上的货物。$b$b历经艰难后，埃达尔拉应该会很高兴收到这样的东西。
text.progress: What have you got there, $n?
text.completion: Why, $n! What a surprise!$b$bIf anyone ever calls your character into question you be sure to send them my way.$b$bI'll tell anyone who'll listen that in my moment of need, you gave me a case of crabs...

english.title: A Case of Crabs
english.objectives: Take the Case of crabs to Adarrah in Smuggler's Scar.
english.description: This crate, labeled 'Crab Meat', seems to have fallen from a recently sunken cargo ship.$b$bAdarrah would surely welcome such a find, considering the ordeal she's had to endure.
english.progress: What have you got there, $n?
english.completion: Why, $n! What a surprise!$b$bIf anyone ever calls your character into question you be sure to send them my way.$b$bI'll tell anyone who'll listen that in my moment of need, you gave me a case of crabs...

text.title: 我爱吃尾巴
text.objectives: 埃达尔拉要你带回4条响钳龙虾人的尾巴。
text.description: 我们需要好些天才能做好返回海面的准备，老实说，我已经有点饿了。$b$b我也不想过于挑剔的，但是说到海味，我能吃的恐怕也没几种。$b$b如果你遇见龙虾人的话，顺便砍下他们的尾巴带回来给我，我会付你钱的。
text.progress: Oh, please tell me you were able to find me some food, $c.
text.completion: Oh, my!$b$bThat's some of the biggest, juiciest tail I've ever seen!

english.title: A Taste For Tail
english.objectives: Adarrah wants you to bring her 4 Clacksnap Tails.
english.description: It could be days before we're ready to make our way to the surface, and to be honest, I'm already beginning to get hungry.$b$bI hate to be picky, but when it comes to seafood, I'm afraid there are very few things I can stomach.$b$bIf you come across any lobster types, I would happily pay you what coin I have with me for their tails.
english.progress: Oh, please tell me you were able to find me some food, $c.
english.completion: Oh, my!$b$bThat's some of the biggest, juiciest tail I've ever seen!

text.title: 女人的好朋友
text.objectives: 埃达尔拉要你取回6件埃达尔拉的信物。
text.description: 开门见山地说，我一直很受欢迎。$b$b这些年来我收到了不少礼物，像是宝石、戒指、项链之类的小玩意儿。那些男人总认为花哨的小礼物能打动我的心。$b$b唉，他们可不知道这对我来说是个很大的负担。为了不至于辜负他们的好意，我走在哪儿都带着它们。至少过去是这样……$b$b在我从船上跌落海中的时候，这些宝贝儿全沉到海里去了。请帮我找到它们，我发誓不会让你白忙活的。
text.progress: Well, $r?$b$bWere you able to recover my valuables?
text.completion: Oh, you've found them! I was sure they were lost forever...$b$bHere you are, $n. I hope this is ample payment.

english.title: A Girl's Best Friend
english.objectives: Adarrah wants you to recover 6 Adarrah's Keepsakes.
english.description: Let's just get it out in the open. I'm no stranger to love, $n.$b$bOver the years, if there's one thing I've learned, it's that love's tangible treasures last longer than the flames of passion.$b$bI've managed to collect my fair share of these gifts - gemstones, rings, necklaces, and the like, and I carry them with me wherever I go.$b$bAt least I used to...$b$bWhen I was swept from the ship, my valuables were scattered across the sea. Help me recover them and I promise to make it worth your trouble.
english.progress: Well, $r?$b$bWere you able to recover my valuables?
english.completion: Oh, you've found them! I was sure they were lost forever...$b$bHere you are, $n. I hope this is ample payment.

text.title: 灵魂武器
text.objectives: 巫医尤克里要你等一会，让他把武器准备好。
text.description: 将灵魂精华注入武器是一道复杂的工序。现在我有了所需要的材料，还有你俘获的生物灵魂精华，我就可以开始了。请稍等，我马上就好。

english.title: Weapons of Spirit
english.objectives: Witch Doctor Uzer'i wants you to wait for a moment while he prepares the weapons.
english.description: Imbuing the muisek into the weapons is a difficult process. Now that I have all of the required materials and the muisek of the creatures that you captured, I may begin. Please wait; I will return in a moment.

text.title: 哦，鹿呐！
text.objectives: 从炼狱火海救出3头受伤的小鹿，护送它们回到艾森娜林地的米露恩那里。
text.description: 你会说鹿语吗？用鼻子就行了。$B$B<她指着自己的鼻子。>$B$B母鹿逃出火海了，但它们的鹿崽——还有困在火里被烧伤的！$B$B回到炼狱火海，去把三头受伤的小鹿送回到我身边它们的妈妈这里。$B$B请救救小鹿，不然我就要瞪你啦！$B$B<她的眼睛开始睁大，泪汪汪的。>
text.completion: Oh yay! Happy little deer!$B$BNow they can grow up and have ADVENTURES.$B$BYou're swell.

english.title: Oh, Deer!
english.objectives: Rescue three Injured Fawns from The Inferno and escort them back to Mylune at the Grove of Aessina.
english.description: Do you speak deer? It's all in the nose.$B$B<She points to her nose.>$B$BThe does have fled the fires, but their little fawns - Some of them are still trapped in the burning and the hurt!$B$BGo back into the Inferno and escort three injured fawns back here to their mothers right here beside me.$B$BPlease save the little fawns, or I'll give you the big eyes!$B$B<Her eyes grow big and dewy.>
english.completion: Oh yay! Happy little deer!$B$BNow they can grow up and have ADVENTURES.$B$BYou're swell.

text.title: 诺莫瑞根行动
text.objectives: 参与梅卡托克国王进攻诺莫瑞根的战斗。
text.description: 针对诺莫瑞根的多段攻击很快就要开始了，机械师瑟玛普拉格和他的爪牙都将得到正义的审判！瑟玛普拉格在我们的家园深处已经盘踞了太长时间。一支在辐射中变异堕落的军队保卫着他。$B$B进攻马上就要开始了！准备好，新兵，这场战斗可不是软弱的人能够承受的。

english.title: Operation: Gnomeregan
english.objectives: Help King Mekkatorque with the assault on Gnomeregan.
english.description: Momentarily, the multi-phased assault upon Gnomeregan will begin and Mekgineer Thermaplugg and his men will be brought to justice!  Too long has Thermaplugg festered in the depths of our home, defended by a corrupt and irradiated army.$B$BThe assault begins in but a moment! Be ready recruit, this fight will not be for the faint-hearted.

objectiveDetails.description: 占领诺莫瑞根地面区域

text.title: 不只是病了
text.objectives: 杀死10头毒性雏龙。
text.description: 我在通向北方的大路旁发现了一窝雏龙，它们也有类似的病征。绿龙是自然的神圣监护者。这种疾病竟然也会传播到它们身上，这真是个严重的警报。$B$B我们必须尽一切手段阻止它进一步蔓延。杀掉感染的雏龙，$n，然后回来找我。
text.completion: This development worries me greatly. This has happened before...

english.title: More Than Illness
english.objectives: Kill 10 Noxious Whelps.
english.description: I've discovered a brood of dragon whelps gathered off the road to the north with a similar affliction. Green dragons are sacred custodians of nature. The fact that this disease is capable of spreading to them is cause for great alarm.$B$BWe must stop this from spreading further through any means. Slay the infected whelps, $n, and return to me.
english.completion: This development worries me greatly. This has happened before...

text.title: 被偷的麦酒
text.objectives: 从丹奥加兹抢回巡山人的麦酒。
text.description: 你得帮我们，$g小伙子:姑娘;。我们受命护送一件贵重货物给我们的矮人朋友……一桶你能找到的最好的麦酒！$B$B不幸的是，那个猪脑子在轮值的时候睡着了！于是咱们的麦酒就让遭瘟的兽人给偷去了丹奥加兹。$B$B这怎么成！现在，趁我忙着说服这个白痴一切都是他的错的时候，你赶快去帮我们把酒桶抢回来。为了卡兹莫丹！

english.title: The Stolen Keg
english.objectives: Retrieve the Mountaineer's Ale from Dun Algaz.
english.description: You've got to help us, $glad:lass;. We were tasked with escorting a precious cargo to our fellow dwarves...a keg full of the finest ale you can get out here!$B$BUnfortunately, bird-brain over here fell asleep on the job! Those blasted orcs took our keg, and hauled it up into Dun Algaz where they're hiding.$B$BThis can't stand! Now, while I stay here and try to convince this idiot that it was his fault, I'd like you to go in there and get our keg back. For Khaz Modan!

text.title: 石之泪
text.objectives: 收集7颗石之泪。
text.description: 你也看到了，巨龙伊森德雷告诉我们，大地的眼泪可以封闭传送门，阻止腐化传播。$B$B她所言不虚。在西边的林地里，我看见高山巨人心神错乱，在沮丧和哭泣中发狂，他们的眼泪落在石头上，形成了闪光的水晶。$B$B尽管巨人们不再哭泣，但伊森德雷所指的一定就是石之泪。我们必须把它们收集起来。
text.progress: The tears are among the very rocks that the giants themselves rise from. There should be loose ones near the base of these large monoliths.
text.completion: The mountain giants are precious allies of our race. We must stop this corruption before it claims any more creatures of the forest.

english.title: Tears of Stone
english.objectives: Collect 7 Stonetears.
english.description: As you witnessed, the dragon Ysondre has told us that the tears of the land can seal the portal from which this corruption stems.$B$BHer words ring true; in the glade to the west, I have seen the mountain giants distraught. They raged in frustration and wept, and their tears fell upon the stones as shining crystals.$B$BThough the giants weep no more, these stonetears must be what Ysondre referred to. We must gather them.
english.progress: The tears are among the very rocks that the giants themselves rise from. There should be loose ones near the base of these large monoliths.
english.completion: The mountain giants are precious allies of our race. We must stop this corruption before it claims any more creatures of the forest.

text.title: 大地，堕落了
text.objectives: 杀死6名堕落的峭壁巨人。
text.description: 菲拉斯峭壁巨人的存在就是大地本身，$n。当大地繁荣时，他们是善心的保护者、平和的守护者。$B$B然而当森林遭到污染时，他们也没能幸免。$B$B若他们受到这种病痛的荼毒，就会变得暴力无比，戕害树木、动物，乃至形成他们的山石。$B$B要千万当心，看在那些幸存者的份上，一旦发现堕落的巨人，就摧毁它们。
text.completion: The spirits of these guardians will return in time, $n. You've freed them to move on in nature's cycle.$B$BNow it falls to us to make sure that cycle is free of corruption and needless suffering.

english.title: The Land, Corrupted
english.objectives: Kill 6 Corrupted Cliff Giants.
english.description: The cliff giants of Feralas are extensions of the earth itself, $n. When nature thrives, they are benevolent protectors and peaceful guardians.$B$BBut as the forest is tainted, so too are they.$B$BShould they be corrupted by this malady, they will lash out in violence against trees, wildlife, and the very boulders they were shaped from.$B$BBe wary in your tasks. Should you find any corrupted giants, destroy them, for the sake of those still spared.
english.completion: The spirits of these guardians will return in time, $n. You've freed them to move on in nature's cycle.$B$BNow it falls to us to make sure that cycle is free of corruption and needless suffering.

text.title: 封锁梦境
text.objectives: 用伊森德雷之泪封闭梦境之树的传送门。
text.description: 东西已经准备好了。拿上这个，$n，这是自然精华的标记，由伊森德雷的意志所祝福。$B$B到北边去，在流淌的小溪对面就是梦境之树。那里矗立着菲拉斯最高的大树，世界之树的一株幼苗——符印巨树。一道通往翡翠梦境心脏地带的传送门就在它的树干上，你必须将其封住。$B$B传送门一定会有重兵把守，但是你要勇敢面对。
text.completion: Your bravery has seen us through! The Emerald Nightmare has been shut out from this land.$B$BThe fate of the dragon Taerar worries me...but there is much work still to be done. I cannot afford to dwell on it.

english.title: Sealing the Dream
english.objectives: Use Ysondre's Tear to seal the portal at Dream Bough.
english.description: It is ready. Take this, $n; a beacon of natural essence, blessed by the will of Ysondre.$B$BTo the north, on the other side of the flowing brook, is Dream Bough. There stands the Great Tree, the tallest in Feralas, a sapling of the very World Tree. A portal to the heart of the Emerald Dream sits in its trunk, and it is this portal you must seal.$B$BThe portal will be guarded, but you must be brave.
english.completion: Your bravery has seen us through! The Emerald Nightmare has been shut out from this land.$B$BThe fate of the dragon Taerar worries me...but there is much work still to be done. I cannot afford to dwell on it.

text.title: 憎世大军
text.objectives: 杀死10条憎世纳迦。
text.description: 憎世纳迦的进攻很猛烈！他们的首领是优先目标，但我们需要尽量多杀掉一些。$B$B你先走一步，我们到时在战场上见。别对他们手软！
text.completion: Your valor was mentioned in my briefings, $n. I commend you.

english.title: Hatecrest Forces
english.objectives: Kill 10 Hatecrest Naga.
english.description: The Hatecrest are fighting fiercely! Their leader is a priority, but we need to kill as many of them as we can.$B$BGo ahead of me, I'll meet you on the battlefield. Show them no mercy!
english.completion: Your valor was mentioned in my briefings, $n. I commend you.

text.title: 戈杜尼的威胁
text.objectives: 杀死高原荒野的16名戈杜尼食人魔。
text.description: 上层精灵埃斯图兰隐居在那座塔里，我跟他不是特别熟，但他告诉我说，南边的高原荒野废墟里全是戈杜尼食人魔。$B$B食人魔不仅仅是一个威胁，他们还摧毁树林及周遭的野生动物。埃斯图兰同时警告我，万一他们在废墟里发现了含有上层精灵之力的法器，那可不得了……$B$B到南边去，$n，杀掉你能找到的所有戈杜尼食人魔！
text.completion: It sounds like there were more than we thought! Thank you for your brave work, $n.

english.title: The Gordunni Threat
english.objectives: Kill 16 Gordunni ogres in the High Wilderness.
english.description: Estulan, the Highborne up in the tower, is reclusive. I haven't been able to speak to him very much. He has, however, told me that the ruins of the High Wilderness to the south are full of Gordunni ogres.$B$BThe ogres are not only a threat, they're destroying any forest and wildlife nearby. Estulan has also warned me of what might happen if they discover any artifacts of Highborne power among the ruins...$B$BHead south, $n, and slay any Gordunni you find!
english.completion: It sounds like there were more than we thought! Thank you for your brave work, $n.

text.title: 戈杜尼宝珠
text.objectives: 从一名戈杜尼术士手里获得戈杜尼宝珠。
text.description: 除了剿除食人魔外……$B$B埃斯图兰还提到了另外一件事。他说食人魔术士可能有某种宝珠，或者其它类似的强力道具。$B$B他好像不愿多说，十分生气……他说“他们绝不可能是上层精灵”，所以我认为他一定想知道食人魔从哪儿弄来的宝珠。给我带一个回来。
text.progress: Do you have the orb?
text.completion: Is that it? Let me see here...

english.title: The Gordunni Orb
english.objectives: Collect a Gordunni Orb from a Gordunni Warlock.
english.description: In addition to clearing out the ogres...$B$BEstulan mentioned something else about the ogres. He said the ogre warlocks may have some sort of orb, or other item of power$B$BHe was terse about it, but seemed upset...he said there was "no way they could be Highborne", so I think he wants to know just where they got them. Bring me back one of these orbs.
english.progress: Do you have the orb?
english.completion: Is that it? Let me see here...

text.title: 埃斯图兰的检视
text.objectives: 将戈杜尼宝珠交给埃斯图兰。
text.description: 他是对的。我和暗夜精灵相处的时间不长，但我看得出来，这些标记完全不像任何卡多雷装饰……$B$B得让埃斯图兰看看这个。把它带到塔上去给他，他脾气也许不好，不过别气馁，一旦他看到宝珠，就会意识到问题的重要性。
text.progress: What is that you're holding?
text.completion: Ahh, the orb I mentioned before. A decent reason to disturb me.

english.title: Estulan's Examination
english.objectives: Deliver the Gordunni Orb to Estulan.
english.description: He's right. I haven't been among the night elves long, but I can tell these markings are completely unlike any kaldorei decorations...$B$BEstulan needs to see this. Take this up the tower to him. He may be surly, but don't be dissuaded; once he sees the orb, he'll realize it's an important issue.
english.progress: What is that you're holding?
english.completion: Ahh, the orb I mentioned before. A decent reason to disturb me.

text.title: 绑架食人魔
text.objectives: 用调整过的灵魂石俘虏一名戈多克食人魔。
text.description: 这既不是粗糙的食人魔饰物，也并非我族所制的远古圣物。它特殊的结构对我来说还是闻所未闻的……这一事实让我惴惴不安。$B$B那个狼人女不久就会派你去厄运之槌，对抗戈多克精英。他们是戈杜尼的领导者，他们或许知道是谁把这些提供给他们的。$B$B把宝珠拿回去，我已经施放了几个附魔在上面。在一个虚弱的戈多克食人魔面前使用，一旦你将其俘虏，就把他带回来。
text.completion: Ah, you've brought him. Now I merely have to suffer the fate of speaking to him.

english.title: Ogre Abduction
english.objectives: Use the Modified Soulstone to capture a Gordok ogre.
english.description: This is neither a crude ogre trinket, nor an ancient relic made by my kind. Its specific construction is new to me...and this fact disturbs me greatly.$B$BThe wolf-girl will be sending you to Dire Maul soon, to fight the Gordok elite. They are the leaders of the Gordunni, and would know who is supplying these.$B$BTake the orb back, I've cast a few enchantments on it. Hold it up in front of a weakened Gordok ogre, and once you've captured him, bring it back here.
english.completion: Ah, you've brought him. Now I merely have to suffer the fate of speaking to him.

objectiveDetails.description: 俘虏戈多克食人魔法师

text.title: 要是你和我们不是对头……
text.objectives: 跟黑角谈一谈，说服他帮忙对抗暮光之锤。
text.description: 南边有一座孤矗的高塔，名为“黑角赎罪地”。上面关着一只恶魔：泰拉斯·黑角。$B$B你可能觉得我疯了，居然想寻求老对头的帮助，但黑角一度也是凡人，我无法想象他会坐观暮光之锤获胜。$B$B跟黑角谈一谈，看看你是不是能说服他助我们一臂之力。也许他还能顺便救赎自己呢。$B$B……别把他放跑了就行！
text.completion: Very well, $r. I will help you mortals, even from within my bonds.$B$BBut don't sicken me by claiming it's my redemption. I do this for my own ends.$B$B<Blackhorn's sudden grin is unsettling.>

english.title: If You're Not Against Us...
english.objectives: Speak with Tyrus Blackhorn and convince him to help in the fight against the Twilight's Hammer.
english.description: South of here you'll find a solitary tower, known as "Blackhorn's Penance." Upon it is bound a demon: Tyrus Blackhorn.$B$BYou may think me mad for turning to an old foe for help, but Blackhorn was once a mortal, and I can't imagine he wants to watch Twilight's Hammer triumph.$B$BSpeak with Blackhorn, and see if you can convince him to help us in our fight. He may yet redeem himself.$B$B...Just don't set him free!
english.completion: Very well, $r. I will help you mortals, even from within my bonds.$B$BBut don't sicken me by claiming it's my redemption. I do this for my own ends.$B$B<Blackhorn's sudden grin is unsettling.>

text.title: 我需要休息
text.objectives: 跟泰勒上尉谈一谈。
text.description: $r，你表现得很好。要做的事还很多，但是我已经疲惫不堪了。$b$b我消耗了大量能量，向大地之环的首领发出了船难消息，希望得到他们的帮助。$b$b我必须休息一会，才能继续贡献力量。$b$b跟上尉谈一谈，尽你所能地帮助他们做好战斗的准备。纳迦必然会再次来犯，这不过是时间问题，而且反攻的势头肯定会更加凶猛的。
text.completion: I hear you, $r.$b$bI understand the urgency, but these men are in no condition to fight.

english.title: Rest For the Weary
english.objectives: Speak with Captain Taylor.
english.description: You have done well, $r, but there is much more to do and I grow weary.$b$bI have expended a great deal of energy sending a distress message to Earthen Ring leadership, pleading for their help.$b$bI must rest if I am to be of further use to us here.$b$bSpeak to the leader of the men you've saved and do what you can to help them prepare for battle.$b$bThe naga are scouring the waters for us. It is but a matter of time before they return - and they will surely come in even greater force.
english.completion: I hear you, $r.$b$bI understand the urgency, but these men are in no condition to fight.

text.title: 戈多克守卫
text.objectives: 杀死6个戈多克执行者和6个戈多克食人魔法师。
text.description: 解决了附近的食人魔之后，我们就应该趁势进攻他们的领地。$B$B戈多克食人魔是戈杜尼氏族的领导者，他们在如今被称为厄运之槌的废墟里统治着后者。他们比戈杜尼食人魔更加强大，但我相信你对付得了他们，$n。去打他们个措手不及。
text.completion: Wonderful! Everything's going according to plan. Lady Shandris will be pleased.

english.title: Gordok Guards
english.objectives: Kill 6 Gordok Enforcers and 6 Gordok Ogre-Mages.
english.description: With the nearby ogres dealt with, we should take the offensive and press our attack into their territory.$B$BThe Gordok ogres are the head of the Gordunni clan, ruling them from the ruins now called Dire Maul. They are stronger than the lesser Gordunni, but I have no doubt you can handle them, $n. They won't know what hit them.
english.completion: Wonderful! Everything's going according to plan. Lady Shandris will be pleased.

text.title: 自然之力：小精灵
text.objectives: 用泰西娜的哨子召集3只羽月小精灵。
text.description: 哨兵填补了我们的兵力空缺，但是一支全能的暗夜精灵军队需要的不仅仅是暗夜精灵。森林是我们先祖的故乡，其中的生物已经保护了我们数个世纪。我们只需要把它们集结起来就可以了。$B$B拿上这只哨子。我们的盟友熟悉这个声音，你可以用它来召集它们。$B$B在你集合生物之前，我想让你先召集几个我们的小精灵，作为练习。你可以在要塞外面的大树中间找到它们。
text.completion: Wisps have always lived in harmony with night elves, and we depend on them for many things. These little guys you sent back, for example, will be helping us with some new construction and repairs.$B$BReady for more?

english.title: Forces of Nature: Wisps
english.objectives: Use Tessina's Whistle to recall 3 Feathermoon Wisps.
english.description: The Sentinels make up the bulk of our forces here, but a well-rounded night elf army requires more than just night elves. The creatures of this forest, our ancestral home, have protected us for centuries. We simply need to rally them.$B$BTake this whistle. Our allies know this sound, and you'll be using it to recall them.$B$BBefore you start gathering creatures, I'd like you to recall a few of our wisps, just for practice. You can find them just outside the fortress, among the trees.
english.completion: Wisps have always lived in harmony with night elves, and we depend on them for many things. These little guys you sent back, for example, will be helping us with some new construction and repairs.$B$BReady for more?

text.title: 毁灭的种子
text.objectives: 收集8颗脓血莓。
text.description: 对于暮光之锤，我们要腐蚀他们，摧毁他们。$B$B既然你不打算将我从束缚中解救出来，那你就得给我去收集一些材料来。我本身的恶魔精华就已经将圣殿周围的植物腐蚀了个遍，你要做的就是从这座塔周围的哀嚎草身上取得一些脓血莓。$B$B不过，我的小宠物们可是也会把你给吞了的哦。尽量别让它们相互呼救求援。
text.progress: Has the local flora been giving you a hard time?$B$B<Blackhorn grins disturbingly.>
text.completion: Very good. Please crush the berries into a pulpy liquid. That's quite an aroma isn't it?$B$BNow now, don't gag. It's beneath you.

english.title: Seeds of Their Demise
english.objectives: Collect 8 Bileberries.
english.description: We will decimate the Twilight's Hammer by corrupting and subverting them. $B$BSeeing that you have no intention of releasing me from my bonds, I require you to collect some reagents for me. My own demonic essence has corrupted the plant life around my shrine here. I need you to harvest some bileberries from the wailing weeds that surround this tower.$B$BMy little pets will attempt to harvest YOU in return. Try not to let them agitate one another.
english.progress: Has the local flora been giving you a hard time?$B$B<Blackhorn grins disturbingly.>
english.completion: Very good. Please crush the berries into a pulpy liquid. That's quite an aroma isn't it?$B$BNow now, don't gag. It's beneath you.

text.title: 自然大军：角鹰兽
text.objectives: 用泰西娜的哨子集结10头乱羽角鹰兽。
text.description: 角鹰兽是一种神秘的生物。有人说它们是由塞纳留斯本人创造出来，当做送给暗夜精灵的礼物。它们对其他种族十分警惕，但也非常聪明，能够分辨出谁是朋友的朋友。$B$B我需要更多的角鹰兽，以便训练一些新来的弓箭手骑上去。再把这只哨子拿去，到埃斯图兰之塔南面的林地里召集乱羽角鹰兽。
text.completion: A properly trained squadron of hippogryph riders can take on nearly any opposing force. Feathermoon Stronghold will be much safer with these noble beasts on our side.

english.title: Forces of Nature: Hippogryphs
english.objectives: Use Tessina's Whistle to rally 10 Frayfeather Hippogryphs.
english.description: Hippogryphs are majestic creatures. Some say they were created by Cenarius himself as a gift for the night elves. They're wary of other races, but they're intelligent enough to recognize a friend of a friend.$B$BI need more hippogryphs here so we can begin training some of our newer archers to ride them. Take the whistle again and rally the Frayfeather hippogyphs in the grove just south of the Tower of Estulan.
english.completion: A properly trained squadron of hippogryph riders can take on nearly any opposing force. Feathermoon Stronghold will be much safer with these noble beasts on our side.

text.title: 自然大军：树人
text.objectives: 用泰西娜的哨子集结6棵森林漫游者。
text.description: 有人认为树人在战场上能发挥的作用也就比端茶送水强一点。然而他们大多数人都没见过，整条防线是如何被他们以为是掩体的东西打得落花流水。$B$B你有没有见过一个苦工打算砍倒树人，结果被吓到的样子？我笑得眼泪都出来了……$B$B不管怎么说，他们都是极其宝贵的盟友。他们就漫游在埃斯图兰之塔附近和更远的东边的森林里，从厄运之槌往东南方走就是。不过要当心部落！
text.completion: They may not look it, but some treants grow to be ancient protectors. We could use a few more of those around here...

english.title: Forces of Nature: Treants
english.objectives: Use Tessina's Whistle to rally 6 Wandering Forest Walkers.
english.description: Some people think treants are good for little more than fetching drinks in a war. Most of them haven't seen an entire defensive line scattered by what they thought was cover.$B$BAnd have you ever seen a peon try to chop one down and get surprised? I was in tears...$B$BAt any rate, they're immensely valuable allies. You'll find some wandering just outside  the Tower of Estulan and more in forest to the east, just southeast of Dire Maul. Be on the lookout for the Horde!
english.completion: They may not look it, but some treants grow to be ancient protectors. We could use a few more of those around here...

text.title: 新的主人
text.objectives: 对昏迷的暮光地狱火主宰的使用脓血莓佳酿，然后与他交谈。
text.description: 你配制的药水非常邪恶，足以唤醒任何人，这也正是它的功用所在。$B$B击昏一个暮光地狱火主宰，然后把药水灌入他的喉咙里。他会短暂地苏醒，并完全受你的控制。$B$B与他进行交谈，问清楚那个他试图引入这个世界并烧毁你们森林的火焰元素究竟叫什么名字。
text.completion: <The wretched creature before you speaks in a wavering voice, its body broken but briefly animated by Blackhorn's vile potion.>$B$BYes, master?

english.title: A New Master
english.objectives: Use the Bottled Bileberry Brew on the corpse of a Twilight Inferno Lord, then speak with him.
english.description: The potion you created is vile enough to wake the dead. Which is its intended purpose.$B$BSlay a Twilight Inferno Lord and force the brew down his throat. He will revive, if only briefly, and be completely under your dominance.$B$BSpeak with him and learn the true name of the fire elemental he is channeling into the world to burn down your precious forest.
english.completion: <The wretched creature before you speaks in a wavering voice, its body broken but briefly animated by Blackhorn's vile potion.>$B$BYes, master?

objectiveDetails.description: 使暮光地狱火主宰屈服

text.title: 隐秘之名
text.objectives: 检查三块火焰石，找出真名。
text.description: 我们呼唤他的怒火和烈焰，我的前任主人。$B$B炼狱火海就是他的杰作。$B$B他的真名从未被提及，因为那名字就是他的力量。$B$B我们每人都知道一部分，每部分都刻在一块火焰石上。$B$B他的真名就在这里，在炼狱火海中。去找那三块火焰石……
text.completion: Yes, yes! Show me the runes you discovered.$B$B"Vol'talo Thol'embaar." That's the name of your real enemy.$B$BPresumably you're dealing with one of Ragnaros's generals, sent here to scorch the mountainside and pave the way for his conquest.$B$BI will show you how to crush him.

english.title: The Name Never Spoken
english.objectives: Assemble the true name by examining the three Firestones.
english.description: We called upon the fury and flame of the One, my former master.$B$BThe Inferno is by His design.$B$BHis true name is never uttered, it holds His power.$B$BEach of us was told but a piece. Each piece engraved on a firestone.$B$BThe One's true name is here, in the Inferno. Seek the three stones...
english.completion: Yes, yes! Show me the runes you discovered.$B$B"Vol'talo Thol'embaar." That's the name of your real enemy.$B$BPresumably you're dealing with one of Ragnaros's generals, sent here to scorch the mountainside and pave the way for his conquest.$B$BI will show you how to crush him.

text.title: Change of Plans
text.objectives: Get the Rusty Harpoon and 3 Coils of Rope.
text.description: Alright, kid. Slight change of plans...$b$bI think I've figured out a way to finish off that monster and you're going to assist me.$b$bThe way I see it, you owe me until my work is done here, and I ain't leaving without that artifact.$b$bFirst I need you to search those old wrecks for some good rope and a serviceable harpoon.$b$bThen... well, I'll fill you in on the rest later.

english.title: Change of Plans
english.objectives: Get the Rusty Harpoon and 3 Coils of Rope.
english.description: Alright, kid. Slight change of plans...$b$bI think I've figured out a way to finish off that monster and you're going to assist me.$b$bThe way I see it, you owe me until my work is done here, and I ain't leaving without that artifact.$b$bFirst I need you to search those old wrecks for some good rope and a serviceable harpoon.$b$bThen... well, I'll fill you in on the rest later.

text.title: The Missing
text.objectives: While wearing your Doomdsay Recruit's Robe, speak to Cultist Lethelyn, Cultist Kaima, Cultist Wyman, and Cultist Orlunn at Mirror Lake Orchard in Elywnn Forest.
text.description: The cult isn't just spreading fear and paranoia anymore. Now, I'm receiving reports of missing people. Mothers, fathers, brothers, and sisters have seemingly disappeared, but I have a feeling they can be found in one of the cult's camps outside the city. If I give you the names of some of the missing people, would you try to locate them in the cultist camp at Mirror Lake Orchard? It's southwest of the city gates. To blend in, you'll need join the cult and get a robe from one of the doomsayers in Old Town.

english.title: The Missing
english.objectives: While wearing your Doomdsay Recruit's Robe, speak to Cultist Lethelyn, Cultist Kaima, Cultist Wyman, and Cultist Orlunn at Mirror Lake Orchard in Elywnn Forest.
english.description: The cult isn't just spreading fear and paranoia anymore. Now, I'm receiving reports of missing people. Mothers, fathers, brothers, and sisters have seemingly disappeared, but I have a feeling they can be found in one of the cult's camps outside the city. If I give you the names of some of the missing people, would you try to locate them in the cultist camp at Mirror Lake Orchard? It's southwest of the city gates. To blend in, you'll need join the cult and get a robe from one of the doomsayers in Old Town.

text.title: Spreading The Word
text.objectives: While wearing your Doomsday Message, visit the Westbrook Garrison, the Valley of Heroes in Stormwind, and the town square of Goldshire.
text.description: Welcome to our orchard, $n. Everyone here works to earn $g his:her; keep. For some, that means tending the fruit trees. Others are responsible for working on our construction projects. Still others work to spread our message among the people and I think that's a good place for you to start.$B$BTake this board. It bears a short message about our beliefs. While wearing it, visit the Westbrook Garrison, southwest of here, the town square of Goldshire just to the east, and the Valley of Heroes in Stormwind.

english.title: Spreading The Word
english.objectives: While wearing your Doomsday Message, visit the Westbrook Garrison, the Valley of Heroes in Stormwind, and the town square of Goldshire.

Others are responsible for working on our construction projects. Still others work to spread our message among the people and I think that's a good place for you to start.$B$BTake this board. It bears a short message about our beliefs. While wearing it, visit the Westbrook Garrison, southwest of here, the town square of Goldshire just to the east, and the Valley of Heroes in Stormwind.

objectiveDetails.description: Spread Message in Valley of Heroes

text.title: The Master's Plan
text.objectives: Learn more about the cult's plans at the altar in the westerm part of Mirror Lake Orchard.
text.description: You're fitting in well here, $n, but there is more to us than daily chores and spreading the message. I'm sure you heard a little bit about it when you first joined.$B$BAs you know, this world is ending and the unprepared will die painful deaths.$B$BWe have been given a gift, an opportunity to become something greater and more powerful. Overseer Talathor is preparing for a ritual at the altar just west of the orchard. Wait there for him, and learn more of your new brothers and sisters.
text.completed: Return to Overseer Sylandra at Mirror Lake Orchard.

english.completed: Return to Overseer Sylandra at Mirror Lake Orchard.

text.title: The Doomsday Plan
text.objectives: Take the Elemental Devices to Captain Anton in Stormwind Keep.
text.description: The first batch of elemental devices are ready. Your task will be to conceal them inside populated areas of Stormwind. The devices will unleash their elementals at the proper time. Don't worry, $n, you'll be safely away before that happens.$B$BDo not do anything that would draw attention to yourself.$B$B<The overseer hands you a package containing several of the elemental devices. This is just the kind of proof that Captain Anton was hoping you'd uncover. You should probably bring the devices to him.>
text.completed: Take the Elemental Devices to Captain Anton in Stormwind Keep.

english.completed: Take the Elemental Devices to Captain Anton in Stormwind Keep.

text.title: Thwarting Twilight's Hammer
text.objectives: Destroy Elemental Devices to release their captive elementals. Defeat 5 Raging Wind Elementals.
text.description: You can't have been the only person sent into Stormwind to deploy those devices containing wind elementals. We have to find and disable the rest of the devices before they set their captive elementals free to create storms in the city.$B$BAre you familiar enough with the devices to destroy them? Our best chance is to break the devices before the elementals inside can reach full strength. Look for the devices in the Trade District, Cathedral Square and the Mage Quarter. Hurry!
text.completed: Return to Captain Anton in Stormwind Keep.
