english.objectives: Destroy Elemental Devices to release their captive elementals. Defeat 5 Raging Wind Elementals.
english.description: You can't have been the only person sent into Stormwind to deploy those devices containing wind elementals. We have to find and disable the rest of the devices before they set their captive elementals free to create storms in the city.$B$BAre you familiar enough with the devices to destroy them? Our best chance is to break the devices before the elementals inside can reach full strength. Look for the devices in the Trade District, Cathedral Square and the Mage Quarter. Hurry!
english.completed: Return to Captain Anton in Stormwind Keep.

text.title: 蕾蒂拉拉的大奖章
text.objectives: 从海地精收集者身上收集5块勋章碎片，用它们制造蕾蒂拉拉的大奖章。
text.description: 这条粗重的锁链由若干个纯金环组成。$B$B锁链正中的金环上悬挂着一块乳白色的碎片，先前应该是一枚贝壳形状的大奖章。$B$B说不定其他的碎片就散落在附近。如果能集齐的话，或许可以拼凑出它本来的模样。
text.progress: You examine the chain, hoping it can be restored.

english.title: Lady La-La's Medallion
english.objectives: Collect the 5 Medallion Fragments from Gilblin Collectors and combine them to create Lady La-La's Medallion.
english.description: Dozens of crude gold links make up this heavy chain.$b$bDangling from the center link is an opalescent fragment of what must have once been a large shell-shaped medallion.$b$bYou wonder if the other fragments might be nearby, and if the medallion might be reassembled into its original state.
english.progress: You examine the chain, hoping it can be restored.

text.title: 古老的障碍
text.objectives: 摧毁6个砂石魔像。
text.description: 我在这座门前研究了好些年，想要找到不会对门后的远古建筑造成破坏的进入方法。谁知道几场猛烈的地震下来，直接把门给震开了！事情已经这样了也没什么办法，毕竟我们找到了奥丹姆的入口。$B$B但是呢，在进入废墟之前，我可没有想过门里会冲出什么东西来。你看，一大堆魔像涌了出来，在废墟里杀气腾腾地乱窜。如果我们要进去的话，就得先找人把它们清理掉！

english.title: Ancient Obstacles
english.objectives: Destroy 6 Sandstone Golems.
english.description: I've studied the gate here for years, trying to find a way of entry that wouldn't disturb any of the ancient architecture just behind it. It figures a few overgrown earthquakes decided to muck the whole thing up! But what's done is done, and the entrance to Uldum is revealed.$B$BI wasn't expecting anything to come out of the ruins before we went in, though. A whole mess of golems are running amok in the valley now, let loose from inside. Someone needs to clean them up if we're gonna get in there!

text.title: 庄严的石板
text.objectives: 将庄严的石板交给古斯坦。
text.description: 在箱子底部，你找到了一块大石板。它的材质好像是石头，但非常光滑，毫无瑕疵，表面布满了奇怪的文字。$B$B其中一些文字和墙上的文字类似，另一些则完全不同。古斯坦可能会对它感兴趣。

english.title: The Grand Tablet
english.objectives: Take the Grand Tablet to Gunstan.
english.description: At the bottom of the chest, you find a large tablet. Made of a material resembling stone, but completely smooth and flawless, it is covered in strange writing.$B$BWhile some resembles the writing on the walls, other scripts appear completely different. Gunstan would probably like to see this.

text.title: 黑雾遗产
text.objectives: 收集6堆闪光的泥土。
text.description: 我被锁在这个地方……光是和你说话就已经很费劲了。我勉强才能维持住这个形态。$B$B如果你打算拿到护符，我可以帮你，但你得先帮我显现形态。一旦我在这个位面聚形，应该就能办到……$B$B如果我能离开这座坟墓就好了。外面的土壤里富含上古奥术魔法的沉淀，堆在那里数个世纪无人问津。你能不能给我带一些泥土来？
text.progress: Do you have the soil? I'm having trouble staying together...hurry...

english.title: The Darkmist Legacy
english.objectives: Collect 6 piles of Glowing Soil.
english.description: I am chained to this place...it takes so much effort just to speak to you. I can barely maintain this shape.$B$BI could help you, but please, help me pull myself together first. Once I'm more focused on this plane, I should be able to do it...$B$BIf I could just leave this tomb, the soil itself outside is full of ancient arcane deposits, laying forgotten for centuries. Could you bring me some?
english.progress: Do you have the soil? I'm having trouble staying together...hurry...

text.title: 万劫不复
text.objectives: 收集6份灵魂精华。
text.description: 你出发的时候一定要小心。这个地方还束缚着其他的灵魂，充满了恶意和仇恨。他们都遭了许多的罪。$B$B他们从前的存在丝毫不剩，留下的只有痛苦和生存的意志。我们需要那意志来召唤将我束缚在这里的主宰。拜托你，收集这些灵魂的精华，然后把它带给我。
text.progress: Have you gathered it?

english.title: Ancient Suffering
english.objectives: Collect 6 Soul Essences.
english.description: You must be careful when you venture forth. Other spirits are bound to this place, malevolvent and hateful ones. They've all suffered so much.$B$BNone of what they used to be remains, only suffering and a will to live. We will need that will to summon the overlord that keeps me bound here. Please, gather the essence of the spirits, and bring it back to me.
english.progress: Have you gathered it?

text.title: 去找奥利瑟拉
text.objectives: 去找海加尔山拉多尼尔遗迹的奥利瑟拉。
text.description: 谢谢你把我放了出来，$n。我会把我的发现告诉我们的盟友。$B$B你现在最好向那条翡翠巨龙复命。$B$B暮光之锤发动这次特别的进攻不单单是为了抢夺领土，他们同时也在寻找一名囚犯。$B$B被关在兽穴里的范达尔·鹿盔。这次进攻其实是为了把他救出来的佯攻。为了什么目的，我不好说。也许我们的龙族盟友知晓一二。
text.completion: 'This development is troubling, $n.  We must act swiftly.'

english.title: Return to Alysra
english.objectives: Return to Alysra at the Ruins of Lar'donir in Hyjal.
english.description: I thank you for freeing me, $n.  I will tell our allies of my findings.$B$BI suggest that you return to the emerald dragon that sent you.$B$BThe Twilight's Hammer does not just seek to gain territory with this particular attack.  They're also after a prisoner.$B$BFandral Staghelm is being held in the Barrow Dens.  The attack doubles as a distraction to free him.  To what end, I cannot tell.  Perhaps our dragon ally can shed some light on this.
english.completion: 'This development is troubling, $n.  We must act swiftly.'

text.title: Warn King Wrynn
text.objectives: Speak with King Varian Wrynn in Stormwind Keep.
text.description: You have successfully defended Stormwind from the threat posed by this Twilight's Hammer cult, $n, and without harming our own citizens. Our enemy will not rest for long. Indeed, Cho'Gall must already be busy planning his next move.$B$BYou must take word to King Varian Wrynn. Go directly to him in the throne room of Stormwind Keep. Tell the king that our enemies have shown themselves and we must be prepared for their return.

english.title: Warn King Wrynn
english.objectives: Speak with King Varian Wrynn in Stormwind Keep.
english.description: You have successfully defended Stormwind from the threat posed by this Twilight's Hammer cult, $n, and without harming our own citizens. Our enemy will not rest for long. Indeed, Cho'Gall must already be busy planning his next move.$B$BYou must take word to King Varian Wrynn. Go directly to him in the throne room of Stormwind Keep. Tell the king that our enemies have shown themselves and we must be prepared for their return.

text.title: 木爪的战争
text.objectives: 收集10束木爪豺狼人的鬃毛。
text.description: 珊蒂斯下达的第一条直接命令是对付这里的木爪豺狼人。他们扩张得太快太广，已经对森林和我们的战备形成了威胁。$B$B他们知道我们在这里。搭建起营地后，我们就一直在对他们进行偷袭。现在是堂堂正正地打一场的时候了，带10束他们的鬃毛回来，然后我们就将准备好进入下一阶段。
text.progress: The manes aren't just for trophies. If there's to be slaughter, we may as well not let it be a total waste.
text.completion: Excellent work, $n. I didn't think those gnolls would give you much trouble.

english.title: War on the Woodpaw
english.objectives: Collect 10 Woodpaw Gnoll Manes.
english.description: The first of Shandris's direct orders is to deal with the Woodpaw gnolls here. They've been spreading too far, too fast, and are becoming a threat to both the forest and our war effort.$B$BThey know we're here. After we took this camp, we've been leading covert strikes against them. It's time to make a major blow; bring back ten of their manes, and we'll be ready for the next phase.
english.progress: The manes aren't just for trophies. If there's to be slaughter, we may as well not let it be a total waste.
english.completion: Excellent work, $n. I didn't think those gnolls would give you much trouble.

text.title: 突击
text.objectives: 杀死5名木爪突击队员。
text.description: 不要轻敌。豺狼人看上去四肢发达头脑简单，但动物的狡黠依然残存在他们体内。$B$B豺狼人成群出动，每一群都有一个突击队员：最大、最强、打起来最不要命的一个。他们负责发号施令，所以他们也是我们要干掉的目标。$B$B他们主要居住在木爪巢穴，耀武扬威，恃强凌弱。去那儿让他们看看谁更强。
text.completion: Perfect. Any gnolls left will be simple prey, lost in the woods.$B$BHeh...here, soldier, take your reward before I get distracted. We've got other threats to deal with.

english.title: Alpha Strike
english.objectives: Kill 5 Woodpaw Alphas.
english.description: Never underestimate a threat. These gnolls may seem like simple brutes, but there's animal cunning even among them.$B$BThe gnolls run as a pack, and every pack has Alphas: The biggest, strongest, and most ruthless members that claw their way to dominance. They're the ones giving orders, so they're the ones we're going to slay now.$B$BThey reside mostly around the Woodpaw Den, pushing the others around. Get out there and push harder.
english.completion: Perfect. Any gnolls left will be simple prey, lost in the woods.$B$BHeh...here, soldier, take your reward before I get distracted. We've got other threats to deal with.

text.title: 烈焰的黑暗精华
text.objectives: 在炼狱火海中使用焦黑的树枝，召唤索恩博尔。击败他，夺取索恩博尔的黑暗精华。
text.description: 现在，你要借助我们刚刚获得的知识，将索恩博尔拽入这个位面来，就像呱呱坠地的婴儿那样。然后，你要击败他。$B$B仪式很简单：拿着这根焦黑的树枝，在地上敲三下，然后大声喊出他的名字。$B$B你必须在炼狱火海的中心呼唤他。干掉他之后，把他的黑暗精华拿回来给我。
text.progress: Tell me! Have you fought Thol'embaar yet?$B$BI am living vicariously through you, $r. Do not disappoint!
text.completion: There it is! Such a trophy! Born in the fires of another plane...$B$BGo ahead, $r. Crush it. Crush his charcoal heart in your hands and let the winds scatter the ashes... yes, yes.
text.giverWindow: 在炼狱火海中使用焦黑的树枝召唤这个烈焰生物。

english.title: Black Heart of Flame
english.objectives: Use the Charred Branch within The Inferno to Summon Thol'embaar. Kill him and take the Black Heart of Thol'embaar.
english.description: Now you will use our newfound knowledge to pull Thol'embaar into the mortal plane like a babe screaming from the womb. Then you will crush him.$B$BThe ritual is simple: take this charred branch, tap it on the ground three times, and utter his name aloud.$B$BYou must call him from within the heart of the Inferno. Destroy him, and bring his black heart back to me.
english.progress: Tell me! Have you fought Thol'embaar yet?$B$BI am living vicariously through you, $r. Do not disappoint!
english.completion: There it is! Such a trophy! Born in the fires of another plane...$B$BGo ahead, $r. Crush it. Crush his charcoal heart in your hands and let the winds scatter the ashes... yes, yes.
english.giverWindow: Use the charred branch within the Inferno to call forth the creature of flame.

text.title: 祖卡什的侵害
text.objectives: 收集20块祖卡什虫壳
text.description: 豺狼人被解决之后，我们就准备要对付其它的敌人了。我们的斥候在附近发现了一个显然是虫巢的东西，深深地延绵至地下。$B$B巢穴里的昆虫既大又凶猛，好像比豺狼人带来的威胁还要大。我要你小心前往虫巢。砍倒一部分虫子，把它们的虫壳带回来，好做进一步的研究。
text.progress: How goes the hunt, $N?  Are you here to report your success?
text.completion: These are silithid after all...I wasn't sure, having never seen one in person. Gilneas had its problems, but at least we didn't have these monstrosities running around!

english.title: Zukk'ash Infestation
english.objectives: Collect 20 Zukk'ash Carapaces.
english.description: With the gnolls out of the way, we're ready to take care of other foes. Our scouts have discovered what appears to be a hive nearby, extending deep beneath the ground.$B$BThe insects of the hive are large and ferocious, and most likely pose an even greater threat than the gnolls. I want you to proceed to the hive with caution. Cut down a good portion of the bugs and bring back their carapaces for further study.
english.progress: How goes the hunt, $N?  Are you here to report your success?
english.completion: These are silithid after all...I wasn't sure, having never seen one in person. Gilneas had its problems, but at least we didn't have these monstrosities running around!

text.title: 翡翠盟友
text.objectives: 与海加尔山拉多尼尔遗迹的奥利瑟拉交谈。
text.description: 誓要保卫这片土地的不止海加尔山的德鲁伊，翡翠龙族曾经也是我们的强大盟友。$B$B跟北边拉多尼尔遗迹的奥利瑟拉谈谈，看看你能帮什么忙。
text.completion: My duties are here, viewing the enemy's movement from above, commanding our armies where they're needed.$B$BYour aid would be most welcome.

english.title: Emerald Allies
english.objectives: Speak to Alysra at the Ruins of Lar'donir in Mount Hyjal.
english.description: The druids of Hyjal are not the only ones sworn to defend this land.  The emerald dragons have once again become a powerful ally to our cause.$B$BSpeak to Alysra at the Ruins of Lar'donir, to the north, and see what you can do to help.
english.completion: My duties are here, viewing the enemy's movement from above, commanding our armies where they're needed.$B$BYour aid would be most welcome.

text.title: 毒刺鞭笞者
text.objectives: 杀死痛苦深渊的毒刺鞭笞者。
text.description: 我们在巢穴附近所看见的大部分虫子都十分巨大，但我的斥候报告说有一只特别肥硕。它应该是一只巨蜂，引领着地面上的工蜂们。$B$B我对这些东西了解不多，但它们若是打算走出地穴，咱们就得出手制止。杀掉这只巨蜂，然后告诉我。
text.completion: Well done, $n! You're proving very valuable to securing this area for the Alliance.
text.giverWindow: 躲开他的剧毒鞭笞！

english.title: Stinglasher
english.objectives: Kill Stinglasher in the Writhing Deep.
english.description: Most of the insects we've seen wandering the hive have been enormous enough, but my scouts reported an especially huge one. It's supposedly a massive wasp, and it seemed to be directing the workers on the surface.$B$BI don't know much about these things, but if they're starting to wander beyond that pit in the ground, we need to put a stop to it. Kill this giant wasp and return to me.
english.completion: Well done, $n! You're proving very valuable to securing this area for the Alliance.
english.giverWindow: Stay clear of his venom splash!

text.title: 跟食人魔没完
text.objectives: 杀死5名戈杜尼山丘卫兵。
text.description: 我们已经让厄运之槌的戈杜尼食人魔吃尽了苦头，但事情还不算完。我的斥候报告说他们在北边的山丘上集结，具体原因不明。$B$B他们很可能是冲着附近的部落聚居地去的，但我不会让他们轻易得逞的。侦查那个地区，杀掉你遭遇的所有食人魔，然后回来向我汇报。
text.completion: It's good to see you back. We've learned more about the ogre situation.

english.title: It's Not "Ogre" Yet
english.objectives: Kill 5 Gordunni Hillguards.
english.description: We dealt the Gordunni ogres a large blow at Dire Maul, but we haven't quite finished the job. My scouts have reported a group of them amassed in the hills to the north, gathering for some reason.$B$BIt's possible they're interested in the Horde settlement nearby, but I don't want to take any chances. Scout the area, kill any ogres you come across, and report back.
english.completion: It's good to see you back. We've learned more about the ogre situation.

text.title: 发现野人
text.objectives: 杀掉大金刚。
text.description: 你可能没亲眼看见，但斥候发现食人魔豢养着一头巨大的野兽。报告说它看上去像是一只大脚野人，要是他们所言非虚，那它就是我们在菲拉斯所见的最大的一只野人了。$B$B食人魔好像打算驯服它，让它听从他们的指挥，这也太滑稽了点，不过我不打算坐着看戏。回到山丘那里去，把它杀掉。
text.completion: Well done once again, $n. Yet another threat removed from Feralas.
text.giverWindow: 我很好奇他怎么会叫这名字…

english.title: Sasquatch Sighting
english.objectives: Kill Bigfist.
english.description: You may have seen it yourself, but other scouts have discovered an enormous beast being held by the ogres. Reports say it looks like a sasquatch, but if it is, it's the biggest ever seen in Feralas.$B$BThe ogres are most likely trying to teach it to obey them. While that's almost comical, I'm not going to sit by and let them train that thing to roll over at their command. Return to the hills and slay it.
english.completion: Well done once again, $n. Yet another threat removed from Feralas.
english.giverWindow: I wonder how he got his name...

text.title: 驯服驯兽员
text.objectives: 杀死6名戈杜尼驯兽员。
text.description: 大脚野人威胁也许很大，但我们同样也要铲除食人魔。长久以来戈杜尼食人魔都令我们非常头疼，珊蒂斯女士希望这些食人魔永远消失。但愿那就是最后几个了。$B$B杀掉锁住那只野兽的戈杜尼驯兽员，让他们知道滋扰我们是什么下场。
text.completion: Good work, and good riddance. I hope we never have to see another ogre here again!

english.title: Taming The Tamers
english.objectives: Kill 6 Gordunni Tamers.
english.description: The sasquatch may be a larger threat, but we also need to wipe out the ogres. The Gordunni have been a nuisance to us for too long, and Lady Shandris wants them completely gone.  Let's hope these are the last ones.$B$BKill the Gordunni tamers that keep the beast chained, and make sure they know the price of their meddling.
english.completion: Good work, and good riddance. I hope we never have to see another ogre here again!

text.title: Pressure is Mounting
text.objectives: Collect 3 Shark Sinews from Ravenous Threshers and 2 Sharpened Crab Claws from Sabreclaw Skitterers.$b$bRavenous Threshers can also be summoned to you by using Crab Entrails.
text.description: G'day, $gladdie:lassie;.$b$bThe name's Rendel.$b$bSeems ol' Moanah and I got here in the nick of time, eh?$b$bErunak wasn't kiddin' when he said it was life or death!$b$bWhile he's tryin' to find us a safe place to hole up, I'm gunna take a stab at securin' you a critter to ride.$b$bNow, I may not be up on all the ins an' outs of life in the sea, but it looked to me like them naga know how to get around down here.$b$bYou round up a few widgets for a bridle and I'll work up an enchantment.

english.title: Pressure is Mounting
english.objectives: Collect 3 Shark Sinews from Ravenous Threshers and 2 Sharpened Crab Claws from Sabreclaw Skitterers.$b$bRavenous Threshers can also be summoned to you by using Crab Entrails.
english.description: G'day, $gladdie:lassie;.$b$bThe name's Rendel.$b$bSeems ol' Moanah and I got here in the nick of time, eh?$b$bErunak wasn't kiddin' when he said it was life or death!$b$bWhile he's tryin' to find us a safe place to hole up, I'm gunna take a stab at securin' you a critter to ride.$b$bNow, I may not be up on all the ins an' outs of life in the sea, but it looked to me like them naga know how to get around down here.$b$bYou round up a few widgets for a bridle and I'll work up an enchantment.

text.title: 堕落的姐妹
text.objectives: 杀死8名堕落的树妖。
text.description: 发生了一些让人不安的事情。在巡逻的时候，我的斥候们遭到了树妖的伏击。$B$B树妖是暗夜精灵的亲密盟友，森林的守护者。我想他们只是被狼人吓着了，但之后我派出去的哨兵同样遭到了攻击。$B$B无论发生了什么，我都觉得不对劲。我要你也去查一查。假如连树妖都堕落了……那就给他们一个痛快。
text.completion: I didn't want to scare you, but this is a grave situation. If the portal at Dream Bough was sealed, and the corruption is still spreading...

english.title: Spiteful Sisters
english.objectives: Kill 8 Corrupted Dryads.
english.description: Something truly disturbing has occured. While on patrol, several of my scouts were ambushed by dryads.$B$BThe dryads are close allies of the night elves and guardians of the forest. I assumed they were just frightened by the sight of worgen, but the sentinels I sent out afterwards were also attacked.$B$BWhatever is going on, I don't like it. I want you to go investigate as well. If even the dryads have been corrupted...put them to the sword.
english.completion: I didn't want to scare you, but this is a grave situation. If the portal at Dream Bough was sealed, and the corruption is still spreading...

text.title: 伊森德雷的召唤
text.objectives: 跟低地荒野翡翠峰顶的伊森德雷谈一谈。
text.description: 一条翡翠梦境的巨龙……你都惹上了什么麻烦啊，$n？$B$B假如我是你的话，我就不会让她久等。我们管她说的那个地方叫翡翠峰。低地荒野那里有条岔路，可以通往一处高耸的石头高地，顶上有一座小小的圣殿。$B$B祝你好运，$n。希望你能平安归来。
text.completion: You've come.$B$BI am ashamed to ask this of you, $c, but I've ran from him long enough. Taerar must be stopped.

english.title: Ysondre's Call
english.objectives: Speak with Ysondre atop the Emerald Summit in the Lower Wilds.
english.description: A dragon of the emerald dream... what have you gotten yourself involved in, $n?$B$BI wouldn't keep her waiting if I were you. The place she spoke of is what we call the Emerald Summit. A path off the main road through the Lower Wilds leads up one of the high stone plateaus; there's a small shrine at the top.$B$BGood luck, $n. I hope to see you back safe.
english.completion: You've come.$B$BI am ashamed to ask this of you, $c, but I've ran from him long enough. Taerar must be stopped.

text.title: 伊森德雷的别离
text.objectives: 跟蔽日林的艾德娜谈一谈。
text.description: 这样一来，我就变成了最后一个了。$B$B即便我选择待在这个世界里，我也不能重新加入绿龙军团。但这场胜利给了我希望。也许，我迟早可以在凡人间的简单生活中找到平静。$B$B你应该回到你的人那里去，告诉他们噩梦的巨龙已经消失，再也不会威胁他们的土地了。
text.completion: To be drawn into a fight between dragons...I don't know if you're blessed or cursed.$B$BLady Shandris has heard of all you've done, and has personally sent this reward for your bravery. I'm glad you came back in one piece to receive it.

english.title: Ysondre's Farewell
english.objectives: Speak to Adella at Shadebough.
english.description: With that, I am the only one left.$B$BEven if I choose to remain in this world, I cannot rejoin the green flight. But this victory gives me hope. Perhaps, in time, I can find peace in a simple life among mortals.$B$BYou must return to your people. Tell them that the dragons of nightmare are gone, and will no longer threaten these lands.
english.completion: To be drawn into a fight between dragons...I don't know if you're blessed or cursed.$B$BLady Shandris has heard of all you've done, and has personally sent this reward for your bravery. I'm glad you came back in one piece to receive it.

text.title: 复仇之心
text.objectives: 杀死10名金加塔尔破坏者。
text.description: 就是这些纳迦掳走了我的人。我只要审一个就够了，其他的杀掉。$B$B不要手下留情，$c，因为他们对我们也没少下狠手。

english.title: Vengeful Heart
english.objectives: Kill 10 Zin'jatar Ravagers.
english.description: These are the naga that took our people. I only need one to interrogate, kill the rest.$B$BShow no mercy, $c, for they would surely show us none.

text.title: 深水领主金加塔尔
text.objectives: 杀死深水领主金加塔尔。
text.description: 深水领主就在这儿，废墟的另一头。咱们上一场战斗里他受的伤还没好。$B$B我把这个荣幸交给你。这一次可别把他放跑了。
text.completion: And with this, hopefully their attacks on us will calm for a while.
text.giverWindow: 在潮光洞穴落败之后，深水领主金加塔尔逃进了废墟里。但看起来他并没有逃多远。

english.title: Fathom-Lord Zin'jatar
english.objectives: Kill Fathom-Lord Zin'jatar.
english.description: The Fathom-Lord is here, at the far side of the ruins. He's still injured from our last battle.$B$BI'll leave this pleasure to you. Make sure he doesn't get away this time.
english.completion: And with this, hopefully their attacks on us will calm for a while.
english.giverWindow: Suffering his first major defeat at Damplight Cavern, Fathom-Lord Zin'jatar retreated to the ruins to recover. It seems he didn't retreat quite far enough.

text.title: 漩涡
text.objectives: 用狂水之球困住30条群游的毒蛇。
text.description: 我从不喜欢蛇，在这里更是如此。好在水元素依然听从我的意志。$B$B将这些宝珠带上，朝地面投掷，让周围的水分形成一道漩涡，将附近的蛇统统卷进去。纳迦肯定会让这些蛇对付我们，所以手头最好留些宝珠。

english.title: Vortex
english.objectives: Use the Globes of Tumultuous Water to trap 30 swarming serpents.
english.description: I have no fondness for snakes, and even less so down here. Fortunately for us, the watery elements still bend to my will for now.$B$BTake these globes and throw them at the ground to send the nearby water into a vortex, pulling in all the nearby serpents. The naga will most certainly turn the snakes against us, so keep the orbs close at hand.

text.title: 智慧珍珠
text.objectives: 将冷光珍珠带给银潮谷的大地治愈者杜安。
text.description: 这颗珍珠同你以往所见过的都不同。它散发着光芒，而且要是你没弄错的话，那是强大的魔法光芒。$B$B大地治愈者杜安肯定会对此感兴趣的。
text.progress: Yes, $c? Have you found something?
text.completion: What is this? A pearl? Much more I think.$B$BThis is exactly what I was looking for, thank you for bringing it to me.

english.title: A Pearl of Wisdom
english.objectives: Bring the Luminescent Pearl to Earthmender Duarn in Silvertide Hollow.
english.description: This pearl is unlike anything you've ever seen before. It radiates light, and if you are not mistaken, it radiates powerful magic as well.$B$BEarthmender Duarn back in Silver Tide Hollow will surely be interested in this.
english.progress: Yes, $c? Have you found something?
english.completion: What is this? A pearl? Much more I think.$B$BThis is exactly what I was looking for, thank you for bringing it to me.

text.title: The Name Never Spoken
text.objectives: Assemble the true name by examining the three Firestones in the Inferno.
text.description: Did my drought work? You spoke with one of them?$B$BThen you know what to do. The name of their elemental master is written on three firestones scattered throughout the Inferno. Examine each of these stones and we will have the name we need.$B$BHurry! Your precious forest burns!

english.title: The Name Never Spoken
english.objectives: Assemble the true name by examining the three Firestones in the Inferno.
english.description: Did my drought work? You spoke with one of them?$B$BThen you know what to do. The name of their elemental master is written on three firestones scattered throughout the Inferno. Examine each of these stones and we will have the name we need.$B$BHurry! Your precious forest burns!

text.title: 完美的间谍
text.objectives: 捉住5只森金青蛙，把它们带到瓦妮拉的岗哨图腾旁，在她的面前对它们施法。
text.description: 盲目行动是愚蠢的，所以我要制造一些小间谍，为沃金收集情报。他需要知道那些岛上都发生了什么。$B$B如果你愿意帮助我，我会非常高兴。让我告诉你该怎样做。首先，你要捉住那里的青蛙。它们很喜欢躲藏在森金周围棕榈树的阴影里。$B$B捉到青蛙以后，就把它们带到我的岗哨图腾来，在我的面前对它们施法。
text.completion: These be enough for me purposes. Now comes de hard part.

english.title: Da Perfect Spies
english.objectives: Capture 5 Sen'jin Frogs and attune them to Vanira's sight at her Sentry Totem.
english.description: Now, it would be foolish to go in blind 'ere, so I be creatin' some tiny spies to gather information for Vol'jin. He got to know what's goin' on over on de islands.$B$BI could use da help, if you be feelin' up to it. I tell ya how it's done. First, ya gotta catch de frogs. Dey like to stay in de shade of da palm trees around Sen'jin.$B$BOnce ya have de frogs, bring 'em over here to my sentry totem an' attune dem to me sight.
english.completion: These be enough for me purposes. Now comes de hard part.

text.title: Zalazane's Fall
text.objectives: Help Vol'jin take back the Echo Isles and kill Zalazane.
text.description: De time for battle is now!  We'd be headin' ova to da islands soon, so you'd betta be ready.$B$BZalazane doesn't have much time left.
text.completion: $n, you'd be a mighty warrior and a fierce commrade to da Darkspear trolls.  De Echo Isles are OURS now and we couldn'ta done it wit'out ya.$B$BTake dis cloak. Wear it wit pride.  You'd be a member of da tribe now!$B$BIn no time, da trolls will have a home again and we have you to thank for dat.

english.title: Zalazane's Fall
english.objectives: Help Vol'jin take back the Echo Isles and kill Zalazane.
english.description: De time for battle is now!  We'd be headin' ova to da islands soon, so you'd betta be ready.$B$BZalazane doesn't have much time left.
english.completion: $n, you'd be a mighty warrior and a fierce commrade to da Darkspear trolls.  De Echo Isles are OURS now and we couldn'ta done it wit'out ya.$B$BTake dis cloak. Wear it wit pride.  You'd be a member of da tribe now!$B$BIn no time, da trolls will have a home again and we have you to thank for dat.

text.title: Frogs Away!
text.objectives: While riding a bat, use the Sack o' Frogs to place 12 attuned frogs on the markers in the Echo Isles.
text.description: Wit de frogs ready to go, I be needin' ya to help me send 'em out to the isles.$B$BOn de eastern side of Sen'jin Village, ya can find Handler Marnlek. He be handlin' all the bats for Vol'jin's scouts and he can loan ya a bat to get ya out to de isles.$B$BTake dis sack' o frogs with ya. I been askin' de spirits for guidance. Dey've sent smoke to show ya where I need de eyes most. While ridin' de bat, reach into de sack and toss de frogs toward de white smoke.
text.completion: I'm already beginnin' to see what de frogs are seein'. Ya done it perfectly, $N. Now Vol'jin and I will see what Zalazane be plannin'.

english.title: Frogs Away!
english.objectives: While riding a bat, use the Sack o' Frogs to place 12 attuned frogs on the markers in the Echo Isles.
english.description: Wit de frogs ready to go, I be needin' ya to help me send 'em out to the isles.$B$BOn de eastern side of Sen'jin Village, ya can find Handler Marnlek. He be handlin' all the bats for Vol'jin's scouts and he can loan ya a bat to get ya out to de isles.$B$BTake dis sack' o frogs with ya. I been askin' de spirits for guidance. Dey've sent smoke to show ya where I need de eyes most. While ridin' de bat, reach into de sack and toss de frogs toward de white smoke.
english.completion: I'm already beginnin' to see what de frogs are seein'. Ya done it perfectly, $N. Now Vol'jin and I will see what Zalazane be plannin'.

text.title: 改变的迹象
text.objectives: 收集8只被感染的鹿角。
text.description: 一种恶疾降临在了这片森林中的生物身上。起先我以为这只是自然现象的一部分，可它经久不褪。$B$B那些平常温驯而强壮的雄鹿，如今病得最重。一些在虚弱中白白送了性命，其他的则陷入危险的癫狂。我需要一些鹿角，以便从万灵那里进一步了解这种疾病。
text.progress: This is a sad task, $n, but necessary.
text.completion: At the very least, these creatures' suffering has ended. Let us hope their sacrifice will bring a stop to further pain.

english.title: Signs of Change
english.objectives: Collect 8 Infected Stag Antlers.
english.description: A severe illness has fallen over the creatures of this forest. While at first I hoped it was part of nature's course, it has refused to pass.$B$BThe forest stags, normally strong and serene, have suffered the worst. Some waste away in weakness; others froth and rage dangerously. If I am to consult the spirits to learn more of this sickness, I will need the stags' antlers.
english.progress: This is a sad task, $n, but necessary.
english.completion: At the very least, these creatures' suffering has ended. Let us hope their sacrifice will bring a stop to further pain.

text.title: 北泉之劫
text.objectives: 击败6只北泉鹰身人和6只北泉唤风者。
text.description: 我在这里的职责是看守特拉隆。就算他没有因为冥想而毫无反击之力，这片森林里的威胁也足以让我俩忙个不停了。$B$B这就是为什么仅仅因为没机会离开营地就让我几乎要抓狂的原因。西北边肆虐的鹰身人比我这辈子见过的还要多……肮脏的生物，肆无忌惮地在远古废墟中散布着她们的污秽。$B$B那些鹰身人对这个营地是一个威胁，这块大地也容不得她们。假如你能把她们击退，我会好好犒赏你的。
text.completion: Thank you, $c. That's one less distraction for me.

english.title: The Northspring Menace
english.objectives: Kill 6 Northspring Harpies and 6 Northspring Windcallers.
english.description: My duty here is to watch over Telaron. Even without his meditation leaving him vulnerable, there's enough threats in this forest to keep both of us on our toes.$B$BThat's why it maddens me so much that I don't have the opportunity to leave camp. More harpies than I've ever seen infest the northwest...foul creatures, spreading their filth across the ancient ruins uncaringly.$B$BThey're a threat to this camp, and have no place in these lands. I'll pay you well if you get rid of them.
english.completion: Thank you, $c. That's one less distraction for me.

text.title: 质量保证
text.objectives: 收集10张厚重的雪人皮。
text.description: 我的制皮哲学是，但求最好——绝不妥协。要是有人说质量不重要，那他就是在丹莫罗给你兜售海景房！$B$B在最近搜罗高质量材料的时候，我发现了厚重的雪人皮。雪人就土生土长在菲拉斯，东北边的怒痕堡里可以找到很多。我要它们的皮，拿十张来，我就让你在我的皮货里挑一件。假如你觉得还公平的话，那咱们就成交。
text.progress: A stack of ten thick yeti hides will net you a choice of one of my crafted items.  Because I care about quality, I am able to ensure you'll get a good item!$B$B
text.completion: Did you stop and examine the texture of these hides?  Properly treated, these hides could very well be stronger than iron.  Not many people know about these hides, and that in combination with the vast treating solutions I know will allow me to potentially make items with a true mark of quality... thanks to you, of course!$B$BAnd now, please choose from what I am able to offer you for your service!

english.title: The Mark of Quality
english.objectives: Collect 10 Thick Yeti Hides.
english.description: My philosophy on leatherworking is that the work must be the best quality possible - no compromises. Anyone who says that quality doesn't matter is trying to sell you ocean-front property in Dun Morogh!$B$BIn my latest pursuit of high-quality materials, I have run across thick yeti hides. The Yeti are native to Feralas, with many found in Rage Scar Hold to the northeast. I want some, and I'll give you a choice of one of my leather goods for a stack of ten.  If that sounds fair, then we're in business.
english.progress: A stack of ten thick yeti hides will net you a choice of one of my crafted items.  Because I care about quality, I am able to ensure you'll get a good item!$B$B
english.completion: Did you stop and examine the texture of these hides?  Properly treated, these hides could very well be stronger than iron.  Not many people know about these hides, and that in combination with the vast treating solutions I know will allow me to potentially make items with a true mark of quality... thanks to you, of course!$B$BAnd now, please choose from what I am able to offer you for your service!

text.title: 精益求精
text.objectives: 收集10张深痕雪人的毛皮。
text.description: 事情的变化可真有意思。北方雪人的毛皮以往是最好的，但这些……好像，质量下降了。也许附近什么东西让他们病了。$B$B幸运的是，东南边的怒痕雪人看样子颇是人丁兴旺。我打赌他们的毛皮甚至比以前还要好！$B$B我出大价钱收你一摞十张，把毛皮给我带来，咱们好完成交易。
text.progress: These hides may not be as resilient as thorium, but they're nice and supple.
text.completion: Excellent, excellent!  These are going to work out incredibly well - I can already tell that they're going to be much harder when properly cured.$B$BThanks again for your help $N.  Here - please take one of my latest creations.

english.title: Improved Quality
english.objectives: Collect 10 Feral Scar Yeti Hides.
english.description: It's funny how things change. The northern yetis used to yield the best hides, but these...there's been a decline in quality, it seems. Maybe something nearby is making them sick.$B$BLuckily, the Feral Scar yetis to the southeast have flourished. I bet their hides are even better than they used to be!$B$BI would reward you handsomely for a stack of ten of their hides; bring them to me here, and we'll finish our business.
english.progress: These hides may not be as resilient as thorium, but they're nice and supple.
english.completion: Excellent, excellent!  These are going to work out incredibly well - I can already tell that they're going to be much harder when properly cured.$B$BThanks again for your help $N.  Here - please take one of my latest creations.

text.title: 原始雪人毛皮
text.objectives: 将原始雪人毛皮交给菲拉斯羽月要塞的普拉特·马克格鲁比。
text.description: 你找到了一张异常厚重和结实的原始雪人毛皮——比你在怒痕堡里见过的那些雪人皮还要厉害。$B$B既然羽月要塞的普拉特·马克格鲁比在雪人皮市场里有门路，他应该会对这块特殊的毛皮感兴趣。

english.title: Pristine Yeti Hide
english.objectives: Bring the Pristine Yeti Hide to Pratt McGrubben at the Feathermoon Stronghold, Feralas.
english.description: You have found a pristine yeti hide that is exceptionally thick and sturdy - more so than even the ones you've seen from the yeti in Rage Scar.$B$BConsidering that Pratt McGrubben at the Feathermoon Stronghold is in the market for yeti hides, this particular one may be of considerable interest to him.

text.title: 质量保证
text.objectives: 收集10张厚重的雪人皮。
text.description: 我为我的皮制品自豪，我能感觉到它们与众不同，质量永远要放在第一位。要是有人说质量不重要，他就像是要你相信大地没法儿保守秘密一样！$B$B在最近寻找高质量材料的时候，我发现了厚重的雪人皮。雪人就土生土长在菲拉斯，北边的怒痕堡里可以找到很多。我要它们的皮，拿十张来，我就让你在我的皮货里挑一件。假如你同意，那咱们就说定了！

english.title: The Mark of Quality
english.objectives: Collect 10 Thick Yeti Hides.
english.description: I take pride in my leather work, and I feel it shows; quality should never be compromised.  Anyone who says that quality doesn't matter would also have you believe that the earth does not keep secrets!$B$BIn my latest pursuit of high-quality materials, I have discovered thick yeti hides.  Yetis are native to Feralas, often found north of here in Rage Scar Hold.  I'll give you a choice of one of my leather goods for a stack of ten.  If that is agreeable to you, then we are set!

text.title: 精益求精
text.objectives: 从深痕雪人身上收集10张深痕雪人皮。
text.description: 我都有点糊涂了。怒痕雪人曾经是这片土地上最好的毛皮来源……但这些皮草质量低下，有些地方还有烂斑。一定是某种疾病感染着这些生物。$B$B我只好靠别的货源了。南边深痕谷的雪人毛皮基本上也很强韧。他们同样相当地凶猛，别贸然就出手，$c。

english.title: Improved Quality
english.objectives: Collect 10 Feral Scar Yeti Hides from Feral Scar Yeti.
english.description: I'm a bit confused. The Rage Scar yeti used to be the finest source of leather in these lands... but these pelts are weak and even rotted in spots. Some sort of illness must be plaguing the creatures.$B$BI'll have to rely on a different source. The yeti of Feral Scar Vale to the south have hides nearly as strong. They are also a great deal fiercer; do not hunt them without caution, $c.

text.title: 完美的雪人皮
text.objectives: 将完美的雪人皮交给菲拉斯石槌要塞的杉多尔·迅蹄。
text.description: 你找到的可能是一张完美的雪人皮。轻易就能感到它异常厚重和结实——比你在怒痕堡里见过的那些雪人皮还要厉害。$B$B既然石槌要塞的杉多尔·迅蹄在雪人皮市场里有门路，他应该会对这块特殊的毛皮感兴趣。

english.title: Perfect Yeti Hide
english.objectives: Bring the Perfect Yeti Hide to Jangdor Swiftstrider at Stonemaul Hold in Feralas.
english.description: You have found what may very well be a perfect yeti hide.  You easily note that it is exceptionally thick and sturdy - more so than even the ones you've seen from the yeti in Rage Scar.$B$BConsidering that Jangdor Swiftstrider at Stonemaul Hold is in the market for yeti hides, this particular one may be of considerable interest to him.

text.title: A Test of Wills
text.objectives: Use Erunak's Bridle to captivate a Zin'jatar Raider, then yank its reins until it submits.
text.description: Arright, $gladdie:lassie; here we go.$b$bYou just need to sneak up on one 'a them naga while they ain't lookin' and use this bridle on 'em.$b$bDon't get too close, now! Ya gotta surprise 'em.$b$bDo it right an' get 'em under your control, and it'll be time ta show 'em who's boss!$b$bJust keep yankin' the reins 'til their will is broken, and you'll have yerself a fancy ride!$b$bGo on, now. Go git you one! I think I can see one just north 'a here...
text.completed: Speak with Rendel Firetongue in Shallow's End.

Go git you one! I think I can see one just north 'a here...
english.completed: Speak with Rendel Firetongue in Shallow's End.

text.title: 安然无恙
text.objectives: 去找银潮谷的费罗拉·火冠。
text.description: 是是，我知道费罗拉想让你回去。那个女人对发明创造一点尊重都没有。我告诉她我为大地元素所做的改良时，她差点大发雷霆。$B$B去告诉她一切都很好，没有差错。还有跟她说，发达了她别想沾我的光。$B$B她多半就喜欢过穷日子。

english.title: Back in One Piece
english.objectives: Return to Felora Firewreath in Silver Tide Hollow.
english.description: Yeah yeah, I'm sure Felora wants you back. That woman has no respect for innovation. When I told her about the modifications I was making for my Earth Elemental, she nearly threw a fit.$B$BGo tell her everything's all well and dandy. And tell her she's not getting a share of my inevitable fortune either.$B$BShe probably likes sleeping on the rock anyway.

text.title: Ron Targetting Test
text.description: Complete this quest.

english.title: Ron Targetting Test
english.description: Complete this quest.

text.title: 思科瑟什将军
text.objectives: 杀死思科瑟什将军，拿下他的徽记。
text.description: 一定得打倒他们的部队领袖！无人指挥，纳迦的进攻就会土崩瓦解。$B$B我看到那懦夫退到一个荒废的建筑中去了。一路杀过去，拿下他的徽记！珊蒂斯女士会想要亲眼过目的。
text.progress: Has the general fallen?
text.completion: Good riddance to foul creatures. May the naga slither back into the sea and never return.$B$BYou've proven yourself on the battlefield, $n. I would ask more assistance of you in defending our lands here.
text.giverWindow: 击溃思科瑟什将军，打退这波攻势。

english.title: General Skessesh
english.objectives: Slay General Skessesh and take his head.
english.description: The leader of these forces must fall! The naga's offensive will be broken with no one to command them.$B$BI saw the coward retreat into one of the abandoned buildings here. Cut your way through the others and take his head! Lady Shandris will want to see it for herself.
english.progress: Has the general fallen?
english.completion: Good riddance to foul creatures. May the naga slither back into the sea and never return.$B$BYou've proven yourself on the battlefield, $n. I would ask more assistance of you in defending our lands here.
english.giverWindow: Break Skessesh and you break this entire offensive.

text.title: 蛇患
text.objectives: 在格洛克的挽歌杀死4条盐鳞蛇。
text.description: 如果说有一样东西是我绝对不能忍的，那就是蛇。任何种类的蛇——这并不重要。$b$b当我外出打捞东西的时候，我在附近的船骸附近看到了一窝海蛇。$b$b一想到那些可怕的东西随时有可能溜到这里来，我就浑身不自在。$b$b求你了，$c！去做点什么吧！
text.completion: Well that's a load off my mind.$b$bThank you again, $c.

english.title: Ophidophobia
english.objectives: Kill 4 Brinescale Serpents at Gorrok's Lament.
english.description: If there's one thing I can't stand, it's snakes. Any kind of snake - doesn't matter.$b$bWhile I was out searching for salvage, I saw a nest of sea serpents surrounding the nearby wreckage.$b$bI simply can't relax knowing that those awful creatures could slither up in here at any moment.$b$bPlease, $c! Do something about them!
english.completion: Well that's a load off my mind.$b$bThank you again, $c.

text.title: 大地崛起
text.objectives: 消灭6只灼热的岩土元素。
text.description: 暮光之锤的暴行在这里都能感觉到，就在距离世界之树如此之近的地方。$B$B森林被烧毁之后，土地再度于疯狂暴怒中进入敌视我们的状态。$B$B我们不能放任元素肆虐，去帮我的人把它们镇住。
text.completion: I thank you, $n.  Your fighting prowess is admirable.  You will be crucial to putting a halt to the elemental onslaught.

english.title: The Earth Rises
english.objectives: Slay 8 Scalding Rock Elementals.
english.description: The effects of the Twilight's Hammer attack can be felt even here, this close to the world tree.$B$BAs our forests burn, the very earth turns against us in a crazed frenzy.$B$BWe can't allow the elementals to go unchecked.  Go and help our men take care of them.
english.completion: I thank you, $n.  Your fighting prowess is admirable.  You will be crucial to putting a halt to the elemental onslaught.

text.title: Trollin' For Volunteers
text.objectives: Use Vol'jin's War Drums to recruit 5 Troll Citizens in Razor Hill.$B$BYou can speak to Handler Marnlek for a bat ride to Razor Hill.
text.description: Vol'jin has given me his war drums and put  me in charge of trainin' da new recruits here. Only problem is we be short on new recruits.$B$BSupposin' I loaned ya dis drum, would ya use it to sound de call to war on Vol'jin's behalf in Razor Hill? If ya could even inspire just a few trolls to join da cause, it would make a difference. Once ya've convinced dem to volunteer, bring dem back to me for trainin'. Go over an' talk to Handler Marnlek to de south. He can lend you a bat for de ride to Razor Hill.
text.completion: Ya found some good ones. I be trainin' them hard and we won't stop until we've driven Zalazane from our islands.

Go over an' talk to Handler Marnlek to de south. He can lend you a bat for de ride to Razor Hill.
english.completion: Ya found some good ones. I be trainin' them hard and we won't stop until we've driven Zalazane from our islands.

objectiveDetails.description: Troll Volunteers delivered to Champion Uru'zin

text.title: 上面的熊
text.objectives: 爬上呼啸林地的树，抓住受惊吓的海加尔幼熊，从树上把它们朝软垫那里扔。这绝对安全。
text.description: 别害怕林地里的这些熊，$c——我暂时让它们平静下来了。$B$B我现在担心的是那些熊崽的安危。大火把小家伙们赶上了树，可它们下不来了。我们得把小熊们安全救下地！$B$B飞行生物会吓着他们的，所以你得亲自爬上去。在树干上找落脚点，爬上去，抓住熊崽，往软垫这儿扔过来——要轻！$B$B这法子应该不会有什么问题。
text.completion: 'I thank you, $n. Those little bears are shaken up but they''ll survive.$B$BAt least the ones that hit the mat.'

english.title: The Bears Up There
english.objectives: Climb up trees in the Whistling Grove, grab stranded Hyjal Bear Cubs, and then hurl them at the Soft Target from the top of the tree. This is perfectly safe.
english.description: Do not fear the bears in this grove, $c - I have pacified them for the moment.$B$BMy concern at present is for the welfare of the bear cubs. The fires drove the little ones up the trees, where they've gotten stuck. We've got to get those bears safely to the ground!$B$BFlying creatures frighten them, so you'll have to climb the trees yourself. Look for footholds at the trunks. Climb the trees, grab the bear cubs, and toss them - GENTLY! - onto the target here.$B$BNothing can go wrong with this plan.
english.completion: 'I thank you, $n. Those little bears are shaken up but they''ll survive.$B$BAt least the ones that hit the mat.'

text.title: 去找西尔维亚
text.objectives: 去找埃斯图兰之塔的西尔维亚。
text.description: 一位名叫埃斯图兰的上层精灵法师，离开了他那些还活着的兄弟们，在东边建立起了一座高塔。他在那里训练着年轻的暗夜精灵，教习他们奥术魔法。$B$B要不是泰兰德女士最近对他们的人大发慈悲，我就会依法将其处决。我们会对他保持严密监视，但我不会因为傲慢而拒绝帮助我的哨兵们。$B$B我已经派西尔维亚前往埃斯图兰之塔，对侵害周遭森林的食人魔展开进攻。去找她，她会给你下达进一步的指令。
text.completion: Good to see you here. Estulan is being...difficult. We're going to have to deal with these ogres for Lady Shandris on our own until he decides to deal with us.

english.title: Report to Silvia
english.objectives: Report to Silvia at the Tower of Estulan.
english.description: A Highborne mage named Estulan, estranged from his surviving brothers, has built a tower to the east where he trains young night elves in arcane magic.$B$BWere it not for Lady Tyrande's recent mercy towards his kind, his execution would be my duty under the law. He will be watched closely, but I will not deny aid to my Sentinels simply out of pride.$B$BI've sent Silvia ahead to the Tower of Estulan to begin an offensive against the ogres infesting the nearby forest. Report to her for further orders.
english.completion: Good to see you here. Estulan is being...difficult. We're going to have to deal with these ogres for Lady Shandris on our own until he decides to deal with us.

text.title: 迦顿男爵归来
text.objectives: 用烈焰先知之杖削弱迦顿男爵。
text.description: 拉格纳罗斯不是唯一一个重现于我们世界的强大元素。$B$B可怕的迦顿男爵正在带兵肆意烧杀，我们必须阻止他。$B$B烈焰先知之杖力量非凡，或许足以削弱他，让我们的大德鲁伊能将他缚住。$B$B去吧，$n，多加小心。迦顿男爵一心报复，狡诈非常。
text.completion: 'Well done, $n.  We cannot afford to lose any further ground in Hyjal.$B$BBy stopping Baron Geddon we will have dealt a huge blow to the enemy.'

english.title: The Return of Baron Geddon
english.objectives: Channel the Flameseer's Staff to weaken Baron Geddon.
english.description: Ragnaros is not the only powerful elemental that has re-emerged into our world.$B$BThe dreaded Baron Geddon is leading the onslaught and we must put an end to this rampage.$B$BThe Flameseer's Staff has proven powerful.  Perhaps it is powerful enough to weaken him to the point where our arch druids can bind him where he stands.$B$BGo, $n and be careful.  Baron Geddon is a vengeful and treacherous being.
english.completion: 'Well done, $n.  We cannot afford to lose any further ground in Hyjal.$B$BBy stopping Baron Geddon we will have dealt a huge blow to the enemy.'

text.title: 还是被缩小的巨人
text.objectives: 使用索尔宾的超级压缩器攻击海岸巨人，收集6份微缩残渣。
text.description: 嘿，老兄！我还在研究侏儒微缩射线的改良，结构上用高级地精科技进行了加强！为了给我自己避免诸多不便，比如死亡，我要你在海边的海岸巨人身上做些试验。把他们变小后，你可以在他们的身上找到微缩残渣——把它们给我带些来！
text.progress: I had to tweak the thing to stop working on mountain giants. Even though I wasn't the one running around zapping things, those night elves beat the copper out of me after they found those guys shrunk.
text.completion: Splendifimous!  Not only am I glad to see that you've returned with the residue, but also with all your major appendages intact!  That is, well, there was never any danger in using the Ultra-Shrinker, now was there!$B$BI do appreciate your effort on my behalf, $N.  Truly, you are a friend to goblins everywhere.  Accept this as a token of my appreciation!

english.title: Still With The Zapped Giants
english.objectives: Use Zorbin's Ultra-Shrinker to zap Shore Striders and collect 6 Miniaturization Residues.
english.description: Hey pal! I'm still working on a variant of a gnomish shrinking ray, using superior GOBLIN technological advances in its construction!  In an effort to avoid inconveniences for myself such as death, I'd like for you to try it out on some of the sea giants along the coast here.  You should find miniaturization residue on them after you shrink them - bring me back some!
english.progress: I had to tweak the thing to stop working on mountain giants. Even though I wasn't the one running around zapping things, those night elves beat the copper out of me after they found those guys shrunk.
english.completion: Splendifimous!  Not only am I glad to see that you've returned with the residue, but also with all your major appendages intact!  That is, well, there was never any danger in using the Ultra-Shrinker, now was there!$B$BI do appreciate your effort on my behalf, $N.  Truly, you are a friend to goblins everywhere.  Accept this as a token of my appreciation!

text.title: 更多压缩器的动力
text.objectives: 从海元素和巨型海元素处收集10颗水元素核心。
text.description: 如果我想要在被遗忘的海岸这里开一家可以正常经营的工程学商店，那我就必须先解决这些讨厌的元素生物——它们简直是无法无天！$B$B幸运的是，我发现这些元素生物身上有一种可以给我的超级压缩器提供动力的理想材料——我希望你可以好好地教训它们，拿到我要的东西！把它们身上的水元素核心给我拿来！
text.progress: While I could bore you with the technical details of the utility behind elemental cores, I will instead tempt you to completion of this important task by offering valuable coin and prizes for doing so.  Yon verily, are you finished?
text.completion: Scrumdillyriffic!  These cores will keep me working for some time.  Add to that the benefit of there now being fewer elementals along the coast, and I might no longer cry myself to sleep at the prospect of having set up shop in perhaps the worst place imaginable!$B$BThank you, $N, for your efforts on my behalf.  While it certainly straps me financially to do this, allow me to show you some gratitude you may understand and appreciate... loot!

english.title: Even More Fuel for the Zapping
english.objectives: Collect 10 Water Elemental Cores from the Sea Elementals and Sea Sprays.
english.description: If I bet against my own better judgment and stay to run an engineering shop along the Forgotten Coast, I will need to deal with these pesky elementals.  Curse the powers of elementalism unchecked, I say!$B$BFortunately for me, and now for you my hopeful agent provocateur, the elementals represent an ideal source of raw power for my Ultra-Shrinker refinement - give them the what-for I say!  When doing this though, be sure to save me the water elemental cores!
english.progress: While I could bore you with the technical details of the utility behind elemental cores, I will instead tempt you to completion of this important task by offering valuable coin and prizes for doing so.  Yon verily, are you finished?
english.completion: Scrumdillyriffic!  These cores will keep me working for some time.  Add to that the benefit of there now being fewer elementals along the coast, and I might no longer cry myself to sleep at the prospect of having set up shop in perhaps the worst place imaginable!$B$BThank you, $N, for your efforts on my behalf.  While it certainly straps me financially to do this, allow me to show you some gratitude you may understand and appreciate... loot!

text.title: 克里克拉克的腹中餐
text.objectives: 从克里克拉克那里夺得被腐蚀的钥匙，用它打开柯尔普萨之森中的半埋的提箱。
text.description: 你惊喜地发现，这张地图在海蟹的肚子里游历一番后，上面的图案依然清晰可辨。$B$B从图上看，柯尔普萨之森里栖息着一只巨型软体动物，而它身后埋着一只箱子。$B$B地图背面是一幅工整的草图，画的是箱子的主人以及钥匙被一只名叫克里克拉克的大龙虾吃掉了。

english.title: Kliklak's Craw
english.objectives: Obtain the Corroded Key from Kliklak to unlock the Half-buried Footlocker in the Kelp'thar Forest.
english.description: You are pleasantly surprised to find that after being mangled and masticated by a sea crab, this map is still quite legible.$b$bIt clearly indicates that a footlocker was buried in the Kelp'thar Forest behind a gigantic mollusk.$b$bA well-drawn sketch on the back of the map shows that the owner, along with his key, was eaten by an overgrown crustacean named Kliklak.

text.title: 自然大军：精灵龙
text.objectives: 用杰莎娜的精灵龙号角集结10头精龙或小精龙。
text.description: 光看外表你是不会明白的，这些居住在森林里的可爱精灵龙一旦经过训练，也可以变得十分可怕。它们可以对魔法能量产生奇妙的作用……吸收它、让它转向，甚至是完全净化。$B$B单个的精灵龙没什么威胁，然而一旦成群结队，它们在战场上就有出人意料的威力。你可以在西北方的原野上找到一些精灵龙，但要当心一点，部落就在附近。
text.completion: Aren't they adorable? The babies are even cuter.

english.title: Forces of Nature: Faerie Dragons
english.objectives: Use Jesana's Faerie Dragon Call to rally 10 Sprite Dragons or Sprite Darters.
english.description: You wouldn't know it from looking at them, but the lovely faerie dragons that inhabit this forest can be truly fearsome if trained properly. They can do amazing things to magical energy...absorb it, redirect it, even nullify it entirely.$B$BThey're nearly harmless alone, but in large numbers, they can have a stunning effect on a battle. You can find some in the fields to the northwest, but be careful, the Horde is nearby.
english.completion: Aren't they adorable? The babies are even cuter.

text.title: 自然大军：山岭巨人
text.objectives: 用杰莎娜的巨人号角集结5名山岭巨人。
text.description: 山岭巨人是我们在森林里最为强大的盟友。他们是由大地本身演化而来。$B$B大多数敌人都不愿意同一座行走的山丘作战。只要区区几个山岭巨人，就能完全扭转战局。$B$B最近这里的山岭巨人染上了某种疾病，不过我在西南边看见过一群健康的。
text.completion: Excellent!$B$B$n, you've helped bolster our forces here, and you've saved many of these forest creatures from the Horde as well. With our army now ready, Feathermoon will stand against all threats, Horde or otherwise!$B$BOn behalf of Lady Feathermoon, I'd like to award you with this weapon, fit for a Sentinel.

english.title: Forces of Nature: Mountain Giants
english.objectives: Use Jesana's Giant Call to rally 5 Mountain Giants.
english.description: The mountain giants are our most powerful allies of the forest. They're carved from the land itself.$B$BNot many of our enemies are willing to fight off a walking hillside. It only takes a few of these to turn the tide of a battle completely.$B$BThe mountain giants here have been afflicted by some illness lately, but I've seen a healthy group of them to the southwest.
english.completion: Excellent!$B$B$n, you've helped bolster our forces here, and you've saved many of these forest creatures from the Horde as well. With our army now ready, Feathermoon will stand against all threats, Horde or otherwise!$B$BOn behalf of Lady Feathermoon, I'd like to award you with this weapon, fit for a Sentinel.

text.title: Lady Of Da Tigers
text.objectives: While imbued with the Spirit of the Tiger, lure the Tiger Matriarch out of hiding and use your new abilities to best it in combat.
text.description: Remember de frogs ya made into me eyes and ears? Well, dey've found somethin' interestin'.$B$BOn an island to de southeast, dey've spied a tiger even de other cats seem to fear. Dis tiger, I've never seen anythin' like it.$B$BIt hunts wit' da instincts of a cat, but de mind of a person. It could be a powerful spirit and a strong ally.$B$BI'll be callin' down the spirit o' the tiger upon ya. Use its gifts to locate this cat and challenge it. See if ya can win its aid in our battle for the isles.
text.completion: Vanira's frogs be tellin' de truth, den? Dis tiger be a druid and an ally? We couldn't be hopin' for a better outcome. Dis be a good omen for de coming battle.

english.title: Lady Of Da Tigers
english.objectives: While imbued with the Spirit of the Tiger, lure the Tiger Matriarch out of hiding and use your new abilities to best it in combat.
english.description: Remember de frogs ya made into me eyes and ears? Well, dey've found somethin' interestin'.$B$BOn an island to de southeast, dey've spied a tiger even de other cats seem to fear. Dis tiger, I've never seen anythin' like it.$B$BIt hunts wit' da instincts of a cat, but de mind of a person. It could be a powerful spirit and a strong ally.$B$BI'll be callin' down the spirit o' the tiger upon ya. Use its gifts to locate this cat and challenge it. See if ya can win its aid in our battle for the isles.
english.completion: Vanira's frogs be tellin' de truth, den? Dis tiger be a druid and an ally? We couldn't be hopin' for a better outcome. Dis be a good omen for de coming battle.

text.title: 大裂谷历险记
text.objectives: 与潮光大厅的先知加德拉交谈。
text.description: 要想弄明白纳迦在这儿的目的，我们还得更深入瓦丝琪尔。$B$B前往湮光海谷，那是西边与柯尔普萨之森交界的一道大裂口。如果你朝它对面看，就可以看到一簇植物围绕着潮光大厅的入口。$B$B到那里之后，要浮出水面还是有一段距离的，不过我在那儿有朋友可以照应你。

english.title: Across the Great Divide
english.objectives: Speak to Farseer Gadra in the Damplight Chamber.
english.description: We will need to press deeper into Vashj'ir if we want to uncover what the naga are doing here.$B$BGo to the Lightless Reaches, the giant chasm bordering the Kelp'thar Forest to the west.  If you look across it, you should see a cluster of plant-life surrounding the entrance to Damplight Chamber.$B$BOnce you're inside the cave, it's a bit of a ride up until you break surface, but I have friends there that should provide you a warm welcome.

text.title: 烈焰先知之杖
text.objectives: 收集8块被烧焦的法杖碎片。
text.description: 上一次海加尔遭袭的时候，一名牛头人长老持有的强大法器遗失了，它被称为烈焰先知之杖。$B$B其碎片就散落在这片区域。找到它们，然后把它们交给玛法里奥。也许我们能用得上这神器的力量。
text.progress: Yes, $N?
text.completion: 'Excellent, $n.  This will be a great weapon against the enemy forces.'

english.title: The Flameseer's Staff
english.objectives: Obtain 8 Bone Staff Fragments.
english.description: A powerful artifact known as the Flameseer's Staff was lost during the initial onslaught by the enemy forces.  It was an ancient bone staff that granted its wielder power over the elements of fire.$B$BIts fragments litter the area around us.  Find them and bring them to Malfurion.  Perhaps the artifact's power will still be of use.
english.progress: Yes, $N?
english.completion: 'Excellent, $n.  This will be a great weapon against the enemy forces.'

text.title: 卡亚可乐
text.objectives: 将半打卡亚可乐带给科赞卡亚罗贸易公司总部的莎希·硬钳。
text.description: 莎希催我准备一些饮料，说今天晚些时候会有一场以你的名义举办的聚会。$B$B哎呀，那应该是个意外的惊喜才对。我可什么都没说！$B$B不过，最近几天产量下降很严重，我好不容易才备到这么多紧俏货。你能带给她吗？
text.progress: <Sassy eyes the six-pack warily, as if she expects it to explode as soon as you hand it to her.>$B$BWe need more Kaja'Cola than this!$B$BI swear I'm going to fire Dampwick if I don't kill him first!
text.completion: Just so you know, you'll find Kaja'Cola all over town. It's the Bilgewater Cartel's best-selling product of all time!$B$BJust remember, image is everything if we're going to get you promoted to Trade $g Prince : Princess;! No, wait, profits are everything! Explosions are a close second! Then, image!

english.objectives: Deliver the Six-Pack of Kaja'Cola to Sassy Hardwrench at KTC Headquarters on Kezan.
english.description: Sassy's been riding me to supply some Kaja'cola for the party that's being thrown in your honor later today.$B$BOops, was it supposed to be a surprise? You didn't hear it from me!$B$BAnywho, with production down these last few days, this is all that I managed to get made. Would you take it to her?

text.title: Once More, With Eeling [DEPRICATED]
text.objectives: Kill 15 of any Eel in the Kelp Forest.
text.description: Eels are among the creepiest of Azeroth's creatures.$b$bSure, there are those who pretend that they don't mind them - and others who actually claim to favor them.$b$bThey are lying.$b$bTruth be told, no one likes eels. Eels don't even like eels.$b$bAzeroth would be a better place if no one ever had to envision an eel slithering out from the murky depths and biting them.$b$bIn the face.
text.giverWindow: <...wretch.>

text.title: 寻找OOX-22/FE！
text.objectives: 把求救定位器带到深痕谷附近山洞中的奥格索普的母体机器人旁边。
text.description: 你发现了一个奇怪的蛋形金属物体。随便拨弄了几下之后，这个金属蛋居然活了，变成了一个看来是由侏儒制造的机器装置！一个奇怪的声音从这个蛋形机器装置中传了出来。$B$B“我的名字叫奥格索普，我的母体机器人不见了！如果你能帮我找到它，我就会奖励你的；请把这个定向器带到那个母体机器人那里！”$B$B“别担心，我现在已经检测到了它的所在地！它现在就位于深痕谷中的一个山洞里！”
text.progress: You appear to have uncovered the wreckage of... a robotic chicken?  The voice from within the egg crackles to life again:$B$B"Yes, excellent work!  This is indeed my homing robot, though my sensors indicate that it needs a jump start before it can fly back to Booty Bay for repairs.  Go ahead and place the beacon inside the rover - the beacon will take care of the rest!"
text.completion: You place the egg... distress beacon... inside the chicken... homing robot.$B$BHums and whirs are heard from inside the robot as it struggles to stand up.  After the robot comes to life, Oglethorpe's voice is heard once more, but now from inside the robot:$B$B"OOX-22/FE is working at least, but it needs major repairs!  It is much too heavy for you to carry it... but I think I have an idea.  Are you up for watching over it some more?"

english.title: Find OOX-22/FE!
english.objectives: Take the distress beacon to Oglethorpe's homing robot in a cave near Feral Scar Vale.
english.description: You have uncovered some sort of strange, egg-shaped device made from metal.  Fiddling with one of its knobs springs the egg to life, as it opens up into some sort of gnomish robotic contraption!  A voice from inside the robotic egg crackles to life.$B$B"My name's Oglethorpe Obnoticus, and my homing robot has crashed!  I will reward you for its recovery; please take this beacon to the robot!"$B$B"I now have computed the coordinates of the robot for you; it is in a cave near Feral Scar Vale!"
english.progress: You appear to have uncovered the wreckage of... a robotic chicken?  The voice from within the egg crackles to life again:$B$B"Yes, excellent work!  This is indeed my homing robot, though my sensors indicate that it needs a jump start before it can fly back to Booty Bay for repairs.  Go ahead and place the beacon inside the rover - the beacon will take care of the rest!"
english.completion: You place the egg... distress beacon... inside the chicken... homing robot.$B$BHums and whirs are heard from inside the robot as it struggles to stand up.  After the robot comes to life, Oglethorpe's voice is heard once more, but now from inside the robot:$B$B"OOX-22/FE is working at least, but it needs major repairs!  It is much too heavy for you to carry it... but I think I have an idea.  Are you up for watching over it some more?"

text.title: 拯救OOX-22/FE！
text.objectives: 安全护送OOX-22/FE到达目的地，然后向藏宝海湾的奥格索普·奥布诺提斯报告。
text.description: 那个侏儒的声音再次从那个机器人中传了出来：$B$B“我需要你帮忙把OOX-22/FE移动到一个安全的开阔地，这样它才可以启动起飞程序。它自带隐形系统，但是我需要一点时间来远程启动这个系统。请你把这个机器人从现在的位置护送到被遗忘的海岸去！那里是个非常理想的起飞点，有足够的空间作为机器人起飞的跑道！”$B$B“将它护送到那里，然后再到藏宝海湾来找我！奥格索普·奥布诺提斯——完毕！”
text.completed: 去荆棘谷，找藏宝海湾的奥格索普·奥布诺提斯。

english.title: Rescue OOX-22/FE!
english.objectives: Escort OOX-22/FE to safety, then report to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.
english.description: The gnome's voice crackles once again from the robot:$B$B"I need to move OOX-22/FE to an open, safe place so it can begin a lengthy take-off procedure.  It has built-in cloaking, but I need time on my end to make it operational again.  Escort the robot from its current location to, let's say, the main road!  That should be a perfect place, and long enough, to get things online!"$B$B"Escort it safely and then come talk to me in Booty Bay!  Oglethorpe Obnoticus - out!"
english.completed: Return to Oglethorpe Obnoticus at Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.

text.title: 迟到总比死掉好
text.objectives: 对一只斑点海龟使用莫安纳的催眠棒，然后骑着它返回莫安纳身边。
text.description: 你好，朋友。$b$b很高兴看到你活着回来了。$b$b在埃鲁纳克试图为我们寻找一个安全的去处的同时，我可以帮你获得一种不那么费劲的交通工具。$b$b我给你准备了一根催眠棒，去对一只海龟使用它。这上面并未施加什么魔法，但是它轻易就能让海龟听从你的指示。$b$b一旦你驯服了那只海兽，就骑着它回来见我吧。
text.progress: Were you able to tame a sea turtle, $n?
text.completion: How unfortunate...$b$bWell, all things considered, it is good to see that you made it back unharmed.

english.title: Better Late Than Dead
english.objectives: Use Moanah's Baitstick on a Speckled Sea Turtle and ride it back to her.
english.description: Greetings, friend.$b$bIt is good to see that you survived your battle in one piece.$b$bWhile Erunak tries to scry a place of safety for us all, I shall assist you in securing a less strenuous means of transport.$b$bI have prepared this baitstick to use near a sea turtle. It is crude, but it should serve to bring one under your control.$b$bOnce you've become comfortable with the animal, simply guide it back here to me.
english.progress: Were you able to tame a sea turtle, $n?
english.completion: How unfortunate...$b$bWell, all things considered, it is good to see that you made it back unharmed.

text.title: 前往西岸峰
text.objectives: 向德斯利克·希维格拉借一头驭风者，然后同菲拉斯西岸峰的卡纳提·灰云交谈。
text.description: 为了千针石林众生，我们在西岸峰展开了救灾工作。地精德斯利克·希维格拉会把我的驭风者借给你，让你安全抵达。着陆后和卡纳提·灰云交谈。$B$B人命关天，你要赶快出发！

english.title: To the Summit
english.objectives: Borrow a wind rider from Dyslix Silvergrub and speak with Kanati Greycloud at Westreach Summit in Thousand Needles.
english.description: We are staging a relief effort at Westreach Summit for all of Thousand Needles. The goblin, Dyslix Silvergrub, will lend you my wind rider to safely get you there. Speak with Kanati Greycloud when you land.$B$BYou must go quickly if lives are to be saved!

text.title: 前往新萨兰纳尔
text.objectives: 向德斯利克·希维格拉借一头角鹰兽，然后同菲拉斯新萨兰纳尔的卡莉希娅·狩月交谈。
text.description: 为了千针石林众生，我们在新萨兰纳尔展开了救灾工作。地精德斯利克·希维格拉会把我的角鹰兽借给你，让你安全抵达。着陆后和卡莉希娅·狩月交谈。$B$B人命关天，你要赶快出发！

english.title: To New Thalanaar
english.objectives: Borrow a hippogryph from Dyslix Silvergrub and speak with Caryssia Moonhunter at New Thalanaar in Feralas.
english.description: We are staging a relief effort at New Thalanaar for all of Thousand Needles. The goblin, Dyslix Silvergrub, will lend you my hippogryph to safely get you there. Speak with Caryssia Moonhunter when you land.$B$BYou must go quickly if lives are to be saved!

objectiveDetails.description: 乘角鹰兽前往新萨兰纳尔

text.title: Dance Of De Spirits
text.objectives: Talk to Witch Doctor Hez'tok near the circle of ritual dancers outside Sen'jin Village when you're ready to consult the omens.
text.description: De time has come to start thinkin' about when to make our move. Champion Uru'zin tells me his men be ready. You and Vanira done good work gatherin' information on de enemy and findin' us new allies.$B$BNow, we read de omens. We find out when to launch de attack.$B$BFind Witch Doctor Hez'tok near the circle of ritual dancers. He be startin' de ritual as soon as ya be ready.
text.completion: I will take de spirits' advice to heart. Wit' dem behind us and de power of de ancient loas of de Darkspear Tribe, we be ready to reclaim what's ours!

text.objectives: 向塞亚娜·夜灵借一头角鹰兽，然后同菲拉斯新萨兰纳尔的卡莉希娅·狩月交谈。
text.description: 为了千针石林众生，我们在新萨兰纳尔展开了救灾工作。塞亚娜·夜灵会把我的角鹰兽借给你，让你安全抵达。着陆后和卡莉希娅·狩月交谈。$B$B人命关天，你要赶快出发！
text.completion: Falfindel Waywarder sent you? Good! We need your help, now!

text.title: 地下城世界事件 - 无头骑士
地下城世界事件 - 科林·烈酒
地下城世界事件 - 埃霍恩
地下城世界事件 - 汉摩尔
恐怖图腾来了
text.objectives: 消灭7名恐怖图腾掠夺者。
text.description: 得花些时间，不过我们能把他们打回去。$B$B千针石林别的地方也需要你。我们有报告说遭淹的盐碱平原的侏儒和地精在一艘大驳船里避难！瑞恩多尔就在码头上，她能给你弄艘去那儿的小船。$B$B你去的路上介意帮我们一个忙吗？
text.completion: A boat? Yes, you can have this last one.

english.title: The Grimtotem are Coming
english.objectives: Slay 7 Grimtotem Marauders.
english.description: This is going to take a while, but I'm sure we'll beat them back.$B$BYou're more good to Thousand Needles elsewhere. We have reports that the gnomes and goblins out on the flooded salt flats somehow survived on a giant barge! Rendow is on the dock. She'll get you a boat to go there.$B$BMind helping us out a little on your way to her?
english.completion: A boat? Yes, you can have this last one.

text.title: 恐怖图腾来了
text.objectives: 消灭7名恐怖图腾抢劫者。
text.description: 成群的恐怖图腾趁我们最为薄弱的时候出其不意地打了过来。$B$B千针石林别的地方也需要你，$c。我们听说侏儒和地精都在盐碱平原的一艘大驳船里幸存下来了。$B$B莫特加·火鬃就在基地里，他能给你弄艘去那儿的独木舟。$B$B你去的路上介意帮我们忙消灭掉恐怖图腾吗？

english.title: The Grimtotem are Coming
english.objectives: Slay 7 Grimtotem Pillagers.
english.description: The cowardly Grimtotem have attacked us by surprise when we were least prepared!$B$BYou will be of most help to Thousand Needles elsewhere, $c. We have heard rumors that the goblins and gnomes somehow survived in a giant barge out on the salt flats.$B$BMotega Firemane is at the base of the summit. He can get you a canoe to take you there.$B$BDo you mind helping us fight off the Grimtotem on your way to him?

text.title: 有船在事半功倍
text.objectives: 同千针石林菲兹尔和普兹克的赛艇平台上的菲兹尔·铜栓交谈。
text.description: 你准备好了吗，$c？我们的一个哨兵会带你去沙漠赛道。$B$B假如那儿还有人活着，救救他们。$B$B愿女神庇佑你！

english.title: Two If By Boat
english.objectives: Speak with Fizzle Brassbolts at Fizzle & Pozzik's Speedbarge in Thousand Needles.
english.description: Are you ready to go, $c? One of the sentinels will take you out to the Mirage Raceway.$B$BIf there's anyone left alive out there, please help them.$B$BGoddess watch over you!

text.title: 有船在事半功倍
text.objectives: 同千针石林菲兹尔和普兹克的赛艇平台上的普兹克交谈。
text.description: 你准备好了吗，$c？$B$B我们的一个勇士会带你去沙漠赛道。假如那儿还有人活着，他们就一定急需你的救援。$B$B愿大地母亲庇佑你！

english.title: Two If By Boat
english.objectives: Speak with Pozzik at Fizzle & Pozzik's Speedbarge in Thousand Needles.
english.description: Are you ready to go, $c?$B$BOne of our braves will row you out to the Mirage Raceway. If anyone has survived out there, they'll desperately need your help.$B$BMay the Earth Mother smile upon you.

text.title: 杀出一条灰路
text.objectives: 杀死8名灼炎使者。
text.description: $n，暮光之锤的恶魔打算将整座山脉的生命统统消灭。即使是现在，他们也在炼狱火海后头散播着死亡与灰烬。$B$B大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾在火海里，试图在这片荒野被彻底从地图上抹去之前拯救它。请朝东南方走，穿过炼狱火海，沿着道路继续向前。找到并尽可能援助他。$B$B路上你可以顺便把遇到的灼炎使者都干掉。
text.completion: Very good. The Twilight's Hammer must be sent the message that we will never give up.

english.title: Smashing Through Ashes
english.objectives: Slay 8 Charbringers.
english.description: $n, these fiends from the Twilight's Hammer are attempting to scourge this whole mountain clean of all life. Even now they trail behind this inferno, leaving death and ash in their wake.$B$BArch Druid Hamuul Runetotem is behind the fires, trying to salvage the wilderness before it's blotted permanently from the map. Travel southeast, through The Inferno and down the road beyond. Find and aid the Arch Druid.$B$BOn your way there, clear the roads by killing any Charbringers that you find.
english.completion: Very good. The Twilight's Hammer must be sent the message that we will never give up.

enders.name: 大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾

text.title: 顽强的生命
text.objectives: 从焦黑的土壤中收集10株海加尔幼苗。
text.description: 这片土地一直在受到火焰的蹂躏，但它仍在自我修复。$B$B烈焰之痕土壤深处的某些种子，或许能从灼热的火海中存活下来。这些生命力顽强的植物是森林复苏的关键。请帮我搜集一些这样的幼苗吧。
text.progress: I suspect life still struggles beneath the ash. What were you able to find?
text.completion: '<The Arch Druid inspects the seedlings.>$B$BThese seedlings have survived an apocalypse. Even a handful hold great power. Life always replenishes itself, often stronger than before.$B$BOnce the way is clear, we will use these to perform a miracle on this mountain, $n. You will see.'

english.title: Durable Seeds
english.objectives: Gather 10 Hyjal Seedlings from piles of Scorched Soil.
english.description: This land has been scourged by fire, but it may yet renew itself.$B$BSome seeds deep in the soil may have withstood the scorching heat here in The Flamewake. These durable plants are the key to this forest's regrowth. Please, collect some of these seedlings for me.
english.progress: I suspect life still struggles beneath the ash. What were you able to find?
english.completion: '<The Arch Druid inspects the seedlings.>$B$BThese seedlings have survived an apocalypse. Even a handful hold great power. Life always replenishes itself, often stronger than before.$B$BOnce the way is clear, we will use these to perform a miracle on this mountain, $n. You will see.'

starters.name: 大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾

enders.name: 大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾

text.title: 防火道
text.objectives: 消灭10个熔岩奔腾者。
text.description: 暮光之锤在侵略海加尔山的过程中，途经这片化为焦土的大地时，还要斩草除根。$B$B他们在焚毁大地，把灰烬里还存活的植物全都消灭掉。好像它们在为谁铺路……我不想再想下去了。$B$B别让它们把海加尔变成一座不毛之山。消灭那些熔岩奔腾者！
text.completion: 'Good work, $n. There''s a chance the forest will recover from this yet.$B$BNow, there''s something else I need you to take care of for me...'

english.title: Firebreak
english.objectives: Slay 10 Lava Surgers.
english.description: In their efforts to decimate Hyjal, Twilight's Hammer has elementals scouring the earth in the wake of the fire.$B$BThey're pulverizing the soil, rooting around in the ash, digging up any scrap of plantlife that survived and destroying it. It's like they're paving the way for... I don't even want to imagine.$B$BStop them before Hyjal is devoid of life. Kill the lava surgers!
english.completion: 'Good work, $n. There''s a chance the forest will recover from this yet.$B$BNow, there''s something else I need you to take care of for me...'

text.title: 活饵
text.objectives: 获得4堆熔火恶犬的内脏。
text.description: 我得知暮光之锤找到——并且监禁了伟大的上古龟神托尔托拉后大吃一惊。他被锁在暗灰湖混浊的湖水里。$B$B要解除托尔托拉的枷锁并不容易，但我们会慢慢来。$B$B到烈焰之痕去给我收集一些熔火恶犬的内脏来。至于干什么用，我过一阵子再解释。$B$B在那里要当心篡神者涅墨西斯！总有一天我们会对付他，但现在还不行。
text.progress: Have you collected the innards?$B$BCore hounds are not native to this part of the world, they accompanied Twilight's Hammer from the nether regions of the earth. Do not trouble yourself over their elimination.
text.completion: Very good. We will need these to act as bait while they are still warm.$B$BHere is my plan...

english.title: Fresh Bait
english.objectives: Collect 4 heaps of Core Hound Entrails.
english.description: I was stunned to discover that Twilight's Hammer had located - and imprisoned - the great turtle ancient Tortolla. As we speak he is chained above the murky waters of the Ashen Lake.$B$BFreeing Tortolla from his bonds will not be easy. But we will take it one step at a time.$B$BHead into the Flamewake and collect for me heaps of core hound entrails. I will explain why later.$B$BAnd beware of Nemesis the Usurper while you are there! His time will come, but we are not yet prepared.

text.title: 冠军项圈
text.objectives: 从脊鳞蜥蜴女王身上获得带刺的蜥蜴皮。
text.description: 这小家伙真够凶的，不是吗？$B$B不过没有一条漂亮的尖刺项圈的话，他还算不上是斗犬。$B$B石化蜥蜴女王在通向冬泉谷的路边筑巢，把她带刺的皮给我带来，咱们好给这位小杀手制作一条时髦的项圈。
text.progress: Did you get it?

english.title: A Champion's Collar
english.objectives: Obtain the Spiked Basilisk Hide from the Spinescale Matriarch.
english.description: This little guy is a true menace now, isn't he?$B$BWe're going to have to give him a nice spiked collar if he's going to be a fighting pup.$B$BThe basilisk matriarch has made her lair off of the road to Winterspring.  Bring me her spiked hide and we'll fashion a collar for our little killer here.
english.progress: Did you get it?

text.title: 战争准备
text.objectives: 同管理员曼雷克交谈，乘蝙蝠飞到集结地去。在战争营地东边的岛屿上与沃金会面。
text.description: 沃金正在指挥他的战士们为战斗进行准备。他要我转告你，去东边的那座岛上去找他和瓦妮拉。$B$B他和战士们就要向扎拉赞恩发动进攻了。$n，愿祖先之灵与你同在。如果没有你，这场战役对我们来说将只不过是一场泡影。同南边的管理员曼雷克谈一谈，他会给你一只蝙蝠，载你飞到部队的集结地去。
text.completion: At last, everythin' be ready. Now, we show Zalazane what happen to dose who defy de Darkspears!

english.title: Preparin' For Battle
english.objectives: Speak to Handler Marnlek for a flight to the staging area. Meet Vol'jin on the island east of the war camp.
english.description: Vol'jin be gatherin' his gear and readyin' de warriors. He ask me to tell ya to meet with him an' Vanira on de island to de east.$B$BFrom dere, he and de warriors will launch de attack on Zalazane. May de ancestors go wit' you, $n. Without ya, dis campaign would only be a shadow of what it become. Speak to Handler Marnlek, just to de south, an' he give you a bat to fly out to de stagin' area.
english.completion: At last, everythin' be ready. Now, we show Zalazane what happen to dose who defy de Darkspears!

text.title: 嫌隙之赛
text.objectives: 挑战海加尔山天选者之座的格罗姆克。
text.description: 我不知道你是不是已经觉察到了，暮光之锤的食人魔成员和我们其余的人有点不是很愉快。$B$B按我说……这事儿属于私人恩怨。$B$B那个叫做格罗姆克的食人魔有条宠物迅猛龙“屠夫”。他把我之前的三条熔火幼犬都干掉了。$B$B我觉得这最后一条有点不一般，他骨子里是个真正的杀手。$B$B到天选者之座挑战格罗姆克，让我们的两条畜牲斗一斗。替我给他点难堪，$n·丹玛斯。

english.title: Grudge Match
english.objectives: Challenge Gromm'ko at the Seat of the Chosen in Hyjal.
english.description: I don't know if you've picked up on this, but there's a bit of a rivalry between the ogre members of the Twilight's Hammer and the rest of us.$B$BFor me... it's personal.$B$BThis one ogre called Gromm'ko has a pet raptor named "Butcher."  He's taken out the last three of my corehound pups.$B$BI think this last one will fare differently.  He's got a real killer's instinct.$B$BGo to the Seat of the Chosen and challenge Gromm'ko to a match between our two beasts.  Humiliate him for me, $ndamus.

text.title: Back in the Saddle
text.objectives: Use 6 Turtle Meat to create shark bait.
text.description: Our situation is growing a bit desperate, $r.$b$bWe must focus our attention on the naga and their prisoners, but it would be folly to do so without being prepared, and down here that means finding a way to travel more quickly.$b$bThese sharks are clearly fond of sea turtle. Let's see if we can turn that into our advantage.

Let's see if we can turn that into our advantage.

text.title: Shark Bait
text.objectives: Use the Shark Bait at the Sunken Anchor and ride the shark to Erunak.
text.description: <Erunak speaks as he places the turtle meat into a porous sack.>$b$bReady yourself, $n. There's no telling how this might end up, but we don't have much choice if we are to rescue your friends.$b$bTake this sack and use it at the sunken anchor southeast of here. Once you've attracted a shark, do your best to ride it back to me here.$b$bIf you can do that, you will have a most intimidating means of transportation.
text.completed: Speak with Erunak at Shallow's End.

text.title: 敏捷训练：没命地跑啊！
text.objectives: 1分钟内别叫哀求熔炉的炽焰训练师抓住。
text.description: 咱们继续之前，得让你活络一下身子骨。$B$B翡翠巨龙在你后面追得你抱头鼠窜的时候，对上古众神的虔诚并不能救你的小命。你得学会脚底抹油，假如你懂我的意思。$B$B废话少说。我们这就召你的训练师来……你的任务就是在这个营地里别让他撵上。$B$B开始！

english.title: Agility Training: Run Like Hell!
english.objectives: Run away from the Blazing Trainer within the Forge of Supplication for 1 minute.
english.description: Before we go any further, we're going to have to get you into shape.$B$BDevotion to the Old Gods is not going to save you when some emerald dragon comes chasing after you.  You need to be fleet of foot, if you catch my drift.$B$BEnough said.  We'll summon your trainer... your job is to run away from him without leaving this camp.$B$BGo!

text.title: Words for Delivery
text.objectives: Give the speech to Captain Tread Sparknozzle at Steelgrill Depot.
text.description: Here we go.  This is the speech, $n!$B$BIt has everything to be a great battle starter: It's inspirational, has eloquent language and speaks directly to gnomes.  Never has a finer speech been written!$B$BTurn this in to Captain Tread Sparknozzle and see if there's anything else he needs of you.
text.completion: This is the speech from Toby? Fantastic!$bRecruit, you've done all we could possibly ask for and the Gnomeregan Army thanks you!$bWe've got a strike team heading to Gnomeregan now and that wouldn't have been possible without your assistance. For all of your help, we'd like you to join the Gnomeregan Reserves!$bIt doesn't pay very well, but you do get this snazzy helmet. Hang on to that, you might need it someday!

text.title: Poaching for Dummies
text.objectives: Use the Butcherbot on the corpse of 20 Glasshide Basilisks, Scorpid Tail Lashers, or Blisterpaw Hyenas.
text.description: A new face around here, huh? You're in luck, making coin's easy thanks to my butcherbots. You go out and hunt some scorpids, some hyenas, maybe a few basilisks, set the butcherbot down, and let him do his thing! I've programmed him to extract all the valuable parts and place it safely in his hopper.$B$BIf you're interested, take him out to the northwest near Sandsorrow Watch first. Just bring him back once he's full and I'll pay you for the contents.
text.completed: Return to Driz Plunkbow at Gadgetzan in Feralas.
