text.title: 准备土壤
text.objectives: 激活并保护防火结界。
text.description: 大德鲁伊派我在这一地区周边设立防火结界。一旦激活，就可以防止那些将山谷焚为废墟的火元素再度进犯。$B$B它们同时也能保护并滋养哈缪尔预备下的土壤。$B$B可以开始了。我在地图上标出了五处防火结界，找一处开启，保护它直到魔法奏效为止。也就要不了一分钟吧。
text.completion: That's good! Between your work and the work of a few others, that valley is secure from a counter-attack.$B$BI've done all I can. It's all up to you and the Arch Druid now.

english.title: Prepping the Soil
english.objectives: Activate and defend a Flameward.
english.description: The Arch Druid has tasked me with setting up a series of flamewards around the perimeter of the area. Once these are active, we can prevent further attacks from the fire elementals that left this valley in ruins.$B$BThese will also protect and nourish the soil for whatever Hamuul has planned.$B$BIt's time to begin. Find one of the five flamewards I've marked on your map, activate it, and defend it from counterattack until its magic kicks in. It won't take more than a minute.
english.completion: That's good! Between your work and the work of a few others, that valley is secure from a counter-attack.$B$BI've done all I can. It's all up to you and the Arch Druid now.

text.title: 黑鳍的赃物
text.objectives: 杀死黑鳍，取回吉布林格的地图。
text.description: <在最新日志的前一张破损书页上写着：>$b$b我们那个自封为王的家伙会用尽各种手段来窃取我们家族的财宝。他对我进行着无休无止的折磨和威胁。$b$b我受够了！$b$b我已经将宝藏埋了起来，并将藏宝图喂给了黑鳍吃。$b$b如此一来，我那表亲的脏手就永远也别想碰到我们宝贵的传家宝！

english.title: Blackfin's Booty
english.objectives: You must slay the orca, Blackfin, to retrieve Gilblingle's Map.
english.description: <A torn page precedes the latest entry, which reads:>$b$bOur self-proclaimed king will stop at nothing to acquire my family fortune. He has threatened and harassed me to no end.$b$bI can't take it anymore!$b$bI've buried the treasure and fed the map to Blackfin.$b$bThat should keep my cousin's grubby little mitts off of our precious heirlooms!

text.title: 帮个忙呗？
text.objectives: 将部件清单送给千针石林菲兹尔和普兹克的赛艇平台上的金克·铁钩。
text.description: 你好，很高兴遇见你！我叫菲兹尔·铜栓，欢迎来到我的赛艇平台。$B$B我同你一样想要帮助千针石林的人们，我坚信赛艇平台是整个地区最大的希望。$B$B也许你能帮我们一个小忙？我保证你会获得所需要的一切装备以应万变。$B$B至于这点，要是你能把这张部件清单送到金克·铁钩的店里，你就可以上路了。

english.title: Do Me a Favor?
english.objectives: Deliver the List of Parts to Jinky Twizzlefixxit at Fizzle & Pozzik's Speedbarge in Thousand Needles.
english.description: Hello there. Pleased to meet you! I'm Fizzle Brassbolts. Welcome to my Speedbarge.$B$BI share your concerns about helping all of Thousand Needles. It's my firm belief that the Speedbarge is the best hope for the entire region.$B$BPerhaps you could help us out a little bit here? I'll make sure that you're equipped with what you need to tackle everything else.$B$BAs to that, if you could just run this list of parts over to Jinky Twizzlefixxit in her shop, you'll be well on your way.

text.title: 帮个忙呗？
text.objectives: 将部件清单送给千针石林菲兹尔和普兹克的赛艇平台的拉泽瑞克。
text.description: 你好，$n。我叫普兹克，举世闻名的火箭车驾驶员。欢迎来到我的赛艇平台。$B$B我同你一样想要帮助千针石林的人们，我坚信赛艇平台是整个地区最大的希望。$B$B也许你能帮我们一个小忙？我保证你会获得所需要的一切装备以应万变。$B$B至于这点，要是你能把这张部件清单送到拉泽瑞克的店里，你就可以上路了。
text.progress: Is that my list of parts from Pozzik?

english.title: Do Me a Favor?
english.objectives: Deliver the List of Parts to Razzeric at Fizzle & Pozzik's Speedbarge in Thousand Needles.
english.description: Hey there, $n. I'm Pozzik, world-renowned rocket car pilot. Welcome to my Speedbarge.$B$BI share your concerns about helping all of Thousand Needles. It's my firm belief that the Speedbarge is the best hope for the entire region.$B$BPerhaps you could help us out a little bit here? I'll make sure that you're equipped with what you need to tackle everything else.$B$BAs to that, if you could just run this list of parts over to Razzeric in his shop, you'll be well on your way.
english.progress: Is that my list of parts from Pozzik?

text.title: Sea-Food Chain
text.objectives: Find a Puffer Hatchling in Gnaws' Boneyard and bring it to the Abyss near the Holding Pens.
text.description: Our time here draws to a close.$b$bI must find my way across the chasm and discover the purpose behind the naga activities here.$b$bIf you are to follow me, you would be wise to conclude your search for a suitable mount first.$b$bSearch the area north of here and find a puffer hatchling. Once you've caught one, bring it to the trench to the west. I will prepare everything you need there.

Once you've caught one, bring it to the trench to the west. I will prepare everything you need there.

text.title: 地狱甲壳
text.objectives: 使用一堆熔火恶犬的内脏吸引涅墨西斯，获取一块涅墨西斯龟壳碎片。
text.description: 这些新鲜的恶臭内脏对暮光之锤一手打造的那个邪恶龟神涅墨西斯来说，就是无法抗拒的美味。$B$B涅墨西斯始终是要被消灭的，但首先，我们得弄到一块他的烈焰甲壳。有了它，我们就能施法救出真正的古神。$B$B到烈焰之痕把饵撒在涅墨西斯附近，趁他分心时撬一块壳下来……然后如果你还想活下来的话，就快跑。
text.progress: Nemesis is a molten ball of fury protected by a stony shell of pure hatred.$B$BHis time will come.
text.completion: <The Arch Druid takes the shell from you with surprising reverence.>$B$BNemesis is an instrument of evil, but he was forged from a shell fragment of the true ancient.$B$BWe will exploit this connection.

english.title: Hell's Shells
english.objectives: Use the Heap of Core Hound Innards near Nemesis to distract him. Collect a Nemesis Shell Fragment.
english.description: Fresh and stinking, these innards will prove to be irresistible for Nemesis, the befouled turtle god created by Twilight's Hammer.$B$BNemesis must eventually be destroyed, but first, we must collect a piece of his fiery armored shell. With it, we'll be able to work some magic to free the true ancient.$B$BGo into the Flamewake and drop this bait near Nemesis. It will distract him. Pry off a piece of his shell... then run, if you hope to survive the encounter.
english.progress: Nemesis is a molten ball of fury protected by a stony shell of pure hatred.$B$BHis time will come.
english.completion: <The Arch Druid takes the shell from you with surprising reverence.>$B$BNemesis is an instrument of evil, but he was forged from a shell fragment of the true ancient.$B$BWe will exploit this connection.

text.title: A Brilliant Idea
text.description: I have a brilliant idea!$B$BLets stop the playthrough here.  There's not much more to see at the moment anyway.$B$BThanks for helping!

english.description: I have a brilliant idea!$B$BLets stop the playthrough here.  There's not much more to see at the moment anyway.$B$BThanks for helping!

text.title: 体能训练：强制劳动
text.objectives: 挖开5处暗语磁石矿。
text.description: 晋升训练可不是什么好差事。为什么它必须是好差事呢？$B$B侍奉上古众神的道路漫长、痛苦，灵魂备受折磨。就当这是你的第一步吧。$B$B带上这把镐，去挖峡谷里的磁石矿。$B$B不，我们不需要任何矿石。这纯粹是为了你好。

english.title: Physical Training: Forced Labor
english.objectives: Break 5 Darkwhisper Lodestones.
english.description: Training to join our ranks is not pleasant.  Why should it be?$B$BThe path to serve the Old Gods is long, painful, and soul-harrowing.  Consider this your first step.$B$BTake this pick and break the lodestone deposits found in the gorge.$B$BNo, we don't need any of the ore.  This is purely for your benefit.

text.title: 托尔托拉有话说
text.objectives: 去找海加尔山暗灰湖的上古龟神托尔托拉。
text.description: <大德鲁伊用龟壳碎片舀起一捧水，水立刻沸腾了。他往里面加了一束药草，开始无声地祈祷。>$B$B$n，上古龟神托尔托拉长生不老，从自泰坦时代起就是这个世界的一部分。他所说的语言比我们所知的还要古老。$B$B喝下这个，凝神静气。你将可以理解托尔托拉的语言。现在去暗灰湖找他，获取古神的信任。海加尔的命运就在此一举了。
text.completion: $R.$B$BThis tongue. Is not yours.$B$BWhat do you want ... tormentor?
text.completed: 去找海加尔山暗灰湖的上古龟神托尔托拉。

english.title: Tortolla Speaks
english.objectives: Go to Tortolla, the turtle ancient, at the Ashen Lake in Mount Hyjal.
english.description: <The Arch Druid fills the shell fragment with water, which boils instantly. He adds a bundle of herbs and closes his eyes in a silent prayer.>$B$B$n, Tortolla the turtle ancient is ageless, a part of this world since the time of the titans. He speaks a language older than our understanding.$B$BDrink this and find a place of calm within yourself. You will be able to understand the language of Tortolla. Go to him now, in the Ashen Lake. Earn the ancient's trust. The fate of Hyjal hinges on this.
english.completion: $R.$B$BThis tongue. Is not yours.$B$BWhat do you want ... tormentor?
english.completed: Go to Tortolla, the turtle ancient, at the Ashen Lake in Mount Hyjal.

starters.name: 大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾

text.title: 雷霆斗技场：宿敌战！
text.objectives: 击败梅格斯·碎纸机。
text.description: 看来我们有个特别的请求！我收到一张来自凯尔希·钢烁的信件，要求进入笼子解决一场纠纷。$B$B她指名你作她的对手，$n。是你之前赢得的拥趸吗？还是你在擂台外面找的？$B$B假如我是你，我就不会怯场。这是决赛了……
text.completed: 去塔纳利斯，找加基森的卡崔娜·特纳尔。

english.title: Thunderdrome: Grudge Match!
english.objectives: Defeat Megs Dreadshredder.
english.description: It seems we have a special request! I have here a note from one Kelsey Steelspark, requesting to enter the cage and settle a dispute.$B$BShe's asked for you to be her partner, $n. A fan of your previous victories? Or perhaps you're acquainted outside the ring?$B$BI wouldn't back down now if I were you. This is the grand finale...
english.completed: Return to Katrina Turner at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

text.title: 打破枷锁
text.objectives: 破坏束缚托尔托拉的两根镇压之棒。
text.description: 来自深处……$B是一个黑暗与火焰的国度。$B在我熟睡时。$B$B将我困住，$r。$B$B阴暗潜伏在我身边的棒子之中。$B除掉它们。$B我才能再度获得自由。
text.completion: <Tortolla quivers and shakes debris free from his great back.>$B$BYou...$BAre not like the others.$B$BI am free once again.$B$BThe others...$BWill pay.

english.title: Breaking the Bonds
english.objectives: Disable the two Rods of Subjugation that bind Tortolla.
english.description: From the deep...$BA realm of darkness and fire.$BGrasping in my slumber.$B$BI am ensnared, $r.$B$BShadows lurk in the rods of fire beside me.$BSlay them.$BThat I may be free again.
english.completion: <Tortolla quivers and shakes debris free from his great back.>$B$BYou...$BAre not like the others.$B$BI am free once again.$B$BThe others...$BWill pay.

text.title: 深水以下
text.objectives: 收集10个火箭车零件。
text.description: <金克卷起袖子，把头发拢起来，上下打量着你。>$B$B好吧，要是菲兹尔想让你有自己的小舟，这头一桩事就是部件。猜猜看谁要去跑这趟腿？$B$B<金克一边笑着一边指着水下，顺手给你拿了套富裕的潜水头盔和脚蹼。>$B$B没错，$g兄弟:姐妹;。你得下到深水里，把在赛道废墟里找到的火箭车部件打捞上来。

english.title: Down in the Deeps
english.objectives: Collect 10 Rocket Car Parts.
english.description: <Jinky rolls up her sleeves and slicks back her hair while eyeing you up and down.>$B$BFine, if Fizzle wants you to have your own boat, the first thing we'll need is parts. Guess who gets to go get them?$B$B<Jinky smiles as she points downward and then grabs you a spare diving helm and flippers.>$B$BThat's right, $g brother : sister;. You get to go down into the deeps and salvage what rocket car parts you can find at the Raceway Ruins.

text.title: 深水以下
text.objectives: 收集10个火箭车零件。
text.description: 好吧，朋友，要是普兹克想让你有自己的小舟，这头一桩事就是部件。猜猜看谁要去跑这趟腿？$B$B<拉泽瑞克一边笑着一边指着水下，顺手给你拿了套富裕的潜水头盔和脚蹼。>$B$B恐怕就是这样，$n。你得下到深水里，把在赛道废墟里找到的火箭车部件打捞上来。
text.progress: We can get started as soon as you get everything that's on the list.

english.title: Down in the Deeps
english.objectives: Collect 10 Rocket Car Parts.
english.description: Well, friend, if Pozzik wants you to have your own boat, the first thing we're going to need is parts. Now guess who gets to go get them?$B$B<Razzeric smiles as he points downward and then grabs you a spare diving helm and flippers.>$B$BI'm afraid so, $n. You get to go down into the deeps and salvage what rocket car parts you can find at the Raceway Ruins.
english.progress: We can get started as soon as you get everything that's on the list.

text.title: 酒吧斗殴！
text.objectives: 挑起酒吧斗殴！
text.description: 那些不干好事、臭气烘烘、青面绿腮的地精是自找的！$B$B我要你到高速驳船酒吧里去，点一瓶烈酒，砸一个地精头上！$B$B让他们知道我们可不会听任他们放肆，$n！

english.title: Bar Fight!
english.objectives: Start a bar fight!
english.description: Those no-good, smelly, green in the gills goblins have got it coming!$B$BI want you to go into the Speedbarge Bar, order a bottle of grog, and hit one over the head with it!$B$BShow them that we're not going to take any more of their insolence, $n!

text.title: 酒吧斗殴！
text.objectives: 挑起酒吧斗殴！
text.description: 那些酒量差劲、缺少礼数、爆不了炸的侏儒是自找的！$B$B我要你到高速驳船酒吧里去，点一瓶烈酒，砸一个侏儒头上！$B$B让他们知道我们可不会听任他们嚣张，$n！

english.title: Bar Fight!
english.objectives: Start a bar fight!
english.description: Those pint-sized, goober-looking, no-explosion gnomes have got it coming!$B$BI want you to go into the Speedbarge Bar, order a bottle of grog, and hit one over the head with it!$B$BShow them that we're not going to take any more of their arrogance, $n!

text.title: 托尔托拉之子
text.objectives: 消灭暗灰湖6名正在攻击托尔托拉的蛋的深渊腐蚀者。
text.description: 我的孩子们。$B他们躺在下面。$B淤泥和沙砾中。$B$B外来人腐化了它们。$B用黑暗渗透了它们的蛋壳。$B$B杀掉外来人。$B摧毁腐蚀者。$B救救它们……
text.completion: $R.$BYou are not like the others.$B$BBraver. Stronger.$BA part of this world...$B    and not the shadow that came before.$B$BThank you.

english.title: Children of Tortolla
english.objectives: Slay 6 Deep Corruptors attacking Tortolla's Eggs in the Ashen Lake.
english.description: My children.$BThey lie below.$BIn silt and sand.$B$BThe others corrupt them.$BDarken them within their shells.$B$BSlay the others.$BDestroy the corruptors.$BSave them...
english.completion: $R.$BYou are not like the others.$B$BBraver. Stronger.$BA part of this world...$B    and not the shadow that came before.$B$BThank you.

text.title: 远古半神的苏醒
text.objectives: 去找海加尔山玛洛恩庇护所的大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾。
text.description: 我浸在海加尔的治疗淤泥中。$B世界裂开时我正在沉睡。$B外来人抵达时我没有准备好。$B$B我现在准备好了，$r。$B$B孩子们和我都是。慢慢地愤怒。$B但我们的怒火将不可改变。$B$B告诉那些派你来的人，我们做好了战争的准备。$B$B外来人会从这座山里被赶出去。
text.completion: '$n!$B$BYou were able to earn the ancient''s trust?$B$BWonderful! We are one step closer to taking back this mountain...'
text.completed: 去海加尔，找玛洛恩庇护所的大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾。

english.title: An Ancient Awakens
english.objectives: Return to Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Hyjal.
english.description: I slumbered in the healing silt of Hyjal.$BI slept until the world broke open.$BWhen the others came, I was not ready.$B$BI am ready now, $r.$B$BMy children and I. Slow to anger.$BBut our wrath is final.$B$BTell those who sent you that we are prepared for war.$B$BThe others will be cast from the mountain.
english.completion: '$n!$B$BYou were able to earn the ancient''s trust?$B$BWonderful! We are one step closer to taking back this mountain...'
english.completed: Return to Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Hyjal.

enders.name: 大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾

text.title: 蝎叮虫咬
text.objectives: 从砂爪蝎虫身上收集6根砂爪之刺。
text.description: 你得帮帮我，一定得帮！切尔西和我出来想挣点钱，就卖点补给，正经生意。接下来我只知道她要死了！她烧得铁匠都嫌烫手，还不住地产生幻觉……$B$B她一定是被附近的蝎子给叮了！我亲眼看到的，很恶心。我得弄点剧毒腺体来做解药，但是我走不开！$B$B求求你，帮帮我！帮我把腺体弄来！
text.progress: Do you have them? Oh, please...
text.completion: Oh thank you, thank you! I know a bit of alchemy, I'm not totally useless. Here goes...

english.title: I'm With Scorpid
english.objectives: Collect 6 Duneclaw Stingers from Duneclaw Scorpids.
english.description: You gotta help me, you just gotta! Chelsea and I came out here to make a bit of money, just sell some supplies, legit work. Next thing I know she's on her deathbed! She's got a fever that'd shock a blacksmith, and she's hallucinating...$B$BShe must've been stung by the scorpids near here! I've seen it happen, it's not pretty. I gotta get some poison glands to make an antidote but I can't leave her side!$B$BPlease, help me! Get me those glands!
english.progress: Do you have them? Oh, please...
english.completion: Oh thank you, thank you! I know a bit of alchemy, I'm not totally useless. Here goes...

text.title: 硬霸蝎
text.objectives: 获得硬霸蝎的剧毒腺体。
text.description: 不！没起作用！我不知道该怎么办了，除非……$B$B哦，天哪，这比我想的还要糟！她一定是被潜伏在洞里的那只给叮了。我们来的头天晚上我就看见了。它的钳子跟地精一般大小，尾巴和大树一样高！我们在营火边低声地交头接耳……我们管它叫做……硬霸蝎！$B$B……嘿，你在笑什么？别笑了！这很严肃！切尔西命悬一线呢！求求你，我会给你报酬的……把硬霸蝎的剧毒腺体拿来就是！
text.progress: You're back! Do you have it?
text.completion: I can't believe it! You're amazing! Here, please, take your reward, take anything you want! I've gotta save Chelsea!
text.giverWindow: 卡利姆多这一侧最大的蝎子。

english.title: Gargantapid
english.objectives: Collect Gargantapid's Stinger.
english.description: No! It didn't work! I don't know what to do, unless...$B$BOh gosh, it's worse than I thought! She must've been stung by the one lurking in the cave. I saw it the first night we arrived. Claws the size of a goblin. A tail as tall as a tree! We shared hushed whispers of it around the campfire... we called it... GARGANTAPID!$B$B ...hey, are you laughing? Stop that! This is serious! Chelsea's life is on the line! Please, I'll make it worth your while...just bring me Gargantapid's poison gland!
english.progress: You're back! Do you have it?
english.completion: I can't believe it! You're amazing! Here, please, take your reward, take anything you want! I've gotta save Chelsea!
english.giverWindow: The biggest scorpid this side of Kalimdor.

text.title: 飞翔在火焰之地
text.objectives: 从法登身后的武器架上拿一把暮光火焰长枪并装备之。乘坐艾维娜的守护者，飞往下方的岩架上的守护之旗。按下“拍翼”按钮以控制你的坐骑扇动翅膀！
text.description: $n，我们的敌人正在利用火焰之地的洞穴准备发动进攻。我们要直捣他们的巢穴，搅他个天翻地覆。$B$B但是首先，你必须飞起来。在火焰之地飞行可跟外面的世界不太一样，主要是因为这里浓密而炙热的空气。你需要一些练习！$B$B从我背后的武器架上拿一把暮光火焰长枪，然后骑上一只艾维娜的守护者。练习一下飞行——记得扇动翅膀！到我放在岩架下面的旗子那里去转一转，然后回来。

english.title: Flight in the Firelands
english.objectives: Get and equip a Twilight Firelance using the rack behind Farden. Mount one of Aviana's Guardians and fly her to the Guardian Flag on the ledge below. Press the flap button to flap your mount's wings!
english.description: $n, our enemy is using this grotto in the Firelands to prepare an invasion. We're going to hit them hard right where they live.$B$BBut first, you'll need to get your wings. Flight in the Firelands does not work as it does in the outside world. Something about the dense, superheated air. You'll need some practice!$B$BGet a Twilight Firelance from the rack behind me, equip it, then mount one of Aviana's Guardians. Practice flying - flap your wings! Visit a flag placed on the ledge below and return.

text.title: 上厕所
text.objectives: 拿到海盗的撬棍，用它撬开被淹没的厕所的门。
text.description: 喂？喂！救命！$B$B我快没空气了！你得把我救出去！$B$B<里边传来了一阵喘息声。>$B$B那些南海寻宝人里肯定有人带着撬棍！

english.title: In the Outhouse
english.objectives: Obtain a Pirate's Crowbar and use it to pry open the Submerged Outhouse door.
english.description: Hello? Hello! HELP!$B$BI'm almost out of air! You have to get me out of here!$B$B<The voice inside gags.>$B$BOne of those Southsea treasure hunters has got to have a crowbar!

text.title: 第一波
text.objectives: 装备一把暮光火焰长枪，乘坐艾维娜的守护者出击。向10个暮光骑士进行冲撞以击落他们。按下“拍翼”按钮以控制你的坐骑扇动翅膀！
text.description: 他们来了，$n！暮光骑士驾着从火焰之地的硫磺池中出生的黑色秃鹰，向我们冲过来了。击败他们的唯一方法，就是升空迎战！$B$B再次起飞吧，$c，消灭他们。$B$B持着火焰长枪直接冲向敌人就可以干掉他们。$B$B去吧。飞翔吧，蠢货。飞翔吧！

english.title: Wave One
english.objectives: Equip a Twilight Firelance and fly Aviana's Guardian. Kill 10 Twilight Knight Riders by flying into them. Press the flap button to flap your mount's wings!
english.description: Here they come, $n! The Twilight Knight Riders, astride black buzzards birthed in the scorching sulfurous breeding pools of the Firelands. The only way to defeat them is from the sky!$B$BTake wing once more, $c, and slay them.$B$BRun into enemy riders with your lance to destroy them.$B$BGo forth. Fly, fool. Fly!

text.title: 上厕所
text.objectives: 拿到海盗的撬棍，用它撬开被淹没的厕所的门。
text.description: 喂？喂！救命！$B$B我快没空气了！你得把我救出去！$B$B<里边传来了一阵喘息声。>$B$B那些肮脏的南海寻宝人里肯定有人带着撬棍！

english.title: In the Outhouse
english.objectives: Obtain a Pirate's Crowbar and use it to pry open the Submerged Outhouse door.
english.description: Hello? Hello! HELP!$B$BI'm almost out of air! You have to get me out of here!$B$B<The voice inside gags.>$B$BOne of those filthy Southsea treasure hunters has got to have a crowbar!

text.title: 暮光暴动
text.objectives: 跟海加尔山索萨恩之门的加洛德·影歌谈一谈。
text.description: 感谢你能救我出来，趁这里还乱糟糟的，咱们赶紧出去。$B$B必须快点，不然邪教徒们会追上来的。$B$B安全逃出这个地方后我们再聊。

english.title: Twilight Riot
english.objectives: Speak to Jarod Shadowsong at the Gates of Sothann in Hyjal.
english.description: I thank you for freeing me.  Let us take advantage of the distraction you've created and get out of here.$B$BWe must hurry before the cultists catch on.$B$BMeet me again when we've left this place.

text.title: 海盗的精准度上升了
text.objectives: 从玛兹尔·螺钉那儿拿到赛艇，并用冰霜大炮扑灭15处大火。
text.description: 不知道你注意到没有，炮弹正在命中我们。我得说南海海盗的准头变好了……船着火啦！$B$B你现在有干活的小舟了。去跟玛兹尔·螺钉说话。他会把船给你的。$B$B然后去救火！

english.title: Pirate Accuracy Increasing
english.objectives: Get a River Boat from Mazzer Stripscrew and then use the Frost Cannon to extinguish 15 fires.
english.description: I don't know if you've noticed, but the cannonballs are hitting us. I'd say the Southsea pirates are getting more accurate... the ship is on fire!$B$BYou've got a river boat now. Go talk to Mazzer Stripscrew.$B$BPut those fires out!

objectiveDetails.description: 从玛兹尔那里得到小舟

text.title: 海盗的精准度上升了
text.objectives: 从格里兹纳克那儿拿到赛艇，并用冰霜大炮扑灭15处大火。
text.description: 啊，糟糕，$n，炮弹打中赛艇平台了。我得说南海海盗的准头变好了……船着火啦！$B$B你现在有干活的小舟了。去跟格里兹纳克说话。他会把船给你。$B$B然后去救火！

english.title: Pirate Accuracy Increasing
english.objectives: Get a River Boat from Griznak and then use the Frost Cannon to extinguish 15 fires.
english.description: Oh no, $n, the cannonballs are hitting the Speedbarge. I'd say the Southsea pirates are getting more accurate... the ship is on fire!$B$BYou've got a river boat now. Please, go speak with Griznak.$B$BExtinguish those fires!

objectiveDetails.description: 从格里兹纳克那里拿到小舟

text.title: 不听管教
text.objectives: 杀掉南海工头。
text.description: 你可能也看到了，停在北边的船只上炮火不停。看着侏儒们一头撞到炮弹上是有点意思，但我的卫兵们也没讨到好，而且这绝对是要浪费我的经费的。$B$B我要你穿越炮火，登上那艘船，杀掉指挥炮手的工头。其他船员多半都是一群乌合之众，只要他死了，我们就会没事的。

english.title: Going Off-Task
english.objectives: Kill the Southsea Taskmaster.
english.description: As you may have seen, the ship docked to the north has its cannons blazing. While it's pretty fun watching the gnomes run face-first into a hail of iron, my bruisers keep doing it too, and it's absolutely killing my overhead expenses.$B$BI'd like you to try and dance through the cannonfire, get on that ship, and kill the taskmaster leading the cannoneers. The rest of the crew is probably a bunch of spineless prats; once he's down, we should be good.

text.title: 强烈的饥饿感
text.objectives: 跟光渊峡谷的潜水大师伯明翰谈一谈。
text.description: 可怜的家伙们。他们饿坏了。$B$B我们有很多事情要操心，其中最重要的就是纳迦，但首先这儿有肚子还得喂。我不知道纳迦在贝壳里都给他们吃了什么，假如真的有吃的话，反正他们肯定是不成人形了。$B$B有些幸存者成功逃到了西北边的光渊峡谷。到那儿去帮帮他们。只要一点蚌肉，我们就能让这些幸存者恢复元气。

english.title: A Powerful Need To Eat
english.objectives: Speak to Divemaster Birmingham in Glimmerdeep Gorge.
english.description: Poor things. They're starving.$B$BWe've many matters to attend to, not the least of them the naga, but first we need to get some food in these bellies. I'm not sure what the naga fed them up in that shell, if anything, but they're definitely worse for the wear.$B$BQuite a few of the survivors have made their way into Glimmerdeep Gorge, to the northwest. Go join them and help out. With a bit of clam meat, we can get these survivors back on their feet.

text.title: 冷遇
text.objectives: 消灭10名光渊潮汐猎手。
text.description: 许多幸存者都来到光渊峡谷帮忙采蚌。我们收到报告说鱼人在下面展开了蓄意进攻。$B$B贝壳里有更多人回报，将军不得不在此坐镇，我很难说服他动用大军帮助潜水员们。要是你准备好了，我倒是可以让你帮上忙。$B$B你把情况控制住了再回来通知我。

english.title: Cold Welcome
english.objectives: Kill 10 Glimmerdeep Tidehunters.
english.description: Many of the survivors made their way down into Glimmerdeep Gorge to help with the clam diving. We've been receiving reports back of deliberate attacks from some kind of murlocs down there.$B$BThe Admiral has to stay here as more men report in from the shell, so I'm having trouble convincing him to get any significant muscle to help the divers. If you'd be up for it, I'm certain they could use your help.$B$BCome back and let me know if you get the situation under control.

text.title: 吸引力的艺术
text.objectives: 使用海葵化合萃取装置，在光渊峡谷围墙附近的红色海葵花上收集8份海葵化合物样本。
text.description: 我有一个主意。一个绝妙的主意！这些小丑模样的鱼同海葵形成了一种共生防御关系。排除了伪装成海葵的可能性后，我发现了一种吸引鱼的化学激素。$B$B我带了一台陀螺除热萃取器下来采集样本。用它萃取几只海葵的化学激素，把样本带给我进行快速合成与部署。$B$B快快前去！聪明才智等着你哪！

english.title: Art of Attraction
english.objectives: Use the Anemone Chemical Extraction Device to gather 8 Anemone Chemical Samples from the red anemones along the walls of Glimmerdeep Gorge.
english.description: I have an idea. A brilliant idea! Those clown-looking fish have developed a symbiotic defensive relationship with the anemones. Having dismissed anemone disguise plausibilities, I've uncovered the chemical attractor that lures the fish.$B$BI have a gyrocoptic thermascrub extractor that I've brought down to take samples. Use it to extract the chemical attractor from several of the anemones, then bring the samples back to me for rapid synthesis and deployment.$B$BGo with haste! Brilliance is waiting!

text.title: 涂味器
text.objectives: 对8名采蚌人使用海葵化合应用装置。
text.description: 要我自己说，真是不得了的发明。准备部署。$B$B只要给采蚌人喷上一点化合物，他们不久就会多一名水下保镖陪伴。要是你愿意，你甚至也可以给自己涂一点儿以达到同样的效果。$B$B说道愿意，我强烈建议你把化学激素的剂量控制在最小适用范围。大剂量会导致意愿之外的效果……$B$B对你来说是意愿之外。对于鱼说可是再好不过了。$B$B去吧！

english.title: Odor Coater
english.objectives: Apply the Anemone Chemical Application Device to 8 Clam Divers.
english.description: Marvelous creation if I do say so myself. Ready for deployment.$B$BSimply spray the clam divers with a bit of the chemical and they shall soon be accompanied by a protective aquatic companion. You can even spray yourself to similar effect if you so desire.$B$BSpeaking of desire, I would highly recommend that you moderate deployment of the chemical attractor to minimal applications. Large doses could result in undesirable effects...$B$BUndesirable for you anyway. Likely very desirable for the fish.$B$BAway!

text.title: 少说多捞
text.objectives: 收集16扇光渊蚌。
text.description: 来帮忙捞蚌的？$B$B去吧。底下全是蚌壳就等着捞呢。

english.title: Clamming Up
english.objectives: Gather 16 Glimmerdeep Clams.
english.description: Here to help with the clam diving?$B$BGet to it then. There are clams about everywhere just waiting to be dived.

text.title: 肚子空着
text.objectives: 将一大袋蛤蚌带回静谧海滩。
text.description: 我们堆了大量的蚌壳要运回去，我就干等人来拖。你证明了自己就是干这种危险活的料。$B$B我强烈希望这么一顿大餐不要在回去的路上被捕食者染指，所以我让你赶紧上路。$B$B谢谢你的帮助，朋友。很是荣幸。

english.title: Bellies Await
english.objectives: Bring the Hefty Sack Of Clams back to the Tranquil Wash.
english.description: We have quite a stock of gathered clams to tote back to the cave, I was simply awaiting someone to do the toting. You've proven dangerous enough to be the sort.$B$BI highly expect that such a fine meal shall not pass uncontested by predators on the way back, so I'd make your trip as swift as possible.$B$BThank you for your help, friend. It's been a pleasure.

text.title: 填满我们的口袋
text.objectives: 从南海火枪手和南海勇夫身上获得20份金料。
text.description: 我们拿走了所有没被钉死的战利品，但是我还没干完呢。如果我们能替热砂港财团干点脏活，那就能尽可能地赚取更多钞票。$B$B这些海盗不怎么戴耳环，所以金子一定是在另一个好地方……他们的牙里。南边的南海火枪手和勇夫是这里的小头目，他们应该是能打扮得起自己的人。替我将大把大把的金料弄来。

english.title: Filling Our Pockets
english.objectives: Collect 20 Gold Fillings from Southsea Musketeers or Southsea Strongarms.
english.description: We've looted everything that isn't bolted down around here, but I'm not done yet. If we're bothering to do the Steamwheedle Cartel's dirty work for them, we're going to make as much cash as we can while we're here.$B$BI haven't seen many earrings on these pirates, so the gold must be in the next best place...their teeth. The Southsea musketeers and strongarms to the south are the higher-ups here; they'll be the ones with the adornment. Bring me back a good fistful of gold fillings.

text.title: 严阵以待……呃，水阵
text.objectives: 击沉15艘南海划艇。
text.description: 火算是扑灭了，可南海海盗还是打算接舷登上赛艇平台。$B$B赶快上另一边的炮位，趁为还来得及，把他们打沉！

english.title: Circle the Wagons... er, Boats
english.objectives: Sink 15 Southsea Rowboats.
english.description: The fires are dealt with, but there are still Southsea pirates getting ready to board the Speedbarge.$B$BTime to switch to the other side cannon and sink them before it's too late!

text.title: 严阵以待……呃，水阵
text.objectives: 击沉15艘南海划艇。
text.description: 火算是扑灭了，可南海海盗还是打算接舷登上赛艇平台。$B$B赶快上另一边的炮位，趁还来得及，把他们打沉！

english.title: Circle the Wagons... er, Boats
english.objectives: Sink 15 Southsea Rowboats.
english.description: The fires are dealt with, but there are still Southsea pirates getting ready to board the Speedbarge.$B$BTime to switch to the other side cannon and sink them before it's too late!

text.title: 第二波
text.objectives: 装备一把暮光火焰长枪，乘坐艾维娜的守护者出击。向10个暮光枪兵进行冲撞以击落他们。按下“拍翼”按钮以控制你的坐骑扇动翅膀！
text.description: 你捅了马蜂窝，$n。不断有石块从洞穴顶上落下，敌人铺天盖地而来，他们最强大的战士驾着被这个世界的烈焰包裹并扭曲的坐骑，向我们杀了过来。$B$B快去把他们打下来！小心那些燃烧着的巨石。

english.title: Wave Two
english.objectives: Equip a Twilight Firelance and fly Aviana's Guardian. Kill 10 Twilight Lancers by flying into them. Press the flap button to flap your mount's wings!
english.description: You've stirred up the hornets, $n. The ceiling is coming down on us! And their strongest fighters are taking wing on creatures warped and twisted by this world of flame.$B$BGet back out there and take them down! Watch out for flaming boulders.

text.title: 备战！
text.objectives: 收集4支暴风城长矛、4件暴风城胸甲、4块暴风城盾牌和4个暴风城头盔。$b$b海地精拾荒者也会掉落这些装备。
text.description: 在努力避免被溺亡的过程中，我们不得不放弃了武器和大部分的护甲。$b$b埃鲁纳克说纳迦很快就会发动一场猛攻，我觉得应该相信他。$b$b请帮我们找到丢弃的军备，这样我们才有获胜的机会。你可以在船只残骸附近的海床上找到它们。$b$b抓紧时间，$r，我们几乎没有防御力量。

english.title: To Arms!
english.objectives: Gather 4 Stormwind Spears, 4 Stormwind Breastplates, 4 Stormwind Shields and 4 Stormwind Helms.$b$bThe equipment may also be collected from Gliblin Scavengers.
english.description: As we struggled not to drown, my men and I were forced to abandon our weapons and much of our armor.$b$bErunak says to expect a major attack from the naga soon and I'm inclined to believe him.$b$bIf we're going to stand a chance, we'll need your help to recover our lost armaments. They should be lying on the sea floor near our shipwrecks.$b$bHurry, $r, we're defenseless here.

text.title: 吃饱了好上路
text.objectives: 从裂钳诱捕蟹那里收集6块多汁的蟹肉。
text.description: 希望你能帮我做好战前的准备。$b$b任何像样的指挥官都知道，将士们吃得饱才能经得起长途跋涉和激烈战斗的考验。没有食物，打不了胜仗。$b$b我们的士兵最近历经艰险，身体十分虚弱。他们需要食物，才能应对随时可能爆发的战争。$b$b俗话说吃饱了好上路，那边的海床上生活着不少肥美的螃蟹……

english.title: Traveling on Our Stomachs
english.objectives: Collect 8 Succulent Crab Meat from Splitclaw Skitterers.
english.description: I'll need your help if I am to get these men ready for battle.$b$bAny decent leader knows that his men travel and fight on their stomachs. No food, no victory.$b$bThese soldiers are weak from their recent ordeal. They'll need sustenance if they're to put up any kind of fight when the need arises.$b$bSpeaking of traveling on stomachs, I've seen several crabs out there on the sea floor....

text.title: 我行我素
text.objectives: 与破浪号上的泰勒上尉交谈。
text.description: 我们已经准备就绪。不用待在这里等纳迦找上门来吧。$b$b我会通知部队行动，然后我们就与敌人直接交战，让命运来决定这结局吧。

english.title: On Our Own Terms
english.objectives: Speak to Captain Taylor in the Briny Cutter.
english.description: We're as ready as we'll ever be. No sense waiting around for the naga to find us.$b$bI'll address the men, then we'll meet the enemy on our own terms and let fate decide the outcome.

text.title: 炎魔之王的力量
text.objectives: 在海加尔山升腾者高地消灭4名火焰升腾者和5名暮光征服者。
text.description: 我被派来负责领导对敌的军事行动。考虑到我们这里还有半神走动，这职称其实也不足挂齿。$B$B我要你去敌后进行游击骚扰。在我们主力进攻前攻敌不备，削减他们的数量将是很重要的。$B$B你的第一个目标是升腾者高地，暮光之锤受到良好训练的狂热者们将在那里进入不完全的元素状态。

english.title: Might of the Firelord
english.objectives: Slay 4 Flame Ascendants and 5 Twilight Subjugators at the Ascendant's Rise in Hyjal.
english.description: I've been charged with leading our military operations against the enemy.  A humbling task when you consider there are demigods walking among us.$B$BI'm going to have you carry out a series of hit-and-run attacks behind enemy lines.  It will be important that you keep the enemy off guard and weaken their numbers ahead of our main force's attack.$B$BYour first target will be the Ascendant's Rise, where the most highly trained Twilight's Hammer devotees have achieved a partial elemental state.

text.title: 先知圣殿
text.objectives: 在先知圣殿消灭4名暮光预言师，4名暮光侍从和1名烈焰使者。
text.description: 暮光之锤的疯狂先知们就在升腾者高地北部地区集会。$B$B据说他们直接从上古众神那里获得黑暗的预景。无论真伪，对邪教来说，它们都是莫大的精神指导，因此攻击先知圣殿对敌人的士气来说无疑是致命的一击。如果你走运的话，说不定还能碰见炎魔之王座下的使者呢。

english.title: The Sanctum of the Prophets
english.objectives: Slay 4 Twilight Augurs, 4 Twilight Retainers and 1 Emissary of Flame at the Sanctum of the Prophets.
english.description: The mad prophets of the Twilight's Hammer congregate in the area just north of the Ascendant's Rise.$B$BIt is said that their dark visions are granted to them directly by the Old Gods.  Whether or not that is true, they provide tremendous spiritual guidance to the cult.  Attacking the Sanctum of the Prophets will deal a devastating blow to the enemy's morale and if we're lucky you might run into one of the Firelord's own emissaries while you're there.

text.title: 熔岩之王
text.objectives: 借助龟神之鼓的力量打败曼格坦大帝。
text.description: 侍奉拉格纳罗斯的熔岩巨人对他们的王言听计从。我们只要搞定了他，其他的自然群龙无首。$B$B没有巨人，地面部队的战斗就可以稍微公平一些。也许对咱们还有利也说不定。$B$B但扳倒熔岩之王不是一件易事。用这些鼓招来托尔托拉，他能抵挡住曼格坦大帝，而且可以坚持好一阵子。但是，仅仅抵挡住敌人是不够的——这个时候就该你出场了。
text.giverWindow: 用鼓声召唤托尔托拉的帮助。

english.title: Magma Monarch
english.objectives: Use the Drums of the Turtle God to help you defeat King Moltron.
english.description: The magma giants who serve Ragnaros are kept in line by their king's heavy-handed rule.  Were we to take care of him, the rest will surely fall into disarray.$B$BWithout the giants, the fight on the ground will get a lot more even.  Perhaps even tilt to our favor.$B$BBut felling the magma monarch will be no easy task.  Use these drums to enlist the help of the great Tortolla who is capable of holding off King Moltron for an eternity.  But holding him off won't be enough -- and that's where you come in.
english.giverWindow: Use the drums to enlist the aid of Tortolla.

text.title: 炎魔之王
text.objectives: 穿过先知圣殿的传送门帮助塞纳留斯打败拉格纳罗斯。
text.description: 护门人一死，海加尔山的守护者们就可以畅行无阻地前往萨弗隆尖塔了。$B$B这下拉格纳罗斯不得不亲自镇守通往火焰之地的主入口了。$B$B穿过位于先知圣殿的暮光之锤传送门，跟我在那里碰头。玛法里奥和哈缪尔也会帮助我们，其他人则会在外面同敌人作战。
text.giverWindow: 炎魔之王的末日到了。

english.title: The Firelord
english.objectives: Go through the portal at the Sanctum of the Prophets and aid Cenarius in defeating Ragnaros.
english.description: With his gatekeeper gone, you've given the Guardians of Hyjal access to Sulfuron Spire.$B$BRagnaros will have no choice but to defend the main entryway to the Firelands himself.$B$BGo through the Twilight's Hammer portal at the Sanctum of the Prophets and meet me inside.  Malfurion and Hamuul will also aid us while the others continue to fight the enemy outside.
english.giverWindow: The Firelord's time has come.

text.title: 邪恶之巢
text.objectives: 在海加尔山升腾者高地获得一颗暮光幼龙的头骨。
text.description: 你发现的这枚蛋是个值得警惕的迹象，$n。暮光巨龙通常是从其他龙族那里偷来的蛋加上黑魔法孵出来的。$B$B这枚“自然”蛋就意味着有一条雌龙已经变成了龙母。我们必须在她开始繁衍之前消灭掉她。$B$B到升腾者高地去，他们把变异的幼龙都集中在那里，杀掉其中一只未成年的幼龙。我们要用它的头骨把母龙引出来。
text.progress: You've returned, $r.

english.title: Brood of Evil
english.objectives: Obtain a Young Twilight Drake's Skull at the Ascendant's Rise in Hyjal.
english.description: This egg you recovered is an alarming sign, $n.  The Twilight dragons are usually raised from stolen eggs from other dragonflights, which are then modified through dark magic.$B$BThis "natural" egg is evidence that one of their matriarchs has become a viable broodmother.  We must destroy her before her brood spreads.$B$BGo to the Ascendant's Rise where they claim these aberrations are kept and slay one of the juvenile drakes.  We will use its skull to lure out its mother.
english.progress: You've returned, $r.

text.title: 龙母之死
text.objectives: 将暮光幼龙的头骨放在升腾者高地南边的觅食地，并消灭迪斯珀蕾欧娜。
text.description: 我们在升腾者高地南边找到了母龙的觅食地。$B$B失去一条幼龙的她将会变得极为愤怒。把这颗头骨放在她的猎物残骸边，她若是在附近，肯定会出来复仇。$B$B到时候我们会给她一个惊喜。
text.giverWindow: 用颅骨把她吸引过来。

english.title: Death to the Broodmother
english.objectives: Place the Twilight Drake Skull at the feeding grounds south of the Ascendant's Rise and slay Desperiona.
english.description: We've located the matriarch's feeding grounds south of the Ascendant's Rise.$B$BShe will be extremely angry to have lost one of her drakes.  Place the skull there near the carcasses she devours.  If she's anywhere in the vicinity, she will come out and attempt to exact revenge.$B$BWe will have a surprise waiting for her.
english.giverWindow: Use the skull to draw her in.

text.title: 火焰的秘密
text.objectives: 在海加尔山升腾者高地找到升腾者教条、燃烧的祷文和烈焰秘典。
text.description: 若想将拉格纳罗斯逐回火焰之地，我们就要想办法进入萨弗隆尖塔。$B$B只有最受信任的暮光之锤成员才能得到如此贵重的情报。$B$B到升腾者高地去，尽可能把所有的典籍书卷都翻找一遍。虽然这些书籍无比堕落，但我们可不能浪费掌握敌人弱点的大好机会。
text.progress: Did you succeed in your task, $N?

english.title: Secrets of the Flame
english.objectives: Obtain the Ascendant's Codex, the Burning Litanies and the Tome of Flame at the Ascendant's Rise in Hyjal.
english.description: If we are to banish Ragnaros back into the Firelands, we will need to gain access to Sulfuron Spire.$B$BOnly the most trusted members of the Twilight's Hammer will have been entrusted with such valuable information.$B$BGo search the Ascendant's Rise for any written tomes you might find.  Foul as they are, we cannot waste the opportunity to learn about our enemy's weaknesses.
english.progress: Did you succeed in your task, $N?

text.title: 护门人
text.objectives: 在塞纳留斯之角的帮助下消灭护门人阿泽莱隆。
text.description: 根据这些书典，拉格纳罗斯最为强大的副手充当着萨弗隆尖塔护门人的角色。$B$B你一个人是无法打败他的。$B$B同阿泽莱隆交战时吹响这个号角，我们附近所有的部队都会赶来支援。$B$B你必须赶快，$n。炎魔之王很快就会意识到我们要干什么。
text.giverWindow: 吹响号角，我们的人就会赶来帮你。

english.title: The Gatekeeper
english.objectives: Use the Horn of Cenarius to help you slay Azralon the Gatekeeper.
english.description: According to these tomes, one of Ragnaros' most powerful lieutenants serves as the sole gatekeeper to Sulfuron Spire.$B$BYou won't be able to defeat him alone.$B$BSound this horn when you engage in combat with Azralon and any of our forces in the vicinity will come to your aid.$B$BYou must hurry, $n.  It won't be long before the Firelord realizes what we're up to.
english.giverWindow: Use the horn, and our troops will come to your aid.

text.title: 进入祖尔法拉克
text.objectives: 去找祖尔法拉克的玛佐加。
text.description: 那卑劣的叛徒……我就知道不能信任他那种人。我对苏萨斯的追寻蒙蔽了我的眼睛。$B$B原谅我，$n。玛佐加逃进了祖尔法拉克，沙怒文明的心脏地带。$B$B如果你真的想追寻那把剑，就要去找他。不要单枪匹马，整个沙怒部族都在里面等着，他们不会欢迎你的。$B$B我会留在这里，对宝剑的研究必须结束。你要是找到了它，就归你了。我必须在被迷惑之前放弃它。

english.title: Into Zul'Farrak
english.objectives: Find Mazoga within Zul'Farrak.
english.description: That foul traitor...I should've known better than to trust his kind. My hunt for Sul'thraze has blinded me.$B$BForgive me, $n. Mazoga has fled inside of Zul'Farrak, the heart of the Sandfury civilization.$B$BIf you truly seek the sword, you must pursue him. Do not go alone; the entirety of the Sandfury tribe lies in wait behind those walls, and they will not welcome you.$B$BI will stay here. My search for the blade must end. Should you find it, keep it; I must give up before I am consumed.

text.title: Chief Ukorz
text.objectives: Kill Chief Ukorz Sandscalp.
text.description: Take a good look, mon. This is how it goes, betrayal after betrayal. I backstab you for the sword, and then Chief Ukorz go and backstab me even better for it.$B$BThat's life, yah! Or was...$B$BNow, I know you don't got no love for Mazoga. But I know you goin' in there anyway. Kill him for me, mon. Spill more blood on the sand, an' give Chief Ukorz Sandscalp what every one of us in here deserves...a gory death.$B$BMaybe I leave some of my belongin's without a curse before passin' on if you do, yah?
text.completed: Return to Mazoga in Zul'Farrak.

english.title: Chief Ukorz
english.objectives: Kill Chief Ukorz Sandscalp.
english.description: Take a good look, mon. This is how it goes, betrayal after betrayal. I backstab you for the sword, and then Chief Ukorz go and backstab me even better for it.$B$BThat's life, yah! Or was...$B$BNow, I know you don't got no love for Mazoga. But I know you goin' in there anyway. Kill him for me, mon. Spill more blood on the sand, an' give Chief Ukorz Sandscalp what every one of us in here deserves...a gory death.$B$BMaybe I leave some of my belongin's without a curse before passin' on if you do, yah?
english.completed: Return to Mazoga in Zul'Farrak.

text.title: 生死之战
text.objectives: 协助泰勒上尉保卫破浪号。
text.description: 就这里吧。$b$b破浪号就是我们的阵地。$b$b誓死保卫这艘船，狠狠地教训那帮傻蛋。他们若再敢来犯，最好能三思而行！$b$b愿锋利的刀刃震慑他们的心灵！

english.title: All or Nothing
english.objectives: Assist Captain Taylor in the defense of The Briny Cutter.
english.description: This is it.$b$bThis is where we make our stand.$b$bWe must defend this ship to our last breath, and make these cretins think twice before approaching it again!$b$bMay our blades strike fear in their hearts!

text.title: 所有权
text.objectives: 杀死10名血精灵废墟猎人。
text.description: 看来我们不是唯一一帮对这片废墟有兴趣的人。首先，血精灵盯上了我们的挖掘场。$B$B我还以为没有漂亮的喷泉和蓬松的枕头，他们就会被晒脱皮呢，不过他们出奇地好斗，还打算动手把我们从南月废墟赶出去。$B$B该开开杀戒了。去教训教训那些精灵，叫他们再跟我们捣乱！

english.title: Laying Claim
english.objectives: Kill 10 Blood Elf Ruins Hunters.
english.description: We're not the only ones interested in these ruins, it seem. Of all things, we've got blood elves after our dig sites.$B$BI'd expect them to wilt in the heat without all their fancy fountains and cushy pillows, but they're surprisingly scrappy, and they're trying to drive us out of the Southmoon Ruins by force.$B$BIt's time to crack a few heads. Head over there and teach those elves not to mess with us!

text.title: 砸蛋
text.objectives: 装备一把暮光火焰长枪，乘坐艾维娜的守护者出击。飞向40枚火焰之地龙卵以击碎它们。按下“拍翼”按钮以控制你的坐骑扇动翅膀！
text.description: 失去了保护的火焰之地龙卵简直不堪一击。$B$B再次起飞，把那些卵都碾碎！只需要冲向它们就行了。搜遍每一个角落、每一道裂隙和每一处山洞。快一点！

english.title: Egg Wave
english.objectives: Equip a Twilight Firelance and fly Aviana's Guardian. Smash 40 Firelands Eggs by running over them. Press the flap button to flap your mount's wings!
english.description: Without any defenders, the Firelands eggs are vulnerable.$B$BTake wing once more and smash those eggs! Simply rush over them to crush them. Search all the nooks, crannies, and side-caves. Hurry!

text.title: Circle the Wagons... er, Boats
text.objectives: Sink 15 Southsea Rowboats.
text.description: The fires may be dealt with, but those Southsea pirates are still getting ready to board the Speedbarge!$B$B$n, you need to go back to Mazzer Stripscrew and get on your boat. Use the cannon to sink them before it's too late!

text.title: Hammering It Out
text.objectives: Take the Mysterious Device to Stormwind, Ironforge, Exodar or Darnassus and show it to an Earthen Ring Representative.
text.description: The rift that was here left behind this strange device, but why?$B$BSomeone in a capital city may have more information.

english.description: The rift that was here left behind this strange device, but why?$B$BSomeone in a capital city may have more information.

text.title: 暴风城海豹突击队
text.objectives: 找到6件暴风城海豹突击队员装备。
text.description: $c，你为我们做出了极大的贡献，不妨让你知道一个秘密。你营救的那些人并不是普通的暴风城士兵。$b$b我们隶属于一支精英部队的特种分队，而此行的目的不仅仅是与部落周旋，还肩负着调查附近海床地质剧变的重任。$b$b我之所以告诉你这些，是因为我们配备的顶级装备都随着船只沉到了海底。$B$B必须将它们找回来！

english.title: Stormwind Elite Aquatic and Land Forces
english.objectives: Find 6 Stormwind SEAL Equipment.
english.description: You've done us a great service, $c, so I'm going to let you in on a little secret. The men you've saved today aren't your everyday Stormwind troops.$b$bWe belong to a special detachment of elite soldiers sent here not only to contend with the Horde, but to investigate the massive geological disturbances originating from the nearby sea floor.$b$bI tell you this because our top secret equipment lies in the bottom of some of our wrecked ships here.$b$bThat gear must be retrieved!

text.title: 语言的碎片
text.objectives: 收集5份远古符文碑刻。
text.description: 近年来，我们第一个重大发现就是在南月废墟这里了。我的伙计们挖掘出了一些石板，上面刻有古代文字。$B$B石板上的雕文跟我们以前见过的都不一样，但是我有一种预感，我们也许可以把它们和其它挖掘场中出土的泰坦铭文联系起来。想象一下吧，这样的突破将意味着什么！$B$B我要派你去南月废墟，帮助我们收集那些石板，其他人抽不开身，他们要提防那些血精灵夺走我们的挖掘场！

english.title: Fragments of Language
english.objectives: Collect 5 Ancient Hieroglyphs.
english.description: We've had our first big find in years here at the Southmoon ruins. My lads have dug up stone tablets, engraved with ancient writings.$B$BThe glyphs on the tablets are like nothing we've ever seen, but I have a hunch we can connect them with titanic scripts found at other digsites. Imagine what a breakthrough like that could mean!$B$B I need you to go to the Southmoon ruins and help us collect the tablets; the other lads can't leave, lest the blood elves take our site!

text.title: 奥丹姆的秘密
text.objectives: 搜索奥丹姆前厅，寻找一件完好的神器。
text.description: 我研究了这些废墟多年，试图找到入口。我们甚至把大门都卸下来一大块，却发现后面是密不透风的墙壁。如今大灾变也许将里面的东西毁了个一干二净，但也做到了我们无法做到的事情，打开了一个入口！$B$B我把这荣誉交给你，$G小子:姑娘;。进去看看还有什么完好的东西。不过要当心……说不好会有什么东西，或者人，会在里面搅和。

english.title: The Secrets of Uldum
english.objectives: Search the Antechamber of Uldum for an intact artifact.
english.description: I studied these ruins for years trying to find a way in. We even took a good chunk out of the gate, only to find impenetrable walls beneath. Now the cataclysm may've wrecked everything in there something fierce, but it's done what we couldn't and opened a way in!$B$BI'd like you to have the honor, $Glad:lass;. Head on in there and see if anything's been left uncracked. Be careful though... there's no telling what, or who, might be stirring in there.

text.title: 自然异象
text.objectives: 将元素碎片交给奥格瑞玛、幽暗城、雷霆崖或银月城的大地之环使者。
text.description: 曾经出现在这里的裂隙已经消失，只剩下了这块元素碎片。我完全不知道这块碎片和裂隙之间有什么联系。但也许会有精通元素知识的人能告诉你更多关于它的知识。$B$B你可以去各个首都找到大地之环使者。他们应该正在搜寻这样的东西。

english.title: A Natural Occurrence
english.objectives: Take the Elemental Shard to an Earthen Ring Emissary in Orgrimmar, Undercity, Thunder Bluff or Silvermoon.
english.description: This Elemental Shard is all that is left from the rift that stood here before.  The connection between the shard and the rift is unknown, but perhaps someone more versed in the elements would know more.$B$BSeek out an Earthen Ring Emissary in any capital city.  This could be exactly what they are looking for.

text.title: Your Underwater Mount (Temp)
text.objectives: Lure and subdue an Abyssal Manta.$B$B[Note: There is a lot pending for this quest - the end result will be much quicker and much cleaner]
text.description: I set up some ropes on the ledge below.  Just tie off your lure to one of the ropes and release it into the abyssal stream. If all goes well, one of the rays should come up for it almost immediately.$B$BI don't expect this to be even remotely easy, so hold on tight and keep an eye ahead at all times. If you should succeed in subduing one of the rays, bring it back here immediately so that we can feed it and cement the bond.$B$BI have a good feeling this time. I think this is it, $n.

If you should succeed in subduing one of the rays, bring it back here immediately so that we can feed it and cement the bond.$B$BI have a good feeling this time. I think this is it, $n.

text.title: 天降之火
text.objectives: 到诺达希尔北边寻找暮光营地，在那里使用索罗之角。
text.description: 多亏了你，我们已经找到了渗透者来袭的大致方位。$B$B现在要做的就是摧毁他们的营地，中止他们在诺达希尔这里的活动。$B$B带上这号角，听到信号后，我们的一条翡翠幼龙会呼啸而来，让这些暮光邪教徒尝尝他们疯狂崇拜的火焰是个什么味道。
text.completion: Excellent, $n.  That should put a stop to the attacks once we finish these elementals off.

english.title: Flames from Above
english.objectives: Seek the Twilight Encampment north of Nordrassil and use Tholo's Horn.
english.description: We've identified the general direction where the infiltrators have been coming from, thanks to your work.$B$BNow we just need to shut down their camp and put an end to their operations this side of Nordrassil.$B$BTake this horn.  It will signal one of our emerald drakes to swoop down and give these Twilight cultists a taste of the flames they so madly worship.
english.completion: Excellent, $n.  That should put a stop to the attacks once we finish these elementals off.

text.title: 铸于暗影与烈焰
text.objectives: 摧毁10只暮光武器箱。
text.description: 暮光之锤用来对付我们的武器，都是由这里的铸炉之主派伦迪乌斯铸造的。那些武器可真是削铁如泥，可一旦被夺走，只要轻轻一碰，原本锋利的钢铁就会立即变脆碎裂。$B$B那就这样吧，$n。我宁可看到那些该死的武器断掉，也不愿让敌人拿着它们。$B$B在这些洞穴里寻找装有暮光武器的箱子，把它们砸成碎片。
text.completion: Good, good. I like nothing more than to see the works of our enemy destroyed.

english.title: Forged of Shadow and Flame
english.objectives: Destroy 10 Twilight Arms crates.
english.description: The weapons the Twilight's Hammer uses against us are crafted by Forgemaster Pyrenduis within these very halls. The metal slices through armor like cheese in the hands of its wielder. Yet, when captured, the steel turns brittle and shatters.$B$BSo be it, $n. I'd rather see those cursed arms smashed than delivered to our enemy.$B$BSeek out the crates of Twilight arms in these caverns and smash them to pieces.
english.completion: Good, good. I like nothing more than to see the works of our enemy destroyed.

text.title: 狼神之怒
text.objectives: 消灭12个黑铁苦工。
text.description: 身处火焰之神的领域深处，我们会有什么发现呢？拉格纳罗斯的小走狗，急吼吼地为他卖命。$B$B这些黑铁苦工正在为暮光之锤征服海加尔山的行动准备武器，我不关心他们是自愿来干活的，还是被洗脑或者被绑架的……他们是我们敬爱的古代狼神的敌人，所以他们要为此付出血的代价。
text.completion: Dead? Good. They sealed their fate when they threw their lot in with Ragnaros and his kingdom of flame.$B$BLeave their bodies down here to crumble into ash.

english.title: Rage of the Wolf Ancient
english.objectives: Slay 12 Dark Iron Laborers.
english.description: Here we are deep within the realm of the fire god and what do we find? The little puppets of Ragnaros, scurrying around to do his bidding.$B$BThese Dark Iron laborers are finishing and packaging the weapons Twilight's Hammer hopes to use in their conquest of Hyjal. I don't care if they're here of their own free will or if they've been brainwashed or kidnapped... They're a foe of our beloved wolf ancient and they should pay the ultimate price.
english.completion: Dead? Good. They sealed their fate when they threw their lot in with Ragnaros and his kingdom of flame.$B$BLeave their bodies down here to crumble into ash.

text.title: 砸碎核心
text.objectives: 消灭炽热守护者，夺取8个闷烧之核，然后用暮光铁砧砸碎这些闷烧之核。
text.description: 这些炽热的守护者实在是太危险了！我们好不容易干掉他们，不消几分钟，他们就从灰烬中重新燃起。$B$B我知道有个办法可以永久地毁灭他们，但我们需要一位能够冲锋陷阵的猛将。$B$B$n，消灭那些炽热守护者，夺取他们的闷烧之核，然后到附近的铁砧旁去。在暮光铁砧上砸碎那些闷烧之核，彻底毁灭他们！
text.completion: Great work!$B$BThere was a time when adventurers would collect these cores in order to craft mediocre fire-resistant equipment. But for now, I'm glad just to destroy these fiends once and for all.

english.title: Crushing the Cores
english.objectives: Acquire 8 Smoldering Cores by killing Searing Guardians, then smash them against a Twilight Anvil.
english.description: These searing guardians are murderous! We destroy them, and within minutes, they reignite from the ashes.$B$BI think there's a way to destroy them permanently, but we'll need someone who can fight through the front ranks.$B$B$n, kill the searing guardians and take their smoldering cores to the nearby anvils. Smash them on the Twilight Anvils, and destroy them for good!
english.completion: Great work!$B$BThere was a time when adventurers would collect these cores in order to craft mediocre fire-resistant equipment. But for now, I'm glad just to destroy these fiends once and for all.

text.title: 回到诺达希尔
text.objectives: 跟海加尔山诺达希尔的伊瑟拉谈一谈。
text.description: 我尽快将范达尔押往月光林地。但愿我能尽早回来，好在战场上助你们一臂之力。$B$B这会儿，你可以去向伊瑟拉报告，告诉她目前的这些进展。
text.completion: 'Alysra''s decision might not have been the wisest, $n.  Yet there is little time to worry about that now.$B$BI bring important discoveries from the Emerald Dream.'

english.title: Return to Nordrassil
english.objectives: Speak to Ysera at Nordrassil in Hyjal.
english.description: I will take Fandral to Moonglade swiftly.  I hope to return soon so I may continue to aid in the battle.$B$BIn the meantime, report back to Ysera and inform her of these recent developments.
english.completion: 'Alysra''s decision might not have been the wisest, $n.  Yet there is little time to worry about that now.$B$BI bring important discoveries from the Emerald Dream.'

text.title: 毫无防备
text.objectives: 杀死10名艾萨尔巡逻兵。
text.description: 我们从贝壳里逃出来不可能没被发现，废墟这里的纳迦要么是没得到消息，要么就根本不把我们当回事。我不想坐等良机——我们马上出击。$B$B我要你摸到西边的废墟下层去，尽可能多地干掉他们的巡逻兵。我们不能冒险让他们发现我们这座山洞的位置——一个都别放跑。

english.title: Caught Off-Guard
english.objectives: Kill 10 Azsh'ir Patrollers.
english.description: Our escape from the shell can't have gone unnoticed, but either the naga at these ruins weren't informed or they don't consider us a threat. I don't intend to take the opportunity for granted - we strike now.$B$BI need you to slip into the lower level of the ruins to our west and take out as many of their patrols as you can. We cannot risk any of those patrols finding out about our occupation of this cave - make sure none escape.

text.title: 蹑手蹑脚
text.objectives: 摧毁8个艾萨尔监控器。
text.description: 我已着手展开初步的侦查。纳迦也许没有意识到我们的存在，但他们也不是对入侵者毫无防备。$B$B在巡逻线后面，他们设置了魔法警戒装置，一旦有不速之客随时报警。幸运的是，它们为数不多，因此绝对有隙可乘，可以在触发之前摧毁这些装置。$B$B我相信你可以在我们的士兵到来之前处理好这件事。

english.title: Swift Approach
english.objectives: Destroy 8 Azsh'ir Monitors.
english.description: I've taken the liberty of performing some preliminary scouting. The naga may not be aware of our position, but they are not entirely unprepared for intruders.$B$BBeyond their patrols, they have set up magical sentry devices that will warn them of unwelcome guests. Fortunately, they seem to have sacrificed quality for quantity, and there is definitely a window in which the devices can be destroyed before their alarms are answered.$B$BI trust that you can see to this before our other soldiers arrive.

text.title: 时光的记录
text.objectives: 调查瓦丝琪尔花园4处完好的雕像。
text.description: 瞧——$n是吧？我需要你的帮助。我知道洞里所有人都认为现在除了自己的温饱不该琢磨其他事情，但我不能就这样忘了本。$B$B我想让你做的，无非就是当你处于其中时，帮我留意一下那些意义非凡的物事。

english.title: An Occupation of Time
english.objectives: Investigate the 4 intact statues in the Vashj'ir Gardens.
english.description: Look--$n is it?--I need your help. I know most everyone in this cave thinks that we're not in a position to be worrying about anything but our own hides right now, but I cannot dismiss my ancestors so readily.$B$BAll I want from you, while you're out in the city proper, is to keep a watchful eye out for objects of significance. The statues interest me especially.

text.title: 奇袭点
text.objectives: 去废墟最下层，调查奎尔多米尔花园北边的尽头，在花园以西的废墟下面有条小路可以通往那里，还有废墟东南角落的建筑群，就在桥下。
text.description: 这个洞穴是我们唯一的避难所，已经退无可退，也毫无外援。无论发生什么，这个洞穴的安全是放在第一位的，不然我们都得死在这儿。$B$B我们需要一个前哨站来实施打击。$B$B去废墟东部最下层，调查花园北边的尽头。然后是花园以西、主建筑之下的通道。此外还有废墟东南角落的建筑群，就在桥下。$B$B去搜集一些情报给我。

english.title: A Better Vantage
english.objectives: On the lowest level of the ruins, scout the northern end of the Quel'Dormir Gardens, the passage that leads under the ruins west of the gardens, and the structures at the southeast corner of the ruins, below the bridges.
english.description: This cave is our only refuge. There's no help on the way. Whatever happens, this cave must remain safe or we are all sure to die down here.$B$BWe need a forward post to launch our attacks from. Something defensible.$B$BIn the eastern portion of the ruins on the lowest level, scout the north end of the gardens, the passage leading under the main structure just west of the gardens, and the cluster of buildings at the southeast corner of the ruins, under the bridges.$B$BBring me back any information you can.

objectiveDetails.description: 侦查奎尔多米尔花园北部
侦查奎尔多米尔花园西边的通道
侦查奎尔多米尔花园南部的建筑

text.title: 在战斗现场
text.objectives: 将破损的碎片带回静谧海滩。
text.description: 你周围曾经发生过一场激烈的战斗。纳迦骷髅不稀奇，但这些武器和他们对手留下的痕迹却出人意料。$B$B在骸骨中间，你发现一块奇怪得惹眼的金属从其中一个颅骨中扎出来。很难说它曾经是什么武器上的，不过它是如此地惹人注意，你无法不把它作为证据带走。$B$B洞里肯定会有人对这一发现感兴趣的。

english.title: Upon the Scene of Battle
english.objectives: Bring the broken shard back to the Tranquil Wash.
english.description: All around you lie the remnants of a fierce battle. The naga skeletons are no surprise, but the weapons and remains of their apparent opponents are somewhat more unexpected.$B$BAmidst the bones, you spot a strangely prominent piece of metal jutting out from one of the skulls. It's difficult to tell what sort of weapon it might have once been part of, but it stands out sufficiently to prompt you to retrieve it as evidence.$B$BSurely someone back at the cave would be interested in this revelation.

text.title: 远古半神的回归
text.objectives: 跟海加尔山狼神小径的欧穆拉·白角谈一谈。
text.description: 收复远古半神们的圣殿将十分关键，$n。$B$B沿着葱郁林地西边的道路进入狼神小径。$B$B那里有我们的行动前哨，尽可能帮他们，想办法到第一座圣殿去。$B$B被精灵称作戈德林、被兽人称作洛戈什的狼神，将会是我们对抗敌人的有力同伴。
text.completion: Ysera sent you? Good! We need all the help we can get.$B$BWe'll never be able to recover the shrines to the ancients so long as Twilight's Hammer controls the roads. Somehow we've got to stem the flood.

english.title: The Return of the Ancients
english.objectives: Speak to Oomla Whitehorn at Wolf's Run in Hyjal.
english.description: It'll be crucial to reclaim each of the ancients' shrines, $n.$B$BFollow the road west of the Verdant Thicket, into Wolf's Run.$B$BWe have operatives stationed there.  Aid them in any way that you can and work your way to the first shrine.$B$BThe wolf god was known to the elves as Goldrinn and to the orcs as Lo'Gosh.  He will be a fierce ally in our fight against the enemy.
english.completion: Ysera sent you? Good! We need all the help we can get.$B$BWe'll never be able to recover the shrines to the ancients so long as Twilight's Hammer controls the roads. Somehow we've got to stem the flood.

text.title: 沉默大炮
text.objectives: 摧毁8挺据点大炮。
text.description: 现在该对付东边悬崖上该死的大炮了！$B$B要是你能的话，跳上你的赛艇，驶往南海据点。抬头你就能看到一排大炮在朝下对我们轰。$B$B那些海盗对工程一窍不通。让大炮炸膛对你来说应该不难。

english.title: Quiet the Cannons
english.objectives: Destroy 8 Holdfast Cannons.
english.description: Now it's time to do something about those darn cannons up on the bluffs to the east!$B$BIf you'd be so kind, hop into your boat and cruise on over to the Southsea Holdfast. Up top you'll see a bunch of cannons firing down on us.$B$BThose pirates don't know squat about engineering. It shouldn't be too difficult for you to clog 'em up and make them explode.

text.title: 沉默大炮
text.objectives: 摧毁8挺据点大炮。
text.description: 现在该对付东边悬崖上该死的大炮了！$B$B要是你能的话，跳上你的赛艇，驶往南海据点。抬头你就能看到一排大炮在朝下对我们轰。$B$B那些海盗对工程一窍不通。让大炮炸膛对你来说应该不难。

english.title: Quiet the Cannons
english.objectives: Destroy 8 Holdfast Cannons.
english.description: Now it's time to do something about those darn cannons up on the bluffs to the east!$B$BIf you'd be so kind, hop into your boat and cruise on over to the Southsea Holdfast. Up top you'll see a bunch of cannons firing down on us.$B$BThose pirates don't know squat about engineering. It shouldn't be too difficult for you to clog 'em up and make them explode.

text.title: 保护我！
text.objectives: 调查柯尔普萨之森的走私者洞穴，确保可以安全进入洞穴后向埃达尔拉发出信号。
text.description: 求求你，$r！你必须帮帮我！$b$b我们的船只遭到纳迦、鲨鱼以及那头恐怖的怪兽的轮番攻击，我勉强捡回一条性命。$b$b我发现这附近有座洞穴，或许那里会比较安全。但是只有在确定洞穴里有空气的情况下，我才敢冒险一试。$b$b你能帮我查探一下吗？
text.completion: I cannot thank you enough, $r.$b$bI just hope this whole nightmare has a happy ending.

english.title: Gimme Shelter!
english.objectives: Investigate Smuggler's Scar in the Kelp'thar forest, then signal to Adarrah that it's safe to enter.
english.description: Please, $r! You must help me!$b$bI've barely managed to survive, what with naga, sharks, and that horrible monster that attacked our ship.$b$bI can see a cave that might be safe, but I don't dare try to make it unless I know there's air inside.$b$bCan you make sure it's ok?
english.completion: I cannot thank you enough, $r.$b$bI just hope this whole nightmare has a happy ending.

text.title: 有仇必报
text.objectives: 在南海据点消灭15名南海海盗。
text.description: 我想，是时候报仇了。这可不能怨我，谁让他们把我锁在厕所里，还想把我淹死？！$B$B要是你前往东边悬崖的南海据点帮我报仇，我不会让你白干的。

english.title: A Little Payback
english.objectives: Slay 15 Southsea pirates at the Southsea Holdfast.
english.description: It's time for a little payback, I think. Can you blame me? After they locked me down in that outhouse and left me to drown?!$B$BI'll make it worth your while if you head up to the Southsea Holdfast on the eastern bluffs and exact my revenge.

text.title: 有仇必报
text.objectives: 在南海据点消灭15名南海海盗。
text.description: 我想，是时候报仇了。这可不能怨我，谁让他们把我锁在厕所里，还想把我淹死？！$B$B要是你前往东边悬崖的南海据点帮我报仇，我不会让你白干的。

english.title: A Little Payback
english.objectives: Slay 15 Southsea pirates at the Southsea Holdfast.
english.description: It's time for a little payback, I think. Can you blame me? After they locked me down in that outhouse and left me to drown?!$B$BI'll make it worth your while if you head up to the Southsea Holdfast on the eastern bluffs and exact my revenge.

text.title: 维兹尔去哪儿了？
text.objectives: 在千针石林的南海据点找到维兹尔·铜栓。
text.description: 嘿，$n，你见过我的另一个兄弟维兹尔吗？$B$B我刚得知海盗抓住了他！他说他打算把工程产品卖些给他们还是咋的。$B$B你能不能去东边南海据点帮忙找找看？我打赌是那个整天和他混在一起不干好事的地精赛恩格惹上的麻烦！

english.title: Where's Wizzle?
english.objectives: Find Wizzle Brassbolts at the Southsea Holdfast in Thousand Needles.
english.description: Hey, $n, you haven't seen my other brother, Wizzle, have you?$B$BI just know that the pirates captured him! He said that he was going to try to sell them some engineering stuff, or something.$B$BWould you please look for him up at the Southsea Holdfast to the east? I'll bet that no-good goblin he's always traveling with, Synge, got him into trouble!

text.title: 雷霆斗技场：宿敌战！
text.objectives: 击败凯尔希·钢烁。
text.description: 看来我们有个特别的请求！我收到一张来自梅格斯·碎纸机的信件，要求进入笼子解决一场纠纷。$B$B她指名你作她的对手，$n。是你之前赢得的拥趸吗？还是你在擂台外面找的？$B$B假如我是你，我就不会怯场。这是决赛了……
text.completed: 去找塔纳利斯加基森的卡崔娜·特纳尔。

english.title: Thunderdrome: Grudge Match!
english.objectives: Defeat Kelsey Steelspark.
english.description: It seems we have a special request! I have here a note from one Megs Dreadshredder, requesting to enter the cage and settle a dispute.$B$BShe's asked for you to be her partner, $n. A fan of your previous victories? Or perhaps you're acquainted outside the ring?$B$BI wouldn't back down now if I were you. This is the grand finale...
english.completed: Return to Katrina Turner at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

text.title: 深度吸引
text.objectives: 消灭10名红腮拾荒者。
text.description: 我成功帮助幸存者们来到这个洞窟，但麻烦的事情也接踵而来。好像我们还不够头疼似的，一些发光的鱼人会从附近的裂隙里冒出来袭击本来已经苦不堪言的幸存者。$B$B那里的人都是战士，他们绝不轻言放弃，但从那该死的贝壳出来以后他们的身体状况就更加难以为继了。$B$B还是你还能憋两口气，出去帮我们干掉些鱼人。地狱咆哮关注着你呢。
text.completion: You know what it is to carry yourself with honor, $c. You do Hellscream proud.

english.title: Deep Attraction
english.objectives: Kill 10 Redgill Scavengers.
english.description: I've been able to help some of the survivors make it to the cave, but it's starting to get hairy out there. If we didn't have enough problems, some glowing murlocs started creeping up from the nearby crevice to attack the stranded survivors.$B$BThe men up there are warriors--they won't go down without a fight--but they're much worse for the wear after that damned shell.$B$BIf you have any breath left in your lungs, get up there and take out some of those murlocs. Hellscream's eyes are upon you.
english.completion: You know what it is to carry yourself with honor, $c. You do Hellscream proud.

text.title: 救命螺
text.objectives: 收集8枚呼吸螺，把它们交给被困住的奈瑟匹拉幸存者。
text.description: 还有很多人没来。他们肯定在海崖的气孔那儿赖着不走。$B$B我们在来的路上发现了一些呼吸螺。它们能产生的空气不是很多，不过足以让我们前往洞窟了。$B$B我得留在这儿数人头，等人到齐了帮他们恢复体力。你帮我个忙，去收集那些呼吸螺，交给我还滞留在海崖那儿的人，顺便给他们的屁股上来一脚，让他们好快点过来。
text.completion: Thank you, $c. You've proven very useful.

english.title: Shelled Salvation
english.objectives: Collect 8 Spiralung shells and give them to stranded Nespirah Survivors.
english.description: A lot of the men haven't made it to the cave yet. It's a safe bet that they're stranded at the vents on the ridge above us.$B$BWe found some spiralung shells on the way here. They don't produce much air, but it was enough for us to make the cave.$B$BI need to stay here to count heads and get them back on their feet as they arrive. Do me a favor - go collect those spiralung shells, get them to any of my men that are still up on the ridge, and give them a swift kick in the arse so that they get moving.
english.completion: Thank you, $c. You've proven very useful.

objectiveDetails.description: 营救气泡贝壳附近的幸存者

text.title: 狡猾的螃蟹
text.objectives: 收集12个菲亚斯科的散落零件。
text.description: 原来是该死的螃蟹！$B$B我以为进行水下练习能让我变得超级能打！我的背包确实越来越轻了。不过！其实是螃蟹在我包上夹了一个洞，里面的零件掉了一路。$B$B你能不能帮帅气的地精一个忙？回去帮我把所有掉出来的零件都找回来。我敢说那些阴险的小螃蟹肯定带走了不少。
text.progress: Never underestimate the appeal of something shiny.
text.completion: Glad you know a quick buck when you see one. Pleasure doing business with you, $g buddy:gorgeous;.

english.title: Crafty Crabs
english.objectives: Collect 12 of Fiasco's Stray Parts.
english.description: It was that darn crab!$B$BHere I thought that all the exercise from walking here was making me super buff! My pack just kept getting lighter and lighter. But no! That crab snipped a hole in my bag and all my parts were falling out the whole way here.$B$BPlease, help a good lookin' goblin out, will ya? Go back and help me pick up all of my stray parts. I'm sure those conniving vicious little crabs ran off with some of them too.
english.progress: Never underestimate the appeal of something shiny.
english.completion: Glad you know a quick buck when you see one. Pleasure doing business with you, $g buddy:gorgeous;.

text.title: 可以食用
text.objectives: 收集8块钳嘴石斑鱼的肉。
text.description: 他们打算把我们都饿死吗？！不给囚犯吃的也太不人道了。$B$B我们得喂饱这些士兵。来这儿的路上我发现那些巨型石斑鱼很有潜力。几条下肚我们就很长一段时间不会惦记肉味了。$B$B要是你能给我弄些来，我保证做好、公平分发。
text.progress: With all the rumbling bellies, it sounds like there's a monster in this cave. It's putting my nerves on edge.
text.completion: Now to hold up my end of the bargain. I'll get this cooked and passed out immediately.$B$BYou and I will have to have a talk later. I'm going to need help that these soldiers just can't offer.

english.title: Something Edible
english.objectives: Collect 8 Snapjaw Grouper Meat.
english.description: Were they trying to starve us all to death?! Not giving prisoners food is just despicable.$B$BWe need to get these soldiers fed. The best prospect I spotted on the way here were those giant grouper. Several of those and we shouldn't want for meat for a while.$B$BIf you can bring me back some, I'll see to it that it gets cooked and passed out fairly.
english.progress: With all the rumbling bellies, it sounds like there's a monster in this cave. It's putting my nerves on edge.
english.completion: Now to hold up my end of the bargain. I'll get this cooked and passed out immediately.$B$BYou and I will have to have a talk later. I'm going to need help that these soldiers just can't offer.

text.title: 赛恩格去哪儿了？
text.objectives: 在千针石林的南海据点找到赛恩格。
text.description: 嘿，$n，你见过我们的枪械工赛恩格吗？$B$B我刚得知海盗抓住了他！他说他打算把步枪卖些给他们还是咋的。$B$B你能不能去东边南海据点帮忙找找看？我打赌是那个整天和他混在一起不干好事的侏儒维兹尔·铜栓惹上的麻烦！

english.title: Where's Synge?
english.objectives: Find Synge at the Southsea Holdfast in Thousand Needles.
english.description: Hey, $n, you haven't seen our gunsmith, Synge, have you?$B$BI just know that the pirates captured him! He said that he was going to try to sell them some rifles, or something.$B$BWould you please look for him up at the Southsea Holdfast to the east? I'll bet that no-good gnome he's always traveling with, Wizzle Brassbolts, got him into trouble!

text.title: 指挥官加洛德·影歌
text.objectives: 跟暗语小径的元素师奥泰尔谈一谈。
text.description: 曾经只有一个人能够配得上同时领导半神和凡人。$B$B他的名字就是加洛德·影歌，他的指挥能力超群，就连塞纳留斯和其他的古神也对他五体投地。$B$B他多年前就行踪不明，所在何处也无人知晓——直到现在。$B$B我们的斥候相信他被关在暗语峡谷的暮光营地里。$B$B你的任务就是渗透到他们当中，把加洛德给救出来。去东南方的暗语小径，跟那个叫做奥泰尔的谈一谈。

english.title: Commander Jarod Shadowsong
english.objectives: Speak to Elementalist Ortell at Darkwhisper Pass.
english.description: Only once has there been a leader capable of commanding demigods and mortals alike.$B$BHis name was Jarod Shadowsong and his ability to lead in battle was such that Cenarius and the other ancients placed themselves under his command.$B$BHe disappeared for years and his whereabouts were unknown.  Until now.$B$BHe is being held captive inside a Twilight camp in Darkwhisper Gorge.$B$BYour job is to infiltrate their ranks and free Jarod.  Speak to the one known as Ortell at Darkwhisper Pass to the southeast.

text.title: 屈尊乞求
text.objectives: 找到萨米尔和马克。
text.description: 你让我脱离了危险，俗话说好人做到底，还有一件小事想麻烦你。$b$b船长萨米尔和马克还流落在外。我确定他们已经抵达了海床地带，但是之后的情形就不得而知了。$b$b没有他们，我是不可能在这种地方生存的。$b$b我是在西边的柯尔普萨之森里跟他们走散的，就是你找到我的地方。$b$b快！他们可能没走多远……
text.completion: Where would we be without you, $r!$b$bI don't want to even imagine!

english.title: Ain't Too Proud to Beg
english.objectives: Find Samir and Mack.
english.description: Now that you've brought me to safety, I'm afraid I must impose upon your kindness just a bit further.$b$bThe captain of our ship, Samir, is still out there. Mack too. I'm sure they made it to the sea floor but beyond that I didn't see what became of them.$b$bI simply couldn't get by in a place like this without their help.$b$bI lost sight of them in a clump of kelp west of where you found me.$b$bPlease hurry! They couldn't have gotten far...
english.completion: Where would we be without you, $r!$b$bI don't want to even imagine!

text.title: 灰槌，传送门之主
text.objectives: 杀死灰槌，找到天启之书。
text.description: 暮光之锤使用许多像这些的通道，将补给物资从元素位面运往艾泽拉斯。要封闭这些通道，我们就必须搞清楚它们的构造是怎样的。$B$B帮我找到天启之书，元素生物就是用它打开位面之间的通路。$B$B传送门之主灰槌应该就有一本，你必须把他干掉。多加小心！他可不是好对付的……
text.progress: The tome! Have you found it?
text.completion: This is the tome we've heard about?$B$B<Jordan hefts the stone slab into his arms and looks it over.>$B$BI see... I guess it's good that I can read some of the elemental script. I'll work on translating this. Meanwhile, there's one final problem to take care of.
text.giverWindow: 小心：灰槌几乎一定会从其他的元素位面召唤帮手。

english.title: Cindermaul, the Portal Master
english.objectives: Slay Cindermaul and locate the Tome of Openings.
english.description: Twilight's Hammer is using these corridors, and others like them, to move supplies from the elemental planes up into Azeroth. In order to seal these passages off, we're going to need to know how they're constructed.$B$BFind for me the Tome of Openings, used by the elementals to open gates between the planes.$B$BCindermaul the Portal Master should have one. You'll have to kill him. Careful! He's probably got some tricks up his sleeve...
english.progress: The tome! Have you found it?
english.completion: This is the tome we've heard about?$B$B<Jordan hefts the stone slab into his arms and looks it over.>$B$BI see... I guess it's good that I can read some of the elemental script. I'll work on translating this. Meanwhile, there's one final problem to take care of.
english.giverWindow: Be careful: Cindermaul will almost certainly call forth reinforcements from the other elemental planes.

text.title: 铸炉之主派伦迪乌斯
text.objectives: 杀死铸炉之主派伦迪乌斯。将他引诱到传送符文旁边，然后使用符文来削弱他。
text.description: 一股可怕的邪恶力量盘踞在这座山洞的中心，$n。铸炉之主派伦迪乌斯亲自打造了许多武器，供暮光之锤用来征服上面的世界。$B$B在我们离开这个烈焰的世界之前……必须除掉派伦迪乌斯。$B$B他可不会坐以待毙。但是，如果我对天启之书的研究结果没错的话，我们可以短暂地开启一些通往水的世界——深渊之喉的通道。将派伦迪乌斯引到传送符文旁，然后启动符文，就可以削弱他！
text.completion: 'It is done! We''ll seal this fiery hole up behind us and let the minions of the Twilight''s Hammer discover the corpses we left behind. We couldn''t have done it without you, $n!'
text.giverWindow: 使用铸炉之主周围的符文来消灭他。单打独斗可不是他的对手。

english.title: Forgemaster Pyrendius
english.objectives: Slay Forgemaster Pyrendius. Lure him onto the Portal Runes and use them to weaken him.
english.description: A terrible evil squats in the heart of this cavern, $n. Forgemaster Pyrendius has personally crafted many of the cursed weapons that Twilight's Hammer is using in their conquest of the realms above.$B$BBefore we leave these lands of flame... Pyrendius must die.$B$BHe will not go down easy. But, if I'm reading the tome correctly, we can briefly open up small gateways to the Abyssal Maw, the realm of water. Lure Pyrendius onto a portal rune and activate it to weaken him!
english.completion: 'It is done! We''ll seal this fiery hole up behind us and let the minions of the Twilight''s Hammer discover the corpses we left behind. We couldn''t have done it without you, $n!'
english.giverWindow: Use the runes that circle Pyrendius to destroy him. He's too strong to fight alone!

text.title: 尖子生
text.objectives: 跟海加尔山哀求熔炉的导师密尔瓦谈一谈。
text.description: 这就是了，“$n·丹玛斯！”你是班里的头一名！$B$B你有机会让这个星球上最狂热、最嗜血、最不要命的人们刮目相看。$B$B去向你的导师报到，了解一下详情，但要记住：你的目的是利用天选者之座的食人魔跟其他非特权种族之间的矛盾。$B$B要是一切顺利的话，我们就能在即将到来的暴动中把加洛德劫出来。

english.title: Head of the Class
english.objectives: Speak to instructor Mylva at the Forge of Supplication in Hyjal.
english.description: That settles it, "$ndamus!"  You are head of your class!$B$BYou will get a chance to address a crowd of the most fanatical, bloodthirsty and certifiably insane people on this planet.$B$BGo report to your instructor for the details, but remember: your goal is to exploit the animosity between the ogres at the Seat of the Chosen and the other, less privileged races.$B$BIf all goes well, we will smuggle Jarod out of here during the ensuing riot.

text.title: 没有火花，生不了火
text.objectives: 在巴德的挖掘场找到一桶火药。
text.description: 马克依然不省人事，不赶紧生火的话，恐怕他会没命的。这些树枝都湿透了，我们需要特殊的易燃物。$b$b附近有一座被废弃的营地，营地里放着一桶炸药。我没法自己取回它。$b$b你愿意帮我跑一趟吗？为了马克？
text.progress: Did you get the explosives from the camp, $c?
text.completion: Outstanding!$b$bLet's see if this does the trick....$b$bStand back, $n!

english.title: Can't Start a Fire Without a Spark
english.objectives: Get the Keg of Gunpowder from Budd's Dig.
english.description: Mack's still out of it, and I fear we may lose him if I can't get this fire started. With the wood being soaked, we'll need something special to get it going.$b$bThere's an abandoned camp nearby with a barrel of explosives in it. There's no way I can recover it on my own.$b$bWould you mind hauling it back for us? For Mack?
english.progress: Did you get the explosives from the camp, $c?
english.completion: Outstanding!$b$bLet's see if this does the trick....$b$bStand back, $n!

text.title: Hammering It Out
text.objectives: Take the Mysterious Device to Stormwind, Ironforge, Exodar or Darnassus and show it to an Earthen Ring Representative.
text.description: The rift that was here left behind this strange device, but why?$B$BSomeone in a capital city may have more information.

english.title: Hammering It Out
english.objectives: Take the Mysterious Device to Stormwind, Ironforge, Exodar or Darnassus and show it to an Earthen Ring Representative.
english.description: The rift that was here left behind this strange device, but why?$B$BSomeone in a capital city may have more information.

text.title: 侏儒通讯器
text.objectives: 收集8份低劣的地精科技。
text.description: 地精让我觉得恶心。他们低劣的科技哪儿都比不上侏儒，然而……$B$B<萨克萨克教授叹了口气。>$B$B它却是拼图的最后一块！少了低劣的地精科技，侏儒通讯器就没法制造！$B$B到东边的“研发部”去，把他们低劣的地精垃圾给拿来！大多数应该都能在地精技师身上找到。$B$B<萨克萨克嘲讽地大笑起来。>$B$B地精技师？那是什么？$B$B<萨克萨克教授耸耸肩。>$B$B说反话吗？
text.progress: Ze junk? Do you have zit?
text.completion: Ah, ze junk haz arrived! Zit is ze last piece of ze puzzle! Now to zet it up! Standby, $N!

english.title: Ze Gnomecorder
english.objectives: Recover 8 pieces of Filthy Goblin Technology.
english.description: Zese goblinz dizgust me. Zer filzy goblin technology iz inferior to anyzing gnomish, yet...$B$B<Professor Xakxak sighs.>$B$BIt iz ze last piece of ze puzzle! Wizout ze filzy goblin technology ze gnomecorder cannot be built!$B$BVenture eazt into ze "Skunkworks" and take from zem zer filzy goblin junk! You vill most likely find zem on goblin technicians.$B$B<Professor Xakxak laughs mockingly.>$B$BGoblin technician? Vut iz zat anyvay?$B$B<Professor Xakxak shrugs.>$B$BZome kind of oxymoron?
english.progress: Ze junk? Do you have zit?
english.completion: Ah, ze junk haz arrived! Zit is ze last piece of ze puzzle! Now to zet it up! Standby, $N!

text.title: 刀劈火燎
text.objectives: 骑上一头翡翠幼龙，消灭40个暮光之锤单位和5头暮光幼龙。
text.description: 胜利是可能的，$n。$B$B这扇传送门不仅能将塞纳留斯从梦境中带回来。想想看吧，$n，一旦通往翡翠梦境的界门被打开，我们的部队就能用它自由出入月光林地、诺达希尔，甚至龙眠神殿，所有这些战略要冲。$B$B伊瑟拉需要的就是时间。要阻止暮光之锤在暗语峡谷的部队集结起来从东部攻打我们，就全得看你了。$B$B骑一条翡翠幼龙，去把他们杀个落花流水，$n。

english.title: Slash and Burn
english.objectives: Ride an Emerald Drake and slay 40 Twilight's Hammer units and 5 Twilight Drakes.
english.description: Victory is possible, $n.$B$BThis portal is not just a means of bringing back Cenarius through the dream.  Think about it, $n.  Once a gateway through the Emerald Dream is open, our forces can use them to move freely from Moonglade, Nordrassil, and even Wyrmrest, to this strategic location.$B$BAll Ysera needs is time. It'll be up to you to keep the Twilight's Hammer forces in Darkwhisper Gorge from pulling together and attacking us from the east.$B$BTake one of the emerald drakes and hit them hard, $n.

text.title: 湖底沉宝
text.objectives: 收集8个沉没的宝箱。
text.description: 笼子的钥匙在海盗将军托尼·双牙手里，身边还有食人魔环侍左右，你杀不光的！$B$B<维兹尔哭闹了一阵，突然抬起头来，有了主意。>$B$B我有了！海盗们最想要的是什么？不，不是老酒。更棒的东西……财宝！$B$B他们有一整船财宝因为鲸鲨袭击沉在了闪光巨湖底。$B$B快去给我捞起来！

english.title: Sunken Treasure
english.objectives: Collect 8 Sunken Treasure Chests.
english.description: The key to the cage is held by Tony Two-Tusk, the pirate admiral, and he's guarded by ogres that you'll never be able to kill!$B$B<Wizzle cries some more and then looks up, an idea forming in his brain.>$B$BI've got it! What do all pirates want more than anything else? No, not grog. Something even better... treasure!$B$BThey had a ship full of treasure that was sunk by a giant whale-shark. The treasure is scattered all over down in the Mirage Abyss to the northwest.$B$BGo get it!

text.title: 湖底沉宝
text.objectives: 收集8个沉没的宝箱。
text.description: 笼子的钥匙在海盗将军托尼·双牙手里，身边还有食人魔环侍左右，你杀不光的！$B$B<维兹尔哭闹了一阵，突然抬起头来，有了主意。>$B$B我有了！海盗们最想要的是什么？不，不是老酒。更棒的东西……财宝！$B$B他们有一整船财宝因为鲸鲨袭击沉在了闪光巨湖底。$B$B去捞！
text.progress: You already have all of that sunken treasure?
